1b145676f8410d38734679d3b7209337d110e41d.zh_abstract: 小病灶在严重感染的早期疾病诊断和干预中起着关键作用。流行模型在分割小病灶时常常面临挑战，因为它在图像中只占很小一部分，而下采样操作可能不可避免地失去对小病灶局部特征的关注。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种小尺寸敏感 Mamba（Small-Size-Sensitive Mamba, S³-Mamba），它从三个维度提升对小病灶的敏感性：通道、空间和训练策略。具体而言，设计了一个增强视觉状态空间（Enhanced Visual State Space）块，通过多个残差连接聚焦小病灶以保留局部特征，并通过通道注意力选择性地放大重要细节，同时抑制无关细节。设计了一种基于张量的跨特征多尺度注意力（Tensor-based Cross-feature Multi-scale Attention），以整合输入图像特征和中间层特征，并 ed

134faaddd00156e87826c62a73dc24f6d0587c9c.title: Controllable Protein Sequence Generation with LLM Preference Optimization
134faaddd00156e87826c62a73dc24f6d0587c9c.abstract: Designing proteins with specific attributes offers an important solution to address biomedical challenges. Pre-trained protein large language models (LLMs) have shown promising results on protein sequence generation. However, to control sequence generation for specific attributes, existing work still exhibits poor functionality and structural stability. In this paper, we propose a novel controllable protein design method called CtrlProt. We finetune a protein LLM with a new multi-listwise preference optimization strategy to improve generation quality and support multi-attribute controllable generation. Experiments demonstrate that CtrlProt can meet functionality and structural stability requirements effectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both single-attribute and multi-attribute protein sequence generation.
134faaddd00156e87826c62a73dc24f6d0587c9c.zh_title: CtrlProt：基于大模型偏好优化的可控蛋白质序列生成
134faaddd00156e87826c62a73dc24f6d0587c9c.summary: 提出CtrlProt，通过新的多列表偏好优化微调蛋白质大模型，实现可控属性的蛋白质序列生成。
key_points: 预训练蛋白质大模型在序列生成上已显成效
现有方法在功能与结构稳定性控制上表现欠佳
采用新的多列表偏好优化进行微调
134faaddd00156e87826c62a73dc24f6d0587c9c.zh_abstract: 设计具有特定属性的蛋白质为解决生物医学挑战提供了重要方案。预训练蛋白质大语言模型（LLMs）在蛋白质序列生成方面已显示出有前景的结果。然而，为了针对特定属性控制序列生成，现有工作仍表现出较差的功能性和结构稳定性。本文中，我们提出了一种新的可控蛋白质设计方法，称为 CtrlProt。我们采用一种新的多列表偏好优化（multi-listwise preference optimization）策略微调蛋白质 LLM，以提高生成质量并支持多属性可控生成。实验表明，CtrlProt 能够有效满足功能性和结构稳定性要求，在单属性和多属性蛋白质序列生成中均达到最先进性能。

fe9044695f693e7c26e4439b5c04bf9c8053d923.title: PET2Rep: Towards Vision-Language Model-Drived Automated Radiology Report Generation for Positron Emission Tomography
fe9044695f693e7c26e4439b5c04bf9c8053d923.abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is a cornerstone of modern oncologic and neurologic imaging, distinguished by its unique ability to illuminate dynamic metabolic processes that transcend the anatomical focus of traditional imaging technologies. Radiology reports are essential for clinical decision making, yet their manual creation is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Recent advancements of vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential in medical applications, presenting a promising avenue for automating report generation. However, existing applications of VLMs in the medical domain have predominantly focused on structural imaging modalities, while the unique characteristics of molecular PET imaging have largely been overlooked. To bridge the gap, we introduce PET2Rep, a large-scale comprehensive benchmark for evaluation of general and medical VLMs for radiology report gen
fe9044695f693e7c26e4439b5c04bf9c8053d923.zh_title: PET2Rep：面向PET的视觉语言模型报告生成
fe9044695f693e7c26e4439b5c04bf9c8053d923.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 PET2Rep，用视觉语言模型自动生成正电子发射断层成像的放射学报告。
key_points: PET 反映代谢动态，是肿瘤与神经影像重要手段
放射学报告对临床决策关键，但人工撰写耗时
视觉语言模型在医学应用中展现潜力
fe9044695f693e7c26e4439b5c04bf9c8053d923.zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）是现代肿瘤学和神经学成像的基石，其独特能力在于能够揭示超越传统成像技术解剖学焦点的动态代谢过程。放射学报告对于临床决策至关重要，但人工创建这些报告既费力又耗时。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展在医学应用中显示出强大潜力，为自动化报告生成提供了有前景的途径。然而，VLMs在医学领域的现有应用主要集中于结构性成像模态，而分子PET成像的独特特征在很大程度上被忽视。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 PET2Rep，一个用于评估通用和医学VLMs进行放射学报告生成的大规模综合基准

fba1e06fc5f2d0bf9fc979c237862f4f3b1da924.title: EHRStruct: A Comprehensive Benchmark Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models on Structured Electronic Health Record Tasks
fba1e06fc5f2d0bf9fc979c237862f4f3b1da924.abstract:
Structured Electronic Health Record (EHR) data stores patient information in relational tables and plays a central role in clinical decision-making. 
Recent advances have explored the use of large language models (LLMs) to process such data, showing promise across various clinical tasks.
However, the absence of standardized evaluation frameworks and clearly defined tasks makes it difficult to systematically assess and compare LLM performance on structured EHR data.
To address these evaluation challenges, we introduce EHRStruct, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on structured EHR tasks.
EHRStruct defines 11 representative tasks spanning diverse clinical needs and includes 2,200 task-specific evaluation samples derived from two widely used EHR datasets.
We use EHRStruct to evaluate 20 advanced and representative LLMs, covering both general and medical models.

EHRStruct用于统一评估与比较LLM表现

结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据将患者信息存储在关系表中，并在临床决策中发挥核心作用。
近期进展探索了使用大型语言模型（LLMs）处理此类数据，在各种临床任务中显示出前景。

9ed7b977cb81f97f4b952ea51ca17c94d96255d5.title: GapMatch: Bridging Instance and Model Perturbations for Enhanced Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
9ed7b977cb81f97f4b952ea51ca17c94d96255d5.abstract: Medical image segmentation provides detailed understanding and aids in diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring of diseases. Due to the high cost of acquiring labeled data in the field of medical image analysis, semi-supervised segmentation methods have garnered increasing attention. Benefiting from their simplicity and effectiveness, consistency regularization-based methods have emerged as a significant research focus by utilizing perturbations. However, existing methods typically consider perturbation strategies from only a single perspective: either instance perturbation or model perturbation, thus ignoring the potential benefit of effectively combining both. 9ed7b977cb81f97f4b952ea51ca17c94d96255d5.zh_title: GapMatch：融合实例与模型扰动的半监督医学图像分割
9ed7b977cb81f97f4b952ea51ca17c94d96255d5.summary: 提出GapMatch，结合实例与模型扰动的一致性正则，提升半监督医学图像分割。

9ed7b977cb81f97f4b952ea51ca17c94d96255d5.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割提供详细理解，并有助于疾病的诊断、治疗计划和监测。由于在医学图像分析领域获取标注数据成本高昂，半监督分割方法日益受到关注。得益于其简单性和有效性，基于一致性正则化的方法通过利用扰动已成为一个重要的研究焦点。然而，现有方法通常仅从单一视角考虑扰动策略：要么是实例扰动，要么是模型扰动，从而忽略了有效结合二者的潜在益处。为此，我们提出一个名为 GapMatch 的统一扰动框架，它连接实例扰动和模型扰动以拓宽扰动空间，并采用双重扰动对

87d3800347308735f7c341e67414fc338202ac0e.title: Memorize and Rank: Elevating Large Language Models for Clinical Diagnosis Prediction
87d3800347308735f7c341e67414fc338202ac0e.abstract: Clinical diagnosis prediction models, when provided with a patient's medical history, aim to detect potential diseases early, facilitating timely intervention and improving prognostic outcomes. However, the inherent scarcity of patient data and large disease candidate space often pose challenges in developing satisfactory models for this intricate task. The exploration of leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for encapsulating clinical decision processes has been limited. We introduce MERA, a clinical diagnosis prediction model that bridges pertaining natural language knowledge with medical practice. We apply hierarchical contrastive learning on a disease candidate ranking list to alleviate the large decision space issue. With concept memorization through fine-tuning, we bridge the natural language clinical knowledge with medical codes. Experimental results on MIMIC-III and IV datasets

710380efd0adab1af8dbafad17da4e75847fd81b.title: anyECG-chat: A Generalist ECG-MLLM for Flexible ECG Input and Multi-Task Understanding
710380efd0adab1af8dbafad17da4e75847fd81b.abstract: The advent of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has sparked interest in their application to electrocardiogram (ECG) analysis. However, existing ECG-focused MLLMs primarily focus on report generation tasks, often limited to single 12-lead, short-duration (10s) ECG inputs, thereby underutilizing the potential of MLLMs. To this end, we aim to develop a MLLM for ECG analysis that supports a broader range of tasks and more flexible ECG inputs. However, existing ECG-QA datasets are often monotonous. To address this gap, we first constructed the anyECG dataset, which encompasses a wide variety of tasks, including report generation, abnormal waveform localization, and open-ended question answering. In addition to standard hospital ECGs, we introduced long-duration reduced-lead ECGs for home environments and multiple ECG comparison scenarios commonly encountered in clinical practice. Furt
710380efd0adab1af8dbafad17da4e75847fd81b.zh_title: anyECG-chat：通用心电图多模态大模型
710380efd0adab1af8dbafad17da4e75847fd81b.summary: 构建支持灵活心电图输入与多任务理解的通用心电图多模态大语言模型，突破单导联短时程限制。
key_points: 现有ECG多模态大模型多聚焦报告生成
多限于单12导联、10秒输入
支持更广任务与更灵活ECG输入
710380efd0adab1af8dbafad17da4e75847fd81b.zh_abstract: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的出现激发了将其应用于心电图（ECG）分析的兴趣。然而，现有以ECG为中心的MLLMs主要关注报告生成任务，通常局限于单次12导联、短时程（10秒）ECG输入，从而未能充分利用MLLMs的潜力。为此，我们旨在开发一种用于ECG分析的MLLM，支持更广泛的任务和更灵活的ECG输入。然而，现有ECG-QA数据集往往单调。为弥补这一空白，我们首先构建了anyECG数据集，涵盖多种任务，包括报告生成、异常波形定位和开放式问答。除标准医院ECG外，我们引入了用于家庭环境的长时程减少导联ECG，以及临床实践中常见的多种ECG比较场景。Furt

63a1f67c57e83974b34135902901cb169d2e8195.title: Towards Realistic Semi-supervised Medical Image Classification
63a1f67c57e83974b34135902901cb169d2e8195.abstract: Existing semi-supervised learning (SSL) approaches follow the idealized closed-world assumption, neglecting the challenges present in realistic medical scenarios, such as open-set distribution and imbalanced class distribution. Although some methods in natural domains attempt to address the open-set problem, they are insufficient for medical domains, where intertwined challenges like class imbalance and small inter-class lesion discrepancies persist. Thus, this paper presents a novel self-recalibrated semantic training framework, which is tailored for SSL in medical imaging by ingeniously harvesting realistic unlabeled samples. Inspired by the observation that certain open-set samples share some similar disease-related representations with in-distribution samples, we first propose an informative sample selection strategy that identifies high-value samples to serve as augmentations, there
63a1f67c57e83974b34135902901cb169d2e8195.zh_title: 面向真实场景的半监督医学图像分类
63a1f67c57e83974b34135902901cb169d2e8195.summary: 指出既有半监督学习依赖闭集假设，提出面向开集与类别不平衡的医学图像分类新方法。

真实医学场景存在开集分布与类别不平衡
类间病灶差异小增加任务难度
63a1f67c57e83974b34135902901cb169d2e8195.zh_abstract: 现有的半监督学习（SSL）方法遵循理想化的封闭世界假设，忽略了现实医学场景中存在的挑战，例如开放集分布和类别分布不平衡。尽管自然领域中的一些方法尝试解决开放集问题，但它们对医学领域而言并不充分，因为医学领域中类别不平衡和类间病灶差异小等相互交织的挑战持续存在。因此，本文提出了一种新颖的自重校准语义训练框架，该框架通过巧妙利用真实的无标注样本，专为医学影像中的 SSL 量身定制。受以下观察启发：某些开放集样本与分布内样本共享一些相似的疾病相关表示，我们首先提出一种信息性样本选择策略，该策略识别高价值样本以作为增强，there

4b2056c011210e3277f3904a0d4ddb822cb0aece.title: Knowledge-Guided Domain Adaptation Model for Transferring Drug Response Prediction from Cell Lines to Patients
4b2056c011210e3277f3904a0d4ddb822cb0aece.abstract: Drug response prediction (DRP) is a longstanding challenge in modern oncology that underpins personalized treatment. Early DRP methods, trained on label-rich cell line samples, suffer from performance degradation when applied to label-scarce patient samples due to the distribution shift. Recently, a few transfer learning efforts have addressed this issue by aligning cell line (source domain) and patient (target domain) data via unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). However, these efforts often treat each drug's response prediction as an isolated task, requiring model retraining when the drug changes; and focus only on aligning data distributions as a whole, neglecting the category (e.g., different cancers or tissues) confusion problem. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided domain adaptation model to transfer the DRP from cell lines to patients, named TransDRP. Speci

4b2056c011210e3277f3904a0d4ddb822cb0aece.summary: AAAI 2025提出知识引导域适应模型，缓解细胞系与患者数据分布偏移，提升患者药物反应预测。
key_points: 药物反应预测支撑肿瘤个体化治疗

4665632b051e0933084eac0930879c5ce4befc31.title: Leveraging Anatomical Consistency for Multi-Object Detection in Ultrasound Images via Source-free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
4665632b051e0933084eac0930879c5ce4befc31.abstract:
Source-free unsupervised domain adaptation aims to eliminate domain shifts when data from the source domain and annotation from the target domain are not available.
The multi-object detection tasks in medical image analysis are constrained by patient privacy and extremely huge annotation consumption. Hence, Source-free UDA is considered a more practical approach for eliminating the domain gap. However, relevant research that explores this topic is a dearth.
In this paper, we design an Anatomy-aware Alignment Teacher-Student learning method using topological consistency based on a mean-teacher framework for Source-free UDA in multiple medical object detection named AATS, including Unsupervised Structure Refinement (USR) and Graph-aware Morphology Alignment (GMA).

4665632b051e0933084eac0930879c5ce4befc31.zh_title: 利用解剖一致性实现超声图像多目标检测的无源无监督域适应
4665632b051e0933084eac0930879c5ce4befc31.summary: 该研究设计解剖感知方法，通过无源无监督域适应提升超声图像多目标检测。

医学多目标检测受隐私与标注成本限制

3f0f24f7f0e41467c445825540748ddbac8b4a7f.title: A Disease-Aware Dual-Stage Framework for Chest X-ray Report Generation
3f0f24f7f0e41467c445825540748ddbac8b4a7f.abstract: Radiology report generation from chest X-rays is an important task in artificial intelligence with the potential to greatly reduce radiologists’ workload and shorten patient wait times. Despite recent advances, existing approaches often lack sufficient disease-awareness in visual representations and adequate vision-language alignment to meet the specialized requirements of medical image analysis. As a result, these models usually overlook critical pathological features on chest X-rays and struggle to generate clinically accurate reports. To address these limitations, we propose a novel dual-stage disease-aware framework for chest X-ray report generation. 3f0f24f7f0e41467c445825540748ddbac8b4a7f.zh_title: 面向胸片报告生成的疾病感知双阶段框架

key_points: 胸片报告生成可减轻阅片负担与等待时间
现有方法缺乏疾病感知视觉表示

3f0f24f7f0e41467c445825540748ddbac8b4a7f.zh_abstract: 从胸部X光片生成放射学报告是人工智能中的一项重要任务，具有大幅减少放射科医生工作量和缩短患者等待时间的潜力。尽管近期取得了进展，现有方法通常在视觉表征中缺乏足够的疾病感知能力，并且缺乏充分的视觉-语言对齐，无法满足医学图像分析的专门要求。因此，这些模型通常忽略胸部X光片上的关键病理特征，并难以生成临床准确的报告。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的双阶段疾病感知框架，用于胸部X光片报告生成。在阶段1中，我们的模型通过交叉注意力机制和多标签分类学习对应于特定病理类别的疾病感知语义Token（DASTs），同时对齐视觉和语言表征

2149eedd06f11eeb7f16ccbf4a47b4784ab2b5cb.title: MEPNet: Medical Entity-balanced Prompting Network for Brain CT Report Generation
2149eedd06f11eeb7f16ccbf4a47b4784ab2b5cb.abstract: The automatic generation of brain CT reports has gained widespread attention, given its potential to assist radiologists in diagnosing cranial diseases. However, brain CT scans involve extensive medical entities, such as diverse anatomy regions and lesions, exhibiting highly inconsistent spatial patterns in 3D volumetric space. This leads to biased learning of medical entities in existing methods, resulting in repetitiveness and inaccuracy in generated reports. To this end, we propose a Medical Entity-balanced Prompting Network (MEPNet), which harnesses the large language model (LLM) to fairly interpret various entities for accurate brain CT report generation. By introducing the visual embedding and the learning status of medical entities as enriched clues, our method prompts the LLM to balance the learning of diverse entities, thereby enhancing reports with comprehensive findings. 2149eedd06f11eeb7f16ccbf4a47b4784ab2b5cb.zh_title: MEPNet：面向脑CT报告生成的医学实体均衡提示网络

2149eedd06f11eeb7f16ccbf4a47b4784ab2b5cb.zh_abstract: 脑CT报告的自动生成已引起广泛关注，因为它具有辅助放射科医生诊断颅脑疾病的潜力。然而，脑CT扫描涉及大量医学实体，例如多样的解剖区域和病变，在三维体积空间中表现出高度不一致的空间模式。这导致现有方法中对医学实体的学习存在偏倚，从而造成生成报告中的重复性和不准确性。为此，我们提出了医学实体平衡提示网络（MEPNet），它利用大型语言模型（LLM）公平地解读各种实体，以准确生成脑CT报告。通过引入视觉嵌入和医学实体的学习状态作为丰富线索，我们的方法提示LLM平衡多样实体的学习，从而以全面的发现增强报告。首先

1e4390393ee1daa02bf15bbdfc4f288811ab8377.title: Beyond N-grams: A Hierarchical Reward Learning Framework for Clinically-Aware Medical Report Generation
1e4390393ee1daa02bf15bbdfc4f288811ab8377.abstract: Automatic medical report generation can greatly reduce the workload of doctors, but it is often unreliable for real-world deployment. Current methods can write formally fluent sentences but may be factually flawed, introducing serious medical errors known as clinical hallucinations, which make them untrustworthy for diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we introduce HiMed-RL, a Hierarchical Medical Reward Learning Framework designed to explicitly prioritize clinical quality. HiMed-RL moves beyond simple text matching by deconstructing reward learning into three synergistic levels: it first ensures linguistic fluency at the token-level, then enforces factual grounding at the concept-level by aligning key medical terms with expert knowledge, and finally assesses high-level diagnostic consistency at the semantic-level using a specialized LLM verifier. 1e4390393ee1daa02bf15bbdfc4f288811ab8377.zh_title: HiMed-RL：临床感知的医学报告生成奖励学习框架
1e4390393ee1daa02bf15bbdfc4f288811ab8377.summary: 提出分层医学奖励学习框架HiMed-RL，以优先保证报告生成的临床质量，应对临床幻觉问题。

1e4390393ee1daa02bf15bbdfc4f288811ab8377.zh_abstract: 自动医学报告生成可以极大减轻医生的工作量，但在真实世界部署中往往不可靠。当前方法能够写出形式上流畅的句子，但可能在事实上存在缺陷，引入被称为临床幻觉（clinical hallucinations）的严重医学错误，使其在诊断中不可信。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 HiMed-RL，一种分层医学奖励学习框架（Hierarchical Medical Reward Learning Framework），旨在明确优先考虑临床质量。HiMed-RL 超越简单的文本匹配，将奖励学习解构为三个协同层次：首先在 token 级别确保语言流畅性，然后在概念级别通过将关键医学术语与专家知识对齐来强制事实基础，最后使用专门的 LLM 验证器在语义级别评估高层诊断一致性。这种分层奖励通过一个

871b49f2391259bc47d4d1624af4ed6a4a68f211.title: Exploit Your Latents: Coarse-Grained Protein Backmapping with Latent Diffusion Models
871b49f2391259bc47d4d1624af4ed6a4a68f211.abstract: Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics of proteins is a preferred approach to studying large molecules on extended time scales by condensing the entire atomic model into a limited number of pseudo-atoms and preserving the thermodynamic properties of the system. However, the significantly increased efficiency impedes the analysis of substantial physicochemical information, since high-resolution atomic details are sacrificed to accelerate simulation. In this paper, we propose LatCPB, a generative approach based on diffusion that enables high-resolution backmapping of CG proteins. 3a119e58d53c013780d32ef750a5559e3fbbcc5d.title: BiCA: Effective Biomedical Dense Retrieval with Citation-Aware Hard Negatives
3a119e58d53c013780d32ef750a5559e3fbbcc5d.abstract: Hard negatives are essential for training effective retrieval models. Hard-negative mining typically relies on ranking documents using cross-encoders or static embedding models based on similarity metrics such as cosine distance. Hard negative mining becomes challenging for biomedical and scientific domains due to the difficulty in distinguishing between source and hard negative documents. However, referenced documents naturally share contextual relevance with the source document but are not duplicates, making them well-suited as hard negatives. In this work, we propose BiCA: Biomedical Dense Retrieval with Citation-Aware Hard Negatives, an approach for hard-negative mining by utilizing citation links in 20,000 PubMed articles for improving a domain-specific small dense retriever. 3a119e58d53c013780d32ef750a5559e3fbbcc5d.zh_title: BiCA：引用感知难负样本的生物医学密集检索
3a119e58d53c013780d32ef750a5559e3fbbcc5d.summary: 提出BiCA，利用被引文献构造难负样本，提升生物医学与科学领域密集检索效果。

c903e1e16a0075500aa00a288fff29f2305ef90a.title: FedVCK: Non-IID Robust and Communication-Efficient Federated Learning via Valuable Condensed Knowledge for Medical Image Analysis
c903e1e16a0075500aa00a288fff29f2305ef90a.abstract: Federated learning has become a promising solution for collaboration among medical institutions. However, data owned by each institution would be highly heterogeneous and the distribution is always non-independent and identical distribution (non-IID), resulting in client drift and unsatisfactory performance. Despite existing federated learning methods attempting to solve the non-IID problems, they still show marginal advantages but rely on frequent communication which would incur high costs and privacy concerns. In this paper, we propose a novel federated learning method: Federated learning via Valuable Condensed Knowledge (FedVCK). We enhance the quality of condensed knowledge and select the most necessary knowledge guided by models, to tackle the non-IID problem within limited communication budgets effectively. c903e1e16a0075500aa00a288fff29f2305ef90a.zh_title: FedVCK：面向医学图像的非IID鲁棒联邦学习

bf6133cf06d9649d71abf94d21090e798b549b4e.title: CliCARE: Grounding Large Language Models in Clinical Guidelines for Decision Support over Longitudinal Cancer Electronic Health Records
bf6133cf06d9649d71abf94d21090e798b549b4e.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) hold significant promise for improving clinical decision support and reducing physician burnout by synthesizing complex, longitudinal cancer Electronic Health Records (EHRs). However, their implementation in this critical field faces three primary challenges: the inability to effectively process the extensive length and fragmented nature of patient records for accurate temporal analysis; a heightened risk of clinical hallucination, as conventional grounding techniques such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) do not adequately incorporate process-oriented clinical guidelines; and unreliable evaluation metrics that hinder the validation of AI systems in oncology.

b771acee5b7ac13325fbd46cde3f6f2ab3d3ed2f.abstract: Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) is an irreversible neurodegenerative disease affecting 50 million people worldwide. Language impairment is one of the earliest signs of cognitive decline, which can be used to discriminate AD patients from normal control (NC) individuals. Patient-interviewer dialogues may be used to detect such impairments, but they are often mixed with ambiguous, noisy, and irrelevant information, making the AD detection task difficult. Moreover, the limited availability of AD speech samples and variability in their speech styles pose significant challenges in developing robust speech-based AD detection models. Recent studies have shown that PD is closely linked to impairments in facial muscle control, resulting in characteristic “masked face” symptoms. This discovery offers a novel perspective for PD diagnosis by leveraging facial expression recognition and analysis techniques to capture and quantify these features, thereby distinguishing between PD patients and non-PD individuals based on their facial expressions. However, concerns about data privacy and legal restrictions have led to significant “data silos”, posing challenges to data sharing and limiting the accuracy and generalization of existing diagnostic models due to small, localized datasets. However, most current radiology report generation (RRG) models are constrained to a fixed task paradigm, such as predicting the full ''finding'' section from a single image, inherently involving a mismatch between inputs and outputs. The trained models lack the flexibility for diverse inputs and could generate harmful, input-agnostic hallucinations. To bridge the gap between current RRG models and the clinical demands in practice, we first develop a data generation pipeline to create a new MIMIC-RG4 dataset, which considers four common radiology report drafting scenarios and has perfectly corresponded input and output. 6cfca777b65ab5788461b6db0f8d5e5dc7cae64f.zh_title: LLM-RG4：跨输入情境的灵活真实放射报告生成

51c33c7d46c04b2e527815c0589e57337bb35549.abstract: Drug Target Interaction (DTI) prediction has witnessed promising performance boosts accompanied by advanced multimodal feature extraction. However, existing approaches suffer from two main difficulties. First, the complex protein structures cannot be well represented by current protein-sequence-based feature extractors. Second, the gap between protein and drug features increases the vulnerability of the obtained classifier thus degrading the prediction robustness. To address these issues, we propose a novel R-DTI method by exploring the second-order relevance in both protein structural feature extraction and DTI prediction phases. 4f94c6516c04253f9a69d9416fbe0d3175650dd7.title: LungNoduleAgent: A Collaborative Multi-Agent System for Precision Diagnosis of Lung Nodules
4f94c6516c04253f9a69d9416fbe0d3175650dd7.abstract: Diagnosing lung cancer typically involves physicians identifying lung nodules in Computed tomography (CT) scans and generating diagnostic reports based on their morphological features and medical expertise. Although advancements have been made in using multimodal large language models for analyzing lung CT scans, challenges remain in accurately describing nodule morphology and incorporating medical expertise. These limitations affect the reliability and effectiveness of these models in clinical settings. Collaborative multi-agent systems offer a promising strategy for achieving a balance between generality and precision in medical applications, yet their potential in pathology has not been thoroughly explored. While these INR-based methods perform well on relatively dense SVCT reconstructions, they struggle to achieve comparable performance with supervised methods in sparser SVCT scenarios and are prone to being affected by noise, limiting their applicability in real clinical settings. befa564005e8b1a9be5f41b36ffad10df15da86f.title: MedSAMix: A Training-Free Model Merging Approach for Medical Image Segmentation
befa564005e8b1a9be5f41b36ffad10df15da86f.abstract: Universal medical image segmentation models have emerged as a promising paradigm due to their strong generalizability across diverse tasks, showing great potential for a wide range of clinical applications. This potential has been partly driven by the success of general-purpose vision models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM), which has inspired the development of various fine-tuned variants for medical segmentation tasks. 90d7f9744b13d29c4aa52610aed7999954129b6d.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering, yet they often overlook the domain-specific expertise that professionals depend on-such as the clinical subject areas (e.g., trauma, airway) and the certification level (e.g., EMT, Paramedic). Existing approaches typically apply general-purpose prompting or retrieval strategies without leveraging this structured context, limiting performance in high-stakes settings. 81dbec1b95c66ad888253be955ca4dcd0f2182cd.title: A Unified Loss for Handling Inter-Class and Intra-Class Imbalance in Medical Image Segmentation
81dbec1b95c66ad888253be955ca4dcd0f2182cd.abstract: In utilizing deep learning techniques for medical image segmentation, two types of imbalance issues are observed: inter-class imbalance between majority and minority classes and intra-class imbalance between easy and hard samples. However, existing loss functions typically confuse these issues, leading to enhancements that cater to only one aspect. Moreover, loss functions optimized for specific tasks often exhibit limited generalizability. To address these issues, we propose Inter-class and Intra-class Balance loss, as well as a unified loss termed Balance loss. The Inter-class Balance loss controls the extent of hard sample mining for majority class samples by considering the frequency of minority classes present in each input image. This approach requires no manual adjustment weights and adapts automatically to different datasets. The Intra-class Balance loss enhances the network's ab
81dbec1b95c66ad888253be955ca4dcd0f2182cd.zh_title: 医学图像分割类间与类内失衡统一损失
81dbec1b95c66ad888253be955ca4dcd0f2182cd.summary: 提出统一损失函数，同时处理医学图像分割中的类间失衡与类内易难样本失衡问题。
key_points: 指出已有损失混淆两类失衡
兼顾多数类与少数类、易与难样本
旨在提升跨任务泛化性
81dbec1b95c66ad888253be955ca4dcd0f2182cd.zh_abstract: 在利用深度学习技术进行医学图像分割时，观察到两类不平衡问题：多数类与少数类之间的类间不平衡，以及简单样本与困难样本之间的类内不平衡。然而，现有损失函数通常混淆这些问题，导致改进仅迎合一个方面。此外，针对特定任务优化的损失函数通常表现出有限的泛化能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出类间与类内平衡损失（Inter-class and Intra-class Balance loss），以及一种称为平衡损失（Balance loss）的统一损失。类间平衡损失通过考虑每张输入图像中存在的少数类频率，控制对多数类样本进行困难样本挖掘的程度。该方法无需手动调整权重，并能自动适应不同数据集。类内平衡损失增强网络的能力

572363e77a99f32b3a1417bda85f6691357ce9c0.title: Multi-view Evidential Learning-based Medical Image Segmentation
572363e77a99f32b3a1417bda85f6691357ce9c0.abstract: Medical image segmentation provides useful information about the shape and size of organs, which is beneficial for improving diagnosis, analysis, and treatment. Despite traditional deep learning-based models can extract domain-specific knowledge, they face a generalization bottleneck due to the limited embedded knowledge scope. Vision foundation models have been demonstrated to be effective in extracting generalizable knowledge, but they cannot extract domain-specific knowledge without fine-tuning. In this work, we propose a novel multi-view evidential learning-based framework, which can extract both domain-specific and generalizable knowledge from multi-view features by combining the advantages of traditional and vision foundation models. Specifically, a novel multi-view state space model (MV-SSM) is designed to extract task-related knowledge while removing redundant information within
572363e77a99f32b3a1417bda85f6691357ce9c0.zh_title: 基于多视角证据学习的医学图像分割
572363e77a99f32b3a1417bda85f6691357ce9c0.summary: 提出多视角证据学习的医学图像分割方法，利用视觉基础模型的泛化知识并弥补其领域特定知识的不足。
key_points: 医学图像分割反映器官形状与大小
传统深度模型存在泛化瓶颈
视觉基础模型缺乏领域特定知识

5488abb77a2049b25d1650e51eceaba711dc271b.title: CUPCase: Clinically Uncommon Patient Cases and Diagnoses Dataset
5488abb77a2049b25d1650e51eceaba711dc271b.abstract:
Medical benchmark datasets significantly contribute to developing Large Language Models (LLMs) for medical knowledge extraction, diagnosis, summarization, and other uses.
Yet, current benchmarks are mainly derived from exam questions given to medical students or cases described in the medical literature, lacking the complexity of real-world patient cases that deviate from classic textbook abstractions. These include rare diseases, uncommon presentations of common diseases, and unexpected treatment responses. 
Here, we construct Clinically Uncommon Patient Cases and Diagnosis Dataset (CUPCase) based on 3,563 real-world case reports from BMC, which we formulate into diagnoses in open-ended textual format and as multiple-choice options with distractors.
Using this dataset, we evaluate the ability of state-of-the-art LLMs, including both general-purpose and Clinical LLMs, to identify and cor
5488abb77a2049b25d1650e51eceaba711dc271b.zh_title: CUPCase：临床罕见病例与诊断数据集
5488abb77a2049b25d1650e51eceaba711dc271b.summary: 构建包含罕见病与非典型表现的临床患者病例数据集，弥补现有医学基准缺乏真实复杂性的不足。
key_points: 现有基准多来自考卷或文献
缺少偏离教科书的真实病例
涵盖罕见病与非典型表现
5488abb77a2049b25d1650e51eceaba711dc271b.zh_abstract:
医学基准数据集对开发用于医学知识提取、诊断、摘要和其他用途的大型语言模型（LLMs）有重要贡献。
然而，当前的基准主要来源于给医学生的考试题目或医学文献中描述的病例，缺乏偏离经典教科书抽象的真实世界患者病例的复杂性。这些包括罕见病、常见病的罕见表现以及意外的治疗反应。
在此，我们基于来自 BMC 的 3,563 份真实世界病例报告构建了临床罕见患者病例与诊断数据集（CUPCase），我们将其表述为开放式文本格式的诊断以及带有干扰项的多项选择选项。

4a6f8bddc0f609e531d69e22706530696c2f35c3.title: Dr. Tongue: Sign-Oriented Multi-label Detection for Remote Tongue Diagnosis
4a6f8bddc0f609e531d69e22706530696c2f35c3.abstract: Tongue diagnosis is a vital tool in both Western and Traditional Chinese Medicine, providing key insights into a patient's health by analyzing tongue attributes. The COVID-19 pandemic has heightened the need for accurate remote medical assessments, emphasizing the importance of precise tongue attribute recognition via telehealth. To address this, we propose a Sign-Oriented multi-label Attributes Detection Framework. Our approach begins with an adaptive tongue feature extraction module that standardizes tongue images and mitigates environmental factors. This is followed by a Sign-oriented Network (SignNet) that identifies specific tongue attributes, emulating the diagnostic process of experienced practitioners and enabling comprehensive health evaluations. To validate our methodology, we developed an extensive tongue image dataset specifically designed for telemedicine. Unlike existing da
4a6f8bddc0f609e531d69e22706530696c2f35c3.zh_title: Dr. Tongue：面向远程舌诊的体征多标签检测
4a6f8bddc0f609e531d69e22706530696c2f35c3.summary: 提出面向体征的多标签属性检测框架，含自适应舌部特征提取模块，用于远程舌诊的舌象属性识别。
key_points: 舌诊用于分析舌部属性以反映健康状况
疫情提升远程医疗评估的准确识别需求
提出自适应舌部特征提取模块的多标签框架
4a6f8bddc0f609e531d69e22706530696c2f35c3.zh_abstract: 舌诊是西方医学和中医中的重要工具，通过分析舌部属性为了解患者健康状况提供关键见解。COVID-19 大流行加剧了对准确远程医疗评估的需求，凸显了通过远程医疗进行精确舌部属性识别的重要性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向体征的多标签属性检测框架。我们的方法首先是一个自适应舌部特征提取模块，该模块标准化舌部图像并减轻环境因素。随后是一个面向体征的网络（SignNet），用于识别特定的舌部属性，模拟经验丰富的从业者的诊断过程，并实现全面的健康评估。为验证我们的方法，我们开发了一个专门为远程医疗设计的大型舌部图像数据集。与现有的 da

289cf1394f623c2e23cb12706756d107899d4604.title: Toward Better EHR Reasoning in LLMs: Reinforcement Learning with Expert Attention Guidance
289cf1394f623c2e23cb12706756d107899d4604.abstract: Improving large language models (LLMs) for electronic health record (EHR) reasoning is essential for enabling accurate and generalizable clinical predictions. While LLMs excel at medical text understanding, they underperform on EHR-based prediction tasks due to challenges in modeling temporally structured, high-dimensional data. Existing approaches often rely on hybrid paradigms, where LLMs serve merely as frozen prior retrievers while downstream deep learning (DL) models handle prediction, failing to improve the LLM’s intrinsic reasoning capacity and inheriting the generalization limitations of DL models. To this end, we propose EAG-RL, a novel two-stage training framework designed to intrinsically enhance LLMs’ EHR reasoning ability through expert attention guidance, where expert EHR models refer to task-specific DL models trained on EHR data. Concretely, EAG-RL first constructs high-q
289cf1394f623c2e23cb12706756d107899d4604.zh_title: 利用专家注意力引导的强化学习改进LLM的EHR推理
289cf1394f623c2e23cb12706756d107899d4604.summary: 提出结合专家注意力引导的强化学习方法，提升大语言模型对电子健康记录的时间结构推理能力。
key_points: 针对EHR时间结构建模
强化学习结合专家注意力
提升LLM临床预测
289cf1394f623c2e23cb12706756d107899d4604.zh_abstract: 改进用于电子健康记录（electronic health record，EHR）推理的大语言模型（large language models，LLMs）对于实现准确且可泛化的临床预测至关重要。虽然 LLMs 擅长医学文本理解，但由于对时间结构化、高维数据进行建模存在挑战，它们在基于 EHR 的预测任务上表现不佳。现有方法通常依赖混合范式，其中 LLMs 仅作为冻结的先验检索器，而下游深度学习（deep learning，DL）模型负责预测，未能提升 LLM 的内在推理能力，并继承了 DL 模型的泛化局限性。为此，我们提出 EAG-RL，一种新颖的两阶段训练框架，旨在通过专家注意力引导从本质上增强 LLMs 的 EHR 推理能力，其中专家 EHR 模型指在 EHR 数据上训练的特定任务 DL 模型。具体而言，EAG-RL 首先构建 high-q

18dde2e5421c4f5a3aecd4a643b5a8904077958a.title: MHB: Medical Hallucination Benchmark for Large Language Models in Complex Clinical Tasks
18dde2e5421c4f5a3aecd4a643b5a8904077958a.abstract:
The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into clinical applications presents transformative potential but is undermined by the critical risk of hallucination, the generation of plausible but factually incorrect information. Such failures pose a direct threat to patient safety and the integrity of clinical decision-making. To address this challenge, we introduce MHB, a novel and comprehensive benchmark framework designed to evaluate LLM reliability in two complex, high-stakes clinical contexts: multi-turn medical dialogues and clinical case report analysis. The core of our contribution is a systematic methodology for generating adversarial test cases by injecting ``hallucination traps" into realistic medical data, guided by a fine-grained taxonomy of clinical errors.

18dde2e5421c4f5a3aecd4a643b5a8904077958a.zh_title: MHB：复杂临床任务中的大模型医学幻觉基准
18dde2e5421c4f5a3aecd4a643b5a8904077958a.summary: 提出医学幻觉基准 MHB，评估大模型在复杂高风险临床任务中生成似是而非错误信息的问题。
key_points: 聚焦复杂高风险临床任务的幻觉风险
指出幻觉直接威胁患者安全
为评估大模型临床可靠性提供基准框架
18dde2e5421c4f5a3aecd4a643b5a8904077958a.zh_abstract:
将大型语言模型（LLMs）整合到临床应用具有变革性潜力，但受到幻觉这一关键风险的破坏，即生成看似合理但事实上不正确的信息。此类失败对患者安全和临床决策的完整性构成直接威胁。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 MHB，这是一个新颖且全面的基准框架，旨在评估 LLM 在两个复杂、高风险的临床场景中的可靠性：多轮医学对话和临床病例报告分析。我们贡献的核心是一种系统方法，通过将“幻觉陷阱”注入真实的医学数据来生成对抗性测试用例，并以细粒度的临床错误分类法为指导。
MHB 包含 4,695 个样本和 20,288 条评估细则，经过了由 panel o 进行的严格两阶段验证。

da39e4524b3c9ede0ddbd11b57e9de6009be0f95.title: Like an Ophthalmologist: Dynamic Selection Driven Multi-View Learning for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
da39e4524b3c9ede0ddbd11b57e9de6009be0f95.abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), with its large patient population, has become a formidable threat to human visual health. In the clinical diagnosis of DR, multi-view fundus images are considered to be more suitable for DR diagnosis because of the wide coverage of the field of view. Therefore, different from most of the previous single-view DR grading methods, we design a dynamic selection-driven multi-view DR grading method to fit clinical scenarios better. Since lesion information plays a key role in DR diagnosis, previous methods usually boost the model performance by enhancing the lesion feature. However, during the actual diagnosis, ophthalmologists not only focus on the crucial parts, but also exclude irrelevant features to ensure the accuracy of judgment. To this end, we introduce the idea of dynamic selection and design a series of selection mechanisms from fine granularity to coarse g
da39e4524b3c9ede0ddbd11b57e9de6009be0f95.zh_title: 像眼科医生一样：动态选择驱动的多视角糖网分级
da39e4524b3c9ede0ddbd11b57e9de6009be0f95.summary: 提出动态选择驱动的多视角学习方法，用于更贴合临床的糖尿病视网膜病变分级。
key_points: 多视角眼底图像更适配 DR 诊断
动态选择机制驱动多视角学习
区别于既往单视角分级方法
da39e4524b3c9ede0ddbd11b57e9de6009be0f95.zh_abstract: 糖尿病视网膜病变（Diabetic Retinopathy, DR）患者群体庞大，已成为人类视觉健康的重大威胁。在DR的临床诊断中，多视角眼底图像因视野覆盖范围广而被认为更适合DR诊断。因此，与以往大多数单视角DR分级方法不同，我们设计了一种动态选择驱动的多视角DR分级方法，以更好地契合临床场景。由于病变信息在DR诊断中起关键作用，以往方法通常通过增强病变特征来提升模型性能。然而，在实际诊断过程中，眼科医生不仅关注关键部分，还会排除无关特征以确保判断的准确性。为此，我们引入动态选择的思想，并设计了一系列从细粒度到粗粒度的选择机制……

cb875231a29f57b044bdeba38283d83491ed179d.title: Domain Generalized Medical Landmark Detection via Robust Boundary-Aware Pre-Training
cb875231a29f57b044bdeba38283d83491ed179d.abstract: In recent years, deep learning has revenue in automated medical landmark detection. Nonetheless, prevailing research in this field predominantly addresses single-center scenarios or domain adaptation settings. In practical environments, the acquisition of multi-center data faces privacy concerns, coupled with the time-intensive and costly nature of data collection and annotation. These challenges substantially impede the broader application of deep learning-based medical landmark detection. To mitigate these issues, we propose a novel domain-generalized medical landmark detection framework that relies solely on single-center data for training. Considering the availability of numerous public medical segmentation datasets, we design a simple yet effective method that utilizes single-center segmentation to enhance the domain generalization capabilities of the landmark detection task. cb875231a29f57b044bdeba38283d83491ed179d.zh_title: 边界感知预训练实现域泛化医学标志点检测
cb875231a29f57b044bdeba38283d83491ed179d.summary: 针对多中心数据受隐私与标注成本限制的难题，提出鲁棒边界感知预训练方法以提升医学标志点检测的跨域泛化能力。
key_points: 现有研究多局限于单中心或域适应场景
多中心数据获取面临隐私与标注成本障碍
通过边界感知预训练提升域泛化性能
cb875231a29f57b044bdeba38283d83491ed179d.zh_abstract: 近年来，深度学习在自动化医学标志点检测中已产生收益。尽管如此，该领域的主流研究主要针对单中心场景或域适应设置。在实际环境中，多中心数据的获取面临隐私问题，同时数据收集和标注具有耗时且 costly 的性质。这些挑战严重阻碍了基于深度学习的医学标志点检测的更广泛应用。为缓解这些问题，我们提出一种新颖的域泛化医学标志点检测框架，仅依赖单中心数据进行训练。考虑到众多公共医学分割数据集的可用性，我们设计了一种简单而有效的方法，利用单中心分割来增强标志点检测任务的域泛化能力。Specif

c42f21f01a5725c6285c7cff79bdcf5fc84b0f13.title: Advancing Feature Extraction in Healthcare through the Integration of Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models
c42f21f01a5725c6285c7cff79bdcf5fc84b0f13.abstract: The exponential growth of unstructured medical data presents a unique opportunity and challenge for advancing healthcare. Traditional methods struggle to extract meaningful insights from this complex data due to its inherent noise, ambiguity, and heterogeneity. To address these limitations, we propose a novel hybrid approach that integrates Knowledge Graphs (KGs) with Large Language Models (LLMs) within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework. By leveraging the structured knowledge of KGs and the contextual understanding of LLMs, we aim to improve the precision of feature extraction and disease progression modeling. Our research focuses on refining the KG representation through advanced entity extraction and relation extraction techniques, ensuring that the KG accurately captures the semantic nuances and temporal dynamics of medical data. c42f21f01a5725c6285c7cff79bdcf5fc84b0f13.zh_title: 知识图谱与大模型融合提升医疗特征抽取
c42f21f01a5725c6285c7cff79bdcf5fc84b0f13.summary: 提出在检索增强生成框架中融合知识图谱与大语言模型，以应对医疗非结构化数据的噪声、歧义与异质性，改进特征抽取。
key_points: 医疗非结构化数据存在噪声与异质性

借助结构化知识提升特征抽取
c42f21f01a5725c6285c7cff79bdcf5fc84b0f13.zh_abstract: 非结构化医疗数据的指数级增长为推进医疗保健带来了独特的机遇和挑战。传统方法因这类复杂数据固有的噪声、歧义和异质性，难以从中提取有意义的洞见。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种新颖的混合方法，在检索增强生成（RAG）框架内将知识图谱（KGs）与大语言模型（LLMs）相集成。通过利用 KG 的结构化知识和 LLM 的上下文理解，我们旨在提高特征提取和疾病进展建模的精确度。我们的研究聚焦于通过先进的实体抽取和关系抽取技术来改进 KG 表示，确保 KG 准确捕捉医疗数据的语义细微差别和时间动态。通过将这个增强的 KG 与

a60840bc3881d37e57507e6870e263f8a932961c.title: MedSpaformer: A Transferable Transformer with Multi-Granularity Token Sparsification for Medical Time Series Classification
a60840bc3881d37e57507e6870e263f8a932961c.abstract:
Accurate medical time series (MedTS) classification is essential for effective clinical diagnosis, yet remains challenging due to complex multi-channel temporal dependencies, information redundancy, and label scarcity.
While transformer-based models have shown promise in time series analysis, most are designed for forecasting tasks and fail to fully exploit the unique characteristics of MedTS.
In this paper, we introduce MedSpaformer, a transformer-based framework tailored for MedTS classification. It incorporates a sparse token-based dual-attention mechanism that enables global context modeling and token sparsification, allowing dynamic feature refinement by focusing on informative tokens while reducing redundancy.
This mechanism is integrated into a multi-granularity cross-channel encoding scheme to capture intra- and inter-granularity temporal dependencies and inter-channel correlatio
a60840bc3881d37e57507e6870e263f8a932961c.zh_title: MedSpaformer：面向医学时间序列分类的多粒度稀疏Transformer
a60840bc3881d37e57507e6870e263f8a932961c.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 MedSpaformer，用多粒度 token 稀疏化应对医学时间序列的多通道依赖、信息冗余与标签稀缺。
key_points: 面向医学时序分类的Transformer框架
多粒度token稀疏化设计

a60840bc3881d37e57507e6870e263f8a932961c.zh_abstract:
准确的医学时间序列（MedTS）分类对于有效的临床诊断至关重要，但由于复杂的多通道时间依赖、信息冗余和标签稀缺，仍然具有挑战性。
尽管基于 transformer 的模型在时间序列分析中已显示出前景，但大多数是为预测任务设计的，未能充分利用 MedTS 的独特特征。

98e7f4f464c2e890a4b32541dde474f8e5fcb7e4.title: Perturbating, Tuning, and Collaborating: Harnessing Vision Foundation Models for Single Domain Generalization on Medical Imaging
98e7f4f464c2e890a4b32541dde474f8e5fcb7e4.abstract: Single Domain Generalization (SDG) is critical in medical imaging applications. Recently, Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have spearheaded a trend in AI development due to their robust generalizability and versatility. This work aims to fully explore the generalization capabilities of VFMs alongside the domain-specific expertise of specialized models, thoroughly investigating the boundaries of their respective capabilities, thereby collaboratively addressing SDG challenges within medical imaging. We propose a framework for Collaborative reasoning between Specialized and Universal models for Single Domain Generalization (CollaSU-SDG) in medical imaging. 8246d9d22ed7ec16910f95baf864bb608f75dea0.title: Towards Effective and Efficient Context-aware Nucleus Detection in Histopathology Whole Slide Images
8246d9d22ed7ec16910f95baf864bb608f75dea0.abstract: Nucleus detection in histopathology whole slide images (WSIs) is crucial for a broad spectrum of clinical applications. The gigapixel size of WSIs necessitates the use of sliding window methodology for nucleus detection. However, mainstream methods process each sliding window independently, which overlooks broader contextual information and easily leads to inaccurate predictions. To address this limitation, recent studies additionally crop a large Filed-of-View (LFoV) patch centered on each sliding window to extract contextual features. However, such methods substantially increase whole-slide inference latency. In this work, we propose an effective and efficient context-aware nucleus detection approach. 8246d9d22ed7ec16910f95baf864bb608f75dea0.zh_title: 病理全切片图像上下文感知细胞核检测

4680f01a9801ae775fabdb797afbaf9f832974ce.title: Dual-calibrated Co-training Framework for Personalized Federated Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
4680f01a9801ae775fabdb797afbaf9f832974ce.abstract: Federated Semi-Supervised Learning (FSSL) has emerged as a crucial topic in medical image analysis, allowing multiple medical institutions to collaboratively train a global model using limited labeled data. However, existing FSSL methods focus solely on an effective combination of federated learning and semi-supervised learning, ignoring the heterogeneity of client data and the inadaptability of semi-supervised methods in diverse environments, which leads to knowledge bias in local models and impedes stable convergence. To this end, we explore the application of personalization in FSSL and propose a novel dual-calibrated co-training framework. To adapt to the unique feature distribution of client data, we consider collaborative relationships among clients to aggregate a personalized model for each client. 4680f01a9801ae775fabdb797afbaf9f832974ce.zh_title: 双校准协同训练用于个性化联邦半监督医学图像分割

key_points: 针对联邦半监督学习的客户端数据异构

4680f01a9801ae775fabdb797afbaf9f832974ce.zh_abstract: 联邦半监督学习（Federated Semi-Supervised Learning, FSSL）已成为医学图像分析中的一个关键课题，允许多个医疗机构使用有限的标记数据协作训练一个全局模型。然而，现有的 FSSL 方法仅关注联邦学习和半监督学习的有效结合，忽视了客户端数据的异质性以及半监督方法在不同环境中的不适应性，这导致局部模型中的知识偏差并阻碍稳定收敛。为此，我们探索了 FSSL 中个性化的应用，并提出了一种新颖的双校准协同训练框架。为了适应客户端数据的独特特征分布，我们考虑客户端之间的协作关系，为每个客户端聚合一个个性化模型。我们进一步构建了一个双学生架构，包含个性化模型和私有

426c959e02ff927f68095721e5b4a3ee3bab7a3b.title: MedAtlas: Evaluating LLMs for Multi-Round, Multi-Task Medical Reasoning Across Diverse Imaging Modalities and Clinical Text
426c959e02ff927f68095721e5b4a3ee3bab7a3b.abstract: Artificial intelligence has demonstrated significant potential in clinical decision-making; however, developing models capable of adapting to diverse real-world scenarios and performing complex diagnostic reasoning remains a major challenge. Existing medical multi-modal benchmarks are typically limited to single-image, single-turn tasks, lacking multi-modal medical image integration and failing to capture the longitudinal and multi-modal interactive nature inherent to clinical practice. To address this gap, we introduce MedAtlas, a novel benchmark framework designed to evaluate large language models on realistic medical reasoning tasks. MedAtlas is characterized by four key features: multi-round visual question answering (VQA), Joint reasoning of multiple modalities of medical images, multi-task integration, and high clinical fidelity. It supports four core tasks: open-ended multi-round
426c959e02ff927f68095721e5b4a3ee3bab7a3b.zh_title: MedAtlas：多轮多任务医学推理评测基准
426c959e02ff927f68095721e5b4a3ee3bab7a3b.summary: 构建跨多种影像模态与临床文本的多轮多任务医学推理基准，评估大语言模型。

30878c3ce7aac041ec524ae7603777ddeb3987e1.title: Deep Hierarchies and Invariant Disease-Indicative Feature Learning for Computer Aided Diagnosis of Multiple Fundus Diseases
30878c3ce7aac041ec524ae7603777ddeb3987e1.abstract: With the advancement of computer vision, numerous models have been proposed for screening of fundus diseases. However, the recognition of multiple fundus diseases is often hampered by the simultaneous presence of multiple disease types and the confluence of lesion types in fundus images. This paper addresses these challenges by conceptualizing them as multi-level feature fusion and self-supervised disease-indicative feature learning problems. We decode fundus images at various levels of granularity to delineate scenarios wherein multiple diseases and lesions co-occur. To effectively integrate these features, we introduce a hierarchical vision transformer (HVT) that adeptly captures both inter-level and intra-level dependencies. 30878c3ce7aac041ec524ae7603777ddeb3987e1.zh_title: 多眼底疾病辅助诊断的深层级与不变特征学习

2f0d8891f238896fe61cc423adb31f03431c5cd1.title: vMFCoOp: Towards Equilibrium on a Unified Hyperspherical Manifold for Prompting Biomedical VLMs
2f0d8891f238896fe61cc423adb31f03431c5cd1.abstract: Recent advances in context optimization (CoOp) guided by large language model (LLM)–distilled medical semantic priors offer a scalable alternative to manual prompt engineering and full fine-tuning for adapting biomedical CLIP-based vision-language models (VLMs). More critically, pairwise multimodal alignment via conventional Euclidean-space optimization lacks the capacity to model unified representations or apply localized geometric constraints, which tends to amplify modality gaps in complex biomedical imaging and destabilize few-shot adaptation. 2f0d8891f238896fe61cc423adb31f03431c5cd1.zh_title: vMFCoOp：统一超球流形上的生物医学提示学习
2f0d8891f238896fe61cc423adb31f03431c5cd1.summary: 提出vMFCoOp，在统一超球流形上寻求平衡，用于生物医学视觉语言模型的提示优化。

2d522b94a1cc22ce47b76d85b4942e6cb7b65409.title: HHAN: Comprehensive Infectious Disease Source Tracing via Heterogeneous Hypergraph Neural Network
2d522b94a1cc22ce47b76d85b4942e6cb7b65409.abstract: Infectious diseases have historically had profound effects on global health, economies, and social structures. Effective tracing of infectious diseases is essential not only for immediate public health responses but also for shaping future prevention strategies. Traditional tracing methods often emphasize homogeneous networks, overlooking the diverse transmission characteristics of heterogeneous populations. This research addresses two critical challenges: the heterogeneity of transmission across various media and modes, and the significant yet underexplored influence of community structures on epidemic spread and tracing.We propose a Heterogeneous Hypergraph Attention Network (HHAN) modelthat accounts for multiple transmission pathways and patterns within heterogeneous networks. 2d522b94a1cc22ce47b76d85b4942e6cb7b65409.zh_title: 基于异质超图神经网络的传染病溯源

2d522b94a1cc22ce47b76d85b4942e6cb7b65409.zh_abstract: 传染病在历史上对全球健康、经济和社会结构产生了深远影响。有效的传染病追踪不仅对即时公共卫生应对至关重要，而且对塑造未来的预防策略也必不可少。传统追踪方法往往强调同质网络，忽视了异质人群多样的传播特征。本研究应对两个关键挑战：跨各种媒介和模式的传播异质性，以及社区结构对流行病传播和追踪的重要但尚未被充分探索的影响。我们提出一种异质超图注意力网络（Heterogeneous Hypergraph Attention Network, HHAN）模型，该模型考虑异质网络中的多种传播路径和模式。HHAN 集成了一个异质图神经网络模块，以处理 d 之间通信的复杂性。

2a2f1ee39b8a5fe146b8f5f916b42ebdb14210dd.title: mmJEPA-ECG: Cross-Posture Robust Contactless Electrocardiogram Monitoring via Millimeter Wave Radar Sensing

Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers a compelling non-contact alternative by capturing cardiac-induced chest-wall micro-vibrations. Existing radar-to-ECG methods often rely on direct waveform regression, assuming posture-stable mappings that break under natural sleep movements and obscure true cardiac rhythms. 2a2f1ee39b8a5fe146b8f5f916b42ebdb14210dd.zh_title: mmJEPA-ECG：跨体姿毫米波雷达无接触心电监测

1b025c0e33f11af0d91a11a11842dbfdd1c665c9.title: Enhancing Vision-Language Models with Morphological and Taxonomic Knowledge: Towards Coral Recognition for Ocean Health
1b025c0e33f11af0d91a11a11842dbfdd1c665c9.abstract: Coral reefs play a crucial role in marine ecosystems, offering a nutrient-rich environment and safe shelter for numerous marine species. Automated coral image recognition aids in monitoring ocean health at a scale without experts' manual effort. Recently, large vision-language models like CLIP have greatly enhanced zero-shot and low-shot classification capabilities for various visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we compile a fine-grained coral image dataset consisting of 16,659 images with taxonomy labels (from Kingdom to Species), accompanied by morphology-specific text descriptions for each species. f8827d1033b1869798dcfe89171fd5325a684981.title: S2D-ALIGN: Shallow-to-Deep Auxiliary Learning for Anatomically-Grounded Radiology Report Generation
f8827d1033b1869798dcfe89171fd5325a684981.abstract: Radiology Report Generation (RRG) aims to automatically generate diagnostic reports from radiology images. To achieve this, existing methods have leveraged the powerful cross-modal generation capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), primarily focusing on optimizing cross-modal alignment between radiographs and reports through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). f8827d1033b1869798dcfe89171fd5325a684981.zh_title: S2D-ALIGN：解剖学落地的放射报告生成

ca8867d884fec559fe940d95e254e4564683a526.title: When the Domain Expert Has No Time and the LLM Developer Has No Clinical Expertise: Real-World Lessons from LLM Co-Design in a Safety-Net Hospital

Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to address social and behavioral determinants of health by transforming labor intensive workflows in resource-constrained settings. Creating LLM-based applications that serve the needs of underserved communities requires a deep understanding of their local context, but it is often the case that neither LLMs nor their developers possess this local expertise, and the experts in these communities often face severe time/resource constraints.
This creates a disconnect: how can one engage in meaningful co-design of an LLM-based application for an under-resourced community when the communication channel between the LLM developer and domain expert is constrained?

ca8867d884fec559fe940d95e254e4564683a526.zh_title: 安全网医院大模型协同设计的真实经验
ca8867d884fec559fe940d95e254e4564683a526.summary: 总结在安全网医院开展大模型协同设计的经验：开发者缺乏临床与本地知识，领域专家时间与资源受限。
key_points: 大模型可改造资源受限场景的繁重工作流程
服务弱势社区需深入理解其本地情境
领域专家无时间、开发者无临床专长
ca8867d884fec559fe940d95e254e4564683a526.zh_abstract:
大语言模型（LLMs）有潜力通过转变资源受限环境中劳动密集型工作流程，来应对健康的社会与行为决定因素。创建服务于服务不足社区需求的基于 LLM 的应用，需要深入理解其当地情境，但情况往往是 LLMs 及其开发者都不具备这种本地专业知识，而这些社区中的专家常常面临严重的时间/资源限制。

ca3257e1d87699714bfe793329470e6a47be16c5.title: Federated CLIP for Resource-Efficient Heterogeneous Medical Image Classification
ca3257e1d87699714bfe793329470e6a47be16c5.abstract: Despite the remarkable performance of deep models in medical imaging, they still require source data for training, which limits their potential in light of privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL), as a decentralized learning framework that trains a shared model with multiple hospitals (a.k.a., FL clients), provides a feasible solution. However, data heterogeneity and resource costs hinder the deployment of FL models, especially when using vision language models (VLM). To address these challenges, we propose a novel contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP) based FL approach for medical image classification. Specifically, we introduce a masked feature adaptation module (FAM) as a communication module to reduce the communication load while freezing the CLIP encoders to reduce the computational overhead. Furthermore, we propose a masked multi-layer perceptron (MLP) as a private local
ca3257e1d87699714bfe793329470e6a47be16c5.zh_title: 面向异构医学影像的资源高效联邦CLIP分类
ca3257e1d87699714bfe793329470e6a47be16c5.summary: 针对数据异构与资源开销问题，提出资源高效的联邦CLIP用于异构医学影像分类。
key_points: 联邦学习避免医院间共享原始数据
数据异构与资源成本阻碍联邦部署
基于视觉语言模型CLIP进行改进
ca3257e1d87699714bfe793329470e6a47be16c5.zh_abstract: 尽管深度模型在医学影像中表现出色，但它们仍然需要源数据来进行训练，这在隐私担忧下限制了其潜力。联邦学习（FL）作为一种去中心化学习框架，通过与多家医院（又称 FL 客户端）训练共享模型，提供了一种可行解决方案。然而，数据异质性和资源成本阻碍了 FL 模型的部署，尤其是在使用视觉语言模型（VLM）时。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的基于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）的 FL 方法，用于医学图像分类。具体而言，我们引入掩码特征自适应模块（FAM）作为通信模块，以降低通信负载，同时冻结 CLIP 编码器以降低计算开销。此外，我们提出掩码多层感知机（MLP）作为私有本地

a1fefe57cb37935f112ff8b293f3819f5b601b55.title: Stress-Testing of Multimodal Models in Medical Image-Based Report Generation
a1fefe57cb37935f112ff8b293f3819f5b601b55.abstract: Multimodal models, namely vision-language models, present unique possibilities through the seamless integration of different information mediums for data generation. These models mostly act as a black-box, making them lack transparency and explicability. Reliable results require accountable and trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI), namely when in use for critical tasks, such as the automatic generation of medical imaging reports for healthcare diagnosis. By exploring stress-testing techniques, multimodal generative models can become more transparent by disclosing their shortcomings, further supporting their responsible usage in the medical field.
a1fefe57cb37935f112ff8b293f3819f5b601b55.zh_title: 医学影像报告生成多模态模型的压力测试
a1fefe57cb37935f112ff8b293f3819f5b601b55.summary: 针对多模态视觉语言模型在医学影像报告生成中的黑箱特性，探索压力测试技术以评估其可信赖性与可解释性。
key_points: 多模态模型可整合多源信息生成报告
模型多为黑箱，缺乏透明与可解释性
医疗诊断等关键任务需可信赖AI
a1fefe57cb37935f112ff8b293f3819f5b601b55.zh_abstract: 多模态模型，即视觉-语言模型，通过无缝整合不同信息媒介进行数据生成，呈现出独特的可能性。这些模型大多充当黑箱，使其缺乏透明性和可解释性。可靠的结果需要负责任且值得信赖的人工智能（AI），尤其是在用于关键任务时，例如为医疗诊断自动生成医学影像报告。通过探索压力测试技术，多模态生成模型可以通过披露其缺点而变得更加透明，进一步支持其在医学领域的负责任使用。

960d2064376367754879732ab9e085ba6a7fa4a1.title: Integrating Sequence and Image Modeling in Irregular Medical Time Series Through Self-Supervised Learning
960d2064376367754879732ab9e085ba6a7fa4a1.abstract: Medical time series are often irregular and face significant missingness, posing challenges for data analysis and clinical decision-making. Existing methods typically adopt a single modeling perspective, either treating series data as sequences or transforming them into image representations for further classification. In this paper, we propose a joint learning framework that incorporates both sequence and image representations. We also design three self-supervised learning strategies to facilitate the fusion of sequence and image representations, capturing a more generalizable joint representation. The results indicate that our approach outperforms seven other state-of-the-art models in three representative real-world clinical datasets. We further validate our approach by simulating two major types of real-world missingness through leave-sensors-out and leave-samples-out techniques. The
960d2064376367754879732ab9e085ba6a7fa4a1.zh_title: 整合序列与图像建模的不规则医学时间序列自监督学习
960d2064376367754879732ab9e085ba6a7fa4a1.summary: 提出联合学习框架，结合序列与图像表示，并用自监督策略处理不规则医学时间序列。
key_points: 医学时间序列常不规则且存在缺失
现有方法多采用单一建模视角
提出序列-图像联合学习与三种自监督策略
960d2064376367754879732ab9e085ba6a7fa4a1.zh_abstract: 医学时间序列通常不规则且面临大量缺失，给数据分析和临床决策带来挑战。现有方法通常采用单一建模视角，要么将序列数据视为序列，要么将其转换为图像表示以进一步分类。在本文中，我们提出一个联合学习框架，同时整合序列表示和图像表示。我们还设计了三种自监督学习策略，以促进序列表示与图像表示的融合，捕获更具泛化性的联合表示。结果表明，我们的方法在三个具有代表性的真实世界临床数据集上优于其他七种最先进模型。我们进一步通过留传感器（leave-sensors-out）和留样本（leave-samples-out）技术模拟两种主要的真实世界缺失类型，以验证我们的方法。该……

795bfb4b5f75612eeb583bbeac2d5000f55738c6.title: A Stage-Aware Mixture of Experts Framework for Neurodegenerative Disease Progression Modelling
795bfb4b5f75612eeb583bbeac2d5000f55738c6.abstract: The long-term progression of neurodegenerative diseases is commonly conceptualized as a spatiotemporal diffusion process that consists of a graph diffusion process across the structural brain connectome and a localized reaction process within brain regions. However, modeling this progression remains challenging due to 1) the scarcity of longitudinal data obtained through irregular and infrequent subject visits and 2) the complex interplay of pathological mechanisms across brain regions and disease stages, where traditional models assume fixed mechanisms throughout disease progression. To address these limitations, we propose a novel stage-aware Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework that explicitly models how different contributing mechanisms dominate at different disease stages through time-dependent expert weighting. This architecture is a key innovation designed to maximize the utility of
795bfb4b5f75612eeb583bbeac2d5000f55738c6.zh_title: 面向神经退行性疾病进展建模的阶段感知专家混合框架
795bfb4b5f75612eeb583bbeac2d5000f55738c6.summary: 提出阶段感知专家混合框架，将神经退行性疾病进展建模为脑连接组图扩散与脑区局部反应的时空过程。
key_points: 将疾病进展视为时空扩散过程
结合脑连接组图扩散与脑区局部反应
针对纵向随访稀疏与机制交互难题
论文载于AAAI 2025
795bfb4b5f75612eeb583bbeac2d5000f55738c6.zh_abstract: 神经退行性疾病的长期进展通常被概念化为一个时空扩散过程，该过程由跨结构性大脑连接组的图扩散过程和脑区内的局部反应过程组成。然而，对该进展进行建模仍然具有挑战性，原因在于：1）通过不规则且不频繁的受试者访视获得的纵向数据稀缺；2）病理机制在脑区和疾病阶段之间的复杂相互作用，而传统模型假设疾病进展过程中机制固定不变。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的阶段感知专家混合（MoE）框架，该框架通过时间依赖的专家加权明确建模不同贡献机制如何在不同的疾病阶段占据主导。这一架构是一项关键创新，旨在最大化……的效用

6b61e03302810c8301dc2afe4864b488c8e9024d.title: Efficient Deformable Convolutional Prompt for Continual Test-Time Adaptation in Medical Image Segmentation
6b61e03302810c8301dc2afe4864b488c8e9024d.abstract: The domain gap resulting from mismatches in acquisition details like protocol and scanner between training and test data hinders the deployment of the trained model in clinical practice. To address this issue, Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) has been proposed to adapt the source model to continually changing unlabeled domains without accessing the source data. Existing methods learn an image-level visual prompt for target domains and inject the trainable prompt into the input space. However, they either combine the input with a prompt of equal scale or determine the prompt injection position through complex strategies such as uncertainty estimation or Fourier Transform. These approaches substantially increase the number of trainable parameters and computational burden, especially in high-dimensional medical imaging data. To overcome these challenges, we propose the Efficient Deform
6b61e03302810c8301dc2afe4864b488c8e9024d.zh_title: 可变形卷积提示用于医学分割持续测试时适应
6b61e03302810c8301dc2afe4864b488c8e9024d.summary: 提出高效可变形卷积提示方法，用于医学图像分割的持续测试时适应，缓解采集差异导致的域差。
key_points: 采集方案与扫描仪差异形成域差
持续测试时适应无需访问源数据
现有图像级提示方法存局限
6b61e03302810c8301dc2afe4864b488c8e9024d.zh_abstract: 训练数据和测试数据之间因采集细节（如协议和扫描仪）不匹配而产生的域间隙，阻碍了训练模型在临床实践中的部署。为了解决这个问题，持续测试时间适应（CTTA）被提出，以在不访问源数据的情况下，使源模型适应不断变化的无标签域。现有方法为目标域学习图像级视觉提示，并将可训练的提示注入输入空间。然而，它们要么将输入与同等尺度的提示相结合，要么通过复杂策略（如不确定性估计或傅里叶变换）确定提示注入位置。这些方法大幅增加了可训练参数的数量和计算负担，尤其是在高维医学影像数据中。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了高效的可变形（Efficient Deform）

6912fc2f5c6b5ac2631fc5e214d11b1ddc594a61.title: CoCoLIT: ControlNet-Conditioned Latent Image Translation for MRI to Amyloid PET Synthesis
6912fc2f5c6b5ac2631fc5e214d11b1ddc594a61.abstract: Synthesizing amyloid PET scans from the more widely available and accessible structural MRI modality offers a promising, cost-effective approach for large-scale Alzheimer's Disease (AD) screening. This is motivated by evidence that, while MRI does not directly detect amyloid pathology, it may nonetheless encode information correlated with amyloid deposition that can be uncovered through advanced modeling. However, the high dimensionality and structural complexity of 3D neuroimaging data pose significant challenges for existing MRI-to-PET translation methods. Modeling the cross-modality relationship in a lower-dimensional latent space can simplify the learning task and enable more effective translation. 6912fc2f5c6b5ac2631fc5e214d11b1ddc594a61.zh_title: CoCoLIT：由MRI合成淀粉样PET的潜在图像翻译
6912fc2f5c6b5ac2631fc5e214d11b1ddc594a61.summary: 以ControlNet条件潜在图像翻译从结构MRI合成淀粉样PET，探索低成本AD筛查路径。
key_points: MRI可编码与淀粉样沉积相关信息
3D神经影像维度高且结构复杂
合成PET有望支持大规模AD筛查
6912fc2f5c6b5ac2631fc5e214d11b1ddc594a61.zh_abstract: 从更广泛可用且易于获取的结构MRI模态合成淀粉样蛋白PET扫描，为大规模阿尔茨海默病（AD）筛查提供了一种有前景且成本效益高的方法。其动机来源于证据表明，尽管MRI不能直接检测淀粉样蛋白病理，但它可能仍然编码了与淀粉样蛋白沉积相关的信息，这些信息可以通过先进的建模来揭示。然而，3D神经影像数据的高维度和结构复杂性对现有的MRI到PET的转换方法构成了重大挑战。在低维潜在空间中建模跨模态关系可以简化学习任务并实现更有效的转换。因此，我们提出了CoCoLIT（ControlNet-Conditioned Latent Image Translation），一个基于扩散的潜在生成框架，它包含三个主要创新：（1）一种新颖的加权

52c40c825d73743e879862ed81fad1b3386f71e5.title: Spatiotemporal-Aware Neural Fields for Dynamic CT Reconstruction
52c40c825d73743e879862ed81fad1b3386f71e5.abstract: We propose a dynamic Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction framework called STNF4D (SpatioTemporal-aware Neural Fields). First, we represent the 4D scene using four orthogonal volumes and compress these volumes into more compact hash grids. Compared to the plane decomposition method, this method enhances the model's capacity while keeping the representation compact and efficient. However, in densely predicted high-resolution dynamic CT scenes, the lack of constraints and hash conflicts in the hash grid features lead to obvious dot-like artifact and blurring in the reconstructed images. To address these issues, we propose the Spatiotemporal Transformer (ST-Former) that guides the model in selecting and optimizing features by sensing the spatiotemporal information in different hash grids, significantly improving the quality of reconstructed images. 52c40c825d73743e879862ed81fad1b3386f71e5.zh_title: 面向动态CT重建的时空感知神经场
52c40c825d73743e879862ed81fad1b3386f71e5.summary: 提出STNF4D动态CT重建框架，用四个正交体表示4D场景并压缩为哈希网格以提升表示效率。
key_points: 四正交体表示4D场景
压缩为更紧凑的哈希网格
较平面分解提升模型容量
高分辨率场景存在哈希冲突约束问题
52c40c825d73743e879862ed81fad1b3386f71e5.zh_abstract: 我们提出了一种动态计算机断层扫描（CT）重建框架，称为STNF4D（时空感知神经场）。首先，我们使用四个正交体表示4D场景，并将这些体压缩为更紧凑的哈希网格。与平面分解方法相比，该方法增强了模型的能力，同时保持表示紧凑且高效。然而，在密集预测的高分辨率动态CT场景中，哈希网格特征中缺乏约束和哈希冲突导致重建图像中出现明显的点状伪影和模糊。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了时空Transformer（ST-Former），它通过感知不同哈希网格中的时空信息来指导模型选择和优化特征，显著提高了重建图像的质量。我们在医学和……上进行了实验

1a248183963dc30691659d6fff7f9f4fcfa881ea.title: A Unified Degradation-Robust Approach to SSL and UDA for 3D Medical Images
1a248183963dc30691659d6fff7f9f4fcfa881ea.abstract: Medical image segmentation often faces the dual challenges of limited annotations and domain shifts, further complicated by degraded images in practical scenarios. Traditional methods tend to underperform when these issues occur simultaneously, as they are typically designed for specific tasks. To address this, we propose a unified framework that effectively handles limited annotations and domain shifts while also managing both clean and degraded images during inference. Overcoming these challenges requires focusing on three critical aspects: First, the model must be robust to various noise conditions. Second, it should excel at capturing domain-invariant features. Third, it should effectively utilize unlabeled data. We propose three major components in our approach to tackle these challenges. 1a248183963dc30691659d6fff7f9f4fcfa881ea.zh_title: 面向3D医学图像的统一退化鲁棒SSL与UDA方法
1a248183963dc30691659d6fff7f9f4fcfa881ea.summary: 提出统一框架，同时应对标注有限、域偏移与图像退化问题，用于3D医学图像分割。
key_points: 面向3D医学图像分割任务
兼顾有限标注与域偏移
推理时可处理干净与退化图像
1a248183963dc30691659d6fff7f9f4fcfa881ea.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割常常面临有限标注和领域偏移的双重挑战，并在实际场景中因图像退化而进一步复杂化。传统方法在这些问题同时出现时往往表现不佳，因为它们通常是为特定任务设计的。为解决这一问题，我们提出一个统一框架，能够有效处理有限标注和领域偏移，同时在推理期间也能处理干净图像和退化图像。克服这些挑战需要关注三个关键方面：第一，模型必须对各种噪声条件具有鲁棒性。第二，它应擅长捕捉领域不变特征。第三，它应有效利用未标注数据。我们的方法中提出三个主要组件来应对这些挑战。第一，基于小波的跨组件交换（Wavelet-based Cross-Component Exchange, WCCE）交换高频小波分量

16f0e97d1ab4eaf3397ef5da8218dc2f8affe147.title: Medverse: A Universal Model for Full-Resolution 3D Medical Image Segmentation, Transformation and Enhancement
16f0e97d1ab4eaf3397ef5da8218dc2f8affe147.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) offers a promising paradigm for universal medical image analysis, enabling models to perform diverse image processing tasks without retraining. However, current ICL models for medical imaging remain limited in two critical aspects: they cannot simultaneously achieve high-fidelity predictions and global anatomical understanding, and there is no unified model trained across diverse medical imaging tasks (e.g., segmentation and enhancement) and anatomical regions. As a result, the full potential of ICL in medical imaging remains underexplored. Thus, we present Medverse, a universal ICL model for 3D medical imaging, trained on 22 datasets covering diverse tasks in universal image segmentation, transformation, and enhancement across multiple organs, imaging modalities, and clinical centers. Medverse employs a next-scale autoregressive in-context learning framework th
16f0e97d1ab4eaf3397ef5da8218dc2f8affe147.zh_title: Medverse：全分辨率三维医学图像通用模型
16f0e97d1ab4eaf3397ef5da8218dc2f8affe147.summary: 提出面向全分辨率三维医学图像分割、转换与增强的通用模型，支持免重训的上下文学习。
key_points: 统一分割、转换与增强多任务
支持全分辨率高保真预测
跨解剖区域与多类影像训练
16f0e97d1ab4eaf3397ef5da8218dc2f8affe147.zh_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）为通用医学图像分析提供了一种有前景的范式，使模型无需重新训练即可执行多样化的图像处理任务。然而，当前用于医学影像的 ICL 模型在两个方面仍存在关键局限：它们无法同时实现高保真预测与全局解剖理解，且缺乏在多样化医学影像任务（如分割与增强）和解剖区域上训练的统一的模型。因此，ICL 在医学影像中的全部潜力仍未被充分探索。为此，我们提出 Medverse，一个用于 3D 医学影像的通用 ICL 模型，其在 22 个数据集上训练，涵盖跨多个器官、成像模态与临床中心的通用图像分割、变换与增强等多样化任务。Medverse 采用下一尺度自回归上下文学习框架，该

0c3229c663f0b515fa9557485045f2d17b7980c2.title: CNM-UNet: Continuous Ordinary Differential Equations for Medical Image Segmentation
0c3229c663f0b515fa9557485045f2d17b7980c2.abstract: Integrating Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) with U-shaped neural networks has emerged as a novel direction in medical image segmentation. Current networks predominantly employ discretization methods incorporating ODEs. However, these methods face inherent trade-offs between model compactness, computational accuracy, and efficiency. Continuous ODE solutions were rarely studied because they face three limitations: high computational costs, long training time, and poor generalization ability. To address these limitations, we propose an innovative Continuous Neural Memory ODE UNet (CNM-UNet), which replaces all hierarchical decoder layers in vanilla UNet with a single Continuous Neural Memory ODEs Block (CNM-Block) decoder, significantly reducing computation costs and improving training efficiency. CNM-UNet leverages ODEs' dynamic properties to establish continuous temporal feature ex

f9ed40c0f2a1119a690f056cdc81cd3a4ddebcf6.title: Optimizing Health Coverage in Ethiopia: A Learning-augmented Approach and Persistent Proportionality Under an Online Budget
f9ed40c0f2a1119a690f056cdc81cd3a4ddebcf6.abstract:
As part of nationwide efforts aligned with the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal 3 on Universal Health Coverage, 
Ethiopia's Ministry of Health is strengthening health posts to expand access to essential healthcare services. However, only a fraction of this health system strengthening effort can be implemented each year due to limited budgets and other competing priorities, thus the need for an optimization framework to guide prioritization across the regions of Ethiopia. In this paper, we develop a tool, Health Access Resource Planner (HARP), based on a principled decision-support optimization framework for sequential facility planning that aims to maximize population coverage under budget uncertainty while satisfying region-specific proportionality targets at every time step. We then propose two algorithms: (i) a learning-augmented approach that improves upon expert recommen
f9ed40c0f2a1119a690f056cdc81cd3a4ddebcf6.zh_title: 埃塞俄比亚健康覆盖优化的学习增强方法
f9ed40c0f2a1119a690f056cdc81cd3a4ddebcf6.summary: 面向埃塞俄比亚全民健康覆盖，提出学习增强优化方法，在年度预算约束下确定卫生站强化优先次序。
key_points: 有限预算下确定区域优先次序
学习增强的在线预算优化框架
给出持续性比例性质

埃塞俄比亚卫生部正在加强卫生站，以扩大基本医疗服务的可及性。然而，由于预算有限和其他竞争性优先事项，这一卫生系统强化工作每年只能实施一小部分，因此需要一个优化框架来指导埃塞俄比亚各区域的优先排序。在本文中，我们开发了一个工具，卫生可及性资源规划器（Health Access Resource Planner, HARP），基于一个有原则的决策支持优化框架，用于序贯设施规划，旨在预算不确定性下最大化人口覆盖，同时在每个时间步满足区域特定的比例目标。然后，我们提出两种算法：(i) 一种学习增强方法，其改进了专家推荐

f9de52ef0a5fc3478e3cfbd726e9b9d3fd7a3857.title: Accurate Nucleic Acid-Binding Residue Identification Based Domain-Adaptive Protein Language Model and Explainable Geometric Deep Learning
f9de52ef0a5fc3478e3cfbd726e9b9d3fd7a3857.abstract: Protein-nucleic acid interactions play a fundamental and critical role in a wide range of life activities. Accurate identification of nucleic acid-binding residues helps to understand the intrinsic mechanisms of the interactions. However, the accuracy and interpretability of existing computational methods for recognizing nucleic acid-binding residues need to be further improved. Here, we propose a novel method called GeSite based the domain-adaptive protein language model and E(3)-equivariant graph neural network. Prediction results across multiple benchmark test sets demonstrate that GeSite is superior or comparable to state-of-the-art prediction methods. The MCC values of GeSite are 0.522 and 0.326 for the one DNA-binding residue test set and one RNA-binding resi-due test set, which are 0.57 and 38.14% higher than that of the second-best method, respectively. f9de52ef0a5fc3478e3cfbd726e9b9d3fd7a3857.zh_title: 基于域自适应蛋白语言模型与可解释几何深度学习的核酸结合残基识别
f9de52ef0a5fc3478e3cfbd726e9b9d3fd7a3857.summary: 提出 GeSite，结合域自适应蛋白语言模型与 E(3) 等变图网络识别核酸结合残基。
key_points: 蛋白质-核酸相互作用在生命活动中关键
现有方法精度与可解释性待提升
结合域自适应语言模型与等变网络
f9de52ef0a5fc3478e3cfbd726e9b9d3fd7a3857.zh_abstract: 蛋白质-核酸相互作用在广泛的生命活动中发挥基础且关键的作用。准确识别核酸结合残基有助于理解这些相互作用的内在机制。然而，现有的用于识别核酸结合残基的计算方法的准确性和可解释性仍需进一步改进。在此，我们提出了一种称为 GeSite 的新方法，该方法基于域自适应蛋白质语言模型和 E(3)-等变图神经网络。跨多个基准测试集的预测结果表明，GeSite 优于或与最先进的预测方法相当。GeSite 在 DNA 结合残基测试集和 RNA 结合残基测试集上的 MCC 值分别为 0.522 和 0.326，分别比第二好的方法高 0.57 和 38.14%。详细的实验结

f1d16657c404f10a16f08b0f47bb0430e54da21d.title: Neighbor Does Matter: Density-Aware Contrastive Learning for Medical Semi-supervised Segmentation
f1d16657c404f10a16f08b0f47bb0430e54da21d.abstract: In medical image analysis, multi-organ semi-supervised segmentation faces challenges such as insufficient labels and low contrast in soft tissues. To address these issues, existing studies typically employ semi-supervised segmentation techniques using pseudo-labeling and consistency regularization. However, these methods mainly rely on individual data samples for training, ignoring the rich neighborhood information present in the feature space. In this work, we argue that supervisory information can be directly extracted from the geometry of the feature space. Inspired by the density-based clustering hypothesis, we propose using feature density to locate sparse regions within feature clusters. f1d16657c404f10a16f08b0f47bb0430e54da21d.zh_title: 密度感知对比学习用于医学半监督分割
f1d16657c404f10a16f08b0f47bb0430e54da21d.summary: AAAI 2025提出密度感知对比学习方法，利用特征空间邻域信息提升多器官半监督分割性能。
key_points: 面向多器官半监督分割
针对标签不足与软组织低对比
利用特征空间邻域监督信息
f1d16657c404f10a16f08b0f47bb0430e54da21d.zh_abstract: 在医学图像分析中，多器官半监督分割面临标签不足和软组织对比度低等挑战。为解决这些问题，现有研究通常采用使用伪标签和一致性正则化的半监督分割技术。然而，这些方法主要依赖单个数据样本进行训练，忽略了特征空间中存在的丰富邻域信息。在这项工作中，我们认为监督信息可以直接从特征空间的几何结构中提取。受基于密度的聚类假设启发，我们提出使用特征密度来定位特征簇内的稀疏区域。我们的目标是通过解决稀疏性问题来提高类内紧凑性。为实现这一点，我们提出一种密度感知对比学习（Density-Aware Contrastive Learning, DACL）策略，推动稀疏中的锚定特征

da357ee34aac50a474433398d9fb73fa18448c3e.title: TCAM-Diff: Triplane-Aware Cross-Attention Medical Diffusion Model
da357ee34aac50a474433398d9fb73fa18448c3e.abstract: We introduce TCAM-Diff, a novel 3D medical image generation model that reduces the memory requirements to encode and generate high-resolution 3D data. This model utilizes a decoder-only autoencoder method to learn triplane representation from dense volume and leverages generalization operations to prevent overfitting. Subsequently, it uses a triplane-aware cross-attention diffusion model to learn and integrate these features effectively. Furthermore, the features generated by the diffusion model can be rapidly transformed into 3D volumes using a pre-trained decoder module. Our experiments on three different scales of medical datasets, BrainTumour 128x128x128, Pancreas 256x256x256, and Colon 512x512x512, demonstrated outstanding results. da357ee34aac50a474433398d9fb73fa18448c3e.zh_title: TCAM-Diff：三平面感知交叉注意力医学扩散模型
da357ee34aac50a474433398d9fb73fa18448c3e.summary: 提出TCAM-Diff，通过三平面表示与交叉注意力扩散模型，降低高分辨率3D医学数据生成的内存需求。
key_points: 仅解码器自编码器学习三平面表示

da357ee34aac50a474433398d9fb73fa18448c3e.zh_abstract: 我们介绍了 TCAM-Diff，一种新颖的 3D 医学图像生成模型，它降低了编码和生成高分辨率 3D 数据的内存需求。该模型利用仅解码器（decoder-only）自编码器方法从稠密体数据中学习三平面（triplane）表示，并利用泛化操作防止过拟合。随后，它使用三平面感知的交叉注意力扩散模型来有效学习和整合这些特征。此外，扩散模型生成的特征可使用预训练解码器模块快速转换为 3D 体数据。我们在三种不同规模的医学数据集——BrainTumour 128x128x128、Pancreas 256x256x256 和 Colon 512x512x512——上的实验展示了出色的结果。我们使用 MSE 和 SSIM 评估重建质量，并利用 Wasserstein 生成对抗网络（W-GAN）critic 来评估生成...

d153b88d90271bb729cad025999912cf85df1095.title: Overcoming Heterogeneous Data in Federated Medical Vision-Language Pre-training: A Triple-Embedding Model Selector Approach
d153b88d90271bb729cad025999912cf85df1095.abstract: The scarcity data of medical field brings the collaborative training in medical vision-language pre-training (VLP) cross different clients. Therefore, the collaborative training in medical VLP faces two challenges: First, the medical data requires privacy, thus can not directly shared across different clients. Second, medical data distribution across institutes is typically heterogeneous, hindering local model alignment and representation capabilities. To simultaneously overcome these two challenges, we propose the framework called personalized model selector with fused multimodal information (PMS-FM). The contribution of PMS-FM is two-fold: 1) PMS-FM uses embeddings to represent information in different formats, allowing for the fusion of multimodal data. 2) PMS-FM adapts to personalized data distributions by training multiple models. d153b88d90271bb729cad025999912cf85df1095.zh_title: 联邦医学视觉语言预训练的三重嵌入模型选择器
d153b88d90271bb729cad025999912cf85df1095.summary: 针对联邦医学视觉语言预训练中的数据异构问题，提出三重嵌入模型选择器方法。

应对机构间数据分布异构

d153b88d90271bb729cad025999912cf85df1095.zh_abstract: 医学领域的数据稀缺带来了跨不同客户端的医学视觉-语言预训练（VLP）中的协作训练。因此，医学VLP中的协作训练面临两个挑战：第一，医学数据需要隐私保护，因而不能在不同客户端之间直接共享。第二，不同机构之间的医学数据分布通常是异质的，阻碍了本地模型对齐和表示能力。为了同时克服这两个挑战，我们提出了名为融合多模态信息的个性化模型选择器（personalized model selector with fused multimodal information, PMS-FM）的框架。PMS-FM的贡献有两方面：1）PMS-FM使用嵌入来表示不同格式的信息，从而允许多模态数据的融合。2）PMS-FM通过训练多个模型来适应个性化数据分布。然后，一个模型选择器识别并选择最佳的

c3b10806c5521c364cfa664d4088ebe9fbe23e2b.title: HeartLLM: Discretized ECG Tokenization for LLM-Based Diagnostic Reasoning
c3b10806c5521c364cfa664d4088ebe9fbe23e2b.abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG) plays a central role in cardiovascular diagnostics, yet existing automated approaches often struggle to generalize across clinical tasks and offer limited support for open-ended reasoning. We present HeartLLM, a novel framework that integrates time-series (TS) and language modeling by enabling large language models (LLMs) to process 12-lead ECG signals for clinical text generation tasks. Our approach discretizes continuous ECG embeddings into quantized codes using a lead-wise encoder and quantization module. These quantized codes are then mapped to an extended ECG vocabulary to form ECG tokens, enabling the model to process both ECG and natural language inputs within a unified framework. c3b10806c5521c364cfa664d4088ebe9fbe23e2b.zh_title: HeartLLM：离散化ECG分词用于LLM诊断推理
c3b10806c5521c364cfa664d4088ebe9fbe23e2b.summary: 提出HeartLLM，将12导联ECG离散化为token，让LLM进行诊断推理。
key_points: 处理12导联ECG信号
将ECG嵌入离散化为量化码
支持开放式诊断推理
c3b10806c5521c364cfa664d4088ebe9fbe23e2b.zh_abstract: 心电图（Electrocardiography，ECG）在心血管诊断中发挥着核心作用，但现有的自动化方法往往难以跨临床任务泛化，并且对开放式推理的支持有限。我们提出了 HeartLLM，一种新颖的框架，它通过使大语言模型（LLMs）处理 12 导联 ECG 信号以完成临床文本生成任务，从而整合时间序列（TS）建模与语言建模。我们的方法使用导联级编码器和量化模块将连续的 ECG 嵌入离散化为量化码。随后，这些量化码被映射到扩展的 ECG 词汇表以形成 ECG token，使模型能够在统一框架内处理 ECG 和自然语言输入。为弥合模态差距，我们在自回归 ECG token 预测任务上预训练该模型，使 LLM 能够通过其固有的语言建模...

b7a089e50ea6f15dd47164e2b0558677e9bfbf61.title: State-Derivative-Aware Neural Controlled Differential Equations for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection and Diagnosis
b7a089e50ea6f15dd47164e2b0558677e9bfbf61.abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection is a crucial factor in real-world applications but a challenging task due to the complex temporal dependencies and system dynamics. Reconstruction-based methods have made great improvements in recent years. However, we observe an issue these methods are suffering, that they primarily measure deviations in the time points themselves when performing anomaly detection but ignore changes in the dynamic properties of the system. In these cases, they are unable to produce sufficient reconstruction errors to detect anomalies, so some potential abnormal time points caused by the dynamic evolution of the system are missing.
