b3b13107dd153f4de1ddfeec0a96998d70caf04b.title: Preference Robustness for DPO with Applications to Public Health
b3b13107dd153f4de1ddfeec0a96998d70caf04b.abstract: We study an LLM fine-tuning task for designing reward functions for sequential resource allocation problems in public health, guided by human preferences expressed in natural language. This setting presents a challenging testbed for alignment due to complex and ambiguous objectives and limited data availability. We propose DPO-PRO, a robust fine-tuning algorithm based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), which accounts for uncertainty in the preference distribution using a lightweight Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) formulation. Unlike prior DRO-based variants, DPO-PRO focuses solely on uncertainty in preferences, avoiding unnecessary conservatism and incurring negligible computational overhead. We evaluate DPO-PRO on a real-world maternal mobile health program operated by the non-profit organization ARMMAN, as well as on standard alignment benchmarks. Experimental results
b3b13107dd153f4de1ddfeec0a96998d70caf04b.zh_title: DPO-PRO：公共卫生资源分配中的偏好鲁棒微调
b3b13107dd153f4de1ddfeec0a96998d70caf04b.summary: 提出基于直接偏好优化的鲁棒微调算法DPO-PRO，应对公共卫生序贯资源分配中偏好分布的不确定性。
key_points: 面向公共卫生序贯资源分配设计奖励函数

用轻量分布建模处理偏好不确定性
b3b13107dd153f4de1ddfeec0a96998d70caf04b.zh_abstract: 我们研究一项 LLM 微调任务，用于设计公共卫生中顺序资源分配问题的奖励函数，并以自然语言表达的人类偏好为指导。由于目标复杂且模糊以及数据可用性有限，这一设定为对齐提供了一个具有挑战性的测试平台。我们提出 DPO-PRO，一种基于直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization, DPO）的稳健微调算法，它使用轻量级分布鲁棒优化（Distributionally Robust Optimization, DRO）公式来考虑偏好分布中的不确定性。与先前基于 DRO 的变体不同，DPO-PRO 仅关注偏好中的不确定性，避免不必要的保守性，并产生可忽略的计算开销。我们在非营利组织 ARMMAN 运营的真实世界孕产妇移动健康项目以及标准对齐基准上评估 DPO-PRO。实验结果

a615bfa882ffe6e6bcf4b5c4f38d93161ac54527.title: PathFLIP: Fine-grained Language-Image Pretraining for Versatile Computational Pathology
a615bfa882ffe6e6bcf4b5c4f38d93161ac54527.abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved notable progress in computational pathology (CPath), the gigapixel scale and spatial heterogeneity of Whole Slide Images (WSIs) continue to pose challenges for multimodal understanding. Existing alignment methods struggle to capture fine-grained correspondences between textual descriptions and visual cues across thousands of patches from a slide, compromising their performance on downstream tasks. In this paper, we propose PathFLIP (Pathology Fine-grained Language-Image Pretraining), a novel framework for holistic WSI interpretation. PathFLIP decomposes slide-level captions into region-level sub-captions and generates text-conditioned region embeddings to facilitate precise visual-language grounding. By harnessing Large Language Models (LLMs), PathFLIP can seamlessly follow diverse clinical instructions and adapt to varied diagnostic cont
a615bfa882ffe6e6bcf4b5c4f38d93161ac54527.zh_title: PathFLIP：面向通用计算病理的细粒度语言-图像预训练
a615bfa882ffe6e6bcf4b5c4f38d93161ac54527.summary: 提出PathFLIP细粒度语言-图像预训练方法，应对全切片图像千兆像素与空间异质性挑战。
key_points: 针对全切片图像的千兆像素规模

a615bfa882ffe6e6bcf4b5c4f38d93161ac54527.zh_abstract: 尽管视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs）在计算病理学（computational pathology，CPath）中取得了显著进展，但全切片图像（Whole Slide Images，WSIs）的十亿像素级规模和空间异质性仍对多模态理解构成挑战。现有对齐方法难以捕捉一张切片中成千上万个图像块（patches）的文本描述与视觉线索之间的细粒度对应关系，从而损害其在下游任务上的性能。本文中，我们提出 PathFLIP（Pathology Fine-grained Language-Image Pretraining，病理细粒度语言-图像预训练），一种用于整体 WSI 理解的新颖框架。PathFLIP 将切片级描述分解为区域级子描述，并生成文本条件化的区域嵌入，以促进精确的视觉-语言 grounding。通过利用大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs），PathFLIP 能够无缝遵循多样的临床指令，并适应不同的诊断情境...

a1dc2a0ee413b2e0b8b14d47ba41009f40b19e5b.title: ProtSAE: Disentangling and Interpreting Protein Language Models via Semantically-Guided Sparse Autoencoders
a1dc2a0ee413b2e0b8b14d47ba41009f40b19e5b.abstract: Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) has emerged as a powerful tool for mechanistic interpretability of large language models. Recent works apply SAE to protein language models (PLMs), aiming to extract and analyze biologically meaningful features from their latent spaces. However, SAE suffers from semantic entanglement, where individual neurons often mix multiple nonlinear concepts, making it difficult to reliably interpret or manipulate model behaviors. In this paper, we propose a semantically-guided SAE, called ProtSAE. Unlike existing SAE which requires annotation datasets to filter and interpret activations, we guide semantic disentanglement during training using both annotation datasets and domain knowledge to mitigate the effects of entangled attributes. We design interpretability experiments showing that ProtSAE learns more biologically relevant and interpretable hidden features compared to
a1dc2a0ee413b2e0b8b14d47ba41009f40b19e5b.zh_title: ProtSAE：用语义引导稀疏自编码器解释蛋白质语言模型
a1dc2a0ee413b2e0b8b14d47ba41009f40b19e5b.summary: 针对稀疏自编码器的语义纠缠问题，提出语义引导的 ProtSAE，以解耦并解释蛋白质语言模型的潜在特征。

a1dc2a0ee413b2e0b8b14d47ba41009f40b19e5b.zh_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）已成为大型语言模型机制可解释性的强大工具。近期工作将 SAE 应用于蛋白质语言模型（protein language models, PLMs），旨在从其潜在空间中提取和分析具有生物学意义的特征。然而，SAE 存在语义纠缠问题，即单个神经元常常混合多个非线性概念，使得难以可靠地解释或操纵模型行为。在本文中，我们提出一种语义引导的 SAE，称为 ProtSAE。与现有 SAE 需要注释数据集来过滤和解释激活不同，我们在训练期间同时使用注释数据集和领域知识来引导语义解缠，以减轻纠缠属性的影响。我们设计可解释性实验，表明相比于

a16583d3f5070f4465381bee870321bf1a8f6e0d.title: Semantic-guided Masked Mutual Learning for Multi-modal Brain Tumor Segmentation with Arbitrary Missing Modalities
a16583d3f5070f4465381bee870321bf1a8f6e0d.abstract: Malignant brain tumors have become an aggressive and dangerous disease that leads to death worldwide. Multi-modal MRI data is crucial for accurate brain tumor segmentation, but missing modalities common in clinical practice can severely degrade the segmentation performance. While incomplete multi-modal learning methods attempt to address this, learning robust and discriminative features from arbitrary missing modalities remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose a novel Semantic-guided Masked Mutual Learning (SMML) approach to distill robust and discriminative knowledge across diverse missing modality scenarios. Specifically, we propose a novel dual-branch masked mutual learning scheme guided by Hierarchical Consistency Constraints (HCC) to ensure multi-level consistency, thereby enhancing mutual learning in incomplete multi-modal scenarios. The HCC framework comprises a
a16583d3f5070f4465381bee870321bf1a8f6e0d.zh_title: 语义引导掩码互学习：任意缺失模态脑肿瘤分割
a16583d3f5070f4465381bee870321bf1a8f6e0d.summary: AAAI 2025 提出语义引导掩码互学习方法，应对临床中模态任意缺失时多模态 MRI 脑肿瘤分割性能下降问题。
key_points: 多模态 MRI 对脑肿瘤分割至关重要

方法目标为学习稳健判别性特征
a16583d3f5070f4465381bee870321bf1a8f6e0d.zh_abstract: 恶性脑肿瘤已成为一种侵袭性强且危险的疾病，在全球范围内导致死亡。多模态MRI数据对于准确的脑肿瘤分割至关重要，但临床实践中常见的模态缺失会严重降低分割性能。尽管不完整多模态学习方法试图解决这一问题，但从任意缺失模态中学习鲁棒且具有判别性的特征仍然具有挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的语义引导掩码互学习（Semantic-guided Masked Mutual Learning, SMML）方法，以在各种缺失模态场景中蒸馏鲁棒且具有判别性的知识。具体而言，我们提出了一种由分层一致性约束（Hierarchical Consistency Constraints, HCC）引导的新颖双分支掩码互学习方案，以确保多级一致性，从而增强不完整多模态场景中的互学习。HCC框架包含一个

9c3bd2bac7a4518edd56c91aa753af888e0e2750.title: Tackling Dual-stage Missing Modalities in Brain Tumor Segmentation via Robust Modality Reconstruction and Prompt-guided Modality Adaptation
9c3bd2bac7a4518edd56c91aa753af888e0e2750.abstract: Addressing missing modalities is a critical challenge in multimodal brain tumor segmentation. Most existing approaches merely handle modality-incomplete inputs during inference, assuming a full set of modalities for all training samples. However, this unrealistic assumption limits the usage of abundant modality-incomplete data commonly observed in clinical practice. In this paper, we explore a more practical task of tackling missing modalities during both training and inference. We propose a universal model featuring robust modality reconstruction and prompt-guided modality adaptation. Our mask-reconstruction pre-training enables robust modality-invariant representation learning, during which we design a novel distribution approximation method that supervises the reconstruction of absent modalities without requiring full-modal training data. Afterwards, when adapting our model to the seg
9c3bd2bac7a4518edd56c91aa753af888e0e2750.zh_title: 脑肿瘤分割中双阶段缺失模态的应对方法
9c3bd2bac7a4518edd56c91aa753af888e0e2750.summary: 研究提出鲁棒模态重建与提示引导模态适应方法，应对训练与推理两阶段均存在模态缺失的脑肿瘤分割任务。
key_points: 针对训练与推理双阶段模态缺失设定
现有方法多只处理推理阶段的缺失
以模态重建与提示引导适应提升分割
9c3bd2bac7a4518edd56c91aa753af888e0e2750.zh_abstract: 处理缺失模态是多模态脑肿瘤分割中的一项关键挑战。大多数现有方法仅在推理阶段处理模态不完整的输入，并假设所有训练样本都拥有完整模态集合。然而，这种不现实的假设限制了临床实践中常见的丰富模态不完整数据的使用。本文中，我们探索一项更实际的任务：在训练和推理阶段均处理缺失模态。我们提出一种通用模型，具有稳健的模态重建和提示引导的模态适应。我们的掩码重建预训练能够实现稳健的模态不变表示学习；在此过程中，我们设计了一种新颖的分布近似方法，无需全模态训练数据即可监督缺失模态的重建。之后，当将我们的模型适应于分割...

8b7d665401cb4a1d947a2f7f7aa97bd4ff90517d.title: SGTC: Semantic-Guided Triplet Co-training for Sparsely Annotated Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
8b7d665401cb4a1d947a2f7f7aa97bd4ff90517d.abstract: Although semi-supervised learning has made significant advances in the field of medical image segmentation, fully annotating a volumetric sample slice by slice remains a costly and time-consuming task. Even worse, most of the existing approaches pay much attention to image-level information and ignore semantic features, resulting in the inability to perceive weak boundaries. To address these issues, we propose a novel Semantic-Guided Triplet Co-training (SGTC) framework, which achieves high-end medical image segmentation by only annotating three orthogonal slices of a few volumetric samples, significantly alleviating the burden of radiologists. Our method consist of two main components. Specifically, to enable semantic-aware, fine-granular segmentation and enhance the quality of pseudo-labels, a novel semantic-guided auxiliary learning mechanism is proposed based on the pretrained CLIP.
8b7d665401cb4a1d947a2f7f7aa97bd4ff90517d.zh_title: SGTC：稀疏标注半监督医学图像分割三元协同训练
8b7d665401cb4a1d947a2f7f7aa97bd4ff90517d.summary: AAAI 2025 提出语义引导三元协同训练框架 SGTC，用于稀疏标注下的半监督医学图像分割。
key_points: 逐层完整标注体数据成本高耗时长
现有方法多关注图像级信息忽略语义特征
难以感知弱边界
8b7d665401cb4a1d947a2f7f7aa97bd4ff90517d.zh_abstract: 尽管半监督学习在医学图像分割领域已取得显著进展，但逐切片地完全标注一个体积样本仍然是一项昂贵且耗时的任务。更糟糕的是，大多数现有方法非常关注图像级信息而忽略语义特征，导致无法感知弱边界。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种新颖的语义引导三元协同训练（Semantic-Guided Triplet Co-training, SGTC）框架，该框架仅通过标注少数体积样本的三个正交切片来实现高端医学图像分割，显著减轻放射科医生的负担。我们的方法由两个主要组成部分构成。具体而言，为实现语义感知、细粒度分割并提高伪标签质量，提出了一种基于预训练 CLIP 的新颖语义引导辅助学习机制。

5f11a4437c70ae1e0a4e7086713bf29713fa2005.title: EEG Agent: A Unified Framework for Automated EEG Analysis Using Large Language Models
5f11a4437c70ae1e0a4e7086713bf29713fa2005.abstract: Scalable and generalizable analysis of brain activity is essential for advancing both clinical diagnostics and cognitive research. Electroencephalography (EEG), a non-invasive modality with high temporal resolution, has been widely used for brain states analysis. However, most exiting EEG models are usually tailored for single specific tasks, limiting their utility in realistic scenarios where EEG analysis often involves multi-task and continuous reasoning. In this work, we introduce EEG Agent, a general-purpose framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to schedule and plan multiple tools to automatically complete EEG-related tasks. EEG Agent is capable of performing the key functions: EEG basic information perception, spatiotemporal EEG exploration, EEG event detection, interaction with users, and EEG report generation. To realize the capabilities, we design a toolbox compos
5f11a4437c70ae1e0a4e7086713bf29713fa2005.zh_title: EEG Agent：LLM驱动的自动化脑电分析框架
5f11a4437c70ae1e0a4e7086713bf29713fa2005.summary: 提出统一框架EEG Agent，用大语言模型实现多任务、连续推理的脑电分析。
key_points: 现有EEG模型多针对单一任务，泛化受限
实际EEG分析常涉及多任务与连续推理
框架基于大语言模型实现自动化分析
5f11a4437c70ae1e0a4e7086713bf29713fa2005.zh_abstract: 对脑活动进行可扩展且可泛化的分析，对于推动临床诊断和认知研究都至关重要。脑电图（Electroencephalography, EEG）是一种具有高时间分辨率的非侵入性模态，已被广泛用于脑状态分析。然而，大多数现有 EEG 模型通常针对单一特定任务定制，限制了它们在真实场景中的实用性，因为真实场景中的 EEG 分析往往涉及多任务和连续推理。在这项工作中，我们提出 EEG Agent，一个通用框架，它利用大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）来调度和规划多个工具，以自动完成 EEG 相关任务。EEG Agent 能够执行关键功能：EEG 基本信息感知、时空 EEG 探索、EEG 事件检测、与用户交互以及 EEG 报告生成。为实现这些能力，我们设计了一个工具箱 compos

4f2c987f175936e94da0baa9b3b6c8384cda63d6.title: PASS: Probabilistic Agentic Supernet Sampling for Interpretable and Adaptive Chest X-Ray Reasoning
4f2c987f175936e94da0baa9b3b6c8384cda63d6.abstract: Existing tool-augmented agentic systems are limited in the real world by (i) black-box reasoning steps that undermine trust of decision-making and pose safety risks, (ii) poor multimodal integration, which is inherently critical for healthcare tasks, and (iii) rigid and computationally inefficient agentic pipelines. We introduce PASS (Probabilistic Agentic Supernet Sampling), the first multimodal framework to address these challenges for Chest X-Ray (CXR) reasoning. PASS adaptively samples agentic workflows over a multi-tool graph, yielding decision paths annotated with interpretable probabilities. Given the complex CXR reasoning task with multimodal medical data, PASS leverages its learned task-conditioned distribution over the agentic supernet. 4f2c987f175936e94da0baa9b3b6c8384cda63d6.zh_title: PASS：面向胸片推理的可解释自适应智能体超级网络采样
4f2c987f175936e94da0baa9b3b6c8384cda63d6.summary: 提出PASS多模态框架，通过概率化智能体超级网络采样实现胸片推理中的可解释性与自适应工具调用。
key_points: 现有工具增强智能体存在黑箱推理问题
多模态整合不足影响医疗任务表现
PASS自适应采样智能体以提升效率与可解释性
4f2c987f175936e94da0baa9b3b6c8384cda63d6.zh_abstract: 现有的工具增强型智能体系统在现实世界中受到以下限制：(i) 黑盒推理步骤削弱了决策信任并带来安全风险，(ii) 多模态集成不佳，而这对医疗保健任务本质上至关重要，以及 (iii) 刚性且计算效率低下的智能体流水线。我们引入了 PASS（Probabilistic Agentic Supernet Sampling，概率智能体超网采样），这是首个应对胸部X射线（Chest X-Ray, CXR）推理中这些挑战的多模态框架。PASS在一个多工具图上自适应采样智能体工作流，产生带有可解释概率注释的决策路径。鉴于具有多模态医疗数据的复杂CXR推理任务，PASS利用其在智能体超网上学习到的任务条件分布。因此，它在每个超网层自适应选择最合适的工具，提供带有概率注释的轨迹以供事后审计和

27c42147b6e97ee2dcbdf5fbe982ad4895eab1c2.title: Hierarchical Divide-and-Conquer for Fine-Grained Alignment in LLM-Based Medical Evaluation
27c42147b6e97ee2dcbdf5fbe982ad4895eab1c2.abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of large language models (LLMs) for medical applications, ensuring the reliability and accuracy of these models in clinical settings is paramount. Existing benchmarks often focus on fixed-format tasks like multiple-choice QA, which fail to capture the complexity of real-world clinical diagnostics. Moreover, traditional evaluation metrics and LLM-based evaluators struggle with misalignment, often providing oversimplified assessments that do not adequately reflect human judgment. To address these challenges, we introduce HDCEval, a Hierarchical Divide-and-Conquer Evaluation framework tailored for fine-grained alignment in medical evaluation. HDCEval is built on a set of fine-grained medical evaluation guidelines developed in collaboration with professional doctors, encompassing Patient Question Relevance, Medical Knowledge Correctness, and Expression. The
27c42147b6e97ee2dcbdf5fbe982ad4895eab1c2.zh_title: 医学评估中LLM细粒度对齐的分层分治方法
27c42147b6e97ee2dcbdf5fbe982ad4895eab1c2.summary: AAAI 2025提出分层分治方法，用于基于大模型的医学评估细粒度对齐，应对现有基准与评估指标的失准问题。
key_points: 现有基准多为固定格式选择题任务
传统指标与LLM评估器存在失准

27c42147b6e97ee2dcbdf5fbe982ad4895eab1c2.zh_abstract: 在医疗应用的大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）快速演进的格局中，确保这些模型在临床环境中的可靠性与准确性至关重要。现有基准往往聚焦于固定格式任务，如多项选择问答（multiple-choice QA），这些任务无法捕捉真实世界临床诊断的复杂性。此外，传统评估指标和基于 LLM 的评估器难以解决错位问题，常常提供过于简化的评估，无法充分反映人类判断。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HDCEval，一个为医学评估中的细粒度对齐而定制的分层分治评估（Hierarchical Divide-and-Conquer Evaluation）框架。HDCEval 建立在一套与专业医生合作开发的细粒度医学评估指南之上，涵盖患者问题相关性（Patient Question Relevance）、医学知识正确性（Medical Knowledge Correctness）和表达（Expression）。The

1cf175c3970972bffce2ead96c0b836cbd0b0b8f.title: Learning Protein-Ligand Binding in Hyperbolic Space
1cf175c3970972bffce2ead96c0b836cbd0b0b8f.abstract: Protein-ligand binding prediction is central to virtual screening and affinity ranking, two fundamental tasks in drug discovery. While recent retrieval-based methods embed ligands and protein pockets into Euclidean space for similarity-based search, the geometry of Euclidean embeddings often fails to capture the hierarchical structure and fine-grained affinity variations intrinsic to molecular interactions. In this work, we propose HypSeek, a hyperbolic representation learning framework that embeds ligands, protein pockets, and sequences into Lorentz-model hyperbolic space. 1cf175c3970972bffce2ead96c0b836cbd0b0b8f.zh_title: 在双曲空间中学习蛋白质-配体结合
1cf175c3970972bffce2ead96c0b836cbd0b0b8f.summary: AAAI 2025提出双曲表征学习框架HypSeek，用于蛋白质-配体结合预测与亲和力排序，弥补欧氏嵌入的几何局限。
key_points: 结合预测是虚拟筛选与亲和力排序核心
欧氏嵌入难刻画层次与亲和力差异
HypSeek采用双曲空间表征学习

15bf83c5cbc420696e6c0f9bbb4b4f082b33dc59.title: Synergy of GFlowNet and Protein Language Model Makes a Diverse Antibody Designer
15bf83c5cbc420696e6c0f9bbb4b4f082b33dc59.abstract: Antibodies defend our health by binding to antigens with high specificity and potentiality, primarily relying on the Complementarity-Determining Region (CDR). Yet, current experimental methods of discovering new antibody CDRs are heavily time-consuming. Computational design could alleviate this burden; especially, protein language models have proven quite beneficial in many recent studies. However, most existing models solely focus on antibody potentiality and struggle to encapsulate the diverse range of plausible CDR candidates, limiting their effectiveness in real-world scenarios as binding is only one factor in the multitude of drug-forming criteria. In this paper, we introduce PG-AbD, a framework uniting Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) and pretrained Protein Language Models (PLMs) to successfully generate highly potent, diverse and novel antibody candidates. We innovatively cons
15bf83c5cbc420696e6c0f9bbb4b4f082b33dc59.zh_title: GFlowNet与蛋白语言模型协同的多样抗体设计器
15bf83c5cbc420696e6c0f9bbb4b4f082b33dc59.summary: AAAI 2025结合GFlowNet与蛋白语言模型，针对抗体CDR开展多样化计算设计。
key_points: 抗体特异性主要依赖CDR区域
传统实验发现新CDR耗时
现有模型偏重效力而多样性不足
15bf83c5cbc420696e6c0f9bbb4b4f082b33dc59.zh_abstract: 抗体通过以高特异性和潜能结合抗原，主要依赖互补决定区（CDR）来捍卫我们的健康。然而，当前发现新抗体CDR的实验方法非常耗时。计算设计可以减轻这一负担；特别是，蛋白质语言模型在许多最近的研究中已被证明非常有益。然而，大多数现有模型仅关注抗体潜能，难以囊括各种可能的CDR候选，限制了它们在现实世界场景中的有效性，因为结合只是众多成药标准中的一个因素。在本文中，我们介绍了PG-AbD，一个结合了生成流网络（GFlowNets）和预训练蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）的框架，以成功生成高效力、多样且新颖的抗体候选。我们创新性地 cons

0e453f63d956c05b33959cb4fae37cd38cb260ef.title: Entity Only vs. Inline Approaches: Evaluating LLMs for Adverse Drug Event Detection in Clinical Text (Student Abstract)
0e453f63d956c05b33959cb4fae37cd38cb260ef.abstract: Adverse Drug Events (ADEs) are a major healthcare issue in the United States, contributing to millions of outpatient and emergency department visits and ranking as the fourth leading cause of death. While many ADEs are identified post-market, improved detection methods are crucial for enhancing patient safety. This study explores the application of large language models (LLMs) to the n2c2 task for ADE detection, evaluating optimal prompting techniques without requiring ADE-specific training data. Results indicate that an entity-only extraction approach outperforms the inline method, offering higher precision, recall, and token efficiency. This study highlights the potential of LLMs for accurate ADE detection in clinical text, improving performance while maintaining model efficiency.
0e453f63d956c05b33959cb4fae37cd38cb260ef.zh_title: 大模型用于临床文本药物不良事件检测的评估
0e453f63d956c05b33959cb4fae37cd38cb260ef.summary: AAAI 2025学生摘要评估LLM在n2c2药物不良事件检测任务上的提示策略，无需专门训练数据。
key_points: 药物不良事件是重大医疗问题
探索LLM在n2c2 ADE任务表现
评估无需ADE专用训练数据的提示
0e453f63d956c05b33959cb4fae37cd38cb260ef.zh_abstract: 药物不良事件（Adverse Drug Events, ADEs）是美国的一个主要医疗保健问题，导致数百万次门诊和急诊科就诊，并且是第四大死因。尽管许多 ADE 是在上市后发现的，但改进检测方法对于提高患者安全至关重要。本研究探讨将大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）应用于 n2c2 任务以进行 ADE 检测，评估在不需要 ADE 特定训练数据的情况下的最佳提示技术。结果表明，仅实体抽取方法优于内联方法，提供更高的精确率、召回率和 token 效率。本研究强调了 LLM 在临床文本中准确检测 ADE 的潜力，在保持模型效率的同时提高性能。

0ba32d79b1af1d282fd749555bb30bc535ff7a16.title: CA-MLIF: Cross-Attention and Multimodal Low-Rank Interaction Fusion Framework for Tumor Prognostic Prediction
0ba32d79b1af1d282fd749555bb30bc535ff7a16.abstract: Cancer is a leading cause of death worldwide due to its aggressive nature and complex variability. Accurate prognosis is therefore challenging but essential for guiding personalized treatment and follow-up. Previous research often relied on single data sources, missing the opportunity to combine various types of patient information for more comprehensive survival predictions. To address these challenges, we propose a two-stage fusion method named Cross-Attention and Multimodal Low-Rank Interaction Fusion Framework (CA-MLIF). In the first stage, we propose a CA mechanism for real-time feature updates and cross-modal mutual learning to capture rich semantic information. In the second stage, we design a novel multimodal low-rank interaction fusion method for survival prediction. Specifically, we present modal attention mechanism (MAM) for feature filtration, low-rank multimodal fusion (LMF)
0ba32d79b1af1d282fd749555bb30bc535ff7a16.zh_title: CA-MLIF：交叉注意力多模态低秩融合预测肿瘤预后
0ba32d79b1af1d282fd749555bb30bc535ff7a16.summary: 提出两阶段交叉注意力与多模态低秩交互融合框架，整合多源患者信息用于肿瘤生存预测。
key_points: 癌症预后需综合多源数据
提出两阶段融合方法CA-MLIF
结合交叉注意力与低秩交互
0ba32d79b1af1d282fd749555bb30bc535ff7a16.zh_abstract: 癌症因其侵袭性和复杂变异性而成为全球主要死因。因此，准确的预后具有挑战性，但对于指导个性化治疗和随访至关重要。既往研究通常依赖单一数据源，错失了结合多种患者信息以进行更全面生存预测的机会。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种两阶段融合方法，名为交叉注意力与多模态低秩交互融合框架（Cross-Attention and Multimodal Low-Rank Interaction Fusion Framework, CA-MLIF）。在第一阶段，我们提出一种 CA 机制，用于实时特征更新和跨模态互学习，以捕获丰富的语义信息。在第二阶段，我们设计了一种新颖的多模态低秩交互融合方法用于生存预测。具体而言，我们提出模态注意力机制（modal attention mechanism, MAM）用于特征过滤，以及低秩多模态融合（low-rank multimodal fusion, LMF）

0335ac7d82a6bc75365de15e8c8424db790a0f68.title: Assessing Automated Fact-Checking for Medical LLM Responses with Knowledge Graphs
0335ac7d82a6bc75365de15e8c8424db790a0f68.abstract: The recent proliferation of large language models (LLMs) holds the potential to revolutionize healthcare, with strong capabilities in diverse medical tasks. Yet, deploying LLMs in high-stakes healthcare settings requires rigorous verification and validation to understand any potential harm. This paper investigates the reliability and viability of using medical knowledge graphs (KGs) for the automated factuality evaluation of LLM-generated responses. To ground this investigation, we introduce FAITH, a framework designed to systematically probe the strengths and limitations of this KG-based approach. FAITH operates without reference answers by decomposing responses into atomic claims, linking them to a medical KG, and scoring them based on evidence paths. 0335ac7d82a6bc75365de15e8c8424db790a0f68.zh_title: 用知识图谱自动核查医学大模型回答事实性
0335ac7d82a6bc75365de15e8c8424db790a0f68.summary: 研究以医学知识图谱自动评估LLM生成回答的事实性，考察其可靠性与可行性。
key_points: 关注高风险医疗场景的验证需求
用医学知识图谱做自动事实性评估
提出相应评估资源与考察结论
0335ac7d82a6bc75365de15e8c8424db790a0f68.zh_abstract: 近期大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）的激增具有彻底改变医疗保健的潜力，其在多种医疗任务中展现出强大能力。然而，在高风险医疗保健环境中部署 LLMs 需要严格的验证和确认，以了解任何潜在危害。本文研究使用医学知识图谱（knowledge graphs, KGs）对 LLM 生成响应进行自动化事实性评估的可靠性和可行性。为支撑这项研究，我们提出 FAITH，一个旨在系统探究这种基于 KG 的方法的优势与局限的框架。FAITH 在无需参考答案的情况下运行，它将响应分解为原子化声明，将其链接到医学 KG，并基于证据路径对其进行评分。在不同医疗任务上结合人工主观评估的实验表明，基于 KG 的评估达到了相当 hig

f285139c9f343f6666c1f5c2a7fac3febf838f85.title: MedMKEB: A Comprehensive Knowledge Editing Benchmark for Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
f285139c9f343f6666c1f5c2a7fac3febf838f85.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have significantly improved medical AI, enabling it to unify the understanding of visual and textual information. However, as medical knowledge continues to evolve, it is critical to allow these models to efficiently update outdated or incorrect information without retraining from scratch. Although textual knowledge editing has been widely studied, there is still a lack of systematic benchmarks for multimodal medical knowledge editing involving image and text modalities. To fill this gap, we present MedMKEB, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the reliability, generality, locality, portability, and robustness of knowledge editing in medical multimodal large language models. MedMKEB is built on a high-quality medical visual question-answering dataset and enriched with carefully constructed editing tasks, includ
f285139c9f343f6666c1f5c2a7fac3febf838f85.zh_title: MedMKEB：医学多模态大模型知识编辑基准
f285139c9f343f6666c1f5c2a7fac3febf838f85.summary: 提出医学多模态大模型知识编辑的综合基准，用于系统评估知识更新能力。
key_points: 聚焦多模态医学知识编辑评估
针对知识更新避免全量重训
填补该方向系统基准的空白
f285139c9f343f6666c1f5c2a7fac3febf838f85.zh_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的进展显著改善了医学AI，使其能够统一理解视觉和文本信息。然而，随着医学知识的不断发展，让这些模型能够高效地更新过时或错误的信息而无需从头重新训练至关重要。尽管文本知识编辑已被广泛研究，但仍缺乏针对涉及图像和文本模态的多模态医学知识编辑的系统性基准。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了MedMKEB，这是第一个全面的基准，旨在评估医学多模态大语言模型中知识编辑的可靠性、通用性、局部性、可移植性和鲁棒性。MedMKEB基于高质量的医学视觉问答数据集构建，并加入了精心构建的编辑任务，包括

e26b8b274c35b80a0f3648ca488f15ee6da8243b.title: EccoMamba: Enhanced Cross-hierarchical Continuity Orthogonal Mamba for Medical Image Segmentation
e26b8b274c35b80a0f3648ca488f15ee6da8243b.abstract: Medical image segmentation plays a crucial role in clinical diagnosis, lesion quantification, and preoperative planning. However, existing Mamba-based architectures, which rely on fixed-direction sequence modeling and flatten images into one-dimensional (1D) sequences, struggle to capture hierarchical anatomical features and spatial dependencies, thereby limiting their representational capacity for complex medical structures. To address these limitations, we propose EccoMamba (Enhanced Cross-hierarchical Continuity Orthogonal Mamba), a U-shaped encoder--decoder framework designed for medical image segmentation. In the encoder's downsampling path, we introduce a Hierarchical Aggregation Enhancement (HAE) module that integrates multi-scale convolutions with hierarchical attention mechanisms. e26b8b274c35b80a0f3648ca488f15ee6da8243b.zh_title: EccoMamba：增强跨层级连续正交Mamba医学图像分割
e26b8b274c35b80a0f3648ca488f15ee6da8243b.summary: 针对Mamba架构固定方向建模与图像展平导致的层级特征与空间依赖捕捉不足，提出EccoMamba分割方法。
key_points: 医学图像分割服务诊断、病灶量化与术前规划

dfd85d4751bbb961cf9083fcd24d669f18203acb.title: Where It Moves, It Matters: Referring Surgical Instrument Segmentation via Motion
dfd85d4751bbb961cf9083fcd24d669f18203acb.abstract: Enabling intuitive, language-driven interaction with surgical scenes is a critical step toward intelligent operating rooms and autonomous surgical robotic assistance. However, the task of referring segmentation, localizing surgical instruments based on natural language descriptions, remains underexplored in surgical videos, with existing approaches struggling to generalize due to reliance on static visual cues and predefined instrument names. In this work, we introduce SurgRef, a novel motion-guided framework that grounds free-form language expressions in instrument motion, capturing how tools move and interact across time, rather than what they look like. This allows models to understand and segment instruments even under occlusion, ambiguity, or unfamiliar terminology. To train and evaluate SurgRef, we present Ref-IMotion, a diverse, multi-institutional video dataset with dense spatiot
dfd85d4751bbb961cf9083fcd24d669f18203acb.zh_title: 运动信息驱动的指代式手术器械分割
dfd85d4751bbb961cf9083fcd24d669f18203acb.summary: AAAI 2026提出SurgRef，利用运动线索结合自然语言描述定位手术器械，面向智能手术室与手术机器人辅助。
key_points: 提出运动引导的SurgRef方法
以自然语言指代定位手术器械

dfd85d4751bbb961cf9083fcd24d669f18203acb.zh_abstract: 实现与手术场景的直观、语言驱动交互，是迈向智能手术室和自主手术机器人辅助的关键一步。然而，指代分割——即根据自然语言描述定位手术器械——这一任务在手术视频中仍未得到充分探索，现有方法由于依赖静态视觉线索和预定义器械名称而难以泛化。在这项工作中，我们提出 SurgRef，一种新颖的运动引导框架，它将自由形式的语言表达落地到器械运动中，捕捉工具如何随时间移动和交互，而不是它们看起来像什么。这使模型即使在遮挡、歧义或不熟悉术语的情况下也能理解和分割器械。为训练和评估 SurgRef，我们提出 Ref-IMotion，一个多样化的、多机构的视频数据集，具有密集的 spatiot

d98efb78a61f097539af74c0b5bb6e30e2b1841d.title: AD4CD: Causal-Guided Anomaly Detection for Enhancing Cognitive Diagnosis
d98efb78a61f097539af74c0b5bb6e30e2b1841d.abstract: Cognitive diagnosis is a key task in computer-aided education, aimed at assessing a students' proficiency in specific knowledge concepts based on their responses to exercises. However, existing cognitive diagnosis models often overlook anomalies in students and exercises. For instance, some students might incorrectly response exercises despite having a strong grasp of the knowledge concept, or they might response correctly despite a lack of understanding. Such subtle anomalies can adversely affect the diagnostic results of the models. To address these anomalies, we conduct a qualitative analysis of how anomalous student states and exercise properties impact response outcomes using causal diagrams. c882eea42e01cd765a068fe60c07fa28ce9b0b29.title: DeNAS-ViT: Data Efficient NAS-Optimized Vision Transformer for Ultrasound Image Segmentation
c882eea42e01cd765a068fe60c07fa28ce9b0b29.abstract:
Accurate segmentation of ultrasound images is essential for reliable medical diagnoses but is challenged by poor image quality and scarce labeled data. Prior approaches have relied on manually designed, complex network architectures to improve multi-scale feature extraction. However, such handcrafted models offer limited gains when prior knowledge is inadequate and are prone to overfitting on small datasets. In this paper, we introduce DeNAS-ViT, a Data efficient NAS-optimized Vision Transformer, the first method to leverage neural architecture search (NAS) for ultrasound image segmentation by automatically optimizing model architecture through token-level search. Specifically, we propose an efficient NAS module that performs multi-scale token search prior to the ViT’s attention mechanism, effectively capturing

c882eea42e01cd765a068fe60c07fa28ce9b0b29.summary: 提出数据高效的NAS优化视觉Transformer，用于超声图像分割。
key_points: 针对超声图像质量差与标注稀缺
以神经架构搜索替代人工设计网络

c882eea42e01cd765a068fe60c07fa28ce9b0b29.zh_abstract:
超声图像的准确分割对于可靠的医学诊断至关重要，但受到图像质量差和标注数据稀缺的挑战。先前方法依赖于人工设计的复杂网络架构来改进多尺度特征提取。然而，当先验知识不足时，这种手工设计的模型带来的收益有限，并且容易在小数据集上过拟合。在本文中，我们提出了 DeNAS-ViT，一种数据高效的 NAS 优化视觉 Transformer（Vision Transformer），这是首个通过 token 级搜索自动优化模型架构来将神经架构搜索（Neural Architecture Search, NAS）用于超声图像分割的方法。具体而言，我们提出了一种高效的 NAS 模块，在 ViT 的注意力机制之前执行多尺度 token 搜索，有效捕获

c3aa1f64ff6f3de9184470ad9c1eff5f67fefdb6.title: Developing Multimodal Healthcare Foundation Model: From Data-driven to Knowledge-enhanced
c3aa1f64ff6f3de9184470ad9c1eff5f67fefdb6.abstract: Foundation models in general domains have leveraged multimodal knowledge graphs to great effect, yet the healthcare sector lacks such comprehensive structures, presenting a significant gap in current research. Based on previous exploration with pure data-driven approaches, this proposal describes a two-stage project aiming to enhance multimodal healthcare foundation model with domain knowledge. The first stage is to construct a robust multimodal healthcare knowledge graph based on established healthcare taxonomies, such as UMLS, and enriched with data from multimodal clinical databases like MIMIC-CXR. This knowledge graph will incorporate medical images as cross-modal instances linked to healthcare terminologies, enhancing the depth and applicability of the graph. c3aa1f64ff6f3de9184470ad9c1eff5f67fefdb6.zh_title: 多模态医疗基础模型：从数据驱动到知识增强
c3aa1f64ff6f3de9184470ad9c1eff5f67fefdb6.summary: AAAI 2025 提出两阶段项目，先构建多模态医疗知识图谱，再以领域知识增强医疗基础模型。
key_points: 指出医疗领域缺乏多模态知识图谱
第一阶段构建医疗知识图谱
第二阶段以知识增强基础模型
c3aa1f64ff6f3de9184470ad9c1eff5f67fefdb6.zh_abstract: 通用领域的基础模型已利用多模态知识图谱取得了巨大效果，但医疗保健领域缺乏这种全面的结构，这在当前研究中构成了显著空白。基于先前对纯数据驱动方法的探索，本提案描述了一个两阶段项目，旨在用领域知识增强多模态医疗保健基础模型。第一阶段是基于已建立的医疗保健分类体系（如UMLS）构建一个稳健的多模态医疗保健知识图谱，并用来自多模态临床数据库（如MIMIC-CXR）的数据进行丰富。该知识图谱将把医学图像作为与医疗保健术语关联的跨模态实例纳入其中，增强图谱的深度和适用性。在第二阶段，知识图谱将作为基础工具，用于训练具有增强

b2ea4b8d0486cc71c12c69402d856d5e7d0d2d76.title: EndoIR: Degradation-Agnostic All-in-One Endoscopic Image Restoration via Noise-Aware Routing Diffusion
b2ea4b8d0486cc71c12c69402d856d5e7d0d2d76.abstract: Endoscopic images often suffer from diverse and co-occurring degradations such as low lighting, smoke, and bleeding, which obscure critical clinical details. Existing restoration methods are typically task-specific and often require prior knowledge of the degradation type, limiting their robustness in real-world clinical use. We propose EndoIR, an all-in-one, degradation-agnostic diffusion-based framework that restores multiple degradation types using a single model. EndoIR introduces a Dual-Domain Prompter that extracts joint spatial–frequency features, coupled with an adaptive embedding that encodes both shared and task-specific cues as conditioning for denoising. b2ea4b8d0486cc71c12c69402d856d5e7d0d2d76.summary: 提出 EndoIR 一体式扩散框架，无需预先知道退化类型即可复原低光、烟雾、出血等多种内镜图像退化。
key_points: 内镜图像常同时存在多种退化

af15d561570a5f0b4b2897f01755ad7622d35db8.title: RTMol: Rethinking Molecule-text Alignment in a Round-trip View
af15d561570a5f0b4b2897f01755ad7622d35db8.abstract: Aligning molecular sequence representations (e.g., SMILES notations) with textual descriptions is critical for applications spanning drug discovery, materials design, and automated chemical literature analysis. Existing methodologies typically treat molecular captioning (molecule-to-text) and text-based molecular design (text-to-molecule) as separate tasks, relying on supervised fine-tuning or contrastive learning pipelines. These approaches face three key limitations: (i) conventional metrics like BLEU prioritize linguistic fluency over chemical accuracy, (ii) training datasets frequently contain chemically ambiguous narratives with incomplete specifications, and (iii) independent optimization of generation directions leads to bidirectional inconsistency. af15d561570a5f0b4b2897f01755ad7622d35db8.zh_title: RTMol：往返视角重构分子-文本对齐
af15d561570a5f0b4b2897f01755ad7622d35db8.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 RTMol，以往返视角统一分子描述生成与文本驱动的分子设计，改进分子-文本对齐。

af02099d8b1ce1f0d224fcbb4a4e4b77608db168.title: MemoryART: Enhancing LLMs via Multi-Memory Models with Adaptive Resonance Theory for Healthcare Agents
af02099d8b1ce1f0d224fcbb4a4e4b77608db168.abstract: Though promising in healthcare consultation applications, large language models (LLMs) face critical limitations in retaining and utilizing long-term memory across multi-turn interactions. In particular, existing memory enhancing paradigms are constrained by limited context windows and embedding-based retrieval, often failing to maintain task relevance and still suffering from memory prototype collapse in multi-turn healthcare consultation. To address these challenges, we propose a cognitively-inspired memory framework named MemoryART, which is grounded in Adaptive Resonance Theory (ART)—a cognitive and learning theory of how humans and animals adapt to dynamic environments. MemoryART employs three memory modules—working memory, episodic memory, and semantic memory to support task-aware memory organization and dynamic retrieval. af02099d8b1ce1f0d224fcbb4a4e4b77608db168.summary: 提出认知启发的MemoryART，用多记忆模型与自适应共振理论增强医疗智能体的长期记忆能力。

af02099d8b1ce1f0d224fcbb4a4e4b77608db168.zh_abstract: 尽管在医疗咨询应用中前景广阔，大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在多轮交互中保留和利用长期记忆方面仍面临关键局限。特别是，现有的记忆增强范式受限于有限的上下文窗口和基于嵌入的检索，往往无法保持任务相关性，并且在多轮医疗咨询中仍会遭受记忆原型坍缩。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个受认知启发的记忆框架，名为 MemoryART，它基于自适应共振理论（Adaptive Resonance Theory, ART）——一种关于人类和动物如何适应动态环境的认知与学习理论。MemoryART 采用三个记忆模块——工作记忆、情景记忆和语义记忆——来支持任务感知的记忆组织和动态检索。具体而言，情景记忆提供对 speci 的存储

9de951dd656d822794645a5f3593a794343aac33.title: Apo2Mol: 3D Molecule Generation via Dynamic Pocket-Aware Diffusion Models
9de951dd656d822794645a5f3593a794343aac33.abstract: Deep generative models are rapidly advancing structure-based drug design, offering substantial promise for generating small molecule ligands that bind to specific protein targets. However, most current approaches assume a rigid protein binding pocket, neglecting the intrinsic flexibility of proteins and the conformational rearrangements induced by ligand binding, limiting their applicability in practical drug discovery. Here, we propose Apo2Mol, a diffusion-based generative framework for 3D molecule design that explicitly accounts for conformational flexibility in protein binding pockets. To support this, we curate a dataset of over 24, 000 experimentally resolved apo-holo structure pairs from the Protein Data Bank, enabling the characterization of protein structure changes associated with ligand binding. 9de951dd656d822794645a5f3593a794343aac33.zh_title: Apo2Mol：基于动态口袋感知扩散模型的3D分子生成

9743acfa3d497567f12bfdb249f9bf3378b11351.title: MedOmni-45°: A Safety-Performance Benchmark for Reasoning-Oriented LLMs in Medicine
9743acfa3d497567f12bfdb249f9bf3378b11351.abstract: With the rapid integration of large language models (LLMs) into medical decision-support aids, ensuring reliability in reasoning steps—not just final answers—is increasingly critical. Two key safety dimensions are Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness, which assesses alignment of the model’s reasoning process with both its response and medical facts, and sycophancy, an emergent misalignment where models follow misleading cues instead of factual correctness. Yet existing benchmarks tend to prioritize performance evaluation, frequently collapsing nuanced safety vulnerabilities into a single accuracy score. To fill this gap, we introduce MedOmni-45°, a benchmark and evaluation workflow explicitly designed to quantify the safety–performance trade-off in LLMs under manipulative hint conditions. 9743acfa3d497567f12bfdb249f9bf3378b11351.zh_title: MedOmni-45°：医学推理大模型安全-性能基准
9743acfa3d497567f12bfdb249f9bf3378b11351.summary: 提出MedOmni-45°基准，评估医学推理大模型的思维链忠实性与迎合性等安全维度。

9743acfa3d497567f12bfdb249f9bf3378b11351.zh_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）快速融入医疗决策支持辅助工具，确保推理步骤（而不仅仅是最终答案）的可靠性变得越来越关键。两个关键的安全维度是思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）忠实性，它评估模型的推理过程与其响应以及医学事实的一致性，以及谄媚（sycophancy），这是一种涌现的错位，即模型遵循误导性线索而非事实正确性。然而，现有的基准测试往往优先考虑性能评估，频繁地将细微的安全漏洞压缩为单一的准确率分数。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了 MedOmni-45°，一个基准测试和评估工作流，明确设计用于量化 LLMs 在操纵性提示条件下的安全-性能权衡。该基准包含 1,804 个以推理为重点的医学问题，涵盖六个临床专科，以及

92fe84da7abb816651ef1ae3f34b2e98d3c3ccc7.title: EPO: Diverse and Realistic Protein Ensemble Generation via Energy Preference Optimization
92fe84da7abb816651ef1ae3f34b2e98d3c3ccc7.abstract:
Accurate exploration of protein conformational ensembles is essential for uncovering function but remains hard because molecular-dynamics (MD) simulations suffer from high computational costs and energy-barrier trapping.
This paper presents Energy Preference Optimization (EPO), an online refinement algorithm that turns a pretrained protein ensemble generator into an energy-aware sampler without extra MD trajectories.
Specifically, EPO leverages stochastic differential equation sampling to explore the conformational landscape and incorporates a novel energy-ranking mechanism based on list-wise preference optimization.
Crucially, EPO introduces a practical upper bound to efficiently approximate the intractable probability of long sampling trajectories in continuous-time generative models, making it easily adaptable to existing pretrained generators.

87fe691f698e810471b57f40c60965e0b0e055d8.title: Learning Cell-Aware Hierarchical Multi-Modal Representations for Robust Molecular Modeling
87fe691f698e810471b57f40c60965e0b0e055d8.abstract: Understanding how chemical perturbations propagate through biological systems is essential for robust molecular property prediction. While most existing methods focus on chemical structures alone, recent advances highlight the crucial role of cellular responses such as morphology and gene expression in shaping drug effects. However, current cell-aware approaches face two key limitations: (1) modality incompleteness in external biological data, and (2) insufficient modeling of hierarchical dependencies across molecular, cellular, and genomic levels. We propose CHMR (Cell-aware Hierarchical Multi-Modal Representations), a robust framework that jointly models local-global dependencies between molecules and cellular responses and captures latent biological hierarchies via a novel tree-structured vector quantization module. 87fe691f698e810471b57f40c60965e0b0e055d8.summary: 提出细胞感知的层次多模态表示学习方法，结合化学结构与细胞响应用于分子性质预测。

8060131c81a98928f5769b25e2db5eba8a057cc9.title: PharmaQA: Prompt-Based Molecular Representation Learning via Pharmacophore-Oriented Question Answering
8060131c81a98928f5769b25e2db5eba8a057cc9.abstract: Molecular representation plays a central role in computational drug discovery. Pharmacophores, functional groups responsible for molecular bioactivity, have been widely studied in cheminformatics. However, their incorporation into molecular representation learning, particularly in a context reasoning or generalization, remains relatively limited. To address this gap, we propose PharmaQA, a pharmacophore oriented question answering framework that formulates tailored prompts to extract context-aware molecular semantics. Rather than encoding pharmacophore features, PharmaQA learns to answer pharmacophore related queries. This design enables flexible reasoning across diverse tasks, including molecular property prediction, compound-target interaction prediction, and binding affinity estimation. 8060131c81a98928f5769b25e2db5eba8a057cc9.summary: 提出面向药效团的问答框架，通过定制提示提取语境信息以学习分子表示，用于计算药物发现。

8060131c81a98928f5769b25e2db5eba8a057cc9.zh_abstract: 分子表示在计算药物发现中起着核心作用。药效团（pharmacophores）是负责分子生物活性的官能团，已在化学信息学中得到广泛研究。然而，将其纳入分子表示学习，尤其是在上下文推理或泛化背景下，仍然相对有限。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 PharmaQA，一个面向药效团的问答框架，通过制定定制提示来提取上下文感知的分子语义。PharmaQA 不是编码药效团特征，而是学习回答与药效团相关的查询。这种设计使得跨多样任务的灵活推理成为可能，包括分子性质预测、化合物-靶标相互作用预测和结合亲和力估计。基准数据集上的实验结果表明，PharmaQA 取得了有竞争力的表现

Despite recent advances, non-IID (non-independent and identically distributed) data poses an inevitable challenge that hinders the use of FL. In this work, we address the issue of non-IID histopathological images with feature distribution shifts from an intuitive perspective that has only received limited attention. Specifically, we address this issue from the perspective of data distribution by solely adjusting the data distributions of all clients. 70fcc9d83091d4c6e52bce3e47dbaf0483940546.title: Anatomical Region-Guided Contrastive Decoding: A Plug-and-Play Strategy for Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical VLMs
70fcc9d83091d4c6e52bce3e47dbaf0483940546.abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (MedVLMs) show immense promise in clinical applicability. However, their reliability is hindered by hallucinations, where models often fail to derive answers from visual evidence, instead relying on learned textual priors. Existing mitigation strategies for MedVLMs have distinct limitations: training-based methods rely on costly expert annotations, limiting scalability, while training-free interventions like contrastive decoding, though data-efficient, apply a global, untargeted correction whose effects in complex real-world clinical settings can be unreliable. To address these challenges, we introduce Anatomical Region-Guided Contrastive Decoding (ARCD), a plug-and-play strategy that mitigates hallucinations by providing targeted, region-specific guidance. 64304acf6ccd8d261c89a61e363017684a343029.title: A Trusted Lesion-assessment Network for Interpretable Diagnosis of Coronary Artery Disease in Coronary CT Angiography
64304acf6ccd8d261c89a61e363017684a343029.abstract: Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) poses a significant threat to cardiovascular patients worldwide, underscoring the critical importance of automated CAD diagnostic technologies in clinical practice. Previous technologies for lesion assessment in Coronary CT Angiography (CCTA) images have been insufficient in terms of interpretability, resulting in solutions that lack clinical reliability in both network architecture and prediction outcomes, even when diagnoses are accurate. To address the limitation of interpretability, we introduce the Trusted Lesion-Assessment Network (TLA-Net), which provides a clinically reliable solution for multi-view CAD diagnosis: (1) The causality-informed evidence collection constructs a causal graph for the diagnostic process and implements causal interventions, preventing confounders' interference and enhancing the transparency of the network architecture. 5d34277fc3923ce935516e1a8597cde26144ba80.title: Unveiling the Landscape of Clinical Depression Assessment: From Behavioral Signatures to Psychiatric Reasoning
5d34277fc3923ce935516e1a8597cde26144ba80.abstract: Depression is a widespread mental disorder that affects millions worldwide. While automated depression assessment shows promise, most studies rely on limited or non-clinically validated data, and often prioritize complex model design over real-world effectiveness. In this paper, we aim to unveil the landscape of clinical depression assessment. We introduce C-MIND, a clinical multimodal neuropsychiatric diagnosis dataset collected over two years from real hospital visits. Each participant completes three structured psychiatric tasks and receives a final diagnosis from expert clinicians, with informative audio, video, transcript, and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) signals recorded. Using C-MIND, we first analyze behavioral signatures relevant to diagnosis. We train a range of classical models to quantify how different tasks and modalities contribute to diagnostic performance
5d34277fc3923ce935516e1a8597cde26144ba80.zh_title: 临床抑郁症评估全景：从行为特征到精神科推理
5d34277fc3923ce935516e1a8597cde26144ba80.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 C-MIND 数据集，采集自两年真实医院就诊，用于临床抑郁症多模态评估研究。

指出多数研究依赖缺乏临床验证的数据
5d34277fc3923ce935516e1a8597cde26144ba80.zh_abstract: 抑郁症是一种广泛存在的精神障碍，影响着全球数百万人。尽管自动化抑郁症评估展现出前景，但大多数研究依赖于有限的或未经临床验证的数据，并且往往优先考虑复杂的模型设计，而非真实世界中的有效性。在本文中，我们旨在揭示临床抑郁症评估的图景。我们提出了 C-MIND，这是一个临床多模态神经精神诊断数据集，历时两年从真实医院就诊中收集。每位参与者完成三项结构化的精神病学任务，并由专家临床医生给出最终诊断，同时记录具有信息量的音频、视频、文本转录以及功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）信号。利用 C-MIND，我们首先分析与诊断相关的行为特征。我们训练了一系列经典模型，以量化不同任务和模态对诊断性能的贡献。

5d297dd6e389f0c396a659b2fb9e02418f9d0b81.title: Unravelling Causal Genetic Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease via Neuron to Gene-token Backtracking in Neural Architecture: A Groundbreaking Reverse-Gene-Finder Approach
5d297dd6e389f0c396a659b2fb9e02418f9d0b81.abstract: Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) affects over 55 million people globally, yet the key genetic contributors remain poorly understood. Leveraging recent advancements in genomic foundation models, we present the innovative Reverse-Gene-Finder technology, a ground-breaking neuron-to-gene-token backtracking approach in a neural network architecture to elucidate the novel causal genetic biomarkers driving AD onset. Reverse-Gene-Finder comprises three key innovations. Firstly, we exploit the observation that genes with the highest probability of causing AD, defined as the most causal genes (MCGs), must have the highest probability of activating those neurons with the highest probability of causing AD, defined as the most causal neurons (MCNs). Secondly, we utilize a gene token representation at the input layer to allow each gene (known or novel to AD) to be represented as a discrete and unique entity i
5d297dd6e389f0c396a659b2fb9e02418f9d0b81.zh_title: 神经网络反向基因追踪解析阿尔茨海默病遗传标志物
5d297dd6e389f0c396a659b2fb9e02418f9d0b81.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 Reverse-Gene-Finder，经神经元到基因 token 回溯，识别阿尔茨海默病因果遗传标志物。
key_points: 提出Reverse-Gene-Finder回溯方法
基于基因组基础模型架构
寻找AD因果遗传标志物
5d297dd6e389f0c396a659b2fb9e02418f9d0b81.zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's Disease，AD）影响全球超过 5500 万人，然而其关键遗传因素仍知之甚少。借助基因组基础模型的最新进展，我们提出了创新的 Reverse-Gene-Finder 技术，这是一种在神经网络架构中开创性的从神经元到基因 token 的回溯方法，用以阐明驱动 AD 发病的新型因果遗传生物标志物。Reverse-Gene-Finder 包含三项关键创新。首先，我们利用这样一个观察：最有可能导致 AD 的基因（定义为最具因果性基因，most causal genes，MCGs）必定具有最高的概率去激活那些最有可能导致 AD 的神经元（定义为最具因果性神经元，most causal neurons，MCNs）。其次，我们在输入层利用基因 token 表示，使每个基因（无论对 AD 已知或新发现）都能被表示为一个离散且独特的实体 i。

5273acd3134fa95653c0dee49cfb1540f601871f.title: Bidirectional Channel-selective Semantic Interaction for Semi-Supervised Medical Segmentation
5273acd3134fa95653c0dee49cfb1540f601871f.abstract: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation is an effective method for addressing scenarios with limited labeled data. Existing methods mainly rely on frameworks such as mean teacher and dual-stream consistency learning. These approaches often face issues like error accumulation and model structural complexity, while also neglecting the interaction between labeled and unlabeled data streams. To overcome these challenges, we propose a Bidirectional Channel-selective Semantic Interaction (BCSI) framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. First, we propose a Semantic-Spatial Perturbation (SSP) mechanism, which disturbs the data using two strong augmentation operations and leverages unsupervised learning with pseudo-labels from weak augmentations. Additionally, we employ consistency on the predictions from the two strong augmentations to further improve model stability and robus
5273acd3134fa95653c0dee49cfb1540f601871f.zh_title: 双向通道选择语义交互的半监督医学分割
5273acd3134fa95653c0dee49cfb1540f601871f.summary: 提出双向通道选择语义交互框架BCSI，缓解半监督医学图像分割中的误差累积并加强标注与未标注流交互。
key_points: 面向标注数据有限的医学图像分割
针对均值教师等方法的误差累积问题
强调标注与未标注数据流的交互
5273acd3134fa95653c0dee49cfb1540f601871f.zh_abstract: 半监督医学图像分割是解决标注数据有限场景的一种有效方法。现有方法主要依赖均值教师（mean teacher）和双流一致性学习等框架。这些方法往往面临误差累积和模型结构复杂等问题，同时也忽视了有标注与无标注数据流之间的交互。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于半监督医学图像分割的双向通道选择语义交互（Bidirectional Channel-selective Semantic Interaction, BCSI）框架。首先，我们提出了一种语义-空间扰动（Semantic-Spatial Perturbation, SSP）机制，该机制使用两种强增强操作扰动数据，并利用来自弱增强的伪标签进行无监督学习。此外，我们对来自两种强增强的预测施加一致性，以进一步提高模型稳定性和鲁棒（robus）

4d3872ae9309bf57330cc0cc82ccbf2681ec9c88.title: Developing a Postgraduate Program for AI in Medicine with Kern's Six-Step Curriculum Development Approach in Singapore
4d3872ae9309bf57330cc0cc82ccbf2681ec9c88.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed the medical field, necessitating significant changes in medical education to prepare healthcare professionals for future work requirements. However, the integration of AI into medical curricula has been slow and lacks standardization. In this paper, we present our work in developing a year-long postgraduate-level AI in Medicine program offered by a medical school at a public university in Singapore. Our curriculum design follows Kern's six-step approach to medical curriculum development, organized into a four-session framework. These sessions involved collaboration with hospital and university administrators, educators, industry experts, and healthcare professionals. The program is structured around three core courses: Foundational Healthcare AI, Clinical Applications of Healthcare AI, and Governance and Ethics for Healthcare AI. Each
4d3872ae9309bf57330cc0cc82ccbf2681ec9c88.zh_title: 新加坡研究生医学AI课程：Kern六步开发法
4d3872ae9309bf57330cc0cc82ccbf2681ec9c88.summary: 介绍新加坡某公立大学医学院依Kern六步课程开发法，建设为期一年的医学AI研究生项目。
key_points: AI正快速改变医学领域
医学课程中AI整合缓慢且缺乏标准

49d27a06d9ab022c277f51353d75582b44d4f74a.title: GP-MoLFormer-Sim: Test Time Molecular Optimization through Contextual Similarity Guidance
49d27a06d9ab022c277f51353d75582b44d4f74a.abstract: The ability to design molecules while preserving similarity to a target molecule and/or property is crucial for various applications in drug discovery, chemical design, and biology. We introduce in this paper an efficient training-free method for navigating and sampling from the molecular space with a generative Chemical Language Model (CLM), while using the molecular similarity to the target as a guide. Our method leverages the contextual representations learned from the CLM itself to estimate the molecular similarity, which is then used to adjust the autoregressive sampling strategy of the CLM. At each step of the decoding process, the method tracks the distance of the current generations from the target and updates the logits to encourage the preservation of similarity in generations. 49d27a06d9ab022c277f51353d75582b44d4f74a.zh_title: GP-MoLFormer-Sim：上下文相似度引导的分子优化
49d27a06d9ab022c277f51353d75582b44d4f74a.summary: 提出免训练方法GP-MoLFormer-Sim，以目标分子相似度为引导，在分子空间中采样与优化。
key_points: 面向药物发现与化学设计中的分子优化
保持与目标分子或性质的相似性
无需训练即可采样
利用化学语言模型的上下文表征
49d27a06d9ab022c277f51353d75582b44d4f74a.zh_abstract: 在设计分子的同时保持与目标分子和/或性质的相似性，对于药物发现、化学设计和生物学中的各种应用至关重要。本文中，我们介绍一种高效的无需训练的方法，利用生成式化学语言模型（Chemical Language Model, CLM）在分子空间中导航和采样，同时以与目标的分子相似性作为指导。我们的方法利用从 CLM 本身学习到的上下文表示来估计分子相似性，然后用于调整 CLM 的自回归采样策略。在解码过程的每一步，该方法跟踪当前生成物与目标的距离，并更新 logits 以鼓励生成物中相似性的保持。我们使用最近提出的约 47M 参数的基于 SMILES 的 CLM——GP-MoLFormer——实现该方法，并

3125cf177e4be40765c8ca4293360a5f6ff8a0a4.title: Advancing Medical Multimodal Learning and Data Generation with Diffusion Model and LLM
3125cf177e4be40765c8ca4293360a5f6ff8a0a4.abstract:
Synthesizing electronic health records (EHR) is essential for addressing data scarcity, bias, and fairness in healthcare models. EHR data are inherently multimodal and sequential, encompassing structured codes, clinical notes, medical
images, and irregular time intervals. Traditional generative models like GANs and VAEs struggle to capture these complexities, while diffusion-based models offer improvements but remain limited to task-specific applications. To address these challenges, two diffusion-based models, MedDiffusion and EHRPD, have been developed. MedDiffusion enhances health risk prediction by generating synthetic patient data
and capturing visit-level relationships, while EHRPD generates sequential, multimodal EHR data, incorporating temporal interval estimation to improve diversity and fidelity. Future work aims to overcome limitations in multimodal data generation by developi
3125cf177e4be40765c8ca4293360a5f6ff8a0a4.zh_title: 扩散模型与LLM推进医学多模态学习与数据生成
3125cf177e4be40765c8ca4293360a5f6ff8a0a4.summary: 提出两个扩散模型方法，用于合成多模态、序列化的电子健康记录数据。
key_points: EHR多模态、序列化且时间间隔不规则
GAN与VAE及既有扩散模型存在局限
提出两个扩散模型应对上述挑战
3125cf177e4be40765c8ca4293360a5f6ff8a0a4.zh_abstract: 合成电子健康记录（EHR）对于解决医疗保健模型中的数据稀缺、偏差和公平性问题至关重要。EHR数据本质上是多模态和序列化的，涵盖结构化编码、临床笔记、医学图像和不规则时间间隔。传统生成模型如GAN和VAE难以捕捉这些复杂性，而基于扩散的模型虽有改进，但仍局限于任务特定的应用。为应对这些挑战，已开发出两种基于扩散的模型：MedDiffusion和EHRPD。MedDiffusion通过生成合成患者数据并捕捉就诊级关系来增强健康风险预测，而EHRPD生成序列化、多模态的EHR数据，并纳入时间间隔估计以提高多样性和保真度。未来工作旨在通过开发……来克服多模态数据生成中的局限

2c96277dd2fc59e0fa696ab2673829cb3a74b305.title: Enhancing Medical Large Vision-Language Models via Alignment Distillation
2c96277dd2fc59e0fa696ab2673829cb3a74b305.abstract: Medical Large Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown promising results in clinical applications, but often suffer from hallucinated outputs due to misaligned visual understanding. In this work, we identify two fundamental limitations contributing to this issue: insufficient visual representation learning and poor visual attention alignment. To address these problems, we propose MEDALIGN, a simple, lightweight alignment distillation framework that transfers visual alignment knowledge from a domain-specific Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model to Med-LVLMs. MEDALIGN introduces two distillation losses: a spatial-aware visual alignment loss based on visual token-level similarity structures, and an attention-aware distillation loss that guides attention toward diagnostically relevant regions. Extensive experiments on medical report generation and medical visual question
2c96277dd2fc59e0fa696ab2673829cb3a74b305.zh_title: MEDALIGN：对齐蒸馏增强医学大视觉语言模型
2c96277dd2fc59e0fa696ab2673829cb3a74b305.summary: 针对医学大视觉语言模型幻觉问题，提出轻量对齐蒸馏框架 MEDALIGN，迁移视觉对齐知识以改善视觉表征与注意力对齐。
key_points: 指出视觉表征不足与注意力对齐差两大问题
提出轻量级对齐蒸馏框架 MEDALIGN
从外部迁移视觉对齐知识，缓解幻觉输出
AAAI 2025 同行评审论文
2c96277dd2fc59e0fa696ab2673829cb3a74b305.zh_abstract: 医学大型视觉语言模型（Medical Large Vision-Language Models，Med-LVLMs）在临床应用中已展现出有前景的结果，但由于视觉理解错位，往往会产生幻觉输出。在本工作中，我们识别出导致该问题的两个根本性局限：视觉表征学习不足和视觉注意力对齐不佳。为解决这些问题，我们提出了 MEDALIGN，一个简单、轻量的对齐蒸馏框架，将来自领域特定的对比语言-图像预训练（Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training，CLIP）模型的视觉对齐知识迁移至 Med-LVLMs。MEDALIGN 引入两种蒸馏损失：一种基于视觉 token 级相似性结构的空间感知视觉对齐损失，以及一种注意力感知蒸馏损失，其将注意力引导至具有诊断相关性的区域。在医学报告生成和医学视觉问答

29ea9273ba1a12cf7401c0429a39ea4d639acd46.title: SIGraph: Saliency Image-Graph Network for Retinal Disease Classification in Fundus Image
29ea9273ba1a12cf7401c0429a39ea4d639acd46.abstract: An efficient and precise diagnosis of retinal diseases is a fundamental goal for auxiliary diagnostic systems in ophthalmology. Inspired by the importance of scattered subtle lesions in manual retinal disease diagnosis, recent research has achieved state-of-the-art performance by mining information related to subtle lesions, including their texture and shape. However, the spatial distribution patterns of subtle lesion areas, which are also crucial in manual diagnosis, have been overlooked in existing research. Neglecting these spatial distribution patterns (e.g., the ring distribution of microaneurysms in diabetic macular edema) may negatively impact the diagnostic process. In this paper, we introduce the Saliency-Image-Graph (SIGraph) network to capture the spatial distribution patterns of lesion areas. We first employ saliency-based perception to identify latent lesion pixels. Subseque
29ea9273ba1a12cf7401c0429a39ea4d639acd46.zh_title: SIGraph：显著性图像-图网络用于眼底疾病分类
29ea9273ba1a12cf7401c0429a39ea4d639acd46.summary: 提出图像-图网络 SIGraph，挖掘细微病灶的空间分布模式，用于眼底图像中的视网膜疾病分类。
key_points: 聚焦眼底细微病灶的纹理与形状信息
补足既有方法忽视的病灶空间分布模式

29ea9273ba1a12cf7401c0429a39ea4d639acd46.zh_abstract: 对视网膜疾病进行高效而精确的诊断是眼科辅助诊断系统的一项基本目标。受人工视网膜疾病诊断中散在细微病变重要性的启发，近期研究通过挖掘与细微病变相关的信息（包括其纹理和形状），已取得最先进的性能。然而，细微病变区域的空间分布模式在人工诊断中同样至关重要，却在现有研究中被忽视。忽视这些空间分布模式（例如糖尿病性黄斑水肿中微血管瘤的环形分布）可能对诊断过程产生负面影响。本文提出显著性图像图（Saliency-Image-Graph，SIGraph）网络，以捕捉病变区域的空间分布模式。我们首先采用基于显著性的感知来识别潜在病变像素。随后……

249b529c301f34b403ef296e16ee42cdf941a7bc.title: Divide, Conquer and Unite: Hierarchical Style-Recalibrated Prototype Alignment for Federated Medical Segmentation
249b529c301f34b403ef296e16ee42cdf941a7bc.abstract: Federated learning enables multiple medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains a major challenge. Many existing works attempt to address this issue by leveraging model representations (e.g., mean feature vectors) to correct local training; however, they often face two key limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: Current approaches primarily focus on final-layer features, overlooking critical multi-level cues and thus diluting essential context for accurate segmentation. 2) Layerwise Style Bias Accumulation: Although utilizing representations can partially align global features, these methods neglect domain-specific biases within intermediate layers, allowing style discrepancies to build up and reduce model robustness. To address these challenges, we propose FedBCS to bridge
249b529c301f34b403ef296e16ee42cdf941a7bc.zh_title: 联邦医学分割的分层风格重校准原型对齐
249b529c301f34b403ef296e16ee42cdf941a7bc.summary: 针对联邦医学图像分割中的特征异质性，提出分层风格重校准原型对齐方法，缓解扫描仪与协议差异。
key_points: 聚焦联邦医学分割特征异质性
指出现有方法仅用末层特征、上下文不足

249b529c301f34b403ef296e16ee42cdf941a7bc.zh_abstract: 联邦学习使多家医疗机构能够在无需共享数据的情况下训练一个全局模型，但来自不同扫描仪或协议的特征异质性仍是一项重大挑战。许多现有工作试图通过利用模型表示（例如平均特征向量）来校正本地训练，以解决这一问题；然而，它们通常面临两个关键局限：1）上下文表示学习不完整：当前方法主要关注最终层特征，忽略了关键的多层级线索，从而稀释了准确分割所必需的重要上下文。2）逐层风格偏差累积：尽管利用表示能够部分对齐全局特征，但这些方法忽略了中间层内领域特定的偏差，使风格差异不断累积并降低模型鲁棒性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 FedBCS 以弥合

10e21cf93ec095990fc398e8d2fdd4d8807f0f70.title: MCAT: Visual Query-Based Localization of Standard Anatomical Clips in Fetal Ultrasound Videos Using Multi-Tier Class-Aware Token Transformer
10e21cf93ec095990fc398e8d2fdd4d8807f0f70.abstract:
Accurate standard plane acquisition in fetal ultrasound (US) videos is crucial for fetal growth assessment, anomaly detection, and adherence to clinical guidelines. However, manually selecting standard frames is time-consuming and prone to intra- and inter-sonographer variability. Existing methods primarily rely on image-based approaches that capture standard frames and then classify the input frames across different anatomies. This ignores the dynamic nature of video acquisition and its interpretation.
To address these challenges, we introduce Multi-Tier Class-Aware Token Transformer (MCAT); a visual query-based video clip localization (VQ-VCL) method to assist sonographers by enabling them to capture a quick US sweep. By then providing a visual query of the anatomy they wish to analyze, MCAT returns the video clip containing the standard frames for that anatomy, facilitating thorough s
10e21cf93ec095990fc398e8d2fdd4d8807f0f70.zh_title: 胎儿超声视频标准切面定位的多层类别感知Transformer
10e21cf93ec095990fc398e8d2fdd4d8807f0f70.summary: 提出MCAT，基于视觉查询在胎儿超声视频中定位标准解剖切面，利用多层类别感知Token Transformer替代逐帧图像分类方法。
key_points: 标准切面获取关乎胎儿生长评估与异常检测
人工选帧耗时且存在观察者间与观察者内差异
现有方法基于图像分类，忽略视频采集的动态特性
10e21cf93ec095990fc398e8d2fdd4d8807f0f70.zh_abstract:
在胎儿超声（ultrasound，US）视频中准确获取标准切面对于胎儿生长评估、异常检测以及遵循临床指南至关重要。然而，人工选择标准帧既耗时，又容易受到超声检查者个体内和个体间变异性的影响。现有方法主要依赖于基于图像的方法，即先捕获标准帧，然后将输入帧按不同解剖结构进行分类。这忽视了视频采集及其解读的动态特性。
为应对这些挑战，我们提出了多层类别感知 Token Transformer（Multi-Tier Class-Aware Token Transformer，MCAT）；这是一种基于视觉查询的视频片段定位（visual query-based video clip localization，VQ-VCL）方法，通过使超声检查者能够进行快速 US 扫查来为其提供辅助。随后，通过提供其希望分析的解剖结构的视觉查询，MCAT 返回包含该解剖结构标准帧的视频片段，从而促进全面的 s

06a7868f5c36efb66b3a00a55d72f74767f4ebbe.title: S2Drug: Bridging Protein Sequence and 3D Structure in Contrastive Representation Learning for Virtual Screening
06a7868f5c36efb66b3a00a55d72f74767f4ebbe.abstract: Virtual screening (VS) is an essential task in drug discovery, focusing on the identification of small-molecule ligands that bind to specific protein pockets. Existing deep learning methods, from early regression models to recent contrastive learning approaches, primarily rely on structural data while overlooking protein sequences, which are more accessible and can enhance generalizability. However, directly integrating protein sequences poses challenges due to the redundancy and noise in large-scale protein-ligand datasets. To address these limitations, we propose S²Drug, a two-stage framework that explicitly incorporates protein Sequence information and 3D Structure context in protein-ligand contrastive representation learning. In the first stage, we perform protein sequence pretraining on ChemBL using an ESM2-based backbone, combined with a tailored data sampling strategy to reduce re
06a7868f5c36efb66b3a00a55d72f74767f4ebbe.zh_title: S2Drug：融合蛋白序列与三维结构的虚拟筛选对比表示学习
06a7868f5c36efb66b3a00a55d72f74767f4ebbe.summary: 提出S2Drug，在对比表示学习中结合蛋白序列与三维结构用于虚拟筛选，以提升泛化能力并应对序列冗余与噪声。
key_points: 虚拟筛选用于识别与特定蛋白口袋结合的小分子配体
现有方法多依赖结构数据而忽略更易获取的蛋白序列
直接引入序列面临冗余与噪声挑战
06a7868f5c36efb66b3a00a55d72f74767f4ebbe.zh_abstract: 虚拟筛选（VS）是药物发现中的一项关键任务，重点在于识别能够结合特定蛋白质口袋的小分子配体。现有的深度学习方法，从早期回归模型到近期的对比学习方法，主要依赖结构数据，而忽视蛋白质序列；蛋白质序列更易获取，并且能够增强泛化能力。然而，由于大规模蛋白质-配体数据集中存在冗余和噪声，直接整合蛋白质序列会带来挑战。为解决这些局限，我们提出 S²Drug，一个两阶段框架，在蛋白质-配体对比表示学习中显式纳入蛋白质序列（Sequence）信息和 3D 结构（Structure）上下文。在第一阶段，我们使用基于 ESM2 的主干网络在 ChemBL 上进行蛋白质序列预训练，并结合定制的数据采样策略来减少 re

0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.title: Ambiguity-aware Truncated Flow Matching for Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.abstract: A simultaneous enhancement of accuracy and diversity of predictions remains a challenge in ambiguous medical image segmentation (AMIS) due to the inherent trade-offs. While truncated diffusion probabilistic models (TDPMs) hold strong potential with a paradigm optimization, existing TDPMs suffer from entangled accuracy and diversity of predictions with insufficient fidelity and plausibility. To address the aforementioned challenges, we propose Ambiguity-aware Truncated Flow Matching (ATFM), which introduces a novel inference paradigm and dedicated model components. Firstly, we propose Data-Hierarchical Inference, a redefinition of AMIS-specific inference paradigm, which enhances accuracy and diversity at data-distribution and data-sample level, respectively, for an effective disentanglement. Secondly, Gaussian Truncation Representation (GTR) is introduced to enhance both fidelity of predi
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.zh_title: 歧义感知截断流匹配的医学图像分割
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.summary: 提出歧义感知截断流匹配ATFM，兼顾模糊医学图像分割的准确性与多样性。
key_points: 模糊分割需兼顾准确与多样
现有截断扩散模型二者纠缠
提出歧义感知截断流匹配
0222daa90c8cdaa5ae025e3243403e00166d3918.zh_abstract: 由于固有的权衡，同时提升预测的准确性和多样性在模糊医学图像分割（AMIS）中仍然是一项挑战。尽管截断扩散概率模型（TDPMs）通过范式优化具有强大潜力，但现有 TDPMs 仍存在预测准确性与多样性相互纠缠、保真度和合理性不足的问题。为应对上述挑战，我们提出模糊感知截断流匹配（ATFM），它引入了一种新的推理范式和专门的模型组件。首先，我们提出数据分层推理（Data-Hierarchical Inference），这是对 AMIS 特定推理范式的重新定义，分别在数据分布和数据样本层面提升准确性和多样性，从而实现有效解耦。其次，引入高斯截断表示（GTR），以增强 predi 的保真度

fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.title: SculptDrug : A Spatial Condition-Aware Bayesian Flow Model for Structure-based Drug Design
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.abstract: Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) has emerged as a popular approach in drug discovery, leveraging three-dimensional protein structures to generate drug ligands. However, existing generative models encounter several key challenges: (1) Incorporating boundary condition constraints, (2) Integrating hierarchical structural conditions and (3) Ensuring spatial modeling fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose SculptDrug, a spatial condition-aware generative model based on Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs). First, SculptDrug follows a BFNs-based framework and employs a progressive denoising strategy to ensure spatial modeling fidelity, iteratively refining atom positions while enhancing local interactions for precise spatial alignment. Second, we introduce the Boundary Awareness Block, which incorporates protein surface constraints into the generative process to ensure that the generate
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.zh_title: SculptDrug：空间条件感知贝叶斯流药物设计
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.summary: 提出SculptDrug空间条件感知贝叶斯流模型，用于基于结构的三维药物分子生成设计。
key_points: 结构药物设计需满足边界约束
需融合层级结构条件
提出空间条件感知贝叶斯流模型
fcccc572017a6ab950d4bc31ab5b5873a45d4674.zh_abstract: 基于结构的药物设计（Structure-Based Drug Design, SBDD）已成为药物发现中一种流行的方法，其利用三维蛋白质结构来生成药物配体。然而，现有的生成模型面临若干关键挑战：（1）纳入边界条件约束；（2）整合层次化结构条件；（3）确保空间建模的保真度。为克服这些局限，我们提出 SculptDrug，一种基于贝叶斯流网络（Bayesian Flow Networks, BFNs）的空间条件感知生成模型。首先，SculptDrug 遵循基于 BFNs 的框架，并采用渐进式去噪策略以确保空间建模保真度，在迭代细化原子位置的同时增强局部相互作用，以实现精确的空间对齐。其次，我们引入边界感知模块（Boundary Awareness Block），将蛋白质表面约束纳入生成过程，以确保生成的

f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.title: Improving Cancer Gene Prediction by Enhancing Common Information Between the PPI Network and Gene Functional Association
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.abstract: Identifying cancer genes is crucial for treatment and understanding pathogenesis. Recent methods typically leverage protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks or gene functional association data from annotated gene sets. There may be some shared neighborhood structure information between these two types of gene association data. While this common information may contain more accurate gene association information, existing methods often overlook this potential. To address this gap, we introduce DISFusion, which integrates multi-omics cancer data, PPI networks, and gene functional associations to identify cancer genes. A key innovation of DISFusion is the cross-view decorrelation loss, which enhances the common information between PPI networks and gene functional associations, thereby improving prediction accuracy. Extensive experiments indicate that DISFusion outperforms state-of-the-art
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.zh_title: 增强PPI网络与基因功能关联共有信息的癌症基因预测
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.summary: 提出方法增强PPI网络与基因功能关联数据间的共有信息，以提升癌症基因预测效果。
key_points: 癌症基因识别对治疗与发病机制重要
现有方法多用PPI或基因功能关联数据
两类数据间可能存在共享邻域结构信息
f229e560f71aca9afb03ea82beca58c4f0adcd77.zh_abstract: 识别癌症基因对于治疗和理解发病机制至关重要。近期方法通常利用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络或来自注释基因集的基因功能关联数据。这两类基因关联数据之间可能存在一些共享的邻域结构信息。虽然这种共同信息可能包含更准确的基因关联信息，但现有方法往往忽视这一潜力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 DISFusion，它整合多组学癌症数据、PPI 网络和基因功能关联来识别癌症基因。DISFusion 的一个关键创新是跨视图去相关损失（cross-view decorrelation loss），它增强 PPI 网络与基因功能关联之间的共同信息，从而提高预测准确性。大量实验表明，DISFusion 优于最先进的

ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.title: Expert-Inspired Multi-Agent Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a fundamental yet inherently challenging task in drug discovery, as it requires simultaneously optimizing multiple, often conflicting, molecular properties. Although recent deep learning methods have shown promise, they often lack objective-specific specialization and dynamic coordination, making them ineffective in handling competing objectives and difficult to scale in complex, high-dimensional molecular design tasks. Inspired by the division of labor among domain experts in medicinal chemistry, we propose MAMO, a multi-agent framework for molecular design that simulates expert collaboration. Each agent specializes in optimizing a single objective, and their interactions are orchestrated by a central scheduling module that dynamically reallocates tasks based on evaluation feedback. This coordination mechanism enables interpretable and goal-cond
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.zh_title: 专家启发的多智能体协同用于多目标分子优化
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.summary: AAAI 2026 提出受专家分工启发的多智能体协同方法，以应对药物发现中多目标、相互冲突的分子性质优化难题。
key_points: 面向多目标分子优化，目标间常相互冲突
指出现有深度学习方法缺乏目标专业化与动态协调
借鉴分工机制提升高维分子设计可扩展性
ee7e6ab1fa4e6a247c520df0562744f6999ee75e.zh_abstract: 多目标分子优化是药物发现中一项基础但本质上具有挑战性的任务，因为它需要同时优化多个、且常常相互冲突的分子性质。尽管近期深度学习方法已显示出前景，但它们通常缺乏目标特定的专门化和动态协调，使其在处理相互竞争的目标时效果不佳，并且难以扩展到复杂、高维的分子设计任务中。受药物化学领域专家分工的启发，我们提出 MAMO，一个模拟专家协作的分子设计多智能体框架。每个智能体专门优化单个目标，它们的交互由中央调度模块编排，该模块根据评估反馈动态重新分配任务。这种协调机制能够实现可解释且目标条件（goal-cond）

ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.title: Blend the Separated: Mixture of Synergistic Experts for Data-Scarcity Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.abstract: Drug-target interaction prediction (DTI) is essential in various applications including drug discovery and clinical application. There are two perspectives of input data widely used in DTI prediction: Intrinsic data represents how drugs or targets are constructed, and extrinsic data represents how drugs or targets are related to other biological entities. However, any of the two perspectives of input data can be scarce for some drugs or targets, especially for those unpopular or newly discovered. Furthermore, ground-truth labels for specific interaction types can also be scarce. Therefore, we propose the first method to tackle DTI prediction under input data and/or label scarcity. To make our model functional when only one perspective of input data is available, we design two separate experts to process intrinsic and extrinsic data respectively and fuse them adaptively according to diffe
ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.zh_title: 混合协同专家：数据稀缺下的药物-靶点相互作用预测
ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.summary: 针对药物或靶点内在数据与外在数据稀缺问题，提出混合协同专家方法预测药物-靶点相互作用。
key_points: DTI预测用于药物发现与临床应用
内在数据描述药物或靶点如何构成
外在数据描述与其他生物实体的关系
ea72682b198f208cad002eb2add795889188216d.zh_abstract: 药物-靶标相互作用预测（DTI）在包括药物发现和临床应用在内的多种应用中至关重要。DTI 预测中广泛使用两种视角的输入数据：内在数据表示药物或靶标是如何构成的，外在数据表示药物或靶标如何与其他生物实体相关联。然而，对于某些药物或靶标，尤其是那些不受关注或新发现的药物或靶标，两种视角的输入数据中的任何一种都可能稀缺。此外，特定相互作用类型的真实标签也可能稀缺。因此，我们提出首个在输入数据和/或标签稀缺情况下解决 DTI 预测的方法。为了在仅有一种视角的输入数据可用时使我们的模型能够发挥作用，我们设计两个独立的专家分别处理内在数据和外在数据，并根据 diffe 自适应地融合它们

e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.title: Reducing Alert Fatigue Through AI Ranking: A Deployed Public Health Data Monitoring System
e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.abstract:
Public health experts need scalable methods to monitor large volumes of health data (e.g., human-reported cases, hospitalizations, deaths). These methods must identify individual data points that may indicate significant events, such as outbreaks, or reveal data quality issues. Identifying, triaging, and analyzing these data points in real-time is critical for preventing downstream errors in forecasting or policy. Traditional alert-based data monitoring systems, used for decades in practice, fail to identify relevant data events for several reasons. For example, these systems may not output real-time results from large data volumes, or they may return tens of thousands of unhelpful alerts. 

We introduce a human-in-the-loop AI system for public health data monitoring that uses a ranking-based AI anomaly detection method. This system was developed through a multi-year interdisciplinary co
e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.zh_title: 以AI排序缓解告警疲劳：已部署公共卫生数据监测系统
e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.summary: 针对公共卫生数据监测中的告警疲劳问题，介绍一套已部署的AI排序监测系统。
key_points: 公共卫生监测需处理海量数据
传统告警系统存在告警疲劳问题
系统已在实践中部署使用
e52c3c05cf3c97bc3f4f93d9f062d8fa8485038d.zh_abstract:
公共卫生专家需要可扩展的方法来监测大量健康数据（例如，人类报告的病例、住院、死亡）。这些方法必须识别可能指示重大事件（如疫情暴发）或揭示数据质量问题的单个数据点。实时识别、分诊和分析这些数据点对于防止预测或政策中的下游错误至关重要。传统基于警报的数据监测系统在实践中已使用数十年，但由于若干原因未能识别相关数据事件。例如，这些系统可能无法从大量数据量中输出实时结果，或者可能返回数万条无用的警报。

我们提出一个用于公共卫生数据监测的人在回路 AI 系统，该系统使用基于排名的 AI 异常检测方法。该系统是通过多年跨学科 co

dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.title: Transforming Healthcare Decision Making Using Artificial Intelligence
dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.abstract: Decision making is at the core of healthcare: clinicians constantly make complex decisions that span diagnosis, treatment, care coordination, and resource allocation. Yet, human decisions are never perfect, leading to suboptimal patient care. My research uses AI to augment and improve decision-making in healthcare, following a synergistic approach that combines novel AI methods with practical, real-world implementation. Here, I will explore two key themes: Application-Inspired AI Innovations, focused on novel AI methods grounded in practical healthcare problems; and Path to Deployment and Impact, which addresses AI integration into clinical workflows for real-world improvements.
dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.zh_title: 用人工智能改进医疗决策
dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.summary: 以应用驱动方式研究AI如何辅助诊断、治疗、照护协调与资源分配等医疗决策。
key_points: 聚焦临床决策全流程
应用启发的AI方法创新
强调真实世界落地实施
dc49253f5600f2d5e1c7042fdf4ad870408fca84.zh_abstract: 决策是医疗保健的核心：临床医生不断做出复杂决策，涵盖诊断、治疗、照护协调和资源分配。然而，人类决策从不会完美，导致次优的患者照护。我的研究利用 AI 来增强并改善医疗保健中的决策，遵循一种将新颖 AI 方法与实际真实世界实施相结合的协同方法。在此，我将探讨两个关键主题：应用启发的 AI 创新（Application-Inspired AI Innovations），聚焦于以实际医疗保健问题为基础的新颖 AI 方法；以及部署与影响之路（Path to Deployment and Impact），其关注将 AI 整合到临床工作流程中以实现真实世界的改善。

dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.title: SVRMamba: Slice-to-Volume Reconstruction from Multiple MRI Stacks with Slice Sequence Guided Mamba
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.abstract: In fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) involves the computational creation of a 3D volume from multiple stacks of 2D slices. This process is challenging due to slice misalignment and image noise. Current state-of-the-art (SOTA) SVR methods typically employ coarse-to-fine techniques that iteratively refine slice-to-volume motion correction and 3D volume reconstruction. However, both processes are inherently inefficient, making these methods time-consuming and prone to errors. This often results in less robust and accurate outcomes, primarily due to insufficient modeling of the spatial relationships between slices. Typically, 2D fetal MRI slices are acquired using the interleave sequence, which first acquires the odd slices and then the even slices in one stack. To this end, we propose a novel Mamba-based framework called SVRMamba, which integrates
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.zh_title: SVRMamba：多MRI堆栈的切片到体积重建
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.summary: 提出切片序列引导的Mamba方法，从多堆栈胎儿MRI重建三维体积。
key_points: 面向胎儿MRI切片到体积重建
针对切片错位与图像噪声
以切片序列引导Mamba提升效率
dacb821342a8e0a82bfcb9258bd215be1f3dba27.zh_abstract: 在胎儿磁共振成像（MRI）中，切片到体积重建（slice-to-volume reconstruction, SVR）涉及通过计算从多个二维切片堆栈创建三维体积。由于切片错位和图像噪声，该过程具有挑战性。当前最先进（SOTA）的SVR方法通常采用由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）技术，迭代地优化切片到体积的运动校正和三维体积重建。然而，这两个过程本质上效率低下，使这些方法耗时且容易出错。这通常导致稳健性和准确性较低的结果，主要是因为对切片之间空间关系的建模不足。通常，二维胎儿MRI切片使用交错序列（interleave sequence）采集，即在一个堆栈中先采集奇数切片，然后采集偶数切片。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的基于Mamba的框架，称为SVRMamba，它整合了

d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.title: HiFusion: Hierarchical Intra-Spot Alignment and Regional Context Fusion for Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) bridges gene expression and tissue morphology but faces clinical adoption barriers due to technical complexity and prohibitive costs. While computational methods predict gene expression from H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs), existing approaches often fail to capture the intricate biological heterogeneity within spots and are susceptible to morphological noise when integrating contextual information from surrounding tissue. To overcome these limitations, we propose HiFusion, a novel deep learning framework that integrates two complementary components. First, we introduce the Hierarchical Intra-Spot Modeling module that extracts fine-grained morphological representations through multi-resolution sub-patch decomposition, guided by a feature alignment loss to ensure semantic consistency across scales. Concurrently, we present the Context-aware Cross-scale Fu
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.zh_title: HiFusion：从病理图像预测空间基因表达
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.summary: 提出HiFusion，通过位点内层次对齐与区域上下文融合，从H&E全切片图像预测空间基因表达。
key_points: 针对空间转录组成本高、难普及
捕捉位点内生物学异质性
降低周围组织形态学噪声影响
d16576c2fc95cba2c8de7b38528f63000d84a849.zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（Spatial transcriptomics, ST）在基因表达与组织形态之间架起桥梁，但由于技术复杂性和高昂成本，其在临床采用方面面临障碍。尽管计算方法可从 H&E 染色的全切片图像（WSIs）预测基因表达，但现有方法往往无法捕捉 spot 内复杂的生物学异质性，并且在整合来自周围组织的上下文信息时易受形态学噪声影响。为克服这些局限，我们提出 HiFusion，一种新颖的深度学习框架，它整合了两个互补的组件。首先，我们引入层次化 spot 内建模（Hierarchical Intra-Spot Modeling）模块，其通过多分辨率子图块分解提取细粒度的形态学表征，并以特征对齐损失进行引导，以确保跨尺度的语义一致性。同时，我们提出上下文感知的跨尺度融合（Context-aware Cross-scale Fu

cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.title: Association Pattern-enhanced Molecular Representation Learning
cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.abstract: The applicability of drug molecules in various clinical scenarios is significantly influenced by a diverse range of molecular properties. By leveraging self-supervised conditions such as atom attributes and interatomic bonds, existing advanced molecular foundation models can generate expressive representations of these molecules. However, such models often overlook the fixed association patterns within molecules that influence physiological or chemical properties. In this paper, we introduce a novel association pattern-aware message passing method, which can serve as an effective yet general plug-and-play plugin, thereby enhancing the atom representations generated by molecular foundation models without requiring additional pretraining. cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.zh_title: 关联模式增强的分子表示学习
cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.summary: 提出引入分子内固定关联模式的分子表示学习方法，以补充现有分子基础模型忽略的性质相关信息。
key_points: 分子性质影响其临床应用场景
现有模型依赖原子属性与化学键
强调分子内固定关联模式
cb256e3e52a957716890a20cf1f07ed2cc4a09d6.zh_abstract: 药物分子在各种临床场景中的适用性受到多种分子性质的显著影响。通过利用原子属性和原子间键等自监督条件，现有先进的分子基础模型能够生成这些分子的表达性表征。然而，此类模型常常忽略分子内部影响生理或化学性质的固定关联模式。在本文中，我们提出一种新颖的关联模式感知消息传递方法，该方法可作为一种有效且通用的即插即用插件，从而增强分子基础模型生成的原子表征，且无需额外的预训练。此外，构建了分子性质特异的模式库，以收集生成的、可解释的、与这些 pro 结合的常见模式

c92e5cfc6580a37c1408abc0273f0af62507c735.title: CareBot: A Pioneering Full-Process Open-Source Medical Language Model
c92e5cfc6580a37c1408abc0273f0af62507c735.abstract: Recently, both closed-source and open-source LLMs have made significant strides, outperforming humans in various general domains. However, their performance in specific professional domains such as medicine, especially within the open-source community, remains suboptimal due to the complexity of medical knowledge. In this paper, we propose CareBot, a bilingual medical LLM, which leverages a comprehensive approach integrating continuous pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF). Our novel two-stage CPT method, comprising Stable CPT and Boost CPT, effectively bridges the gap between general and domain-specific data, facilitating a smooth transition from pre-training to fine-tuning and enhancing domain knowledge progressively. c92e5cfc6580a37c1408abc0273f0af62507c735.zh_title: CareBot：全流程开源医疗语言模型
c92e5cfc6580a37c1408abc0273f0af62507c735.summary: 提出双语医疗大模型CareBot，融合持续预训练、监督微调与强化学习提升医学领域表现。
key_points: 开源模型医学领域表现仍不理想
融合持续预训练与监督微调
