c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.title: PulseMind: A Multi-Modal Medical Model for Real-World Clinical Diagnosis
c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.abstract:
Recent advances in medical multi-modal models focus on specialized image analysis like dermatology, pathology, or radiology. However, they do not fully capture the complexity of real-world clinical diagnostics, which involve heterogeneous inputs and require ongoing contextual understanding during patient-physician interactions.
To bridge this gap, we introduce PulseMind, a new family of multi-modal diagnostic models that integrates a systematically curated dataset, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, and a tailored training framework. Specifically, we first construct a diagnostic dataset, MediScope, which comprises 98,000 real-world multi-turn consultations and 601,500 medical images, spanning over 10 major clinical departments and more than 200 sub-specialties. Then, to better reflect the requirements of real-world clinical diagnosis, we develop the PulseMind Benchmark, a multi-turn d
c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.zh_title: PulseMind：面向真实临床诊断的多模态医疗模型
c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.summary: 提出多模态诊断模型系列PulseMind，整合系统化整理的数据集与综合评估基准。
key_points: 面向真实临床诊断的多模态模型系列
整合系统化整理的数据集
提供综合评估基准
c848eab7a1fda119d34917159ed72094796c929c.zh_abstract:
近期医学多模态模型的进展聚焦于皮肤病学、病理学或放射学等专科图像分析。然而，它们并未充分捕捉真实世界临床诊断的复杂性，后者涉及异质性输入，并需要在医患互动过程中进行持续的上下文理解。

b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.title: A Simple and Comprehensive Benchmark for Single-Cell Transcriptomics
b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.abstract: Single-cell transcriptomics describes complex molecular features at the individual cell level, serving various roles in biological research, such as enhancing gene expression and predicting drug responses. Due to transcriptomic data structurally resembling sequential data, many researchers have trained numerous transformers on extensive transcriptomic datasets. However, they have consistently neglected to explore the intrinsic properties of the data and the appropriateness of their chosen model architecture. In this paper, we carefully investigate the nature of transcriptomics, identifying three overlooked problems: 1) long-tailed data problem, 2) model selection problem, and 3) evaluation problem. Consequently, by applying the weighted sampling strategy, we address the long-tailed data problem and achieve consistent improvement across all settings. By adapting different model structures
b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.zh_title: 面向单细胞转录组的简明综合基准
b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.summary: 提出单细胞转录组基准，检验Transformer模型对数据内在特性与任务的适配性。
key_points: 单细胞转录组支撑多种生物学研究
已有研究多基于Transformer建模

b68440a6847d8dbba8824adc599714032681b860.zh_abstract: 单细胞转录组学描述了单细胞水平上的复杂分子特征，在生物学研究中发挥多种作用，例如增强基因表达和预测药物反应。由于转录组数据在结构上类似于序列数据，许多研究人员在大量转录组数据集上训练了众多Transformer。然而，他们一直忽视探索数据的内在属性以及所选模型架构的适当性。在本文中，我们仔细研究了转录组学的本质，识别出三个被忽视的问题：1）长尾数据问题，2）模型选择问题，3）评估问题。因此，通过应用加权采样策略，我们解决了长尾数据问题，并在所有设置中实现了一致的改进。通过适配不同的模型结构

b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.title: MARE: Multimodal Analogical Reasoning for Disease Evolution-Aware Radiology Report Generation
b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.abstract: Radiology report generation from longitudinal medical data is critical for assessing disease progression and automating diagnostic workflows. While recent methods incorporate longitudinal information, they primarily rely on multimodal feature fusion, with limited capacity for explicit disease evolution modeling and temporal reasoning. To address this, we propose MARE, an end-to-end framework that formulates longitudinal radiology report generation as a multimodal analogical reasoning task. Inspired by the Abduction–Mapping–Induction paradigm, MARE models latent relational structures underlying disease evolution by aligning lesion-level visual features across time and mapping them to the textual domain for temporally coherent and clinically meaningful report generation. To mitigate the spatial misalignment caused by patient positioning or imaging variation, we introduce an Adaptive Region
b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.zh_title: MARE：面向疾病演变的类比推理放射报告生成
b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.summary: 提出端到端框架MARE，将纵向放射报告生成建模为多模态类比推理任务，以显式建模疾病演变与时间推理。
key_points: 面向纵向数据的放射报告生成

b1abe874ed941fd82557aa02c74a8c0c97aa6b85.zh_abstract: 从纵向医学数据生成放射学报告对于评估疾病进展和自动化诊断工作流程至关重要。尽管最近的方法纳入了纵向信息，但它们主要依赖多模态特征融合，在显式的疾病演化建模和时间推理方面能力有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 MARE，一个端到端框架，将纵向放射学报告生成形式化为多模态类比推理任务。受 Abduction–Mapping–Induction（溯因-映射-归纳）范式启发，MARE 通过对齐跨时间的病灶级视觉特征，并将其映射到文本域，以生成时间连贯且具有临床意义的报告，从而对疾病演化背后的潜在关系结构进行建模。为了减轻由患者定位或成像变化引起的空间错位，我们引入了一种自适应区域（Adaptive Region）

b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.title: Make Foundation Models Trustworthy Again: Causal Fine-Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation
b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.abstract: Vision foundation models (e.g., SAM2, CLIP) show strong generalization in natural image analysis but degrade significantly in specialized domains like medical imaging. This is critical for tasks such as brain tumor segmentation, where errors directly affect surgical planning and patient outcomes. In such contexts, segmentation must be highly reliable and structurally precise, underscoring the need for adaptable methods with low error tolerance. While fine-tuning is the dominant strategy, it is computationally expensive and prone to forgetting. To address this, we propose CausalBridgeNet, a causality-guided correction framework for medical image segmentation. Inspired by predictive coding theories of the Bayesian brain, our method introduces a Predictive Causal Reasoning Unit (PCRU) that estimates structured error maps and delivers targeted feedback to iteratively refine predictions. b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.zh_title: 因果微调适配提升医学图像分割基础模型的可靠性
b1a733975a649e223240b29b59d2c91c47b499c8.summary: 针对视觉基础模型在医学图像分割中性能显著下降的问题，提出因果微调适配方法以提升可靠性与结构精度。
key_points: SAM2、CLIP 等在医学领域泛化性能下降

af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.title: Class Incremental Medical Image Segmentation via Prototype-Guided Calibration and Dual-Aligned Distillation
af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.abstract: Class incremental medical image segmentation (CIMIS) aims to preserve knowledge of previously learned classes while learning new ones without relying on old-class annotations. However, existing methods 1) either adopt one-size-fits-all strategies that treat all spatial regions and feature channels equally, which may hinder the preservation of accurate old knowledge, 2) or focus solely on aligning local prototypes with global ones for old classes while overlooking their local representations in new data, leading to knowledge degradation. To mitigate the above issues, we propose Prototype-Guided Calibration Distillation (PGCD) and Dual-Aligned Prototype Distillation (DAPD) for CIMIS in this paper. af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.zh_title: 原型引导校准与双对齐蒸馏的类增量医学图像分割
af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.summary: 提出原型引导校准与双对齐蒸馏方法，用于类增量医学图像分割，兼顾旧知识保持与新类学习。
key_points: 面向类增量医学图像分割
无需旧类标注学习新类
校准原型并双对齐蒸馏
af7984f2ce1e84caf25d110b47a370fdcc4b04b7.zh_abstract: 类增量医学图像分割（Class incremental medical image segmentation, CIMIS）旨在保留先前学习类别的知识，同时在不依赖旧类别标注的情况下学习新类别。然而，现有方法 1) 要么采用一刀切的策略，平等对待所有空间区域和特征通道，这可能阻碍准确旧知识的保留；2) 要么仅关注将旧类别的局部原型与全局原型对齐，而忽视了它们在新数据中的局部表示，导致知识退化。为了缓解上述问题，本文提出了用于 CIMIS 的原型引导校准蒸馏（Prototype-Guided Calibration Distillation, PGCD）和双对齐原型蒸馏（Dual-Aligned Prototype Distillation, DAPD）。具体而言，PGCD 利用原型到特征的相似性来校准不同空间区域中特定类别的蒸馏强度，有效强化可靠的旧知识并 sup

9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.title: BioDPP: Dynamic Prompt Policy Learning for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.abstract:
Foundational vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, are emerging as a promising paradigm in vision tasks due to their strong generalization ability. Nevertheless, adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging, especially in biomedical imaging, where scarce annotations, low-contrast features and complex patterns hinder model adaptation. Thus, prompt tuning is employed to facilitate the adaptation of VLMs. However, current prompt tuning methods like Context Optimization (CoOp) mainly learn a single yet static prompt which is applied to all images, and such one-size-fits-all prompt cannot describe the case-specific diagnostic cues in biomedical data, compromising the adaptation of VLMs.

9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.zh_title: BioDPP：生物医学视觉语言模型的动态提示策略学习
9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.summary: AAAI 2026提出BioDPP，为生物医学视觉语言模型学习动态提示策略，应对标注稀缺与低对比度特征的适配难题。
key_points: 生物医学影像标注稀缺、特征对比度低
提示微调用于适配CLIP等视觉语言模型
指出CoOp等现有提示微调方法存在不足
9f55f030f04065855684cfce12431bf068ebb9e2.zh_abstract: 基础视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs），如 CLIP，因其强大的泛化能力，正成为视觉任务中一种有前景的范式。然而，将其适应下游任务仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在生物医学成像中，稀缺的标注、低对比度特征和复杂模式阻碍了模型适应。因此，提示调优（prompt tuning）被用于促进 VLMs 的适应。然而，当前的提示调优方法如上下文优化（Context Optimization, CoOp）主要学习一个单一且静态的提示，应用于所有图像，这种一刀切的提示无法描述生物医学数据中病例特定的诊断线索，损害了 VLMs 的适应。为此，我们提出了一种动态提示策略学习方法，能够高效适应生物医学 VLMs（BioDPP），用于准确且高度可泛化的少样本生物医学图像分

9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.title: DSFedMed: Dual-Scale Federated Medical Image Segmentation via Mutual Distillation Between Foundation and Lightweight Models
9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.abstract: Foundation Models (FMs) have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse vision tasks. However, their deployment in federated settings is hindered by high computational demands, substantial communication overhead, and significant inference costs. We propose DSFedMed, a dual-scale federated framework that enables mutual knowledge distillation between a centralized foundation model and lightweight client models for medical image segmentation. To support knowledge distillation, a set of high-quality medical images is generated to replace real public datasets, and a learnability-guided sample selection strategy is proposed to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in dual-scale distillation. This mutual distillation enables the foundation model to transfer general knowledge to lightweight clients, while also incorporating client-specific insights to refine the foundation model. Evaluatio
9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.zh_title: DSFedMed：双尺度联邦医学图像分割
9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.summary: DSFedMed在集中式基础模型与轻量客户端模型间相互蒸馏，实现双尺度联邦医学图像分割。
key_points: 基础模型联邦部署算力与通信开销高
集中基础模型与客户端模型互蒸馏

9a9523a7e3482e3860a75fcb02139f0e5206e516.zh_abstract: 基础模型（Foundation Models, FMs）已在多种视觉任务中展现出很强的泛化能力。然而，它们在联邦环境中的部署受到高计算需求、大量通信开销和显著推理成本的阻碍。我们提出了DSFedMed，一种双尺度联邦框架，可在用于医学图像分割的集中式基础模型与轻量级客户端模型之间实现相互知识蒸馏。为了支持知识蒸馏，生成了一组高质量医学图像以替代真实的公共数据集，并提出了一种可学习性引导的样本选择策略，以提高双尺度蒸馏的效率和有效性。这种相互蒸馏使基础模型能够将通用知识传递给轻量级客户端，同时也纳入客户端特定的见解来优化基础模型。评估

8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.title: Enhancing Predictive Healthcare Using AI-Driven Early Warning Systems
8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.abstract: This research proposes an AI-driven early warning system to predict patient deterioration in real-time using electronic health records (EHRs) and wearable devices. Leveraging deep learning techniques, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for sequential data and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for pattern recognition, the system adapts dynamically through reinforcement learning. Evaluation strategies include retrospective and prospective studies in clinical settings, measuring prediction accuracy and impact on patient outcomes. If successful, this system has the potential to save lives, reduce ICU admissions, and transform healthcare into a proactive, data-driven field.
8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.zh_title: AI驱动早期预警系统提升预测性医疗
8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.summary: 提出AI驱动早期预警系统，利用EHR与可穿戴设备实时预测患者病情恶化。
key_points: 使用EHR与可穿戴设备数据
结合RNN、CNN与强化学习
开展回顾性与前瞻性评估
8a0875369412d218cd5a588b4be1f3df8501250b.zh_abstract: 本研究提出一种人工智能驱动的早期预警系统，利用电子健康记录（EHRs）和可穿戴设备实时预测患者病情恶化。借助深度学习技术，例如用于序列数据的循环神经网络（RNNs）和用于模式识别的卷积神经网络（CNNs），该系统通过强化学习进行动态调整。评估策略包括在临床环境中开展回顾性和前瞻性研究，测量预测准确性及其对患者结局的影响。如果成功，该系统有望挽救生命、减少ICU入住，并将医疗保健转变为一个主动的、数据驱动的领域。

78b9e4d82424f61ac42f384646e059a0ad6fdbd6.title: VidSole: A Multimodal Dataset for Joint Kinetics Quantification and Disease Detection with Deep Learning
78b9e4d82424f61ac42f384646e059a0ad6fdbd6.abstract: Understanding internal joint loading is critical for diagnosing gait-related diseases such as knee osteoarthritis; however, current methods of measuring joint risk factors are time-consuming, expensive, and restricted to lab settings. In this paper, we enable the large-scale, cost-effective biomechanical analysis of joint loading via three key contributions: the development and deployment of novel instrumented insoles, the creation of a large multimodal biomechanics dataset (VidSole), and a baseline deep learning pipeline to predict internal joint loading factors. Our novel instrumented insole measures the tri-axial forces and moments across five high-pressure points under the foot. VidSole consists of the forces and moments measured by these insoles along with corresponding RGB video from two viewpoints, 3D body motion capture, and force plate data for over 2,600 trials of 52 diverse pa
78b9e4d82424f61ac42f384646e059a0ad6fdbd6.zh_title: VidSole：关节动力学量化与疾病检测数据集
78b9e4d82424f61ac42f384646e059a0ad6fdbd6.summary: 发布新型仪器化鞋垫与大规规模多模态生物力学数据集VidSole，支持深度学习关节负荷量化与步态疾病检测。

78b9e4d82424f61ac42f384646e059a0ad6fdbd6.zh_abstract: 理解关节内部负荷对于诊断膝骨关节炎等步态相关疾病至关重要；然而，当前测量关节风险因素的方法耗时、昂贵，且局限于实验室环境。在本文中，我们通过三项关键贡献实现了对关节负荷的大规模、经济有效的生物力学分析：开发并部署新型仪器化鞋垫，创建大规模多模态生物力学数据集（VidSole），以及用于预测关节内部负荷因素的基线深度学习流程。我们的新型仪器化鞋垫测量足下五个高压点处的三轴力和力矩。VidSole 包含这些鞋垫测得的力和力矩，以及来自两个视角的对应 RGB 视频、3D 人体运动捕捉，和超过 2,600 次试验的测力板数据，涉及 52 名不同 pa

6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.title: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts with Retrieval Augmentation for Protein Active Site Identification
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.abstract:
Accurate identification of protein active sites at the residue level is crucial for understanding protein function and advancing drug discovery. However, current methods face two critical challenges: vulnerability in single-instance prediction due to sparse training data, and inadequate modality reliability estimation that leads to performance degradation when unreliable modalities dominate fusion processes. To address these challenges, we introduce Multimodal Mixtureof-Experts with Retrieval Augmentation (MERA), the first
retrieval-augmented framework for protein active site identification. MERA employs hierarchical multi-expert retrieval that dynamically aggregates contextual information from chain, sequence, and active-site perspectives through residuelevel mixture-of-experts gating. To prevent modality degradation, we propose a reliability-aware fusion strategy based on Dempster–Shaf
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.zh_title: 多模态专家混合与检索增强的蛋白质活性位点识别
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.summary: 提出结合检索增强的多模态专家混合方法，在残基级别识别蛋白质活性位点，助力功能理解与药物发现。
key_points: 残基级活性位点识别对药物发现重要
训练数据稀疏致单实例预测脆弱
模态可靠性估计不足致融合性能下降
6ab7527c194a624ab4944ce3817e2876b9afdc24.zh_abstract: 在残基水平准确识别蛋白质活性位点对于理解蛋白质功能和推进药物发现至关重要。然而，当前方法面临两个关键挑战：由于训练数据稀疏，单实例预测存在脆弱性；以及模态可靠性估计不足，导致当不可靠模态主导融合过程时性能下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Multimodal Mixtureof-Experts with Retrieval Augmentation（MERA），这是首个用于蛋白质活性位点识别的检索增强框架。MERA 采用分层多专家检索，通过残基级专家混合门控动态聚合来自链、序列和活性位点视角的上下文信息。为防止模态退化，我们提出一种基于 Dempster–Shaf 的可靠性感知融合策略

5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.title: ShortageSim: Simulating Drug Shortages under Information Asymmetry
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.abstract: Drug shortages pose critical risks to patient care and healthcare systems worldwide, yet the effectiveness of regulatory interventions remains poorly understood due to information asymmetries in pharmaceutical supply chains. We propose ShortageSim, which addresses this challenge by providing the first simulation framework that evaluates the impact of regulatory interventions on competition dynamics under information asymmetry. Using Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents, the framework models the strategic decisions of drug manufacturers and institutional buyers, in response to shortage alerts given by the regulatory agency. Unlike traditional game theory models that assume perfect rationality and complete information, ShortageSim simulates heterogeneous interpretations on regulatory announcements and the resulting decisions. Experiments on self-processed dataset of historical shortage
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.zh_title: ShortageSim：信息不对称下的药品短缺仿真
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.summary: 提出首个基于大模型智能体的仿真框架，评估信息不对称下监管干预对药品供应链竞争动态的影响。
key_points: 药品短缺威胁患者照护与医疗体系
供应链信息不对称使干预效果不明
用大模型智能体建模竞争动态
5c5320f6f1b8d7aaa96e050de40eb9b7466ac076.zh_abstract: 药品短缺对全球患者护理和医疗系统构成严重风险，然而由于药品供应链中的信息不对称，监管干预的有效性仍鲜为人知。我们提出 ShortageSim，它通过提供首个模拟框架来应对这一挑战，该框架评估信息不对称下监管干预对竞争动态的影响。该框架使用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体，对药品制造商和机构买家的战略决策进行建模，以响应监管机构发布的短缺警报。与假设完全理性和完全信息的传统博弈论模型不同，ShortageSim 模拟对监管公告的异质性解读及其由此产生的决策。在自行处理的历史短缺数据集上的实验

555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.title: Multi-OphthaLingua: A Multilingual Benchmark for Assessing and Debiasing LLM Ophthalmological QA in LMICs
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.abstract: Current ophthalmology clinical workflows are plagued by over-referrals, long waits, and complex and heterogeneous medical records. Large language models (LLMs) present a promising solution to automate various procedures such as triaging, preliminary tests like visual acuity assessment, and report summaries. However, LLMs have demonstrated significantly varied performance across different languages in natural language question-answering tasks, potentially exacerbating healthcare disparities in Low and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs). This study introduces the first multilingual ophthalmological question-answering benchmark with manually curated questions parallel across languages, allowing for direct cross-lingual comparisons. Our evaluation of 6 popular LLMs across 7 different languages reveals substantial bias across different languages, highlighting risks for clinical deployment of LLM
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.zh_title: Multi-OphthaLingua：面向LMIC的多语言眼科LLM问答基准
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.summary: 提出多语言眼科问答基准，用于评估并去偏大语言模型在低收入和中等收入国家的表现。
key_points: 眼科流程存在过度转诊与长等待
LLM跨语言问答表现差异显著
构建多语言基准并尝试去偏
555dd6d2edae044032bd1f0ead202025d5dd0e6a.zh_abstract: 当前的眼科临床工作流程受到过度转诊、漫长等待以及复杂且异质的医疗记录的困扰。大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）为自动化各种程序（如分诊、视力评估等初步测试以及报告摘要）提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，LLMs 在自然语言问答任务中在不同语言间表现出显著差异的性能，可能加剧中低收入国家（Low and Middle-Income Countries, LMICs）的医疗保健差距。本研究引入了首个多语言眼科问答基准，其中人工策划的问题在语言间平行，允许直接的跨语言比较。我们对 7 种不同语言中的 6 个流行 LLMs 的评估揭示了不同语言间的显著偏差，突出了 LLM 临床部署的风险

5515c85a0dc05b57f3f5740a2761203f6451730e.title: Physics-Informed Multi-Task Learning for Battery State of Health Prediction with Uncertainty Quantification
5515c85a0dc05b57f3f5740a2761203f6451730e.abstract: Existing battery State of Health (SOH) prediction approaches often struggle to provide both accurate predictions and reliable uncertainty estimates. This paper presents a novel Multi-Task Learning (MTL) framework that jointly tackles SOH prediction and provides a proxy metric for uncertainty through a unified architecture. The framework combines a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) for SOH prediction with a deep autoencoding Gaussian mixture model for uncertainty modeling. Particularly, the energy score from the Gaussian mixture model serves as a proxy metric for uncertainty, where a higher score indicates potential prediction unreliability. Moreover, to enhance task-specific learning, we employ a multi-head attention mechanism that adaptively captures distinct feature relationships. Our experiments show improvements in prediction performance compared to the state-of-the-art baseline

503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.title: Sim4Seg: Boosting Multimodal Multi-disease Medical Diagnosis Segmentation with Region-Aware Vision-Language Similarity Masks
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.abstract: Despite significant progress in pixel-level medical image analysis, existing medical image segmentation models rarely explore medical segmentation and diagnosis tasks jointly. However, it is crucial for patients that models can provide explainable diagnoses along with medical segmentation results. In this paper, we introduce a medical vision-language task named Medical Diagnosis Segmentation (MDS), which aims to understand clinical queries for medical images and generate the corresponding segmentation masks as well as diagnostic results. To facilitate this task, we first present the Multimodal Multi-disease Medical Diagnosis Segmentation (M3DS) dataset, containing diverse multimodal multi-disease medical images paired with their corresponding segmentation masks and diagnosis chain-of-thought, created via an automated diagnosis chain-of-thought generation pipeline. Moreover, we propose Si
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.zh_title: Sim4Seg：区域感知视觉语言相似掩码的多疾病分割诊断
503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.summary: 提出医学诊断分割任务与Sim4Seg方法，通过区域感知视觉语言相似掩码联合实现分割与可解释诊断。
key_points: 现有分割模型少联合诊断任务

503993355e2e8264cd31632f4860c598b495a396.zh_abstract: 尽管像素级医学图像分析已取得显著进展，现有医学图像分割模型很少联合探索医学分割与诊断任务。然而，对患者而言，模型能够随医学分割结果一并提供可解释诊断至关重要。在本文中，我们引入一项名为医学诊断分割（Medical Diagnosis Segmentation, MDS）的医学视觉-语言任务，旨在理解针对医学图像的临床查询，并生成相应的分割掩膜以及诊断结果。为促进该任务，我们首先提出多模态多疾病医学诊断分割（Multimodal Multi-disease Medical Diagnosis Segmentation, M3DS）数据集，包含多样化的多模态多疾病医学图像，配有相应的分割掩膜和诊断思维链，该数据集通过自动化诊断思维链生成流程创建。此外，我们提出 Si

48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.title: Note2Chat: Improving LLMs for Multi-Turn Clinical History Taking Using Medical Notes
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.abstract: Effective clinical history taking is a foundational yet underexplored component of clinical reasoning. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise on static benchmarks, they often fall short in dynamic, multi-turn diagnostic settings that require iterative questioning and hypothesis refinement. To address this gap, we propose Note2Chat, a note-driven framework that trains LLMs to conduct structured history taking and diagnosis by learning from widely available medical notes. Instead of relying on scarce and sensitive dialogue data, we convert real-world medical notes into high-quality doctor-patient dialogues using a decision tree-guided generation and refinement pipeline. We then propose a three-stage fine-tuning strategy combining supervised learning, simulated data augmentation, and preference learning. Furthermore, we propose a novel single-turn reasoning paradigm that refr
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.zh_title: Note2Chat：用医学笔记提升多轮病史采集
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.summary: Note2Chat利用医学笔记训练大模型进行结构化病史采集与诊断，改善多轮动态问诊表现。
key_points: 从医学笔记学习结构化病史采集
面向多轮动态诊断场景
迭代提问与假设修正
48aceeca94323593dade6126e67cdda12bb1e679.zh_abstract: 有效的临床病史采集是临床推理中一个基础性但尚未充分探索的组成部分。尽管大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在静态基准上展现出潜力，但它们在需要迭代提问和假设细化的动态、多轮诊断场景中往往表现不足。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了 Note2Chat，一个由笔记驱动的框架，通过从广泛可得的医疗笔记中学习，训练 LLMs 进行结构化的病史采集和诊断。我们不依赖稀缺且敏感的对话数据，而是使用决策树引导的生成与精炼流水线，将真实世界医疗笔记转换为高质量的医患对话。随后，我们提出了一种三阶段微调策略，结合了监督学习、模拟数据增强和偏好学习。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的单轮推理范式，该范式 refr

41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.title: Generalizable Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via ESM-2 Representations and Progressive Contrastive Curriculum Learning
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.abstract: Predicting drug–target interactions (DTIs) is a fundamental task in computational drug discovery, yet it remains challenging under distribution shifts and limited training data. Existing approaches often suffer from poor generalization, weak cross-modal alignment between molecular and protein representations, and vulnerability to noisy supervision.We propose ESP-DTI, a unified framework designed to enhance generalization by integrating large-scale protein language models with curriculum learning and cross-modal contrastive alignment. Specifically, we leverage ESM-2 to encode context-aware protein representations and adopt a CLIP-style contrastive objective to align drug and protein embeddings in a shared latent space. To further improve learning robustness, we introduce a progressive curriculum sampling strategy that dynamically schedules training instances based on model confidence, ena
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.zh_title: ESM-2表示与渐进对比课程学习的药物-靶点预测
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.summary: 提出ESP-DTI框架，结合蛋白质语言模型与课程学习提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。
key_points: 针对分布偏移与训练数据有限下的泛化难题
融合大规模蛋白质语言模型与课程学习
关注分子与蛋白质表示的跨模态对齐
41d1954fd1d534ec7aedb8883036a557e2e96744.zh_abstract: 预测药物-靶标相互作用（drug–target interactions, DTIs）是计算药物发现中的一项基础任务，但在分布偏移和训练数据有限的情况下仍具挑战性。现有方法通常泛化能力差、分子与蛋白质表示之间的跨模态对齐较弱，并且易受噪声监督影响。我们提出 ESP-DTI，一个统一框架，旨在通过将大规模蛋白质语言模型与课程学习和跨模态对比对齐相结合来增强泛化能力。具体而言，我们利用 ESM-2 编码上下文感知的蛋白质表示，并采用 CLIP 风格的对比目标，在共享潜在空间中对齐药物和蛋白质嵌入。为进一步提高学习稳健性，我们引入渐进式课程采样策略，该策略根据模型置信度动态安排训练实例，ena

2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.title: DiA-gnostic VLVAE: Disentangled Alignment-Constrained Vision Language Variational AutoEncoder for Robust Radiology Reporting with Missing Modalities
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.abstract: The integration of medical images with clinical context is essential for generating accurate and clinically interpretable radiology reports. However, current automated methods often rely on resource-heavy Large Language Models (LLMs) or static knowledge graphs and struggle with two fundamental challenges in real-world clinical data: (1) missing modalities, such as incomplete clinical context , and (2) feature entanglement, where mixed modality-specific and shared information leads to suboptimal fusion and clinically unfaithful hallucinated findings. To address these challenges, we propose the DiA-gnostic VLVAE, which achieves robust radiology reporting through Disentangled Alignment. Our framework is designed to be resilient to missing modalities by disentangling shared and modality-specific features using a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based Vision-Language Variational Autoencoder (VLVAE).
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.zh_title: 解耦对齐视觉语言VAE用于放射报告生成
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.summary: 提出DiA-gnostic VLVAE，以解耦对齐约束的视觉语言变分自编码器应对缺失模态与特征纠缠，生成放射报告。
key_points: 面向放射报告生成，不依赖大型语言模型或静态知识图谱
针对真实临床数据中的模态缺失问题
解耦模态特有与共享特征，缓解特征纠缠
2ceda18cbc9ff1272ecc51d2c27ff8be88109e09.zh_abstract: 将医学图像与临床背景相结合，对于生成准确且临床可解释的放射学报告至关重要。然而，当前的自动化方法往往依赖资源消耗大的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）或静态知识图谱，并且在真实世界临床数据中难以应对两个基本挑战：(1) 模态缺失，例如临床背景不完整，以及 (2) 特征纠缠，即模态特定信息和共享信息混杂，导致次优融合以及临床上不忠实的幻觉发现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DiA-gnostic VLVAE，它通过解缠对齐（Disentangled Alignment）实现稳健的放射学报告生成。我们的框架通过使用基于专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）的视觉-语言变分自编码器（Vision-Language Variational Autoencoder, VLVAE）解缠共享特征和模态特定特征，被设计为对模态缺失具有韧性。

2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.title: Anatomical Knowledge Mining and Matching for Semi-supervised Medical Multi-structure Detection
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.abstract: In medical image analysis, detecting multiple structures is crucial for evaluations and diagnosis but is often limited by the lack of high-quality annotations. Semi-supervised object detection emerges as a potent methodology to enhance model performance and generalization by leveraging a vast pool of unlabeled data alongside a minimal set of labeled data. A striking observation is that both unlabelled and labeled medical images contain a priori anatomical knowledge from human screening. In this work, we introduce a novel semi-supervised approach named Semi-akmm for mining and matching anatomical knowledge in ultrasound images. We develop an Adaptive Prior Knowledge Transfer (APKT) module to mine and explore the distribution and knowledge of potential proposal boxes by proposal proportion constraint. Furthermore, within a teacher-student learning framework, we put forward an Anatomical St
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.zh_title: 解剖知识挖掘与匹配的半监督多结构检测
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.summary: 利用标注与未标注医学图像中的先验解剖知识，开展半监督医学多结构检测以缓解高质量标注不足。
key_points: 多结构检测对评估与诊断至关重要
受限于高质量标注缺乏
结合少量标注与大量未标注数据
2a77e6b1ebdfc166962545ec84b38213f2460a72.zh_abstract: 在医学图像分析中，检测多个结构对于评估和诊断至关重要，但常受限于高质量标注的缺乏。半监督目标检测通过利用大量未标注数据以及少量标注数据，成为一种增强模型性能和泛化能力的有效方法。一个引人注目的观察是，未标注和标注医学图像都包含来自人工筛查的先验解剖知识。在本工作中，我们提出一种名为 Semi-akmm 的新型半监督方法，用于挖掘和匹配超声图像中的解剖知识。我们开发了一个自适应先验知识迁移（APKT）模块，通过候选框比例约束来挖掘和探索潜在候选框的分布和知识。此外，在教师-学生学习框架内，我们提出了一个 Anatomical St

260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.title: Class-Aware Active Annotation in Federated Semi-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Classification
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.abstract: In medical image classification, data privacy constraints and the high cost of expert annotations pose significant challenges to building generalizable models. Federated semi-supervised learning (FSSL), which combines the privacy-preserving nature of federated learning with the label efficiency of semi-supervised learning, offers a promising direction. However, in real-world deployments, client data often exhibits highly non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) characteristics. This distributional heterogeneity undermines the reliability of pseudo-labels generated by global models, ultimately limiting model generalization. A key limitation of existing FSSL approaches lies in their reliance on a static labeled set fixed prior to training. Such strategies lack the ability to adaptively correct pseudo-label noise or address class imbalance throughout training, particularly unde
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.zh_title: 联邦半监督医学图像分类中的类别感知主动标注
260db51c1cc96664aa0dcfe15c962b92fa01e090.summary: 针对联邦半监督学习中客户端数据 Non-IID 问题，提出类别感知主动标注方法用于医学图像分类。

120996efb7374dae87a14483ef9d186e75c117d2.abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is widely used in many applications such as smart city, transportation, healthcare, and environment monitoring. ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.title: AI in the Wild: A Meta-Analytic Evaluation of Depression Detection from Social Media Data
ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.abstract:
As AI moves into high-stakes, human-centered settings, we still lack clear evidence on when and why these systems succeed or fail. This meta-analysis synthesizes all empirical studies published between 2022 and 2025 that use social-media data to predict depression, quantifying pooled accuracy and testing study-level moderators. By showing how data sources and model architecture shape outcomes, we offer an empirical foundation for a more reliable, socially aware deployment of AI in mental health.

ef1dc77c742c6007acc912ad176a2e241b86dbba.zh_abstract:
随着 AI 进入高风险、以人为中心的场景，我们仍缺乏明确证据说明这些系统何时以及为何成功或失败。这项荟萃分析综合了 2022 年至 2025 年间发表的所有使用社交媒体数据预测抑郁症的实证研究，量化合并准确率并检验研究层面的调节因素。通过展示数据来源和模型架构如何影响结果，我们为在心理健康领域更可靠、更具社会意识的 AI 部署提供了实证基础。

ebbdfaa64b44ee0066e6b0916e9df7928cff24e8.title: From Diagnosis to Generalization: A Cognitive Approach to Data Selection for Educational LLMs
ebbdfaa64b44ee0066e6b0916e9df7928cff24e8.abstract: Specializing Large Language Models for educational domains is a key frontier in creating personalized learning tools. The central challenge is not data scarcity but its abundance: efficiently selecting a curated data subset from vast corpora to enhance specialized skills and foster generalization, without degrading existing abilities. Existing data selection paradigms, relying on superficial semantic similarity or model training dynamics, often lack a principled framework to identify data that promotes true cognitive growth. Our work proposes a paradigm shift from leveraging indirect proxies of learning value, such as semantic similarity and training dynamics, towards a framework that performs a direct, cognitive-level modeling of the learner's state. eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.title: Pairing-free Group-level Knowledge Distillation for Robust Gastrointestinal Lesion Classification in White-Light Endoscopy
eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.abstract: White-Light Imaging (WLI) is the standard for endoscopic cancer screening, but Narrow-Band Imaging (NBI) offers superior diagnostic details. A key challenge is transferring knowledge from NBI to enhance WLI-only models, yet existing methods are critically hampered by their reliance on paired NBI-WLI images of the same lesion, a costly and often impractical requirement that leaves vast amounts of clinical data untapped. In this paper, we break this paradigm by introducing PaGKD, a novel Pairing-free Group-level Knowledge Distillation framework that that enables effective cross-modal learning using unpaired WLI and NBI data. Instead of forcing alignment between individual, often semantically mismatched image instances, PaGKD operates at the group level to distill more complete and compatible knowledge across modalities. eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.zh_title: 免配对组级知识蒸馏用于白光内镜胃肠病变分类
eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.summary: 提出PaGKD，无需同一病灶的NBI-WLI配对图像，即可将窄带成像知识蒸馏至白光内镜模型以提升病变分类。

eaeab4d5c08c3a5de571796785eb8f45bffebe9a.zh_abstract: 白光成像（White-Light Imaging, WLI）是内镜癌症筛查的标准，但窄带成像（Narrow-Band Imaging, NBI）提供更优的诊断细节。一个关键挑战是将知识从 NBI 迁移以增强仅使用 WLI 的模型，但现有方法因依赖同一病变的配对 NBI-WLI 图像而受到严重制约，这一要求成本高昂且通常不切实际，导致大量临床数据未被利用。在本文中，我们打破这一范式，提出 PaGKD，这是一种新颖的无配对组级知识蒸馏（Pairing-free Group-level Knowledge Distillation）框架，能够使用未配对的 WLI 和 NBI 数据实现有效的跨模态学习。PaGKD 不是在单个、通常在语义上不匹配的图像实例之间强制对齐，而是在组级别运作，以跨模态蒸馏出更完整且更兼容的知识。PaGKD 的核心是两个互补模块：（1）组级原型（Group-level Protot

e2927761ff7ac6b68fc76b0ddb8fd47657104ed4.title: Fault Diagnosis of Irregular Sequences by Adjoint Learning in Continuous-Time Model Space
e2927761ff7ac6b68fc76b0ddb8fd47657104ed4.abstract: Fault Diagnosis (FD) on sequential data suffers from irregular sampling (with missing values), limited training data, and varying underlying environments. In response, this paper proposes FD by adjoint learning in continuous-time model space. Model-Space Learning employs well-fitted models that capture data's dynamics (i.e., changing information) as more stable and concise representations of the original data. cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.title: REMEDIS: A Clinical AI Framework for Retinal Disease Diagnosis with Explainable Fundus Image Analysis
cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.abstract: Timely detection of retinal diseases is crucial for preventing vision loss; yet the limited availability of ophthalmologists and disparities in access to diagnostic services continue to hinder widespread screening, particularly in primary care settings. We present REMEDIS, a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)-based clinical AI framework for the automated diagnosis of major retinal diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD), diabetic retinopathy (DR), epiretinal membrane (ERM), and glaucoma, using fundus images. The system analyzes high-resolution fundus photographs in a secure cloud environment via a Swin-Large-based multi-disease classification network, producing disease-specific probability scores. cc939b49b51e9ffc379f62f13d39fc312a5d2b00.zh_title: REMEDIS：可解释眼底图像的视网膜疾病诊断AI框架

c6406e390149e7b1f386ba9213de820914d3167d.title: Enhancing Molecular Representation Learning Through the Combination of 3D and 2D Graph Machine Learning (Student Abstract)
c6406e390149e7b1f386ba9213de820914d3167d.abstract: Molecular machine learning has broad applications across multiple domains such as drug development, environmental toxicology, and materials science. Various pre-trained frameworks using self-supervised representation learning have emerged to tackle the difficulty of obtaining large molecular datasets useful for training high-performing molecular machine learning models. In this study, we explore a novel representation learning framework trained using both 2D and 3D molecular data. Specifically, a 3D invariant graph neural network to learn how to capture 3D atomic information and then pass these atomic representations into a regular 2D graph neural network which can leverage molecular topology. Results from experiments demonstrate the representations produced by our method using both 3D and 2D molecular information lead to strong performance in downstream tasks.

be5d7c6a5a5fc2842e40ece4704ac06ad2adb4f1.abstract: As the global population ages and the incidence of chronic diseases increases, the demand for early detection of abnormal medical conditions is increasing. Traditional health monitoring methods often require significant resources and specialized personnel, limiting their widespread use. Leveraging advancements in AI technologies, this study proposes a non-invasive method for detecting abnormal medical conditions from image data. A multimodal perception framework is introduced, integrating features from various modalities, including facial expressions and body postures, to enhance detection accuracy. The framework employs a Cascaded Squeeze-Excitation (CSE) module, consisting of Adaptive and Multi-modal Squeeze-Excitation components, to capture complex feature dependencies and improve cross-modal performance. be5d7c6a5a5fc2842e40ece4704ac06ad2adb4f1.zh_title: MMPF：异常医疗状况检测的多模态感知框架

bd108f248fa29968754940ea9f0b7319d677dadf.title: Voices, Faces, and Feelings: Multi-modal Emotion-Cognition Captioning for Mental Health Understanding
bd108f248fa29968754940ea9f0b7319d677dadf.abstract: Emotional and cognitive factors are essential for understanding mental health disorders. However, existing methods often treat multi-modal data as classification tasks, limiting interpretability especially for emotion and cognition. Although large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities for mental health analysis, they mainly rely on textual semantics and overlook fine-grained emotional and cognitive cues in multi-modal inputs. While some studies incorporate emotional features via transfer learning, their connection to mental health conditions remains implicit. To address these issues, we propose ECMC, a novel task that aims at generating natural language descriptions of emotional and cognitive states from multi-modal data, and producing emotion–cognition profiles that improve both the accuracy and interpretability of mental health assessments. b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.title: Calibrating Reliance: Addressing Misuse and Disuse in AI-Based Second-Opinion Systems for Medical Diagnosis
b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.abstract:
AI systems are widely proposed as second-opinion advisors in clinical diagnosis, offering the promise of enhancing decision accuracy and clinician confidence while preserving human oversight. However, successful deployment in real-world practice faces a critical barrier: clinicians' reliance on AI is often miscalibrated, manifesting as misuse (over-reliance driven by automation bias) and disuse (under-utilization driven by self-anchoring bias). 
This paper addresses these deployment challenges by systematically analyzing how such reliance patterns affect diagnostic accuracy, confidence, and decision-making across diverse medical specialties. b15dd7908845c017dc21de7bbf3d538087531b38.summary: AAAI 2026针对临床AI第二意见系统的过度依赖（误用）与利用不足（弃用）提出依赖校准。
key_points: 误用源于自动化偏差
弃用源于自我锚定偏差
聚焦真实部署中的依赖校准

b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.title: Tracing the Heart's Pathways: ECG Representation Learning from a Cardiac Conduction Perspective
b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.abstract: The multi-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) stands as a cornerstone of cardiac diagnosis. Recent strides in electrocardiogram self-supervised learning (eSSL) have brightened prospects for enhancing representation learning without relying on high-quality annotations. Yet earlier eSSL methods suffer a key limitation: they focus on consistent patterns across leads and beats, overlooking the inherent differences in heartbeats rooted in cardiac conduction processes, while subtle but significant variations carry unique physiological signatures. Moreover, representation learning for ECG analysis should align with ECG diagnostic guidelines, which progress from individual heartbeats to single leads and ultimately to lead combinations. b0b24d2c7c955bf751db76a9e65dc5bc0537d4dc.summary: 提出从心脏传导过程出发的ECG自监督表示学习方法，弥补忽略心搏固有差异的不足。

abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.title: Generative Flow Networks for Lead Optimization in Drug Design (Student Abstract)
abaa5a730ce15e5636a1a2b1366ed73112b58298.abstract: This paper investigates the application of Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) to lead optimization in drug discovery. GFlowNets provide a novel framework for generating diverse molecular structures while optimizing for desired properties, addressing the limitations of traditional methods in exploring vast chemical spaces. We adapt GFlowNets to incrementally modify lead compounds, integrating domain-specific heuristics to guide the generation process. Our method employs the trajectory balance objective on a graph neural network (GNN), to learn a policy that samples fragments based on a multi-objective reward. To address these challenges, we introduce OFL-SAM2, a prompt-free SAM2 framework for label-efficient MIS. a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.zh_title: OFL-SAM2：在线少样本学习提示 SAM2 的医学分割
a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.summary: AAAI 2025 提出 OFL-SAM2，用在线少样本学习器为 SAM2 提供提示，降低医学图像分割对大量标注与人工提示的依赖。

a4dda9af9a08f0ecb9f87b375c3006e9a2d38c22.zh_abstract: Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2）已在视频数据中展现出卓越的可提示视觉分割能力，显示出扩展到涉及 3D 体积和时间相关的 2D 图像序列的医学图像分割（medical image segmentation，MIS）任务的潜力。然而，将 SAM2 适配到 MIS 面临若干挑战，包括需要大量带标注的医学数据进行微调以及高质量的人工提示，这两者都劳动密集且需要医学专家介入。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 OFL-SAM2，一种用于标签高效 MIS 的无提示 SAM2 框架。我们的核心思想是利用有限的标注样本训练一个轻量级映射网络，该网络捕获医学知识并将通用图像特征转换为目标特征，从而为每一帧提供额外的判别性目标表示，并消除了

99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.title: Graph-Theoretic Consistency for Robust and Topology-Aware Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.abstract: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation (SSSS) is vital in computational pathology, where dense annotations are costly and limited. Existing methods often rely on pixel-level consistency, which propagates noisy pseudo-labels and produces fragmented or topologically invalid masks. We propose Topology Graph Consistency (TGC), a framework that integrates graph-theoretic constraints by aligning Laplacian spectra, component counts, and adjacency statistics between prediction graphs and references. This enforces global topology and improves segmentation accuracy. Experiments on GlaS and CRAG demonstrate that TGC achieves state-of-the-art performance under 5–10% supervision and significantly narrows the gap to full supervision.
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.zh_title: 图论一致性用于半监督病理分割
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.summary: AAAI 2025 提出拓扑图一致性框架 TGC，通过图论约束对齐预测图与参考图，改善半监督病理分割的拓扑有效性。
key_points: 针对病理分割中标注昂贵、伪标签噪声
对齐拉普拉斯谱、连通分量与邻接统计
缓解分割碎片化与拓扑错误
99681a18adfe1a28d7459107541e9707e653097c.zh_abstract: 半监督语义分割（semi-supervised semantic segmentation，SSSS）在计算病理学中至关重要，因为密集标注成本高昂且数量有限。现有方法通常依赖像素级一致性，这会传播带噪声的伪标签并产生碎片化或拓扑上无效的掩码。我们提出拓扑图一致性（Topology Graph Consistency，TGC），一个通过对齐预测图与参考图之间的拉普拉斯谱、连通分量数量和邻接统计量来整合图论约束的框架。这强制实现全局拓扑并提高分割精度。在 GlaS 和 CRAG 上的实验表明，TGC 在 5–10% 监督下达到最先进性能，并显著缩小了与全监督之间的差距。

9949c42174c64e60819ee5598ba93a6509b15e8c.title: Learning Cross-Domain Representations for Transferable Drug Perturbations on Single-Cell Transcriptional Responses
9949c42174c64e60819ee5598ba93a6509b15e8c.abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery has attracted widespread attention because of its potential to identify bioactive molecules. Transcriptomic profiling provides a comprehensive reflection of phenotypic changes in cellular responses to external perturbations. In this paper, we propose XTransferCDR, a novel generative framework designed for feature decoupling and transferable representation learning across domains. Given a pair of perturbed expression profiles, our approach decouples the perturbation representations from basal states through domain separation encoders and then cross-transfers them in the latent space. The transferred representations are then used to reconstruct the corresponding perturbed expression profiles via a shared decoder. This cross-transfer constraint effectively promotes the learning of transferable drug perturbation representations. We conducted extensive evaluations of
9949c42174c64e60819ee5598ba93a6509b15e8c.zh_title: 面向单细胞转录响应的跨域可迁移药物扰动表征学习
9949c42174c64e60819ee5598ba93a6509b15e8c.summary: 提出生成式框架XTransferCDR，通过特征解耦实现跨域可迁移药物扰动表征学习。

9949c42174c64e60819ee5598ba93a6509b15e8c.zh_abstract: 表型药物发现因其识别生物活性分子的潜力而受到广泛关注。转录组分析全面反映了细胞对外部扰动响应中的表型变化。在本文中，我们提出了 XTransferCDR，一种新颖的生成框架，旨在进行特征解耦和跨域的可迁移表示学习。给定一对扰动表达谱，我们的方法通过域分离编码器将扰动表示与基态解耦，然后在潜在空间中交叉迁移它们。然后使用迁移后的表示通过共享解码器重建相应的扰动表达谱。这种交叉迁移约束有效地促进了可迁移药物扰动表示的学习。我们进行了广泛的评估

97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.title: Vision-Language Models Guided Graph Concept Reasoning for Interpretable Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have significantly advanced diabetic retinopathy (DR) diagnosis, yet their black-box nature limits clinical acceptance due to a lack of interpretability. Concept bottleneck model (CBM) offers a promising solution by enabling concept-level reasoning and test-time intervention, with recent DR studies modeling lesions as concepts and grades as outcomes. However, current methods often ignore relationships between lesion concepts across different DR grades and struggle when fine-grained lesion concepts are unavailable, limiting their interpretability and real-world applicability. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLM-GCR, a vision-language model guided graph concept reasoning framework for interpretable DR diagnosis. VLM-GCR emulates the diagnostic process of ophthalmologists by constructing a grading-aware lesion concept graph that explicitly models the interaction
97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.zh_title: 视觉语言模型引导图概念推理的可解释糖网诊断
97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.summary: 研究提出由视觉语言模型引导的图概念推理方法，用于可解释的糖尿病视网膜病变诊断，建模不同分级间病灶概念关系。
key_points: 深度模型黑盒性限制糖网诊断临床接受度
概念瓶颈模型支持概念级推理与测试时干预
现有方法常忽视不同分级间病灶概念关系
97f3fba73bc334bf1b3aa52962fea62293ed6840.zh_abstract: 深度神经网络（deep neural networks，DNNs）显著推进了糖尿病视网膜病变（diabetic retinopathy，DR）诊断，然而其黑箱性质因缺乏可解释性而限制了临床接受度。概念瓶颈模型（concept bottleneck model，CBM）通过支持概念级推理和测试时干预提供了一种有前景的解决方案，近期 DR 研究将病变建模为概念、将分级建模为结果。然而，当前方法往往忽略不同 DR 分级之间病变概念的关系，并且在细粒度病变概念不可用时表现不佳，限制了其可解释性和实际适用性。为弥合这些差距，我们提出 VLM-GCR，一个用于可解释 DR 诊断的视觉-语言模型引导的图概念推理框架。VLM-GCR 通过构建分级感知的病变概念图来模拟眼科医生的诊断过程，该图明确建模了相互作用

9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.title: Multi-Level Domain Adaptation and Contrastive Domain Isolation with Bilinear Fusion for Patient Drug Response Prediction
9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.abstract: Accurate prediction of patient drug response is critical for precision cancer medicine but remains constrained by limited clinical data. While in vitro cell line data offer a scalable alternative, effective cross-domain transfer remains challenging. Many existing methods tend to overlook heterogeneous domain shifts across biological contexts, underrepresent the intrinsic differences between cell lines and patient tissues, and insufficiently capture high-order gene-drug interactions. To address these challenges, we propose MACB-DRP, a hierarchical transfer learning framework comprising three complementary stages that progressively coordinate adaptation across tissue, drug, and sample levels while enabling representation separation. The framework begins with tissue-aware domain adaptation, leveraging cancer-type classification and unsupervised alignment to preserve biologically meaningful
9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.zh_title: 多层次域适应与对比域隔离双线性融合预测药物反应
9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.summary: 针对细胞系与患者组织间的域偏移，提出多层次域适应与对比域隔离及双线性融合的患者药物反应预测方法。
key_points: 患者药物反应预测受限于临床数据不足

9722d386d197d0f20cdf173a9548451f2a26b6b1.zh_abstract: 准确预测患者药物反应对精准癌症医学至关重要，但仍受限于有限的临床数据。虽然体外细胞系数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但有效的跨域迁移仍然具有挑战性。许多现有方法往往忽视跨生物背景的异质域偏移，未能充分表征细胞系与患者组织之间的内在差异，并且对高阶基因-药物相互作用的捕获不足。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MACB-DRP，一个分层迁移学习框架，包含三个互补阶段，逐步协调组织、药物和样本层面的适应，同时实现表示分离。该框架从组织感知域适应开始，利用癌症类型分类和无监督对齐来保留具有生物学意义的

94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.title: SEBSFormer: A Spectral-Enhanced Bi-Stream Transformer for Robust EEG Decoding
94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) plays a vital role in clinical and cognitive applications such as epilepsy diagnosis and emotion recognition. However, the low signal-to-noise ratio, inter-subject variability, and inherent non-stationarity of EEG signals present substantial modeling challenges. While recent Transformer-based models offer promising long-range modeling capabilities, their self-attention mechanism behaves as a low-pass filter, suppressing high-frequency neural patterns critical for decoding transient events. In this work, we provide the first formal analysis demonstrating this low-pass behavior in self-attention mechanisms when applied to EEG signals, revealing a fundamental limitation of deep attention-based EEG models. To address this, we propose SEBSFormer, a spectral-enhanced bi-Stream Transformer that jointly models temporal dependencies and spectral structures. SEBSFormer
94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.zh_title: SEBSFormer：用于稳健脑电解码的谱增强双流Transformer

94aa0290bdee2d8aad61abf5029e6102b51a81ed.zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）在癫痫诊断和情感识别等临床和认知应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，EEG 信号的低信噪比、受试者间变异性以及固有的非平稳性给建模带来了巨大挑战。尽管最近基于 Transformer 的模型提供了有前景的长程建模能力，但其自注意力机制表现为低通滤波器，抑制了对解码瞬态事件至关重要的高频神经模式。在这项工作中，我们首次提供了形式化分析，证明了自注意力机制在应用于 EEG 信号时的这种低通行为，揭示了基于深度注意力的 EEG 模型的一个基本局限性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 SEBSFormer，一种频谱增强的双流 Transformer，它联合建模时间依赖性和频谱结构。SEBSFormer

949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.title: Aligning Time-series by Local Trends: Applications in Public Health
949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.abstract: Individual models of infectious diseases or trajectories coming from different simulations may vary considerably, making it challenging for public communication and supporting policy-making. Therefore, it is common in public health to first create a consensus across multiple models and simulations through ensembling. However, current methods are limited to mean and median ensembles that perform aggregation of scale (cases, hospitalizations, deaths) along the time axis, which often misrepresents the underlying trajectories -- e.g., they underrepresent the peak. Instead, we wish to create an ensemble that represents aggregation simultaneously over both time and scale and thus better preserves the properties of the trajectories. This is particularly useful for public health where time-series have a sequence of meaningful local trends that are ordered, e.g., a surge to an increase to a peak
949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.zh_title: 以局部趋势对齐时间序列：公共卫生应用
949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.summary: 针对公共卫生多模型集成，提出基于局部趋势的时间序列对齐方法以改进共识构建。
key_points: 解决多模型与仿真轨迹差异

949f22074b3f17d7d1e548e502f311a9f46f9e06.zh_abstract: 传染病个体模型或来自不同模拟的轨迹可能差异很大，这给公共传播和支持政策制定带来挑战。因此，在公共卫生中，通常首先通过集成（ensembling）在多个模型和模拟之间建立共识。然而，当前方法仅限于均值集成和中位数集成，即沿时间轴对规模（病例、住院、死亡）进行聚合，这常常错误地表示潜在轨迹——例如，它们对峰值的表示不足。相反，我们希望创建一个集成，表示同时跨时间和规模的聚合，从而更好地保留轨迹特性。这对于公共卫生特别有用，因为时间序列具有一系列有序且有意义的局部趋势，例如，从激增到上升再到峰值

92dd049eee0eb48fa3ae3300d675b3cdd1f80b50.title: Surgical AI Copilot: Energy-Based Fourier Gradient Low-Rank Adaptation for Surgical LLM Agent Reasoning and Planning
92dd049eee0eb48fa3ae3300d675b3cdd1f80b50.abstract: Image-guided surgery demands adaptive, real-time decision support, yet static AI models struggle with structured task planning and providing interactive guidance. Large language models (LLMs)-powered agents offer a promising solution by enabling dynamic task planning and predictive decision support. Despite recent advances, the absence of surgical agent datasets and robust parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques limits the development of LLM agents capable of complex intraoperative reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Surgical AI Copilot, an LLM agent for image-guided pituitary surgery, capable of conversation, planning, and task execution in response to queries involving tasks such as MRI tumor segmentation, endoscope anatomy segmentation, overlaying preoperative imaging with intraoperative views, instrument tracking, and surgical visual question answering (VQA). To enable structur
92dd049eee0eb48fa3ae3300d675b3cdd1f80b50.zh_title: 外科AI Copilot：能量基傅里叶梯度低秩适配的外科LLM智能体

8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.title: IMQC: A Large Language Model Platform for Medical Quality Control
8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.abstract: Medical quality control (MQC) indicators are essential for evaluating the performance of healthcare institutions to ensure high-quality patient care. In this paper, we report the design, implementation, and deployment of the Intelligent EMR-LLM platform for Medical Quality Control (IMQC), a large language model (LLM)-empowered system for automatically computing MQC indicators for enhancing the quality of medical services in Shanghai. It consists of an LLM (i.e., EMR-LLM) for processing electronic medical records (EMRs). With EMR-LLM, IMQC translates existing MQC indicators into a standardized representation language and automatically computes them based on EMRs. Since its deployment in February 2024, IMQC has been adopted by the Shanghai Medical Quality Management Center and associated hospitals. So far, it has processed 1,245 medical quality indicators for secondary- and tertiary-level
8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.zh_title: IMQC：面向医疗质控的大语言模型平台
8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.summary: 报告面向医疗质控的IMQC大模型平台的设计、实现与部署，可自动计算质控指标。

8ea84c91a7bdc27621aba1b46b1f23e1ab888b79.zh_abstract: 医疗质量控制（Medical Quality Control, MQC）指标对于评估医疗机构绩效以确保高质量患者照护至关重要。本文中，我们报告了用于医疗质量控制的智能 EMR-LLM 平台（Intelligent EMR-LLM platform for Medical Quality Control, IMQC）的设计、实现与部署，这是一个由大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）赋能的系统，用于自动计算 MQC 指标，以提升上海的医疗服务质量。它包含一个用于处理电子病历（Electronic Medical Records, EMRs）的 LLM（即 EMR-LLM）。借助 EMR-LLM，IMQC 将现有 MQC 指标转换为标准化表示语言，并基于 EMRs 自动计算这些指标。自 2024 年 2 月部署以来，IMQC 已被上海市医疗质量管理中心及相关医院采用。迄今为止，它已处理了 1,245 项医疗质量指标，用于二级和三级

86995174147ae29515ff4d510c23802c4b00e3a2.title: Falcon Medical Visual Question Answering
86995174147ae29515ff4d510c23802c4b00e3a2.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) bridge the gap between visual and textual data, enabling multimodal tasks like Visual Question Answering (VQA). Leveraging this capability, Medical VQA systems have the potential to transform clinical decision-making by allowing healthcare providers to query medical images—such as X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans—and receive rapid, informed responses, thereby speeding up diagnoses and treatment planning. In this work, we introduce Falcon Med-VQA, a generative VQA system meticulously designed to interpret visual and textual medical data and generate free-form answers to medical questions. By leveraging a vision language model and a dynamic model selection mechanism, Falcon Med-VQA ensures relevance and precision in its responses. The system is equipped with an intuitive user interface that displays top answers with Confidence Scores (CF), enhances explainability th
86995174147ae29515ff4d510c23802c4b00e3a2.zh_title: Falcon 医学视觉问答系统
86995174147ae29515ff4d510c23802c4b00e3a2.summary: 提出生成式医学视觉问答系统Falcon Med-VQA，可针对X光、MRI、CT等医学图像提问并获取回答。

8488f8b67c04fe87b0e3597e93a71545ff46612d.title: ClinicalRAG: Automating Pharmaceutical Label Quality Control with Hierarchical RAG and Large Language Models
8488f8b67c04fe87b0e3597e93a71545ff46612d.abstract: Every pharmaceutical product must be accompanied by a comprehensive label that delineates its indications, usage, dosages, and side effects, essential for safe medication practices. Traditionally, creating drug labels is labor-intensive and dependent on manual quality checks. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue to streamline this process. In this paper we introduce ClinicalRAG, an automated labeling quality control pipeline that integrates LLM with hierarchical Retrieval Augmented Generation that allows to cross-check every statement in the drug label document. ClinicalRAG enhances the reliability of automated drug labeling by systematically reducing hallucination risks, achieving an accuracy of 96.1% in internal validation. 841d480c1a97f4f8a39309f01ca4c49d2397eccb.title: Rethinking Bias in Generative Data Augmentation for Medical AI: a Frequency Recalibration Method
841d480c1a97f4f8a39309f01ca4c49d2397eccb.abstract: Developing Medical AI relies on large datasets and easily suffers from data scarcity. Generative data augmentation (GDA) using AI generative models offers a solution to synthesize realistic medical images. However, the bias in GDA is often underestimated in medical domains, with concerns about the risk of introducing detrimental features generated by AI and harming downstream tasks. This paper identifies the frequency misalignment between real and synthesized images as one of the key factors underlying unreliable GDA and proposes the Frequency Recalibration (FreRec) method to reduce the frequency distributional discrepancy and thus improve GDA. FreRec involves (1) Statistical High-frequency Replacement (SHR) to roughly align high-frequency components and (2) Reconstructive High-frequency Mapping (RHM) to enhance image quality and reconstruct high-frequency details. 83eb9178dfe7dcfcecd5b34b6321ee9bba3b0731.title: Knowledge-Infused Learning for Developing a Mental Health Diagnostic Copilot in Healthcare Systems
83eb9178dfe7dcfcecd5b34b6321ee9bba3b0731.abstract: Healthcare diagnostics, especially in underserved communities, faces critical gaps in accessibility and accuracy. African Americans experience significant disparities in mental health care, often receiving delayed or inadequate treatment. This research proposes a diagnostic copilot, an AI-powered assistant designed to work alongside healthcare professionals. Using Knowledge-Infused Learning (KIL) and multi-turn conversations, the system integrates clinical knowledge and patient input to deliver actionable, explainable diagnoses in real-time. By engaging with both patients and clinicians, the copilot aims to reduce disparities, enhance trust, and improve diagnostic accuracy in mental health care.

81ce611c3cba4fa92bbacde5c331fed38def1a02.abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have effectively improved the performance of Cognitive Diagnosis Models (CDMs). Existing works have proposed a series of Graph-based Cognitive Diagnosis Frameworks (GCDFs) to enhance robustness to noise. However, these robust designs are often general methods for GNNs and are not designed for cognitive diagnosis, which undermines real cognitive information during the denoising process. Interestingly, a noteworthy phenomenon has been overlooked: even without robustness designs, GCDFs can still learn correct information in noisy environments. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive empirical analysis of this issue. We found that noise primarily accumulates in lower singular components. 7fff21e5e4379ba930d5442e2257fefe8c0283be.abstract:
Data economics drives AI by optimizing data usage, reducing costs, and enhancing efficiency. In 3D tumor segmentation, efficiency is crucial due to the high demand for labor-intensive manual annotations. Box-supervised segmentation offers a promising alternative but is constrained by tumor morphology complexity and boundary ambiguity.
In this paper, we propose a novel 3D tumor segmentation model that integrates both positional and embedding features to facilitate inter-task collaboration. We introduce an Anatomical-Driven Class Activation Map to predefine the complex tumor morphology prior, which is further refined by our Geometric Pixel Co-embedding Learner. This learner utilizes contrastive learning to encode semantic information between center and edge pixels, enhancing pixel clustering and progressively refining tumor boundary segmentation in a coarse-to-fine manner. 71b7ade5091be343dd7c2b0aa7a3aa6935913689.title: From Detection to Diagnosis: Advancing Hallucination Analysis with Automated Data Synthesis
71b7ade5091be343dd7c2b0aa7a3aa6935913689.abstract:
Hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs), defined as the generation of content inconsistent with facts or context, represent a core obstacle to their reliable deployment in critical domains. Current research primarily focuses on binary "detection" approaches that, while capable of identifying hallucinations, fail to provide interpretable and actionable feedback for model improvement, thus limiting practical utility. To address this limitation, a new research paradigm is proposed, shifting from "detection" to "diagnosis". The Hallucination Diagnosis Task is introduced, a task which requires models to not only detect hallucinations, but also perform error localization, causal explanation, and content correction.

70f00b3b21fdf6de806e5e8bb5c354311a64f06b.abstract: Accurate drug-target affinity (DTA) prediction holds significant potential in the field of artificial intelligence (AI)-based drug discovery. However, existing methods primarily operate at a single scale, specifically at the macro (residue) scale for target proteins and the micro (atom) scale for drugs, which limits their ability to provide information at micro (atom) scale for targets and macro (functional group, FG) scale for drugs. This limitation hinders a comprehensive understanding of the binding patterns and properties of drug-target pairs. In this paper, we propose a progressive Macro-to-Micro 3D Modeling Network (M²N) that enables macro (residue/FG) to micro (atom) scale unified modeling, termed cross-scale, to predict DTA. 707792d5c1b9222856ae54416610dd82ca70e25b.title: Zero-shot Implicit Neural Manifold Representation (INMR) for Ultra-high Temporal Resolution Dynamic MRI
707792d5c1b9222856ae54416610dd82ca70e25b.abstract:
Capturing accurate dynamic information of moving organs is essential for functional assessment using non-invasive imaging modalities. Achieving high temporal resolution visualization of physiological processes remains a critical challenge in dynamic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) when reconstructing from extremely limited acquisitions. We introduce an unsupervised zero-shot reconstruction framework combining Implicit Neural Representation (INR) with manifold learning, capable of reconstructing dynamic MRI data at unprecedented temporal resolutions (less than 10 ms per frame for 2D imaging, less than 400 ms per frame for 3D imaging). 
The framework employs learnable low-dimensional manifold vectors to autonomously capture motion in real time directly from undersampled data, and dynamically condition coordinate-based spatial representations to generate high-fidelity image sequences.

70606307a547d89063b2674c2a373dea838fe290.abstract: Ultrasound standard plane recognition is essential for clinical tasks such as disease screening, organ evaluation, and biometric measurement. However, existing methods fail to effectively exploit shallow structural information and struggle to capture fine-grained semantic differences through contrastive samples generated by image augmentations, leading to poor recognition of structural and discriminative details in ultrasound standard planes. To address these issues, we propose Structure-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Contrastive Learning (SEMC), a novel framework that combines structure-aware feature fusion with expert-guided contrastive learning. Specifically, we propose a Semantic-Structure Fusion Module (SSFM) to exploit multi-scale structural information and enhance the model's ability to perceive fine-grained structural details by effectively aligning shallow and deep features. Unlike conventional MRI focused on anatomical structures, 4D flow MRI requires high spatiotemporal resolution for early detection of critical conditions such as stenosis or aneurysms. 67ccd85fdcc82eb7c36a585c3686569dfabf3096.title: Personality-guided Public-Private Domain Disentangled Hypergraph-Former Network for Multimodal Depression Detection
67ccd85fdcc82eb7c36a585c3686569dfabf3096.abstract: Depression represents a global mental health challenge requiring efficient and reliable automated detection methods. Current Transformer- or Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)-based multimodal depression detection methods face significant challenges in modeling individual differences and cross-modal temporal dependencies across diverse behavioral contexts. Therefore, we propose P³HF (Personality-guided Public-Private Domain Disentangled Hypergraph-Former Network) with three key innovations: (1) personality-guided representation learning using LLMs to transform discrete individual features into contextual descriptions for personalized encoding; (2) Hypergraph-Former architecture modeling high-order cross-modal temporal relationships; (3) event-level domain disentanglement with contrastive learning for improved generalization across behavioral contexts. 61f133e29bc9a5fcfcb19bdba9b9dc51fdb37811.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) aims to generate accurate answers for clinical questions grounded in medical images, which has attracted increasing research attention due to its potential to streamline diagnostics and reduce clinical burden. Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown great promise for Med-VQA, but still suffer from two inference-time issues: (1) attention shift, where the LVLM over-relies on textual priors; and (2) attention dispersion, where it fails to focus on critical diagnostic regions. 61f133e29bc9a5fcfcb19bdba9b9dc51fdb37811.zh_title: CMID：对比互信息解码的医学视觉问答

5a789012f07d3eca523ca04e8ba232ced4911f91.abstract: Aligning the decision-making process of deep learning models with that of experienced sonographers is essential for ultrasound-based reliable disease diagnosis. Although existing methods have made significant progress in this aspect, their alignments are primarily associational rather than causal, leading to pseudo-correlations between features and diagnostic results. Such a biased diagnosis blindly models the sonographer's diagnostic skills and attention to specific patterns, which we argue hardly produces an AI diagnoser that is comparable to human experts. To address this issue, we propose a causality-based diagnostic framework to align the model's diagnostic behaviors with those of experts. 5963c1ed6fbffe5b1de9c4d4e5cf05bb4b26000f.title: PeerCoPilot: A Language Model-Powered Assistant for Behavioral Health Organizations
5963c1ed6fbffe5b1de9c4d4e5cf05bb4b26000f.abstract: Behavioral health conditions, which include mental health and substance use disorders, are the leading disease burden in the United States. Peer-run behavioral health organizations (PROs) critically assist individuals facing these conditions by combining mental health services with assistance for needs such as income, employment, and housing. However, limited funds and staffing make it difficult for PROs to address all service user needs. To assist peer providers at PROs with their day-to-day tasks, we introduce PeerCoPilot, a large language model (LLM)-powered assistant that helps peer providers create wellness plans, construct step-by-step goals, and locate organizational resources to support these goals. PeerCoPilot ensures information reliability through a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline backed by a large database of over 1,300 vetted resources. We conducted human evaluations

57595c93ff4c78409b51d404fe35cb3a15e2a1db.title: Multivariate Gaussian Representation Learning for Medical Action Evaluation
57595c93ff4c78409b51d404fe35cb3a15e2a1db.abstract: Fine-grained action evaluation in medical vision faces unique challenges due to the unavailability of comprehensive datasets, stringent precision requirements, and insufficient spatiotemporal dynamic modeling of very rapid actions. To support development and evaluation, we introduce CPREval-6k, a multi-view, multi-label medical action benchmark containing 6,372 expert-annotated videos with 22 clinical labels. Using this dataset, we present GaussMedAct, a multivariate Gaussian encoding framework, to advance medical motion analysis through adaptive spatiotemporal representation learning. Multivariate Gaussian Representation projects the joint motions to a temporally scaled multi-dimensional space, and decomposes actions into adaptive 3D Gaussians that serve as tokens. 57595c93ff4c78409b51d404fe35cb3a15e2a1db.zh_title: 医学动作评估的多元高斯表示学习

57595c93ff4c78409b51d404fe35cb3a15e2a1db.zh_abstract: 医学视觉中的细粒度动作评估面临独特挑战，原因包括缺乏全面数据集、严格的精度要求，以及对非常快速动作的时空动态建模不足。为支持开发与评估，我们推出 CPREval-6k，一个多视图、多标签医学动作基准，包含 6,372 个由专家标注的视频，具有 22 个临床标签。使用该数据集，我们提出 GaussMedAct，一个多元高斯编码框架，通过自适应时空表示学习推进医学运动分析。多元高斯表示将关节运动投影到按时间缩放的多维空间，并将动作分解为可自适应调整的 3D 高斯，这些高斯充当 token。这些 token 通过各向异性协方差建模保留运动语义，同时保持对 spatiotempor 的稳健性

558be26e589636364b3d7849010b35eb285c7559.title: GIIM: Graph-based Learning of Inter- and Intra-view Dependencies for Multi-view Medical Image Diagnosis
558be26e589636364b3d7849010b35eb285c7559.abstract: Computer-aided diagnosis (CADx) has become vital in medical imaging, but automated systems often struggle to replicate the nuanced process of clinical interpretation. Expert diagnosis requires a comprehensive analysis of how abnormalities relate to each other across various views and time points, but current multi-view CADx methods frequently overlook these complex dependencies. Specifically, they fail to model the crucial relationships within a single view and the dynamic changes lesions exhibit across different views. This limitation, combined with the common challenge of incomplete data, greatly reduces their predictive reliability. 558be26e589636364b3d7849010b35eb285c7559.zh_title: GIIM：面向多视图医学图像诊断的视图内外依赖图学习

4e1d8c1f80a125e01b95c6b291d756687136970e.title: CryoDomain: Sequence-free Protein Domain Identification from Low-resolution Cryo-EM Density Maps
4e1d8c1f80a125e01b95c6b291d756687136970e.abstract: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has revolutionized the field of structural biology, determining structures of large protein machines and sharpening the understanding of fundamental biological processes. Despite cryo-EM’s unique capacity to discover novel proteins from unpurified samples and reveal the intricate structures of protein complexes within native cellular environments, the advancement of protein identification methods for cryo-EM lags behind. Without prior knowledge, such as sequence, protein identification from low-resolution density maps remains challenging. Here we introduce CryoDomain, an innovative method for identifying protein domains — conserved constituent units of proteins — from low-resolution cryo-EM density maps without requiring prior knowledge of protein sequences. 415dd3d4bde0748dcd7bf2e74bf032cd0a072967.title: A Multimodal EEG-Eye Movement Model for Automatic Depression Detection
415dd3d4bde0748dcd7bf2e74bf032cd0a072967.abstract: Depression is a prevalent mental health disorder characterized by persistent sadness and a diminished interest in daily activities, early detection of depression facilitates timely intervention, mitigating its adverse effects. Electroencephalography (EEG) signals and eye movements are emerging as promising biomarkers for depression detection due to their non-invasive nature and cost-effectiveness. Nevertheless, existing studies suffer from methodological constraints, including low specificity, insufficient sample sizes, limited generalizability, and difficulties in large-scale replication, which collectively undermine their clinical utility. To address these challenges, we collected a large-scale depression dataset comprising EEG and eye movements from 1,060 individuals diagnosed with depression and 1,308 healthy controls. To efficiently leverage multimodal data for automatic depression
415dd3d4bde0748dcd7bf2e74bf032cd0a072967.zh_title: EEG与眼动多模态抑郁自动检测模型

4141c1e53e1e8126370b47f046d9ec884196e194.zh_abstract: 改造优化蛋白质变体的能力对生物技术和医学具有变革性潜力。此前的基于序列的优化方法因上位效应以及忽视结构约束而在高维复杂性方面面临困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出 HADES，一种利用哈密顿动力学的贝叶斯优化方法，能够从结构感知的近似后验中高效采样。借助模拟物理运动中的动量和不确定性，HADES 使候选方案能够快速向有前景的区域转移。引入位置离散化程序，以从此类连续状态系统提出离散蛋白质序列。后验代理模型由两阶段编码器-解码器框架提供支持，用于确定突变邻居之间的结构与功能关系，从而学习一个平滑的 lands

402dbb7f0045b82607bc5d92e345a0e4e8710be0.title: GEMA-Score: Granular Explainable Multi-Agent Scoring Framework for Radiology Report Evaluation
402dbb7f0045b82607bc5d92e345a0e4e8710be0.abstract: Automatic medical report generation has the potential to support clinical diagnosis, reduce the workload of radiologists, and demonstrate potential for enhancing diagnostic consistency. However, current evaluation metrics often fail to reflect the clinical reliability of generated reports. Overlap-based methods overlook fine-grained details (e.g., location, severity), diagnostic metrics are constrained by fixed vocabularies. Some diagnostic metrics are limited by fixed vocabularies or templates, reducing their ability to capture diverse clinical expressions. LLM-based metrics lack interpretable reasoning, limiting trust in clinical settings. Therefore, we propose a Granular Explainable Multi-Agent Score (GEMA-Score) in this paper, which conducts both objective quantification and subjective evaluation through a large language model-based multi-agent workflow. 402dbb7f0045b82607bc5d92e345a0e4e8710be0.zh_title: GEMA-Score：可解释多智能体放射报告评分框架

诊断类指标受固定词表或模板限制
402dbb7f0045b82607bc5d92e345a0e4e8710be0.zh_abstract: 自动医学报告生成有潜力支持临床诊断、减少放射科医生的工作量，并展现出增强诊断一致性的潜力。然而，当前的评估指标往往无法反映所生成报告的临床可靠性。基于重叠的方法忽视细粒度细节（例如位置、严重程度），诊断指标受限于固定词表。一些诊断指标受固定词表或模板限制，降低了其捕捉多样临床表述的能力。基于 LLM 的指标缺乏可解释推理，限制了临床环境中的信任。因此，本文提出粒度可解释多智能体评分（Granular Explainable Multi-Agent Score，GEMA-Score），通过基于大语言模型的多智能体工作流进行客观量化和主观评价。我们的 GEMA-Score 解析 structu

3c4af3f2e63c035b87c8ed97f369c68b2392dffd.title: ProPL: Universal Semi-Supervised Ultrasound Image Segmentation via Prompt-Guided Pseudo-Labeling
3c4af3f2e63c035b87c8ed97f369c68b2392dffd.abstract: Existing approaches for the problem of ultrasound image segmentation, whether supervised or semi-supervised, are typically specialized for specific anatomical structures or tasks, limiting their practical utility in clinical settings. In this paper, we pioneer the task of universal semi-supervised ultrasound image segmentation and propose ProPL, a framework that can handle multiple organs and segmentation tasks while leveraging both labeled and unlabeled data. At its core, ProPL employs a shared vision encoder coupled with prompt-guided dual decoders, enabling flexible task adaptation through a prompting-upon-decoding mechanism and reliable self-training via an uncertainty-driven pseudo-label calibration (UPLC) module. To facilitate research in this direction, we introduce a comprehensive ultrasound dataset spanning 5 organs and 8 segmentation tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate tha
3c4af3f2e63c035b87c8ed97f369c68b2392dffd.zh_title: ProPL：提示引导伪标签的通用半监督超声图像分割
3c4af3f2e63c035b87c8ed97f369c68b2392dffd.summary: 提出ProPL框架，首次面向通用半监督超声分割，统一处理多器官与多任务并利用无标注数据。

39b319333438b2f1d2cac233d33037b5de6aee69.title: VALIANT: Prompt Instability for Active Learning in Black-Box Medical Imaging
39b319333438b2f1d2cac233d33037b5de6aee69.abstract:
The deployment of large, black-box foundation models for medical image classification is often hindered by the high
cost of acquiring large, task-specific labeled datasets for fine-tuning. While active learning (AL) presents a promising solution, many state-of-the-art AL methods are computationally
expensive or require full access to internal model parameters. We present VALIANT (Visual Adaptation and Learning
Integration for Active learNing Tasks), a new active learning framework designed to efficiently adapt black-box foundation models by overcoming these limitations. VALIANT
introduces a lightweight Visual Prompt Decoder (VIPD), trained via unsupervised Zero-Order Optimization (ZOO), to

39b319333438b2f1d2cac233d33037b5de6aee69.zh_title: VALIANT：黑盒医学影像主动学习中的提示不稳定性
39b319333438b2f1d2cac233d33037b5de6aee69.summary: 提出VALIANT主动学习框架，利用提示不稳定性在黑盒医学影像模型中降低标注成本。

35bb7a0f742e6f7cc374dbfd455d225c50af3b8d.title: Dep-MAP: A Multi-level Alignment Framework with Semantic Prototypes for Video-based Automatic Depression Assessment
35bb7a0f742e6f7cc374dbfd455d225c50af3b8d.abstract: Spatiotemporal analysis of facial behavior is a crucial method for evaluating the mental state of depression patients. However, in practice, depressed patients often display facial behaviors similar to healthy individuals due to masking tendencies. Additionally, facial expressions among depressed patients are also different, increasing the difficulty of assessment. To address this, we propose a video-based automatic depression assessment model Dep-MAP for complex facial behaviors of depression patients. Dep-MAP adopts a dual-branch architecture to extract visual features of facial behavior and capture corresponding emotional semantic features. 35bb7a0f742e6f7cc374dbfd455d225c50af3b8d.zh_title: Dep-MAP：基于视频的自动抑郁评估多级对齐框架
35bb7a0f742e6f7cc374dbfd455d225c50af3b8d.summary: 提出Dep-MAP模型，通过语义原型多级对齐应对抑郁患者面部行为掩蔽与个体差异，实现基于视频的自动抑郁评估。

29ec1255b4dc8d8e308a88ae588662b55d058bf4.title: QAPNet: A Quantum-Attentive Patchwise Network for Robust Medical Image Classification Under Noisy Inputs
29ec1255b4dc8d8e308a88ae588662b55d058bf4.abstract:
Robust medical image classification under input corruption
and bag-level annotation remains a critical challenge in clinical
AI applications. We propose QAPNet, a Quantum-
Attentive Patchwise Network that integrates quantum neural
encoding, additive attention-based instance reweighting, and
prototype-contrastive regularization for reliable diagnosis
from degraded inputs. Our framework uses a sliding-window
strategy to divide each MRI medical Image into overlapping
patches, where each is encoded via an 8-qubit quantum circuit
using RY -based noise-sensitive layers for yielding expressive
low-dimensional representations without relying on
classical CNNs. A lightweight additive attention mechanism
computes instance-wise importance weights that enable interpretable
and noise-aware bag-level aggregation. To enhance
robustness, we apply a contrastive loss that aligns clean and
noisy embeddings

29d6f48147963d463f95dc14c220025bcbae5cf1.title: HierarNet: Independent Interactive Hierarchical Disease Outbreak Forecasting
29d6f48147963d463f95dc14c220025bcbae5cf1.abstract:
Early warning systems for disease outbreaks play a crucial role in public health for management and contingency planning. However, most predictive modeling works focus on flat models that incorporate exogenous inputs (e.g. climate, demographics) to predict future outbreaks at different locations, but do not jointly model multiple spatial aggregation levels. 
In this paper, we introduce HierarNet, a unique independent-interactive hierarchical forecasting framework that aims to predict disease outbreaks at different levels of spatial resolution, such as provinces, regions, and nations. HierarNet consists of two main phases. In the local phase, we train independent forecasting models for all locations at all levels. In the global phase, all models iteratively interact with others across different levels via their hierarchical relationships under an ensemble fashion to maximize their agreeme
29d6f48147963d463f95dc14c220025bcbae5cf1.zh_title: HierarNet：独立交互式分层疾病暴发预测
29d6f48147963d463f95dc14c220025bcbae5cf1.summary: 提出独立—交互式分层预测框架HierarNet，联合建模多个空间聚合层级，用于疾病暴发预测与公共卫生早期预警。
key_points: 多数预测工作采用纳入外生变量的平面模型
现有方法未联合建模多个空间聚合层级
