29d6f48147963d463f95dc14c220025bcbae5cf1.zh_abstract: 疾病暴发的早期预警系统在公共卫生的管理和应急规划中发挥着关键作用。然而，大多数预测建模工作集中于扁平模型，这些模型纳入外生输入（例如气候、人口统计学特征）来预测不同地点的未来暴发，但并不联合建模多个空间聚合层级。在本文中，我们引入 HierarNet，一种独特的独立-交互式分层预测框架，旨在预测不同空间分辨率层级上的疾病暴发，例如省、地区和国家。HierarNet 包含两个主要阶段。在局部阶段，我们为所有层级的所有地点训练独立的预测模型。在全局阶段，所有模型在集成方式下，通过其层级关系在不同层级间迭代地与其他模型交互，以最大化它们的一致性

2449ed96b707bc7dddad430aa7108dab154bfbc2.title: Towards Robust, Reliable, and Generalized Medical AI
2449ed96b707bc7dddad430aa7108dab154bfbc2.abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming biomedical imaging, from tumor segmentation to multimodal diagnosis, but reliable deployment in hospitals remains a pressing challenge. Models often struggle with limited labeled data, fail to generalize across scanners and institutions, and lack theoretical guarantees needed for safety-critical decisions. In this talk, I will present our research on overcoming these challenges. I will discuss label-efficient and class-imbalanced learning methods that make effective use of large-scale unlabeled data, theoretical frameworks that embed statistical principles into deep learning for stability and reliability, and medical foundation models that provide universal anatomical priors with lightweight refinement for diverse clinical settings. 1e1892c5d492a44c12c289b816136ebe51c84b39.title: Breaking Task Boundaries: A Unified Model for 3D Medical Image Fusion and Segmentation Guided by Manifold Perspective
1e1892c5d492a44c12c289b816136ebe51c84b39.abstract: 3D medical image fusion (MIF) and segmentation (MIS) are critical and inherently synergistic tasks in medical image analysis. However, fundamentally integrating them remains highly challenging, since effective collaborative paradigms are still scarce and their optimization objectives fundamentally diverge. Moreover, existing continual learning techniques are unable to achieve truly advanced performance for both tasks using a shared weight. To address these challenges, we propose M²-CoFS, a unified model capable of jointly handling both tasks. Our core contribution is a “network-guided network learning” paradigm designed to break the task boundaries. We model the weight spaces of MIF and MIS as high-dimensional manifolds and innovatively use a lightweight neural network to implicitly construct a shared manifold. Interestingly, this network yields a unified weight for both tasks. To ensure
1e1892c5d492a44c12c289b816136ebe51c84b39.zh_title: M²-CoFS：统一的三维医学图像融合与分割模型
1e1892c5d492a44c12c289b816136ebe51c84b39.summary: 提出流形视角引导的统一模型M²-CoFS，用共享权重同时完成三维医学图像融合与分割，突破两任务优化目标分歧的难题。

1b9d3ea8d6841b231f1f323744fdaf7b2b0cc195.title: Conversational Learning Diagnosis via Reasoning Multi-Turn Interactive Learning
1b9d3ea8d6841b231f1f323744fdaf7b2b0cc195.abstract: Learning diagnosis is a critical task that monitors students' cognitive state during educational activities, with the goal of enhancing learning outcomes. With advancements in language models (LMs), many AI-driven educational studies have shifted towards conversational learning scenarios, where students engage in multi-turn interactive dialogues with tutors. However, conversational learning diagnosis remains underdeveloped, and most existing techniques acquire students' cognitive state through intuitive instructional prompts on LMs to analyze the dialogue text. This direct prompting approach lacks a solid psychological foundation and fails to ensure the reliability of the generated analytical text. 10b5b2449735ef8c5272e0649126f01bc230d5f0.title: CMedBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Efficient Medical Large Language Models
10b5b2449735ef8c5272e0649126f01bc230d5f0.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) hold significant potential for enhancing healthcare applications, yet their deployment is hindered by high computational and memory demands. Model compression techniques offer solutions to reduce these demands, but their impact on medical LLMs remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce CMedBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating compressed LLMs in medical contexts. CMedBench assesses five core dimensions: Medical Knowledge Ability, Medical Application Ability, Trustworthiness Maintenance, 
Compression Cross Combination, and Computational Efficiency. To recommend doctors who provide online consultations to health video viewers and enable multimodal cross-domain recommendations from short video platforms (source domain) to online healthcare communities (target domain), this paper introduces a framework based on the User-Centric Synthetic Data Architect (UCSDA) and Pre-trained Large Language Model (PtLLM). 0eed0b7a0e95c0a71140f1874c4fba1465159c1d.abstract: Entity hallucination poses a major challenge in radiology report generation (RRG), particularly for 3D CT scans where complex spatial contexts amplify factual errors. To address this, medical entity phrases serve as key carriers for multi-modal prompting, integrating expert knowledge into the vision-language model. Current methods use unified cross-attention for volume-phrase alignment, failing to account for anatomical specificity during the alignment process. In this work, we introduce the Dual-stream Entity Alignment Reporting network (DEAR) that separately models organ and lesion entities to resolve anatomical bias. fee0c05619966ad1fd11cc3100c4a12085832939.abstract: Medical vision–language pretraining typically relies on static image–text pairs, overlooking temporal cues vital for understanding clinical progression. This limits model sensitivity to evolving semantics and reduces their effectiveness in real-world clinical reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose TAMM—a temporal alignment framework that leverages weak but semantically rich supervision from large language models (LLMs). Given temporally adjacent clinical reports, LLMs automatically generate (i) coarse-grained trend labels (e.g., improving or worsening), and (ii) fine-grained rationales explaining the supporting clinical evidence. fe44edb1d36d4d31da3a502f82ad18edc59e431d.abstract:
Automated interpretation and reporting of chest X-rays (CXRs) hold significant promise in reducing diagnostic errors and supporting radiologists under heavy clinical workloads. However, existing methods typically rely on global visual features and token-level supervision, limiting their sensitivity to subtle abnormalities and reducing their clinical reliability.

fb767de1f90e3ea279b07a87b7670e6568fde6d2.abstract: The prediction of compound–protein interactions (CPIs) is crucial for drug discovery. Most existing CPI prediction models rely on protein sequence information as input. However, in early-stage drug development, particularly in phenotype-driven studies or compound-response analyses, proteins are often annotated only with functional labels, and their sequences remain undetermined. Consequently, current methods are inapplicable in such scenarios. Furthermore, our experiments find that even when large-scale perturbations were applied to protein sequences, the predictive performance of the existing models did not show a significant decline. It indicates that the high investment in sequencing may not bring corresponding returns. f98c1f25f657ce27a144ce7a22d3c31ee8c6d1c3.abstract: Deep learning has demonstrated expert-level performance in melanoma classification, positioning it as a powerful tool in clinical dermatology. However, model opacity and the lack of interpretability remain critical barriers to clinical adoption, as clinicians often struggle to trust the decision-making processes of black-box models. Specifically, CEFM maps clinical criteria for melanoma diagnosis—namely Asymmetry, Border, and Color (ABC)—into the Vision Transformer embedding space using dual projection heads, thereby aligning clinical semantics with visual features. f8a636cdd948237e9f0f5533926edf8cb2a07b1f.title: Rethinking Surgical Smoke: A Smoke-Type-Aware Laparoscopic Video Desmoking Method and Dataset
f8a636cdd948237e9f0f5533926edf8cb2a07b1f.abstract: Electrocautery or lasers will inevitably generate surgical smoke, which hinders the visual guidance of laparoscopic videos for surgical procedures. The surgical smoke can be classified into different types based on its motion patterns, leading to distinctive spatio-temporal characteristics across smoky laparoscopic videos. However, existing desmoking methods fail to account for such smoke-type-specific distinctions. Therefore, we propose the first Smoke-Type-Aware Laparoscopic Video Desmoking Network (STANet) by introducing two smoke types: Diffusion Smoke and Ambient Smoke. Specifically, a smoke mask segmentation sub-network is designed to jointly conduct smoke mask and smoke type predictions based on the attention-weighted mask aggregation, while a smokeless video reconstruction sub-network is proposed to perform specially desmoking on smoky features guided by two types of smoke mask.

f8a636cdd948237e9f0f5533926edf8cb2a07b1f.zh_abstract: 电灼或激光不可避免地会产生手术烟雾，这会阻碍腹腔镜视频在外科手术中的视觉引导。手术烟雾可根据其运动模式分为不同类型，从而在有烟雾的腹腔镜视频中呈现出不同的时空特征。然而，现有去烟方法未能考虑这种烟雾类型特异性差异。因此，我们通过引入两种烟雾类型：扩散烟雾（Diffusion Smoke）和环境烟雾（Ambient Smoke），提出首个烟雾类型感知的腹腔镜视频去烟网络（Smoke-Type-Aware Laparoscopic Video Desmoking Network, STANet）。具体而言，设计了一个烟雾掩膜分割子网络，基于注意力加权掩膜聚合联合进行烟雾掩膜和烟雾类型预测；同时提出了一个无烟视频重建子网络，在两类烟雾掩膜引导下对含烟特征进行专门去烟。

f74359e0e999002370369003f82817e48ccbf0bd.zh_abstract: 准确预测治疗后乳腺癌复发对于改善长期结局至关重要。然而，现有模型受限于三个关键挑战：(1) 它们通常依赖单模态数据，缺失跨模态交互；(2) 它们分析静态快照，未能捕捉疾病随时间的进展；(3) 它们通常执行粗糙的特征融合，缺乏语义解缠和可解释性。为解决这些问题，我们提出 LUMIN（Longitudinal Multi-modal Knowledge Decomposition Network，纵向多模态知识分解网络），这是一个新颖框架，整合纵向乳腺 X 线摄影和电子健康记录（EHRs）以进行复发预测。LUMIN 利用视觉-语言对比预训练主干来对齐多模态表示，并引入两个知识提取模块：(1) 一个跨模态解缠知识提取器（Cross-Modal Disentangled Knowledge Extractor，CM-DKE），其分离共享...

f6563d538b8ac96b28fcf868de0340c9ee711851.title: A Human-Centric Pipeline for Aligning Large Language Models with Chinese Medical Ethics
f6563d538b8ac96b28fcf868de0340c9ee711851.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled their application to a range of healthcare tasks. However, aligning LLMs with the nuanced demands of medical ethics, especially under complex real-world scenarios, remains underexplored. In this work, we present MedES, a dynamic, scenario-centric benchmark specifically constructed from 260 authoritative Chinese medical, ethical, and legal sources to reflect the challenges in clinical decision-making. To facilitate model alignment, we introduce a guardian-in-the-loop framework that leverages a dedicated automated evaluator—trained on expert-labeled data and achieving over 97% accuracy within our domain—to generate targeted prompts and provide structured ethical feedback. Using this pipeline, we align a 7B-parameter LLM through supervised fine-tuning and domain-specific preference optimization. Experimental results, conducted ent
f6563d538b8ac96b28fcf868de0340c9ee711851.zh_title: 面向中文医学伦理的大模型人本对齐流程
f6563d538b8ac96b28fcf868de0340c9ee711851.summary: 基于260个中文权威医学、伦理与法律来源构建场景化基准 MedES，并提出与大模型对齐的人本流程。

f6563d538b8ac96b28fcf868de0340c9ee711851.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的近期进展使其能够应用于一系列医疗保健任务。然而，使LLM与医学伦理的细微要求对齐，尤其是在复杂的现实世界场景下，仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了MedES，一个动态的、以场景为中心的基准，专门基于260个权威的中文医学、伦理和法律来源构建，以反映临床决策中的挑战。为促进模型对齐，我们引入了一个守护者在环（guardian-in-the-loop）框架，该框架利用一个专门的自动评估器——在专家标注数据上训练，并在我们的领域内达到超过97%的准确率——来生成针对性提示并提供结构化的伦理反馈。使用这一流程，我们通过监督微调和领域特定的偏好优化对齐了一个70亿参数（7B-parameter）的LLM。实验结果，在 ent

f4d85767cb36a85e9ac8a7e3c9778dd980439cec.title: Toward Trustworthy AI for Decision Making in Population Health
f4d85767cb36a85e9ac8a7e3c9778dd980439cec.abstract: AI and population health are becoming increasingly intertwined, driven by the growing availability of multimodal data and rapid advances in AI. At the AAAI-26 New Faculty Highlights, I present our efforts to harness these trends to enhance our capacity to model, simulate, and adapt to complex dynamical processes. I first introduce our robust deep learning architectures for real-time outbreak response, highlighting how our frameworks capture uncertainty and dynamics across shifting distributions, multimodal data, hierarchical structures, and relational dependencies. I will then introduce our hybrid approaches that integrate machine learning with science-based mechanistic epidemiological models, including physics-informed neural networks, expert-guided generative models for causal inference, and differentiable agent-based models. Together, these advances illustrate how combining data-drive
f4d85767cb36a85e9ac8a7e3c9778dd980439cec.zh_title: 面向人群健康决策的可信AI
f4d85767cb36a85e9ac8a7e3c9778dd980439cec.summary: 在AAAI-26新教师亮点报告介绍面向人群健康的可信AI工作，含实时疫情响应的稳健深度学习架构。
key_points: AI与人群健康因多模态数据与算法进展而交织
提出用于实时疫情响应的稳健深度学习架构
框架刻画不确定性与分布偏移下的动态
f4d85767cb36a85e9ac8a7e3c9778dd980439cec.zh_abstract: 人工智能与群体健康正日益交织，其驱动力是多模态数据的日益可获取以及人工智能的快速进展。在 AAAI-26 New Faculty Highlights 上，我介绍我们为利用这些趋势以增强对复杂动态过程进行建模、模拟和适应能力所做的努力。我首先介绍我们用于实时疫情应对的稳健深度学习架构，重点说明我们的框架如何在分布变化、多模态数据、层次结构和关系依赖中捕捉不确定性和动态。然后，我将介绍我们将机器学习与基于科学的机制性流行病学模型相结合的混合方法，包括物理信息神经网络（physics-informed neural networks）、用于因果推断的专家引导生成模型（expert-guided generative models for causal inference）以及可微分基于智能体模型（differentiable agent-based models）。总之，这些进展说明了如何结合数据驱动（data-drive）……

f4525dd57502d73f89995a72619cb44f86353e9d.title: FuseMine: Robust Multi-Modal Compound-Protein Interaction Prediction via Differential Attention Feature Mining
f4525dd57502d73f89995a72619cb44f86353e9d.abstract:
Accurate prediction of compound protein interactions (CPIs) is crucial for drug discovery. 
However, existing deep learning-based methods suffer from hidden biases and poor cross-domain generalization, leading to spurious correlations and inadequate representation of unseen compound-protein pairs. 
To address these limitations, we propose FuseMine, a multimodal deep learning framework that jointly leverages molecular structures and biological sequences for reliable CPI prediction.
Specifically, FuseMine adopts a dual-representation strategy for each molecule. It employs a convolutional encoder to capture structural features, combined with pretrained large language models for extracting semantic information from sequences. We propose a novel Multi-modal Feature Orchestration Aggregation (MFOA) module that enables deep and synergistic fusion between the structural features and the sequenti
f4525dd57502d73f89995a72619cb44f86353e9d.zh_title: FuseMine：多模态化合物-蛋白相互作用预测
f4525dd57502d73f89995a72619cb44f86353e9d.summary: 提出多模态深度学习框架，联合分子结构与生物序列预测化合物-蛋白相互作用。
key_points: 现有方法存在隐藏偏差与跨域泛化不足
联合利用分子结构与生物序列
采用差分注意力进行特征挖掘
f4525dd57502d73f89995a72619cb44f86353e9d.zh_abstract:
化合物-蛋白质相互作用（CPIs）的准确预测对于药物发现至关重要。
然而，现有的基于深度学习的方法存在隐藏偏差和跨域泛化能力差的问题，导致虚假相关性和对未见化合物-蛋白质对的表示不足。
为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了FuseMine，一个多模态深度学习框架，它联合利用分子结构和生物序列来进行可靠的CPI预测。
具体来说，FuseMine对每个分子采用双表示策略。它使用卷积编码器捕捉结构特征，并结合预训练的大语言模型从序列中提取语义信息。我们提出了一种新颖的多模态特征编排聚合（MFOA）模块，该模块能够在结构特征和 sequenti 之间实现深度和协同的融合。

f0a92cf33bbae3f92244ce4cf49cdae476078944.title: scMBERT: A Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model for Single-Cell Multiomic Data Representation and Prediction (Student Abstract)
f0a92cf33bbae3f92244ce4cf49cdae476078944.abstract: Recent advancements in single-cell sequencing technologies enable the measurement of multiple modalities in individual cells, offering insights into the transcriptome and regulome in various biological systems and human diseases in an unprecedented resolution. However, effectively using these ultra-high-dimensional and large-scale multiomic data to understand gene regulation remains challenging. Inspired by the success of adapting large language models into the genomics field, we develop scMBERT, a BERT framework-based pre-trained deep learning model using single-cell multiomic data. We showed that scMBERT increases model flexibility and performance in downstream tasks like cell type annotation and batch-effect correction, demonstrating the potential of leveraging multiomic data to improve single-cell genomic data analyses.
f0a92cf33bbae3f92244ce4cf49cdae476078944.zh_title: scMBERT：单细胞多组学表征与预测的预训练模型
f0a92cf33bbae3f92244ce4cf49cdae476078944.summary: 受基因组学大模型启发，构建预训练深度学习模型scMBERT，用于单细胞多组学数据的表征与预测。
key_points: 面向超高维大规模单细胞多组学数据
借鉴大语言模型思路迁移至基因组学
用于基因调控理解与预测任务
f0a92cf33bbae3f92244ce4cf49cdae476078944.zh_abstract: 单细胞测序技术的最新进展使得能够测量单个细胞中的多种模态，以前所未有的分辨率提供对不同生物系统和人类疾病中转录组与调控组（regulome）的洞察。然而，有效利用这些超高维、大规模的多组学（multiomic）数据来理解基因调控仍然具有挑战性。受将大型语言模型适配到基因组学领域取得成功的启发，我们开发了 scMBERT，一种基于 BERT 框架的预训练深度学习模型，使用单细胞多组学数据。我们表明，scMBERT 提高了细胞类型注释和批次效应校正等下游任务中的模型灵活性和性能，展示了利用多组学数据改进单细胞基因组数据分析的潜力。

eecfe40f02305bc308cf2450f3a18484c04e5c29.title: Realizing AI for Impact: Towards Participatory Human-AI Collaboration for Water Conservation and Reproductive Health
eecfe40f02305bc308cf2450f3a18484c04e5c29.abstract: AI has immense potential for positive social impact, including in domains ranging from conservation to health. However, it can be challenging to account for human collaborations and real-world uncertainties when deploying such systems, which can lead to critical errors. Therefore, my research focuses on developing new methods in multi-agent systems and machine learning, including methods for participatory design of AI, human-AI collaboration, and uncertainty quantification, to develop safe, impactful AI systems, particularly in the domains of water conservation and reproductive health.
eecfe40f02305bc308cf2450f3a18484c04e5c29.zh_title: 面向影响的AI：节水与生殖健康的参与式人机协作

ec9726dcbb040cd68ae2af989160b0d1c69cf996.title: From Complexity to Clarity: Transforming Chest X-ray Reports with Chained Prompting (Student Abstract)
ec9726dcbb040cd68ae2af989160b0d1c69cf996.abstract: In the rapidly advancing field of AI-assisted medical diagnosis, the generation of medical reports for Chest X-rays (CXR) has significantly improved with the increased availability of radiographs and their corresponding reports. However, these reports often contain complex medical terminology, making them difficult for patients and non-healthcare professionals to understand. In this study, we introduce a strategy called Chained Prompting for Improved Readability of Medical Reports (CPIR-MR), which translates original medical reports into more comprehensible language. Our primary contribution is the creation of a new extension to the IU X-Ray dataset, providing Simplified Medical Reports (SMRs) generated by CPIR-MR. Additionally, we demonstrate that standard methodologies can effectively produce these simplified reports by proposing a multi-modal text decoder (MTD) that combines BLIP with
ec9726dcbb040cd68ae2af989160b0d1c69cf996.zh_title: 链式提示提升胸部X线报告可读性
ec9726dcbb040cd68ae2af989160b0d1c69cf996.summary: 提出链式提示策略CPIR-MR，将含复杂术语的胸部X线报告改写为便于患者理解的表述。

采用链式提示提升报告可读性

ec9726dcbb040cd68ae2af989160b0d1c69cf996.zh_abstract: 在快速发展的 AI 辅助医学诊断领域，随着放射影像及其对应报告的可获得性增加，胸部 X 射线（Chest X-rays, CXR）医学报告的生成已显著改善。然而，这些报告通常包含复杂的医学术语，使患者和非医疗专业人员难以理解。在本研究中，我们引入一种称为“链式提示提升医学报告可读性”（Chained Prompting for Improved Readability of Medical Reports, CPIR-MR）的策略，将原始医学报告转换为更易理解的语言。我们的主要贡献是创建了 IU X-Ray 数据集的一个新扩展，提供由 CPIR-MR 生成的简化医学报告（Simplified Medical Reports, SMRs）。此外，我们证明标准方法能够有效生成这些简化报告，方法是提出一种多模态文本解码器（multi-modal text decoder, MTD），它将 BLIP 与……

e5b12dd73d426e743ee071d0429036ae3e6fd6d0.title: How Your Location Relates to Health: Variable Importance and Interpretable Machine Learning for Environmental and Sociodemographic Data
e5b12dd73d426e743ee071d0429036ae3e6fd6d0.abstract: Health outcomes depend on complex environmental and sociodemographic factors whose effects change over location and time. Only recently has fine-grained spatial and temporal data become available to study these effects, namely the MEDSAT dataset of English health, environmental, and sociodemographic information. Leveraging this new resource, we use a variety of variable importance techniques to robustly identify the most informative predictors across multiple health outcomes. We then develop an interpretable machine learning framework based on Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) and Multiscale Geographically Weighted Regression (MGWR) to analyze both local and global spatial dependencies of each variable on various health outcomes. Our findings identify NO2 as a global predictor for asthma, hypertension, and anxiety, alongside other outcome-specific predictors related to occupation, marri
e5b12dd73d426e743ee071d0429036ae3e6fd6d0.zh_title: 位置与健康：环境与社会人口数据的可解释机器学习
e5b12dd73d426e743ee071d0429036ae3e6fd6d0.summary: 基于MEDSAT英国健康、环境与社会人口数据，用变量重要性方法识别关键预测因子并构建可解释模型。

变量重要性稳健识别关键预测因子
开发可解释机器学习方法
e5b12dd73d426e743ee071d0429036ae3e6fd6d0.zh_abstract: 健康结局取决于复杂的环境和社会人口因素，其影响随地点和时间而变化。直到最近，才有细粒度空间和时间数据可用于研究这些影响，即包含英格兰健康、环境和社会人口信息的 MEDSAT 数据集。利用这一新资源，我们使用多种变量重要性技术，稳健地识别跨多个健康结局最具信息量的预测变量。随后，我们开发了一个基于广义相加模型（Generalized Additive Models, GAMs）和多尺度地理加权回归（Multiscale Geographically Weighted Regression, MGWR）的可解释机器学习框架，以分析每个变量对各种健康结局的局部和全局空间依赖关系。我们的发现将 NO2 确定为哮喘、高血压和焦虑的全局预测因子，以及其他与职业、婚姻（marri）……相关的结局特异性预测因子。

e4725f58d9a757f1029581edd16c5c9ed05326c4.title: DEGRE: Dynamic Gating Ensembles for Trust-Aware Rejection in Medical Image Diagnostics
e4725f58d9a757f1029581edd16c5c9ed05326c4.abstract: For artificial intelligence to be safely deployed in high-risk domains, it must reliably know its limits. Selective prediction, or learning with a reject option, addresses this by enabling a model to abstain from prediction on inputs it deems unreliable, deferring them to a human expert. While deep ensembles have emerged as a leading approach for uncertainty estimation, their potential is often squandered by rejection methods that rely on static thresholds applied to the mean prediction. In this paper, we propose to learn a dynamic rejection policy directly from the rich behavioral signals of the ensemble itself. Our framework, DEGRE (Dynamic Ensembles Gating for REjection), is a novel meta-learning approach that trains a lightweight gating network on the ensemble’s consensus confidence and its internal disagreement (variance)— to explicitly discriminate between correct and incorrect pre
e4725f58d9a757f1029581edd16c5c9ed05326c4.zh_title: DEGRE：医学影像诊断中的信任感知拒答集成
e4725f58d9a757f1029581edd16c5c9ed05326c4.summary: 提出DEGRE动态门控集成方法，改进选择性预测的拒绝机制，使模型对不可靠输入弃权并转交专家。
key_points: 高风险领域部署要求模型自知能力边界
选择性预测允许模型弃权并转交人工
静态阈值限制深度集成的不确定性估计
e4725f58d9a757f1029581edd16c5c9ed05326c4.zh_abstract: 为了使人工智能能够安全部署在高风险领域，它必须可靠地知道自身的局限。选择性预测（selective prediction），或称带拒绝选项的学习（learning with a reject option），通过使模型能够对自认为不可靠的输入放弃预测、将其交由人类专家处理，来解决这一问题。尽管深度集成（deep ensembles）已成为不确定性估计的一种领先方法，但其潜力常常被依赖于对平均预测施加静态阈值的拒绝方法所浪费。在本文中，我们提出直接从集成本身丰富的行为信号中学习一种动态拒绝策略。我们的框架DEGRE（Dynamic Ensembles Gating for REjection）是一种新颖的元学习方法，它在集成的共识置信度及其内部分歧（方差）上训练一个轻量级门控网络——以明确区分正确和不正确的 pre

e10381276f798be3928649c2b09d52ab8c6e1688.title: MMPG: MoE-based Adaptive Multi-Perspective Graph Fusion for Protein Representation Learning
e10381276f798be3928649c2b09d52ab8c6e1688.abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely adopted for Protein Representation Learning (PRL), as residue interaction networks can be naturally represented as graphs. Current GNN-based PRL methods typically rely on single-perspective graph construction strategies, which capture partial properties of residue interactions, resulting in incomplete protein representations. To address this limitation, we propose MMPG, a framework that constructs protein graphs from multiple perspectives and adaptively fuses them via Mixture of Experts (MoE) for PRL. MMPG constructs graphs from physical, chemical, and geometric perspectives to characterize different properties of residue interactions. e10381276f798be3928649c2b09d52ab8c6e1688.zh_title: MMPG：基于MoE的自适应多视角图融合蛋白质表示学习
e10381276f798be3928649c2b09d52ab8c6e1688.summary: 提出MMPG框架，通过多视角蛋白质图构建与MoE自适应融合提升表示学习。
key_points: GNN广泛用于蛋白质表示学习
单视角图构建导致表示不完整
提出多视角图与MoE自适应融合
e10381276f798be3928649c2b09d52ab8c6e1688.zh_abstract: 图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNNs）已被广泛用于蛋白质表示学习（Protein Representation Learning, PRL），因为残基相互作用网络可以自然地表示为图。当前基于 GNN 的 PRL 方法通常依赖单一视角的图构建策略，这些策略仅捕获残基相互作用的部分性质，导致蛋白质表示不完整。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了 MMPG，一个从多个视角构建蛋白质图并通过专家混合（Mixture of Experts, MoE）为 PRL 自适应融合这些图的框架。MMPG 从物理、化学和几何视角构建图，以刻画残基相互作用的不同性质。为了捕获视角特有特征及其协同作用，我们开发了一个 MoE 模块，它将视角动态路由到专门的专家，专家学习内在特征和跨视角（cross-perspe

df5c9fac989bf58f4f009b61995f21017aeffed1.title: MIRNet: Integrating Constrained Graph-Based Reasoning with Pre-training for Diagnostic Medical Imaging
df5c9fac989bf58f4f009b61995f21017aeffed1.abstract: Automated interpretation of medical images demands robust modeling of complex visual-semantic relationships while addressing annotation scarcity, label imbalance, and clinical plausibility constraints. We introduce MIRNet (Medical Image Reasoner Network), a novel framework that integrates self-supervised pre-training with constrained graph-based reasoning. Tongue image diagnosis is a particularly challenging domain that requires fine-grained visual and semantic understanding. Our approach leverages self-supervised masked autoencoder (MAE) to learn transferable visual representations from unlabeled data; employs graph attention networks (GAT) to model label correlations through expert-defined structured graphs; enforces clinical priors via constraint-aware optimization using KL divergence and regularization losses; and mitigates imbalance using asymmetric loss (ASL) and boosting ensembles
df5c9fac989bf58f4f009b61995f21017aeffed1.zh_title: MIRNet：约束图推理与预训练结合的诊断医学影像框架
df5c9fac989bf58f4f009b61995f21017aeffed1.summary: MIRNet 将自监督预训练与受约束的图推理结合，面向标注稀缺、类别不均衡的诊断影像任务，并以舌象诊断为例。
key_points: 自监督预训练结合约束图推理

dee0c3cb5015655aa5164ebb01094a6cd0eb9fe4.title: Machine Learning Models Assisting the Development of Antibody Therapeutics and Vaccines - an Emerging Trend
dee0c3cb5015655aa5164ebb01094a6cd0eb9fe4.abstract: The development of novel effective medical treatments is one of the most important and expected beneficial effects of the AI revolution. This decade is witnessing the rise of AI models able to predict complex properties for protein-protein interactions that hold great promise in assisting in the development of antibody therapeutics and vaccines, including for diseases that long eluded us in the pursuit of an effective treatment. This paper introduces this area of research in a language accessible to an AI researcher, exploring the biological problems that can be solved by AI models, as well as the general context to make solutions feasible in practical scenarios. We survey the main current trends and works in this research area and point towards current still unsolved challenges and trade offs. dec96591f39c164c55ed17b29da32c7b3396c77b.title: FAMDR: Feature-Aligned Multimodal Denoising for Reliable Diagnostic Reconciliation in Medical Imaging
dec96591f39c164c55ed17b29da32c7b3396c77b.abstract: This paper presents FAMDR, a Feature-Aligned Multimodal Denoising framework for Reliable Diagnostic Reconciliation. Existing approaches suffer from two major limitations: (1) an overemphasis on simplifying observational descriptions and (2) a failure to denoise the misleading content in radiological findings against clinical histories. Current methods often dismiss such cross-modal inconsistencies as noise rather than clinically significant signals. To bridge this gap, the framework integrates four synergistic components: (1) noise-aware multimodal alignment that preserves discriminative discrepancy features while ensuring semantic coherence, (2) cross-modal retrieval augmentation leveraging external medical knowledge to resolve ambiguous cases, (3) granular localization of noises at pixel and phrase levels using adaptive thresholding, and (4) medical noise uncertainty quantification to
dec96591f39c164c55ed17b29da32c7b3396c77b.zh_title: FAMDR：特征对齐多模态去噪与诊断校验
dec96591f39c164c55ed17b29da32c7b3396c77b.summary: 提出FAMDR框架，对齐多模态特征并对影像所见中误导性内容去噪，用于可靠诊断校验。

de2d5cc1f224ce71d9a8018d839c002a6bcde081.title: Hide and Seek with LLMs: An Adversarial Game for Sneaky Error Generation and Self-Improving Diagnosis
de2d5cc1f224ce71d9a8018d839c002a6bcde081.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in reasoning and generation across domains, but still struggle with identifying and diagnosing complex errors. This stems mainly from training objectives that prioritize correct answers, limiting exposure to and learning from errors. While recent studies have begun to address this by introducing error signals, most rely on shallow, static errors, restricting improvement in deep diagnostic ability. To overcome this, we propose Hide and Seek Game (HSG), a dynamic adversarial framework for error generation and diagnosis, and evaluate it on mathematical problem-solving. HSG involves two adversarial roles: Sneaky, which hides by generating subtle, deceptive reasoning errors, and Diagnosis, which seeks to accurately detect them. Through adversarial co-evolution, both error stealth and diagnostic precision are enhanced. Experiments on three mathematical reason
de2d5cc1f224ce71d9a8018d839c002a6bcde081.zh_title: 与大模型捉迷藏：对抗博弈生成隐蔽错误并自我改进诊断
de2d5cc1f224ce71d9a8018d839c002a6bcde081.summary: 提出 Hide and Seek Game 动态对抗博弈，让 LLM 接触更深层错误信号以提升复杂错误的诊断与改进能力。

de2d5cc1f224ce71d9a8018d839c002a6bcde081.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在跨领域的推理与生成方面表现出色，但在识别和诊断复杂错误方面仍存在困难。这主要源于优先考虑正确答案的训练目标，限制了对错误的接触和从错误中学习。尽管近期研究已开始通过引入错误信号来应对这一问题，但大多数依赖浅层、静态的错误，制约了深度诊断能力的提升。为克服这一问题，我们提出“捉迷藏游戏”（Hide and Seek Game, HSG），一个用于错误生成与诊断的动态对抗框架，并在数学问题求解上对其进行评估。HSG 包含两个对抗角色：Sneaky，通过生成细微、具有欺骗性的推理错误来进行隐藏；Diagnosis，力求准确检测这些错误。通过对抗性协同演化，错误的隐蔽性和诊断的精确性均得到增强。在三个数学推理

dd3ee5f538031a2a0171e5d7368047d4afb0bb72.title: MoEA-Net: Modality-Incremental Expert Aggregation Network for Retinal Prognostic Prediction
dd3ee5f538031a2a0171e5d7368047d4afb0bb72.abstract: Automated analysis of temporal changes in multimodal retinal images is critical for the prognostic assessment of ophthalmic diseases. Unlike traditional single-timepoint diagnosis, tracking longitudinal changes across multiple imaging modalities introduces significant data bias challenges: (1) Imbalanced modality samples compromise the integration of knowledge within minority modalities; (2) Heterogeneous visual patterns across modalities undermine the perception of disease-relevant biomarkers. To tackle these issues, we propose a Modality-Incremental Expert Aggregation Network (MoEA-Net), which unifies the inter-modal integration and intra-modal perception for enhanced retinal prognostic prediction. Specifically, we employ the large language model (LLM) with incremental LoRA layers for specific modalities to effectively integrate knowledge from imbalanced data. Besides, we introduce a S
dd3ee5f538031a2a0171e5d7368047d4afb0bb72.zh_title: MoEA-Net：模态增量专家聚合的视网膜预后预测
dd3ee5f538031a2a0171e5d7368047d4afb0bb72.summary: 提出模态增量专家聚合网络，应对多模态视网膜图像纵向分析中的数据偏置挑战。

d9eceb5bbd9f1ccd3a278958b65dc30621f70e08.title: Constrained Molecule Generation Modelled Using the Grammar Constraint
d9eceb5bbd9f1ccd3a278958b65dc30621f70e08.abstract: Drug discovery is a very time-consuming and costly endeavour due to its huge design space and to the lengthy and failure-fraught process of bringing a product to market. Automating the generation of candidate molecules exhibiting some of the desired properties can help. Among the standard formats to encode molecules, SMILES is a widespread string representation. We propose a constraint programming model showcasing the grammar constraint to express the design space of organic molecules using the SMILES notation. We show how some common physicochemical properties --- such as molecular weight and lipophilicity --- and structural features can be expressed as constraints in the model. We also contribute a weighted counting algorithm for the grammar constraint, allowing us to use a belief propagation heuristic to guide the generation. Our experiments indicate that such a heuristic is key to dr
d9eceb5bbd9f1ccd3a278958b65dc30621f70e08.zh_title: 基于语法约束建模的受限分子生成
d9eceb5bbd9f1ccd3a278958b65dc30621f70e08.summary: 提出约束规划模型，用语法约束表达有机分子的SMILES设计空间以生成候选分子。

d9eceb5bbd9f1ccd3a278958b65dc30621f70e08.zh_abstract: 药物发现是一项非常耗时且昂贵的工作，因为其设计空间巨大，而且将产品推向市场的过程漫长且充满失败。自动化生成具有某些所需性质的候选分子可能会有所帮助。在编码分子的标准格式中，SMILES 是一种广泛使用的字符串表示。我们提出一个约束编程模型，展示用于表达有机分子设计空间的 SMILES 记法下的语法约束。我们展示了一些常见的理化性质——如分子量和亲脂性——以及结构特征如何能在该模型中表示为约束。我们还为语法约束贡献了一种加权计数算法，使我们能够使用信念传播启发式来指导生成。我们的实验表明，这种启发式对于 dr 至关重要。

d9977172a107515df00c30dbe6a285a9f0b478c8.title: OncoCoT: A Temporal-causal Chain-of-Thought Dataset for Oncologic Decision-Making
d9977172a107515df00c30dbe6a285a9f0b478c8.abstract:
Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has shown great promise in complex reasoning tasks, but its application to medical decision-making presents unique challenges. Unlike structured tasks relying on static verification frameworks, medical decision-making requires dynamic validation through longitudinal clinical outcomes, exhibiting temporal-causal dependencies that complicate the verification of reasoning processes. Therefore, we introduce a novel data construction framework specifically designed for medical decision-making. First, the framework analyzes real-world clinical cases to construct a timeline of medical events and identify critical decision points, including examination, diagnosis, and treatment. Subsequently, it employs a clinical causality-aware strategy to generate decision-making questions at the identified points, along with reasoning traces and corresponding answers.

长思维链（Long Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理在复杂推理任务中展现出巨大前景，但其在医学决策中的应用带来了独特挑战。与依赖静态验证框架的结构化任务不同，医学决策需要通过纵向临床结局进行动态验证，表现出时间-因果依赖性，这使推理过程的验证变得复杂。因此，我们引入了一个专为医学决策设计的新颖数据构建框架。首先，该框架分析真实世界临床病例，构建医学事件时间线，并识别关键决策点，包括检查、诊断和治疗。随后，它采用临床因果感知策略，在识别出的决策点生成决策问题，以及推理轨迹和相应答案。

d4cebefec84583629f5bccfca7b6ca5177f5fec3.title: ReFINE: A Reward-Based Framework for Interpretable and Nuanced Evaluation of Radiology Report Generation
d4cebefec84583629f5bccfca7b6ca5177f5fec3.abstract: Automated radiology report generation (R2Gen) has advanced significantly, yet evaluation remains challenging due to the complexity of assessing report quality. Traditional metrics often misalign with human judgments, failing to identify specific deficiencies. To address this, we introduce ReFINE, a framework for training an Evaluation Model using a novel margin-based reward enforcement loss. This approach decomposes report quality into fine-grained sub-scores across user-defined criteria, improving interpretability. Leveraging GPT-4, we generate diverse training data with paired accepted and rejected reports to train our model under a reward-based system. The trained ReFINE Score provides both granular sub-scores and an aggregated quality assessment, enabling criterion-specific evaluation. d4cebefec84583629f5bccfca7b6ca5177f5fec3.zh_title: ReFINE：放射报告生成的可解释奖励评估框架

d4cebefec84583629f5bccfca7b6ca5177f5fec3.zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成（Automated radiology report generation, R2Gen）已取得显著进展，但由于评估报告质量的复杂性，评估仍然具有挑战性。传统指标常常与人类判断不一致，无法识别具体的缺陷。为解决这一问题，我们引入了 ReFINE，一个使用新型基于间隔的奖励强制损失（margin-based reward enforcement loss）训练评估模型的框架。该方法将报告质量分解为用户定义标准下的细粒度子分数，从而提高了可解释性。利用 GPT-4，我们生成包含成对被接受和拒绝报告的多样化训练数据，以在基于奖励的系统中训练我们的模型。训练后的 ReFINE Score 既提供细粒度子分数，也提供聚合质量评估，从而支持特定标准的评估。实验结果表明，ReFINE 与人类判断具有更优的一致性，优于 tr。

d1b90c63224140b7f396e6ef8658842307a34492.title: MultiMedBench: A Scenario-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Editing in Medical VQA
d1b90c63224140b7f396e6ef8658842307a34492.abstract:
Knowledge editing (KE) provides a scalable approach for updating factual knowledge in large language models without full retraining. While previous studies have demonstrated effectiveness in general domains and medical QA tasks, little attention has been paid to KE in multimodal medical scenarios. Unlike text-only settings, medical KE demands integrating updated knowledge with visual reasoning to support safe and interpretable clinical decisions. To address this gap, we propose MultiMedBench, the first benchmark tailored to
evaluating KE in clinical multimodal tasks. Our framework spans both understanding and reasoning task types, defines a three-dimensional metric suite (reliability, generality, and locality), and supports cross-paradigm comparisons across general and domain-specific models. We conduct extensive experiments under single-editing and lifelong-editing settings. Results sug
d1b90c63224140b7f396e6ef8658842307a34492.zh_title: MultiMedBench：医学视觉问答知识编辑评估基准
d1b90c63224140b7f396e6ef8658842307a34492.summary: 提出场景感知基准 MultiMedBench，用于评估多模态医学视觉问答中的知识编辑效果。
key_points: 知识编辑可免全量重训更新模型事实

d1b90c63224140b7f396e6ef8658842307a34492.zh_abstract: 知识编辑（Knowledge editing, KE）提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于在不进行完整重新训练的情况下更新大型语言模型中的事实性知识。尽管先前研究已在通用领域和医学问答（QA）任务中证明了有效性，但很少有人关注多模态医学场景中的 KE。与纯文本设置不同，医学 KE 要求将更新后的知识与视觉推理相结合，以支持安全且可解释的临床决策。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 MultiMedBench，这是首个专为评估临床多模态任务中的 KE 而设计的基准。我们的框架涵盖理解和推理任务类型，定义了一个三维指标套件（可靠性、通用性和局部性），并支持跨通用模型和领域特定模型的跨范式比较。我们在单次编辑和终身编辑设置下进行了广泛实验。结果 sug。

ce2c630edea818254ce622e4fbbdda49da79a9f5.title: VitalDiagnosis: AI-Driven Ecosystem for 24/7 Vital Monitoring and Chronic Disease Management
ce2c630edea818254ce622e4fbbdda49da79a9f5.abstract: Chronic diseases have become the leading cause of death worldwide, a challenge intensified by strained medical resources and an aging population. Individually, patients often struggle to interpret early signs of deterioration or maintain adherence to care plans. In this paper, we introduce VitalDiagnosis, an LLM-driven ecosystem designed to shift chronic disease management from passive monitoring to proactive, interactive engagement. By integrating continuous data from wearable devices with the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, the system addresses both acute health anomalies and routine adherence. It analyzes triggers through context-aware inquiries, produces provisional insights within a collaborative patient–clinician workflow, and offers personalized guidance. This approach aims to promote a more proactive and cooperative care paradigm, with the potential to enhance patient self-manage
ce2c630edea818254ce622e4fbbdda49da79a9f5.zh_title: VitalDiagnosis：LLM驱动的慢病全天候监测生态
ce2c630edea818254ce622e4fbbdda49da79a9f5.summary: AAAI 2026提出LLM驱动生态系统，融合可穿戴连续数据，将慢病管理从被动监测转为主动交互。

ce2c630edea818254ce622e4fbbdda49da79a9f5.zh_abstract: 慢性病已成为全球范围内的首要死因，而紧张的医疗资源和人口老龄化加剧了这一挑战。就个体而言，患者常常难以解读病情恶化的早期迹象，或难以维持对护理计划的依从性。在本文中，我们介绍 VitalDiagnosis，一个由 LLM 驱动的生态系统，旨在将慢性病管理从被动监测转变为主动、互动式参与。通过将来自可穿戴设备的连续数据与 LLM 的推理能力相结合，该系统可同时应对急性健康异常和日常依从性问题。它通过情境感知的询问分析触发因素，在患者—临床医生协作工作流程中产生临时性见解，并提供个性化指导。这种方法旨在促进一种更主动、更协作的护理范式，并具有增强患者自我管理的潜力。

ce14c0c394f23ab99f202065a818f393c6e89b4c.abstract: Deformable medical image registration is essential in medical image analyses. Recent transformer-based registration methods have achieved high registration accuracy. However, these methods often rely on patch embedding at the beginning of encoding, resulting in limited ability to capture detailed anatomical structural information in the images and explore local semantic relationships within individual patches. Here, we proposed a novel Dual-feet Encoder (DFEnc) to asynchronously model semantic information from moving and fixed images at various scales through two separate branches in three steps. For each step, features from adjacent resolution levels were processed by a Single Step Hybrid Extractor (SSHExt), which performed patch convolution to preserve local information, followed by several transformer blocks to capture global context. c495f4a47da2c2f5d1761aed267588719d0c8873.title: Domain-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Representation Learning for Protein Subcellular Localization Prediction
c495f4a47da2c2f5d1761aed267588719d0c8873.abstract: Protein subcellular localization prediction is essential for understanding protein function and cellular organization. However, existing methods exhibit two major limitations: (1) they overlook the critical role of evolutionarily conserved protein domains, which are fundamental functional and structural units that significantly influence functions and subcellular localization, and (2) they rarely learn residue order and backbone coordinates simultaneously, neglecting the complementary information inherent in multi-modal representations. In this paper, we propose a novel Domain-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Representation Learning for Protein Subcellular Localization prediction, named DMVCL. Firstly, it devises domain-sequence/structure attention modules, which identify functionally significant regions in protein structures/sequences that critically determine subcellular localization. b98f386ca52f08dc56d24ca4cabed6f3a17645ec.abstract: Modern public health data contains information about changes in disease dynamics that can have significant downstream benefits if these phenomena can be identified. However, systemic data quality issues hamper automated analysis of these vast data volumes, and there is now far too much data (3-4 million data points/day) for public health data experts to inspect manually as they may have done in the past. This interdisciplinary thesis addresses practical questions about large-scale data monitoring that impact public health data users and are also reflected in the larger public health community. b603098d3d5946e926db1437fcf8f88af3266e5d.title: Closer to Biological Mechanism: Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction from the Perspective of Pharmacophore
b603098d3d5946e926db1437fcf8f88af3266e5d.abstract: Drug combinations are widely used in modern medicine but may cause severe adverse drug reactions. Therefore, making effective drug-drug interactions (DDI) prediction is crucial for pharmacovigilance. Existing DDI prediction models are typically built from a structural perspective, assuming that drugs with similar molecular structures may exhibit similar interactions. However, such approaches overlook the biological mechanisms underlying DDI in the human body. This not only weakens the generalization ability of the model, but also makes its interpretability less convincing. Inspired by this, we propose a new method called PC-DDI. Unlike structure-based models, PC-DDI utilizes pharmacophores as basic unit, and designs a complete pharmacophore feature processing framework. b603098d3d5946e926db1437fcf8f88af3266e5d.zh_title: 从药效团视角预测药物相互作用

b3b0c17e9f9e290ac721458feeaa5f13ce154cea.title: Retriever Encoder Selection Matters for In-Context Learning-based Medical Segmentation
b3b0c17e9f9e290ac721458feeaa5f13ce154cea.abstract: In-context learning-based medical segmentation (ICLM) enables foundation models to generalize to unseen cases without retraining. To enhance performance on test queries, existing methods typically follow a two-stage process: (1) using a retrieval encoder (RE) to map both queries and training samples into a shared feature space, and (2) retrieving and utilizing the top-k most similar training samples. While current methods fix the RE and focus on optimizing stage (2), we show that the choice of RE in stage (1) alone can account for over 70% of the performance variation, highlighting RE selection as a critical yet often overlooked factor in ICLM. a952fc8dce8476339b62a45db159e648e9c94855.title: Wearable Intelligence for Healthcare Robotics: From Brain Activity to Body Movements
a952fc8dce8476339b62a45db159e648e9c94855.abstract: My research aims to pioneer efficient and reliable wearable intelligence algorithms that transform healthcare robotics into adaptive, patient-centered systems. I take a four-step approach: (1) design multimodal wearable sensing platforms to capture human and biometric signals; (2) train a foundation model that learns from these rich datasets to reason about human behaviors and health states; (3) validate the model through large-scale simulation and principled uncertainty quantification; and (4) deploy it in rehabilitation and assistive robots for intelligent, personalized care. This research not only advances fundamental understanding of multimodal human behavior, but also opens new pathways for early disease diagnosis, adaptive treatment, and accessible digital health. a34d7878b9270488d662780ef71c26d5c447dbff.title: Assessing LLMs for Serendipity Discovery in Knowledge Graphs: A Case for Drug Repurposing
a34d7878b9270488d662780ef71c26d5c447dbff.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have greatly advanced knowledge graph question answering (KGQA), yet existing systems are typically optimized for returning highly relevant but predictable answers. A missing yet desired capacity is to exploit LLMs to suggest surprise and novel ("serendipitious") answers. In this paper, we formally define the serendipity-aware KGQA task and propose the SerenQA framework to evaluate LLMs' ability to uncover unexpected insights in scientific KGQA tasks. SerenQA includes a rigorous serendipity metric based on relevance, novelty, and surprise, along with an expert-annotated benchmark derived from the Clinical Knowledge Graph for drug repurposing. Additionally, it features a structured evaluation pipeline encompassing three subtasks: knowledge retrieval, subgraph reasoning, and serendipity exploration. a1ac99f9155c9757496ff6b43aafe115a248e381.title: Universal EEG Epilepsy Detection via Evidential Multi-View De-Biasing
a1ac99f9155c9757496ff6b43aafe115a248e381.abstract: Epilepsy is a widespread neurological disorder characterized by highly patient-specific EEG patterns. Existing EEG-based seizure detection methods either train individualized models for each patient or adapt models pre-trained on known patients to new ones. However, when encountering previously unseen patients, these methods typically require retraining or fine-tuning, which limits their practical utility in clinical settings. This limitation can be linked to biases caused by patient-specific variations, which obscure the underlying pathological patterns of seizures. To address this, we propose an evidential multi-view framework that reinforces the learning of core epileptic features by promoting consistency across multiple views and reducing reliance on high-uncertainty, patient-specific segments. a110a24d0b17ad532531368105e03c840d0e3236.title: Efficient Transcoder Adaptation for Fine-Tuned Models: Revealing Medical Reasoning Mechanisms in Large Language Models
a110a24d0b17ad532531368105e03c840d0e3236.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a lack of decision-making transparency, limiting their deployment in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. We propose a mechanistic interpretability framework that introduces two novel paradigms: Medical Fine-Tuning with Frozen Attention Layers (FTFA) and Posterior Adaptation Transcoders (PAT). FTFA freezes attention layers while fine-tuning only feed-forward network (FFN) parameters, enabling PAT to efficiently adapt pre-trained transcoders on the same data. This approach achieves over 1000× efficiency improvement compared to training transcoders from scratch. a0f9f67f48f4f35cd375532b513a1ccd3b894e70.title: TWiST: Temporal Weakly-Supervised Triplets Recognition in Surgical Videos (Student Abstract)
a0f9f67f48f4f35cd375532b513a1ccd3b894e70.abstract:
Deep learning is increasingly applied to intraoperative and
surgical video analysis to enable real-time workflow
recognition, and decision support for improved surgical
precision. A key direction is modeling surgical activity as
triplets of instrument, action, and target, which provide a
richer representation of procedures. However, existing
approaches often depend on bounding-box annotations or lack
temporal context. We propose TWiST (Temporal Weakly
Supervised Triplet detection), a framework that combines
weakly supervised instrument localization, temporal
attention for triplet prediction, and grounding of triplets
with detected instruments. Our experiments show that TWiST
outperforms prior weakly supervised baselines.

现有方法依赖边界框标注、缺乏时序上下文
TWiST使用时序弱监督进行三元组检测
a0f9f67f48f4f35cd375532b513a1ccd3b894e70.zh_abstract: 深度学习越来越多地应用于术中与手术视频分析，以实现实时工作流程识别和决策支持，从而提高手术精准度。一个关键方向是将手术活动建模为器械、动作和目标的三元组，这能提供对手术过程更丰富的表示。然而，现有方法往往依赖边界框标注或缺乏时间上下文。我们提出 TWiST（Temporal Weakly Supervised Triplet detection，时间弱监督三元组检测），一个结合弱监督器械定位、用于三元组预测的时间注意力，以及将三元组锚定到检测到的器械的框架。我们的实验表明，TWiST 优于先前的弱监督基线。

98a90e7d070bcf69c2325a27e45340dc83e73da3.title: Risk-Aware Bilingual Spoken Dialogue for Campus Mental Health Support
98a90e7d070bcf69c2325a27e45340dc83e73da3.abstract: This work presented a web-based system which introduces an active-listening strategy in a spoken dialogue for self-disclosure to support mental health of a campus user. To enhance the system usability and safety, this demo is developed to conduct the bilingual (Mandarin/English) spoken dialogue where a high-risk dialogue detection during speech interaction is reliably augmented. In particular, a prompt-driven GPT classifier identifies the utterances indicating self-harm or suicide intent and triggers safety alerts with help center and counselor notification. We also integrate a TTS module for Taiwanese Mandarin and standard English, and redesign the user interface to automatically pop up alert messages when high-risk dialogue is detected. In addition, we collect speech data under diverse mental dialogue scenarios with bilingual speech to enable system analysis, evaluation and refinement.
98a90e7d070bcf69c2325a27e45340dc83e73da3.zh_title: 校园心理健康支持的风险感知双语语音对话系统
98a90e7d070bcf69c2325a27e45340dc83e73da3.summary: 构建基于网页的中英双语语音对话系统，采用主动倾听策略促进自我表露，并用GPT分类器识别自伤或自杀意图。
key_points: 面向校园用户心理健康的语音对话系统
采用主动倾听策略支持自我表露
提示驱动的GPT分类器检测高风险表述
98a90e7d070bcf69c2325a27e45340dc83e73da3.zh_abstract: 本工作提出了一个基于网络的系统，该系统在用于自我披露的口语对话中引入主动倾听（active-listening）策略，以支持校园用户的心理健康。为提升系统可用性和安全性，本演示被开发用于进行双语（普通话/英语）口语对话，其中语音交互过程中的高风险对话检测得到可靠增强。具体而言，一个提示驱动（prompt-driven）的 GPT 分类器识别表明自伤或自杀意图的话语，并触发安全警报，同时通知帮助中心和咨询师。我们还集成了面向台湾普通话和标准英语的 TTS 模块，并重新设计用户界面，以便在检测到高风险对话时自动弹出警报消息。此外，我们收集了双语语音下多样心理健康对话场景的语音数据，以支持系统分析、评估和改进。

9739e64bcd806faa24b5f7b8f0a1ced2c282aa28.title: Can Large Language Models Grasp 3D Medical Anatomy Shapes? (Student Abstract)
9739e64bcd806faa24b5f7b8f0a1ced2c282aa28.abstract: What if the next generation of human-computer interaction is not a screen... but a conversation? Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a new paradigm for interacting with computers through text, but they lack shape reasoning capabilities. We introduce Textual Anatomy Encoding (TAE), a workflow that connects LLMs with 3D anatomies. TAE employs clinician-validated semantic annotations and rule-based prompts to achieve deterministic and interpretable landmark localization. The results indicate that TAE enables LLMs to move beyond textual knowledge, achieving an accurate understanding of anatomical localization. This framework opens opportunities for diagnosis, surgical planning, and scalable medical annotation, positioning LLMs as a foundation for next-generation human–computer interaction in healthcare.
9739e64bcd806faa24b5f7b8f0a1ced2c282aa28.zh_title: 大模型能否理解三维医学解剖形状？
9739e64bcd806faa24b5f7b8f0a1ced2c282aa28.summary: AAAI 2026学生摘要提出文本化解剖编码TAE，以临床验证的语义标注和规则提示实现确定、可解释的关键点定位。
key_points: LLM缺乏形状推理能力
TAE连接LLM与三维解剖结构
定位结果确定且可解释

9693fd38a4e6d4095a6b9f5380eabdfde111a1da.title: MentalGuide: Towards Multi-Turn, State-Aware and Strategy-Driven Conversations for Mental Health Support
9693fd38a4e6d4095a6b9f5380eabdfde111a1da.abstract: The global shortage of psychiatrists has become a critical issue, and the advent of large language models (LLMs) presents new opportunities to address this challenge. However, existing approaches continue to underperform in multi-turn mental health counseling, particularly in the arrangement of counseling strategies. To overcome these limitations, we propose MentalGuide, a state-aware and strategy-driven conversation framework designed for multi-turn mental health support. Our method integrates expert-derived prior probabilities of counseling strategies tailored to the target client's state with the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. This enables effective strategy formulation and strategy-driven response generation, without the need for additional training. Experimental results show that MentalGuide surpasses baselines in automated and human expert evaluations, demonstrating the closest al
9693fd38a4e6d4095a6b9f5380eabdfde111a1da.zh_title: MentalGuide：状态感知与策略驱动的心理健康对话
9693fd38a4e6d4095a6b9f5380eabdfde111a1da.summary: AAAI 2026提出状态感知、策略驱动的对话框架MentalGuide，用于多轮心理健康支持，回应精神科医生短缺问题。
key_points: 全球精神科医生短缺问题突出
现有多轮咨询策略安排不足
框架实现状态感知与策略驱动
9693fd38a4e6d4095a6b9f5380eabdfde111a1da.zh_abstract: 精神科医生的全球短缺已成为一个关键问题，而大语言模型（LLMs）的出现为应对这一挑战提供了新机会。然而，现有方法在多轮心理健康咨询中仍表现不佳，尤其是在咨询策略的安排方面。为克服这些局限，我们提出 MentalGuide，一个面向多轮心理健康支持的状态感知且策略驱动的对话框架。我们的方法将针对目标来访者状态定制的咨询策略专家推导先验概率与 LLMs 的推理能力相结合。这使得无需额外训练即可进行有效的策略制定和策略驱动的回应生成。实验结果表明，MentalGuide 在自动评估和人类专家评估中均优于基线，表现出最接近的 al

91ec875ad11f43593c7abe99ec231cf7c763fa3d.title: ParseCaps: An Interpretable Parsing Capsule Network for Medical Image Diagnosis
91ec875ad11f43593c7abe99ec231cf7c763fa3d.abstract:
Deep learning has excelled in medical image classification, 
but its clinical application is limited by poor interpretability. 
Capsule networks, known for encoding hierarchical relationships and spatial features, 
show potential in addressing this issue. 
Nevertheless, traditional capsule networks often underperform due to their shallow structures, 
and deeper variants lack hierarchical architectures, thereby compromising interpretability. 
This paper introduces a novel capsule network, ParseCaps, 
which utilizes the sparse axial attention routing and parse convolutional capsule layer to form a parse-tree-like structure, 
enhancing both depth and interpretability.

as well as emphasizes the weight distribution across instantiation parameters of parent capsules.

91ec875ad11f43593c7abe99ec231cf7c763fa3d.zh_title: ParseCaps：面向医学图像诊断的可解释解析胶囊网络
91ec875ad11f43593c7abe99ec231cf7c763fa3d.summary: 提出可解释的解析胶囊网络 ParseCaps，缓解医学图像分类中深度模型可解释性不足的问题，发表于 AAAI 2025。
key_points: 传统胶囊网络浅层导致性能受限
深层变体缺乏层级结构影响可解释性
提出 ParseCaps 兼顾性能与可解释性
91ec875ad11f43593c7abe99ec231cf7c763fa3d.zh_abstract: 深度学习在医学图像分类中表现出色，但其临床应用因可解释性差而受到限制。胶囊网络（Capsule networks）以编码层级关系和空间特征而闻名，在解决这一问题方面显示出潜力。然而，传统胶囊网络由于其浅层结构往往表现不佳，而更深的变体缺乏层级架构，从而损害了可解释性。本文介绍了一种新颖的胶囊网络 ParseCaps，它利用稀疏轴向注意力路由（sparse axial attention routing）和解析卷积胶囊层（parse convolutional capsule layer）形成类似解析树的结构，同时提升深度和可解释性。首先，稀疏轴向注意力路由优化子胶囊与父胶囊之间的连接，并强调父胶囊实例化参数上的权重分布。其次，解析卷积。

8ddbbde539132e38facc8cb1d011f9fbe87c8963.title: DualFete: Revisiting Teacher-Student Interactions from a Feedback Perspective for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
8ddbbde539132e38facc8cb1d011f9fbe87c8963.abstract: The teacher-student paradigm has emerged as a canonical framework in semi-supervised learning. When applied to medical image segmentation, the paradigm faces challenges due to inherent image ambiguities, making it particularly vulnerable to erroneous supervision. Crucially, the student's iterative reconfirmation of these errors leads to self-reinforcing bias. While some studies attempt to mitigate this bias, they often rely on external modifications to the conventional teacher-student framework, overlooking its intrinsic potential for error correction. In response, this work introduces a feedback mechanism into the teacher-student framework to counteract error reconfirmations. Here, the student provides feedback on the changes induced by the teacher's pseudo-labels, enabling the teacher to refine these labels accordingly. We specify that this interaction hinges on two key components: the
8ddbbde539132e38facc8cb1d011f9fbe87c8963.zh_title: DualFete：半监督医学图像分割的师生反馈视角
8ddbbde539132e38facc8cb1d011f9fbe87c8963.summary: AAAI 2026从反馈视角重新审视师生交互，缓解半监督医学图像分割中的自强化偏差。
key_points: 师生范式是半监督学习经典框架
图像模糊易致错误监督
学生迭代确认错误形成自强化偏差
8ddbbde539132e38facc8cb1d011f9fbe87c8963.zh_abstract: 教师-学生范式已成为半监督学习中的一种经典框架。当应用于医学图像分割时，该范式由于图像固有的歧义而面临挑战，使其特别容易受到错误监督的影响。关键的是，学生对这些错误的迭代式再确认会导致自我强化的偏差。虽然一些研究试图减轻这种偏差，但它们往往依赖对传统教师-学生框架的外部修改，忽视了其内在的纠错潜力。作为回应，本工作将一种反馈机制引入教师-学生框架，以抵消错误的再确认。在这里，学生对教师伪标签引起的变化提供反馈，使教师能够相应地细化这些标签。我们明确指出，这种交互取决于两个关键组成部分：the

8ba84947029eb6c58031768ed2d3fbfb251fc37c.title: VietCheckMed: Explainable Regulatory Compliance Checking for Medical Advertisements on Vietnamese Social Media
8ba84947029eb6c58031768ed2d3fbfb251fc37c.abstract: Regulatory compliance checking for online medical advertisements poses a critical public safety challenge distinct from traditional fact-checking, particularly in low-resource languages. Existing automated systems are ill-suited for the authorization-based, evidence-grounded, and explainable reasoning this task demands. To address this gap, we introduce VietCheckMed, a novel retrieval-augmented framework, and VietAestheticAds, the first large-scale, expert-validated benchmark for this task, comprising 8,329 advertisements paired with an authoritative regulatory corpus of 9,978 facilities. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our evidence-grounded approach is essential, substantially outperforming powerful unassisted LLM baselines by over 0.3805 F1-score. A detailed analysis reveals that the primary remaining challenges are nuanced failures in semantic and logical reasoning, definin
8ba84947029eb6c58031768ed2d3fbfb251fc37c.zh_title: VietCheckMed：越南社媒医疗广告合规检查
8ba84947029eb6c58031768ed2d3fbfb251fc37c.summary: 提出检索增强框架VietCheckMed及首个专家验证基准，用于越南社交媒体医疗广告合规检查。
key_points: 医疗广告合规检查不同于事实核查
提出检索增强框架VietCheckMed
发布专家验证基准VietAestheticAds
8ba84947029eb6c58031768ed2d3fbfb251fc37c.zh_abstract: 在线医疗广告的监管合规检查构成一项关键的公共安全挑战，不同于传统的事实核查，尤其是在低资源语言中。现有自动化系统不适合该任务所需的基于授权、以证据为基础且可解释的推理。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 VietCheckMed，一种新颖的检索增强框架，以及 VietAestheticAds，这是该任务的首个大规模、经专家验证的基准，包含 8,329 条广告，并配有一个包含 9,978 家机构的权威监管语料库。综合实验表明，我们以证据为基础的方法是必要的，其显著优于强大的无辅助 LLM 基线，F1 分数高出超过 0.3805。详细分析显示，剩余的主要挑战是语义和逻辑推理中的细微失败，定义

88d273360e77dd8efbaffc7f58aa69e5e757f1e3.title: VEDA: 3D Molecular Generation via Variance-Exploding Diffusion with Annealing
88d273360e77dd8efbaffc7f58aa69e5e757f1e3.abstract:
Diffusion models show promise for 3D molecular generation, but face a fundamental trade-off between sampling efficiency and conformational accuracy. While flow-based models are fast, they often produce geometrically inaccurate structures, as they have difficulty capturing the multimodal distributions of molecular conformations. In contrast, denoising diffusion models are more accurate but suffer from slow sampling, a limitation attributed to sub-optimal integration between diffusion dynamics and SE(3)‑equivariant architectures. 
To address this, we propose VEDA, a unified SE(3)-equivariant framework that combines variance-exploding diffusion with annealing to efficiently generate conformationally accurate 3D molecular structures. Specifically, our key technical contributions include: (1) a VE schedule that enables noise injection functionally analogous to simulated annealing, improving 3
88d273360e77dd8efbaffc7f58aa69e5e757f1e3.zh_title: VEDA：方差爆炸扩散与退火的3D分子生成
88d273360e77dd8efbaffc7f58aa69e5e757f1e3.summary: 针对扩散模型采样效率与构象精度权衡，提出方差爆炸扩散结合退火的3D分子生成方法。
key_points: 指出现有方法在效率与几何精度间取舍
流模型快但难捕捉多峰构象分布
提出方差爆炸扩散配退火策略
88d273360e77dd8efbaffc7f58aa69e5e757f1e3.zh_abstract: 扩散模型在 3D 分子生成方面展现出前景，但面临采样效率与构象准确性之间的根本性权衡。虽然基于流的模型速度快，但它们常常产生几何上不准确的结构，因为它们难以捕捉分子构象的多模态分布。相比之下，去噪扩散模型更准确，但采样速度慢，这一局限被归因于扩散动力学与 SE(3)-等变架构之间的次优整合。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 VEDA，一个统一的 SE(3)-等变框架，它将方差爆炸扩散（variance-exploding diffusion）与退火相结合，以高效生成构象准确的 3D 分子结构。具体而言，我们的关键技术贡献包括：(1) 一种 VE 调度，使噪声注入在功能上类似于模拟退火，改善 3。

844e3e87701a03cdfcf3e37a9f4a1e723b53b61c.title: TraceTrans: Translation and Spatial Tracing for Surgical Prediction
844e3e87701a03cdfcf3e37a9f4a1e723b53b61c.abstract: Image-to-image translation models have achieved notable success in converting images across visual domains and are increasingly used for medical tasks such as predicting post-operative outcomes and modeling disease progression. However, most existing methods primarily aim to match the target distribution and often neglect spatial correspondences between the source and translated images. This limitation can lead to structural inconsistencies and hallucinations, undermining the reliability and interpretability of the predictions. These challenges are accentuated in clinical applications by the stringent requirement for anatomical accuracy. In this work, we present TraceTrans, a novel deformable image translation model designed for post-operative prediction that generates images aligned with the target distribution while explicitly revealing spatial correspondences with the pre-operative in
844e3e87701a03cdfcf3e37a9f4a1e723b53b61c.zh_title: TraceTrans：面向手术预测的翻译与空间追踪
844e3e87701a03cdfcf3e37a9f4a1e723b53b61c.summary: 针对图像翻译忽视源图与译图空间对应的问题，提出兼顾翻译与空间追踪的方法以用于手术预测。
key_points: 现有图像翻译方法多忽略空间对应关系
结构不一致与幻觉削弱可靠性
方法面向术后结果与疾病进展预测
844e3e87701a03cdfcf3e37a9f4a1e723b53b61c.zh_abstract: 图像到图像的翻译模型在跨视觉域转换图像方面已取得显著成功，并越来越多地用于医学任务，例如预测术后结局和建模疾病进展。然而，大多数现有方法主要旨在匹配目标分布，往往忽略源图像与翻译图像之间的空间对应关系。这一局限可能导致结构不一致和幻觉，削弱预测的可靠性和可解释性。在临床应用中，对解剖准确性的严格要求使这些挑战更加突出。在这项工作中，我们提出 TraceTrans，一种新颖的可变形图像翻译模型，专为术后预测设计，它生成与目标分布对齐的图像，同时明确揭示与术前输入（pre-operative in...）的空间对应关系。

813897b1e2d52f52d22bb47b6559bd03fcfc161a.title: MIRA: Evaluating Multimodal AI on Complex Clinical Reasoning in Interventional Radiology
813897b1e2d52f52d22bb47b6559bd03fcfc161a.abstract: We present MIRA (Multimodal Interventional RAdiology evaluation), a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models in expert-level interventional radiology tasks requiring specialized domain knowledge and advanced visual reasoning capabilities. Unlike existing medical benchmarks that primarily provide binary labels without contextual depth, MIRA offers diverse question formats, including open-ended, closed-ended, single-choice, and multiple-choice categories, each accompanied by detailed expert-validated explanations. The benchmark incorporates approximately 184K high-quality medical images spanning multiple imaging modalities with 1.2M meticulously generated question-answer pairs across various anatomical regions. These pairs were created through a sophisticated cascade methodology involving expert interventional radiologists at both the data collection and validation st
813897b1e2d52f52d22bb47b6559bd03fcfc161a.zh_title: MIRA：介入放射学多模态临床推理基准
813897b1e2d52f52d22bb47b6559bd03fcfc161a.summary: 提出MIRA基准，用于评估大型多模态模型在介入放射学专家级临床推理任务中的表现。
key_points: 评估多模态模型介入放射学推理
提供多种题型与上下文
区别于仅二分类的医学基准
813897b1e2d52f52d22bb47b6559bd03fcfc161a.zh_abstract: 我们提出 MIRA（Multimodal Interventional RAdiology evaluation，多模态介入放射学评估），这是一个综合性基准测试，用于在需要专业领域知识与高级视觉推理能力的专家级介入放射学任务中评估大型多模态模型。与现有主要提供二元标签、缺乏语境深度的医学基准测试不同，MIRA 提供多样化的问题形式，包括开放式、封闭式、单选题和多选题类别，每类均配有经专家验证的详细解释。该基准测试纳入约 184K 幅高质量医学图像，涵盖多种成像模态，并包含 1.2M 条精心生成的问答对，覆盖多个解剖区域。这些问答对通过一套复杂的级联方法生成，介入放射学专家在数据收集与验证阶段均参与其中

804339456b88d8f5fa21b7fa1f74d9cb93b1018a.title: Rescind: Countering Image Misconduct in Biomedical Publications with Vision-Language and State-Space Modeling
804339456b88d8f5fa21b7fa1f74d9cb93b1018a.abstract: Scientific image manipulation in biomedical publications poses a growing threat to research integrity and reproducibility. Unlike natural image forensics, biomedical forgery detection is uniquely challenging due to domain-specific artifacts, complex textures, and unstructured figure layouts. We present the first vision-language guided framework for both generating and detecting biomedical image forgeries. By combining diffusion-based synthesis with vision-language prompting, our method enables realistic and semantically controlled manipulations—including duplication, splicing, and region removal—across diverse biomedical modalities. 804339456b88d8f5fa21b7fa1f74d9cb93b1018a.zh_title: Rescind：视觉语言与状态空间建模检测生物医学图像不端
804339456b88d8f5fa21b7fa1f74d9cb93b1018a.summary: 提出首个视觉语言引导框架，用于生成与检测生物医学出版物中的图像伪造。
key_points: 针对生物医学图像伪造检测
结合扩散合成与视觉语言提示

804339456b88d8f5fa21b7fa1f74d9cb93b1018a.zh_abstract: 生物医学出版物中的科学图像操纵对研究诚信和可重复性构成日益严重的威胁。与自然图像取证不同，生物医学伪造检测由于领域特定的伪影、复杂纹理和非结构化图像布局而具有独特挑战性。我们提出了首个视觉-语言引导框架，用于生成和检测生物医学图像伪造。通过将基于扩散的合成与视觉-语言提示相结合，我们的方法能够在多种生物医学模态中实现真实且语义可控的操纵——包括复制、拼接和区域去除。我们引入 Rescind，这是一个大规模基准，具有细粒度标注和模态特定划分，并提出 Integscan，一种结构化状态空间建模框架，它将注意力增强的视觉编码与提示条件化的语义（semant...）相结合。

80081c2a4984fea5d3eb79ceedf0035e4caeb31d.title: HINPool: A Unified Heterogeneous Graph Pooling Framework for Accurate Molecular and Protein Property Prediction
80081c2a4984fea5d3eb79ceedf0035e4caeb31d.abstract: Graph pooling has gained significant progress in recent years as an effective solution for graph-level property classification tasks. With the emergence of research on Heterogeneous Information Networks (HINs), this paper argues that graph-level datasets for graph classification should be treated as HINs rather than homogeneous graphs to enhance information aggregation. We propose HINPool, a novel and general graph pooling framework for graph-level property classification with HINs. First, we devise a systematic HIN construction procedure from the original data to capture complex interactions. Next, we introduce a type-aware heterogeneous graph pooling method featuring a Type-Aware Selector (TAS) to select essential nodes and a Readout Aggregator (RA) to fuse critical information into a graph-level representation. Finally, a cross-layer fusion function is applied to combine the output em
80081c2a4984fea5d3eb79ceedf0035e4caeb31d.zh_title: HINPool：异构图表池化框架预测分子与蛋白性质
80081c2a4984fea5d3eb79ceedf0035e4caeb31d.summary: 提出统一异构信息网络图池化框架 HINPool，用于图级分子与蛋白质性质预测。

面向分子与蛋白质性质预测
80081c2a4984fea5d3eb79ceedf0035e4caeb31d.zh_abstract: 近年来，图池化作为图级属性分类任务的一种有效解决方案取得了显著进展。随着异构信息网络（Heterogeneous Information Networks, HINs）研究的出现，本文认为用于图分类的图级数据集应被视为 HINs 而非同构图，以增强信息聚合。我们提出 HINPool，一种新颖且通用的图池化框架，用于 HINs 的图级属性分类。首先，我们设计了一个从原始数据出发的系统化 HIN 构建流程，以捕捉复杂交互。接下来，我们引入一种类型感知的异构图池化方法，其特点是使用类型感知选择器（Type-Aware Selector, TAS）选择关键节点，并使用读出聚合器（Readout Aggregator, RA）将关键信息融合为图级表示。最后，应用跨层融合函数来组合输出嵌入（output em...）。

7fe1ea8a93dff72b7f835950487a805b2aac037d.abstract: We present iDT-diet, an intelligent digital twin prototype designed to model the long-term influence of diet quality on health biomarkers and chronic conditions. The system integrates three novel components: (i) a random forest learning model enhanced with Choquet LASSO feature selection for capturing complex, nonlinear interactions in temporal health data; (ii) a translation module that converts predictive outputs into natural language narratives of physical and biomarker states; and (iii) a generative 3D visualization engine that produces dynamic, personalized digital twins reflecting evolving health trajectories. This integration uniquely links advanced machine learning, interpretable communication, and immersive visualization within a single framework. 7fe1ea8a93dff72b7f835950487a805b2aac037d.zh_title: iDT-diet：面向个性化健康预测的数字孪生模型

7fdcdd82945fd9b09b96d979b589d80939121915.title: DCMM-Transformer: Degree-Corrected Mixed-Membership Attention for Medical Imaging
7fdcdd82945fd9b09b96d979b589d80939121915.abstract:
Medical images exhibit latent anatomical groupings, such as organs, tissues, and pathological regions, that standard Vision Transformers (ViTs) fail to exploit.
While recent work like SBM-Transformer attempts to incorporate such structures through stochastic binary masking, they suffer from non-differentiability, training instability, and the inability to model complex community structure. 
We present DCMM-Transformer, a novel ViT architecture for medical image analysis that incorporates a Degree-Corrected Mixed-Membership (DCMM) model as an additive bias in self-attention. Unlike prior approaches that rely on multiplicative masking and binary sampling, our method introduces community structure and degree heterogeneity in a fully differentiable and interpretable manner.

7fdcdd82945fd9b09b96d979b589d80939121915.zh_title: DCMM-Transformer：度校正混合成员注意力用于医学影像
7fdcdd82945fd9b09b96d979b589d80939121915.summary: 提出引入度校正混合成员注意力的ViT架构，以利用医学影像中器官、组织与病灶等潜在解剖分组结构。
key_points: 标准ViT未利用潜在解剖分组结构

7fdcdd82945fd9b09b96d979b589d80939121915.zh_abstract: 医学图像表现出潜在的解剖学分组，例如器官、组织和病理区域，而标准 Vision Transformer（ViTs）未能利用这些分组。虽然近期如 SBM-Transformer 的工作试图通过随机二值掩码纳入此类结构，但它们存在不可微、训练不稳定以及无法建模复杂社区结构的问题。我们提出 DCMM-Transformer，一种用于医学图像分析的新型 ViT 架构，它将度校正混合隶属度（Degree-Corrected Mixed-Membership, DCMM）模型作为自注意力中的加性偏置纳入。与依赖乘性掩码和二值采样的先前方法不同，我们的方法以完全可微且可解释的方式引入社区结构和度异质性。在包括脑、胸部、乳腺和眼部模态（ocular modaliti）的多种医学图像数据集上的综合实验

7ec5702aade89b658e2b7a7d0ba5c1699349b8cf.title: Prediction of Hospital Associated Infections During Continuous Hospital Stays
7ec5702aade89b658e2b7a7d0ba5c1699349b8cf.abstract: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in 2019, designated Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) as a serious antimicrobial resistance threat. The risk of acquiring MRSA and suffering life-threatening consequences due to it remains especially high for hospitalized patients due to a unique combination of factors, including: co-morbid conditions, immuno suppression, antibiotic use, and risk of contact with contaminated hospital workers and equipment. In this paper, we present a novel generative probabilistic model, GenHAI, for modeling sequences of MRSA test results outcomes for patients during a single hospitalization. This model can be used to answer many important questions from the perspectives of hospital administrators for mitigating the risk of MRSA infections. 7ec5702aade89b658e2b7a7d0ba5c1699349b8cf.zh_title: 连续住院期间医院相关感染的预测
7ec5702aade89b658e2b7a7d0ba5c1699349b8cf.summary: 针对住院患者MRSA等医院相关感染风险，构建连续住院期间的感染预测模型。

7c2a0b5473a6f9ec027725301957816e2e8852b4.title: LLM-Based Agent for Competitive Landscape Mapping in Drug Asset Due Diligence
7c2a0b5473a6f9ec027725301957816e2e8852b4.abstract: In this paper, we describe and benchmark a competitor-discovery component used within an agentic AI system for fast drug asset due diligence. A competitor-discovery AI agent, given an indication, retrieves all drugs comprising the competitive landscape of that indication and extracts canonical attributes for these drugs. The competitor definition is investor-specific, and data is paywalled/licensed, fragmented across registries, ontology-mismatched by indication, alias-heavy for drug names, multimodal, and rapidly changing. Although considered the best tool for this problem, the current LLM-based AI systems aren’t capable of reliably retrieving all competing drug names, and there is no accepted public benchmark for this task. 7876ab27f7344fb95327d88b8127dfc4de4ce19e.title: KOALA: Knowledge of Optimization and Learning Algorithms for Healthcare
7876ab27f7344fb95327d88b8127dfc4de4ce19e.abstract: The Knowledge of Optimization And Learning Algorithms (KOALA) group studies how to integrate optimization, machine learning, and generative modeling to enable data-driven decision-making under uncertainty. We study decision-focused learning, embedding optimization as a differentiable layer to train models end-to-end for decision quality. We design scalable reinforcement learning algorithms for population and personalized healthcare, and develop efficient bilevel optimization methods for nested and multi-agent decision-making. These directions form a unified framework linking optimization and learning for impactful AI in healthcare. Through collaborations with hospitals and NGOs, our group designs and deploys algorithms for pediatric, diabetes, maternal, and mental health applications. We consider the conditional generation of 3D drug-like molecules with explicit control over molecular properties 
such as drug-like properties (e.g., Quantitative Estimate of Druglikeness or Synthetic Accessibility score) and effectively binding to specific protein sites.

Our model ensures explicit control over these molecular attributes while maintaining equivariance of coordinate representation and invariance of data likelihood.

74db351b9ed24ade9db16b4167774b211fa0afab.title: Energy-guided Dual Domain-invariant Prompting Framework with Fourier Regularization for Generalized Few-Shot Medical Segmentation
74db351b9ed24ade9db16b4167774b211fa0afab.abstract: Precise segmentation of organ and tissue lesions is essential for clinical diagnosis and treatment. Despite the progress of deep learning and foundation segmentation models, their domain generalization capability remains limited particularly when dealing with cross-domain scenarios or unseen data, leading to significant performance degradation. Current medical SAM-based generalization methods face two primary challenges: First, existing prompt-tuning strategies inadequately capture key domain-invariant features; Second, the reliance on fully labeled source domain data is unrealistic in clinical practice. 74a19fa7dab173e499b80e42a6ff06151a71284a.abstract:
Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging is widely used to characterize cardiac morphology and function. To accelerate CMR imaging, various methods have been proposed to recover high-quality spatiotemporal CMR images from highly undersampled k-t space data. 6be8903faec547acd03f7ed28daee34a9f99e513.abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving model training across distributed Electronic Health Records (EHRs), but its deployment remains limited by data-view heterogeneity, where institutions maintain incompatible local schemas. Most existing methods address this by enforcing flat, aligned data views, which require extensive cross-site preprocessing and manual harmonisation that often discards client-specific features, or by projecting inputs into a shared latent space, which sacrifices interpretability. We propose a modelling shift from conventional FL with vectorised inputs to a symbolic, relation-centric framework, where each client organises its EHR data as a structured, type-aware relational graph. 6be8903faec547acd03f7ed28daee34a9f99e513.zh_title: 异构数据视图下的神经符号联邦电子病历建模
6be8903faec547acd03f7ed28daee34a9f99e513.summary: 提出神经符号联邦学习方法，应对机构间电子病历数据视图异构，实现隐私保护下的分布式建模。

避免强制对齐造成特征丢弃
联邦学习保护隐私
6be8903faec547acd03f7ed28daee34a9f99e513.zh_abstract: 联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）能够跨分布式电子健康记录（Electronic Health Records, EHR）进行隐私保护模型训练，但其部署仍受限于数据视图异质性，即各机构维护互不兼容的本地模式。多数现有方法通过强制采用扁平、对齐的数据视图来解决该问题，这需要大量跨站点预处理和人工协调，且常常丢弃客户端特有特征；或通过将输入投影到共享潜在空间，但这牺牲了可解释性。我们提出一种建模范式转变，从使用向量化输入的传统 FL 转向符号化、以关系为中心的框架，其中每个客户端将其 EHR 数据组织为结构化、类型感知的关系图。这使客户端特异性推理无需模式对齐，并支持跨异质数据视图的 FL。为在这些符号结构上进行建模，我们引入一个

68e07da6392ac2fef989256035295c3eaa2ba7e3.title: EgoEMS: A High-Fidelity Multimodal Egocentric Dataset for Cognitive Assistance in Emergency Medical Services
68e07da6392ac2fef989256035295c3eaa2ba7e3.abstract: Emergency Medical Services (EMS) are critical to patient survival in emergencies, but first responders often face intense cognitive demands in high-stakes situations. AI cognitive assistants, acting as virtual partners, have the potential to ease this burden by supporting real-time data collection and decision making. In pursuit of this vision, we introduce EgoEMS, the first end-to-end, high-fidelity, multimodal, multiperson dataset capturing over 20 hours of realistic, procedural EMS activities from an egocentric view in 233 simulated emergency scenarios performed by 62 participants, including 46 EMS professionals. 68e07da6392ac2fef989256035295c3eaa2ba7e3.summary: 发布EgoEMS多模态第一视角数据集，含超20小时急救医疗服务活动，支持AI认知辅助。

63693dda9eddd3e4c9f36781cd9da41decb723c2.abstract: Recently, Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) has gained increasing attention in medical imaging due to its ability to improve model generalization under domain shifts without retraining. In particular, directly applying a well-trained model across various medical centers faces significant performance degradation caused by variations in equipment, operators, imaging conditions, and scanning skill levels of sonographers. Existing TTA methods either rely on parameter adaptation that increases computational cost or apply simple prediction fusion that ignores anatomical structure knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose a novel backward-free Topology-aware TTA framework named T^3 that integrates Structural Perception Modeling (SPM) and Box Regression Adaptation (BRA). 63693dda9eddd3e4c9f36781cd9da41decb723c2.zh_title: 拓扑启发的医学检测无反向传播测试时自适应框架
63693dda9eddd3e4c9f36781cd9da41decb723c2.summary: 提出受拓扑启发的无反向传播测试时自适应框架，在无需重训练的前提下缓解医学检测模型跨中心部署的性能下降。

621bb6e264a62a26bec2ecc42522619ddfdf8db9.title: Benchmarking Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for ICU Ventilator Settings: An Interpretable and Probabilistic Patient Environment for Doctor Agents
621bb6e264a62a26bec2ecc42522619ddfdf8db9.abstract: Mechanical ventilation is essential in intensive care units (ICUs), but prolonged use increases patient risk. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers potential for optimizing ventilator management, yet its clinical adoption is limited by the lack of interpretable and realistic simulation environments. We propose an interpretable and probabilistic patient environment simulator based on action-based k-nearest neighbors and empirical transition probabilities, modeling stochastic state transitions grounded in real ICU data (MIMIC-IV and eICU). The simulator supports anomaly detection and provides probabilistic next-state distributions to enhance transparency and safety. Within this environment, we benchmark seven offline RL algorithms under clinically guided reward designs, including five distinct reward function configurations to explore the impact of reward shaping on agent behavior. 621bb6e264a62a26bec2ecc42522619ddfdf8db9.zh_abstract: 机械通气在重症监护病房（ICU）中至关重要，但长期使用会增加患者风险。强化学习（RL）为优化呼吸机管理提供了潜力，然而其临床采用受限于缺乏可解释且逼真的仿真环境。我们提出一种可解释的概率性患者环境模拟器，基于动作的k近邻和经验转移概率，对以真实ICU数据（MIMIC-IV和eICU）为基础的随机状态转移进行建模。该模拟器支持异常检测，并提供概率性下一状态分布，以增强透明性和安全性。在此环境中，我们在临床指导的奖励设计下对七种离线RL算法进行基准测试，包括五种不同的奖励函数配置，以探索奖励塑形对智能体行为的影响。我们的结果

5ffe48054e7a811b9b8b594a5b96b94167bd7a23.abstract: Missense mutations could affect the Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation (LLPS) propensity of proteins and lead to aberrant phase-separating behaviours, which are recently found to be associated with many diseases including Alzheimer's and cancer. However, the regulatory role of mutations in LLPS remains unclear due to challenges in accurately characterizing the LLPS ability of mutants, including the high similarity in features, lack of labeled data, and vast amounts of data involved. To bridge this gap and facilitate the discovery of therapeutic strategies, we propose the first machine learning-based guider for protein phase-separating behaviour alteration, PScalpel. 55b65acbac0d163f7aa15f3ff62fd61662b0c813.title: REACT-LLM: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Integration with Causal Features in Clinical Prognostic Tasks
55b65acbac0d163f7aa15f3ff62fd61662b0c813.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and causal learning each hold strong potential for clinical decision making (CDM). However, their synergy remains poorly understood, largely due to the lack of systematic benchmarks evaluating their integration in clinical risk prediction. In real-world healthcare, identifying features with causal influence on outcomes is crucial for actionable and trustworthy predictions. While recent work highlights LLMs' emerging causal reasoning abilities, there lacks comprehensive benchmarks to assess their causal learning and performance informed by causal features in clinical risk prediction. To address this, we introduce REACT-LLM, a benchmark designed to evaluate whether combining LLMs with causal features can enhance clinical prognostic performance and potentially outperform traditional machine learning (ML) methods. 55b65acbac0d163f7aa15f3ff62fd61662b0c813.summary: AAAI 2026 提出 REACT-LLM 基准，系统评估大语言模型与因果特征结合用于临床风险预测的表现。
