5136ccf686c5ee37a98aa767a644d52259244743.title: Δt-Mamba3D: A Time-Aware Spatio-Temporal State-Space Model for Breast Cancer Risk Prediction
5136ccf686c5ee37a98aa767a644d52259244743.abstract: Longitudinal analysis of sequential radiological images is hampered by a fundamental data challenge: how to effectively model a sequence of high-resolution images captured at irregular time intervals. This data structure contains indispensable spatial and temporal cues that current methods fail to fully exploit. Models often compromise by either collapsing spatial information into vectors or applying spatio-temporal models that are computationally inefficient and incompatible with non-uniform time steps. We address this challenge with Time-Aware Δt-Mamba3D, a novel state-space architecture adapted for longitudinal medical imaging. Our model simultaneously encodes irregular inter-visit intervals and rich spatio-temporal context while remaining computationally efficient. 4e2c1c77e2bacdcb70d066c65af56681563b652b.abstract: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to multimodal medical diagnosis for their inherent relational modeling capabilities. However, their efficacy is often compromised by the prevailing reliance on a single, static graph built from indiscriminate features, hindering the ability to model patient-specific pathological relationships. To this end, the proposed Multi-Activation Plane Interaction Graph Neural Network (MAPI-GNN) reconstructs this single-graph paradigm by learning a multifaceted graph profile from semantically disentangled feature subspaces. This technology has emerged as a crucial method for studying the cellular composition and differentiation states of tissues, investigating cell-cell interactions, and unraveling the molecular mechanisms underlying diseases and developmental processes. However, existing segmentation methods often fail to fully leverage the valuable information provided by spatial transcriptomics, leading to inaccurate cell segmentation. 4c9b42a52cad37b7fc1e2899d83bae12cc0aeb3a.title: Beyond Plain Demos: A Demo-centric Anchoring Paradigm for In-Context Learning in Alzheimer's Disease Detection
4c9b42a52cad37b7fc1e2899d83bae12cc0aeb3a.abstract: Detecting Alzheimer’s disease (AD) from narrative transcripts challenges large language models (LLMs): pre-training rarely covers this out-of-distribution task, and all transcript demos describe the same scene, producing highly homogeneous contexts. These factors cripple both the model’s built-in task knowledge (task cognition) and its ability to surface subtle, class-discriminative cues (contextual perception). Because cognition is fixed after pre-training, improving in-context learning (ICL) for AD detection hinges on enriching perception through better demonstration (demo) sets. 4c7ec832f6cf5d04b18352065b9e4930f0b03316.abstract: We introduce a single–backbone foundation model for brain MRI that supports dynamic modality integration: it operates with arbitrary, possibly unseen, combinations of MRI sequences at pretrain and transfer. The encoder is conditioned by text-derived modality embeddings via conditional layer normalization, while a variance–covariance penalty discourages feature collapse. Pretrained self-supervised on ∼60,000 heterogeneous MRIs, the model learns modality-aware yet modality-agnostic features. We outline evaluation on segmentation and classification under missing/unseen modalities and cross-center shifts, and present early feasibility on multiple sclerosis lesion segmentation under limited data. 42efba50bbd5909c18e53f1e6aa7d49553812a59.title: Learning to Transform: Unifying Latent Geometric Shape and Appearance Representations in Healthcare Imaging
42efba50bbd5909c18e53f1e6aa7d49553812a59.abstract: Recent advances in deep neural networks have highlighted the importance of geometric shape in various image analysis and computer vision tasks. However, most current approaches rely on coarse or simplified shape representations, such as binary masks, meshes, or point clouds, that are primarily designed to capture global structures of objects presented in images. While effective for general image and visual understanding, these methods often fail to learn fine-grained geometric information that is critical for accurately modeling complex shapes and subtle anatomical variations. This limitation is particularly consequential in healthcare applications, where understanding fine-grained anatomical shapes and their changes is crucial for accurate disease detection and diagnosis. Traditional CTR detection methods, which typically rely on the rich cellular morphology in histology images, are susceptible to a high rate of false positives due to morphological similarities across different tissue regions. The groundbreaking advances in spatial transcriptomics (ST) provide detailed cellular phenotypes and spatial localization information, offering new opportunities for more accurate cancer region detection. However, current methods are unable to effectively integrate histology images with ST data, especially in the context of cross-sample and cross-platform/batch settings for accomplishing the CTR detection. 4107acc38b5800e13c9518f0e92615c4d39e4961.zh_title: SpaCRD：组织学与空间转录组多模态融合的癌症区域检测

400c20ddc56ae07a64b7b5835393a8c3a4e2940b.abstract: With the advancement of information retrieval (IR) technologies toward deep semantic understanding, reasoning-based methods—featuring explicit chain-of-thought generation—have demonstrated significant advantages in multi-hop and causal reasoning tasks. However, in complex clinical case retrieval scenarios, implicit reasoning cues within clinical data often hinder current models from effectively capturing deep semantic associations between queries and cases. Query rewriting and expansion techniques based on reasoning offer a promising solution to this challenge by uncovering and completing the latent clinical intent behind user queries, thereby enhancing semantic coverage and reasoning sensitivity. 400c20ddc56ae07a64b7b5835393a8c3a4e2940b.zh_title: CRAF：面向相似病例检索的临床推理自适应框架

400c20ddc56ae07a64b7b5835393a8c3a4e2940b.zh_abstract: 随着信息检索（IR）技术向深度语义理解发展，基于推理的方法——以显式思维链（chain-of-thought）生成为特征——在多跳和因果推理任务中展现出显著优势。然而，在复杂临床病例检索场景中，临床数据中的隐含推理线索往往阻碍当前模型有效捕获查询与病例之间的深层语义关联。基于推理的查询重写与扩展技术通过揭示并补全用户查询背后潜在的临床意图，为这一挑战提供了有前景的解决方案，从而增强语义覆盖与推理敏感性。本文提出 CRAF，一种面向相似病例检索的临床自适应推理框架。我们的方法生成临床推理路径，并纳入细粒度语义

4001be87e2dfb7f951bd31c6f1bdec8a62938614.title: Bridging Vision and Language for Robust Context-Aware Surgical Point Tracking: The VL-SurgPT Dataset and Benchmark
4001be87e2dfb7f951bd31c6f1bdec8a62938614.abstract: Accurate point tracking in surgical environments remains challenging due to complex visual conditions, including smoke occlusion, specular reflections, and tissue deformation. While existing surgical tracking datasets provide coordinate information, they lack the semantic context necessary to understand tracking failure mechanisms. We introduce VL-SurgPT, the first large-scale multimodal dataset that bridges visual tracking with textual descriptions of point status in surgical scenes. The dataset comprises 908 in vivo video clips, including 754 for tissue tracking (17,171 annotated points across five challenging scenarios) and 154 for instrument tracking (covering seven instrument types with detailed keypoint annotations). 4001be87e2dfb7f951bd31c6f1bdec8a62938614.zh_title: VL-SurgPT：视觉与语言结合的手术点跟踪数据集与基准

3e206a0271005bed750aa4892c32b59188a64ee0.title: DISC: Dynamic Feature Selection for Cost-Sensitive Medical Diagnosis
3e206a0271005bed750aa4892c32b59188a64ee0.abstract:
Accurate medical diagnosis often relies on both textual self-reported symptoms and structured medical examination results of patients. However, these examinations vary significantly in cost—measured in time, money, or patient discomfort---creating a challenging trade-off between diagnostic accuracy and resource efficiency.

Starting with textual self-reported symptoms and basic demographic, the system determines follow-up examinations step-by-step, improving accuracy while minimizing additional costs.

3e206a0271005bed750aa4892c32b59188a64ee0.summary: 提出动态诊断框架，依据患者个体特征逐步选择检查项目，权衡诊断准确率与资源成本。
key_points: 利用文本自述症状与结构化检查结果

3e206a0271005bed750aa4892c32b59188a64ee0.zh_abstract:

3c92ba8ee70018f1349203cff02af6af2953e61f.title: Tuning Medical Foundation Models for Inner Ear Temporal CT Analysis with Plug-and-play Domain Knowledge Aggregator
3c92ba8ee70018f1349203cff02af6af2953e61f.abstract: High-resolution computed tomography (CT) is essential for diagnosing hearing loss and planning interventions such as cochlear implantation, as it provides detailed visualization of inner-ear anatomy. This paper focuses on advancing AI-based analysis of inner-ear CT scans to support clinical decision-making. However, a major challenge lies in the scarcity of annotated data, which limits the applicability of conventional supervised learning techniques. To address this, we present the first publicly available Children's Inner Ear CT Dataset (CIED), comprising 722 CT scans labeled for structural anomaly detection, postoperative hearing outcome prediction, and anatomical segmentation. In addition, we explore the use of medical foundation models to improve generalization in data-scarce scenarios. 3c92ba8ee70018f1349203cff02af6af2953e61f.zh_title: 内耳颞骨CT分析：基础模型与即插即用领域知识聚合
3c92ba8ee70018f1349203cff02af6af2953e61f.summary: 面向内耳CT分析，提出即插即用领域知识聚合器调优医学基础模型，以应对标注数据稀缺。
key_points: 高分辨CT用于听力损失诊断与干预规划
标注数据稀缺限制传统监督学习应用

3c92ba8ee70018f1349203cff02af6af2953e61f.zh_abstract: 高分辨率计算机断层扫描（CT）对于诊断听力损失和规划诸如人工耳蜗植入等干预措施至关重要，因为它能提供内耳解剖结构的详细可视化。本文聚焦于推进基于人工智能的内耳CT扫描分析，以支持临床决策。然而，一个主要挑战在于标注数据的稀缺，这限制了传统监督学习技术的适用性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了首个公开可用的儿童内耳CT数据集（Children's Inner Ear CT Dataset, CIED），包含722例CT扫描，标注用于结构异常检测、术后听力结局预测和解剖分割。此外，我们探索使用医学基础模型来提高数据稀缺场景下的泛化能力。现有的参数高效适配方法通常在两个方式存在不足：它们缺乏统一的

3ad8e1fa6e9a33ef01b1fc34a7fdf65fc32ef7bc.title: Learning to Cluster Rare Cell Types: Implicit Semantic Data Augmentation for Spatial Multi-modal Omics Analysis
3ad8e1fa6e9a33ef01b1fc34a7fdf65fc32ef7bc.abstract: Spatial multi-modal omics technologies have transformed biological research by enabling the simultaneous profiling of gene expression, protein abundance, and chromatin accessibility within their native spatial contexts. Despite these advances, accurately clustering rare cell types remains a major challenge due to data sparsity, high dimensionality, and limited annotated samples. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown potential in modeling spatial omics data, their effectiveness is often constrained by the use of fixed K-nearest neighbor (KNN) graph structures, which fail to capture latent semantic relationships masked by sequencing noise. To overcome these limitations, we propose CRCT (Clustering Rare Cell Types): a novel framework that combines Implicit Semantic Data Augmentation (ISDA) with adaptive graph learning for spatial multi-modal omics analysis. 3ad8e1fa6e9a33ef01b1fc34a7fdf65fc32ef7bc.zh_title: 稀有细胞类型聚类：空间多模态组学的隐式语义增强
3ad8e1fa6e9a33ef01b1fc34a7fdf65fc32ef7bc.summary: 提出隐式语义数据增强方法，提升空间多模态组学中稀有细胞类型聚类的准确性。
key_points: 面向空间多模态组学数据分析

3ad8e1fa6e9a33ef01b1fc34a7fdf65fc32ef7bc.zh_abstract: 空间多模态组学技术通过能够在原生空间背景下同时分析基因表达、蛋白质丰度和染色质可及性，改变了生物学研究。尽管取得这些进展，由于数据稀疏性、高维度和标注样本有限，准确聚类稀有细胞类型仍然是一项重大挑战。虽然图神经网络（GNNs）在建模空间组学数据方面显示出潜力，但其有效性常受限于使用固定的 K 最近邻（KNN）图结构，这些结构无法捕获被测序噪声掩盖的潜在语义关系。为克服这些局限，我们提出 CRCT（Clustering Rare Cell Types，聚类稀有细胞类型）：一种新颖框架，结合隐式语义数据增强（ISDA）与自适应图学习，用于空间多模态组学分析。与传统的增强

3a13e08bbe28d8303a4c13a097a4f37b03146db7.title: Intelligent Clinical Assistant for Personalized Responses and Clinical Summaries
3a13e08bbe28d8303a4c13a097a4f37b03146db7.abstract: Healthcare information is scattered across heterogeneous data sources, such as patient medical records, clinical guidelines, research literature, and online knowledge bases. Segmented information, both structured and unstructured, when integrated together using context augmentation - a knowledge fusion technique, has the ability to contextualize broader medical context. Current approaches lack knowledge aggregation that is necessary to generate personalized healthcare recommendations. I propose novel AI frameworks that leverage language models and hybrid retrieval techniques to aggregate multi source knowledge, enabling the generation of contextual and accurate medical response.
3a13e08bbe28d8303a4c13a097a4f37b03146db7.zh_title: 智能临床助手：个性化应答与临床摘要
3a13e08bbe28d8303a4c13a097a4f37b03146db7.summary: 提出智能临床助手构想，通过上下文增强融合多源医疗知识，生成个性化医疗响应与临床摘要。
key_points: 整合病历、指南与文献等异构来源
使用上下文增强进行知识融合
现方法缺乏知识聚合与个性化
3a13e08bbe28d8303a4c13a097a4f37b03146db7.zh_abstract: 医疗保健信息分散在异构数据源中，例如患者病历、临床指南、研究文献和在线知识库。分段的信息，无论结构化还是非结构化，在使用上下文增强（context augmentation）——一种知识融合技术——整合在一起时，能够将更广泛的医疗上下文语境化。当前方法缺乏生成个性化医疗保健建议所必需的知识聚合。我提出新颖的 AI 框架，利用语言模型和混合检索技术来聚合多源知识，从而能够生成具有上下文且准确的医疗响应。

39100e42fa67aedc0d21e690f3914fd8f5b21435.title: Topology-Enhanced and Label Correlation-Aware Model for Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
39100e42fa67aedc0d21e690f3914fd8f5b21435.abstract: Protein-Protein Interactions (PPIs) prediction is crucial for understanding cellular functions and disease mechanisms. Existing deep learning–based methods primarily rely on direct interaction within the PPI network to update protein representations. However, (1) such networks overlook the potential associations between functionally similar proteins, limiting the smoothing capability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) in learning representations for similar nodes. (2) Additionally, most approaches fail to adequately model the latent dependencies among interaction types (edge labels), which hinders their performance in PPI prediction tasks. To address these limitations, we propose TELC-PPI, a topology-enhanced and label correlation-aware model for protein-protein interactions prediction. 39100e42fa67aedc0d21e690f3914fd8f5b21435.zh_title: 拓扑增强与标签相关性感知的蛋白质互作预测模型
39100e42fa67aedc0d21e690f3914fd8f5b21435.summary: 融合网络拓扑结构与标签相关性建模，提升蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用预测性能。
key_points: 面向蛋白质相互作用预测

39100e42fa67aedc0d21e690f3914fd8f5b21435.zh_abstract: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）预测对于理解细胞功能和疾病机制至关重要。现有基于深度学习的方法主要依赖 PPI 网络内的直接相互作用来更新蛋白质表示。然而，（1）此类网络忽略了功能相似蛋白质之间的潜在关联，限制了图神经网络（GNNs）在学习相似节点表示时的平滑能力。（2）此外，大多数方法未能充分建模相互作用类型（边标签）之间的潜在依赖关系，这阻碍了它们在 PPI 预测任务中的性能。为解决这些局限，我们提出 TELC-PPI，一种用于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用预测的拓扑增强且标签相关性感知的模型。具体而言，TELC-PPI 首先通过同时利用拓扑信息来识别相似蛋白质

34a7bb1ae78b29a49a2b4b6a5395bea7745abcaa.title: A Spatio-temporal Cluster-aware Supervised Learning Framework for Predicting County-level Drug Overdose Deaths
34a7bb1ae78b29a49a2b4b6a5395bea7745abcaa.abstract: The soaring drug overdose crisis in the United States has claimed more than half a million lives in the past decade and remains a major public health threat. The ability to predict drug overdose deaths at the county level can help local communities develop action plans in response to emerging changes. Applying off-the-shelf machine learning algorithms for prediction can be challenging due to the heterogeneous risk profiles of the counties and suppressed data in common publicly available data sources. To fill these gaps, we develop a cluster-aware supervised learning (CASL) framework to enhance the prediction of county-level drug overdose deaths. This CASL model simultaneously clusters counties into groups based on geographical and socioeconomic characteristics and minimizes the loss function that accounts for suppressed values and cluster-specific regularization. 34a7bb1ae78b29a49a2b4b6a5395bea7745abcaa.zh_title: 时空聚类感知的县级药物过量死亡预测框架
34a7bb1ae78b29a49a2b4b6a5395bea7745abcaa.summary: 提出时空聚类感知的监督学习框架，用于预测美国县级药物过量死亡，应对县域风险异质与数据抑制问题。
key_points: 预测县级药物过量死亡以支持社区应对
应对县域风险特征高度异质

34a7bb1ae78b29a49a2b4b6a5395bea7745abcaa.zh_abstract: 美国急剧上升的药物过量危机在过去十年已夺去超过50万人的生命，并仍是一个重大公共卫生威胁。能够在县（county）层面预测药物过量死亡，有助于当地社区针对新出现的变化制定行动计划。由于各县风险特征异质，且常用公开数据源中的数据存在被抑制（suppressed data）的情况，应用现成的机器学习算法进行预测可能具有挑战性。为填补这些空白，我们开发了一个聚类感知监督学习（cluster-aware supervised learning, CASL）框架，以增强对县级药物过量死亡的预测。该CASL模型同时根据地理和社会经济特征将县聚类为不同组，并最小化一个考虑被抑制值和聚类特定正则化的损失函数。我们的计算研究

335dfdac10cc1cd587146fc01c918fa1a2a3b7a1.title: From Crayons to Code: AI-Driven Insights into a Child's Mental Health Through Drawings
335dfdac10cc1cd587146fc01c918fa1a2a3b7a1.abstract: Children's mental health is crucial for their development, but it's often overlooked, leading to psychological issues. Many children struggle to express their thoughts and feelings effectively. To address this issue, we have proposed a novel approach to analyze children's drawings for psychological screening using artificial intelligence. Specifically, we're focusing on the `draw a person' (DAP) test, where a child's drawing is used to identify potential indicators of their mental and emotional state. Thus, we are introducing an AI-powered technique to automate the psychological screening process for children using the DAP test, which a human professional would traditionally conduct. 335dfdac10cc1cd587146fc01c918fa1a2a3b7a1.zh_title: AI通过绘画分析儿童心理健康
335dfdac10cc1cd587146fc01c918fa1a2a3b7a1.summary: 提出基于AI分析儿童“画人”测验绘画，用于心理与情绪筛查。
key_points: 聚焦儿童画人心理测试
用AI识别心理健康潜在指标

335dfdac10cc1cd587146fc01c918fa1a2a3b7a1.zh_abstract: 儿童的心理健康对其发展至关重要，但常被忽视，从而导致心理问题。许多儿童难以有效表达自己的想法和感受。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，利用人工智能分析儿童绘画以进行心理筛查。具体而言，我们聚焦于“画人”（draw a person, DAP）测验，其中使用儿童的绘画来识别其心理和情绪状态的潜在指标。因此，我们引入一种由人工智能（AI）驱动的技术，以使用 DAP 测验自动化儿童心理筛查过程，而这一过程传统上由人类专业人员执行。该筛查工具将提示儿童是否需要或不需要进一步的心理转介。我们收集了一个由儿童绘画组成的数据集，并由专家将其标注为 `n

30d1f2f1947335e6c832cae1cab4f21da964ccb1.title: Cancer Survival Prediction by Cyclic Generation and Multi-grained Alignment
30d1f2f1947335e6c832cae1cab4f21da964ccb1.abstract: Cancer survival analysis with multimodal data is crucial for precise treatments and patient benefits. However, the following challenges prohibit integrating histopathology and genomics: (i) multimodal data is not always complete, especially for the more costly genomics data; (ii) intricate interactions between different modalities are difficult to capture and understand. To response, we propose an end-to-end framework (CIMA) that coordinates Cyclic modality generation and Multi-grained multimodal Alignment. Specifically, CIMA designs a cyclic modality reconstruction module to reciprocally impute missing modalities and infer the interactions between them. Next, it introduces the multi-grained alignment module over the imputed data and interactions to mine fine-grained alignments between histopathology (slide patches) and genomics (biological pathways). 30d1f2f1947335e6c832cae1cab4f21da964ccb1.zh_title: 循环生成与多粒度对齐的癌症生存预测框架CIMA
30d1f2f1947335e6c832cae1cab4f21da964ccb1.summary: 提出端到端框架CIMA，通过循环模态生成与多粒度对齐，整合病理与基因组数据用于癌症生存分析。
key_points: 针对多模态数据不完整问题
缓解基因组数据缺失带来的限制

30d1f2f1947335e6c832cae1cab4f21da964ccb1.zh_abstract: 利用多模态数据进行癌症生存分析对于精准治疗和患者获益至关重要。然而，以下挑战阻碍了组织病理学和基因组学的整合：（i）多模态数据并不总是完整的，尤其是对于成本更高的基因组学数据；（ii）不同模态之间复杂的相互作用难以捕捉和理解。作为回应，我们提出了一个端到端框架（CIMA），它协调循环模态生成（Cyclic modality generation）和多粒度多模态对齐（Multi-grained multimodal Alignment）。具体而言，CIMA设计了一个循环模态重建模块，以相互填补缺失模态并推断它们之间的相互作用。接下来，它在填补后的数据和相互作用上引入多粒度对齐模块，以挖掘组织病理学（切片图像块）与基因组学（生物学通路）之间的细粒度对齐。CIMA然后构建自适应融合

2d5f75d3c2987f8557b7de7cf523d1472926f25b.title: DS-ProGen: A Dual-Structure Deep Language Model for Functional Protein Design
2d5f75d3c2987f8557b7de7cf523d1472926f25b.abstract: Inverse Protein Folding (IPF) is a critical subtask in the field of protein design, aiming to engineer amino acid sequences capable of folding correctly into a specified three-dimensional (3D) conformation. Although substantial progress has been achieved in recent years, existing methods generally rely on either backbone coordinates or molecular surface features alone, which restricts their ability to fully capture the complex chemical and geometric constraints necessary for precise sequence prediction. To address this limitation, we present DS-ProGen, a dual-structure deep language model for functional protein design, which integrates both backbone geometry and surface-level representations. 2d5f75d3c2987f8557b7de7cf523d1472926f25b.zh_title: DS-ProGen：用于功能性蛋白质设计的双结构深度语言模型
2d5f75d3c2987f8557b7de7cf523d1472926f25b.summary: 针对逆蛋白质折叠任务，提出同时利用主链坐标与分子表面特征的双结构深度语言模型。
key_points: 面向逆蛋白质折叠序列设计
现有方法多仅用单一结构信息
结合化学与几何约束

2b59bf767ab02b525deae8f2913c54bcbd8903c8.title: HeMeNet: Heterogeneous Multichannel Equivariant Network for Protein Multi-task Learning
2b59bf767ab02b525deae8f2913c54bcbd8903c8.abstract: Understanding and leveraging the 3D structures of proteins is central to a variety of biological and drug discovery tasks. While deep learning has been applied successfully for structure-based protein function prediction tasks, current methods usually employ distinct training for each task. However, each of the tasks is of small size, and such a single-task strategy hinders the models' performance and generalization ability. As some labeled 3D protein datasets are biologically related, combining multi-source datasets for larger-scale multi-task learning is one way to overcome this problem. In this paper, we propose a neural network model to address multiple tasks jointly upon the input of 3D protein structures. In particular, we first construct a standard structure-based multi-task benchmark called Protein-MT, consisting of 6 biologically relevant tasks, including affinity prediction and
2b59bf767ab02b525deae8f2913c54bcbd8903c8.zh_title: HeMeNet：蛋白质多任务学习异质多通道等变网络
2b59bf767ab02b525deae8f2913c54bcbd8903c8.summary: 提出异质多通道等变网络，联合学习多个蛋白质结构相关任务。
key_points: 面向蛋白质3D结构理解
多任务联合训练提升泛化
服务生物与药物发现任务
2b59bf767ab02b525deae8f2913c54bcbd8903c8.zh_abstract: 理解和利用蛋白质的3D结构是多种生物学和药物发现任务的核心。尽管深度学习已成功应用于基于结构的蛋白质功能预测任务，但当前方法通常针对每个任务进行不同的训练。然而，每个任务的规模都很小，这种单任务策略阻碍了模型的性能和泛化能力。由于一些带标签的3D蛋白质数据集在生物学上相关，将多源数据集结合起来进行更大规模的多任务学习是克服这一问题的一种途径。在本文中，我们提出了一种神经网络模型，以3D蛋白质结构为输入联合解决多个任务。具体而言，我们首先构建了一个标准的基于结构的多任务基准，称为Protein-MT，包含6个生物学相关任务，包括亲和力预测和

1ca69247720b9300d3f16c1c63ecfe2db3fbef7f.title: Hierarchical Structure-Property Alignment for Data-Efficient Molecular Generation and Editing
1ca69247720b9300d3f16c1c63ecfe2db3fbef7f.abstract: Property-constrained molecular generation and editing are crucial in AI-driven drug discovery but remain hindered by two factors: (i) capturing the complex relationships between molecular structures and multiple properties remains challenging, and (ii) the narrow coverage and incomplete annotations of molecular properties weaken the effectiveness of property-based models. To tackle these limitations, we propose HSPAG, a data-efficient framework featuring hierarchical structure–property alignment. By treating SMILES and molecular properties as complementary modalities, the model learns their relationships at atom, substructure, and whole-molecule levels. 1ca69247720b9300d3f16c1c63ecfe2db3fbef7f.summary: 提出HSPAG数据高效框架，通过层级结构—性质对齐改进性质约束的分子生成与编辑。

1ca69247720b9300d3f16c1c63ecfe2db3fbef7f.zh_abstract: 性质约束的分子生成与编辑在人工智能（AI）驱动的药物发现中至关重要，但仍受两个因素阻碍：(i) 捕捉分子结构与多种性质之间的复杂关系仍然具有挑战性；(ii) 分子性质的覆盖范围狭窄和注释不完整削弱了基于性质的模型的有效性。为解决这些局限，我们提出 HSPAG，一个具有分层结构–性质对齐的数据高效框架。通过将 SMILES 和分子性质视为互补模态，该模型在原子、子结构和整分子层面学习它们之间的关系。此外，我们通过骨架聚类选择代表性样本，并通过辅助变分自编码器（VAE）选择困难样本，从而大幅减少所需的预训练数据。另外，我们引入了一种性质 relevan

1c82e3c3312faf7eb7adfd1e5a5488f4b173f20e.title: FDP: A Frequency-Decomposition Preprocessing Pipeline for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Brain MRI
1c82e3c3312faf7eb7adfd1e5a5488f4b173f20e.abstract:
Due to the diversity of brain anatomy and the scarcity of annotated data, supervised anomaly detection for brain MRI remains challenging, driving the development of unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) approaches. 
Current UAD methods typically utilize synthetically generated noise perturbations on healthy MRIs to train generative models for normal anatomy reconstruction, enabling anomaly detection via residual maps.
However, such simulated anomalies lack the biophysical fidelity and morphological complexity characteristic of true clinical lesions.
To advance UAD in brain MRI, we conduct the first systematic frequency-domain analysis of pathological signatures, revealing two key properties: (1) anomalies exhibit unique frequency patterns distinguishable from normal anatomy, and (2) low-frequency signals maintain consistent representations across healthy scans. 1c82e3c3312faf7eb7adfd1e5a5488f4b173f20e.zh_title: FDP：脑MRI无监督异常检测频域分解预处理
1c82e3c3312faf7eb7adfd1e5a5488f4b173f20e.summary: 提出频域分解预处理流程，提升脑MRI无监督异常检测的解剖重建效果。
key_points: 针对脑MRI无监督异常检测
频域分解预处理方法
改进正常解剖重建与残差检测

1c1909f32f8ef2eced454ec52827ff896623959a.title: HyperDiag: Temporal-Regional Hypergraph Learning via Topology-Enhanced State Propagation for Brain Disease Diagnosis
1c1909f32f8ef2eced454ec52827ff896623959a.abstract:
Dynamic brain networks provide a powerful representation for capturing temporal variations in functional brain connectivity and have gained increasing attention in brain disease diagnosis. However, most existing methods extract features from isolated time windows, making it difficult to capture the high-order dynamic evolution of brain activity. Moreover, these methods often neglect the functional heterogeneity among brain regions, thereby limiting diagnostic performance. To address these limitations, we propose HyperDiag, a novel temporal-regional Hypergraph learning via topology-enhanced state propagation for brain disease Diagnosis.

1c1909f32f8ef2eced454ec52827ff896623959a.zh_title: HyperDiag：拓扑增强状态传播的时空超图脑病诊断
1c1909f32f8ef2eced454ec52827ff896623959a.summary: 提出时空超图学习框架，捕捉脑网络高阶动态演化以提升脑疾病诊断性能。
key_points: 动态脑网络刻画功能连接时间变化
现有方法难以捕捉高阶动态演化
常忽略脑区功能异质性
1c1909f32f8ef2eced454ec52827ff896623959a.zh_abstract:
动态脑网络为捕捉功能性脑连接的时间变化提供了一种强大的表示，并在脑疾病诊断中受到越来越多关注。然而，大多数现有方法从孤立的时间窗口提取特征，使得难以捕捉脑活动的高阶动态演化。此外，这些方法常常忽略脑区之间的功能异质性，从而限制了诊断性能。为解决这些局限，我们提出 HyperDiag，一种通过拓扑增强状态传播进行脑疾病诊断的新型时间–区域超图学习。

14722f3ce460a6e8d4c8101519d0329e10807308.title: PLA-MGRA: Multi-Granularity and Relation-Aware Learning for Efficient and Generalizable Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
14722f3ce460a6e8d4c8101519d0329e10807308.abstract: Protein-Ligand Affinity (PLA) prediction quantifies the interaction strength to guide rational drug design. Existing approaches typically analyze interaction at a single granularity and overlook tightly coupled relationships between protein and ligand in both structure and functionality, consequently yielding suboptimal representations, leading to significant performance drops in real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose PLA-MGRA, a minimalist and effective PLA prediction framework. Specifically, PLA-MGRA captures both fine-grained atomic details and coarse grained functional semantics within the 3D structure of protein–ligand complexes, through multi-granularity learning. To further parse the coupled protein–ligand relationships, we design relation-aware learning to enhance the binding nature of representations. 14722f3ce460a6e8d4c8101519d0329e10807308.zh_title: PLA-MGRA：多粒度关系感知的蛋白-配体亲和力预测
14722f3ce460a6e8d4c8101519d0329e10807308.summary: 提出PLA-MGRA框架，用于高效且可泛化的蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测，以指导理性药物设计。

14722f3ce460a6e8d4c8101519d0329e10807308.zh_abstract: 蛋白质-配体亲和力（Protein-Ligand Affinity，PLA）预测量化相互作用强度，以指导合理的药物设计。现有方法通常仅在单一粒度上分析相互作用，并忽视了蛋白质与配体在结构和功能两方面紧密耦合的关系，因而产生次优的表征，导致在真实场景中性能显著下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出 PLA-MGRA，一个简约而有效的 PLA 预测框架。具体而言，PLA-MGRA 通过多粒度学习，同时捕获蛋白质-配体复合物三维结构中的细粒度原子细节和粗粒度功能语义。为进一步解析耦合的蛋白质-配体关系，我们设计了关系感知学习，以增强表征的结合本质。大量实验表明，我们的方法达到

12cf94db766640f72209d7f3286d1c8b164e9b75.title: Pancreatic Cancer Diagnosis System
12cf94db766640f72209d7f3286d1c8b164e9b75.abstract: My research direction is about the pancreatic cancer diagnosis system. Pancreatic cancer, as one of the cancers with the highest mortality rate, has always been a difficult problem in world medicine. I hope that through my efforts, I can contribute to the integration of AI and medicine, and contribute to increasing the probability of early diagnosis of pancreatic cancer.

1249fb97ea28760ced3df2066df8f3ec0d80fe51.title: Experience with Single Domain Generalization in Real World Medical Imaging Deployments
1249fb97ea28760ced3df2066df8f3ec0d80fe51.abstract: A desirable property of any deployed artificial intelligence is generalization across domains, i.e. data generation distribution under a specific acquisition condition. In medical imagining applications the most coveted property for effective deployment is Single Domain Generalization (SDG), which addresses the challenge of training a model on a single domain to ensure it generalizes well to unseen target domains. In multi-center studies, differences in scanners and imaging protocols introduce domain shifts that exacerbate variability in rare class characteristics. This paper presents our experience on SDG in real life deployment for two exemplary medical imaging case studies on seizure onset zone detection using fMRI data, and stress electrocardiogram based coronary artery detection. 1249fb97ea28760ced3df2066df8f3ec0d80fe51.zh_title: 真实医学影像部署中的单域泛化经验
1249fb97ea28760ced3df2066df8f3ec0d80fe51.summary: 分享单域泛化在真实世界医学影像部署中的经验，关注模型跨未见域泛化的挑战。
key_points: 部署AI需跨域泛化
单域泛化是医学影像部署重点
多中心扫描仪与协议致域偏移

0c1d21b8807aa5c1e2da1c14799e54b8f2cff482.title: Neural Architecture for Fast and Reliable Coagulation Assessment in Clinical Settings: Leveraging Thromboelastography
0c1d21b8807aa5c1e2da1c14799e54b8f2cff482.abstract: In an ideal medical environment, real-time coagulation monitoring can enable early detection and prompt remediation of risks. However, traditional Thromboelastography (TEG), a widely employed diagnostic modality, can only provide such outputs after nearly 1 hour of measurement. The delay might lead to elevated mortality rates. These issues clearly point out one of the key challenges for medical AI development: Making reasonable predictions based on very small data sets and accounting for variation between different patient populations, a task where conventional deep learning methods typically perform poorly. We present Physiological State Reconstruction (PSR), a new algorithm specifically designed to take advantage of dynamic changes between individuals and to maximize useful information produced by small amounts of clinical data through mapping to reliable predictions and diagnosis. 0c1d21b8807aa5c1e2da1c14799e54b8f2cff482.zh_title: 用于临床快速可靠凝血评估的神经架构

0795041e650d60d845f89d86b204bbe3577e6781.title: Fine-tuning Zero-shot Large Language Models for Patient-reported Outcomes (Student Abstract)
0795041e650d60d845f89d86b204bbe3577e6781.abstract: Radiotherapy (RT) is a cornerstone of cancer treatment. Following RT, patient-reported outcomes (PROs) collected via standardized questionnaires are crucial for monitoring patients' quality of life and side effects. However, traditional statistical and machine learning methods, which rely on structured numerical data, often fail to capture semantic meaning within patients' health status. To address this, we developed a novel framework using zero- and few-shot large language models (LLMs) to identify patients experiencing mild to severe depression. Furthermore, classification performance is enhanced through parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on a prostate cancer PRO dataset for depression have demonstrated that our fine-tuned LLMs consistently outperformed other baseline methods across key evaluation metrics.

key_points: 患者报告结局用于监测生活质量与副作用

0795041e650d60d845f89d86b204bbe3577e6781.zh_abstract: 放疗（radiotherapy, RT）是癌症治疗的基石。放疗后，通过标准化问卷收集的患者报告结局（patient-reported outcomes, PROs）对于监测患者的生活质量和副作用至关重要。然而，依赖结构化数值数据的传统统计和机器学习方法往往无法捕捉患者健康状况中的语义含义。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种新颖框架，使用零样本和少样本大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）来识别经历轻至重度抑郁的患者。此外，通过参数高效微调增强了分类性能。在前列腺癌PRO抑郁数据集上的实验表明，我们微调后的LLMs在关键评价指标上始终优于其他基线方法。

cec94c80fda3e38e612edf32b975dfcc27b4fb90.title: DiffECG: Diffusion Model-Powered Label-Efficient and Personalized Arrhythmia Diagnosis
cec94c80fda3e38e612edf32b975dfcc27b4fb90.abstract: Arrhythmia diagnosis using electrocardiogram (ECG) is critical for preventing cardiovascular risks. Besides, due to inter-subject variability, pre-trained models cannot achieve evenly performance across individuals. Conducting model fine-tuning for each individual is computationally expensive and does not guarantee improvement. We propose DiffECG, a diffusion-based self-supervised learning framework for label-efficient and personalized arrhythmia detection. cec94c80fda3e38e612edf32b975dfcc27b4fb90.zh_title: DiffECG：扩散模型驱动的心律失常诊断
cec94c80fda3e38e612edf32b975dfcc27b4fb90.summary: IJCAI 2025提出DiffECG，用扩散模型实现标签高效且个性化的心律失常诊断。
key_points: 应对ECG诊断标签稀缺
减少对比学习假阴性样本

a366e4e1c8b6807110b1659307c9d54f3470d676.title: Multimodal Cancer Survival Analysis via Hypergraph Learning with Cross-Modality Rebalance
a366e4e1c8b6807110b1659307c9d54f3470d676.abstract: Multimodal pathology-genomic analysis has become increasingly prominent in cancer survival prediction. However, existing studies mainly utilize multi-instance learning to aggregate patch-level features, neglecting the information loss of contextual and hierarchical details within pathology images. Furthermore, the disparity in data granularity and dimensionality between pathology and genomics leads to a significant modality imbalance. The high spatial resolution inherent in pathology data renders it a dominant role while overshadowing genomics in multimodal integration. In this paper, we propose a multimodal survival prediction framework that incorporates hypergraph learning to effectively capture both contextual and hierarchical details from pathology images. a366e4e1c8b6807110b1659307c9d54f3470d676.zh_title: 基于超图学习与跨模态重平衡的多模态癌症生存分析
a366e4e1c8b6807110b1659307c9d54f3470d676.summary: 提出超图学习与跨模态重平衡方法，用于病理-基因组多模态癌症生存预测。

4833e9691c224d4c6739ec8ae42b9b6748c6c593.title: Localizing Before Answering: A Benchmark for Grounded Medical Visual Question Answering
4833e9691c224d4c6739ec8ae42b9b6748c6c593.abstract:
Medical Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in medical data interpretation. However, these models frequently generate hallucinations contradicting source evidence, particularly due to inadequate localization reasoning. This work reveals a critical limitation in current medical LMMs: instead of analyzing relevant pathological regions, they often rely on linguistic patterns or attend to irrelevant image areas when responding to disease-related queries.

To address this, we introduce HEAL-MedVQA (Hallucination Evaluation via Localization MedVQA), a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate LMMs' localization abilities and hallucination robustness. HEAL-MedVQA features (i) two innovative evaluation protocols to assess visual and textual shortcut learning, and (ii) a dataset of 67K VQA pairs, with doctor-annotated anatomical segmentation masks for path
4833e9691c224d4c6739ec8ae42b9b6748c6c593.zh_title: 先定位后回答：医学视觉问答的循证基准
4833e9691c224d4c6739ec8ae42b9b6748c6c593.summary: 该工作揭示医学多模态大模型定位推理不足导致幻觉，并提出面向循证定位的医学视觉问答基准。
key_points: 医学多模态大模型常产生与证据矛盾的幻觉
模型依赖语言模式或关注无关图像区域
构建强调定位推理的医学视觉问答基准

医学大型多模态模型（LMMs）在医学数据解读方面已展现出显著能力。然而，这些模型经常生成与源证据相矛盾的幻觉，尤其是由于定位推理不足。这项工作揭示了当前医学 LMMs 的一个关键局限：在回答疾病相关查询时，它们往往依赖语言模式或关注不相关的图像区域，而不是分析相关的病理区域。

4a832891838276fcf39827533df5a41a46ff929e.title: Concentrate on Weakness: Mining Hard Prototypes for Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
4a832891838276fcf39827533df5a41a46ff929e.abstract: Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation (FSMIS) has been widely used to train a model that can perform segmentation from only a few annotated images. However, most existing prototype-based FSMIS methods generate multiple prototypes from the support image solely by random sampling or local averaging, which can cause particularly severe boundary blurring due to the tendency for normal features accounting for the majority of features of a specific category. Consequently, we propose to focus more attention to those weaker features that are crucial for clear segmentation boundary. Specifically, we design a Support Self-Prediction (SSP) module to identify such weak features by comparing true support mask with one predicted by global support prototype. 9424a52439742314adf00eb2ed914b8b8618d1ef.title: RRG-Mamba: Efficient Radiology Report Generation with State Space Model
9424a52439742314adf00eb2ed914b8b8618d1ef.abstract: Recent advancements in radiology report generation have utilized deep neural networks such as CNNs and Transformers, achieving notable improvements in generating accurate and detailed reports. However, their practical adoption is hindered by the challenge of balancing global dependency modeling with computational efficiency. The state space model, particularly its enhanced variant Mamba, offers promising linear-complexity solutions for long-range dependency modeling. Despite its strengths, Mamba’s fixed positional encoding limits its ability to effectively capture complex spatial dependencies. To address this gap, we propose RRG-Mamba, an advanced framework for efficient radiology report generation. 6a9e064a40377c7a14f0f52cffb343d29fde6348.title: Rewarding Explainability in Drug Repurposing with Knowledge Graphs
6a9e064a40377c7a14f0f52cffb343d29fde6348.abstract:
Knowledge graphs (KGs) are powerful tools for modelling complex, multi-relational data and supporting hypothesis generation, particularly in applications like drug repurposing. However, for predictive methods to gain acceptance as credible scientific tools, they must ensure not only accuracy but also the capacity to offer meaningful scientific explanations.



This paper presents a novel approach REx, for generating scientific explanations based in link prediction in knowledge graphs. It employs reward and policy mechanisms that consider desirable properties of scientific explanation to guide a reinforcement learning agent in the identification of explanatory paths within a KG. The approach further enriches explanatory paths with domain-specific ontologies, ensuring that the explanations are both insightful and grounded in established biomedical knowledge.

644cb6478e2e34f6aca5cb3ce2ead36ba5abeb5e.title: POMP: Pathology-omics Multimodal Pre-training Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction
644cb6478e2e34f6aca5cb3ce2ead36ba5abeb5e.abstract: Cancer survival prediction is an important direction in precision medicine, aiming to help clinicians tailor treatment regimens for patients. With the rapid development of high-throughput sequencing and computational pathology technologies, survival prediction has shifted from clinical features to joint modeling of multi-omics data and pathology images. However, existing multimodal learning methods struggle to effectively learn pathology-omics interactions due to the lack of proper alignment of multimodal data before fusion. In this paper, we propose POMP, a pathology-omics multimodal pre-training framework jointly learned with three training tasks for integrating pathological images and omics data for cancer survival prediction. 644cb6478e2e34f6aca5cb3ce2ead36ba5abeb5e.zh_title: POMP：面向癌症生存预测的病理-组学多模态预训练框架

3c3af643fd11e50ce9da1b13f2938ecc88b475e1.title: MVP-CBM:Multi-layer Visual Preference-enhanced Concept Bottleneck Model for Explainable Medical Image Classification
3c3af643fd11e50ce9da1b13f2938ecc88b475e1.abstract: The concept bottleneck model (CBM), as a technique improving interpretability via linking predictions to human-understandable concepts, makes high-risk and life-critical medical image classification credible. Typically, existing CBM methods associate the final layer of visual encoders with concepts to explain the model’s predictions. However, we empirically discover the phenomenon of concept preference variation, that is, the concepts are preferably associated with the features at different layers than those only at the final layer; yet a blind last-layer-based association neglects such a preference variation and thus weakens the accurate correspondences between features and concepts, impairing model interpretability. 3c3af643fd11e50ce9da1b13f2938ecc88b475e1.zh_title: MVP-CBM：多层视觉偏好增强的概念瓶颈模型

540feb22f87e4faebe1d2d24b39c131ef4ac26da.title: ImputeINR: Time Series Imputation via Implicit Neural Representations for Disease Diagnosis with Missing Data
540feb22f87e4faebe1d2d24b39c131ef4ac26da.abstract: Healthcare data frequently contain a substantial proportion of missing values, necessitating effective time series imputation to support downstream disease diagnosis tasks. However, existing imputation methods focus on discrete data points and are unable to effectively model sparse data, resulting in particularly poor performance for imputing substantial missing values. In this paper, we propose a novel approach, ImputeINR, for time series imputation by employing implicit neural representations (INR) to learn continuous functions for time series. ImputeINR leverages the merits of INR in that the continuous functions are not coupled to sampling frequency and have infinite sampling frequency, allowing ImputeINR to generate fine-grained imputations even on extremely sparse observed values. 33489535968e3bc9730168f2fbd5c509cc8797a7.title: Phenotypic Profile-Informed Generation of Drug-Like Molecules via Dual-Channel Variational Autoencoders
33489535968e3bc9730168f2fbd5c509cc8797a7.abstract: The de novo generation of drug-like molecules capable of inducing desirable phenotypic changes is receiving increasing attention. However, previous methods predominantly rely on expression profiles to guide molecule generation, but overlook the perturbative effect of the molecules on cellular contexts. To overcome this limitation, we propose SmilesGEN, a novel generative model based on variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture to generate molecules with potential therapeutic effects. SmilesGEN integrates a pre-trained drug VAE (SmilesNet) with an expression profile VAE (ProfileNet), jointly modeling the interplay between drug perturbations and transcriptional responses in a common latent space. Specifically, MHO employs adaptive learning rates for specific modalities to achieve heterogeneous optimization, thus enhancing robust reasoning capabilities.

5ef1618dfb46121098183c561899dc288805677f.summary: 提出因果效应驱动优化框架，缓解医学视觉问答中的语言偏差，提升模型鲁棒性。

13e84a33b53c565d7686b2d0adf2d2c8e5a93a41.title: DERI: Cross-Modal ECG Representation Learning with Deep ECG-Report Interaction
13e84a33b53c565d7686b2d0adf2d2c8e5a93a41.abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) is widely used to diagnose cardiac conditions via deep learning methods. Although existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods have achieved great performance in learning representation for ECG-based cardiac conditions classification, the clinical semantics can not be effectively captured. To overcome this limitation, we proposed to learn cross-modal ECG representations that contain more clinical semantics via a novel framework with \textbf{D}eep \textbf{E}CG-\textbf{R}eport \textbf{I}nteraction (\textbf{DERI}). Specifically, we design a novel framework combining multiple alignments and mutual feature reconstructions to learn effective representation of the ECG with the clinical report, which fuses the clinical semantics of the report. f3525d02dfb4d9336a0484c50df7601c1db76dc3.title: A Fast-Adaptive Cognitive Diagnosis Framework for Computerized Adaptive Testing Systems
f3525d02dfb4d9336a0484c50df7601c1db76dc3.abstract: Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT) measures student ability by iteratively selecting informative questions, with core components being the Cognitive Diagnosis Model (CDM) and selection strategy. Current research focuses on optimizing the selection strategy, assuming relatively accurate CDM results. However, existing static CDMs struggle with rapid and accurate diagnosis in the early stage of CAT. To this end, this paper proposes a Fast Adaptive Cognitive Diagnosis (FACD) framework, which incorporates dynamic collaborative and personalized diagnosis modules. Specifically, the collaborative module in FACD uses a dynamic response graph to quickly build student cognitive profiles, while the personalized module leverages each student's response sequence for robust and individualized diagnosis. 7044047a5e08826b90d7006432cad285edd12336.title: Wavelet Multi-scale Region-Enhanced Network for Medical Image Segmentation
7044047a5e08826b90d7006432cad285edd12336.abstract: Medical image segmentation is an important task in medical artificial intelligence. Traditional segmentation methods often suffer from the information loss problem, especially in medical image data which contain many different-scale organs or tissues. To address this problem, we propose a novel medical image segmentation method called Wavelet Multi-scale Region-Enhanced Network (WMREN), which has a UNet structure. In the encoder, we design a bi-branch feature extraction architecture, which simultaneously learns the representations with Haar wavelet transform and the residual blocks. The bi-branch architecture can effectively tackle the information loss problem when extracting features. In the decoder we design an innovative Spatial Adaptive Fusion Module to enhance the regions of interest. As we know, the boundaries of objects play an important role in segmentation. 7044047a5e08826b90d7006432cad285edd12336.zh_title: 小波多尺度区域增强网络用于医学图像分割
7044047a5e08826b90d7006432cad285edd12336.summary: 提出WMREN医学图像分割方法，采用UNet结构缓解多尺度组织的信息损失。
key_points: 医学图像分割是医学AI重要任务
传统方法常存在信息损失问题
WMREN设计双分支特征提取架构
7044047a5e08826b90d7006432cad285edd12336.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割是医学人工智能中的一项重要任务。传统分割方法常常遭受信息丢失问题，尤其是在包含许多不同尺度器官或组织的医学图像数据中。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新的医学图像分割方法，称为小波多尺度区域增强网络（Wavelet Multi-scale Region-Enhanced Network, WMREN），其具有 UNet 结构。在编码器中，我们设计了一种双分支特征提取架构，该架构同时学习基于 Haar 小波变换的表示和残差块。双分支架构能够在提取特征时有效解决信息丢失问题。在解码器中，我们设计了一种创新的空间自适应融合模块（Spatial Adaptive Fusion Module）来增强感兴趣区域。众所周知，对象边界在分割中起着重要作用。为此，我们还

99ec5caec2e6d4f9bd01b81fe47805ded3c4b5b8.title: Enhancing Multimodal Protein Function Prediction Through Dual-Branch Dynamic Selection with Reconstructive Pre-Training
99ec5caec2e6d4f9bd01b81fe47805ded3c4b5b8.abstract: Multimodal protein features play a crucial role in protein function prediction. However, these features encompass a wide range of information, ranging from structural data and sequence features to protein attributes and interaction networks, making it challenging to decipher their complex interconnections. In this work, we propose a multimodal protein function prediction method (DSRPGO) by utilizing dynamic selection and reconstructive pre-training mechanisms. To acquire complex protein information, we introduce reconstructive pre-training to mine more fine-grained information with low semantic levels. Moreover, we put forward the Bidirectional Interaction Module (BInM) to facilitate interactive learning among multimodal features. Additionally, to address the difficulty of hierarchical multi-label classification in this task, a Dynamic Selection Module (DSM) is designed to select the fea
99ec5caec2e6d4f9bd01b81fe47805ded3c4b5b8.zh_title: 动态选择与重构预训练的多模态蛋白功能预测
99ec5caec2e6d4f9bd01b81fe47805ded3c4b5b8.summary: 提出DSRPGO方法，通过双分支动态选择与重构预训练整合结构、序列及互作网络等多模态蛋白信息。
key_points: 整合结构与序列等多模态特征
双分支动态选择机制
重构式预训练策略
99ec5caec2e6d4f9bd01b81fe47805ded3c4b5b8.zh_abstract: 多模态蛋白质特征在蛋白质功能预测中起着至关重要的作用。然而，这些特征涵盖广泛的信息，从结构数据和序列特征到蛋白质属性和相互作用网络，使得解读其复杂的相互关联具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出一种多模态蛋白质功能预测方法（DSRPGO），利用动态选择和重构预训练机制。为了获取复杂的蛋白质信息，我们引入重构预训练，以挖掘更多具有低语义水平的细粒度信息。此外，我们提出双向交互模块（Bidirectional Interaction Module, BInM），以促进多模态特征之间的交互学习。另外，为解决该任务中分层多标签分类的困难，设计了动态选择模块（Dynamic Selection Module, DSM）以选择 fea

09d8b350c3ab43f2a7c38521299c3cf007ab28c8.title: Unlocking Dark Vision Potential for Medical Image Segmentation
09d8b350c3ab43f2a7c38521299c3cf007ab28c8.abstract: Accurate segmentation of lesions is crucial for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. However, blurring and low contrast in the imaging process can affect segmentation results. We have observed that noninvasive medical imaging shares considerable similarities with natural images under low light conditions and that nocturnal animals possess extremely strong night vision capabilities. Inspired by the dark vision of these nocturnal animals, we proposed a novel plug-and-play dark vision network (DVNet) to enhance the model's perception for low-contrast medical images. Specifically, by employing the wavelet transform, we decompose medical images into subbands of varying frequencies, mimicking the sensitivity of photoreceptor cells to different light intensities. To simulate the antagonistic receptive fields of horizontal cells and bipolar cells, we design a Mamba-Enhanced Fusion Module to
09d8b350c3ab43f2a7c38521299c3cf007ab28c8.zh_title: 仿夜行动物暗视觉的医学图像分割网络
09d8b350c3ab43f2a7c38521299c3cf007ab28c8.summary: 受夜行动物暗视觉启发，提出即插即用的暗视觉网络，用于改善模糊低对比医学图像的病灶分割。
key_points: 提出即插即用暗视觉网络
针对低对比与模糊成像
用于病灶分割以辅助诊疗规划
09d8b350c3ab43f2a7c38521299c3cf007ab28c8.zh_abstract: 病变的准确分割对于疾病诊断和治疗规划至关重要。然而，成像过程中的模糊和低对比度会影响分割结果。我们观察到，无创医学成像与低光照条件下的自然图像具有相当大的相似性，并且夜行动物拥有极强的夜视能力。受这些夜行动物暗视觉的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的即插即用暗视觉网络（DVNet），以增强模型对低对比度医学图像的感知。具体而言，通过采用小波变换，我们将医学图像分解为不同频率的子带，模拟感光细胞对不同光强度的敏感性。为了模拟水平细胞和双极细胞的拮抗感受野，我们设计了一个 Mamba 增强融合模块（Mamba-Enhanced Fusion Module）以

d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.title: SpeechHGT: A Multimodal Hypergraph Transformer for Speech-Based Early Alzheimer's Disease Detection
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.abstract: Early detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) through spontaneous speech analysis represents a promising, non-invasive diagnostic approach. Existing methods predominantly rely on fusion-based multimodal deep learning, effectively integrating linguistic and acoustic features. However, these methods inadequately model higher-order interactions between modalities, reducing diagnostic accuracy. To address this, we introduce SpeechHGT, a multimodal hypergraph transformer designed to capture and learn higher-order interactions in spontaneous speech features. SpeechHGT encodes multimodal features as hypergraphs, where nodes represent individual features and hyperedges represent grouped interactions. A novel hypergraph attention mechanism enables robust modeling of both pairwise and higher-order interactions. Experimental evaluations on the DementiaBank datasets reveal that SpeechHGT achieves stat
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.zh_title: SpeechHGT：基于语音的多模态超图 Transformer 阿尔茨海默病早期检测
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.summary: 提出多模态超图 Transformer SpeechHGT，从自发语音中建模模态间高阶交互以早期检测阿尔茨海默病。
key_points: 基于自发语音的非侵入式筛查
超图建模模态间高阶交互
融合语言与声学特征
d7ffff2cd9825ad908c62239090ff63bd96f5333.zh_abstract: 通过自发语音分析对阿尔茨海默病（AD）进行早期检测是一种有前景的非侵入性诊断方法。现有方法主要依赖基于融合的多模态深度学习，有效整合语言和声学特征。然而，这些方法未能充分建模模态之间的高阶交互，从而降低了诊断准确率。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SpeechHGT，一种多模态超图 Transformer，旨在捕捉并学习自发语音特征中的高阶交互。SpeechHGT 将多模态特征编码为超图，其中节点表示单个特征，超边表示分组交互。一种新颖的超图注意力机制能够对成对交互和高阶交互进行稳健建模。在 DementiaBank 数据集上的实验评估表明，SpeechHGT 实现了 stat

e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.title: ActiveHAI: Active Collection Based Human-AI Diagnosis with Limited Expert Predictions
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.abstract: Recent studies indicate that human-AI collaboration performs better than either alone, particularly in medical diagnosis. Beyond collaboration methods that focus on assigning tasks to humans or AI, like deferral, combining human and AI decisions with their confidence scores is emerging as a promising strategy. Due to high cognitive load, doctors often struggle to provide confidence assessments, necessitating explicit human uncertainty evaluation through a limited number of additional expert predictions. There are two challenges. (1) how to actively collect limited yet representative expert predictions? (2) how to accurately evaluate human uncertainty with limited expert predictions? To address the challenges, we propose ActiveHAI, an active human-AI diagnosis method that reduces expert costs through a median-window sampling strategy that actively selects representative samples near the e
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.zh_title: ActiveHAI：有限专家预测下的人机协作诊断
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.summary: 提出ActiveHAI，通过有限次额外专家预测显式评估人类不确定性，结合人与AI决策及置信度提升医学诊断。
key_points: 人机协作优于单独一方决策
医生高认知负荷下难给出置信度
以有限专家预测量化人类不确定性
e853adaabb8205addc6bd9afd872b3b4bbca851a.zh_abstract: 近期研究表明，人-AI 协作的表现优于任何单独一方，尤其是在医学诊断中。除了将任务分配给人类或 AI 的协作方法（如转交/deferral）之外，将人类和 AI 的决策及其置信度分数结合起来正成为一种有前景的策略。由于高认知负荷，医生往往难以提供置信度评估，因此需要通过有限数量的额外专家预测来显式评估人类不确定性。这里有两个挑战。(1) 如何主动收集有限但具有代表性的专家预测？(2) 如何利用有限的专家预测准确评估人类不确定性？为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ActiveHAI，一种主动人-AI 诊断方法，通过中位窗口采样策略主动选择靠近 e 的代表性样本，从而降低专家成本。

d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.title: KGCL: Knowledge-Enhanced Graph Contrastive Learning for Retrosynthesis Prediction Based on Molecular Graph Editing
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.abstract: Retrosynthesis, which predicts the reactants of a given target molecule, is an essential task for drug discovery. Retrosynthesis prediction based on molecular graph editing has garnered widespread attention due to excellent interpretability. Existing methods fail to effectively incorporate the chemical knowledge when learning molecular representations. To address this issue, we propose a Knowledge-enhanced Graph Contrastive Learning model (KGCL), which retrieve functional group embeddings from a chemical knowledge graph and integrate them into the atomic embeddings of the product molecule using an attention mechanism. Furthermore, we introduce a graph contrastive learning strategy that generates augmented samples using graph edits to improve the molecular graph encoder. Our proposed method outperforms the strong baseline method Graph2Edits by 1.6% and 3.2% in terms of the top-1 accuracy
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.zh_title: KGCL：知识增强图对比学习的逆合成预测
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.summary: 提出知识增强图对比学习模型KGCL，基于分子图编辑做逆合成预测，从官能团嵌入中融入化学知识以提升分子表示。
key_points: 逆合成预测是药物发现的关键任务
基于分子图编辑的方法可解释性较好
已有方法未有效融入化学知识
d4a7f99bf49800c2c30521a3512e4b3f933a116b.zh_abstract: 逆合成（Retrosynthesis）预测给定目标分子的反应物，是药物发现中的一项关键任务。基于分子图编辑的逆合成预测因具有出色的可解释性而受到广泛关注。现有方法在学习分子表示时未能有效融入化学知识。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种知识增强图对比学习模型（Knowledge-enhanced Graph Contrastive Learning model, KGCL），该模型从化学知识图谱中检索官能团嵌入，并通过注意力机制将其整合到产物分子的原子嵌入中。此外，我们引入了一种图对比学习策略，利用图编辑生成增强样本以改进分子图编码器。我们提出的方法在 top-1 准确率方面分别以 1.6% 和 3.2% 优于强基线方法 Graph2Edits。

cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.title: KnowMDD: Knowledge-guided Cross Contrastive Learning for Major Depressive Disorder Diagnosis
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.abstract: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) is a prevalent and severe mental disease. Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI)-based diagnostic methods, which analyze Functional Connectivity (FC) to identify abnormal functional connections, have shown promise as biomarker-based approaches for diagnosing depression. However, the high costs of fMRI data result in small sample sizes, hindering the effective identification of abnormal FC patterns. Moreover, existing methods often overlook the potential benefits of incorporating domain knowledge into their models. In this paper, we propose KnowMDD, a novel knowledge-guided cross contrastive learning framework for MDD diagnosis. By incorporating domain knowledge and employing data augmentation, KnowMDD addresses data sparsity while improving robustness and interpretability. Specifically, multiple atlases are used to construct complementary brain graph
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.zh_title: KnowMDD：知识引导交叉对比学习诊断重度抑郁症
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.summary: 提出知识引导的交叉对比学习方法KnowMDD，基于fMRI功能连接辅助重度抑郁症诊断。
key_points: fMRI功能连接可作为抑郁症诊断标志
fMRI成本高导致样本量小
现有方法未充分利用潜在信息
cbf171518433fd10b42a977bb2f74506391c0d07.zh_abstract: 重性抑郁障碍（Major Depressive Disorder, MDD）是一种普遍且严重的精神疾病。基于功能磁共振成像（Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging, fMRI）的诊断方法通过分析功能连接（Functional Connectivity, FC）来识别异常功能连接，已显示出作为基于生物标志物方法用于诊断抑郁症的前景。然而，fMRI 数据的高成本导致样本量小，阻碍了对异常 FC 模式的有效识别。此外，现有方法常常忽视将领域知识纳入其模型的潜在益处。在本文中，我们提出了 KnowMDD，一种用于 MDD 诊断的新型知识引导交叉对比学习框架。通过融入领域知识并采用数据增强，KnowMDD 解决了数据稀疏性问题，同时提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。具体而言，使用多个图谱构建互补的大脑图（complementary brain graph）。

aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.title: A Medical Image Classification Network Based on Multi-View Consistent Momentum Contrastive Learning
aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.abstract: Due to variations in imaging conditions, images often exhibit discrepancies in color reproduction. Furthermore, motion-induced blur can lead to edge degradation, making color sensitivity and edge blurriness two prevalent and challenging issues in both natural image processing and medical image analysis. To address these challenges, we propose a model termed the Three-View Consistency Mo-mentum Contrastive with Sobel Operator (SVCMC). Specifically, we first design a three-view momen-tum-update architecture that employs a So-bel-augmented ResNet as the backbone. We then introduce a novel contrastive loss, referred to as the Three-View Consistency Momentum Contrastive Loss. Next, to mitigate the oscillations and slow convergence commonly observed in contrastive learning, we construct a dynamic contrastive loss function that adapts in real time over the training process. Finally, we validate
aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.zh_title: 基于多视角一致动量对比学习的医学图像分类网络
aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.summary: IJCAI 2025 提出 SVCMC，用三视角一致动量更新结合 Sobel 算子，应对医学图像颜色差异与运动模糊问题。
key_points: 颜色敏感与边缘模糊是常见挑战
设计三视角动量更新机制
融合 Sobel 算子构建对比学习模型
aa6db77ac47fff0d5c6f02481cb9a5be6eaf34de.zh_abstract: 由于成像条件的变化，图像在颜色再现方面常常表现出差异。此外，运动引起的模糊会导致边缘退化，使颜色敏感性和边缘模糊成为自然图像处理和医学图像分析中两个普遍且具有挑战性的问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种称为基于 Sobel 算子的三视图一致性动量对比模型（Three-View Consistency Momentum Contrastive with Sobel Operator, SVCMC）。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种三视图动量更新架构，采用 Sobel 增强的 ResNet 作为骨干网络。然后，我们引入了一种新的对比损失，称为三视图一致性动量对比损失（Three-View Consistency Momentum Contrastive Loss）。接下来，为缓解对比学习中常见的振荡和收敛缓慢问题，我们构建了一个在训练过程中实时自适应的动态对比损失函数。最后，我们验证

6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.title: DFCA: Disentangled Feature Contrastive Learning and Augmentation for Fairer Dermatological Diagnostics
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.abstract: With the increasing integration of AI in medical research and applications, the issue of fairness has become as critical as diagnostic accuracy. In dermatology diagnosis, the challenge of class-imbalanced data, which is sometimes limited and contains demographic attributes, results in an imbalanced and insufficient representation within the feature space of deep learning models. Besides, feature entanglement within deep learning models confuses skin tone and disease condition information, impairing model performance among vulnerable groups. Moreover, feature entanglement often constrains the efforts to mitigate unfairness, entailing a trade-off between fairness and diagnostic accuracy. This paper introduces the Disentangled Feature Contrastive learning and Augmentation framework (DFCA), aiming to enhance fairness in dermatological diagnoses without compromising accuracy. Initially, DFCA
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.zh_title: DFCA：解耦特征对比学习与增强用于更公平皮肤病诊断
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.summary: 提出DFCA方法，通过解耦特征对比学习与增强，缓解皮肤病诊断中的数据不平衡和特征纠缠带来的公平性问题。
key_points: AI医疗中公平性与诊断准确性同样关键
皮肤病诊断数据类别不平衡且含人口属性
特征纠缠混淆肤色与疾病信息，影响公平
6fb86f1c358911abcc5d8b5c0baa2d670393046b.zh_abstract: 随着 AI 在医学研究和应用中的日益融合，公平性问题已变得与诊断准确性同样关键。在皮肤病学诊断中，类别不平衡数据的挑战——这些数据有时有限且包含人口统计学属性——导致深度学习模型特征空间中的表示不平衡且不充分。此外，深度学习模型中的特征纠缠混淆了肤色和疾病状况信息，损害了模型在弱势群体中的性能。而且，特征纠缠常常制约了减轻不公平性的努力，从而导致公平性与诊断准确性之间的权衡。本文介绍了解缠特征对比学习与增强框架（Disentangled Feature Contrastive learning and Augmentation framework, DFCA），旨在不牺牲准确性的情况下提高皮肤病学诊断中的公平性。起初，DFCA

335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.title: MolHFCNet: Enhancing Molecular Graph Representations with Hierarchical Feature Combining and Hybrid Pretraining
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.abstract: Efficient molecular property prediction is crucial in bioinformatics and cheminformatics, with applications in drug discovery, materials science, and chemical engineering. This paper introduces MolHFCNet, a graph neural network designed to enhance molecular representation learning. At its core, the n-Hierarchical Features Combining (n-HFC) module aggregates information across multiple hierarchical feature spaces, effectively capturing both local and global graph structures. Unlike conventional models, n-HFC maintains computational complexity comparable to a single full-dimensional graph layer while supporting either 2D or 3D molecular graphs, ensuring flexibility across tasks. Furthermore, we propose a novel graph pretraining strategy that integrates predictive and contrastive learning, enabling the model to capture local chemical interactions and global molecular contexts for robust emb
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.zh_title: MolHFCNet：分子图表示与混合预训练
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.summary: 提出MolHFCNet图神经网络，通过层次特征组合与混合预训练增强分子表示学习。
key_points: 面向分子性质预测任务
n-HFC聚合多层级特征
结合混合预训练策略
335d780170f411902fa79e77808b02fb592c98f9.zh_abstract: 高效分子性质预测在生物信息学和化学信息学中至关重要，其应用涵盖药物发现、材料科学和化学工程。本文介绍 MolHFCNet，一种旨在增强分子表示学习的图神经网络。其核心是 n-Hierarchical Features Combining (n-HFC) 模块，该模块跨多个层次化特征空间聚合信息，有效捕获局部和全局图结构。与传统模型不同，n-HFC 保持与单个全维图层相当的计算复杂度，同时支持 2D 或 3D 分子图，确保跨任务的灵活性。此外，我们提出一种新颖的图预训练策略，该策略整合预测学习和对比学习，使模型能够捕获局部化学相互作用和全局分子背景，以获得稳健的嵌入

0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.title: InstGAN: Instant Actor-Critic-Driven GAN for De Novo Molecule Generation and Property Optimization
0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.abstract: Deep generative models, such as generative adversarial networks (GANs), have been employed for de~novo molecular generation in drug discovery. Most prior studies have utilized reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms, particularly Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), to handle the discrete nature of molecular representations in GANs. However, due to the inherent instability in training GANs and RL models, along with the high computational cost associated with MCTS sampling, MCTS RL-based GANs struggle to scale to large chemical databases. To tackle these challenges, this study introduces a novel GAN based on actor-critic RL with instant and global rewards, called InstGAN, to generate molecules at the token-level with multi-property optimization. 0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.zh_title: InstGAN：面向药物发现的即时分子生成与优化
0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.summary: 提出 InstGAN，用 actor-critic 驱动的 GAN 进行全新分子生成与性质优化，以应对 GAN 与强化学习不稳定及 MCTS 采样高成本问题。
key_points: 用于药物发现的全新分子生成
采用 actor-critic 驱动 GAN
针对 GAN/RL 不稳定与 MCTS 高成本
0121037641b1f5662ee29604d8126439cec402f4.zh_abstract: 深度生成模型，例如生成对抗网络（GANs），已被用于药物发现中的 de~novo 分子生成。大多数先前研究利用强化学习（RL）算法，特别是蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），来处理 GAN 中分子表示的离散性质。然而，由于训练 GAN 和 RL 模型固有的不稳定性，以及 MCTS 采样相关的高计算成本，基于 MCTS RL 的 GAN 难以扩展到大型化学数据库。为应对这些挑战，本研究引入一种基于 actor-critic RL 且具有即时和全局奖励的新型 GAN，称为 InstGAN，以在 token 级别生成分子并进行多性质优化。此外，利用最大化信息熵来缓解模式崩溃。实验结果表明，InstGAN 优于 o

e01c29528fe38af9edef553ddcf4cd80c558e33b.title: Multi-Omics Analysis for Cancer Subtype Inference via Unrolling Graph Smoothness Priors
e01c29528fe38af9edef553ddcf4cd80c558e33b.abstract:

Existing approaches often neglect the intricate coupling between heterogeneous omics, limiting their capacity to resolve subtle cancer subtype heterogeneity critical for precision oncology.

To address these limitations, we propose a framework named Graph Transformer for Multi-omics Cancer Subtype Classification (GTMancer).

This framework builds upon the GNN optimization problem and extends its application to complex multi-omics data.

e01c29528fe38af9edef553ddcf4cd80c558e33b.zh_title: 基于展开图平滑先验的多组学癌症亚型推断
e01c29528fe38af9edef553ddcf4cd80c558e33b.summary: 提出通过展开图平滑先验整合多组学数据，用于癌症亚型推断。

d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.title: Self-calibration Enhanced Whole Slide Pathology Image Analysis
d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.abstract: Pathology images are considered the ``gold standard" for cancer diagnosis and treatment, with gigapixel images providing extensive tissue and cellular information. Existing methods fail to simultaneously extract global structural and local detail features for comprehensive pathology image analysis efficiently. To address these limitations, we propose a self-calibration enhanced framework for whole slide pathology image analysis, comprising three components: a global branch, a focus predictor, and a detailed branch. The global branch initially classifies using the pathological thumbnail, while the focus predictor identifies relevant regions for classification based on the last layer features of the global branch. d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.zh_title: 自校准增强的全切片病理图像分析
d4c0c19a66fe246684f1684ead1090692df041ff.summary: 提出自校准增强框架，含全局分支与聚焦预测器，用于全切片病理图像的全局结构与局部细节分析。
key_points: 面向十亿像素级全切片病理图像
现有方法难以兼顾全局结构与局部细节

c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.title: Volumetric Axial Disentanglement Enabling Advancing in Medical Image Segmentation
c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.abstract: Information retrieved from three dimensions is treated uniformly in CNN-based volumetric segmentation methods. However, such neglect of axial disparities fails to capture true spatio-temporal variations. This paper introduces the volumetric axial disentanglement to address the disparities in spatial information along different axial dimensions. Building on this concept, we propose the Post-Axial Refiner (PaR) module to refine segmentation masks by implementing axial disentanglement on the specific axis of the volumetric medical sequences. As a plug-and-play enhancement to existing volumetric segmentation architecture, PaR further utilizes specialized attention approaches to learn disentangled post-decoding features, enhancing spatial representation and structural detail. Validation on various datasets demonstrates PaR's consistent elevation of segmentation precision and boundary clarity
c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.zh_title: 体积轴向解耦提升医学图像分割
c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.summary: 提出体积轴向解耦概念与Post-Axial Refiner模块，区分不同轴向空间信息差异以细化分割掩膜。
key_points: 指出现有CNN忽视三维轴向差异
提出体积轴向解耦概念
PaR模块据此细化分割掩膜
c6f688b046b4dda141e2dce663e77d0abed74406.zh_abstract: 在基于 CNN 的体数据分割方法中，从三个维度检索到的信息被统一处理。然而，这种对轴向差异的忽视无法捕捉真实的时空变化。本文引入体轴向解缠（volumetric axial disentanglement），以应对沿不同轴向维度的空间信息差异。基于这一概念，我们提出 Post-Axial Refiner（PaR）模块，通过在体医学序列的特定轴上实施轴向解缠来细化分割掩膜。作为对现有体数据分割架构的即插即用增强，PaR 进一步利用专门的注意力方法来学习解缠后的解码后特征，增强空间表示和结构细节。在各种数据集上的验证表明，PaR 能够持续提升分割精度和边界清晰度

93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.abstract: Inferring causal protein signaling networks from human immune system cellular data is an important approach to reveal underlying tissue signaling biology and dysfunction in diseased cells. In recent years, reinforcement learning (RL) methods have shown excellent performance in the field of causal protein signaling network inference. However, the complexity of RL models and the need for manual hyperparameter tuning can hinder performance. In this paper, we propose a actor-critic RL model via artificial bee colony (ABC) neural architecture search, called ABCNAS-RL. Specifically, the entire method is divided into two phases: ABC neural architecture search and actor-critic RL search. In phase one, we represent each bee as a set of hyperparameter, utilizing the ABC algorithm searching for optimal hyperparameters of the actor-critic RL model on the training set. 93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.zh_title: 强化学习结合蜂群架构搜索推断蛋白信号网络
93f68c21235b13499d45dd287197fe4d635a794b.summary: 提出结合人工蜂群神经架构搜索的 actor-critic 强化学习模型，从免疫细胞数据推断因果蛋白信号网络。

913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.title: CFII-Net: Explicit Class Embeddings and Feature Maps Through Iterative Interaction for Boosting Medical Image Segmentation
913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.abstract: Prior knowledge of category structure is essential in medical image segmentation, especially with significant organ structure differences. However, current hybrid architectures primarily focus on enhancing pixel-level representation learning, often neglecting or weakening the key prior knowledge of categorical structures, which poses challenges in capturing category relationships and accurate segmenting. To address this concern, we propose a novel network using Explicit Class Embeddings and Feature Maps through Iterative Interaction (CFII-Net) for boosting medical image segmentation. CFII-Net effectively segments images by exploring the relationship between explicit class embeddings and pixels in images. 913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.zh_title: CFII-Net：迭代交互的类别嵌入与特征图分割
913736a2096e5fe8acf28736e78f659781e6490c.summary: 通过显式类别嵌入与特征图迭代交互引入类别结构先验，提升医学图像分割对类别关系的刻画。

6689d493775b0ed4ad7acc940d662a873e202dd5.abstract:
Fault Diagnosis (FD) in time-varying data presents considerations such as limited training data, intra- and inter-dimensional correlations, and constraints of training time. In response, this paper introduces FD in the Reservoir-Embedded-Directional Network (REDNet) model space. Model-oriented methods utilize well-fitted networks or functions, denoted as "models" that capture data's changing information, as more stable and parsimonious representations of the data. Our approach employs REDNet for data fitting, wherein multiple reservoirs are organized along intrinsic correlation directions to establish intra- and inter-dimensional dependencies, thereby capturing multi-directional dynamics in high-dimensional data.

6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.title: Data Poisoning Attack Defense and Evolutionary Domain Adaptation for Federated Medical Image Segmentation
6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.abstract: Federated learning has significant demonstrated potential in medical image segmentation to protect data privacy by retaining local data. However, its application is still hindered by two critical challenges: 1) the retained data poisoning attacks that severely compromise the accuracy of the global segmentation model and 2) domain gaps among clients, undermining its generalizability. To address these issues, we propose AdaShield-FL, a data poisoning attack defense and evolutionary domain adaptation for federated medical image segmentation. AdaShield-FL incorporates a disentangled reconstruction and segmentation module that purifies data in the k-space domain to mitigate the effects of adversarial attacks iteratively. 6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.zh_title: 联邦医学图像分割的投毒防御与域适应
6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.summary: 提出AdaShield-FL，在联邦医学图像分割中同时应对数据投毒攻击与客户端间域差距。
key_points: 联邦场景下数据投毒损害全局模型精度

6007a50bbab2c85706f8b5dd88e9337a8c23dbaf.zh_abstract: 联邦学习在医学图像分割中已明显展现出通过保留本地数据来保护数据隐私的巨大潜力。然而，其应用仍受两个关键挑战阻碍：1）留存数据投毒攻击会严重损害全局分割模型的准确性；2）客户端之间的域差距削弱了其泛化能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出 AdaShield-FL，一种用于联邦医学图像分割的数据投毒攻击防御与进化域适应方法。AdaShield-FL 包含一个解耦重建与分割模块，该模块在 k 空间域中净化数据，以迭代地减轻对抗攻击的影响。此外，它引入了一种数据投毒攻击检测机制，通过分析训练损失序列中的异常模式来识别恶意客户端。该方法还

2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.title: M2LLM: Multi-view Molecular Representation Learning with Large Language Models
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.abstract: Accurate molecular property prediction is a critical challenge with wide-ranging applications in chemistry, materials science, and drug discovery. Molecular representation methods, including fingerprints and graph neural networks (GNNs), achieve state-of-the-art results by effectively deriving features from molecular structures. However, these methods often overlook decades of accumulated semantic and contextual knowledge. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning abilities and prior knowledge across scientific domains, leading us to hypothesize that LLMs can generate rich molecular representations when guided to reason in multiple perspectives. To address these gaps, we propose M^2LLM, a multi-view framework that integrates three perspectives: the molecular structure view, the molecular task view, and the molecular rules view. These views are f
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.zh_title: M2LLM：多视图分子表示学习与大语言模型
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.summary: 提出M2LLM，结合多视图分子表示与大语言模型，用于分子性质预测，服务化学、材料与药物发现。
key_points: 融合多视图分子表示
利用大语言模型语义知识
提升分子性质预测性能
2bed739b9675a83664e25af8f7074e5e375c2767.zh_abstract: 准确的分子性质预测是一个关键挑战，在化学、材料科学和药物发现中具有广泛的应用。分子表示方法，包括指纹和图神经网络（GNNs），通过有效从分子结构中提取特征，取得了最先进的结果。然而，这些方法常常忽略了数十年来积累的语义和上下文知识。大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展展示了跨科学领域的显著推理能力和先验知识，使我们假设当引导LLMs从多个角度进行推理时，它们能够生成丰富的分子表示。为弥补这些差距，我们提出M^2LLM，一个多视角框架，整合了三个视角：分子结构视角、分子任务视角和分子规则视角。这些视角是 f

03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.title: MCD-CLIP: Multi-view Chest Disease Diagnosis with Disentangled CLIP
03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.abstract: Pre-trained methods for multi-view chest X-ray images have demonstrated impressive performance in chest disease diagnosis, but there are still some limitations that need to be addressed. Firstly, many pre-trained methods require full fine-tuning pre-trained models to induce significant computational resource usage and the prior knowledge destruction. Secondly, many pre-trained methods cannot efficiently balance consistency and complementarity among views, leading to information loss and performance degradation. To tackle these issues, we propose MCD-CLIP, a CLIP-based multi-view chest disease diagnosis method. It uses visual prompts and a Prompt-Aligner to align prompts across views, along with the additional text representation for efficient transfer. Moreover, we employ Adapters to disentangle the image representation, maintaining consistency and complementarity from different views. E
03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.zh_title: MCD-CLIP：多视图胸部疾病诊断的解耦CLIP
03dd889367a857ee88b1dc9179978a2a97469ba5.summary: IJCAI 2025提出MCD-CLIP，用解耦CLIP进行多视图胸部X光疾病诊断，兼顾视图一致性与互补性。
key_points: 解决全量微调计算开销大和知识破坏

d9954145c0d527aebe71b8041c5c1115f21db2f2.title: Underground Diagnosis in 3D GPR Data by Learning in CuCoRes Model Space
d9954145c0d527aebe71b8041c5c1115f21db2f2.abstract: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) provides detailed subterranean insights. Nevertheless, underground diagnosis via GPR is hindered by the fact that training data typically contain only normal samples, along with the complexity of GPR data’s wave-collection characteristics. This paper proposes subsurface anomaly detection within the Cubic Correlation Reservoir Network (CuCoRes) model space. CuCoRes incorporates three reservoirs with spatial correlation adjustment in each direction to adequately and accurately capture multi-directional dynamics (i.e., changing information) within GPR data. Fitting GPR data with CuCoRes and representing data with fitted models, the original GPR data is mapped into a category-discriminative CuCoRes model space, where anomalies could be efficiently identified and categorized based on model dissimilarities. c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.title: PAMol: Pocket-Aware Drug Design Method with Hypergraph Representation of Protein Pocket Structure and Feature Fusion
c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.abstract: Efficient generation of targeted drug molecules is crucial in the field of drug discovery. Most existing methods neglect the high-order information in the structure of protein pockets, limiting the performance of generated drug molecules. This paper proposes a pocket-aware drug design framework, namely PAMol, constructing the hypergraph to represent the spatial structure of protein pockets, effectively capturing high-order relations and neighborhood information within the pocket structures. This framework also fuses different modal embeddings from proteins and molecules, to generate high-quality molecules. In addition, a conditional molecule generation module uses the high-order structural information in protein pockets as constraints to more accurately generate molecules for specific targets. c62998658810a246f00a826f7a7ecee3db649452.zh_abstract: 高效生成靶向药物分子在药物发现领域至关重要。大多数现有方法忽略了蛋白质口袋结构中的高阶信息，限制了所生成药物分子的性能。本文提出了一种口袋感知的药物设计框架，即 PAMol，构建超图来表示蛋白质口袋的空间结构，有效捕获口袋结构内的高阶关系和邻域信息。该框架还融合来自蛋白质和分子的不同模态嵌入，以生成高质量分子。此外，一个条件分子生成模块以蛋白质口袋中的高阶结构信息作为约束，更准确地为特定靶标生成分子。PAMol 的性能已通过从 vina sc 方面分析所生成的分子进行评估

538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.title: RPMIL: Rethinking Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Multiple Instance Learning for Whole Slide Pathology Diagnosis
538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.abstract: Whole slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel digital scans of traditional pathology slides, offering substantial support for cancer diagnosis. Current multiple instance learning (MIL) methods for WSIs typically extract instance features and aggregate these into a single bag feature for prediction. We observe that these MIL methods rely on point estimation, where each bag is mapped to a deterministic embedding. Such MIL methods based on point estimation fail to capture the full spectrum of data variability due to the reliance on fixed embedding, especially when the number of trainable bags is limited. In this paper, we rethink probabilistic modeling in MIL and propose RPMIL, an uncertainty-aware probabilistic MIL method for whole slide pathology diagnosis. RPMIL learns a probabilistic aggregator to consolidate instance features into dynamic bag feature distributions instead of a deterministic
538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.zh_title: RPMIL：重思不确定性感知概率多实例学习用于全切片病理诊断
538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.summary: 该研究重思不确定性感知概率多实例学习，用于全切片病理图像诊断。
key_points: 全切片图像为癌症诊断提供重要支持
现有多实例学习多采用点估计聚合特征

538938a29a092ed0d0a6c61274781db0d91a4ecd.zh_abstract: 全切片图像（Whole Slide Images，WSI）是传统病理切片的千兆像素数字扫描，为癌症诊断提供了重要支持。当前用于 WSI 的多实例学习（multiple instance learning，MIL）方法通常提取实例特征，并将这些特征聚合为单个包（bag）特征用于预测。我们观察到，这些 MIL 方法依赖于点估计，即每个包被映射为一个确定性嵌入。此类基于点估计的 MIL 方法由于依赖固定嵌入，无法捕获数据变异性的完整谱系，尤其是在可训练的包数量有限时。在本文中，我们重新思考 MIL 中的概率建模，并提出 RPMIL，一种用于全切片病理诊断的不确定性感知概率 MIL 方法。RPMIL 学习一个概率聚合器，将实例特征整合为动态的包特征分布，而非一个确定性

52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.title: ElaD-Net: An Elastic Semantic Decoupling Network for Lesion Segmentation in Breast Ultrasound Images
52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.abstract: Breast diseases pose a significant threat to women’s health. Automatic lesion segmentation in breast ultrasound images (BUSI) plays a crucial role in fast diagnosis. While various enhanced U-Net-based models have achieved success in multi-scale feature analysis and handling blurred boundaries, two key challenges persist that could guide the improvement of BUSI segmentation networks: 1) significant fluctuations in pixel intensity distribution similarity between the lesion and surrounding tissues, and 2) inconsistent transmission of spatial detail due to multi-scale lesion sampling. These issues highlight the necessity of semantic elasticity understanding and consistency control. To this end, we propose ElaD-Net, an Elastic Semantic Decoupling Network for lesion segmentation in BUSI. This network uses the pre-trained EfficientNet-B2 for multi-scale encoding of BUSI. 52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.zh_title: ElaD-Net：乳腺超声图像病灶分割的弹性语义解耦网络
52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.summary: 提出弹性语义解耦网络ElaD-Net，用于乳腺超声图像病灶分割，应对病灶与周围组织像素强度相似等挑战。
key_points: 乳腺超声病灶分割有助快速诊断
