52cc1d3056c1fca972840a3c953f21f6b51ddbf1.zh_abstract: 乳腺疾病对女性健康构成重大威胁。乳腺超声图像（BUSI）中的自动病灶分割在快速诊断中起着关键作用。尽管各种增强的基于 U-Net 的模型在多尺度特征分析和处理模糊边界方面取得了成功，但仍存在两个关键挑战，可指导 BUSI 分割网络的改进：1）病灶与周围组织之间像素强度分布相似性的显著波动，以及 2）由于多尺度病灶采样导致的空间细节传递不一致。这些问题凸显了语义弹性理解和一致性控制的必要性。为此，我们提出 ElaD-Net，一种用于 BUSI 中病灶分割的弹性语义解耦网络（Elastic Semantic Decoupling Network）。该网络使用预训练的 EfficientNet-B2 对 BUSI 进行多尺度编码。解码阶段 feat

4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.title: REVE: A Foundation Model for EEG - Adapting to Any Setup with Large-Scale Pretraining on 25,000 Subjects
4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.abstract: Foundation models have transformed AI by reducing reliance on task-specific data through large-scale pretraining. While successful in language and vision, their adoption in EEG has lagged due to the heterogeneity of public datasets, which are collected under varying protocols, devices, and electrode configurations. Existing EEG foundation models struggle to generalize across these variations, often restricting pretraining to a single setup, resulting in suboptimal performance, in particular under linear probing. We present REVE (Representation for EEG with Versatile Embeddings), a pretrained model explicitly designed to generalize across diverse EEG signals. REVE introduces a novel 4D positional encoding scheme that enables it to process signals of arbitrary length and electrode arrangement. Using a masked autoencoding objective, we pretrain REVE on over 60,000 hours of EEG data from 92
4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.zh_title: REVE：可适配任意设置的EEG基础模型
4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出REVE，在2.5万名受试者上大规模预训练，旨在适应不同EEG采集设置。
key_points: 预训练覆盖2.5万名受试者
应对EEG数据集异质性
适配不同协议与电极配置
4bd4eb927e9d11b1b9567cf54a39d768d636fbff.zh_abstract: 基础模型通过大规模预训练减少了对任务特定数据的依赖，从而改变了 AI。尽管在语言和视觉领域取得了成功，但它们在 EEG 中的应用一直滞后，原因在于公共数据集的异质性——这些数据集是在不同的协议、设备和电极配置下收集的。现有的 EEG 基础模型难以在这些差异之间泛化，往往将预训练限制在单一设置中，导致性能欠佳，尤其是在线性探测（linear probing）下。我们提出 REVE（Representation for EEG with Versatile Embeddings，面向 EEG 的多功能嵌入表示），这是一个明确为跨多样 EEG 信号泛化而设计的预训练模型。REVE 引入了一种新颖的 4D 位置编码方案，使其能够处理任意长度的信号和电极排布。使用掩码自编码（masked autoencoding）目标，我们在来自 92 的超过 60,000 小时 EEG 数据上预训练 REVE。

5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.title: CSBrain: A Cross-scale Spatiotemporal Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding
5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.abstract: Understanding and decoding brain activity from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a fundamental challenge in neuroscience and AI, with applications in cognition, emotion recognition, diagnosis, and brain-computer interfaces. While recent EEG foundation models advance generalized decoding via unified architectures and large-scale pretraining, they adopt a scale-agnostic dense modeling paradigm inherited from NLP and vision. This design neglects a core property of neural activity: cross-scale spatiotemporal structure. EEG task patterns span a wide range of temporal and spatial scales, from short bursts to slow rhythms, and from localized cortical responses to distributed interactions. Ignoring this diversity leads to suboptimal representations and weak generalization. We propose CSBrain, a Cross-scale Spatiotemporal Brain foundation model for generalized EEG decoding. 5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.summary: 提出跨尺度时空脑基础模型CSBrain，用于EEG解码，强调神经活动的跨尺度特性。

5b26f69b54dfcab7c78554b45725f42da5a589dc.zh_abstract: 从脑电图（EEG）信号中理解和解码大脑活动是神经科学和人工智能中的一个基本挑战，其应用涵盖认知、情绪识别、诊断和脑机接口。尽管近期的EEG基础模型通过统一架构和大规模预训练推进了泛化解码，但它们采用了继承自自然语言处理（NLP）和视觉的与尺度无关的稠密建模范式。这种设计忽略了神经活动的一个核心特性：跨尺度时空结构。EEG任务模式跨越广泛的时间和空间尺度，从短促爆发到慢节律，从局部皮层反应到分布式交互。忽视这种多样性会导致次优表征和弱泛化。我们提出CSBrain，一种用于泛化EEG解码的跨尺度时空脑基础模型。CSBrain introduc

f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.title: GEM: Empowering MLLM for Grounded ECG Understanding with Time Series and Images
f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.abstract: While recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced automated ECG interpretation, they still face two key limitations: (1) insufficient multimodal synergy between time series signals and visual ECG representations, and (2) limited explainability in linking diagnoses to granular waveform evidence. We introduce GEM, the first MLLM unifying ECG time series, 12-lead ECG images and text for grounded and clinician-aligned ECG interpretation. f14b994542fb8ba5d8bd341a9680610330ccfd20.zh_title: GEM：面向心电时序与图像的循证理解多模态大模型

31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.title: QoQ-Med: Building Multimodal Clinical Foundation Models with Domain-Aware GRPO Training
31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.abstract: Clinical decision-making routinely demands reasoning over heterogeneous data, yet existing multimodal language models (MLLMs) remain largely vision-centric and fail to generalize across clinical specialties. To bridge this gap, we introduce QoQ-Med-7B/32B, the first open generalist clinical foundation model that jointly reasons across medical images, time-series signals, and text reports. QoQ-Med is trained with Domain-aware Relative Policy Optimization (DRPO), a novel reinforcement-learning objective that hierarchically scales normalized rewards according to domain rarity and modality difficulty, mitigating performance imbalance caused by skewed clinical data distributions. 31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.zh_title: QoQ-Med：领域感知GRPO的多模态临床基础模型

31d1c7055635090186b1d667055c990b8b6d828b.zh_abstract: 临床决策通常需要对异构数据进行推理，然而现有多模态语言模型（MLLMs）在很大程度上仍以视觉为中心，并且无法在临床专科之间泛化。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 QoQ-Med-7B/32B，这是首个开放的通用临床基础模型，可跨医学图像、时间序列信号和文本报告进行联合推理。QoQ-Med 使用领域感知相对策略优化（DRPO）训练，这是一种新颖的强化学习目标，其根据领域稀有性和模态难度分层缩放归一化奖励，从而缓解由偏斜的临床数据分布导致的性能不平衡。在涵盖 9 个临床领域的 261 万条指令调优对上进行训练后，我们表明，与其他 crit 相比，DRPO 训练在所有视觉领域上平均将诊断性能在 macro-F1 上提升 43%。

91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.title: MedAgentBoard: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Collaboration with Conventional Methods for Diverse Medical Tasks
91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has stimulated interest in multi-agent collaboration for addressing complex medical tasks. However, the practical advantages of multi-agent collaboration approaches remain insufficiently understood. Existing evaluations often lack generalizability, failing to cover diverse tasks reflective of real-world clinical practice, and frequently omit rigorous comparisons against both single-LLM-based and established conventional methods. To address this critical gap, we introduce MedAgentBoard, a comprehensive benchmark for the systematic evaluation of multi-agent collaboration, single-LLM, and conventional approaches. 91a4eb8e4f69f0a100d3bb4aa3d6e98d0a1bdf71.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展激发了人们对多智能体协作以解决复杂医学任务的兴趣。然而，多智能体协作方法的实际优势仍未得到充分理解。现有评估往往缺乏泛化性，未能覆盖反映真实临床实践的各种任务，并且经常缺少与基于单一 LLM 的方法以及已确立的传统方法之间的严格比较。为弥补这一关键空白，我们提出 MedAgentBoard，一个用于系统评估多智能体协作、单一 LLM 和传统方法的综合基准。MedAgentBoard 涵盖四个不同的医学任务类别：（1）医学（视觉）问答，（2）通俗摘要生成，（3）结构化电子健康记录（EHR）预测建模，以及（4）临床工作流 au

ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.title: PatientSim: A Persona-Driven Simulator for Realistic Doctor-Patient Interactions
ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.abstract: Doctor-patient consultations require multi-turn, context-aware communication tailored to diverse patient personas. Training or evaluating doctor LLMs in such settings requires realistic patient interaction systems. However, existing simulators often fail to reflect the full range of personas seen in clinical practice. To address this, we introduce PatientSim, a patient simulator that generates realistic and diverse patient personas for clinical scenarios, grounded in medical expertise. PatientSim operates using: 1) clinical profiles, including symptoms and medical history, derived from real-world data in the MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV datasets, and 2) personas defined by four axes: personality, language proficiency, medical history recall level, and cognitive confusion level, resulting in 37 unique combinations. ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.zh_title: PatientSim：角色驱动的医患交互模拟器
ec4031e9350fdb28447ef3b749c910edb51199d1.summary: 提出PatientSim患者模拟器，基于医学知识生成多样化的患者人设，用于训练或评估医生LLM。

15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.title: CARES: Comprehensive Evaluation of Safety and Adversarial Robustness in Medical LLMs
15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in medical contexts, raising critical concerns about safety, alignment, and susceptibility to adversarial manipulation. While prior benchmarks assess model refusal capabilities for harmful prompts, they often lack clinical specificity, graded harmfulness levels, and coverage of jailbreak-style attacks. We introduce CARES (Clinical Adversarial Robustness and Evaluation of Safety), a benchmark for evaluating LLM safety in healthcare. CARES includes over 18,000 prompts spanning eight medical safety principles, four harm levels, and four prompting styles: direct, indirect, obfuscated, and role-play, to simulate both malicious and benign use cases. 15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.zh_title: CARES：医学大模型安全与对抗鲁棒性评估
15b8ead2bf17a7cc36bbe68b1830a46107ab43e6.summary: 提出CARES基准，从临床特异性、分级危害程度与越狱式攻击等方面评估医学大模型的安全性与对抗鲁棒性。

47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.title: Consistent Sampling and Simulation: Molecular Dynamics with Energy-Based Diffusion Models
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.abstract: In recent years, diffusion models trained on equilibrium molecular distributions have proven effective for sampling biomolecules. Beyond direct sampling, the score of such a model can also be used to derive the forces that act on molecular systems. However, while classical diffusion sampling usually recovers the training distribution, the corresponding energy-based interpretation of the learned score is often inconsistent with this distribution, even for low-dimensional toy systems. We trace this inconsistency to inaccuracies of the learned score at very small diffusion timesteps, where the model must capture the correct evolution of the data distribution. In this regime, diffusion models fail to satisfy the Fokker-Planck equation, which governs the evolution of the score. We interpret this deviation as one source of the observed inconsistencies and propose an energy-based diffusion mode
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.zh_title: 一致采样与模拟：基于能量扩散模型的分子动力学
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.summary: 针对扩散模型学习分数与能量解释不一致的问题，提出用于分子动力学采样的能量扩散模型方法。
key_points: 平衡态扩散模型可用于生物分子采样
学得分数导出的力与训练分布不一致
在低维玩具系统上追溯该不一致来源
47d104e45a0ffb4a42890db10352299f4ba2b850.zh_abstract: 近年来，在平衡分子分布上训练的扩散模型已被证明能有效用于生物分子采样。除了直接采样，此类模型的分数（score）也可用于推导作用于分子系统的力。然而，尽管经典扩散采样通常能恢复训练分布，但所学分数相应的基于能量的解释往往与该分布不一致，即使对于低维玩具系统也是如此。我们将这种不一致追溯至所学分数在非常小的扩散时间步长下的不准确性，此时模型必须捕捉数据分布的正确演化。在这种情形下，扩散模型无法满足 Fokker-Planck 方程，而该方程支配分数的演化。我们将这一偏差解释为所观察到的不一致性的一个来源，并提出一种基于能量的扩散 mode

d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.title: MIRA: Medical Time Series Foundation Model for Real-World Health Data
d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.abstract: A unified foundation model for medical time series -- pretrained on open access and ethics board-approved medical corpora -- offers the potential to reduce annotation burdens, minimize model customization, and enable robust transfer across clinical institutions, modalities, and tasks, particularly in data-scarce or privacy-constrained environments. However, existing generalist time series foundation models struggle to handle medical time series data due to their inherent challenges, including irregular intervals, heterogeneous sampling rates, and frequent missing values. To address these challenges, we introduce MIRA, a unified foundation model specifically designed for medical time series forecasting. MIRA incorporates a Continuous-Time Rotary Positional Encoding that enables fine-grained modeling of variable time intervals, a frequency-specific mixture-of-experts layer that routes comp
d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.zh_title: MIRA：面向真实世界健康数据的医学时间序列基础模型
d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.summary: 提出医学时间序列基础模型MIRA，在合规医学语料预训练，提升跨机构跨任务迁移能力。
key_points: 统一医学时间序列基础模型
预训练于开放与伦理批准的语料
减少标注负担并缓解数据稀缺
d64d108fd7fae6535543de8029bc0e40a02526ea.zh_abstract: 一个统一的医学时间序列基础模型——在开放获取和伦理委员会批准的医学语料库上预训练——具有减少标注负担、最小化模型定制，并实现跨临床机构、模态和任务的稳健迁移的潜力，特别是在数据稀缺或隐私受限的环境中。然而，现有的通用时间序列基础模型由于医学时间序列数据固有的挑战，包括不规则间隔、异质采样率和频繁缺失值，难以处理这些数据。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MIRA，一个专门为医学时间序列预测设计的统一基础模型。MIRA 包含连续时间旋转位置编码（Continuous-Time Rotary Positional Encoding），可对可变时间间隔进行细粒度建模；以及一个频率特定的专家混合层（frequency-specific mixture-of-experts layer），它路由 comp

04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.title: CPathAgent: An Agent-based Foundation Model for Interpretable High-Resolution Pathology Image Analysis Mimicking Pathologists' Diagnostic Logic
04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.abstract: Recent advances in computational pathology have led to the emergence of numerous foundation models. These models typically rely on general-purpose encoders with multi-instance learning for whole slide image (WSI) classification or apply multimodal approaches to generate reports directly from images. However, these models cannot emulate the diagnostic approach of pathologists, who systematically examine slides at low magnification to obtain an overview before progressively zooming in on suspicious regions to formulate comprehensive diagnoses. Instead, existing models directly output final diagnoses without revealing the underlying reasoning process. To address this gap, we introduce CPathAgent, an innovative agent-based approach that mimics pathologists'diagnostic workflow by autonomously navigating across WSI based on observed visual features, thereby generating substantially more transp
04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.zh_title: CPathAgent：模拟病理医生诊断逻辑的可解释病理基础模型
04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.summary: 提出基于智能体的病理基础模型，模拟病理医生由低倍到高倍逐级观察的诊断逻辑。
key_points: 现有病理模型难以模拟诊断流程
模仿先低倍概览再放大可疑区域
面向高分辨率病理图像的可解释分析
04945ab22b89e3a423a010d161620f323efb0e00.zh_abstract: 计算病理学（computational pathology）的最新进展催生了许多基础模型（foundation models）。这些模型通常依赖通用编码器（general-purpose encoders）结合多实例学习（multi-instance learning）进行全切片图像（WSI）分类，或应用多模态方法直接从图像生成报告。然而，这些模型无法模拟病理学家的诊断方法：病理学家系统地在低倍放大下检查切片以获得整体概览，然后逐步放大可疑区域，从而形成全面的诊断。相反，现有模型直接输出最终诊断，而不揭示潜在的推理过程。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 CPathAgent，这是一种创新的基于智能体（agent-based）的方法，它通过基于观察到的视觉特征在 WSI 上自主导航，模拟病理学家的诊断工作流程，从而生成显著更多的 transp

5763eb443b946d72c4512b9f2863e9f82051f9ea.title: Look Before You Leap: A GUI-Critic-R1 Model for Pre-Operative Error Diagnosis in GUI Automation
5763eb443b946d72c4512b9f2863e9f82051f9ea.abstract: In recent years, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been extensively utilized for multimodal reasoning tasks, including Graphical User Interface (GUI) automation. Unlike general offline multimodal tasks, GUI automation is executed in online interactive environments, necessitating step-by-step decision-making based on real-time status of the environment. This task has a lower tolerance for decision-making errors at each step, as any mistakes may cumulatively disrupt the process and potentially lead to irreversible outcomes like deletions or payments. To address these issues, we introduce a pre-operative critic mechanism that provides effective feedback prior to the actual execution, by reasoning about the potential outcome and correctness of actions. Specifically, we propose a Suggestion-aware Gradient Relative Policy Optimization (S-GRPO) strategy to construct our pre-operativ

b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.title: 3D-RAD: A Comprehensive 3D Radiology Med-VQA Dataset with Multi-Temporal Analysis and Diverse Diagnostic Tasks
b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) holds significant potential for clinical decision support, yet existing efforts primarily focus on 2D imaging with limited task diversity. This paper presents 3D-RAD, a large-scale dataset designed to advance 3D Med-VQA using radiology CT scans. The 3D-RAD dataset encompasses six diverse VQA tasks: anomaly detection, image observation, medical computation, existence detection, static temporal diagnosis, and longitudinal temporal diagnosis. It supports both open- and closed-ended questions while introducing complex reasoning challenges, including computational tasks and multi-stage temporal analysis, to enable comprehensive benchmarking. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing vision-language models (VLMs), especially medical VLMs exhibit limited generalization, particularly in multi-temporal tasks, underscoring the challenges of real-wo
b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.summary: NeurIPS 2025 发布基于放射科CT扫描的大规模3D医学视觉问答数据集，涵盖六类任务并支持多时间点分析。
key_points: 基于放射科CT影像构建
含异常检测等六类VQA任务
支持纵向时间诊断任务
b17d087a5e4c535ece5d4f299a559129d7fd00fd.zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答（Medical Visual Question Answering, Med-VQA）在临床决策支持方面具有巨大潜力，但现有工作主要集中于 2D 成像且任务多样性有限。本文提出 3D-RAD，一个旨在利用放射学 CT 扫描推进 3D Med-VQA 的大规模数据集。3D-RAD 数据集涵盖六项多样的 VQA 任务：异常检测、图像观察、医学计算、存在检测、静态时间诊断和纵向时间诊断。它支持开放式和封闭式问题，同时引入复杂推理挑战，包括计算任务和多阶段时间分析，以实现全面基准测试。大量评估表明，现有视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs），尤其是医学 VLMs，泛化能力有限，特别是在多时间任务中，凸显了真实世的挑战

2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.title: PanTS: The Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation Dataset
2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.abstract: PanTS is a large-scale, multi-institutional dataset curated to advance research in pancreatic CT analysis. It contains 36,390 CT scans from 145 medical centers, with expert-validated, voxel-wise annotations of over 993,000 anatomical structures, covering pancreatic tumors, pancreas head, body, and tail, and 24 surrounding anatomical structures such as vascular/skeletal structures and abdominal/thoracic organs. Each scan includes metadata such as patient age, sex, diagnosis, contrast phase, in-plane spacing, slice thickness, etc. AI models trained on PanTS achieve significantly better performance in pancreatic tumor detection, localization, and segmentation compared to those trained on existing public datasets. Our analysis indicates that these gains are directly attributable to the 16x larger-scale tumor annotations and indirectly supported by the 24 additional surrounding anatomical str
2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.summary: 发布PanTS大规模多中心胰腺CT数据集，含36,390例扫描与专家验证的体素级标注。
key_points: 36,390例CT扫描、145家医疗中心
逾99.3万解剖结构体素级标注
覆盖胰腺肿瘤及24种周围结构
2ca8bcaffa636200fecafb892529c44a86449a02.zh_abstract: PanTS是一个大规模、多机构的数据集，旨在推进胰腺CT分析的研究。它包含来自145个医疗中心的36,390张CT扫描，具有专家验证的、体素级别的超过993,000个解剖结构的标注，涵盖胰腺肿瘤、胰头、胰体和胰尾，以及24个周围解剖结构，如血管/骨骼结构和腹部/胸部器官。每次扫描包括元数据，如患者年龄、性别、诊断、对比期、平面内间距、层厚等。在PanTS上训练的AI模型在胰腺肿瘤检测、定位和分割方面，与在现有公共数据集上训练的模型相比，取得了显著更好的性能。我们的分析表明，这些收益直接归因于规模大16倍的肿瘤标注，并间接得到24个额外周围解剖结构的支持。

f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.title: Mol-LLaMA: Towards General Understanding of Molecules in Large Molecular Language Model
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.abstract: Understanding molecules is key to understanding organisms and driving advances in drug discovery, requiring interdisciplinary knowledge across chemistry and biology. Although large molecular language models have achieved notable success in task transfer, they often struggle to accurately analyze molecular features due to limited knowledge and reasoning capabilities. To address this issue, we present Mol-LLaMA, a large molecular language model that grasps the general knowledge centered on molecules and exhibits explainability and reasoning ability. To this end, we design key data types that encompass the fundamental molecular features, taking into account the essential abilities for molecular reasoning. Further, to improve molecular understanding, we propose a module that integrates complementary information from different molecular encoders, leveraging the distinct advantages of molecula
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.zh_title: Mol-LLaMA：面向分子通用理解的大型分子语言模型
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.summary: 提出Mol-LLaMA分子大语言模型，旨在提升对分子特征的分析与推理能力。
key_points: 理解分子对认识生物体和药物发现关键
现有分子大模型知识与推理能力有限
Mol-LLaMA以分子为中心获取通用知识
f53651553e060e56c14efe31b069edc2c92e6317.zh_abstract: 理解分子是理解生物体和推动药物发现进展的关键，这需要跨越化学与生物学的跨学科知识。尽管大型分子语言模型在任务迁移方面取得了显著成功，但由于知识和推理能力有限，它们常常难以准确分析分子特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 Mol-LLaMA，一个大型分子语言模型，其掌握以分子为中心的一般知识，并表现出可解释性和推理能力。为此，我们设计了涵盖基本分子特征的关键数据类型，同时考虑分子推理所需的基本能力。进一步，为了改进分子理解，我们提出了一个模块，该模块整合来自不同分子编码器的互补信息，利用分子编码器的独特优势。

c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.title: Better Tokens for Better 3D: Advancing Vision-Language Modeling in 3D Medical Imaging
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.abstract: Recent progress in vision-language modeling for 3D medical imaging has been fueled by large-scale computed tomography (CT) corpora with paired free-text reports, stronger architectures, and powerful pretrained models. This has enabled applications such as automated report generation and text-conditioned 3D image synthesis. Yet, current approaches struggle with high-resolution, long-sequence volumes: contrastive pretraining often yields vision encoders that are misaligned with clinical language, and slice-wise tokenization blurs fine anatomy, reducing diagnostic performance on downstream tasks. We introduce BTB3D (Better Tokens for Better 3D), a causal convolutional encoder-decoder that unifies 2D and 3D training and inference while producing compact, frequency-aware volumetric tokens. A three-stage training curriculum enables (i) local reconstruction, (ii) overlapping-window tiling, and
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.zh_title: 改进Token化以推进3D医学影像视觉语言建模
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.summary: 针对高分辨率长序列3D CT数据，改进视觉语言模型的token表示以缓解视觉编码器与临床语言的错位。
key_points: 面向高分辨率长序列3D体数据
缓解视觉编码器与临床语言错位
服务于报告生成与文本条件合成
c8c8ee6ccb6425ba42732c8bc2713ab737bf1e19.zh_abstract: 三维医学影像视觉—语言建模的近期进展，得益于带有配对自由文本报告的大规模计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）语料库、更强的架构以及强大的预训练模型。这促成了自动报告生成和文本条件化三维图像合成等应用。然而，当前方法在高分辨率、长序列体数据上仍面临困难：对比预训练往往产生与临床语言不对齐的视觉编码器，而逐切片的标记化（slice-wise tokenization）会模糊精细解剖结构，降低下游任务的诊断性能。我们提出 BTB3D（Better Tokens for Better 3D），这是一种因果卷积编码器—解码器，统一了二维与三维的训练和推理，同时生成紧凑、频率感知的体素标记（volumetric tokens）。一个三阶段训练课程依次实现：(i) 局部重建，(ii) 重叠窗口分块（overlapping-window tiling），以及

8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.title: Towards Better Dental AI: A Multimodal Benchmark and Instruction Dataset for Panoramic X-ray Analysis
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on general-purpose medical tasks. However, their effectiveness in specialized domains such as dentistry remains underexplored. In particular, panoramic X-rays, a widely used imaging modality in oral radiology, pose interpretative challenges due to dense anatomical structures and subtle pathological cues, which are not captured by existing medical benchmarks or instruction datasets. To this end, we introduce MMOral, the first large-scale multimodal instruction dataset and benchmark tailored for panoramic X-ray interpretation. MMOral consists of 20,563 annotated images paired with 1.3 million instruction-following instances across diverse task types, including attribute extraction, report generation, visual question answering, and image-grounded dialogue. In addition, we present MMOral-Bench, a com
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.zh_title: 面向口腔AI：全景X线分析的多模态基准与指令数据集
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.summary: NeurIPS 2025 针对牙科全景X线，构建多模态基准与指令数据集，弥补现有医学基准在口腔领域的空白。
key_points: 大型视觉语言模型在牙科等专科表现尚待探索
全景X线结构密集、病理征象细微，解读困难
现有医学基准与指令数据集未覆盖该场景
8f80e3a52457f68e44c740a69056d7a14d8d6583.zh_abstract: 近期，大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）的进展已在通用医学任务上展现出强大性能。然而，其在牙科等专业领域中的有效性仍未被充分探索。特别是，全景X射线作为口腔放射学中广泛使用的成像模态，由于密集的解剖结构和细微的病理线索而带来判读挑战，这些挑战未被现有医学基准或指令数据集所涵盖。为此，我们提出 MMOral，这是首个面向全景X射线判读定制的大规模多模态指令数据集与基准。MMOral 包含 20,563 张标注图像，并配有 130 万个遵循指令的实例，涵盖多种任务类型，包括属性提取、报告生成、视觉问答和基于图像的对话。此外，我们提出 MMOral-Bench，一个 com

4009db3a123f9771f8ef1f06cf4277ec3790afcd.title: How to Train Your LLM Web Agent: A Statistical Diagnosis
4009db3a123f9771f8ef1f06cf4277ec3790afcd.abstract: LLM-based web agents have recently made significant progress, but much of it has occurred in closed-source systems, widening the gap with open-source alternatives. Progress has been held back by two key challenges: first, a narrow focus on single-step tasks that overlooks the complexity of multi-step web interactions; and second, the high compute costs required to post-train LLM-based web agents. To address this, we present the first statistically grounded study on compute allocation for LLM web-agent post-training. Our approach uses a two-stage pipeline, training a Llama 3.1 8B student to imitate a Llama 3.3 70B teacher via supervised fine-tuning (SFT), followed by on-policy reinforcement learning. cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.title: Statistically Valid Post-Deployment Monitoring Should Be Standard for AI-Based Digital Health
cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.abstract: This position paper argues that post-deployment monitoring in clinical AI is underdeveloped and proposes statistically valid and label-efficient testing frameworks as a principled foundation for ensuring reliability and safety in real-world deployment. A recent review found that only 9% of FDA-registered AI-based healthcare tools include a post-deployment surveillance plan. Existing monitoring approaches are often manual, sporadic, and reactive, making them ill-suited for the dynamic environments in which clinical models operate. We contend that post-deployment monitoring should be grounded in label-efficient and statistically valid testing frameworks, offering a principled alternative to current practices. cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.zh_title: 立场论文：AI数字健康部署后监测应标准化
cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.summary: 该立场论文指出临床AI部署后监测不足，提出统计有效且标签高效的测试框架，并援引仅9%的FDA注册AI医疗工具含监测计划。
key_points: 主张部署后监测应成为临床AI标准
提出统计有效、标签高效的测试框架
引用综述：仅9%FDA注册AI工具含监测
cb9fbddab8e8e8ff03623ff8b0985d72e4c15874.zh_abstract: 这篇立场论文认为，临床 AI 中的部署后监测尚不发达，并提出统计有效且标签高效的测试框架，作为确保真实世界部署中可靠性与安全性的原则性基础。近期一篇综述发现，只有 9% 的 FDA 注册 AI 医疗工具包含部署后监测计划。现有监测方法往往是手动的、零星的且反应性的，使其不适合临床模型运行的动态环境。我们主张，部署后监测应以标签高效且统计有效的测试框架为基础，为当前实践提供一种原则性替代方案。我们使用术语“统计有效”来指代那些对错误率（例如，I 类/II 类错误）提供明确保证、能够在预定义假设下进行正式推断，

290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.title: EndoBench: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Modal Large Language Models for Endoscopy Analysis
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.abstract: Endoscopic procedures are essential for diagnosing and treating internal diseases, and multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to assist in endoscopy analysis. However, current benchmarks are limited, as they typically cover specific endoscopic scenarios and a small set of clinical tasks, failing to capture the real-world diversity of endoscopic scenarios and the full range of skills needed in clinical workflows. To address these issues, we introduce EndoBench, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to assess MLLMs across the full spectrum of endoscopic practice with multi-dimensional capacities. EndoBench encompasses 4 distinct endoscopic scenarios, 12 specialized clinical tasks with 12 secondary subtasks, and 5 levels of visual prompting granularities, resulting in 6,832 rigorously validated VQA pairs from 21 diverse datasets. 290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.zh_title: EndoBench：内镜分析多模态大模型综合评测
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出EndoBench，针对内镜分析的多模态大语言模型综合基准，覆盖多场景与多临床任务。
key_points: 内镜诊疗中MLLM应用渐增
现有基准场景与任务覆盖有限
提出EndoBench综合评测基准
强调真实场景多样性与临床技能
290bb7fade17d1ee13d2e36489273ccff274a3ce.zh_abstract: 内镜操作对于诊断和治疗内部疾病至关重要，而多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）正越来越多地被用于辅助内镜分析。然而，当前基准是有限的，因为它们通常覆盖特定的内镜场景和一小部分临床任务，未能捕捉内镜场景的真实世界多样性以及临床工作流程所需的全部技能范围。为解决这些问题，我们提出 EndoBench，这是首个专门设计用于评估 MLLMs 在内镜实践全谱系中多维能力的综合性基准。EndoBench 涵盖 4 个不同的内镜场景、12 项专业临床任务及 12 项二级子任务，以及 5 个级别的视觉提示粒度，从而产生来自 21 个多样化数据集的 6,832 对严格验证的 VQA 对。我们的多 dimen

bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.title: Chiron-o1: Igniting Multimodal Large Language Models towards Generalizable Medical Reasoning via Mentor-Intern Collaborative Search
bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have begun to demonstrate robust reasoning capabilities on general tasks, yet their application in the medical domain remains in its early stages. Constructing chain-of-thought (CoT) training data is essential for bolstering the reasoning abilities of medical MLLMs. However, existing approaches exhibit a deficiency in offering a comprehensive framework for searching and evaluating effective reasoning paths towards critical diagnosis. To address this challenge, we propose Mentor-Intern Collaborative Search (MICS), a novel reasoning-path searching scheme to generate rigorous and effective medical CoT data. bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.zh_title: Chiron-o1：师徒协作搜索提升医学多模态推理
bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.summary: 提出Chiron-o1，通过师徒协作搜索构建思维链数据，提升医学多模态大模型的泛化推理能力。
key_points: 医学MLLM推理仍处早期阶段
现有方法缺乏推理路径搜索评估框架
采用师徒协作搜索构建思维链数据
bf5f27b17ee596b7f8a96e6dabd608f5f6723387.zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）已开始在通用任务上展现出强大的推理能力，但其在医学领域的应用仍处于早期阶段。构建思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）训练数据对于增强医学 MLLMs 的推理能力至关重要。然而，现有方法在提供用于搜索和评估通向关键诊断的有效推理路径的综合框架方面存在不足。为应对这一挑战，我们提出导师-实习生协同搜索（Mentor-Intern Collaborative Search, MICS），一种新颖的推理路径搜索方案，用于生成严谨且有效的医学 CoT 数据。MICS 首先利用导师模型逐步初始化推理，然后提示每个实习生模型沿这些已初始化的路径继续思考，最后根据整体推理

79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.title: EgoExOR: An Ego-Exo-Centric Operating Room Dataset for Surgical Activity Understanding
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.abstract: Operating rooms (ORs) demand precise coordination among surgeons, nurses, and equipment in a fast-paced, occlusion-heavy environment, necessitating advanced perception models to enhance safety and efficiency. Existing datasets either provide partial egocentric views or sparse exocentric multi-view context, but do not explore the comprehensive combination of both. We introduce EgoExOR, the first OR dataset and accompanying benchmark to fuse first-person and third-person perspectives. Spanning 94 minutes (84,553 frames at 15 FPS) of two emulated spine procedures, Ultrasound-Guided Needle Insertion and Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery, EgoExOR integrates egocentric data (RGB, gaze, hand tracking, audio) from wearable glasses, exocentric RGB and depth from RGB-D cameras, and ultrasound imagery. Its detailed scene graph annotations, covering 36 entities and 22 relations (568,235 triplets), en
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.zh_title: EgoExOR：第一/第三人称手术室活动理解数据集
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.summary: NeurIPS 2025发布EgoExOR，首个融合第一人称与第三人称视角的手术室数据集与配套基准。
key_points: 手术室遮挡严重、需多方精确协调
现有数据集仅含自我或稀疏外部视角
首个融合第一与第三人称视角的基准
79b2879bf280fc0e09bbe0e14f82c0cd710d88a7.zh_abstract: 手术室（ORs）在快节奏、遮挡严重的环境中要求外科医生、护士和设备之间精确协调，因而需要先进的感知模型来提升安全性和效率。现有数据集要么提供部分自我中心视角，要么提供稀疏的外中心多视角上下文，但未探索两者的全面结合。我们提出 EgoExOR，这是首个用于融合第一人称与第三人称视角的手术室数据集及配套基准。EgoExOR 涵盖两种模拟脊柱手术——超声引导下针插入和微创脊柱手术——共 94 分钟（15 FPS 下 84,553 帧），整合了来自可穿戴眼镜的自我中心数据（RGB、注视、手部追踪、音频）、来自 RGB-D 相机的外中心 RGB 和深度，以及超声图像。其详细的场景图标注涵盖 36 个实体和 22 种关系（568,235 个三元组），en

5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.title: THUNDER: Tile-level Histopathology image UNDERstanding benchmark
5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.abstract: Progress in a research field can be hard to assess, in particular when many concurrent methods are proposed in a short period of time. This is the case in digital pathology, where many foundation models have been released recently to serve as feature extractors for tile-level images, being used in a variety of downstream tasks, both for tile- and slide-level problems. Benchmarking available methods then becomes paramount to get a clearer view of the research landscape. In particular, in critical domains such as healthcare, a benchmark should not only focus on evaluating downstream performance, but also provide insights about the main differences between methods, and importantly, further consider uncertainty and robustness to ensure a reliable usage of proposed models. 5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.zh_title: THUNDER：组织病理图像瓦片级理解基准
5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.summary: 提出组织病理图像瓦片级理解基准THUNDER，用于评估多种基础模型在下游任务的表现。
key_points: 数字病理领域近期发布多种基础模型
模型用作瓦片级图像特征提取器
需基准评估以厘清研究全景
5dc9df29822f744ebe5364b9c87e75948f0edde8.zh_abstract: 一个研究领域的进展可能难以评估，特别是当短时间内提出许多并行方法时。数字病理学就是这种情况，最近发布了许多基础模型，用作瓦片级图像的特征提取器，被用于各种下游任务，包括瓦片级和切片级问题。因此，对可用方法进行基准测试变得至关重要，以便更清晰地了解研究格局。特别是在医疗保健等关键领域，基准测试不应仅关注评估下游性能，还应提供关于方法之间主要差异的见解，并且重要的是，进一步考虑不确定性和鲁棒性，以确保所提出模型的可靠使用。出于这些原因，我们引入了THUNDER，一个用于数字病理学基础模型的瓦片级基准，允许 eff

23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.title: Understanding protein function with a multimodal retrieval-augmented foundation model
23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) learn probability distributions over natural protein sequences. By learning from hundreds of millions of natural protein sequences, protein understanding and design capabilities emerge. Recent works have shown that scaling these models improves structure prediction, but does not seem to improve mutation understanding and representation quality for protein function prediction. We introduce PoET-2, a multimodal, retrieval-augmented protein foundation model that incorporates in-context learning of family-specific evolutionary constraints with optional structure conditioning to learn generative distributions over protein sequences. 23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.zh_title: PoET-2：多模态检索增强蛋白质基础模型
23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.summary: 提出PoET-2多模态检索增强蛋白质基础模型，用于蛋白质功能理解。
key_points: 基于蛋白质语言模型

面向功能理解与突变表征
23dbafd5ab4a48ed2ca7627f5d7721394680b69d.zh_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）学习自然蛋白质序列上的概率分布。通过从数亿条自然蛋白质序列中学习，蛋白质理解和设计能力得以涌现。近期工作表明，扩展这些模型可改进结构预测，但似乎并未改进突变理解以及用于蛋白质功能预测的表示质量。我们提出 PoET-2，一种多模态、检索增强的蛋白质基础模型，它结合了对家族特异性进化约束的上下文学习以及可选的结构条件化，以学习蛋白质序列上的生成分布。PoET-2 使用一个对序列上下文顺序等变的层次化 Transformer 编码器，以及一个同时具有因果和掩码语言建模目标的双解码器架构，使 PoET-2 能够在完全生成式

e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.title: DrVD-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Reason Like Human Doctors in Medical Image Diagnosis?
e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization on natural images and show early promise in interpretable medical image analysis. However, existing benchmarks do not systematically evaluate whether these models truly reason like human clinicians or merely imitate superficial patterns. To address this gap, we propose DrVD-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for clinical visual reasoning. DrVD-Bench consists of three modules: Visual Evidence Comprehension, Reasoning Trajectory Assessment, and Report Generation Evaluation, comprising a total of 7,789 image-question pairs. Our benchmark covers 20 task types, 17 diagnostic categories, and five imaging modalities-CT, MRI, ultrasound, radiography, and pathology. e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.zh_title: DrVD-Bench：视觉语言模型是否像医生一样推理医学图像
e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.summary: 提出首个临床视觉推理多模态基准DrVD-Bench，含视觉证据理解与推理轨迹等模块，系统评估视觉语言模型是否真正像临床医生一样推理。

包含视觉证据理解、推理轨迹等模块
面向医学图像诊断的多模态评测
e183dd689fe208bde16f4426984a2958a7ac9ccb.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在自然图像上展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，并在可解释医学图像分析中显示出早期前景。然而，现有基准并未系统评估这些模型是否真正像人类临床医生那样推理，还是仅模仿表面模式。为填补这一空白，我们提出 DrVD-Bench，首个用于临床视觉推理的多模态基准。DrVD-Bench 由三个模块组成：视觉证据理解、推理轨迹评估和报告生成评估，共包含 7,789 个图像-问题对。我们的基准涵盖 20 种任务类型、17 个诊断类别和五种成像模态——CT、MRI、超声、放射摄影和病理学。DrVD-Bench 的结构明确反映从模态识别到病变识别和诊断的临床推理工作流程。我们对 19

e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.title: Doctor Approved: Generating Medically Accurate Skin Disease Images through AI-Expert Feedback
e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.abstract: Paucity of medical data severely limits the generalizability of diagnostic ML models, as the full spectrum of disease variability can not be represented by a small clinical dataset. To address this, diffusion models (DMs) have been considered as a promising avenue for synthetic image generation and augmentation. However, they frequently produce medically inaccurate images, deteriorating the model performance. Expert domain knowledge is critical for synthesizing images that correctly encode clinical information, especially when data is scarce and quality outweighs quantity. Existing approaches for incorporating human feedback, such as reinforcement learning (RL) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), rely on robust reward functions or demand labor-intensive expert evaluations. Recent progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) reveals their strong visual reasoning capabilities
e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.zh_title: 医生认可：AI与专家反馈生成皮肤病图像
e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.summary: 利用AI与专家反馈机制生成医学上准确的皮肤病图像，以缓解医学数据稀缺问题。
key_points: 扩散模型合成皮肤病图像
引入专家反馈提升医学准确性

e7b92915a9cd82fbc31388834097d5fd3ecb48c9.zh_abstract: 医学数据的匮乏严重限制了诊断性机器学习（ML）模型的泛化能力，因为小型临床数据集无法代表疾病变异性的完整谱系。为解决这一问题，扩散模型（DMs）被认为是合成图像生成与增强的一条有前景的途径。然而，它们经常生成医学上不准确的图像，导致模型性能下降。专家领域知识对于合成能正确编码临床信息的图像至关重要，尤其是在数据稀缺且质量重于数量的情况下。现有纳入人类反馈的方法，如强化学习（RL）和直接偏好优化（DPO），依赖于稳健的奖励函数或需要劳动密集的专家评估。多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展揭示了其强大的视觉推理能力

c88ebab24da1206956cad89aa6d444f5c7802d6d.title: Steering Generative Models with Experimental Data for Protein Fitness Optimization
c88ebab24da1206956cad89aa6d444f5c7802d6d.abstract: Protein fitness optimization involves finding a protein sequence that maximizes desired quantitative properties in a combinatorially large design space of possible sequences. Recent advances in steering protein generative models (e.g., diffusion models and language models) with labeled data offer a promising approach. However, most previous studies have optimized surrogate rewards and/or utilized large amounts of labeled data for steering, making it unclear how well existing methods perform and compare to each other in real-world optimization campaigns where fitness is measured through low-throughput wet-lab assays. c88ebab24da1206956cad89aa6d444f5c7802d6d.zh_title: 以实验数据引导生成模型优化蛋白质适应度
c88ebab24da1206956cad89aa6d444f5c7802d6d.summary: 研究用标注数据引导蛋白质生成模型，在巨大序列空间中优化目标性质。

c88ebab24da1206956cad89aa6d444f5c7802d6d.zh_abstract: 蛋白质适应度优化涉及在可能的序列所构成的组合上巨大的设计空间中，寻找能够最大化所需定量特性的蛋白质序列。近期在利用带标签数据引导蛋白质生成模型（例如扩散模型和语言模型）方面的进展提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，大多数先前研究优化了替代奖励和/或利用大量带标签数据进行引导，这使得在通过低通量湿实验室测定来测量适应度的真实世界优化活动中，现有方法的表现如何以及彼此之间如何比较仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探索使用少量（数百）带标签的序列-适应度对进行适应度优化，并全面评估诸如分类器引导和后验采样等策略，用于引导来自不同离散扩散模型的 protei

886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.title: CARE-PD: A Multi-Site Anonymized Clinical Dataset for Parkinson's Disease Gait Assessment
886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.abstract: Objective gait assessment in Parkinson's Disease (PD) is limited by the absence of large, diverse, and clinically annotated motion datasets. We introduce CARE-PD, the largest publicly available archive of 3D mesh gait data for PD, and the first multi-site collection spanning 9 cohorts from 8 clinical centers. All recordings (RGB video or motion capture) are converted into anonymized SMPL meshes via a harmonized preprocessing pipeline. CARE-PD supports two key benchmarks: supervised clinical score prediction (estimating Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale, UPDRS, gait scores) and unsupervised motion pretext tasks (2D-to-3D keypoint lifting and full-body 3D reconstruction). Clinical prediction is evaluated under four generalization protocols: within-dataset, cross-dataset, leave-one-dataset-out, and multi-dataset in-domain adaptation. 886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.zh_title: CARE-PD：帕金森病步态评估多中心匿名临床数据集
886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.summary: 发布迄今最大的帕金森病3D网格步态公开数据集，覆盖8家临床中心9个队列，支持临床评分等基准。

886b10e7f6a200a59d2255daff252bd4e6de4ba3.zh_abstract: 帕金森病（PD）中的客观步态评估因缺乏大型、多样且具有临床注释的运动数据集而受到限制。我们引入了 CARE-PD，这是目前最大的公开可用的 PD 三维网格步态数据档案，也是首个涵盖来自 8 个临床中心的 9 个队列的多中心采集数据集。所有记录（RGB 视频或运动捕捉）通过统一预处理流程转换为匿名化的 SMPL 网格。CARE-PD 支持两个关键基准：监督式临床评分预测（估计统一帕金森病评定量表，UPDRS，步态评分）和无监督运动预训练任务（2D 到 3D 关键点提升和全身 3D 重建）。临床预测在四种泛化协议下进行评估：数据集内、跨数据集、留一数据集和多数据集域内适应。为评估临床相关性，我们比较了最先进

8854d51b01a85685fab9e2fde036d53badcbdfee.title: Simultaneous Modeling of Protein Conformation and Dynamics via Autoregression
8854d51b01a85685fab9e2fde036d53badcbdfee.abstract: Understanding protein dynamics is critical for elucidating their biological functions. The increasing availability of molecular dynamics (MD) data enables the training of deep generative models to efficiently explore the conformational space of proteins. However, existing approaches either fail to explicitly capture the temporal dependencies between conformations or do not support direct generation of time-independent samples. To address these limitations, we introduce ConfRover, an autoregressive model that simultaneously learns protein conformation and dynamics from MD trajectories, supporting both time-dependent and time-independent sampling. 8854d51b01a85685fab9e2fde036d53badcbdfee.zh_abstract: 理解蛋白质动力学对于阐明其生物学功能至关重要。分子动力学（MD）数据的日益可用性使得能够训练深度生成模型，以高效探索蛋白质的构象空间。然而，现有方法要么未能明确捕捉构象之间的时间依赖性，要么不支持直接生成与时间无关的样本。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 ConfRover，这是一种自回归模型，可从 MD 轨迹中同时学习蛋白质构象和动力学，支持时间相关和时间无关采样。我们模型的核心是一个模块化架构，包括：（i）一个编码层，改编自蛋白质折叠模型，将每个时间帧的蛋白质特异性信息和构象嵌入潜在空间；（ii）一个时间模块，一个

5a83768d4ae930d2ae8b6715604d636a24de8c66.title: Thousand Voices of Trauma: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Modeling Prolonged Exposure Therapy Conversations
5a83768d4ae930d2ae8b6715604d636a24de8c66.abstract: The advancement of AI systems for mental health support is hindered by limited access to therapeutic conversation data, particularly for trauma treatment. We present Thousand Voices of Trauma, a synthetic benchmark dataset of 3,000 therapy conversations based on Prolonged Exposure therapy protocols for Post-traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD). The dataset comprises 500 unique cases, each explored through six conversational perspectives that mirror the progression of therapy from initial anxiety to peak distress to emotional processing. We incorporated diverse demographic profiles (ages 18-80, M=49.3, 49.4% male, 44.4% female, 6.2% non-binary), 20 trauma types, and 10 trauma-related behaviors using deterministic and probabilistic generation methods. 5a83768d4ae930d2ae8b6715604d636a24de8c66.zh_title: 创伤暴露治疗对话大规模合成数据集

eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.title: AOR: Anatomical Ontology-Guided Reasoning for Medical Large Multimodal Model in Chest X-Ray Interpretation
eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.abstract: Chest X-rays (CXRs) are the most frequently performed imaging examinations in clinical settings. Recent advancements in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have enabled automated CXR interpretation, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. However, despite their strong visual understanding, current Medical LMMs (MLMMs) still face two major challenges: (1) Insufficient region-level understanding and interaction, and (2) Limited accuracy and interpretability due to single-step reasoning. In this paper, we empower MLMMs with anatomy-centric reasoning capabilities to enhance their interactivity and explainability. Specifically, we first propose an Anatomical Ontology-Guided Reasoning (AOR) framework, which centers on cross-modal region-level information to facilitate multi-step reasoning. Next, under the guidance of expert physicians, we develop AOR-Instruction, a large instruction dataset f
eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.zh_title: AOR：解剖本体引导推理用于胸片解读
eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.summary: 提出解剖本体引导推理方法AOR，用于医学多模态大模型的胸部X光解读。
key_points: 胸片为临床最常进行的影像检查

单步推理限制准确性与可解释性
eb477ef69fac4f9b53c992cbc71863ac762bda54.zh_abstract: 胸部 X 射线（Chest X-rays，CXRs）是临床环境中最常进行的影像学检查。大型多模态模型（Large Multimodal Models，LMMs）的近期进展使自动化 CXR 解读成为可能，提高了诊断准确性和效率。然而，尽管当前医学 LMM（Medical LMMs，MLMMs）具有强大的视觉理解能力，但仍面临两大挑战：（1）区域级理解与交互不足；（2）由于单步推理而导致的准确性和可解释性有限。在本文中，我们赋予 MLMM 以解剖为中心的推理能力，以增强其交互性和可解释性。具体而言，我们首先提出一个解剖本体引导推理（Anatomical Ontology-Guided Reasoning，AOR）框架，该框架以跨模态区域级信息为中心，以促进多步推理。接下来，在专家医生的指导下，我们开发了 AOR-Instruction，一个大型指令数据集 f

c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.title: Multiscale guidance of protein structure prediction with heterogeneous cryo-EM data
c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.abstract: Protein structure prediction models are now capable of generating accurate 3D structural hypotheses from sequence alone. However, they routinely fail to capture the conformational diversity of dynamic biomolecular complexes, often requiring heuristic MSA subsampling approaches for generating alternative states. In parallel, cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has emerged as a powerful tool for imaging near-native structural heterogeneity, but is challenged by arduous pipelines to transform raw experimental data into atomic models. Here, we bridge the gap between these modalities, combining cryo-EM density maps with the rich sequence and biophysical priors learned by protein structure prediction models. Our method, CryoBoltz, guides the sampling trajectory of a pretrained biomolecular structure prediction model using both global and local structural constraints derived from density maps, d
c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.zh_title: 异构冷冻电镜数据的多尺度蛋白结构预测引导
c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.summary: 利用异构冷冻电镜数据多尺度引导蛋白质结构预测，以捕捉动态复合物的构象多样性。
key_points: 序列预测模型常难以捕捉构象多样性
冷冻电镜可成像近天然结构异质性
原始数据到结构流程仍较为繁琐
c17cdb96f8dde38f443c141424885efa487f2674.zh_abstract: 蛋白质结构预测模型如今能够仅从序列生成准确的 3D 结构假设。然而，它们通常无法捕捉动态生物分子复合物的构象多样性，往往需要启发式 MSA 子采样方法来生成替代状态。与此同时，冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-electron microscopy, cryo-EM）已成为对接近天然的结构异质性进行成像的强大工具，但其面临的挑战是将原始实验数据转化为原子模型的艰巨流程。在这里，我们弥合了这些模态之间的差距，将 cryo-EM 密度图与蛋白质结构预测模型学到的丰富序列和生物物理先验相结合。我们的方法 CryoBoltz 使用源自密度图的全局和局部结构约束，引导预训练生物分子结构预测模型的采样轨迹，d

b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.title: Prot2Text-V2: Protein Function Prediction with Multimodal Contrastive Alignment
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.abstract: Predicting protein function from sequence is a central challenge in computational biology. While existing methods rely heavily on structured ontologies or similarity-based techniques, they often lack the flexibility to express structure-free functional descriptions and novel biological functions. In this work, we introduce Prot2Text-V2, a novel multimodal sequence-to-text model that generates free-form natural language descriptions of protein function directly from amino acid sequences. Our method combines a protein language model as a sequence encoder (ESM-3B) and a decoder-only language model (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) through a lightweight nonlinear modality projector. A key innovation is our Hybrid Sequence-level Contrastive Alignment Learning (H-SCALE), which improves cross-modal learning by matching mean- and std-pooled protein embeddings with text representations via contrastive loss
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.zh_title: Prot2Text-V2：多模态对比对齐预测蛋白质功能
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.summary: 提出多模态序列到文本模型Prot2Text-V2，直接从氨基酸序列生成蛋白质功能的自由文本描述。
key_points: 序列到文本预测蛋白质功能
多模态对比对齐方法
生成自由形式功能描述
b6a74f0782b87c02460450a978eb0a73e4f8de0f.zh_abstract: 从序列预测蛋白质功能是计算生物学的核心挑战。尽管现有方法严重依赖结构化本体或基于相似性的技术，但它们通常缺乏表达能力，无法表达无结构的功能描述和新颖的生物功能。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 Prot2Text-V2，一种新型多模态序列到文本模型，可直接从氨基酸序列生成蛋白质功能的自由形式自然语言描述。我们的方法通过一个轻量级非线性模态投影器，将作为序列编码器的蛋白质语言模型（ESM-3B）与仅解码器语言模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct）相结合。一项关键创新是我们的混合序列级对比对齐学习（Hybrid Sequence-level Contrastive Alignment Learning，H-SCALE），它通过对比损失将均值池化和标准差池化的蛋白质嵌入与文本表示进行匹配，从而改进跨模态学习

8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.title: Protein Design with Dynamic Protein Vocabulary
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.abstract: Protein design is a fundamental challenge in biotechnology, aiming to design novel sequences with specific functions within the vast space of possible proteins. Recent advances in deep generative models have enabled function-based protein design from textual descriptions, yet struggle with structural plausibility. Inspired by classical protein design methods that leverage natural protein structures, we explore whether incorporating fragments from natural proteins can enhance foldability in generative models. Our empirical results show that even random incorporation of fragments improves foldability. Building on this insight, we introduce ProDVa, a novel protein design approach that integrates a text encoder for functional descriptions, a protein language model for designing proteins, and a fragment encoder to dynamically retrieve protein fragments based on textual functional descriptions
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.zh_title: 基于动态蛋白质词汇表的蛋白质设计
8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出引入天然蛋白质片段，以提升生成模型设计蛋白质的折叠可行性。
key_points: 探索天然蛋白质片段增强折叠可行性

8728223d2918f4e45f06bd0cf1a67c9b506e1a0b.zh_abstract: 蛋白质设计是生物技术中的一项基本挑战，旨在在可能的蛋白质广阔空间中设计具有特定功能的新颖序列。深度生成模型的最新进展使得能够根据文本描述进行基于功能的蛋白质设计，但在结构合理性方面仍存在困难。受利用天然蛋白质结构的经典蛋白质设计方法启发，我们探讨了将来自天然蛋白质的片段纳入生成模型是否能增强可折叠性。我们的实证结果表明，即使是随机纳入片段也能提高可折叠性。基于这一洞见，我们提出了 ProDVa，一种新颖的蛋白质设计方法，它集成了用于功能描述的文本编码器、用于设计蛋白质的蛋白质语言模型，以及一个片段编码器，以基于文本功能描述动态检索蛋白质片段。

4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.title: ProtInvTree: Deliberate Protein Inverse Folding with Reward-guided Tree Search
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.abstract: Designing protein sequences that fold into a target 3D structure, known as protein inverse folding, is a fundamental challenge in protein engineering. While recent deep learning methods have achieved impressive performance by recovering native sequences, they often overlook the one-to-many nature of the problem: multiple diverse sequences can fold into the same structure. This motivates the need for a generative model capable of designing diverse sequences while preserving structural consistency. To address this trade-off, we introduce ProtInvTree, the first reward-guided tree-search framework for protein inverse folding. ProtInvTree reformulates sequence generation as a deliberate, step-wise decision-making process, enabling the exploration of multiple design paths and exploitation of promising candidates through self-evaluation, lookahead, and backtracking. We propose a two-stage focus
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.zh_title: ProtInvTree：奖励引导树搜索的蛋白质逆向折叠
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.summary: NeurIPS 2025论文，提出奖励引导树搜索的蛋白质逆向折叠方法，可生成多样且结构一致的序列。
key_points: 面向蛋白质逆向折叠
引入奖励引导树搜索
兼顾序列多样性与结构一致性
4c418c79a0030d1a9e2d8bb55f49bbd26f8f6597.zh_abstract: 设计能够折叠成目标 3D 结构的蛋白质序列，即蛋白质逆折叠，是蛋白质工程中的一项基本挑战。尽管近期深度学习方法通过恢复天然序列取得了令人印象深刻的性能，但它们常常忽视该问题的一对多性质：多个不同的序列可以折叠成同一结构。这促使我们需要一种能够设计多样化序列同时保持结构一致性的生成模型。为了解决这一权衡，我们引入了 ProtInvTree，这是首个用于蛋白质逆折叠的奖励引导树搜索框架。ProtInvTree 将序列生成重新表述为一个审慎的、逐步的决策过程，通过自评估、前瞻和回溯，支持探索多条设计路径并利用有前景的候选。我们提出一个两阶段聚焦

f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.title: MedSG-Bench: A Benchmark for Medical Image Sequences Grounding
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.abstract: Visual grounding is essential for precise perception and reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially in medical imaging domains. While existing medical visual grounding benchmarks primarily focus on single-image scenarios, real-world clinical applications often involve sequential images, where accurate lesion localization across different modalities and temporal tracking of disease progression (e.g., pre- vs. post-treatment comparison) require fine-grained cross-image semantic alignment and context-aware reasoning. To remedy the underrepresentation of image sequences in existing medical visual grounding benchmarks, we propose MedSG-Bench, the first benchmark tailored for Medical Image Sequences Grounding. f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.zh_title: MedSG-Bench：医学图像序列定位基准
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.summary: NeurIPS 2025提出MedSG-Bench，面向多模态大模型在医学序列图像中的病灶定位与跨图像语义推理评估。
key_points: 现有医学视觉定位基准多为单图场景
临床常涉及序列图像与跨模态定位
需时序追踪病变进展如治疗前后对比
f2d17a503a95a236d327a2937277ee374fc0f64f.zh_abstract: 视觉定位（visual grounding）对于多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）中的精确感知与推理至关重要，尤其是在医学影像领域。尽管现有医学视觉定位基准主要聚焦于单图像场景，真实世界临床应用常常涉及序列图像，其中跨不同模态的准确病灶定位以及对疾病进展的时间追踪（例如治疗前与治疗后比较）需要细粒度的跨图像语义对齐和上下文感知推理。为弥补现有医学视觉定位基准中图像序列代表性不足的问题，我们提出了 MedSG-Bench，这是首个为医学图像序列定位（Medical Image Sequences Grounding）量身定制的基准。它包含八个 VQA 风格的任务，被表述为定位任务的两类范式，包括 1）图像差异定位（Image Difference Grounding），其重点在于检测变化。

c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.title: Unified Guidance for Geometry-Conditioned Molecular Generation
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.abstract: Effectively designing molecular geometries is essential to advancing pharmaceutical innovations, a domain, which has experienced great attention through the success of generative models and, in particular, diffusion models. However, current molecular diffusion models are tailored towards a specific downstream task and lack adaptability. We introduce UniGuide, a framework for controlled geometric guidance of unconditional diffusion models that allows flexible conditioning during inference without the requirement of extra training or networks. We show how applications such as structure-based, fragment-based, and ligand-based drug design are formulated in the UniGuide framework and demonstrate on-par or superior performance compared to specialised models. Offering a more versatile approach, UniGuide has the potential to streamline the development of molecular generative models, allowing the
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.zh_title: 几何条件分子生成的统一引导框架
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.summary: 提出UniGuide，在推理时对无条件扩散模型进行可控几何引导。
key_points: 分子几何设计助力药物创新
现有扩散模型缺乏任务适应性
UniGuide支持推理时灵活条件控制
c62d594e4710d7a16bed59ba2b20b045d40b99ca.zh_abstract: 有效设计分子几何结构对于推动药物创新至关重要，这一领域因生成模型、尤其是扩散模型的成功而受到极大关注。然而，当前的分子扩散模型是针对特定下游任务定制的，缺乏适应性。我们提出 UniGuide，这是一个用于对无条件扩散模型进行受控几何引导的框架，允许在推理期间灵活地进行条件控制，而无需额外训练或网络。我们展示了如何将基于结构、基于片段和基于配体的药物设计等应用在 UniGuide 框架中表述，并证明与专用模型相比具有相当或更优的性能。UniGuide 提供了一种更通用的方法，有潜力简化分子生成模型的开发，从而允许

54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.title: Toward a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Medical Data: Multimodal Dataset and Benchmarks for Vietnamese PET/CT Report Generation
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.abstract: Vision-Language Foundation Models (VLMs), trained on large-scale multimodal datasets, have driven significant advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) by enabling rich cross-modal reasoning. Despite their success in general domains, applying these models to medical imaging remains challenging due to the limited availability of diverse imaging modalities and multilingual clinical data. Most existing medical VLMs are trained on a subset of imaging modalities and focus primarily on high-resource languages, thus limiting their generalizability and clinical utility. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel Vietnamese-language multimodal medical dataset consisting of 2,757 whole-body PET/CT volumes from independent patients and their corresponding full-length clinical reports. This dataset is designed to fill two pressing gaps in medical AI development: (1) the lack of PET/CT imaging
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.zh_title: 面向越南语PET/CT报告生成的多模态数据集与基准
54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.summary: 构建越南语PET/CT多模态数据集与基准，推动医学视觉语言基础模型在低资源语言与影像模态上的应用。
key_points: 现有医学视觉语言模型多覆盖部分影像模态

54199f365efa9ca6c64677b916a3e43900ce6e96.zh_abstract: 视觉-语言基础模型（VLMs）在大规模多模态数据集上训练，通过实现丰富的跨模态推理，推动了人工智能（AI）的重大进展。尽管它们在通用领域取得了成功，但由于多样化影像模态和多语言临床数据的可用性有限，将这些模型应用于医学影像仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有医学VLMs在影像模态的一个子集上训练，并主要关注高资源语言，从而限制了其泛化性和临床实用性。为解决这些局限，我们引入了一个新的越南语多模态医学数据集，由来自独立患者的2,757个全身PET/CT体积及其对应的完整临床报告组成。该数据集旨在填补医学AI开发中两个紧迫空白：（1）缺乏PET/CT成像

2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.title: Towards Unified and Lossless Latent Space for 3D Molecular Latent Diffusion Modeling
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.abstract: 3D molecule generation is crucial for drug discovery and material science, requiring models to process complex multi-modalities, including atom types, chemical bonds, and 3D coordinates. A key challenge is integrating these modalities of different shapes while maintaining SE(3) equivariance for 3D coordinates. To achieve this, existing approaches typically maintain separate latent spaces for invariant and equivariant modalities, reducing efficiency in both training and sampling. In this work, we propose \textbf{U}nified Variational \textbf{A}uto-\textbf{E}ncoder for \textbf{3D} Molecular Latent Diffusion Modeling (\textbf{UAE-3D}), a multi-modal VAE that compresses 3D molecules into latent sequences from a unified latent space, while maintaining near-zero reconstruction error. This unified latent space eliminates the complexities of handling multi-modality and equivariance when performin
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.zh_title: 面向3D分子扩散建模的统一无损隐空间
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.summary: NeurIPS 2025 提出统一且无损的隐空间方法，整合原子类型、化学键与3D坐标多模态，兼顾 SE(3) 等变性。
key_points: 面向药物发现与材料科学的3D分子生成
整合不同形状的多模态分子信息
保持3D坐标的 SE(3) 等变性
2af3c9303c752612544f64e52a77c379e344d51f.zh_abstract: 3D分子生成对药物发现和材料科学至关重要，要求模型处理复杂的多模态，包括原子类型、化学键和3D坐标。一个关键挑战是在保持3D坐标的SE(3)等变性的同时整合这些不同形状的模态。为实现这一点，现有方法通常为不变模态和等变模态维护单独的潜在空间，降低了训练和采样的效率。在这项工作中，我们提出统一变分自编码器用于3D分子潜在扩散建模（UAE-3D），一种多模态VAE，将3D分子压缩为来自统一潜在空间的潜在序列，同时保持接近零的重建误差。这种统一潜在空间消除了在执行时处理多模态和等变性的复杂性

1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.title: Prior-Guided Flow Matching for Target-Aware Molecule Design with Learnable Atom Number
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD), aiming to generate 3D molecules with high binding affinity toward target proteins, is a vital approach in novel drug discovery. Although recent generative models have shown great potential, they suffer from unstable probability dynamics and mismatch between generated molecule size and the protein pockets geometry, resulting in inconsistent quality and off-target effects. We propose PAFlow, a novel target-aware molecular generation model featuring prior interaction guidance and a learnable atom number predictor. PAFlow adopts the efficient flow matching framework to model the generation process and constructs a new form of conditional flow matching for discrete atom types. 1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.zh_title: PAFlow：可学习原子数的先验引导流匹配分子设计
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.summary: 提出面向靶点的分子生成模型PAFlow，以先验交互引导流匹配并学习原子数，缓解生成质量不稳与靶点错配问题。
key_points: 面向基于结构的药物设计生成3D分子
引入先验交互引导的流匹配机制
可学习原子数以匹配蛋白口袋几何
1fe7861bae6126c022dd2fc5d25bbb9f53e9632b.zh_abstract: 结构基药物设计（Structure-based drug design, SBDD）旨在生成对靶蛋白具有高结合亲和力的3D分子，是新型药物发现中的关键方法。尽管近期的生成模型已展现出巨大潜力，但它们面临概率动态不稳定以及生成分子大小与蛋白质口袋几何形状不匹配的问题，导致质量不一致和脱靶效应。我们提出PAFlow，一种新型的靶标感知分子生成模型，具有先验相互作用引导和可学习的原子数预测器。PAFlow采用高效流匹配框架来建模生成过程，并为离散原子类型构建了一种新形式的条件流匹配。引入了一个蛋白质-配体相互作用预测器，在生成过程中引导向量场趋向更高亲和力区域，而一个基于蛋白质口袋的原子数预测器

ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.title: MTBBench: A Multimodal Sequential Clinical Decision-Making Benchmark in Oncology
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) hold promise for biomedical reasoning, but current benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of real-world clinical workflows. Existing evaluations primarily assess unimodal, decontextualized question-answering, overlooking multi-agent decision-making environments such as Molecular Tumor Boards (MTBs). MTBs bring together diverse experts in oncology, where diagnostic and prognostic tasks require integrating heterogeneous data and evolving insights over time. Current benchmarks lack this longitudinal and multimodal complexity. We introduce MTBBench, an agentic benchmark simulating MTB-style decision-making through clinically challenging, multimodal, and longitudinal oncology questions. Ground truth annotations are validated by clinicians via a co-developed app, ensuring clinical relevance. We benchmark multiple open and closed-source LLMs and show t
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.zh_title: MTBBench：肿瘤学多模态序贯临床决策基准
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.summary: 面向分子肿瘤委员会场景的多模态序贯临床决策基准，评估多智能体环境下异构数据整合与动态推理能力。
key_points: 聚焦分子肿瘤委员会决策场景
整合多模态异构临床数据
弥补现有基准缺乏动态决策评估
ab7dcfe711552a50aa8713a76b1a5965bfa57c0c.zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models，LLMs）在生物医学推理方面具有前景，但当前基准无法捕捉真实世界临床工作流程的复杂性。现有评估主要评估单模态、去语境化的问答，忽视了诸如分子肿瘤委员会（Molecular Tumor Boards，MTBs）等多智能体决策环境。MTBs 汇集肿瘤学领域的多元专家，其中诊断和预后任务需要整合异质性数据以及随时间演变的见解。当前基准缺乏这种纵向和多模态复杂性。我们提出 MTBBench，一个通过具有临床挑战性的、多模态和纵向的肿瘤学问题来模拟 MTB 风格决策的智能体基准（agentic benchmark）。真实标注（Ground truth annotations）由临床医生通过共同开发的应用程序进行验证，确保了临床相关性。我们对多个开源和闭源 LLMs 进行基准测试，并显示 t

3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.title: Revisiting End-to-End Learning with Slide-level Supervision in Computational Pathology
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.abstract: Pre-trained encoders for offline feature extraction followed by multiple instance learning (MIL) aggregators have become the dominant paradigm in computational pathology (CPath), benefiting cancer diagnosis and prognosis. However, performance limitations arise from the absence of encoder fine-tuning for downstream tasks and disjoint optimization with MIL. While slide-level supervised end-to-end (E2E) learning is an intuitive solution to this issue, it faces challenges such as high computational demands and suboptimal results. These limitations motivate us to revisit E2E learning. We argue that prior work neglects inherent E2E optimization challenges, leading to performance disparities compared to traditional two-stage methods. In this paper, we pioneer the elucidation of optimization challenge caused by sparse-attention MIL and propose a novel MIL called ABMILX. It mitigates this problem
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.zh_title: 重新审视计算病理中切片级监督的端到端学习
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.summary: 针对计算病理主流“离线特征提取+MIL聚合”范式的性能局限，重新审视切片级监督端到端学习及其计算成本挑战。
key_points: 主流范式为预训练编码器加MIL聚合
离线范式缺乏编码器下游微调
端到端面临高计算成本等挑战
3de4ef33eb9cf8d3649f0ead232dd531b0180629.zh_abstract: 用于离线特征提取的预训练编码器，随后接多实例学习（multiple instance learning，MIL）聚合器，已成为计算病理学（computational pathology，CPath）中的主导范式，有益于癌症诊断和预后。然而，由于未针对下游任务微调编码器以及与 MIL 的分离优化，性能限制随之出现。虽然切片级监督的端到端（end-to-end，E2E）学习是解决该问题的直观方案，但它面临高计算需求和次优结果等挑战。这些限制促使我们重新审视 E2E 学习。我们认为，先前工作忽视了固有的 E2E 优化挑战，导致与传统两阶段方法相比存在性能差异。在本文中，我们率先阐明由稀疏注意力 MIL 引起的优化挑战，并提出一种名为 ABMILX 的新型 MIL。它缓解了这一问题

1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.title: SonoGym: High Performance Simulation for Challenging Surgical Tasks with Robotic Ultrasound
1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.abstract: Ultrasound (US) is a widely used medical imaging modality due to its real-time capabilities, non-invasive nature, and cost-effectiveness. Robotic ultrasound can further enhance its utility by reducing operator dependence and improving access to complex anatomical regions. For this, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and imitation learning (IL) have shown potential for autonomous navigation, their use in complex surgical tasks such as anatomy reconstruction and surgical guidance remains limited -- largely due to the lack of realistic and efficient simulation environments tailored to these tasks. We introduce SonoGym, a scalable simulation platform for complex robotic ultrasound tasks that enables parallel simulation across tens to hundreds of environments. 1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.zh_title: SonoGym：机器人超声复杂手术任务高性能仿真
1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.summary: 提出SonoGym仿真平台，支持机器人超声在解剖重建与手术引导等复杂任务中的学习研究。
key_points: 超声具实时、无创、低成本特点
机器人超声可降低操作者依赖
深度强化学习与模仿学习自主导航仍受限
1cbe271b2e5113b646919ef41d714884160feed3.zh_abstract: 超声（US）因其实时能力、非侵入性和成本效益，是一种广泛使用的医学成像模态。机器人超声可以通过减少操作者依赖并改善对复杂解剖区域的访问，进一步增强其效用。为此，尽管深度强化学习（DRL）和模仿学习（IL）已显示出在自主导航方面的潜力，但它们在诸如解剖重建和手术引导等复杂外科任务中的应用仍然有限——这在很大程度上是由于缺乏针对这些任务定制的真实且高效的仿真环境。我们介绍了 SonoGym，一个用于复杂机器人超声任务的可扩展仿真平台，它能够跨数十到数百个环境进行并行仿真。我们的框架支持通过 both a phys 对来自 CT 衍生的解剖 3D 模型的 US 数据进行真实且实时的仿真

68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.title: Protein Inverse Folding From Structure Feedback
68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.abstract: The inverse folding problem, aiming to design amino acid sequences that fold into desired three-dimensional structures, is pivotal for various biotechnological applications. Here, we introduce a novel approach leveraging Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to fine-tune an inverse folding model using feedback from a protein folding model. Given a target protein structure, we begin by sampling candidate sequences from the inverse-folding model, then predict the three-dimensional structure of each sequence with the folding model to generate pairwise structural-preference labels. These labels are used to fine-tune the inverse-folding model under the DPO objective. 68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.zh_title: 基于结构反馈的蛋白质逆向折叠
68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.summary: 利用直接偏好优化结合蛋白质折叠模型反馈微调逆向折叠模型，提升序列设计效果。
key_points: 用 DPO 微调逆向折叠模型
以折叠模型反馈作为优化信号
由逆向折叠模型采样候选序列
68fc245b586e9cb4a70eda4e0cbc8ca753069428.zh_abstract: 逆折叠问题旨在设计可折叠成所需三维结构的氨基酸序列，对多种生物技术应用至关重要。在此，我们介绍了一种新方法，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）并使用蛋白质折叠模型的反馈来微调逆折叠模型。给定目标蛋白质结构，我们首先从逆折叠模型中采样候选序列，然后用折叠模型预测每个序列的三维结构，以生成成对结构偏好标签。这些标签用于在DPO目标下微调逆折叠模型。我们在CATH 4.2测试集上的结果表明，DPO微调不仅提高了基线模型的序列恢复率，还使平均TM-Score从0.77显著提高到0.81，表明增强的st

4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.title: CellVerse: Do Large Language Models Really Understand Cell Biology?
4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of modeling single-cell data as natural languages and the potential of leveraging powerful large language models (LLMs) for understanding cell biology. However, a comprehensive evaluation of LLMs' performance on language-driven single-cell analysis tasks still remains unexplored. Motivated by this challenge, we introduce CellVerse, a unified language-centric question-answering benchmark that integrates four types of single-cell multi-omics data and encompasses three hierarchical levels of single-cell analysis tasks: cell type annotation (cell-level), drug response prediction (drug-level), and perturbation analysis (gene-level). Going beyond this, we systematically evaluate the performance across 14 open-source and closed-source LLMs ranging from 160M to 671B on CellVerse. 4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.zh_title: CellVerse：大语言模型真的理解细胞生物学吗
4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.summary: 研究提出以语言为中心的单细胞多组学问答基准CellVerse，用于系统评估大语言模型在细胞生物学任务上的表现。
key_points: 将单细胞数据建模为自然语言

4dd1c628a26c7b13c98e975c7ae8b5c16fbc320e.zh_abstract: 近期研究表明，将单细胞数据建模为自然语言是可行的，并且利用强大的大型语言模型（LLMs）理解细胞生物学具有潜力。然而，对LLMs在语言驱动的单细胞分析任务上性能的全面评估仍未得到探索。受这一挑战启发，我们提出了CellVerse，一个统一的以语言为中心的问答基准，它整合了四种单细胞多组学数据，并涵盖三个层级的单细胞分析任务：细胞类型注释（细胞级）、药物反应预测（药物级）和扰动分析（基因级）。更进一步，我们在CellVerse上系统评估了14个开源和闭源LLMs的性能，这些LLMs从160M到671B不等。值得注意的是，实验结果表明：（1）现有的专业

17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.title: Is Limited Participant Diversity Impeding EEG-based Machine Learning?
17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.abstract: The application of machine learning (ML) to electroencephalography (EEG) has great potential to advance both neuroscientific research and clinical applications. However, the generalisability and robustness of EEG-based ML models often hinge on the amount and diversity of training data. It is common practice to split EEG recordings into small segments, thereby increasing the number of samples substantially compared to the number of individual recordings or participants. We conceptualise this as a multi-level data generation process and investigate the scaling behaviour of model performance with respect to the overall sample size and the participant diversity through large-scale empirical studies. We then use the same framework to investigate the effectiveness of different ML strategies designed to address limited data problems: data augmentations and self-supervised learning. Our findings
17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.zh_title: 参与者多样性不足是否制约基于脑电的机器学习
17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.summary: 该研究指出脑电机器学习模型的泛化性与稳健性受训练数据规模与多样性限制，并提出将长记录切分为小片段会掩盖参与者多样性问题。
key_points: 脑电机器学习依赖训练数据量与多样性

17bc2391c9e907f6d536354acf131229856dc102.zh_abstract: 将机器学习（ML）应用于脑电图（EEG）在推进神经科学研究和临床应用方面具有巨大潜力。然而，基于EEG的ML模型的泛化性和稳健性通常取决于训练数据的数量和多样性。常见做法是将EEG记录分割成小段，从而与单个记录或参与者的数量相比大幅增加样本数量。我们将此概念化为一个多级数据生成过程，并通过大规模实证研究考察模型性能相对于总体样本量和参与者多样性的缩放行为。然后，我们使用同一框架来考察旨在解决数据有限问题的不同ML策略的有效性：数据增强和自监督学习。我们的发现

0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.title: RadZero: Similarity-Based Cross-Attention for Explainable Vision-Language Alignment in Radiology with Zero-Shot Multi-Task Capability
0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal models have significantly improved vision-language (VL) alignment in radiology. However, existing approaches struggle to effectively utilize complex radiology reports for learning and offer limited interpretability through attention probability visualizations. To address these challenges, we introduce $\textbf{RadZero}$, a novel framework for VL alignment in chest X-ray with zero-shot multi-task capability. A key component of our approach is $\textbf{VL-CABS}$ ($\textbf{V}$ision-$\textbf{L}$anguage $\textbf{C}$ross-$\textbf{A}$ttention $\textbf{B}$ased on $\textbf{S}$imilarity), which aligns text embeddings with local image features for interpretable, fine-grained VL reasoning. RadZero leverages large language models to extract concise semantic sentences from radiology reports and employs multi-positive contrastive training to effectively capture relatio
0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.zh_title: RadZero：放射学可解释视觉-语言对齐零样本框架
0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.summary: 提出RadZero框架，用于胸片视觉-语言对齐，具备零样本多任务能力并提升注意力可视化可解释性。
key_points: 面向胸片的视觉-语言对齐
基于相似度交叉注意力提升可解释性

利用复杂放射报告学习
0dcb5bd508ccf4ba192274b2a020e1b6eae14918.zh_abstract: 近期多模态模型的进展显著改善了放射学中的视觉-语言（VL）对齐。然而，现有方法难以有效利用复杂的放射学报告进行学习，并且通过注意力概率可视化提供的可解释性有限。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了 $\textbf{RadZero}$，一种用于胸部X射线中VL对齐的新型框架，具有零样本多任务能力。我们方法的一个关键组件是 $\textbf{VL-CABS}$（基于相似性的视觉-语言交叉注意力，$\textbf{V}$ision-$\textbf{L}$anguage $\textbf{C}$ross-$\textbf{A}$ttention $\textbf{B}$ased on $\textbf{S}$imilarity），它将文本嵌入与局部图像特征对齐，以实现可解释的、细粒度的VL推理。RadZero利用大型语言模型从放射学报告中提取简洁的语义句子，并采用多正例对比训练来有效捕捉关系

b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.title: Simulating Viva Voce Examinations to Evaluate Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Models
b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.abstract: Clinical reasoning in medicine is a hypothesis-driven process where physicians refine diagnoses from limited information through targeted history, physical examination, and diagnostic investigations. In contrast, current medical benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) primarily assess knowledge recall through single-turn questions, where complete clinical information is provided upfront. To address this gap, we introduce VivaBench, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates sequential clinical reasoning in LLM agents. Our dataset consists of 1762 physician-curated clinical vignettes structured as interactive scenarios that simulate a (oral) examination in medical training, requiring agents to actively probe for relevant findings, select appropriate investigations, and synthesize information across multiple steps to reach a diagnosis. While current LLMs demonstrate competence in diagnosing
b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.zh_title: 以模拟口试评估大语言模型的临床推理能力
b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.summary: 提出多轮基准VivaBench，通过模拟临床口试、逐轮追问评估大语言模型的序贯临床推理。

VivaBench为多轮、信息逐步揭示

b31a49e1a2c60fce292f63c9c2dd19d64589532d.zh_abstract: 医学中的临床推理是一个假设驱动的过程，医生通过有针对性的病史采集、体格检查和诊断性检查，从有限的信息中完善诊断。相比之下，当前针对大语言模型（LLMs）的医学基准主要通过单轮问题评估知识回忆，这些问题预先提供了完整的临床信息。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 VivaBench，这是一个多轮基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体中的序列临床推理。我们的数据集包含 1762 个由医生整理的临床案例，构建为交互式场景，模拟医学培训中的（口头）考试，要求智能体主动探测相关发现、选择适当的检查，并在多个步骤中综合信息以得出诊断。虽然当前 LLMs 在诊断方面表现出能力

7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.title: Reinforcement Learning for Out-of-Distribution Reasoning in LLMs: An Empirical Study on Diagnosis-Related Group Coding
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.abstract: Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) codes are essential for hospital reimbursement and operations but require labor-intensive assignment. Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with DRG coding due to the out-of-distribution (OOD) nature of the task: pretraining corpora rarely contain private clinical or billing data. We introduce DRG-Sapphire, which uses large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) for automated DRG coding from clinical notes. Built on Qwen2.5-7B and trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using rule-based rewards, DRG-Sapphire introduces a series of RL enhancements to address domain-specific challenges not seen in previous mathematical tasks. Our model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the MIMIC-IV benchmark and generates physician-validated reasoning for DRG assignments, significantly enhancing explainability. Our study further sheds light on broader challenges
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.zh_title: 强化学习用于DRG编码的分布外推理实证
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.summary: NeurIPS 2025 研究提出 DRG-Sapphire，基于 Qwen2.5-7B 与大模型强化学习，从临床文本自动完成 DRG 编码。
key_points: DRG编码关系医院报销，人工分配耗时
预训练语料缺私有临床与账单数据，属分布外
基于Qwen2.5-7B并以GRPO训练
7d52057bce1d4e1edd05aa31df2844bfa03a043e.zh_abstract: 诊断相关组（Diagnosis-Related Group，DRG）代码对于医院报销和运营至关重要，但需要劳动密集型的分配工作。大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）在 DRG 编码方面表现吃力，因为该任务具有分布外（out-of-distribution，OOD）性质：预训练语料库很少包含私有临床或账单数据。我们介绍 DRG-Sapphire，它使用大规模强化学习（reinforcement learning，RL）从临床笔记中进行自动 DRG 编码。DRG-Sapphire 基于 Qwen2.5-7B 构建，并使用基于规则的奖励通过组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization，GRPO）训练，引入了一系列 RL 增强，以应对先前数学任务中未见的领域特定挑战。我们的模型在 MIMIC-IV 基准上达到最先进准确率，并为 DRG 分配生成经医生验证的推理，显著增强了可解释性。我们的研究进一步揭示了更广泛的挑战

30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.title: FGBench: A Dataset and Benchmark for Molecular Property Reasoning at Functional Group-Level in Large Language Models
30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have gained significant attention in chemistry. However, most existing datasets center on molecular-level property prediction and overlook the role of fine-grained functional group (FG) information. Incorporating FG-level data can provide valuable prior knowledge that links molecular structures with textual descriptions, which can be used to build more interpretable, structure-aware LLMs for reasoning on molecule-related tasks. Moreover, LLMs can learn from such fine-grained information to uncover hidden relationships between specific functional groups and molecular properties, thereby advancing molecular design and drug discovery. Here, we introduce FGBench, a dataset comprising 625K molecular property reasoning problems with functional group information. Functional groups are precisely annotated and localized within the molecule, which ensures the dataset's
30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.zh_title: FGBench：官能团级分子性质推理数据集与基准
30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.summary: FGBench提供官能团级分子性质推理数据集与基准，用于评估大语言模型的分子相关推理能力。
key_points: 现有数据集多聚焦分子级性质预测
纳入官能团级细粒度信息
可支撑更可解释的结构感知推理
30ec8e7ff4731232fd17f604bf88938d4ee32c36.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型 (Large Language Models, LLMs) 在化学领域已引起了广泛关注。然而，大多数现有数据集集中于分子层面的性质预测，忽视了细粒度官能团 (functional group, FG) 信息的作用。纳入 FG 层面的数据可以提供有价值的先验知识，将分子结构与文本描述联系起来，这可用于构建更具可解释性、结构感知的 LLMs，以对分子相关任务进行推理。此外，LLMs 可以从这种细粒度信息中学习，以揭示特定官能团与分子性质之间的隐藏关系，从而推进分子设计与药物发现。在此，我们介绍了 FGBench，一个包含 625K 个带有官能团信息的分子性质推理问题的数据集。官能团在分子内被精确注释和定位，这确保了该数据集的

c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.title: CPSea: Large-scale cyclic peptide-protein complex dataset for machine learning in cyclic peptide design
c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.abstract: Cyclic peptides exhibit better binding afﬁnity and proteolytic stability compared to their linear counterparts. However, the development of cyclic peptide de-sign models is hindered by the scarcity of data. To address this, we introduce CPSea ( C yclic P eptide Sea ), a dataset of 2.71 million cyclic peptide-receptor complexes, curated through systematic mining of the AlphaFold Database (AFDB). Our pipeline extracts compact domains from AFDB, identiﬁes cyclization sites using the β -carbon (C β ) distance thresholds, and applies multi-stage ﬁltering to ensure structure ﬁdelity and binding compatibility. Compared with experimental data of cyclic peptides, CPSea shows similar distributions in metrics on structure ﬁdelity and wet-lab compatibility. c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.zh_title: CPSea：环肽-蛋白复合物大规模数据集
c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.summary: 发布CPSea数据集，含271万环肽-受体复合物，助力环肽设计机器学习。

c7034910e158b64809971b4b4414153117dec798.zh_abstract: 环肽与其线性对应物相比，表现出更好的结合亲和力和蛋白水解稳定性。然而，环肽设计模型的开发受到数据稀缺的阻碍。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 CPSea（Cyclic Peptide Sea），这是一个包含 271 万个环肽-受体复合物的数据集，通过对 AlphaFold 数据库（AFDB）的系统挖掘进行整理。我们的流程从 AFDB 中提取紧凑结构域，使用 β-碳（C β）距离阈值识别环化位点，并应用多阶段过滤以确保结构保真度和结合兼容性。与环肽的实验数据相比，CPSea 在结构保真度和湿实验室兼容性的指标上显示出相似的分布。据我们所知，CPSea 是迄今为止最大的环肽-受体数据集，首次实现了端到端模型训练。该 datase

9963e88a148d1f9f1886031070902898e299bb12.title: Generative Modeling of Full-Atom Protein Conformations using Latent Diffusion on Graph Embeddings
9963e88a148d1f9f1886031070902898e299bb12.abstract: Generating diverse, all-atom conformational ensembles of dynamic proteins such as G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) is critical for understanding their function, yet most generative models simplify atomic detail or ignore conformational diversity altogether. We present latent diffusion for full protein generation (LD-FPG), a framework that constructs complete all-atom protein structures, including every side-chain heavy atom, directly from molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories. LD-FPG employs a Chebyshev graph neural network (ChebNet) to obtain low-dimensional latent embeddings of protein conformations, which are processed using three pooling strategies: blind, sequential and residue-based. 9963e88a148d1f9f1886031070902898e299bb12.zh_title: 基于图嵌入潜在扩散的全原子蛋白质构象生成
9963e88a148d1f9f1886031070902898e299bb12.summary: 提出LD-FPG框架，基于分子动力学轨迹直接构建含全部侧链重原子的全原子蛋白质结构。

多数生成模型简化原子细节

9963e88a148d1f9f1886031070902898e299bb12.zh_abstract: 生成诸如 G 蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）等动态蛋白的多样化全原子构象集合对于理解其功能至关重要，但大多数生成模型简化了原子细节或完全忽略了构象多样性。我们提出用于完整蛋白质生成的潜在扩散（LD-FPG），这是一个直接从分子动力学（MD）轨迹构建完整全原子蛋白质结构（包括每个侧链重原子）的框架。LD-FPG 采用切比雪夫图神经网络（ChebNet）获得蛋白质构象的低维潜在嵌入，这些嵌入使用三种池化策略处理：盲式、顺序式和基于残基的。在这些潜在表示上训练的扩散模型生成新样本，解码器（可选地由二面角损失正则化）将这些样本映射回笛卡尔坐标。使用 D2R-MD，一个 2-

9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.title: PathVQ: Reforming Computational Pathology Foundation Model for Whole Slide Image Analysis via Vector Quantization
9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.abstract: Computational pathology and whole-slide image (WSI) analysis are pivotal in cancer diagnosis and prognosis. However, the ultra-high resolution of WSIs presents significant modeling challenges. Recent advancements in pathology foundation models have improved performance, yet most approaches rely on [CLS] token representation of tile ViT as slide-level inputs (16x16 pixels is refereed as patch and 224x224 pixels as tile). This discards critical spatial details from patch tokens, limiting downstream WSI analysis tasks. We find that leveraging all spatial patch tokens benefits WSI analysis but incurs nearly 200x higher storage and training costs (e.g., 196 tokens in ViT$_{224}$). To address this, we introduce vector quantized (VQ) distillation on patch feature, which efficiently compresses spatial patch tokens using discrete indices and a decoder. Our method reduces token dimensionality from
9153bc6eba0c1e9231415d2918730d77d4e4986b.zh_title: PathVQ：以向量量化改造病理基础模型分析全切片图像
