51aa08867c85ec5de638bd24377afc3be3d6b7a0.abstract: Designing protein binders targeting specific sites, which requires to generate realistic and functional interaction patterns, is a fundamental challenge in drug discovery. This enriched dataset enables benchmarking of predictive models under biologically realistic conditions. 3ec75ecbf938f475e1871dc70dc102ce70d629db.zh_abstract: 结直肠癌（CRC）组织病理学图像的多类组织类型分类是开发用于诊断和治疗计划的下游机器学习模型的重要一步。然而，用于构建组织分类器的公开可用 CRC 数据集常常存在形态学多样性不足、类别不平衡和图像图块质量低的问题，限制了下游模型性能和泛化能力。为填补这一研究空白，我们推出 STARC-9（STAnford coloRectal Cancer），一个用于多类组织分类的大规模数据集。STARC-9 包含 630,000 个组织病理学图像图块，均匀采样自九个临床相关组织类别（每个类别由 70,000 个图块代表），这些图块系统性地提取自斯坦福大学医学院 200 名 CRC 患者的苏木精&伊红染色全切片图像（WSI）。为构建

36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.title: Generating Multi-Table Time Series EHR from Latent Space with Minimal Preprocessing
36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.abstract: Electronic Health Records (EHR) are time-series relational databases that record patient interactions and medical events over time, serving as a critical resource for healthcare research and applications. However, privacy concerns and regulatory restrictions limit the sharing and utilization of such sensitive data, necessitating the generation of synthetic EHR datasets. Unlike previous EHR synthesis methods, which typically generate medical records consisting of expert-chosen features (e.g. a few vital signs or structured codes only), we introduce RawMed, the first framework to synthesize multi-table, time-series EHR data that closely resembles raw EHRs. Using text-based representation and compression techniques, RawMed captures complex structures and temporal dynamics with minimal preprocessing. We also propose a new evaluation framework for multi-table time-series synthetic EHRs, asses
36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.zh_title: 从潜空间生成多表时间序列电子病历数据
36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.summary: 提出从潜空间生成多表时间序列电子病历的合成方法，以极少预处理应对隐私与监管限制。
key_points: 电子病历为时间序列关系型数据库

36201ec9b9c77e7206c57642471ca67495ae6a6d.zh_abstract: 电子健康记录（EHR）是记录患者随时间交互和医疗事件的时间序列关系数据库，是医疗健康研究和应用的关键资源。然而，隐私问题和监管限制限制了此类敏感数据的共享和利用，因此需要生成合成 EHR 数据集。与以往通常生成由专家选定特征（例如仅少数生命体征或结构化代码）组成的医疗记录的 EHR 合成方法不同，我们提出 RawMed，这是首个合成与原始 EHR 高度相似的多表、时间序列 EHR 数据的框架。使用基于文本的表示和压缩技术，RawMed 以最少预处理捕获复杂结构和时间动态。我们还提出一个新的评估框架，用于多表时间序列合成 EHR，评估

20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.title: Democratizing Clinical Risk Prediction with Cross-Cohort Cross-Modal Knowledge Transfer
20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.abstract: Clinical risk prediction plays a crucial role in early disease detection and personalized intervention. While recent models increasingly incorporate multimodal data, their development typically assumes access to large-scale, multimodal datasets and substantial computational resources. In practice, however, most clinical sites operate under resource constraints, with access limited to EHR data alone and insufficient capacity to train complicated models. This gap highlights the urgent need to democratize clinical risk prediction by enabling effective deployment in data-and resource-limited local clinical settings. In this work, we propose a cross-cohort cross-modal knowledge transfer framework that leverages the multimodal model trained on a nationwide cohort and adapts it to local cohorts with only EHR data. We focus on EHR and genetic data as representative multimodal inputs and address
20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.zh_title: 跨队列跨模态知识迁移实现临床风险预测普惠
20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.summary: 提出跨队列跨模态知识迁移方法，使资源受限临床站点利用EHR数据提升风险预测。
key_points: 跨队列知识迁移
跨模态知识迁移

20bb6c6dc5a231a29eb26b7c6dd2ff2b45e4299e.zh_abstract: 临床风险预测在疾病早期检测和个性化干预中起着至关重要的作用。尽管近来的模型越来越多地整合多模态数据，但其开发通常假设能够获取大规模多模态数据集和大量计算资源。然而在实际中，大多数临床机构在资源受限的条件下运行，仅能获取电子健康记录（EHR）数据，且没有足够能力训练复杂模型。这一差距凸显了迫切需求：通过使临床风险预测能够在数据和资源受限的本地临床环境中有效部署，从而实现其普及化。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个跨队列跨模态知识迁移框架，该框架利用在全国性队列上训练的多模态模型，并将其适配到仅有 EHR 数据的本地队列。我们关注 EHR 和遗传数据作为代表性多模态输入，并解决

18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.title: Towards Multiscale Graph-based Protein Learning with Geometric Secondary Structural Motifs
18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning protein structures by capturing spatial relationships at the residue level. However, existing GNN-based methods often face challenges in learning multiscale representations and modeling long-range dependencies efficiently. In this work, we propose an efficient multiscale graph-based learning framework tailored to proteins. Our proposed framework contains two crucial components: (1) It constructs a hierarchical graph representation comprising a collection of fine-grained subgraphs, each corresponding to a secondary structure motif (e.g., $\alpha$-helices, $\beta$-strands, loops), and a single coarse-grained graph that connects these motifs based on their spatial arrangement and relative orientation. 18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.zh_title: 基于几何二级结构基序的多尺度蛋白质图学习
18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.summary: 提出面向蛋白质的多尺度图学习框架，构建层级图表示，以更高效地建模长程依赖与多尺度结构表征。

18bd9ae3d2afcae52c3955b227b2562eaf7690c9.zh_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）已成为通过学习残基层面的空间关系来学习蛋白质结构的强大工具。然而，现有基于 GNN 的方法在学习多尺度表示和高效建模长程依赖方面常常面临挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出一个为蛋白质量身定制的有效多尺度基于图的学习框架。我们提出的框架包含两个关键组成部分：（1）它构建一个分层图表示，包括一组细粒度子图，每个子图对应一个二级结构基序（例如，$\alpha$-螺旋、$\beta$-链、环），以及一个单一的粗粒度图，该图基于这些基序的空间排列和相对取向将它们连接起来。（2）它采用两个 GNN 进行特征学习：第一个在单个二级基序内运行，以捕获局部 in

ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.title: MedXpertQA: Benchmarking Expert-Level Medical Reasoning and Understanding
ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.abstract: We introduce MedXpertQA, a highly challenging and comprehensive benchmark to evaluate expert-level medical knowledge and advanced reasoning. MedXpertQA includes 4,460 questions spanning 17 specialties and 11 body systems. It includes two subsets, Text for text evaluation and MM for multimodal evaluation. Notably, MM introduces expert-level exam questions with diverse images and rich clinical information, including patient records and examination results, setting it apart from traditional medical multimodal benchmarks with simple QA pairs generated from image captions. MedXpertQA applies rigorous filtering and augmentation to address the insufficient difficulty of existing benchmarks like MedQA, and incorporates specialty board questions to improve clinical relevance and comprehensiveness. We perform data synthesis to mitigate data leakage risk and conduct multiple rounds of expert review
ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.zh_title: MedXpertQA：专家级医学推理与理解基准
ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.summary: ICML 2025提出MedXpertQA基准，含4460道题，覆盖17个专科与11个身体系统，分文本与多模态子集。
key_points: 含4460道题，覆盖17专科11系统
设文本与多模态两个子集
MM含图像、病历与检查结果
ccf92ec10b578411bb0c4950fc4e747bed31c17d.zh_abstract: 我们提出 MedXpertQA，这是一个极具挑战性且全面的基准，用于评估专家级医学知识和高级推理。MedXpertQA 包含 4,460 个问题，涵盖 17 个专科和 11 个身体系统。它包含两个子集，Text 用于文本评估，MM 用于多模态评估。值得注意的是，MM 引入了带有多样化图像和丰富临床信息（包括患者记录和检查结果）的专家级考试问题，使其区别于传统医学多模态基准中由图像描述生成的简单 QA 对。MedXpertQA 应用严格的过滤和增强，以解决现有基准（如 MedQA）难度不足的问题，并纳入专科委员会问题以提高临床相关性和全面性。我们进行数据合成以降低数据泄漏风险，并开展多轮专家审查

c618b27700eff3f59abaaa926922369b95ec7f78.title: HealthGPT: A Medical Large Vision-Language Model for Unifying Comprehension and Generation via Heterogeneous Knowledge Adaptation
c618b27700eff3f59abaaa926922369b95ec7f78.abstract: We present HealthGPT, a powerful Medical Large Vision-Language Model (Med-LVLM) that integrates medical visual comprehension and generation capabilities within a unified autoregressive paradigm. Our bootstrapping philosophy is to progressively adapt heterogeneous comprehension and generation knowledge to pre-trained large language models (LLMs). This is achieved through a novel heterogeneous low-rank adaptation (H-LoRA) technique, which is complemented by a tailored hierarchical visual perception approach and a three-stage learning strategy. To effectively learn the HealthGPT, we devise a comprehensive medical domain-specific comprehension and generation dataset called VL-Health. Experimental results demonstrate exceptional performance and scalability of HealthGPT in medical visual unified tasks. Our project can be accessed at https://github.com/DCDmllm/HealthGPT.

c618b27700eff3f59abaaa926922369b95ec7f78.summary: 提出医学大视觉语言模型HealthGPT，以异构低秩适配H-LoRA在统一自回归范式中整合医学视觉理解与生成。
key_points: 统一理解与生成的自回归范式

c618b27700eff3f59abaaa926922369b95ec7f78.zh_abstract: 我们提出 HealthGPT，一个强大的医学大型视觉-语言模型（Medical Large Vision-Language Model, Med-LVLM），它在统一的自回归范式内整合了医学视觉理解与生成能力。我们的自举（bootstrapping）理念是逐步将异质的理解与生成知识适配到预训练大语言模型（LLMs）中。这是通过一种新颖的异质低秩适配（heterogeneous low-rank adaptation, H-LoRA）技术实现的，并辅以量身定制的分层视觉感知方法和三阶段学习策略。为有效学习 HealthGPT，我们设计了一个全面的医学领域专用的理解与生成数据集，称为 VL-Health。实验结果证明了 HealthGPT 在医学视觉统一任务中卓越的性能与可扩展性。我们的项目可访问 https://github.com/DCDmllm/HealthGPT。

c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.title: All-atom Diffusion Transformers: Unified generative modelling of molecules and materials
c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.abstract: Diffusion models are the standard toolkit for generative modelling of 3D atomic systems. However, for different types of atomic systems -- such as molecules and materials -- the generative processes are usually highly specific to the target system despite the underlying physics being the same. We introduce the All-atom Diffusion Transformer (ADiT), a unified latent diffusion framework for jointly generating both periodic materials and non-periodic molecular systems using the same model: (1) An autoencoder maps a unified, all-atom representations of molecules and materials to a shared latent embedding space; and (2) A diffusion model is trained to generate new latent embeddings that the autoencoder can decode to sample new molecules or materials. c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.zh_title: 全原子扩散Transformer：分子与材料的统一生成建模
c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.summary: 提出统一的潜在扩散框架ADiT，用同一模型联合生成周期性材料与非周期性分子体系，涵盖全原子建模。
key_points: 扩散模型是三维原子体系生成的常用工具

c5837223a75ed7a186f5f2ad0a21dbf8892a3432.zh_abstract: 扩散模型是3D原子系统生成建模的标准工具包。然而，对于不同类型的原子系统——例如分子和材料——尽管底层物理相同，生成过程通常仍高度特定于目标系统。我们引入了全原子扩散Transformer（All-atom Diffusion Transformer, ADiT），这是一个统一的潜在扩散框架，用于使用同一模型联合生成周期性材料和非周期性分子系统：（1）自编码器将分子和材料的统一全原子表示映射到共享潜在嵌入空间；（2）训练扩散模型以生成新的潜在嵌入，自编码器可将其解码以采样新分子或材料。在MP20、QM9和GEOM-DRUGS数据集上的实验表明，联合训练的ADiT生成的分子和材料既逼真又有效，以及材料

42535556d6fa176751774b7084f3b282093b026d.title: MedRAX: Medical Reasoning Agent for Chest X-ray
42535556d6fa176751774b7084f3b282093b026d.abstract: Chest X-rays (CXRs) play an integral role in driving critical decisions in disease management and patient care. While recent innovations have led to specialized models for various CXR interpretation tasks, these solutions often operate in isolation, limiting their practical utility in clinical practice. We present MedRAX, the first versatile AI agent that seamlessly integrates state-of-the-art CXR analysis tools and multimodal large language models into a unified framework. MedRAX dynamically leverages these models to address complex medical queries without requiring additional training. To rigorously evaluate its capabilities, we introduce ChestAgentBench, a comprehensive benchmark containing 2,500 complex medical queries across 7 diverse categories. 42535556d6fa176751774b7084f3b282093b026d.summary: MedRAX将先进胸片分析工具与多模态大语言模型整合为统一框架，动态调用工具完成胸片解读。

42535556d6fa176751774b7084f3b282093b026d.zh_abstract: 胸部X射线片（CXR）在推动疾病管理和患者护理中的关键决策方面发挥着不可或缺的作用。尽管近期的创新为各种CXR解读任务带来了专用模型，但这些解决方案往往孤立运行，限制了它们在临床实践中的实际效用。我们提出MedRAX，这是首个多功能AI智能体，将最先进的CXR分析工具和多模态大型语言模型无缝集成到一个统一框架中。MedRAX动态利用这些模型来处理复杂的医学查询，而无需额外训练。为了严格评估其能力，我们推出ChestAgentBench，这是一个综合基准，包含跨越7个不同类别的2,500个复杂医学查询。我们的实验表明，与开源和专有模型相比，MedRAX达到了最先进的性能，represe

40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.title: GenMol: A Drug Discovery Generalist with Discrete Diffusion
40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.abstract: Drug discovery is a complex process that involves multiple stages and tasks. However, existing molecular generative models can only tackle some of these tasks. We present Generalist Molecular generative model (GenMol), a versatile framework that uses only a single discrete diffusion model to handle diverse drug discovery scenarios. GenMol generates Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) sequences through non-autoregressive bidirectional parallel decoding, thereby allowing the utilization of a molecular context that does not rely on the specific token ordering while having better sampling efficiency. GenMol uses fragments as basic building blocks for molecules and introduces fragment remasking, a strategy that optimizes molecules by regenerating masked fragments, enabling effective exploration of chemical space. 40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.zh_title: GenMol：面向药物发现的离散扩散通用模型
40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.summary: 提出GenMol，用单一离散扩散模型处理多种药物发现任务。

40c83a41820a61f9dbba02ad4d6c726a0aba48a6.zh_abstract: 药物发现是一个复杂过程，涉及多个阶段和任务。然而，现有的分子生成模型只能处理其中一些任务。我们提出了通用分子生成模型（Generalist Molecular generative model, GenMol），一个仅使用单个离散扩散模型即可处理多样药物发现场景的多功能框架。GenMol 通过非自回归双向并行解码生成基于序列附着的片段嵌入（Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding, SAFE）序列，从而允许利用不依赖于特定词元顺序的分子上下文，同时具有更好的采样效率。GenMol 使用片段作为分子的基本构建模块，并引入片段重掩码（fragment remasking），这是一种通过重新生成被掩码片段来优化分子、从而有效探索化学空间的策略。我们进一步提出分子上下文引导（molecular context guidance, MCG），一种 guidanc

6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.title: Medical Large Language Model Benchmarks Should Prioritize Construct Validity
6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.abstract: Medical large language models (LLMs) research often makes bold claims, from encoding clinical knowledge to reasoning like a physician. These claims are usually backed by evaluation on competitive benchmarks; a tradition inherited from mainstream machine learning. But how do we separate real progress from a leaderboard flex? Medical LLM benchmarks, much like those in other fields, are arbitrarily constructed using medical licensing exam questions. For these benchmarks to truly measure progress, they must accurately capture the real-world tasks they aim to represent. In this position paper, we argue that medical LLM benchmarks should (and indeed can) be empirically evaluated for their construct validity. 6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.zh_title: 医学大模型基准应优先考虑构念效度
6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.summary: ICML 2025论文指出医学LLM基准多基于执照考试题构建，主张优先考虑构念效度以衡量真实进展。
key_points: 医学LLM评估常依赖竞争性基准

6c5bf3393b57497e1bc64c7d3bffa3cf01f7620a.zh_abstract: 医学大型语言模型（LLMs）研究常常提出大胆主张，从编码临床知识到像医生一样推理。这些主张通常以在竞争性基准上的评估为依据；这是一种继承自主流机器学习的传统。但是，我们如何将真正的进展与排行榜上的炫技区分开来？医学LLM基准测试与其他领域的基准测试非常相似，都是使用医师执照考试问题任意构建的。要使这些基准测试真正衡量进展，它们必须准确捕捉其旨在代表的真实世界任务。在这篇立场论文中，我们认为医学LLM基准测试应当（而且确实可以）对其构念效度（construct validity）进行实证评估。在心理测试文献中，“构念效度”（construct validity）指测验测量潜在“构念”（construct）的能力，即评估的实际概念目标。通过绘制

ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.title: Learning-Order Autoregressive Models with Application to Molecular Graph Generation
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.abstract: Autoregressive models (ARMs) have become the workhorse for sequence generation tasks, since many problems can be modeled as next-token prediction. While there appears to be a natural ordering for text (i.e., left-to-right), for many data types, such as graphs, the canonical ordering is less obvious. To address this problem, we introduce a variant of ARM that generates high-dimensional data using a probabilistic ordering that is sequentially inferred from data. This model incorporates a trainable probability distribution, referred to as an order-policy, that dynamically decides the autoregressive order in a state-dependent manner. To train the model, we introduce a variational lower bound on the log-likelihood, which we optimize with stochastic gradient estimation. We demonstrate experimentally that our method can learn meaningful autoregressive orderings in image and graph generation. On
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.zh_title: 学习顺序自回归模型及其分子图生成应用
ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.summary: 提出以可训练的概率顺序替代固定顺序的自回归模型，适用于图等无自然序列顺序的数据，并应用于分子图生成。
key_points: 自回归模型依赖文本式自然顺序假设
图等数据类型缺乏公认规范顺序

ef10a451a1aaaf51aeeef0802fcc4d35d3d51927.zh_abstract: 自回归模型（Autoregressive Models, ARMs）已成为序列生成任务的主力，因为许多问题可以建模为下一标记预测。虽然文本似乎存在自然顺序（即从左到右），但对于许多数据类型，例如图，其规范顺序则不那么明显。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 ARM 的一个变体，它使用从数据中顺序推断的概率排序来生成高维数据。该模型包含一个可训练的概率分布，称为顺序策略（order-policy），它以依赖于状态的方式动态决定自回归顺序。为了训练模型，我们引入了对数似然上的变分下界，并使用随机梯度估计对其进行优化。我们通过实验证明，我们的方法可以在图像和图生成中学习有意义的自回归顺序。在

7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.title: Beyond Sensor Data: Foundation Models of Behavioral Data from Wearables Improve Health Predictions
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.abstract: Wearable devices record physiological and behavioral signals that can improve health predictions. While foundation models are increasingly used for such predictions, they have been primarily applied to low-level sensor data, despite behavioral data often being more informative due to their alignment with physiologically relevant timescales and quantities. We develop foundation models of such behavioral signals using over 2.5B hours of wearable data from 162K individuals, systematically optimizing architectures and tokenization strategies for this unique dataset. Evaluated on 57 health-related tasks, our model shows strong performance across diverse real-world applications including individual-level classification and time-varying health state prediction. The model excels in behavior-driven tasks like sleep prediction, and improves further when combined with representations of raw sensor
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.zh_title: 超越传感器数据：可穿戴行为数据基础模型提升健康预测
7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.summary: 基于16.2万人超25亿小时可穿戴数据构建行为信号基础模型，用于提升健康预测。

行为数据与生理相关时间尺度更契合

7b01cfae88657f2771ef91d86611fed56d5505a3.zh_abstract: 可穿戴设备记录能够改善健康预测的生理和行为信号。虽然基础模型越来越多地用于此类预测，但它们主要应用于低级传感器数据，尽管行为数据通常信息更丰富，因为它们与生理相关的时间尺度和数量保持一致。我们使用来自 162K 个体的超过 2.5B 小时的可穿戴数据开发了此类行为信号的基础模型，并针对这一独特数据集系统地优化了架构和标记化策略。在 57 项健康相关任务上评估，我们的模型在包括个体级分类和时变健康状态预测在内的多样化现实应用中表现出强大性能。该模型在睡眠预测等行为驱动任务中表现出色，并且当与原始传感器表示结合时进一步提升

6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.title: Reward-Guided Iterative Refinement in Diffusion Models at Test-Time with Applications to Protein and DNA Design
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.abstract: To fully leverage the capabilities of diffusion models, we are often interested in optimizing downstream reward functions during inference. While numerous algorithms for reward-guided generation have been recently proposed due to their significance, current approaches predominantly focus on single-shot generation, transitioning from fully noised to denoised states. We propose a novel framework for inference-time reward optimization with diffusion models inspired by evolutionary algorithms. Our approach employs an iterative refinement process consisting of two steps in each iteration: noising and reward-guided denoising. This sequential refinement allows for the gradual correction of errors introduced during reward optimization. Besides, we provide a theoretical guarantee for our framework. Finally, we demonstrate its superior empirical performance in protein and cell-type-specific regula
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.zh_title: 奖励引导扩散模型迭代优化用于蛋白质与DNA设计
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.summary: 提出推理时奖励优化框架，受进化算法启发对扩散模型迭代精炼，应用于蛋白质与DNA设计。
key_points: 测试时奖励引导的扩散模型迭代精炼
受进化算法启发的推理框架
应用于蛋白质与DNA序列设计
6e09d4a4e9a05a278d7e068b6bf69f2beb873a1c.zh_abstract: 为了充分利用扩散模型（diffusion models）的能力，我们通常希望在推理过程中优化下游奖励函数。尽管由于其重要性，最近提出了许多用于奖励引导生成的算法，但当前方法主要集中于单次生成，即从完全加噪状态过渡到去噪状态。受进化算法（evolutionary algorithms）启发，我们提出了一种利用扩散模型进行推理时奖励优化的新框架。我们的方法采用迭代细化过程，每次迭代包含两个步骤：加噪和奖励引导的去噪。这种顺序细化允许逐步纠正奖励优化过程中引入的误差。此外，我们为我们的框架提供了理论保证。最后，我们展示了其在蛋白质和细胞类型特异性调控（regula）方面优越的实证性能。

20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.title: CLIMB: Data Foundations for Large Scale Multimodal Clinical Foundation Models
20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.abstract: Recent advances in clinical AI have enabled remarkable progress across many clinical domains. However, existing benchmarks and models are primarily limited to a small set of modalities and tasks, which hinders the development of large-scale multimodal methods that can make holistic assessments of patient health and well-being. To bridge this gap, we introduce Clinical Large-Scale Integrative Multimodal Benchmark (CLIMB), a comprehensive clinical benchmark unifying diverse clinical data across imaging, language, temporal, and graph modalities. CLIMB comprises 4.51 million patient samples totaling 19.01 terabytes distributed across 2D imaging, 3D video, time series, graphs, and multimodal data. 20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.zh_title: CLIMB：大规模多模态临床基础模型的数据基础
20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.summary: 提出整合多来源临床数据的综合性多模态基准 CLIMB，推动大规模临床基础模型研究。
key_points: 现有临床基准模态与任务覆盖有限
CLIMB 统一多类临床数据与任务

20e821a7cdb3eb8f7a17b5b9ecc4bdd5e11b7666.zh_abstract: 临床AI的近期进展已在许多临床领域取得了显著进步。然而，现有的基准和模型主要局限于少量模态和任务，这阻碍了能够对患者健康和福祉进行整体评估的大规模多模态方法的发展。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了临床大规模整合多模态基准（Clinical Large-Scale Integrative Multimodal Benchmark, CLIMB），这是一个综合性的临床基准，统一了跨越影像、语言、时间序列和图模态的多样临床数据。CLIMB包含451万患者样本，总计19.01太字节，分布在2D影像、3D视频、时间序列、图和多模态数据中。通过广泛的实证评估，我们证明多任务预训练显著提高了研究不足领域的性能，在超声中实现了高达29%的提升，以及在……中提升了23%

da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.title: From Token to Rhythm: A Multi-Scale Approach for ECG-Language Pretraining
da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.abstract: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) play a vital role in monitoring cardiac health and diagnosing heart diseases. However, traditional deep learning approaches for ECG analysis rely heavily on large-scale manual annotations, which are both time-consuming and resource-intensive to obtain. To overcome this limitation, self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising alternative, enabling the extraction of robust ECG representations that can be efficiently transferred to various downstream tasks. While previous studies have explored SSL for ECG pretraining and multi-modal ECG-language alignment, they often fail to capture the multi-scale nature of ECG signals. As a result, these methods struggle to learn generalized representations due to their inability to model the hierarchical structure of ECG data. da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.zh_title: ECG-语言多尺度预训练方法
da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.summary: 提出多尺度ECG-语言预训练方法，利用自监督学习减少标注依赖，提升下游任务迁移能力。
key_points: 多尺度ECG-语言预训练
自监督学习减少标注依赖
提升下游任务迁移能力
da8d5ff7f1cea4ea8d747f3c8a1400296c0e4576.zh_abstract: 心电图（Electrocardiograms, ECGs）在监测心脏健康和诊断心脏疾病中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，传统用于心电图分析的深度学习方法严重依赖大规模人工标注，而获取这些标注既耗时又耗费资源。为克服这一局限，自监督学习（self-supervised learning, SSL）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，能够提取可高效迁移至各种下游任务的稳健心电图表示。尽管先前研究已探索将 SSL 用于心电图预训练和多模态心电图-语言对齐，但它们往往未能捕捉心电图信号的多尺度特性。因此，这些方法由于无法建模心电图数据的层次结构，难以学习泛化表示。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 MELP，一种新颖的多尺度心电图-语言预训练（Multi-scale ECG-Language Pretraining, MELP

0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.title: Multimodal Medical Code Tokenizer
0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.abstract: Foundation models trained on patient electronic health records (EHRs) require tokenizing medical data into sequences of discrete vocabulary items. Existing tokenizers treat medical codes from EHRs as isolated textual tokens. However, each medical code is defined by its textual description, its position in ontological hierarchies, and its relationships to other codes, such as disease co-occurrences and drug-treatment associations. Medical vocabularies contain more than 600,000 codes with critical information for clinical reasoning. We introduce MedTok, a multimodal medical code tokenizer that uses the text descriptions and relational context of codes. MedTok processes text using a language model encoder and encodes the relational structure with a graph encoder. 0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.zh_title: 多模态医学编码分词器
0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.summary: 提出多模态医学编码分词器，将EHR医学编码的文本描述、本体层级与编码间关系一并纳入分词。

0e87337c51dd87d13b69c81f8cd084356f2d1ae7.zh_abstract: 在患者电子健康记录（EHRs）上训练的基础模型需要将医学数据标记化为离散词汇项序列。现有分词器将来自 EHRs 的医学代码视为孤立的文本标记。然而，每个医学代码由其文本描述、在本体层级中的位置以及与其他代码的关系（如疾病共现和药物治疗关联）所定义。医学词表包含超过 600,000 个代码，这些代码含有对临床推理至关重要的信息。我们提出了 MedTok，一种多模态医学代码分词器，它使用代码的文本描述和关系上下文。MedTok 使用语言模型编码器处理文本，并使用图编码器编码关系结构。然后，它将两种模态量化为统一的标记空间，保留模态特定信息和跨模态信息。我们……

d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.title: Protein Structure Tokenization: Benchmarking and New Recipe
d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.abstract: Recent years have witnessed a surge in the development of protein structural tokenization methods, which chunk protein 3D structures into discrete or continuous representations. Structure tokenization enables the direct application of powerful techniques like language modeling for protein structures, and large multimodal models to integrate structures with protein sequences and functional texts. Despite the progress, the capabilities and limitations of these methods remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified evaluation framework. We first introduce StructTokenBench, a framework that comprehensively evaluates the quality and efficiency of structure tokenizers, focusing on fine-grained local substructures rather than global structures, as typical in existing benchmarks. d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.zh_title: 蛋白质结构Token化：基准评测与新方案

d7c5e7f65d6fd7cc7593cbd0c413f991825c9d2d.zh_abstract: 近年来，蛋白质结构分词（tokenization）方法的发展激增，这些方法将蛋白质3D结构切分成离散或连续表示。结构分词使得诸如蛋白质结构语言建模之类的强大技术以及大型多模态模型能够直接应用，以将结构与蛋白质序列和功能文本整合。尽管取得了进展，由于缺乏统一的评估框架，这些方法的能力与局限性仍鲜为人知。我们首先提出 StructTokenBench，这是一个全面评估结构分词器质量与效率的框架，关注细粒度局部子结构而非现有基准中典型的全局结构。我们的评估表明，没有任何单一模型在所有基准测试视角上都占主导地位。对码本（codebook）的观察

724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.title: An All-Atom Generative Model for Designing Protein Complexes
724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.abstract: Proteins typically exist in complexes, interacting with other proteins or biomolecules to perform their specific biological roles. Research on single-chain protein modeling has been extensively and deeply explored, with advancements seen in models like the series of ESM and AlphaFold2. Despite these developments, the study and modeling of multi-chain proteins remain largely uncharted, though they are vital for understanding biological functions. Recognizing the importance of these interactions, we introduce APM (All-Atom Protein Generative Model), a model specifically designed for modeling multi-chain proteins. 724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.zh_title: 用于设计蛋白质复合物的全原子生成模型
724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.summary: 提出面向多链蛋白质复合物的全原子生成模型，以建模蛋白质相互作用。
key_points: 蛋白质常以复合物形式发挥功能

724aa025b55fb8b165ab376a32172ab0a8026daf.zh_abstract: 蛋白质通常以复合物形式存在，与其他蛋白质或生物分子相互作用以执行其特定的生物学功能。单链蛋白质建模研究已被广泛而深入地探索，ESM 系列和 AlphaFold2 等模型取得了进展。尽管有这些发展，多链蛋白质的研究与建模在很大程度上仍属未知领域，但它们对于理解生物学功能至关重要。认识到这些相互作用的重要性，我们提出了 APM（All-Atom Protein Generative Model，全原子蛋白质生成模型），一种专门为多链蛋白质建模而设计的模型。通过整合原子级信息并利用多链蛋白质数据，APM 能够精确建模链间相互作用，并从零开始设计具有结合能力的蛋白质复合物。它还为多链

07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.title: Aligning Protein Conformation Ensemble Generation with Physical Feedback
07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.abstract: Protein dynamics play a crucial role in protein biological functions and properties, and their traditional study typically relies on time-consuming molecular dynamics (MD) simulations conducted in silico. Recent advances in generative modeling, particularly denoising diffusion models, have enabled efficient accurate protein structure prediction and conformation sampling by learning distributions over crystallographic structures. However, effectively integrating physical supervision into these data-driven approaches remains challenging, as standard energy-based objectives often lead to intractable optimization. In this paper, we introduce Energy-based Alignment (EBA), a method that aligns generative models with feedback from physical models, efficiently calibrating them to appropriately balance conformational states based on their energy differences. 07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.zh_title: 以物理反馈对齐蛋白质构象系综生成
07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.summary: 针对扩散模型构象采样难以融入物理监督的问题，提出与物理反馈对齐的蛋白质构象系综生成方法。
key_points: 蛋白动力学依赖耗时的分子动力学模拟

07c117eb9b00fb9432d1784811dbd7a97a404e90.zh_abstract: 蛋白质动力学在蛋白质生物功能与性质中起着关键作用，其传统研究通常依赖于在计算机（in silico）中进行耗时的分子动力学（MD）模拟。生成建模的近期进展，特别是去噪扩散模型，通过学习晶体学结构上的分布，使得高效、准确的蛋白质结构预测与构象采样成为可能。然而，将物理监督有效整合到这些数据驱动方法中仍然具有挑战性，因为标准的基于能量的目标往往导致难以处理的优化。在本文中，我们提出 Energy-based Alignment（EBA），一种使生成模型与物理模型反馈对齐的方法，通过高效校准它们，以基于能量差异适当平衡构象状态。在MD ensembl上的实验结果

e3ae92ee97a0183e853fedac9bdc1dbac8884fb1.title: UniMoMo: Unified Generative Modeling of 3D Molecules for De Novo Binder Design
e3ae92ee97a0183e853fedac9bdc1dbac8884fb1.abstract: The design of target-specific molecules such as small molecules, peptides, and antibodies is vital for biological research and drug discovery. In particular, UniMoMo unifies the representations of different molecules as graphs of blocks, where each block corresponds to either a standard amino acid or a molecular fragment. 13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.title: Predicting mutational effects on protein binding from folding energy
13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.abstract: Accurate estimation of mutational effects on protein-protein binding energies is an open problem with applications in structural biology and therapeutic design. Several deep learning predictors for this task have been proposed, but, presumably due to the scarcity of binding data, these methods underperform computationally expensive estimates based on empirical force fields. In response, we propose a transfer-learning approach that leverages advances in protein sequence modeling and folding stability prediction for this task. The key idea is to parameterize the binding energy as the difference between the folding energy of the protein complex and the sum of the folding energies of its binding partners. We show that using a pre-trained inverse-folding model as a proxy for folding energy provides strong zero-shot performance, and can be fine-tuned with (1) copious folding energy measurement
13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.zh_title: 由折叠能预测突变对蛋白结合的影响
13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.summary: 提出迁移学习方法，结合蛋白序列建模与折叠稳定性，预测突变对蛋白结合能的影响。
key_points: 目标是估计突变对结合能的影响

13f01fd07934737d0cb2b314749da0367976f38c.zh_abstract: 准确估计突变对蛋白质-蛋白质结合能的影响是一个未解决的问题，在结构生物学和治疗设计中具有应用。针对该任务，已有若干深度学习预测器被提出，但大概由于结合数据的稀缺，这些方法的表现不及基于经验力场的计算成本高昂的估计。作为回应，我们提出一种迁移学习方法，利用蛋白质序列建模和折叠稳定性预测方面的进展来完成该任务。关键思想是将结合能参数化为蛋白质复合物的折叠能与其结合伙伴的折叠能之和之间的差值。我们表明，使用预训练的逆向折叠模型作为折叠能的代理可提供强大的零样本性能，并可用以下数据进行微调：（1）大量的折叠能测量

31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Multimodal Protein Language Models
31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.abstract: Multimodal protein language models (PLMs) integrate sequence and token-based structural information, serving as a powerful foundation for protein modeling, generation, and design. However, the reliance on tokenizing 3D structures into discrete tokens causes substantial loss of fidelity about fine-grained structural details and correlations. In this paper, we systematically elucidate the design space of multimodal PLMs to overcome their limitations. We identify tokenization loss and inaccurate structure token predictions by the PLMs as major bottlenecks. To address these, our proposed design space covers improved generative modeling, structure-aware architectures and representation learning, and data exploration. Our advancements approach finer-grained supervision, demonstrating that token-based multimodal PLMs can achieve robust structural modeling. The effective design methods dramatica
31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.zh_title: 多模态蛋白质语言模型设计空间解析
31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.summary: ICML 2025论文系统解析多模态蛋白质语言模型设计空间，指出三维结构离散化带来的保真度损失等问题。
key_points: 多模态PLM融合序列与结构信息

31fc5eda319a5b9ede02fe7a243f3345e39635bd.zh_abstract: 多模态蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）整合了序列与基于 token 的结构信息，为蛋白质建模、生成和设计提供了强大的基础。然而，依赖将 3D 结构 token 化为离散 token 会导致细粒度结构细节及关联的保真度大幅损失。在本文中，我们系统性地阐明了多模态 PLMs 的设计空间以克服其局限性。我们将 token 化损失以及 PLMs 对结构 token 的不准确预测识别为主要瓶颈。为解决这些问题，我们提出的设计空间涵盖改进的生成建模、结构感知架构与表示学习以及数据探索。我们的进展朝向更细粒度的监督，表明基于 token 的多模态 PLMs 能够实现稳健的结构建模。有效的设计方法显著

7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.title: Compositional Flows for 3D Molecule and Synthesis Pathway Co-design
7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.abstract: Many generative applications, such as synthesis-based 3D molecular design, involve constructing compositional objects with continuous features. Here, we introduce Compositional Generative Flows (CGFlow), a novel framework that extends flow matching to generate objects in compositional steps while modeling continuous states. Our key insight is that modeling compositional state transitions can be formulated as a straightforward extension of the flow matching interpolation process. We further build upon the theoretical foundations of generative flow networks (GFlowNets), enabling reward-guided sampling of compositional structures. We apply CGFlow to synthesizable drug design by jointly designing the molecule's synthetic pathway with its 3D binding pose. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art binding affinity on all 15 targets from the LIT-PCBA benchmark, and 5.8$\times$ improvement in sampl
7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.zh_title: 组合生成流：三维分子与合成路径协同设计
7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.summary: 提出组合生成流 CGFlow，将流匹配扩展到组合步骤生成并建模连续状态，用于三维分子与合成路径协同设计。
key_points: 面向基于合成的三维分子设计
将组合状态转移建模为流匹配插值扩展
支持分子与合成路径的协同生成
7535f6505302f55ca8e3eccfbdff6f4e299d72be.zh_abstract: 许多生成式应用，例如基于合成的 3D 分子设计，涉及构建具有连续特征的组合式对象。在此，我们介绍 Compositional Generative Flows（CGFlow），这是一个新颖的框架，扩展了流匹配，以在建模连续状态的同时按组合步骤生成对象。我们的关键见解是，建模组合状态转移可以被表述为流匹配插值过程的直接扩展。我们进一步建立在生成流网络（GFlowNets）的理论基础之上，实现对组合结构的奖励引导采样。我们将 CGFlow 应用于可合成药物设计，通过联合设计分子的合成路径及其 3D 结合构象。我们的方法在 LIT-PCBA 基准的所有 15 个靶标上实现了最先进的结合亲和力，并在 sampl 上取得了 5.8$\times$ 的提升

4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.title: Raptor: Scalable Train-Free Embeddings for 3D Medical Volumes Leveraging Pretrained 2D Foundation Models
4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.abstract: Current challenges in developing foundational models for volumetric imaging data, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), stem from the computational complexity of training state-of-the-art architectures in high dimensions and curating sufficiently large datasets of volumes. To address these challenges, we introduce Raptor (Random Planar Tensor Reduction), a train-free method for generating semantically rich embeddings for volumetric data. Raptor leverages a frozen 2D foundation model, pretrained on natural images, to extract visual tokens from individual cross-sections of medical volumes. These tokens are then spatially compressed using random projections, significantly reducing computational complexity while retaining semantic information. 4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.zh_title: Raptor：免训练的3D医学体数据嵌入方法

key_points: 无需训练即可生成体数据嵌入

缓解高维训练的计算与数据难题
4f3dec2e3899fb9ac6fd1847a1b19e66b35a4c14.zh_abstract: 当前为体积成像数据（例如磁共振成像（MRI））开发基础模型所面临的挑战，源于在高维中训练最先进架构的计算复杂性以及策划足够大的体积数据集。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 Raptor（Random Planar Tensor Reduction），这是一种无需训练的方法，用于为体积数据生成语义丰富的嵌入。Raptor 利用一个在自然图像上预训练的冻结 2D 基础模型，从医学体积的各个横截面提取视觉 token。然后使用随机投影对这些 token 进行空间压缩，在保留语义信息的同时显著降低计算复杂性。在十项多样化的医学体积任务上的广泛实验验证了 Raptor 优于最先进方法的性能，包括那些

374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.title: All-atom inverse protein folding through discrete flow matching
374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.abstract: The recent breakthrough of AlphaFold3 in modeling complex biomolecular interactions, including those between proteins and ligands, nucleotides, or metal ions, creates new opportunities for protein design. In so-called inverse protein folding, the objective is to find a sequence of amino acids that adopts a target protein structure. Many inverse folding methods struggle to predict sequences for complexes that contain non-protein components, and perform poorly with complexes that adopt multiple structural states. To address these challenges, we present ADFLIP (All-atom Discrete FLow matching Inverse Protein folding), a generative model based on discrete flow-matching for designing protein sequences conditioned on all-atom structural contexts. 374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.zh_title: 基于离散流匹配的全原子逆向蛋白质折叠
374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.summary: 提出全原子逆向折叠方法，用离散流匹配为含配体、核苷酸或金属离子的复合物结构设计氨基酸序列。

374d4235543e66668d7659ca9af35b2e10634d4d.zh_abstract: AlphaFold3 最近在建模复杂生物分子相互作用（包括蛋白质与配体、核苷酸或金属离子之间的相互作用）方面取得的突破，为蛋白质设计创造了新机遇。在所谓的逆蛋白质折叠中，目标是找到一种采用目标蛋白质结构的氨基酸序列。许多逆折叠方法难以预测包含非蛋白质组分的复合物的序列，并且在采用多种结构状态的复合物上表现不佳。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 ADFLIP（All-atom Discrete FLow matching Inverse Protein folding），这是一种基于离散流匹配的生成模型，用于以全原子结构上下文为条件设计蛋白质序列。ADFLIP 在序列生成过程中逐步纳入预测的氨基酸侧链作为结构上下文，并能够设计动态

7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.title: ReQFlow: Rectified Quaternion Flow for Efficient and High-Quality Protein Backbone Generation
7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.abstract: Protein backbone generation plays a central role in de novo protein design and is significant for many biological and medical applications. Although diffusion and flow-based generative models provide potential solutions to this challenging task, they often generate proteins with undesired designability and suffer computational inefficiency. In this study, we propose a novel rectified quaternion flow (ReQFlow) matching method for fast and high-quality protein backbone generation. In particular, our method generates a local translation and a 3D rotation from random noise for each residue in a protein chain, which represents each 3D rotation as a unit quaternion and constructs its flow by spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) in an exponential format. We train the model by quaternion flow (QFlow) matching with guaranteed numerical stability and rectify the QFlow model to accelerate its inf
7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.zh_title: ReQFlow：校正四元数流用于高效蛋白质骨架生成
7d2c546d294cd827acc8c9adcc720c68df3c5624.summary: 提出校正四元数流匹配方法ReQFlow，用于快速、高质量地生成蛋白质骨架，面向从头蛋白质设计。
key_points: 蛋白质骨架生成是从头设计核心环节

83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.title: Retrieval-augmented systems can be dangerous medical communicators
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.abstract: Patients have long sought health information online, and increasingly, they are turning to generative AI to answer their health-related queries. Given the high stakes of the medical domain, techniques like retrieval-augmented generation and citation grounding have been widely promoted as methods to reduce hallucinations and improve the accuracy of AI-generated responses and have been widely adopted into search engines. This paper argues that even when these methods produce literally accurate content drawn from source documents sans hallucinations, they can still be highly misleading. Patients may derive significantly different interpretations from AI-generated outputs than they would from reading the original source material, let alone consulting a knowledgeable clinician. Through a large-scale query analysis on topics including disputed diagnoses and procedure safety, we support our arg
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.zh_title: 检索增强系统可能是危险的医疗传播者
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.summary: 论文指出检索增强与引用接地即便内容字面准确，仍可能构成危险的医疗信息传播。
key_points: 检索增强与引用接地被广泛采用
字面准确不等于安全医疗传播
呼吁重估此类系统的沟通风险
83cd33a1b71ce8b5df6289120df41b0f9da3542f.zh_abstract: 患者长期以来一直在网上寻求健康信息，并且越来越多地转向生成式 AI 来回答其健康相关查询。鉴于医学领域的高风险性，检索增强生成和引文溯源等技术已被广泛宣传为减少幻觉并提高 AI 生成回答准确性的方法，并已被广泛采用到搜索引擎中。本文认为，即使这些方法产生了从源文档中抽取的、没有幻觉的字面准确内容，它们仍可能具有高度误导性。患者可能从 AI 生成的输出中得到与阅读原始源材料时显著不同的解读，更不用说咨询知识渊博的临床医生了。通过对包括有争议诊断和操作安全性在内的主题进行大规模查询分析，我们支持我们的论点。

dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.title: Steering Protein Language Models
dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.abstract: Protein Language Models (PLMs), pre-trained on extensive evolutionary data from natural proteins, have emerged as indispensable tools for protein design. While powerful, PLMs often struggle to produce proteins with precisely specified functionalities or properties due to inherent challenges in controlling their outputs. In this work, we investigate the potential of Activation Steering, a technique originally developed for controlling text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), to direct PLMs toward generating protein sequences with targeted properties. We propose a simple yet effective method that employs activation editing to steer PLM outputs, and extend this approach to protein optimization through a novel editing site identification module. Through comprehensive experiments on lysozyme-like sequence generation and optimization, we demonstrate that our methods can be seamlessly i
dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.zh_title: 蛋白质语言模型的激活引导
dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.summary: 探究将大模型激活引导技术迁移至蛋白质语言模型，以定向控制其输出性质。
key_points: 蛋白质语言模型难以精确控制输出功能与性质
借鉴文本生成中的激活引导技术
探索对蛋白质设计的定向调控
dada5ca798f89f546b944a78cfa3a3769b6dce98.zh_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（PLM）在来自天然蛋白质的大量进化数据上预训练，已成为蛋白质设计中不可或缺的工具。尽管强大，PLM 由于控制其输出的固有挑战，常常难以产生具有精确指定功能或性质的蛋白质。在这项工作中，我们研究了激活引导（Activation Steering）的潜力，这是一种最初为控制大型语言模型（LLM）中的文本生成而开发的技术，用于引导 PLM 生成具有目标性质的蛋白质序列。我们提出了一种简单而有效的方法，该方法采用激活编辑来引导 PLM 输出，并通过一种新颖的编辑位点识别模块将这一方法扩展到蛋白质优化。通过在类溶菌酶序列生成和优化上的综合实验，我们证明我们的方法可以被无缝地 i

975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.title: CFP-Gen: Combinatorial Functional Protein Generation via Diffusion Language Models
975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.abstract: Existing PLMs generate protein sequences based on a single-condition constraint from a specific modality, struggling to simultaneously satisfy multiple constraints across different modalities. In this work, we introduce CFP-Gen, a novel diffusion language model for Combinatorial Functional Protein GENeration. CFP-Gen facilitates the de novo protein design by integrating multimodal conditions with functional, sequence, and structural constraints. Specifically, an Annotation-Guided Feature Modulation (AGFM) module is introduced to dynamically adjust the protein feature distribution based on composable functional annotations, e.g., GO terms, IPR domains and EC numbers. Meanwhile, the Residue-Controlled Functional Encoding (RCFE) module captures residue-wise interaction to ensure more precise control. 975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.zh_title: CFP-Gen：基于扩散语言模型的组合式功能蛋白生成
975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.summary: 提出扩散语言模型 CFP-Gen，整合功能、序列与结构多模态条件，实现组合式功能蛋白从头设计。
key_points: 解决单一模态单条件约束局限
整合功能、序列与结构多约束
采用注释引导特征调制模块
975da32711b08c8a30e79f58c9b9677b85fdbe16.zh_abstract: 现有 PLMs 基于来自特定模态的单一条件约束生成蛋白质序列，难以同时满足跨不同模态的多个约束。在这项工作中，我们提出 CFP-Gen，一种用于组合功能蛋白质生成（Combinatorial Functional Protein GENeration）的新型扩散语言模型。CFP-Gen 通过整合具有功能、序列和结构约束的多模态条件，促进从头蛋白质设计。具体而言，引入了注释引导特征调制（Annotation-Guided Feature Modulation, AGFM）模块，以基于可组合的功能注释（例如 GO 术语、IPR 结构域和 EC 编号）动态调整蛋白质特征分布。同时，残基控制功能编码（Residue-Controlled Functional Encoding, RCFE）模块捕获逐残基相互作用，以确保更精确的控制。此外，现成的 3D 结构编码器可以无缝集成，以施加 ge

26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.title: Flexibility-Conditioned Protein Structure Design with Flow Matching
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.abstract: Recent advances in geometric deep learning and generative modeling have enabled the design of novel proteins with a wide range of desired properties. However, current state-of-the-art approaches are typically restricted to generating proteins with only static target properties, such as motifs and symmetries. In this work, we take a step towards overcoming this limitation by proposing a framework to condition structure generation on flexibility, which is crucial for key functionalities such as catalysis or molecular recognition. We first introduce BackFlip, an equivariant neural network for predicting per-residue flexibility from an input backbone structure. Relying on BackFlip, we propose FliPS, an SE(3)-equivariant conditional flow matching model that solves the inverse problem, that is, generating backbones that display a target flexibility profile. In our experiments, we show that Fli
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.zh_title: 基于流匹配的柔性条件蛋白质结构设计
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.summary: 提出以柔性为条件的蛋白质结构生成框架，突破仅生成静态目标属性蛋白质的限制。
key_points: 现有方法多只能生成静态目标属性蛋白质
以柔性为条件驱动结构生成
采用流匹配生成框架
26e9b283f3d970741cf58835e528685eed67c7d7.zh_abstract: 近期几何深度学习（geometric deep learning）和生成建模（generative modeling）的进展使得设计具有广泛所需性质的新型蛋白质成为可能。然而，当前最先进的方法通常局限于生成仅具有静态目标性质（如基序（motifs）和对称性（symmetries））的蛋白质。在这项工作中，我们朝着克服这一局限迈出一步，提出一个框架，将结构生成以灵活性（flexibility）为条件，这对催化（catalysis）或分子识别（molecular recognition）等关键功能至关重要。我们首先引入 BackFlip，一个等变神经网络（equivariant neural network），用于从输入主链结构预测逐残基灵活性（per-residue flexibility）。依赖 BackFlip，我们提出 FliPS，一个 SE(3)-等变条件流匹配模型（SE(3)-equivariant conditional flow matching model），解决逆问题，即生成显示目标灵活性谱（target flexibility profile）的主链。在我们的实验中，我们表明 Fli

e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.title: Protriever: End-to-End Differentiable Protein Homology Search for Fitness Prediction
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.abstract: Retrieving homologous protein sequences is essential for a broad range of protein modeling tasks such as fitness prediction, protein design, structure modeling, and protein-protein interactions. Traditional workflows have relied on a two-step process: first retrieving homologs via Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSA), then training models on one or more of these alignments. However, MSA-based retrieval is computationally expensive, struggles with highly divergent sequences or complex insertions&deletions patterns, and operates independently of the downstream modeling objective. We introduce Protriever, an end-to-end differentiable framework that learns to retrieve relevant homologs while simultaneously training for the target task. When applied to protein fitness prediction, Protriever achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to sequence-based models that rely on MSA-based homolog re
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.zh_title: Protriever：面向适应度预测的端到端可微蛋白同源搜索
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.summary: 提出Protriever，以端到端可微的同源序列检索替代传统MSA两步流程，用于蛋白质适应度预测。
key_points: 同源序列检索对适应度预测等蛋白建模任务重要
传统流程先做MSA再训练模型，计算代价高
MSA检索难以处理高度歧异序列与复杂插入缺失
e97046f4956a338d4a31840822bf1fb57df33864.zh_abstract: 检索同源蛋白质序列对于广泛的蛋白质建模任务至关重要，例如适应度预测、蛋白质设计、结构建模和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。传统工作流程依赖于两步过程：首先通过多序列比对（MSA）检索同源物，然后在一个或多个这些比对上训练模型。然而，基于 MSA 的检索计算成本高昂，难以处理高度分化的序列或复杂的插入和缺失模式，并且独立于下游建模目标运行。我们引入了 Protriever，一个端到端可微分框架，它学习检索相关的同源物，同时针对目标任务进行训练。当应用于蛋白质适应度预测时，与依赖基于 MSA 的同源物检索的基于序列的模型相比，Protriever 达到了最先进的性能

291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.title: CombiMOTS: Combinatorial Multi-Objective Tree Search for Dual-Target Molecule Generation
291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.abstract: Dual-target molecule generation, which focuses on discovering compounds capable of interacting with two target proteins, has garnered significant attention due to its potential for improving therapeutic efficiency, safety and resistance mitigation. Existing approaches face two critical challenges. First, by simplifying the complex dual-target optimization problem to scalarized combinations of individual objectives, they fail to capture important trade-offs between target engagement and molecular properties. Second, they typically do not integrate synthetic planning into the generative process. This highlights a need for more appropriate objective function design and synthesis-aware methodologies tailored to the dual-target molecule generation task. In this work, we propose CombiMOTS, a Pareto Monte Carlo Tree Search (PMCTS) framework that generates dual-target molecules. CombiMOTS is des
291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.zh_title: CombiMOTS：双靶点分子生成的组合多目标树搜索
291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.summary: 提出组合多目标树搜索方法 CombiMOTS，用于生成可同时作用于两个靶点的分子。
key_points: 面向双靶点分子生成任务
避免标量化组合忽略目标间权衡
目标涵盖疗效、安全性与抗耐药性
291b52f2ceba5c21f2819c2fa4119af540173b06.zh_abstract: 双靶点分子生成，其重点在于发现能够与两种靶标蛋白相互作用的化合物，因其在提高治疗效率、安全性和缓解耐药性方面的潜力而获得了广泛关注。现有方法面临两个关键挑战。首先，通过将复杂的双靶点优化问题简化为各个目标的标量化组合，它们未能捕捉靶标结合与分子性质之间的重要权衡。其次，它们通常没有将合成规划整合到生成过程中。这凸显了对更适合双靶点分子生成任务的目标函数设计以及合成感知方法的需求。在这项工作中，我们提出 CombiMOTS，一种生成双靶点分子的帕累托蒙特卡洛树搜索 (Pareto Monte Carlo Tree Search, PMCTS) 框架。CombiMOTS 被设

1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.title: Piloting Structure-Based Drug Design via Modality-Specific Optimal Schedule
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.abstract: Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) is crucial for identifying bioactive molecules. Recent deep generative models are faced with challenges in geometric structure modeling. A major bottleneck lies in the twisted probability path of multi-modalities -- continuous 3D positions and discrete 2D topologies -- which jointly determine molecular geometries. By establishing the fact that noise schedules decide the Variational Lower Bound (VLB) for the twisted probability path, we propose VLB-Optimal Scheduling (VOS) strategy in this under-explored area, which optimizes VLB as a path integral for SBDD. Our model effectively enhances molecular geometries and interaction modeling, achieving state-of-the-art PoseBusters passing rate of 95.9% on CrossDock, more than 10% improvement upon strong baselines, while maintaining high affinities and robust intramolecular validity evaluated on held-out test set
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.zh_title: 模态特定最优调度推进基于结构的药物设计
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.summary: ICML 2025 提出 VLB 最优调度方法，改进基于结构的药物设计中连续3D与离散2D的联合几何建模。
key_points: 基于结构的药物设计用于发现生物活性分子
连续 3D 位置与离散 2D 拓扑构成主要瓶颈
噪声调度决定扭曲概率路径的变分下界
1e79c7262f52eb7ab0302c021022ca0d66054846.zh_abstract: 基于结构的药物设计（Structure-Based Drug Design, SBDD）对于识别具有生物活性的分子至关重要。近期深度生成模型在几何结构建模方面面临挑战。一个主要瓶颈在于多模态——连续的三维位置和离散的二维拓扑——的扭曲概率路径，这两者共同决定分子几何结构。通过确立噪声调度决定扭曲概率路径的变分下界（Variational Lower Bound, VLB）这一事实，我们在这个尚未充分探索的领域提出 VLB 最优调度（VLB-Optimal Scheduling, VOS）策略，该策略将 VLB 作为路径积分进行优化以用于 SBDD。我们的模型有效增强了分子几何结构和相互作用建模，在 CrossDock 上达到最先进的 PoseBusters 通过率 95.9%，较强基线提升超过 10%，同时在留出测试集上评估时保持高亲和力和稳健的分子内有效性

0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.title: Pretraining Generative Flow Networks with Inexpensive Rewards for Molecular Graph Generation
0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have recently emerged as a suitable framework for generating diverse and high-quality molecular structures by learning from rewards treated as unnormalized distributions. Previous works in this framework often restrict exploration by using predefined molecular fragments as building blocks, limiting the chemical space that can be accessed. In this work, we introduce Atomic GFlowNets (A-GFNs), a foundational generative model leveraging individual atoms as building blocks to explore drug-like chemical space more comprehensively. We propose an unsupervised pre-training approach using drug-like molecule datasets, which teaches A-GFNs about inexpensive yet informative molecular descriptors such as drug-likeliness, topological polar surface area, and synthetic accessibility scores. These properties serve as proxy rewards, guiding A-GFNs towards regions of ch
0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.zh_title: 原子级GFlowNet预训练用于分子图生成
0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.summary: 提出Atomic GFlowNets，以单个原子为构建单元预训练生成流网络，突破片段化探索对化学空间的限制。
key_points: 以单个原子而非预设片段为构建单元
借助低成本奖励进行预训练

0988bc0256481c11a32c495823780df8d78d9938.zh_abstract: 生成流网络（Generative Flow Networks, GFlowNets）最近已成为一种合适的框架，通过从被视为未归一化分布的奖励中学习，生成多样且高质量的分子结构。该框架中先前的工作通常通过使用预定义分子片段作为构建块来限制探索，从而限制了可访问的化学空间。在这项工作中，我们引入原子生成流网络（Atomic GFlowNets, A-GFNs），这是一种基础生成模型，利用单个原子作为构建块，以更全面地探索类药化学空间。我们提出一种使用类药分子数据集的无监督预训练方法，该方法教会 A-GFNs 了解廉价但信息丰富的分子描述符，如类药性、拓扑极性表面积和合成可及性分数。这些性质作为代理奖励，引导 A-GFNs 朝向 ch 的区域

ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.title: Energy-Based Flow Matching for Generating 3D Molecular Structure
ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.abstract: Molecular structure generation is a fundamental problem that involves determining the 3D positions of molecules'constituents. It has crucial biological applications, such as molecular docking, protein folding, and molecular design. Recent advances in generative modeling, such as diffusion models and flow matching, have made great progress on these tasks by modeling molecular conformations as a distribution. In this work, we focus on flow matching and adopt an energy-based perspective to improve training and inference of structure generation models. Our view results in a mapping function, represented by a deep network, that is directly learned to \textit{iteratively} map random configurations, i.e. samples from the source distribution, to target structures, i.e. points in the data manifold. This yields a conceptually simple and empirically effective flow matching setup that is theoretical
ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.zh_title: 基于能量的流匹配生成三维分子结构
ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.summary: 研究提出基于能量视角的流匹配方法，用于生成三维分子结构，可应用于分子对接、蛋白质折叠与分子设计。
key_points: 采用能量视角改进流匹配
生成分子三维构象分布

ca3a4571e77ef0b511b8fb246270d6451fa14f6a.zh_abstract: 分子结构生成是一个基本问题，涉及确定分子组成成分的3D位置。它具有关键的生物学应用，例如分子对接、蛋白质折叠和分子设计。生成建模的最新进展，例如扩散模型和流匹配，通过将分子构象建模为分布，在这些任务上取得了巨大进展。在这项工作中，我们关注流匹配，并采用基于能量的视角来改进结构生成模型的训练和推理。我们的观点导致了一个映射函数，由深度网络表示，该函数被直接学习以迭代地将随机配置（即来自源分布的样本）映射到目标结构（即数据流形中的点）。这产生了一个概念上简单且经验上有效的流匹配设置，该设置是理论上的

fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.title: Position: Beyond Assistance - Reimagining LLMs as Ethical and Adaptive Co-Creators in Mental Health Care
fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.abstract: This position paper argues for a fundamental shift in how Large Language Models (LLMs) are integrated into the mental health care domain. We advocate for their role as co-creators rather than mere assistive tools. While LLMs have the potential to enhance accessibility, personalization, and crisis intervention, their adoption remains limited due to concerns about bias, evaluation, over-reliance, dehumanization, and regulatory uncertainties. To address these challenges, we propose two structured pathways: SAFE-i (Supportive, Adaptive, Fair, and Ethical Implementation) Guidelines for ethical and responsible deployment, and HAAS-e (Human-AI Alignment and Safety Evaluation) Framework for multidimensional, human-centered assessment. SAFE-i provides a blueprint for data governance, adaptive model engineering, and real-world integration, ensuring LLMs align with clinical and ethical standards. H
fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.zh_title: 立场：LLM应成为心理健康护理的伦理共创者
fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.summary: ICML 2025立场论文主张LLM在心理健康领域应从辅助工具转向伦理且自适应的共创者角色。

fb73e567c1d90785b84368c38a5b610e1e8647f3.zh_abstract: 本立场论文主张，在大语言模型（LLMs）融入心理健康护理领域的方式上需要进行根本性转变。我们倡导将其角色定位为共同创造者，而非单纯的辅助工具。尽管 LLMs 有潜力增强可及性、个性化和危机干预，但由于对偏见、评估、过度依赖、非人性化和监管不确定性的担忧，其采用仍然有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出两条结构化路径：SAFE-i（支持性、适应性、公平和合乎伦理的实施）指南，用于合乎伦理且负责任的部署；以及 HAAS-e（人类-人工智能对齐与安全评估）框架，用于多维、以人为本的评估。SAFE-i 为数据治理、自适应模型工程和现实世界整合提供了蓝图，确保 LLMs 符合临床和伦理标准。H

732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.title: A Variational Perspective on Generative Protein Fitness Optimization
732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.abstract: The goal of protein fitness optimization is to discover new protein variants with enhanced fitness for a given use. The vast search space and the sparsely populated fitness landscape, along with the discrete nature of protein sequences, pose significant challenges when trying to determine the gradient towards configurations with higher fitness. We introduce Variational Latent Generative Protein Optimization (VLGPO), a variational perspective on fitness optimization. Our method embeds protein sequences in a continuous latent space to enable efficient sampling from the fitness distribution and combines a (learned) flow matching prior over sequence mutations with a fitness predictor to guide optimization towards sequences with high fitness. VLGPO achieves state-of-the-art results on two different protein benchmarks of varying complexity. Moreover, the variational design with explicit prior
732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.zh_title: 生成式蛋白质适应度优化的变分视角
732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.summary: 提出变分潜变量生成优化方法VLGPO，用于蛋白质适应度优化中搜索高适应度变体。

732c7bb296d55fa64025140672c3796e9bb0f590.zh_abstract: 蛋白质适应度优化的目标是发现对给定用途具有增强适应度的新蛋白质变体。巨大的搜索空间、稀疏填充的适应度景观以及蛋白质序列的离散性质，在试图确定朝向更高适应度配置的梯度时构成了重大挑战。我们引入变分潜在生成蛋白质优化（VLGPO），一种关于适应度优化的变分视角。我们的方法将蛋白质序列嵌入连续潜在空间，以便从适应度分布中进行高效采样，并将序列突变上的（学习的）流匹配先验与适应度预测器相结合，以引导优化朝向高适应度序列。VLGPO在两个复杂度不同的蛋白质基准上取得了最先进的结果。此外，带有显式先验的变分设计

46b14f4c6ee1f0c885573322e37b0f7fa52d44ff.title: Efficient Molecular Conformer Generation with SO(3)-Averaged Flow Matching and Reflow
46b14f4c6ee1f0c885573322e37b0f7fa52d44ff.abstract: Fast and accurate generation of molecular conformers is desired for downstream computational chemistry and drug discovery tasks. Currently, training and sampling state-of-the-art diffusion or flow-based models for conformer generation require significant computational resources. In this work, we build upon flow-matching and propose two mechanisms for accelerating training and inference of generative models for 3D molecular conformer generation. For fast training, we introduce the SO(3)-Averaged Flow training objective, which leads to faster convergence to better generation quality compared to conditional optimal transport flow or Kabsch-aligned flow. We demonstrate that models trained using SO(3)-Averaged Flow can reach state-of-the-art conformer generation quality. For fast inference, we show that the reflow and distillation methods of flow-based models enable few-steps or even one-step
46b14f4c6ee1f0c885573322e37b0f7fa52d44ff.zh_title: SO(3)平均流匹配加速分子构象生成
46b14f4c6ee1f0c885573322e37b0f7fa52d44ff.summary: 基于流匹配提出两种机制，加速3D分子构象生成模型的训练与推理。
key_points: 分子构象生成服务药物发现

46b14f4c6ee1f0c885573322e37b0f7fa52d44ff.zh_abstract: 在下游计算化学和药物发现任务中，人们期望快速且准确地生成分子构象。目前，为构象生成训练和采样最先进的扩散模型或基于流的模型需要大量计算资源。在这项工作中，我们基于流匹配（flow-matching）并提出了两种机制，用于加速3D分子构象生成中生成模型的训练和推理。为了实现快速训练，我们引入了SO(3)-平均流（SO(3)-Averaged Flow）训练目标，与条件最优传输流（conditional optimal transport flow）或Kabsch对齐流（Kabsch-aligned flow）相比，它能更快收敛并达到更好的生成质量。我们证明，使用SO(3)-Averaged Flow训练的模型可以达到最先进的构象生成质量。为了实现快速推理，我们表明，基于流的模型的重流（reflow）和蒸馏方法能够实现少步甚至一步

370c70836fd27d2801e6310c0ce70f994a270626.title: Evaluating LLMs Across Multi-Cognitive Levels: From Medical Knowledge Mastery to Scenario-Based Problem Solving
370c70836fd27d2801e6310c0ce70f994a270626.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on various medical benchmarks, but their capabilities across different cognitive levels remain underexplored. Inspired by Bloom's Taxonomy, we propose a multi-cognitive-level evaluation framework for assessing LLMs in the medical domain in this study. The framework integrates existing medical datasets and introduces tasks targeting three cognitive levels: preliminary knowledge grasp, comprehensive knowledge application, and scenario-based problem solving. Using this framework, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art general and medical LLMs from six prominent families: Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, GPT, and DeepSeek. Our findings reveal a significant performance decline as cognitive complexity increases across evaluated models, with model size playing a more critical role in performance at higher cognitive levels. cac6d7f0b878d37dcc5b5f931f765c6428bfc4be.abstract: Cell instance segmentation is critical to analyzing biomedical images, yet accurately distinguishing tightly touching cells remains a persistent challenge. Existing instance segmentation frameworks, including detection-based, contour-based, and distance mapping-based approaches, have made significant progress, but balancing model performance with computational efficiency remains an open problem. In this paper, we propose a novel cell instance segmentation method inspired by the four-color theorem. By conceptualizing cells as countries and tissues as oceans, we introduce a four-color encoding scheme that ensures adjacent instances receive distinct labels. This reformulation transforms instance segmentation into a constrained semantic segmentation problem with only four predicted classes, substantially simplifying the instance differentiation process. Despite recent advancements targeting specific proteins, the ability to create high-affinity binders for arbitrary protein targets on demand, without extensive rounds of wet-lab testing, remains a significant challenge. 8a31d635cab73b14e64347130d688de12294947f.title: NeuroTree: Hierarchical Functional Brain Pathway Decoding for Mental Health Disorders
8a31d635cab73b14e64347130d688de12294947f.abstract: Mental disorders are among the most widespread diseases globally. Analyzing functional brain networks through functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is crucial for understanding mental disorder behaviors. Although existing fMRI-based graph neural networks (GNNs) have demonstrated significant potential in brain network feature extraction, they often fail to characterize complex relationships between brain regions and demographic information in mental disorders. To overcome these limitations, we propose a learnable NeuroTree framework that integrates a k-hop AGE-GCN with neural ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and contrastive masked functional connectivity (CMFC) to enhance similarities and dissimilarities of brain region distance. 8a31d635cab73b14e64347130d688de12294947f.zh_title: NeuroTree：面向精神疾病的分层脑功能通路解码

8a31d635cab73b14e64347130d688de12294947f.zh_abstract: 精神障碍是全球最普遍的疾病之一。通过功能磁共振成像（fMRI）分析功能性脑网络对于理解精神障碍行为至关重要。尽管现有的基于 fMRI 的图神经网络（GNN）在脑网络特征提取中已展现出巨大潜力，但它们往往无法刻画精神障碍中脑区与人口统计学信息之间的复杂关系。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一个可学习的 NeuroTree 框架，它将 k-hop AGE-GCN 与神经常微分方程（ODE）以及对比掩码功能连接（CMFC）相结合，以增强脑区距离的相似性和差异性。此外，NeuroTree 有效地将 fMRI 网络特征解码为树结构，这改善了对高阶脑区通路的捕获

7bbcb90352dad827f40448141d2fcee56d3030f6.title: Beyond Atoms: Enhancing Molecular Pretrained Representations with 3D Space Modeling
7bbcb90352dad827f40448141d2fcee56d3030f6.abstract: Molecular pretrained representations (MPR) has emerged as a powerful approach for addressing the challenge of limited supervised data in applications such as drug discovery and material design. While early MPR methods relied on 1D sequences and 2D graphs, recent advancements have incorporated 3D conformational information to capture rich atomic interactions. However, these prior models treat molecules merely as discrete atom sets, overlooking the space surrounding them. We argue from a physical perspective that only modeling these discrete points is insufficient. We first present a simple yet insightful observation: naively adding randomly sampled virtual points beyond atoms can surprisingly enhance MPR performance. 7bbcb90352dad827f40448141d2fcee56d3030f6.zh_title: 超越原子：以3D空间建模增强分子预训练表征

7bbcb90352dad827f40448141d2fcee56d3030f6.zh_abstract: 分子预训练表示（MPR）已成为一种强大的方法，用于解决药物发现和材料设计等应用中监督数据有限的挑战。虽然早期的 MPR 方法依赖于 1D 序列和 2D 图，但最近的进展已纳入 3D 构象信息以捕获丰富的原子相互作用。然而，这些先前的模型仅将分子视为离散的原子集合，忽略了它们周围的空间。我们从物理角度认为，仅对这些离散点建模是不够的。我们首先提出一个简单但富有洞察力的观察：在原子之外简单地添加随机采样的虚拟点可以出人意料地增强 MPR 性能。鉴于此，我们提出了一个原则性框架，该框架纳入了分子所跨越的整个 3D 空间。我们通过一种新颖的基于 Transformer 的架构来实现该框架

6f52e89f1b5f809803be840e87515128e9ebb487.title: “Why Is There a Tumor?”: Tell Me the Reason, Show Me the Evidence
6f52e89f1b5f809803be840e87515128e9ebb487.abstract: Medical AI models excel at tumor detection and segmentation. However, their latent representations often lack explicit ties to clinical semantics, producing outputs less trusted in clinical practice. Most of the existing models generate either segmentation masks/labels (localizing where without why) or textual justifications (explaining why without where), failing to ground clinical concepts in spatially localized evidence. To bridge this gap, we propose to develop models that can justify the segmentation or detection using clinically relevant terms and point to visual evidence. We address two core challenges: First, we curate a rationale dataset to tackle the lack of paired images, annotations, and textual rationales for training. 6f52e89f1b5f809803be840e87515128e9ebb487.zh_title: 肿瘤为何出现：将临床语义落于空间证据

6f52e89f1b5f809803be840e87515128e9ebb487.zh_abstract: 医学 AI 模型在肿瘤检测和分割方面表现突出。然而，其潜在表征往往缺乏与临床语义的明确关联，产生在临床实践中可信度较低的结果。现有模型大多要么生成分割掩膜/标签（定位“何处”却不说明“为何”），要么生成文本论证（解释“为何”却不指出“何处”），未能将临床概念建立在空间定位的证据之上。为弥合这一差距，我们提出开发能够使用临床相关术语为分割或检测提供依据，并指向视觉证据的模型。我们应对两个核心挑战：第一，我们整理了一个理由（rationale）数据集，以解决训练中缺乏配对图像、标注和文本理由的问题。该数据集包含 180K 个图像-掩膜-理由三元组，其质量由专家放射科医生评估。第二，我们设计了理由信息引导的优化，该 d

4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.title: Distribution-aware Fairness Learning in Medical Image Segmentation From A Control-Theoretic Perspective
4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.abstract: Ensuring fairness in medical image segmentation is critical due to biases in imbalanced clinical data acquisition caused by demographic attributes (e.g., age, sex, race) and clinical factors (e.g., disease severity). To address these challenges, we introduce Distribution-aware Mixture of Experts (dMoE), inspired by optimal control theory. We provide a comprehensive analysis of its underlying mechanisms and clarify dMoE's role in adapting to heterogeneous distributions in medical image segmentation. Furthermore, we integrate dMoE into multiple network architectures, demonstrating its broad applicability across diverse medical image analysis tasks. By incorporating demographic and clinical factors, dMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance on two 2D benchmark datasets and a 3D in-house dataset. Our results highlight the effectiveness of dMoE in mitigating biases from imbalanced distributi
4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.zh_title: 基于控制论的分布感知医学图像分割公平性学习
4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.summary: 提出分布感知混合专家dMoE，借鉴最优控制理论提升医学图像分割公平性。

4a08c145ab345fed4be6c03b859aecf436d0f3e8.zh_abstract: 确保医学图像分割中的公平性至关重要，因为人口统计学属性（如年龄、性别、种族）和临床因素（如疾病严重程度）会导致不平衡的临床数据采集产生偏差。为了应对这些挑战，我们受最优控制理论启发，引入了分布感知专家混合（Distribution-aware Mixture of Experts, dMoE）。我们对其底层机制进行了全面分析，并阐明了 dMoE 在医学图像分割中适应异质分布的作用。此外，我们将 dMoE 集成到多种网络架构中，展示了其在多样化医学图像分析任务中的广泛适用性。通过纳入人口统计学和临床因素，dMoE 在两个 2D 基准数据集和一个 3D 内部数据集上实现了最先进的性能。我们的结果凸显了 dMoE 在减轻来自不均衡分布的偏差方面的有效性。

82a4124e3e76dc3fbd8e735ad41808021969ec6b.title: LangDAug: Langevin Data Augmentation for Multi-Source Domain Generalization in Medical Image Segmentation
82a4124e3e76dc3fbd8e735ad41808021969ec6b.abstract: Medical image segmentation models often struggle to generalize across different domains due to various reasons. Domain Generalization (DG) methods overcome this either through representation learning or data augmentation (DAug). f271a65d845eeb0c824717c656e5fbc6e5f384be.abstract: Recently, diffusion- and flow-based generative models of protein structures have emerged as a powerful tool for de novo protein design. 3b25ed7cf82a9fed530fecdda27dfc2dcb8015c4.abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) is essential for the clinical diagnosis of arrhythmias and other heart diseases, but deep learning methods based on ECG often face limitations due to the need for high-quality annotations. e778e55a5f7deb0ca9213a26550f69550fce3c65.abstract: We introduce DrugFlow, a generative model for structure-based drug design that integrates continuous flow matching with discrete Markov bridges, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in learning chemical, geometric, and physical aspects of three-dimensional protein-ligand data. We endow DrugFlow with an uncertainty estimate that is able to detect out-of-distribution samples. To further enhance the sampling process towards distribution regions with desirable metric values, we propose a joint preference alignment scheme applicable to both flow matching and Markov bridge frameworks. Furthermore, we extend our model to also explore the conformational landscape of the protein by jointly sampling side chain angles and molecules.

Notably, our 1D molecule LM significantly outperforms baseline

b9c3ab56eef1e4f50b422730ec42357ac206969d.abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection using deep learning has garnered significant research attention due to its broad applicability, particularly in medical imaging where labeled anomalous data are scarce. While earlier approaches leverage generative models like autoencoders and generative adversarial networks (GANs), they often fall short due to overgeneralization. Recent methods explore various strategies, including memory banks, normalizing flows, self-supervised learning, and knowledge distillation, to enhance discrimination. Among these, knowledge distillation, particularly reverse distillation, has shown promise. Following this paradigm, we propose a novel scale-aware contrastive reverse distillation model that addresses two key limitations of existing reverse distillation methods: insufficient feature discriminability and inability to handle anomaly scale variations. b4d19a909aabe7b67a3970b58eda917dd737725f.title: ProtComposer: Compositional Protein Structure Generation with 3D Ellipsoids
b4d19a909aabe7b67a3970b58eda917dd737725f.abstract: We develop ProtComposer to generate protein structures conditioned on spatial protein layouts that are specified via a set of 3D ellipsoids capturing substructure shapes and semantics. Conditioning on ellipsoids of existing proteins enables redesigning their substructure's connectivity or editing substructure properties. fe65fd3a2d633a18e6e92b58986a3123b5aeeb3c.abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), including diffusion MRI (dMRI), serves as a ``microscope'' for anatomical structures and routinely mitigates the influence of low signal-to-noise ratio scans by compromising temporal or spatial resolution. However, these compromises fail to meet clinical demands for both efficiency and precision. Consequently, denoising is a vital preprocessing step, particularly for dMRI, where clean data is unavailable. In this paper, we introduce Di-Fusion, a fully self-supervised denoising method that leverages the latter diffusion steps and an adaptive sampling process. Unlike previous approaches, our single-stage framework achieves efficient and stable training without extra noise model training and offers adaptive and controllable results in the sampling process. 1ae54bd533deab3dd33b5c81417b8f22fecf9d77.title: UniMatch: Universal Matching from Atom to Task for Few-Shot Drug Discovery
1ae54bd533deab3dd33b5c81417b8f22fecf9d77.abstract: Drug discovery is crucial for identifying candidate drugs for various diseases.However, its low success rate often results in a scarcity of annotations, posing a few-shot learning problem. Existing methods primarily focus on single-scale features, overlooking the hierarchical molecular structures that determine different molecular properties. To address these issues, we introduce Universal Matching Networks (UniMatch), a dual matching framework that integrates explicit hierarchical molecular matching with implicit task-level matching via meta-learning, bridging multi-level molecular representations and task-level generalization. Specifically, our approach explicitly captures structural features across multiple levels, such as atoms, substructures, and molecules, via hierarchical pooling and matching, facilitating precise molecular representation and comparison. bbdc99cc9dea5f78d80e6223d343ab52d35914df.abstract: Structure-based drug discovery, encompassing the tasks of protein-ligand docking and pocket-aware 3D drug design, represents a core challenge in drug discovery. However, no existing work can deal with both tasks to effectively leverage the duality between them, and current methods for each task are hindered by challenges in modeling 3D information and the limitations of available data. To address these issues, we propose 3DMolFormer, a unified dual-channel transformer-based framework applicable to both docking and 3D drug design tasks, which exploits their duality by utilizing docking functionalities within the drug design process. However, traditional drug development methods are costly and inefficient. Recognizing the pressing need for more effective solutions, researchers have turned to machine learning techniques to streamline the prediction and development of novel antibiotic compounds. While foundation models have shown promise in antibiotic discovery, current mainstream efforts still fall short of fully leveraging the potential of multimodal molecular data. adeeca58f2a1c26e4241889e45068e15b2ba3527.title: Recognize Any Surgical Object: Unleashing the Power of Weakly-Supervised Data
adeeca58f2a1c26e4241889e45068e15b2ba3527.abstract: We present RASO, a foundation model designed to Recognize Any Surgical Object, offering robust open-set recognition capabilities across a broad range of surgical procedures and object classes, in both surgical images and videos. RASO leverages a novel weakly-supervised learning framework that generates tag-image-text pairs automatically from large-scale unannotated surgical lecture videos, significantly reducing the need for manual annotations. Our scalable data generation pipeline gathers 2,200 surgical procedures and produces 3.6 million tag annotations across 2,066 unique surgical tags. Our experiments show that RASO achieves improvements of 2.9 mAP, 4.5 mAP, 10.6 mAP, and 7.2 mAP on four standard surgical benchmarks, respectively, in zero-shot settings, and surpasses state-of-the-art models in supervised surgical action recognition tasks. 7eb8d8a9b20a1311c3799af028fbd3a5be0d707e.abstract: Diagnosing the root cause of an anomaly in a complex interconnected system is a pressing problem in today's cloud services and industrial operations. 7563ad5fe50442b3cd98770dc2364ffe680065db.abstract: Exploring chemical space to find novel molecules that simultaneously satisfy multiple properties is crucial in drug discovery. However, existing methods often struggle with trading off multiple properties due to the conflicting or correlated nature of chemical properties. In the direct prediction path of InversionGNN, we train the model for multi-property prediction to acquire knowledge of the optimal combination of functional groups. fc27afde448f0df789160afa4c7ac751b81a0fee.title: Prompt as Knowledge Bank: Boost Vision-language model via Structural Representation for zero-shot medical detection
fc27afde448f0df789160afa4c7ac751b81a0fee.abstract: Zero-shot medical detection can further improve detection performance without relying on annotated medical images even upon the fine-tuned model, showing great clinical value. Recent studies leverage grounded vision-language models (GLIP) to achieve this by using detailed disease descriptions as prompts for the target disease name during the inference phase. However, these methods typically treat prompts as equivalent context to the target name, making it difficult to assign specific disease knowledge based on visual information, leading to a coarse alignment between images and target descriptions. In this paper, we propose StructuralGLIP, which introduces an auxiliary branch to encode prompts into a latent knowledge bank layer-by-layer, enabling more context-aware and fine-grained alignment. fc27afde448f0df789160afa4c7ac751b81a0fee.zh_title: 提示即知识库：结构化表征提升零样本医学检测

ab9a8817e542a4b1431496e49aa07b79de780b46.title: The Case for Cleaner Biosignals: High-fidelity Neural Compressor Enables Transfer from Cleaner iEEG to Noisier EEG
ab9a8817e542a4b1431496e49aa07b79de780b46.abstract: All data modalities are not created equal, even when the signal they measure comes from the same source. In the case of the brain, two of the most important data modalities are the scalp electroencephalogram (EEG), and the intracranial electroencephalogram (iEEG). They are used by human experts, supported by deep learning (DL) models, to accomplish a variety of tasks, such as seizure detection and motor imagery classification. Although the differences between EEG and iEEG are well understood by human experts, the performance of DL models across these two modalities remains under-explored. To help characterize the importance of clean data on the performance of DL models, we propose BrainCodec, a high-fidelity EEG and iEEG neural compressor. ab9a8817e542a4b1431496e49aa07b79de780b46.zh_title: 高保真神经压缩器实现iEEG到EEG的知识迁移

50a97e4c5caa4c72b56220bc120bb6ce7e2e451c.title: Rethinking the generalization of drug target affinity prediction algorithms via similarity aware evaluation
50a97e4c5caa4c72b56220bc120bb6ce7e2e451c.abstract: Drug-target binding affinity prediction is a fundamental task for drug discovery. It has been extensively explored in literature and promising results are reported. However, in this paper, we demonstrate that the results may be misleading and cannot be well generalized to real practice. The core observation is that the canonical randomized split of a test set in conventional evaluation leaves the test set dominated by samples with high similarity to the training set. The performance of models is severely degraded on samples with lower similarity to the training set but the drawback is highly overlooked in current evaluation. As a result, the performance can hardly be trusted when the model meets low-similarity samples in real practice. 13d8054b93c45d6858f27d10171e6e3506bb1a15.abstract: The dynamic nature of proteins, influenced by ligand interactions, is essential for comprehending protein function and progressing drug discovery. Traditional structure-based drug design (SBDD) approaches typically target binding sites with rigid structures, limiting their practical application in drug development. While molecular dynamics simulation can theoretically capture all the biologically relevant conformations, the transition rate is dictated by the intrinsic energy barrier between them, making the sampling process computationally expensive. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, we propose to use generative modeling for SBDD considering conformational changes of protein pockets. 13d8054b93c45d6858f27d10171e6e3506bb1a15.zh_title: 以全原子随机流将蛋白动态整合入基于结构的药物设计

7cd40761785edac59568417638b25f0407a935db.abstract: Protein family design emerges as a promising alternative by combining the advantages of de novo protein design and mutation-based directed evolution.In this paper, we propose ProfileBFN, the Profile Bayesian Flow Networks, for specifically generative modeling of protein families. ProfileBFN extends the discrete Bayesian Flow Network from an MSA profile perspective, which can be trained on single protein sequences by regarding it as a degenerate profile, thereby achieving efficient protein family design by avoiding large-scale MSA data construction and training. Empirical results show that ProfileBFN has a profound understanding of proteins. When generating diverse and novel family proteins, it can accurately capture the structural characteristics of the family. 7cd40761785edac59568417638b25f0407a935db.zh_title: ProfileBFN：以轮廓贝叶斯流网络引导蛋白质家族设计

0c77c73b78c1fab21ee1f3c48037e0beba81f062.title: Group Ligands Docking to Protein Pockets
0c77c73b78c1fab21ee1f3c48037e0beba81f062.abstract: Molecular docking is a key task in computational biology that has attracted increasing interest from the machine learning community. While existing methods have achieved success, they generally treat each protein-ligand pair in isolation. Inspired by the biochemical observation that ligands binding to the same target protein tend to adopt similar poses, we propose \textsc{GroupBind}, a novel molecular docking framework that simultaneously considers multiple ligands docking to a protein. This is achieved by introducing an interaction layer for the group of ligands and a triangle attention module for embedding protein-ligand and group-ligand pairs. By integrating our approach with diffusion-based docking model, we set a new S performance on the PDBBind blind docking benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed molecular docking paradigm.
