0c77c73b78c1fab21ee1f3c48037e0beba81f062.zh_abstract: 分子对接是计算生物学中的一项关键任务，已引起机器学习界日益增长的兴趣。尽管现有方法已取得成功，但它们通常将每个蛋白质-配体对孤立看待。受以下生化观察的启发：与同一靶蛋白结合的配体倾向于采取相似的姿态，我们提出 GroupBind，这是一种新颖的分子对接框架，可同时考虑多个配体与一个蛋白质对接。这是通过为配体组引入交互层，以及为嵌入蛋白质-配体和组-配体对引入三角注意力模块来实现的。通过将我们的方法与基于扩散的对接模型相结合，我们在 PDBBind 盲对接基准上设定了新的 S 性能，证明了我们提出的分子对接范式的有效性。

05efaf072e77a3cd0dd061ca9f940098826bf168.title: ProtPainter: Draw or Drag Protein via Topology-guided Diffusion
05efaf072e77a3cd0dd061ca9f940098826bf168.abstract: Recent advances in protein backbone generation have achieved promising results under structural, functional, or physical constraints. However, existing methods lack the flexibility for precise topology control, limiting navigation of the backbone space. We present ProtPainter, a diffusion-based approach for generating protein backbones conditioned on 3D curves. ProtPainter follows a two-stage process: curve-based sketching and sketch-guided backbone generation. For the first stage, we propose CurveEncoder, which predicts secondary structure annotations from a curve to parametrize sketch generation. For the second stage, the sketch guides the generative process in Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Modeling (DDPM) to generate backbones. 2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.title: Knowledgeable Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers for Personalized Medicine
2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.abstract: The goal of personalized medicine is to discover a treatment regimen that optimizes a patient’s clinical outcome based on their personal genetic and environmental factors. However, candidate treatments cannot be arbitrarily administered to the patient to assess their efficacy; we often instead have access to an in silico surrogate model that approximates the true fitness of a proposed treatment. Unfortunately, such surrogate models have been shown to fail to generalize to previously unseen patient-treatment combinations. We hypothesize that domain-specific prior knowledge—such as medical textbooks and biomedical knowledge graphs—can provide a meaningful alternative signal of the fitness of proposed treatments. 2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.zh_title: 知识型语言模型作黑箱优化器用于个性化医疗
2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.summary: 该研究将知识型语言模型作为黑箱优化器，用于在替代模型上搜索个性化治疗方案。
key_points: 个性化医疗需基于遗传与环境因素优化疗效
候选治疗无法直接试验，依赖替代模型评估
替代模型对未见过患者泛化不足
2890ec0aea2ab51bf575464b915973f3cedcb9b6.zh_abstract: 个性化医疗的目标是发现一种治疗方案，根据患者个人的遗传和环境因素优化其临床结局。然而，候选治疗不能任意施用于患者以评估其疗效；我们通常转而使用一种计算机模拟替代模型，该模型近似所提出治疗的真实适应度。不幸的是，此类替代模型已被证明无法泛化到先前未见过的患者-治疗组合。我们假设领域特定的先验知识——例如医学教科书和生物医学知识图谱——能够为所提出治疗的适应度提供有意义的替代信号。为此，我们提出了基于 LLM 的、以知识先验进行熵引导优化（LLM-based Entropy-guided Optimization with kNowledgeable priors, LEON），这是一种基于数学原理的方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为 b

551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.title: Enhanced Contrastive Learning with Multi-view Longitudinal Data for Chest X-ray Report Generation
551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.abstract: Automated radiology report generation offers an effective solution to alleviate radiologists’ workload. However, most existing methods focus primarily on single or fixed-view images to model current disease conditions, which limits diagnostic accuracy and overlooks disease progression. Although some approaches utilize longitudinal data to track disease progression, they still rely on single images to analyze current visits. To address these issues, we propose enhanced contrastive learning with Multi-view Longitudinal data to facilitate chest X-ray Report Generation, named MLRG. Specifically, we introduce a multi-view longitudinal contrastive learning method that integrates spatial information from current multi-view images and temporal information from longitudinal data. This method also utilizes the inherent spatiotemporal information of radiology reports to supervise the pre-training o
551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.zh_title: 多视角纵向数据增强对比学习生成胸片报告
551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.summary: CVPR 2025提出方法，利用多视角纵向数据与增强对比学习生成胸部X光报告。
key_points: 面向自动放射报告生成
结合多视角与纵向数据
关注疾病进展与当前就诊分析
551f11ea1416b3791b3f49b8b7ee4f565e3ac8c4.zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成提供了一种有效解决方案，以减轻放射科医生的工作量。然而，大多数现有方法主要关注单视角或固定视角图像来建模当前疾病状况，这限制了诊断准确性并忽视了疾病进展。尽管一些方法利用纵向数据来跟踪疾病进展，它们仍然依赖单张图像来分析当前就诊。为解决这些问题，我们提出了结合多视角纵向数据的增强对比学习以促进胸部X射线报告生成，名为MLRG。具体而言，我们引入了一种多视角纵向对比学习方法，该方法整合了来自当前多视角图像的空间信息和来自纵向数据的时间信息。该方法还利用放射学报告固有的时空信息来监督预训练 o

3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.title: nnWNet: Rethinking the Use of Transformers in Biomedical Image Segmentation and Calling for a Unified Evaluation Benchmark
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.abstract: Semantic segmentation is a crucial prerequisite in clinical applications and computer-aided diagnosis. With the development of deep neural networks, biomedical image segmentation has achieved remarkable success. Encoder-Decoder architectures that integrate convolutions and transformers are gaining attention for their potential to capture both global and local features. However, current designs face the contradiction that these two features cannot be continuously transmitted. In addition, some models lack a unified and standardized evaluation benchmark, leading to significant discrepancies in the experimental setup. In this study, we review and summarize these architectures and analyze their contradictions in design. We modify UNet and propose WNet to combine transformers and convolutions, addressing the transmission issue effectively. WNet captures long-range dependencies and local detai
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.zh_title: nnWNet：重新思考生物医学图像分割中的Transformer
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.summary: 提出nnWNet重新思考Transformer在生物医学图像分割中的使用，并呼吁统一评估基准。
key_points: 语义分割是临床与计算机辅助诊断前提
编解码器融合卷积与Transformer受关注
全局与局部特征当前无法持续传递
3a436775dbc0e5484bb7554d40baf702e05f19cb.zh_abstract: 语义分割是临床应用和计算机辅助诊断中的重要前提。随着深度神经网络的发展，生物医学图像分割已取得显著成功。整合卷积和 transformer 的 Encoder-Decoder 架构因其同时捕获全局和局部特征的潜力而受到关注。然而，当前设计面临矛盾：这两种特征无法被连续传递。此外，一些模型缺乏统一且标准化的评估基准，导致实验设置存在显著差异。在本研究中，我们回顾并总结这些架构，并分析其设计中的矛盾。我们修改 UNet 并提出 WNet，以结合 transformer 和卷积，有效解决传递问题。WNet 捕获长程依赖和局部细节

afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.title: BIOMEDICA: An Open Biomedical Image-Caption Archive, Dataset, and Vision-Language Models Derived from Scientific Literature
afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.abstract: The development of vision-language models (VLMs) is driven by large-scale and diverse multi-modal datasets. However, progress toward generalist biomedical VLMs is limited by the lack of annotated, publicly accessible datasets across biology and medicine. Existing efforts are limited to narrow domains, missing the full diversity of biomedical knowledge encoded in scientific literature. To address this gap, we introduce BIOMEDICA: a scalable, open-source framework to extract, annotate, and serialize the entirety of the PubMed Central Open Access subset into an easy-to-use, publicly accessible dataset. Our framework produces a comprehensive archive with over 24 million unique image-text pairs from over 6 million articles. afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.zh_title: BIOMEDICA：开放生物医学图像-文本档案与模型
afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.summary: BIOMEDICA 从科学文献中抽取并标注图像-文本数据，构建开放数据集并衍生视觉-语言模型。
key_points: 生物医学视觉-语言模型缺乏公开标注数据
既有数据集多局限于狭窄领域
提供可扩展的开源抽取与标注框架
afe5441c9185638d687c6f6843e3f907c36ac1f4.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）的发展由大规模且多样的多模态数据集驱动。然而，通用生物医学 VLMs 的进展受限于生物学和医学领域缺乏带标注、可公开访问的数据集。现有工作局限于狭窄领域，遗漏了科学文献中编码的生物医学知识的完整多样性。为填补这一空白，我们引入 BIOMEDICA：一个可扩展的开源框架，用于提取、标注并序列化 PubMed Central Open Access 子集的全部内容，将其转化为易于使用、可公开访问的数据集。我们的框架产生了一个综合档案，包含来自超过 600 万篇文章的超过 2400 万个独特图像-文本对。还额外提供元数据和专家指导的标注。我们通过发布 BMC-CLIP 来证明我们资源的实用性和可访问性，BMC-CLIP 是一套 CLIP 风格的

d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.title: MM-OR: A Large Multimodal Operating Room Dataset for Semantic Understanding of High-Intensity Surgical Environments
d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.abstract: Operating rooms (ORs) are complex, high-stakes environments requiring precise understanding of interactions among medical staff, tools, and equipment for enhancing surgical assistance, situational awareness, and patient safety. Current datasets fall short in scale, realism and do not capture the multimodal nature of OR scenes, limiting progress in OR modeling. To this end, we introduce MM-OR, a realistic and large-scale multimodal spatiotemporal OR dataset, and the first dataset to enable multimodal scene graph generation. MM-OR captures comprehensive OR scenes containing RGB-D data, detail views, audio, speech transcripts, robotic logs, and tracking data and is annotated with panoptic segmentations, semantic scene graphs, and downstream task labels. Further, we propose MM2SG, the first multimodal large vision-language model for scene graph generation, and through extensive experiments,
d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.zh_title: MM-OR：大型多模态手术室数据集
d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.summary: 研究提出MM-OR，一个真实大规模多模态时空手术室数据集，用于手术环境语义理解。
key_points: 提出MM-OR数据集
大规模多模态时空数据
面向手术室语义理解
d8cf45ca67f8c2d807c0523b3f7f7e1203a30289.zh_abstract: 手术室（ORs）是复杂、高风险的环境，需要精确理解医务人员、工具和设备之间的交互，以增强手术辅助、态势感知和患者安全。当前数据集在规模、真实性方面存在不足，且未能捕捉手术室场景的多模态特性，限制了手术室建模的进展。为此，我们引入 MM-OR，一个真实且大规模的多模态时空手术室数据集，也是首个能够实现多模态场景图生成的数据集。MM-OR 捕获包含 RGB-D 数据、细节视图、音频、语音转录文本、机器人日志和跟踪数据的全面手术室场景，并标注有全景分割、语义场景图和下游任务标签。此外，我们提出 MM2SG，首个用于场景图生成的多模态大型视觉语言模型，并且通过大量实验，

88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.title: Noise-Consistent Siamese-Diffusion for Medical Image Synthesis and Segmentation
88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized medical image segmentation, yet its full potential remains constrained by the paucity of annotated datasets. While diffusion models have emerged as a promising approach for generating synthetic image-mask pairs to augment these datasets, they paradoxically suffer from the same data scarcity challenges they aim to mitigate. Traditional mask-only models frequently yield low-fidelity images due to their inability to adequately capture morphological intricacies, which can critically compromise the robustness and reliability of segmentation models. To alleviate this limitation, we introduce Siamese-Diffusion, a novel dual-component model comprising Mask-Diffusion and Image-Diffusion. 88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.zh_title: 噪声一致孪生扩散用于医学图像合成与分割
88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.summary: 提出噪声一致孪生扩散方法，合成图像-掩码对以缓解医学图像分割标注稀缺。
key_points: 扩散模型合成图像-掩码对增强分割数据
传统仅掩码模型图像保真度低
面向医学图像合成与分割任务
88ecda31867c681925d4fe52d01ded7c13a9f6be.zh_abstract: 深度学习已经彻底改变了医学图像分割，但其全部潜力仍受限于标注数据集的缺乏。尽管扩散模型已成为生成合成图像-掩膜对以扩充这些数据集的一种有前景的方法，但矛盾的是，它们也遭受着其旨在缓解的同样数据稀缺挑战。传统的仅掩膜模型由于无法充分捕捉形态学复杂性，常常生成低保真图像，这可能严重损害分割模型的鲁棒性和可靠性。为缓解这一局限，我们引入 Siamese-Diffusion，一种新颖的双组件模型，包含 Mask-Diffusion 和 Image-Diffusion。在训练期间，在这些组件之间引入噪声一致性损失（Noise Consistency Loss），以在参数空间中增强 Mask-Diffusion 的形态保真度。在采样期间，o

be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.title: MIMO: A medical vision language model with visual referring multimodal input and pixel grounding multimodal output
be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.abstract: Currently, medical vision language models are widely used in medical vision question answering tasks. However, existing models are confronted with two issues: for input, the model only relies on text instructions and lacks direct understanding of visual clues in the image; for output, the model only gives text answers and lacks connection with key areas in the image. To address these issues, we propose a unified medical vision language model MIMO, with visual referring Multimodal Input and pixel grounding Multimodal Output. MIMO can not only combine visual clues and textual instructions to understand complex medical images and semantics, but can also ground medical terminologies in textual output within the image. be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.zh_title: MIMO：视觉指代与像素定位的医学视觉语言模型
be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.summary: 提出统一医学视觉语言模型MIMO，支持视觉指代多模态输入与像素定位多模态输出。
key_points: 现有模型输入仅靠文本指令
输出仅文本缺乏与图像区域关联
MIMO实现像素级定位输出
be14dea67bfc5d77e009363702c07545ae567f11.zh_abstract: 目前，医学视觉语言模型被广泛用于医学视觉问答任务。然而，现有模型面临两个问题：在输入方面，模型仅依赖文本指令，缺乏对图像中视觉线索的直接理解；在输出方面，模型仅给出文本答案，缺乏与图像中关键区域的联系。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个统一的医学视觉语言模型 MIMO，具有视觉指代的多模态输入（visual referring Multimodal Input）和像素定位的多模态输出（pixel grounding Multimodal Output）。MIMO 不仅能够结合视觉线索和文本指令来理解复杂的医学图像和语义，还能够将文本输出中的医学术语定位到图像中。为了克服医学领域相关数据的稀缺，我们提出了 MIMOSeg，一个包含 895K 样本的全面医学多模态数据集。MIMOSeg 的构建 fr

b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.title: Patient-Level Anatomy Meets Scanning-Level Physics: Personalized Federated Low-Dose CT Denoising Empowered by Large Language Model
b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.abstract: Reducing radiation doses benefits patients, but the resultant low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) images often suffer from clinically unacceptable noise and artifacts. While deep learning (DL) has shown promise in LDCT reconstruction, it requires large-scale data collection from multiple clients, raising privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) has been introduced to mitigate these privacy concerns; however, current methods are typically tailored to specific scanning protocols, which limits their generalizability and makes them less effective for unseen protocols. To address these issues, we propose SCANPhysFed, a novel SCanning- and ANatomy-level personalized Physics-Driven Federated learning paradigm for LDCT reconstruction. Since the noise distribution in LDCT data is closely tied to scanning protocols and anatomical structures, we propose a dual-level physics-informed way to address
b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.zh_title: 患者级解剖与扫描级物理结合：大模型赋能个性化联邦低剂量CT去噪
b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.summary: CVPR 2025 论文提出个性化联邦低剂量CT去噪方法，结合患者级解剖与扫描级物理信息，并由大语言模型赋能，以在多客户端数据不出本地的前提下应对噪声与伪影。
key_points: 低剂量CT存在噪声与伪影，影响临床可接受度
深度学习需多机构数据，存在隐私顾虑
现有联邦方法多针对特定扫描协议，适用性受限
b5b4e89784bd14996787f5a367863ebe751d27e4.zh_abstract: 降低辐射剂量对患者有益，但由此产生的低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）图像通常存在临床上不可接受的噪声和伪影。虽然深度学习（DL）在 LDCT 重建中显示出前景，但它需要从多个客户端收集大规模数据，引发了隐私问题。联邦学习（FL）已被引入以缓解这些隐私问题；然而，当前方法通常针对特定的扫描协议量身定制，这限制了它们的泛化能力，并使其对未见过的协议效果较差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 SCANPhysFed，一种新颖的扫描（SCanning）和解剖（ANatomy）级别的个性化物理驱动联邦学习范式，用于 LDCT 重建。由于 LDCT 数据中的噪声分布与扫描协议和解剖结构密切相关，我们提出了一种双级物理信息方法来以解决

f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.title: DyCON: Dynamic Uncertainty-aware Consistency and Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.abstract: Semi-supervised learning in medical image segmentation leverages unlabeled data to reduce annotation burdens through consistency learning. However, current methods struggle with class imbalance and high uncertainty from pathology variations, leading to inaccurate segmentation in 3D medical images. To address these challenges, we present DyCON, a Dynamic Uncertainty-aware Consistency and Contrastive Learning framework that enhances the generalization of consistency methods with two complementary losses: Uncertainty-aware Consistency Loss (UnCL) and Focal Entropy-aware Contrastive Loss (FeCL). UnCL enforces global consistency by dynamically weighting the contribution of each voxel to the consistency loss based on its uncertainty, preserving high-uncertainty regions instead of filtering them out. Initially, UnCL prioritizes learning from uncertain voxels with lower penalties, encouraging th
f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.zh_title: DyCON：动态不确定性感知的半监督医学图像分割
f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.summary: CVPR 2025 提出 DyCON 框架，用动态不确定性感知的一致性与对比学习缓解类别不平衡与高不确定性，改善 3D 医学图像分割。
key_points: 面向半监督医学图像分割任务
融合一致性与对比学习两种机制
针对类别不平衡与病理变异高不确定性
f7b3d1048c2aa5302d184920fc8adae66cb6b3c6.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割中的半监督学习利用未标注数据，通过一致性学习减轻标注负担。然而，当前方法难以应对类别不平衡以及由病理变化引起的高不确定性，导致 3D 医学图像中的分割不准确。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DyCON，一个动态不确定性感知一致性与对比学习（Dynamic Uncertainty-aware Consistency and Contrastive Learning）框架，它通过两个互补的损失增强一致性方法的泛化能力：不确定性感知一致性损失（UnCL）和焦点熵感知对比损失（FeCL）。UnCL 根据每个体素的不确定性动态加权其对一致性损失的贡献，从而施加全局一致性，保留高不确定性区域而非将其滤除。最初，UnCL 优先从惩罚较低的不确定性体素中学习，鼓励 th

9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.title: Show and Segment: Universal Medical Image Segmentation via In-Context Learning
9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.abstract: Medical image segmentation remains challenging due to the vast diversity of anatomical structures, imaging modalities, and segmentation tasks. While deep learning has made significant advances, current approaches struggle to generalize as they require task-specific training or fine-tuning on unseen classes. We present Iris, a novel In-context Reference Image guided Segmentation framework that enables flexible adaptation to novel tasks through the use of reference examples without fine-tuning. At its core, Iris features a lightweight context task encoding module that distills task-specific information from reference context image-label pairs. This rich context embedding information is used to guide the segmentation of target objects. By decoupling task encoding from inference, Iris supports diverse strategies from one-shot inference and context example ensemble to object-level context exa
9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.zh_title: Iris：基于上下文学习的通用医学图像分割框架
9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.summary: CVPR 2025 提出 Iris 框架，通过参考示例的上下文学习适配新分割任务，无需微调。

9004d51741a54b8ddd5b058b4020033c9ea84b7a.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割仍然具有挑战性，因为解剖结构、成像模式和分割任务多种多样。尽管深度学习取得了重大进展，但当前的方法难以泛化，因为它们需要针对特定任务进行训练或在未见类别上进行微调。我们提出了Iris，一种新颖的上下文参考图像引导分割框架，它通过使用参考示例而无需微调，能够灵活地适应新任务。其核心是，Iris具有一个轻量级的上下文任务编码模块，从参考上下文图像-标签对中提取特定任务信息。这些丰富的上下文嵌入信息用于指导目标对象的分割。通过将任务编码与推理解耦，Iris支持从单样本推理和上下文示例集成到对象级上下文示例等多种策略。

b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.title: MedUnifier: Unifying Vision-and-Language Pre-training on Medical Data with Vision Generation Task using Discrete Visual Representations
b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.abstract: Despite significant progress in Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP), current approaches predominantly emphasize feature extraction and cross-modal comprehension, with limited attention to generating or transforming visual content. This gap hinders the model’s ability to synthesize coherent and novel visual representations from textual prompts, thereby reducing the effectiveness of multi-modal learning. In this work, we propose MedUnifier, a unified VLP framework tailored for medical data. MedUnifier seamlessly integrates text-grounded image generation capabilities with multi-modal learning strategies, including image-text contrastive alignment, image-text matching and image-grounded text generation. b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.zh_title: MedUnifier：以离散视觉表示统一医学视觉语言预训练与生成
b6f14a2a31044d5e850d8490bc60da17c700ee45.summary: 提出医学视觉语言预训练框架 MedUnifier，通过离散视觉表示引入视觉生成任务。

a0f243d9e014e68f9b13552161067c3cfea1d44b.title: OpenMIBOOD: Open Medical Imaging Benchmarks for Out-Of-Distribution Detection
a0f243d9e014e68f9b13552161067c3cfea1d44b.abstract: The growing reliance on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in critical domains such as healthcare demands robust mechanisms to ensure the trustworthiness of these systems, especially when faced with unexpected or anomalous inputs. This paper introduces the Open Medical Imaging Benchmarks for Out-Of-Distribution Detection (OpenMI-BOOD), a comprehensive framework for evaluating out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods specifically in medical imaging contexts. OpenMIBOOD includes three benchmarks from diverse medical domains, encompassing 14 datasets divided into covariate-shifted in-distribution, near-OOD, and far-OOD categories. We evaluate 24 post-hoc methods across these benchmarks, providing a standardized reference to advance the development and fair comparison of OOD detection methods. 7c3f1d187dee36485755d23e22cf0c50f0a18ab7.abstract: Foundational models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) are gaining traction in medical imaging segmentation, supporting multiple downstream tasks. However, such models are supervised in nature, still relying on large annotated datasets or prompts supplied by experts. Conventional techniques such as active learning to alleviate such limitations are limited in scope and still necessitate continuous human involvement and complex domain knowledge for label refinement or establishing reward ground truth. To address these challenges, we propose an enhanced Segment Anything Model (SAM) framework that utilizes annotation-efficient prompts generated in a fully unsupervised fashion, while still capturing essential semantic, location, and shape information through contrastive language-image pretraining and visual question answering. 3ecb8447b2c2bd1c0a890ca2425cae26c2b1df51.title: dFLMoE: Decentralized Federated Learning via Mixture of Experts for Medical Data Analysis
3ecb8447b2c2bd1c0a890ca2425cae26c2b1df51.abstract: Federated learning has wide applications in the medical field. It enables knowledge sharing among different healthcare institutes while protecting patients’ privacy. However, existing federated learning systems are typically centralized, requiring clients to upload client-specific knowledge to a central server for aggregation. This centralized approach would integrate the knowledge from each client into a centralized server, and the knowledge would be already undermined during the centralized integration before it reaches back to each client. Besides, the centralized approach also creates a dependency on the central server, which may affect training stability if the server malfunctions or connections are unstable. 3ecb8447b2c2bd1c0a890ca2425cae26c2b1df51.zh_title: dFLMoE：专家混合的去中心化联邦学习医学数据分析

967288dcb37c2577c8b47510536ae40586b2ce81.abstract: The development of large-scale image-text pair datasets has significantly advanced self-supervised learning in Vision-Language Processing (VLP). However, directly applying general-domain architectures such as CLIP to medical data presents challenges, particularly in handling negations and addressing the inherent data imbalance of medical datasets. To address these issues, we propose a novel approach that integrates clinically-enhanced dynamic soft labels and medical graphical alignment, thereby improving clinical comprehension and improving the applicability of contrastive loss in medical contexts. Furthermore, we introduce negation-based hard negatives to deepen the model’s understanding of the complexities of clinical language. 967288dcb37c2577c8b47510536ae40586b2ce81.zh_title: 将CLIP引入临床：动态软标签与否定感知学习

967288dcb37c2577c8b47510536ae40586b2ce81.zh_abstract: 大规模图像-文本对数据集的发展显著推进了视觉-语言处理（Vision-Language Processing, VLP）中的自监督学习。然而，将 CLIP 等通用领域架构直接应用于医学数据会带来挑战，尤其是在处理否定表述以及应对医学数据集固有的数据不平衡方面。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种新方法，该方法整合了临床增强的动态软标签与医学图形对齐，从而提升临床理解并改善对比损失在医学语境中的适用性。此外，我们引入基于否定的难负样本，以加深模型对临床语言复杂性的理解。我们的方法易于集成到医学 CLIP 训练流程中，并在多项任务上取得最先进性能，包括零样本、微调

8eebdc15895eb880d3e92d4103eeaf7bf57cc588.title: LesionLocator: Zero-Shot Universal Tumor Segmentation and Tracking in 3D Whole-Body Imaging
8eebdc15895eb880d3e92d4103eeaf7bf57cc588.abstract: In this work, we present LesionLocator, a framework for zero-shot longitudinal lesion tracking and segmentation in 3D medical imaging, establishing the first end-to-end model capable of 4D tracking with dense spatial prompts. Our model leverages an extensive dataset of 23,262 annotated medical scans, as well as synthesized longitudinal data across diverse lesion types. The diversity and scale of our dataset significantly enhances model generalizability to real-world medical imaging challenges and addresses key limitations in longitudinal data availability. LesionLocator outperforms all existing promptable models in lesion segmentation by nearly 10 dice points, reaching human-level performance, and achieves state-of-the-art results in lesion tracking, with superior lesion retrieval and segmentation accuracy. 734b8beb568c22b492506885600e8f0ac8c367ff.title: Multi-modal Medical Diagnosis via Large-small Model Collaboration
734b8beb568c22b492506885600e8f0ac8c367ff.abstract: Recent advances in medical AI have shown a clear trend towards large models in healthcare. However, developing large models for multi-modal medical diagnosis remains challenging due to a lack of sufficient modal-complete medical data. Most existing multi-modal diagnostic models are relatively small and struggle with limited feature extraction capabilities. To bridge this gap, we propose AdaCoMed, an adaptive collaborative-learning framework that synergistically integrates the off-the-shelf medical single-modal large models with multi-modal small models. Our framework first employs a mixture-of-modality-experts (MoME) architecture to combine features extracted from multiple single-modal medical large models, and then introduces a novel adaptive co-learning mechanism to collaborate with a multi-modal small model. 734b8beb568c22b492506885600e8f0ac8c367ff.zh_title: 大小模型协作的多模态医学诊断框架

dcf7fac663ef10057c549d16e8a648c6660db987.abstract: Large pretrained visual foundation models exhibit impressive general capabilities. However, the extensive prior knowledge inherent in these models can sometimes be a double-edged sword when adapting them to downstream tasks in specific domains. In the context of semi-supervised medical image segmentation with domain shift, foundation models like MedSAM tend to make overconfident predictions, some of which are incorrect. The error accumulation hinders the effective utilization of unlabeled data and limits further improvements. In this paper, we introduce a Synergistic training framework for Foundation and Conventional models (SynFoC) to address the issue. dcf7fac663ef10057c549d16e8a648c6660db987.summary: 提出基础模型与传统模型互助的方法，用于混合域半监督医学图像分割，缓解预测过度自信导致的误差累积。

This dynamic reordering ensures that critical spatial inductive biases and long-range semantic correlations inherent in 3D brain MRI are preserved, which is crucial for imcomplete multi-modal brain tumor segmentation. 6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.title: Interactive Medical Image Analysis with Concept-based Similarity Reasoning
6a95909e870ea3ba0e6739182f75455f50f30ea1.abstract: The ability to interpret and intervene model decisions is important for the adoption of computer-aided diagnosis methods in clinical workflows. Recent concept-based methods link the model predictions with interpretable concepts and modify their activation scores to interact with the model. However, these concepts are at the image level, which hinders the model from pinpointing the exact patches the concepts are activated. Alternatively, prototype-based methods learn representations from training image patches and compare these with test image patches, using the similarity scores for final class prediction. However, interpreting the underlying concepts of these patches can be challenging and often necessitates post-hoc guesswork. 257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.title: DeformCL: Learning Deformable Centerline Representation for Vessel Extraction in 3D Medical Image
257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.abstract: In the field of 3D medical imaging, accurately extracting and representing the blood vessels with curvilinear structures holds paramount importance for clinical diagnosis. Previous methods have commonly relied on discrete representation like mask, often resulting in local fractures or scattered fragments due to the inherent limitations of the per-pixel classification paradigm. In this work, we introduce DeformCL, a new continuous representation based on Deformable Centerlines, where centerline points act as nodes connected by edges that capture spatial relationships. Compared with previous representations, DeformCL offers three key advantages: natural connectivity, noise robustness, and interaction facility. 257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.zh_title: DeformCL：3D医学图像血管提取的可变形中心线表征
257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.summary: 提出基于可变形中心线的连续表征DeformCL，用于3D医学图像中的血管提取。

257e78de6af74bfa93f89208e04b822e5af57773.zh_abstract: 在3D医学成像领域，准确提取和表示具有曲线结构的血管对于临床诊断至关重要。先前的方法通常依赖于像掩膜这样的离散表示，由于逐像素分类范式的固有局限性，常常导致局部断裂或碎片散落。在这项工作中，我们引入了DeformCL，一种基于可变形中心线（Deformable Centerlines）的新连续表示，其中中心线点充当由边连接的节点，边捕获空间关系。与先前的表示相比，DeformCL提供了三个关键优势：自然的连通性、噪声鲁棒性和交互便利性。我们提出了一个以级联方式结构化的综合训练流程，以充分利用DeformCL的这些有利特性。在四个3D血管分割

acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.title: A Semantic Knowledge Complementarity based Decoupling Framework for Semi-supervised Class-imbalanced Medical Image Segmentation
acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.abstract: The limited data annotations have made semi-supervised learning (SSL) increasingly popular in medical image analysis. However, the use of pseudo labels in SSL degrades the performance of decoders that heavily rely on high-accuracy annotations. This issue is particularly pronounced in class-imbalanced multi-organ segmentation tasks, where small organs may be under-segmented or even ignored. In this paper, we propose SKCDF, a semantic knowledge complementarity based decoupling framework for multi-organ segmentation in class-imbalanced medical images. SKCDF decouples the data flow based on the responsibilities of the encoder and decoder during model training to make the model effectively learn semantic features, while mitigating the negative impact of unlabeled data on the semantic segmentation task. acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.zh_title: SKCDF：语义知识互补解耦的半监督类不平衡医学图像分割框架
acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.summary: CVPR 2025 提出 SKCDF 解耦框架，用语义知识互补缓解半监督伪标签在类不平衡多器官分割中的小器官漏分问题。

acad8cbd165686f5046c7e25a6508e38a23bf8ce.zh_abstract: 有限的数据标注使半监督学习（SSL）在医学图像分析中日益流行。然而，在 SSL 中使用伪标签会降低严重依赖高精度标注的解码器的性能。这个问题在类别不平衡的多器官分割任务中尤为明显，其中小器官可能被分割不足甚至被忽略。在本文中，我们提出 SKCDF，一种基于语义知识互补的解耦框架，用于类别不平衡医学图像中的多器官分割。SKCDF 在模型训练期间根据编码器和解码器的职责解耦数据流，使模型能够有效学习语义特征，同时减轻未标注数据对语义分割任务的负面影响。我们还设计了一个语义知识互补模块，采用标注数据来引导

032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.title: Cross-Modal Interactive Perception Network with Mamba for Lung Tumor Segmentation in PET-CT Images
032fe8ee5714aff0c74369d07a01fda9996dcf07.abstract: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally. PET-CT is crucial for imaging lung tumors, providing essential metabolic and anatomical information, while it faces challenges such as poor image quality, motion artifacts, and complex tumor morphology. Deep learning-based models are expected to address these problems, however, existing small-scale and private datasets limit significant performance improvements for these methods. Hence, we introduce a large-scale PET-CT lung tumor segmentation dataset, termed PCLT20K, which comprises 21, 930 pairs of PET-CT images from 605 patients. Furthermore, we propose a cross-modal interactive perception network with Mamba (CIPA) for lung tumor segmentation in PET-CT images. key_points: PET-CT对肺癌成像重要，但图像质量等有挑战

f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.title: Fast and Accurate Gigapixel Pathological Image Classification with Hierarchical Distillation Multi-Instance Learning
f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.abstract: Although multi-instance learning (MIL) has succeeded in pathological image classification, it faces the challenge of high inference costs due to processing numerous patches from gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs). To address this, we propose HDMIL, a hierarchical distillation multi-instance learning framework that achieves fast and accurate classification by eliminating irrelevant patches. HD-MIL consists of two key components: the dynamic multi-instance network (DMIN) and the lightweight instance pre-screening network (LIPN). DMIN operates on high-resolution WSIs, while LIPN operates on the corresponding low-resolution counterparts. f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.zh_title: 层次蒸馏多实例学习用于病理图像分类
f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.summary: 提出HD-MIL框架，通过剔除无关切片实现千兆像素病理图像快速准确分类。
key_points: 病理全切片图像推理成本高

f7cc4e43741f952005a6d4e15e071a4c3124cca9.zh_abstract: 尽管多实例学习（MIL）在病理图像分类中取得了成功，但由于需要处理千兆像素全切片图像（WSIs）中的大量图像块，它面临高推理成本的挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出 HDMIL，一个分层蒸馏多实例学习框架，通过消除不相关的图像块来实现快速准确的分类。HD-MIL 由两个关键组件组成：动态多实例网络（DMIN）和轻量级实例预筛选网络（LIPN）。DMIN 在高分辨率 WSIs 上运行，而 LIPN 在相应的低分辨率对应图像上运行。在训练期间，DMIN 被训练用于 WSI 分类，同时生成基于注意力分数的掩码，以指示不相关的图像块。这些掩码随后指导 LIPN 的训练，以预测每个低分辨率图像块的相关性。在测试期间，LIPN f

8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.title: Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of deep learning-based methods in medical image segmentation, their use in clinical practice remains limited for two main reasons. First, obtaining a large medical dataset with precise annotations to train segmentation models is challenging. Secondly, most current segmentation techniques generate a single deterministic segmentation mask for each image. However, in real-world scenarios, there is often significant uncertainty regarding what defines the "correct" segmentation, and various expert annotators might provide different segmentations for the same image. To tackle both of these problems, we propose Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation (AmbiSSL). 8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.zh_title: 标注模糊性感知的半监督医学图像分割
8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.summary: 针对医学图像分割中精确标注获取困难与单一确定性掩码忽视“正确分割”不确定性的问题，提出标注模糊性感知的半监督分割方法。
key_points: 大规模精确标注获取困难

8d7be3f6014ea0004278bd14e1d3d1bac2374749.zh_abstract: 尽管基于深度学习的方法在医学图像分割方面取得了显著进展，但其在临床实践中的应用仍然有限，主要有两个原因。首先，获取具有精确标注的大型医学数据集以训练分割模型具有挑战性。其次，当前大多数分割技术为每张图像生成单一确定性分割掩膜。然而，在真实场景中，对于什么定义“正确”的分割往往存在显著不确定性，不同专家标注者可能对同一张图像提供不同的分割。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出标注歧义感知半监督医学图像分割（Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation，AmbiSSL）。AmbiSSL 结合少量多标注者标注数据和大量未标注数据，以生成多样且合理的分割图。我们的方法由 t

623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.title: Multi-Resolution Pathology-Language Pre-training Model with Text-Guided Visual Representation
623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.abstract: In Computational Pathology (CPath), the introduction of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has opened new avenues for research, focusing primarily on aligning image-text pairs at a single magnification level. However, this approach might not be sufficient for tasks like cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, and survival analysis due to the limited level of detail that a single-resolution image can provide. Addressing this, we propose a novel multi-resolution paradigm leveraging Whole Slide Images (WSIs) to extract histology patches at multiple resolutions and generate corresponding textual descriptions through advanced CPath VLM. 623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.zh_title: 多分辨率病理-语言预训练与文本引导视觉表征

623491543ed8f550741d9b9a4683b3146fdb6d43.zh_abstract: 在计算病理学（Computational Pathology, CPath）中，视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）的引入开辟了新的研究途径，主要集中在单一放大倍数水平下对齐图像-文本对。然而，由于单一分辨率图像所能提供的细节水平有限，这种方法对于癌症亚型分类、组织表型分析和生存分析等任务可能并不足够。针对这一点，我们提出一种新颖的多分辨率范式，利用全切片图像（Whole Slide Images, WSIs）在多个分辨率下提取组织学图像块，并通过先进的 CPath VLM 生成相应的文本描述。我们引入多分辨率下的视觉-文本对齐以及跨分辨率对齐，以建立更有效的文本引导视觉表示。使用多模态编码器的跨分辨率对齐增强了模型 cap 的能力

d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.title: AeSPa : Attention-guided Self-supervised Parallel imaging for MRI Reconstruction
d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.abstract: This study introduces a novel zero-shot scan-specific self-supervised reconstruction method for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to reduce scan times. Conventional supervised reconstruction methods require large amounts of fully-sampled reference data, which is often impractical to obtain and can lead to artifacts by overly emphasizing learned patterns. Existing zero-shot scan-specific methods have attempted to overcome this data dependency but show limited performance due to insufficient utilization of k-space information and constraints derived from MRI forward model. To address these limitations, we introduce a framework utilizing all acquired k-space measurements for both network inputs and training targets. d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.summary: 提出零样本、针对单次扫描的自监督MRI重建方法，旨在缩短扫描时间并减少数据依赖。

d336d9ff24823303664f3642e8f8514a2c56a2b3.zh_abstract: 本研究介绍了一种用于磁共振成像（MRI）的新型零样本、扫描特异性自监督重建方法，以减少扫描时间。传统的监督重建方法需要大量完全采样的参考数据，而这些数据通常难以获得，并且可能因过度强调学习到的模式而导致伪影。现有的零样本扫描特异性方法曾试图克服这种数据依赖，但由于未充分利用 k 空间信息以及源自 MRI 前向模型的约束，其性能有限。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了一个框架，利用所有采集到的 k 空间测量值同时作为网络输入和训练目标。虽然该框架存在训练不稳定的问题，但我们通过三个关键组件解决了这些挑战：一个注意力引导的 k 空间选择机制（Attention-guided K-space Selective Mechanism, AKSM），其能够 prov

cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.title: Towards All-in-One Medical Image Re-Identification
cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.abstract: Medical image re-identification (MedReID) is underexplored so far, despite its critical applications in personalized healthcare and privacy protection. In this paper, we introduce a thorough benchmark and a unified model for this problem. First, to handle various medical modalities, we propose a novel Continuous Modality-based Parameter Adapter (ComPA). ComPA condenses medical content into a continuous modality representation and dynamically adjusts the modality-agnostic model with modalityspecific parameters at runtime. This allows a single model to adaptively learn and process diverse modality data. Furthermore, we integrate medical priors into our model by aligning it with a bag of pre-trained medical foundation models, in terms of the differential features. cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.zh_title: 面向通用医学图像重识别的基准与统一模型
cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.summary: 构建医学图像重识别基准并提出统一模型，含连续模态参数适配器ComPA以应对多种医学模态。

cff30c974598561e4560a0298ae5941793620a06.zh_abstract: 医学图像重识别（MedReID）迄今为止仍未得到充分探索，尽管其在个性化医疗和隐私保护中具有关键应用。在本文中，我们为该问题引入了一个全面的基准和一个统一模型。首先，为了处理各种医学模态，我们提出了一种新颖的基于连续模态的参数适配器（ComPA）。ComPA 将医学内容浓缩为连续模态表示，并在运行时用模态特定参数动态调整模态无关模型。这使单个模型能够自适应地学习和处理多样化的模态数据。此外，我们通过将模型与一组预训练的医学基础模型在差异特征方面对齐，将医学先验整合到我们的模型中。与单图像特征相比，建模图像间差异更适合重识别问题，该问题涉及

d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.title: DART: Disease-aware Image-Text Alignment and Self-correcting Re-alignment for Trustworthy Radiology Report Generation
d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.abstract: The automatic generation of radiology reports has emerged as a promising solution to reduce a time-consuming task and accurately capture critical disease-relevant findings in X-ray images. Previous approaches for radiology report generation have shown impressive performance. However, there remains significant potential to improve accuracy by ensuring that retrieved reports contain disease-relevant findings similar to those in the X-ray images and by refining generated reports. In this study, we propose a Disease-aware image-text Alignment and self-correcting Re-alignment for Trustworthy radiology report generation (DART) framework. In the first stage, we generate initial reports based on image-to-text retrieval with disease-matching, embedding both images and texts in a shared embedding space through contrastive learning. d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.zh_title: DART：面向可信放射报告生成的疾病感知对齐
d74eb67a335c5bdfd4b6c8dc55791deaf0fa5d41.summary: 提出 DART，通过疾病感知的图像-文本对齐与自校正重对齐，生成更可信的放射报告。

1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.title: SACB-Net: Spatial-Awareness Convolutions for Medical Image Registration
1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.abstract: Deep learning-based image registration methods have shown state-of-the-art performance and rapid inference speeds. Despite these advances, many existing approaches fall short in capturing spatially varying information in non-local regions of feature maps due to the reliance on spatially-shared convolution kernels. This limitation leads to suboptimal estimation of deformation fields. In this paper, we propose a 3D Spatial-Awareness Convolution Block (SACB) to enhance the spatial information within feature representations. Our SACB estimates the spatial clusters within feature maps by leveraging feature similarity and subsequently parameterizes the adaptive convolution kernels across diverse regions. This adaptive mechanism generates the convolution kernels (weights and biases) tailored to spatial variations, thereby enabling the network to effectively capture spatially varying information
1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.zh_title: SACB-Net：面向医学图像配准的空间感知卷积
1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.summary: 提出3D空间感知卷积块SACB，缓解空间共享卷积核导致形变场估计欠佳的问题。
key_points: 共享卷积核难以捕捉空间变化信息
提出3D空间感知卷积块
改善形变场估计效果
1dc1b8629dbe8aad88e43abc92b19f8e0367b8dd.zh_abstract: 基于深度学习的图像配准方法已展现出最先进的性能和快速的推理速度。尽管有这些进展，许多现有方法由于依赖空间共享的卷积核，在捕获特征图的非局部区域中的空间变化信息方面存在不足。这一局限性导致变形场估计次优。在本文中，我们提出了一个3D空间感知卷积块（3D Spatial-Awareness Convolution Block, SACB）以增强特征表示中的空间信息。我们的SACB通过利用特征相似性来估计特征图内的空间聚类，并随后在不同区域参数化自适应卷积核。这种自适应机制生成针对空间变化的卷积核（权重和偏置），从而使网络能够有效捕获空间变化信息。

29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.title: Alignment, Mining and Fusion: Representation Alignment with Hard Negative Mining and Selective Knowledge Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering
29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-Vqa) is a challenging task that requires a deep understanding of both medical images and textual questions. Although recent works leveraging Medical Vision-Language Pre-Training (Med-Vlp) have shown strong performance on the Med-Vqa task, there is still no unified solution for modality alignment, and the issue of hard negatives remains underexplored. Additionally, commonly used knowledge fusion techniques for Med-Vqa may introduce irrelevant information. In this work, we propose a framework to address these challenges through three key contributions: (1) a unified solution for heterogeneous modality alignments across multiple levels, modalities, views, and stages, leveraging methods like contrastive learning and optimal transport theory; (2) a hard negative mining method that employs soft labels for multi-modality alignments and enforces the hard ne
29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.zh_title: 医学VQA的表示对齐、难负样本挖掘与知识融合
29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.summary: 面向医学视觉问答，提出表示对齐、难负样本挖掘与选择性知识融合的统一方法。
key_points: 医学VQA模态对齐尚无统一方案
难负样本问题研究不足
常用知识融合可能引入无关信息
29a552a6f08913ee3aa5b87032146d11c0140191.zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答（Med-Vqa）是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要对医学图像和文本问题都有深入的理解。尽管最近利用医学视觉-语言预训练（Med-Vlp）的工作在Med-Vqa任务上表现出强大的性能，但仍然没有统一的模态对齐解决方案，而且困难负样本的问题仍未得到充分探索。此外，常用的Med-Vqa知识融合技术可能会引入不相关信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个框架，通过三个关键贡献来应对这些挑战：（1）一个统一的解决方案，用于跨多个层次、模态、视图和阶段的异构模态对齐，利用对比学习和最优传输理论等方法；（2）一种困难负样本挖掘方法，该方法采用软标签进行多模态对齐，并强制困难负

24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.title: Test-Time Domain Generalization via Universe Learning: A Multi-Graph Matching Approach for Medical Image Segmentation
24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.abstract: Despite domain generalization (DG) has significantly addressed the performance degradation of pre-trained models caused by domain shifts, it often falls short in real-world deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA), which adjusts a learned model using unlabeled test data, presents a promising solution. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to deliver strong performance in medical image segmentation, primarily because they overlook the crucial prior knowledge inherent to medical images. To address this challenge, we incorporate morphological information and propose a framework based on multi-graph matching. Specifically, we introduce learnable universe embeddings that integrate morphological priors during multi-source training, along with novel unsupervised test-time paradigms for domain adaptation. This approach guarantees cycle-consistency in multi-matching while enabling the model t
24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.zh_title: 多图匹配的测试时域泛化医学图像分割
24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.summary: 提出基于Universe Learning的多图匹配方法，实现医学图像分割的测试时域泛化。
key_points: 域偏移导致预训练模型性能下降
现有测试时适应方法忽略医学先验
以多图匹配统一学习实现域泛化
24ca2aaa9579e914c8d81cf937ae0eff986d88be.zh_abstract: 尽管领域泛化（DG）已显著解决了由领域偏移引起的预训练模型性能下降问题，但在实际部署中往往表现不佳。测试时自适应（TTA）通过使用未标记的测试数据调整学习到的模型，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，大多数现有的TTA方法在医学图像分割中难以提供强大性能，主要是因为它们忽略了医学图像固有的关键先验知识。为了应对这一挑战，我们结合形态学信息，提出了一个基于多图匹配的框架。具体而言，我们引入了可学习的全域嵌入，在多源训练期间整合形态学先验，以及用于领域自适应的新型无监督测试时范式。这种方法保证了多匹配中的循环一致性，同时使模型能

0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.title: HistoFS: Non-IID Histopathologic Whole Slide Image Classification via Federated Style Transfer with RoI-Preserving
0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.abstract: Federated learning for pathological whole slide image (WSI) classification allows multiple clients to train a global multiple instance learning (MIL) model without sharing their privacy-sensitive WSIs. To accommodate the non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) feature shifts, cross-client style transfer has been popularly used but is subject to two fundamental issues: (1) WSI contains multiple morphological structures, each corresponding to a distinct style. (2) Performing style transfer may potentially shift the region of interests (RoIs) in the augmented WSIs. To address these challenges, we propose HistoFS, a federated learning framework for computational pathology on non-i.i.d. feature shifts in WSI classification. Specifically, we introduce pseudo bag styles that capture multiple style variations within a single WSI. In addition, an authenticity module is introduced
0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.zh_title: HistoFS：非独立同分布病理全切片联邦分类
0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.summary: 提出HistoFS方法，通过联邦风格迁移与感兴趣区域保留，解决非独立同分布病理全切片图像分类问题。
key_points: 联邦学习保护病理数据隐私
风格迁移应对非独立同分布
保留感兴趣区域提升分类
0b4ebbfec4da1fe4d5cc76f5b0383d28a0d509e7.zh_abstract: 用于病理全切片图像（whole slide image, WSI）分类的联邦学习允许多个客户端在不共享其隐私敏感的 WSI 的情况下训练一个全局多示例学习（multiple instance learning, MIL）模型。为适应非独立同分布（non-independent and identically distributed, non-i.i.d.）的特征偏移，跨客户端风格迁移已被广泛使用，但它存在两个基本问题：（1）WSI 包含多种形态结构，每种结构对应一种不同的风格。（2）执行风格迁移可能会在增强后的 WSI 中移动感兴趣区域（region of interests, RoIs）。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HistoFS，一种用于计算病理学的联邦学习框架，针对 WSI 分类中的 non-i.i.d. 特征偏移。具体而言，我们引入伪袋风格（pseudo bag styles），其捕获单个 WSI 内的多种风格变化。此外，引入了一个真实性模块

460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.title: Multi-modal Topology-embedded Graph Learning for Spatially Resolved Genes Prediction from Pathology Images with Prior Gene Similarity Information
460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.abstract: The rapid development of spatial transcriptomics (ST) allows researchers to measure the spatial-level gene expression in tissues. Although powerful, the cost for collecting the ST data is expensive, and thus several studies aim to predict gene expression in ST by utilizing their corresponding H/E stained pathology images. The existing ST based gene expression prediction models either adopt the pre-trained networks or rely on the handcrafted features to describe the pathology images, which still lack a systematic way to combine them together to define a spot-level representation that can reflect the topological profiles of different spots. 460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.zh_title: 多模态拓扑嵌入图学习从病理图像预测空间基因
460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.summary: CVPR 2025提出多模态拓扑嵌入图学习，利用病理图像和基因相似性先验预测空间基因表达。
key_points: 从H/E病理图像预测空间转录组基因
融合先验基因相似性信息
解决现有模型依赖预训练或手工特征
460f2d9a18c7792d59d59b86b99e5c8a9ff5bf7c.zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics, ST）的快速发展使研究人员能够测量组织中的空间水平基因表达。尽管功能强大，但收集 ST 数据的成本高昂，因此一些研究旨在利用其对应的 H/E 染色病理图像来预测 ST 中的基因表达。现有的基于 ST 的基因表达预测模型要么采用预训练网络，要么依赖手工设计的特征来描述病理图像，仍缺乏一种系统化的方式将它们结合起来，以定义能够反映不同 spot 拓扑轮廓的 spot 级表示。另一方面，所有基于 ST 的基因预测模型都独立地处理每个基因的预测任务，忽视了探索它们之间潜在相互关系有助于提高 ind 的预测性能这一事实。

2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.title: Multi-modal Contrastive Learning with Negative Sampling Calibration for Phenotypic Drug Discovery
2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery presents a promising strategy for identifying first-in-class drugs by bypassing the need for specific drug targets. Recent advances in cell-based phenotypic screening tools, including Cell Painting and the LINCS L1000, provide essential cellular data that capture biological responses to compounds. While the integration of the multi-modal data enhances the use of contrastive learning (CL) methods for molecular phenotypic representation, these approaches treat all negative pairs equally, failing to discriminate molecules with similar phenotypes. To address these challenges, we introduce a foundational framework MINER that dynamically estimates the likelihoods of sample pairs as negative pairs based on uni-modal disentangled representations. In addition, our approach incorporates a mixture fusion strategy to effectively integrate multimodal data, even in cases wher
2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.zh_title: 面向表型药物发现的多模态对比学习与负采样校准
2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.summary: CVPR 2025论文，提出多模态对比学习与负采样校准方法用于表型药物发现。
key_points: 整合细胞表型多模态数据
改进对比学习负采样校准
面向表型药物发现
2c2d362d552cc09f7c0d0396d93bb66a8e91a7ee.zh_abstract: 表型药物发现通过绕过对特定药物靶点的需求，为识别首创药物（first-in-class drugs）提供了一种有前景的策略。基于细胞的表型筛选工具（包括 Cell Painting 和 LINCS L1000）的最新进展提供了捕获化合物生物反应的关键细胞数据。虽然多模态数据的整合增强了对比学习（contrastive learning, CL）方法在分子表型表示中的应用，但这些方法平等对待所有负样本对，无法区分具有相似表型的分子。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一个基础框架 MINER，它基于单模态解耦表示动态估计样本对作为负样本对的可能性。此外，我们的方法结合了混合融合策略，以有效整合多模态数据，即使在……情况下

fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.title: KMD: Koopman Multi-modality Decomposition for Generalized Brain Tumor Segmentation under Incomplete Modalities
fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), with modalities including T1, T2, T1ce, and Flair, providing complementary information critical for sub-region analysis, is widely used for brain tumor diagnosis. However, clinical practice often suffers from varying degrees of incompleteness of necessary modalities due to reasons such as susceptibility to artifacts. It significantly impairs segmentation model performance. Given the limited available modalities at hand, existing approaches attempt to project them into a shared latent space. However, they ignore decomposing the modality-shared and modality-specific information and failed to construct the relationship among different modalities. Such deficiency limits the effectiveness of the segmentation performance, particularly at the time when the amount of data in each modality is different. In this paper, we propose the plug-and-play Koopman Multi-mo
fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.zh_title: KMD：模态不完整下的脑肿瘤分割
fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.summary: CVPR 2025提出Koopman多模态分解方法，应对MRI模态缺失情形下的泛化脑肿瘤分割。
key_points: MRI的T1/T2/T1ce/Flair提供互补信息
临床常因伪影等导致模态不完整
模态缺失显著损害分割模型性能
fc984a7cc83ef154481a3b75fe07560262a90054.zh_abstract: 磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）具有包括 T1、T2、T1ce 和 Flair 在内的模态，提供对子区域分析至关重要的互补信息，被广泛用于脑肿瘤诊断。然而，临床实践常因易受伪影影响等原因而遭受必要模态不同程度的不完整。这显著损害分割模型性能。鉴于手头可用模态有限，现有方法尝试将它们投影到共享潜在空间。然而，它们忽略了分解模态共享信息和模态特异信息，也未能构建不同模态之间的关系。这种缺陷限制了分割性能的有效性，尤其是在每个模态的数据量不同时。在本文中，我们提出即插即用的 Koopman Multi-mo

18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.title: CSC-PA: Cross-image Semantic Correlation via Prototype Attentions for Single-network Semi-supervised Breast Tumor Segmentation
18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.abstract: Accurate automatic breast ultrasound (BUS) image segmentation is essential for early breast cancer screening and diagnosis. However, it remains challenging owing to (1) breast lesions of various scale and shape, (2) ambiguous boundaries caused by speckle noise and artifacts, and (3) the scarcity of high-quality annotations. Most existing semi-supervised methods employ the mean-teacher architecture, which merely learns semantic information within a single image and heavily relies on the performance of the teacher model. Therefore, we present a novel cross-image semantic correlation semi-supervised framework, named CSC-PA, to improve the performance of BUS image segmentation. CSC-PA is trained based on a single network, which integrates a foreground prototype attention (FPA) and an edge prototype attention (EPA). Specifically, FPA transfers complementary foreground information for more sta
18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.zh_title: CSC-PA：原型注意力跨图像语义关联的乳腺肿瘤分割
18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.summary: 该研究提出CSC-PA方法，用于单网络半监督乳腺超声肿瘤分割。
key_points: 乳腺超声分割对早期筛查诊断重要
面临病灶尺度形状多变与边界模糊
高质量标注稀缺，现有方法依赖单图语义
18f581d582f046dedb8403d781efb53597cc0589.zh_abstract: 准确的自动乳腺超声 (automatic breast ultrasound, BUS) 图像分割对于早期乳腺癌筛查和诊断至关重要。然而，由于 (1) 各种尺度和形状的乳腺病灶，(2) 由斑点噪声和伪影引起的模糊边界，以及 (3) 高质量标注的稀缺，它仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有半监督方法采用均值教师 (mean-teacher) 架构，该架构仅学习单张图像内的语义信息，并严重依赖教师模型的性能。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的跨图像语义相关性半监督框架，名为 CSC-PA，以提高 BUS 图像分割的性能。CSC-PA 基于单一网络进行训练，该网络集成了前景原型注意力 (foreground prototype attention, FPA) 和边缘原型注意力 (edge prototype attention, EPA)。具体来说，FPA 传递互补的前景信息，以实现更稳

933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.title: Boost the Inference with Co-Training: A Depth-Guided Mutual Learning Framework for Semi-Supervised Medical Polyp Segmentation
933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.abstract: Semi-Supervised polyp segmentation has made significant progress in recent years as a potential solution for computer-assisted treatment. Since depth images can provide extra information other than RGB images to help segment these problematic areas, depth-assisted polyp segmentation has gained much attention. However, the utilization of depth information is still worth studying. The existing RGB-D segmentation methods rely on depth data in the inference stage, limiting their clinical applications. To tackle this problem, we propose a semi-supervised polyp segmentation framework based on the mean teacher architecture. We establish an auxiliary student network with depth images as input in the training stage, and we propose a depth-guided cross-modal mutual learning strategy to promote the learning of complementary information between different student networks. 933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.zh_title: 协同训练提升推理：深度引导互学习半监督息肉分割
933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.summary: 提出深度引导的互学习框架，用于半监督医学息肉分割，并减少推理阶段对深度数据的依赖。
key_points: 半监督息肉分割有助计算机辅助治疗
深度图可提供RGB之外的补充信息
现有RGB-D方法推理期依赖深度数据
933ef649ce2871313f813a4c9cd3fd359b16d3f7.zh_abstract: 半监督息肉分割近年来作为计算机辅助治疗的一种潜在解决方案取得了显著进展。由于深度图像可以提供 RGB 图像之外的信息，帮助分割这些有问题的区域，深度辅助息肉分割已引起广泛关注。然而，深度信息的利用仍然值得研究。现有的 RGB-D 分割方法在推理阶段依赖深度数据，限制了其临床应用。为解决这个问题，我们提出一种基于平均教师（mean teacher）架构的半监督息肉分割框架。我们在训练阶段建立以深度图像为输入的辅助学生网络，并提出一种深度引导的跨模态互学习策略，以促进不同学生网络之间互补信息的学习。同时，我们使用高-

8e7efac2d4a0bfa66a3683fce863cfa8acf0120b.title: Unified Medical Lesion Segmentation via Self-referring Indicator
8e7efac2d4a0bfa66a3683fce863cfa8acf0120b.abstract: The recently emerged in-context-learning-based (ICL-based) models have the potential towards the unification of medical lesion segmentation. However, due to their cross-fusion designs, existing ICL-based unified segmentation models fail to accurately localize lesions with low-matched reference sets. 8e7efac2d4a0bfa66a3683fce863cfa8acf0120b.zh_title: 基于自参照指示符的统一医学病灶分割
8e7efac2d4a0bfa66a3683fce863cfa8acf0120b.summary: CVPR 2025 提出自参照机制，将查询自身视为高匹配参照，改善上下文学习式统一医学病灶分割的低匹配参照定位问题。
key_points: 针对ICL统一分割定位不准问题
以查询自身作高匹配参照

39bacf40ae5061c241ea6f513b67da0bf80c9ff2.title: β-FFT: Nonlinear Interpolation and Differentiated Training Strategies for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
39bacf40ae5061c241ea6f513b67da0bf80c9ff2.abstract: Co-Training has achieved significant success in the field of semi-supervised learning(SSL); however, the homogenization phenomenon, which arises from multiple models tending towards similar decision boundaries, remains inadequately addressed. To tackle this issue, we propose a novel algorithm called β-FFT from the perspectives of data processing and training structure. In data processing, we apply diverse augmentations to input data and feed them into two sub-networks. To balance the training instability caused by different augmentations during consistency learning, we introduce a nonlinear interpolation technique based on the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). 39bacf40ae5061c241ea6f513b67da0bf80c9ff2.zh_title: β-FFT：半监督医学图像分割的非线性插值与差异化训练
39bacf40ae5061c241ea6f513b67da0bf80c9ff2.summary: 针对协同训练中的同质化现象，提出β-FFT，从数据处理与训练结构两方面改进半监督医学图像分割。

对输入施加多样增强并送入双子网络
兼顾数据处理与训练结构改进
39bacf40ae5061c241ea6f513b67da0bf80c9ff2.zh_abstract: 协同训练（Co-Training）在半监督学习（SSL）领域取得了显著成功；然而，由多个模型趋向相似决策边界所引起的同质化现象仍未得到充分解决。为解决这一问题，我们从数据处理和训练结构的角度提出了一种名为 β-FFT 的新算法。在数据处理中，我们对输入数据应用多样化的增强，并将其输入两个子网络。为了平衡一致性学习过程中由不同增强引起的训练不稳定性，我们引入了一种基于快速傅里叶变换（FFT）的非线性插值技术。通过在经过不同增强的图像之间交换低频分量，该方法不仅生成桥接不同增强的平滑且多样的训练样本，还增强了模型的泛化能力，whi

fbda82b30954d60fe81f62906b542695ac7f8673.title: OralXrays-9: Towards Hospital-Scale Panoramic X-ray Anomaly Detection via Personalized Multi-Object Query-Aware Mining
fbda82b30954d60fe81f62906b542695ac7f8673.abstract: In clinical practice, panoramic dental radiography is a widely employed imaging technique that can provide a detailed and comprehensive view of dental structures and surrounding tissues for identifying various oral anomalies. However, due to the complexity of oral anomalies and the scarcity of available data, existing research still suffers from substantial challenges in automated oral anomaly detection. To this end, this paper presents a new hospital-scale panoramic X-ray benchmark, namely "OralXrays-91", which consists of 12,688 panoramic X-ray images with 84,113 meticulously annotated instances across nine common oral anomalies. fbda82b30954d60fe81f62906b542695ac7f8673.zh_title: OralXrays-9：医院级全景X光异常检测基准
fbda82b30954d60fe81f62906b542695ac7f8673.summary: 提出医院规模全景牙科X光基准，结合个性化多目标查询感知挖掘实现口腔异常检测。
key_points: 新建医院级全景牙科X光基准
面向多类口腔异常自动检测
提出个性化多目标查询感知挖掘
fbda82b30954d60fe81f62906b542695ac7f8673.zh_abstract: 在临床实践中，全景牙科放射摄影（panoramic dental radiography）是一种广泛采用的成像技术，可为识别各种口腔异常提供牙科结构及周围组织的详细而全面的视图。然而，由于口腔异常的复杂性和可用数据的稀缺性，现有研究在自动化口腔异常检测方面仍然面临重大挑战。为此，本文提出了一个新的医院级全景 X 射线基准，即“OralXrays-91”，它包含 12,688 幅全景 X 射线图像，涵盖九种常见口腔异常，并带有 84,113 个细致标注的实例。相应地，我们提出了一种个性化的多目标查询感知挖掘（Multi-Object Query-Aware Mining, MOQAM）范式，它联合结合了分布 IoU 区域提议网络（Distribution-IoU Region Proposal Network, DI-RPN）和类别平衡球面对比正则化（Class-Balanced Spherical Contrastive Regularization, CB-SCR）机制，以解决

9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.title: EffiDec3D: An Optimized Decoder for High-Performance and Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation
9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.abstract: Recent 3D deep networks such as SwinUNETR, Swin-Unetrv2, and 3D UX-Net have shown promising performance by leveraging self-attention and large-kernel convolutions to capture the volumetric context. However, their substantial computational requirements limit their use in real-time and resource-constrained environments. The high #FLOPs and #Params in these networks stem largely from complex decoder designs with high-resolution layers and excessive channel counts. In this paper, we propose EffiDec3D, an optimized 3D decoder that employs a channel reduction strategy across all decoder stages, which sets the number of channels to the minimum needed for accurate feature representation. Additionally, EffiDec3D removes the high-resolution layers when their contribution to segmentation quality is minimal. 9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.zh_title: EffiDec3D：高效高性能的3D医学图像分割解码器
9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.summary: 针对3D医学图像分割网络因复杂解码器导致计算量大的问题，提出优化解码器EffiDec3D以降低FLOPs与参数量。
key_points: 现有3D网络解码器复杂、算力开销高
提出EffiDec3D优化解码器设计
面向实时与资源受限环境
9c03118a7bdda09be904f48dddfa6875ed2d94f6.zh_abstract: 近期的 3D 深度网络（如 SwinUNETR、Swin-Unetrv2 和 3D UX-Net）通过利用自注意力与大核卷积来捕获体数据上下文，已展现出有前景的性能。然而，它们庞大的计算需求限制了它们在实时和资源受限环境中的应用。这些网络中较高的 #FLOPs 和 #Params 主要源于带有高分辨率层和过多通道数的复杂解码器设计。在本文中，我们提出 EffiDec3D，一种优化的 3D 解码器，它在所有解码器阶段采用通道缩减策略，将通道数量设为准确特征表示所需的最小值。此外，当高分辨率层对分割质量的贡献极小时，EffiDec3D 会移除这些层。我们优化的 EffiDec3D 解码器实现了 #Params 减少 96.4% 以及 93.0% 的减少

144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.title: DiN: Diffusion Model for Robust Medical VQA with Semantic Noisy Labels
144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) systems benefit the interpretation of medical images containing critical clinical information. However, the challenge of noisy labels and limited high-quality datasets remains underexplored. To address this, we establish the first benchmark for noisy labels in Med-VQA by simulating human mislabeling with semantically designed noise types. More importantly, we introduce the DiN framework, which leverages a diffusion model to handle noisy labels in Med-VQA. Unlike the dominant classification-based VQA approaches that directly predict answers, our Answer Diffuser (AD) module employs a coarse-to-fine process, refining answer candidates with a diffusion model for improved accuracy. The Answer Condition Generator (ACG) further enhances this process by generating task-specific conditional information via integrating answer embeddings with fused image-
144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.zh_title: DiN：面向语义噪声标签的鲁棒医学VQA扩散模型
144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.summary: CVPR 2025提出首个医学VQA噪声标签基准，并用扩散模型DiN处理语义噪声标签。
key_points: 建立首个Med-VQA噪声标签基准
用扩散模型处理语义噪声标签
模拟人类语义错误标注类型
144783f08621cee07e222ed4ca9b18ba50e786d9.zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答 (Med-VQA) 系统有助于解释包含关键临床信息的医学图像。然而，噪声标签和有限的高质量数据集这一挑战仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这个问题，我们通过使用语义设计的噪声类型模拟人类错误标注，建立了 Med-VQA 中噪声标签的第一个基准。更重要的是，我们引入了 DiN 框架，该框架利用扩散模型来处理 Med-VQA 中的噪声标签。与直接预测答案的主流基于分类的 VQA 方法不同，我们的答案扩散器 (Answer Diffuser, AD) 模块采用由粗到细的过程，利用扩散模型细化答案候选以提高准确性。答案条件生成器 (Answer Condition Generator, ACG) 通过将答案嵌入与融合图像- 相结合来生成任务特定的条件信息，进一步增强了这一过程。

96475d59bbd156d8e6ce250087619744a87b158a.title: Model Diagnosis and Correction via Linguistic and Implicit Attribute Editing
96475d59bbd156d8e6ce250087619744a87b158a.abstract: How can we troubleshoot a deep visual model, i.e. understand why it makes certain mistakes and further take action to correct its behavior? We design a ${\mathbf{M}}$ odel ${\mathbf{D}}$ iagnosis and ${\mathbf{C}}$ orrection system (MDC), an automated framework that analyzes the pattern of errors, proposes candidate causes of attributes, conducts hypothesis testing via attribute editing, and ultimately generates counterfactual training samples to improve the performance of the model. Unlike previous methods, in addition to the linguistic attributes, our method also incorporates the analysis for implicit causal attributes, those cannot to be accurately described by natural language. a10a2364c7be00185bb9c2d3f9c85e3736df12c1.title: Minding Fuzzy Regions: A Data-driven Alternating Learning Paradigm for Stable Lesion Segmentation
a10a2364c7be00185bb9c2d3f9c85e3736df12c1.abstract: Deep learning has achieved significant advancements in medical image segmentation, but existing models still face challenges in accurately segmenting lesion regions. The main reason is that some lesion regions in medical images have unclear boundaries, irregular shapes, and small tissue density differences, leading to label ambiguity. However, the existing model treats all data equally without taking quality differences into account in the training process, resulting in noisy labels negatively impacting model training and unstable feature representations. In this paper, a data-driven alternating learning (DALE) paradigm is proposed to optimize the model’s training process, achieving stable and high-precision segmentation. The paradigm focuses on two key points: (1) reducing the impact of noisy labels, and (2) calibrating unstable representations. To mitigate the negative impact of noisy
a10a2364c7be00185bb9c2d3f9c85e3736df12c1.zh_title: 面向模糊区域：稳定病灶分割的数据驱动交替学习
a10a2364c7be00185bb9c2d3f9c85e3736df12c1.summary: 研究提出数据驱动的交替学习范式，针对病灶边界模糊、形状不规则与标签歧义问题提升医学图像病灶分割稳定性。
key_points: 病灶边界不清与密度差异导致标签歧义

a10a2364c7be00185bb9c2d3f9c85e3736df12c1.zh_abstract: 深度学习在医学图像分割方面已取得显著进展，但现有模型在准确分割病灶区域方面仍面临挑战。主要原因是医学图像中某些病灶区域边界不清晰、形状不规则且组织密度差异小，导致标签模糊。然而，现有模型在训练过程中平等对待所有数据，未考虑质量差异，导致噪声标签对模型训练产生负面影响，并使特征表示不稳定。本文提出一种数据驱动的交替学习（data-driven alternating learning, DALE）范式来优化模型训练过程，实现稳定且高精度的分割。该范式聚焦两个关键点：（1）降低噪声标签的影响，（2）校准不稳定的表示。为减轻噪声

6c9e7e8374023b8743388235ebf61eb37ab72004.title: Advancing Generalizable Tumor Segmentation with Anomaly-Aware Open-Vocabulary Attention Maps and Frozen Foundation Diffusion Models
6c9e7e8374023b8743388235ebf61eb37ab72004.abstract: We explore Generalizable Tumor Segmentation, aiming to train a single model for zero-shot tumor segmentation across diverse anatomical regions. Existing methods face limitations related to segmentation quality, scalability, and the range of applicable imaging modalities. In this paper, we uncover the potential of the internal representations within frozen medical foundation diffusion models as highly efficient zero-shot learners for tumor segmentation by introducing a novel framework named DiffuGTS. DiffuGTS creates anomaly-aware open-vocabulary attention maps based on text prompts to enable generalizable anomaly segmentation without being restricted by a predefined training category list. 6c9e7e8374023b8743388235ebf61eb37ab72004.zh_title: 基于异常感知开放词汇注意力与冻结扩散模型的泛化肿瘤分割
6c9e7e8374023b8743388235ebf61eb37ab72004.summary: 论文提出利用冻结医学基础扩散模型内部表征实现跨解剖区域的零样本肿瘤分割框架。
key_points: 目标是单模型跨部位零样本肿瘤分割

6c9e7e8374023b8743388235ebf61eb37ab72004.zh_abstract: 我们探索可泛化肿瘤分割，旨在训练单个模型以跨多样解剖区域进行零样本肿瘤分割。现有方法在分割质量、可扩展性以及适用成像模态范围方面面临局限。在本文中，我们通过引入一个名为DiffuGTS的新框架，揭示了冻结医学基础扩散模型内部表征作为高效零样本学习器用于肿瘤分割的潜力。DiffuGTS基于文本提示创建异常感知的开放词汇注意力图，以实现可泛化的异常分割，而不受预定义训练类别列表的限制。为了进一步改善和细化异常分割掩码，DiffuGTS利用扩散模型，将病理区域转化为高质量的伪健康对应物，通过潜在空间中的

304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.title: BioX-CPath: Biologically-driven Explainable Diagnostics for Multistain IHC Computational Pathology
304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.abstract: The development of biologically interpretable and explainable models remains a key challenge in computational pathology, particularly for multistain immunohistochemistry (IHC) analysis. We present BioX-CPath, an explainable graph neural network architecture for whole slide image (WSI) classification that leverages both spatial and semantic features across multiple stains. At its core, BioX-CPath introduces a novel Stain-Aware Attention Pooling (SAAP) module that generates biologically meaningful, stain-aware patient embeddings. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both Rheumatoid Arthritis and Sjogren’s Disease multistain datasets. Beyond performance metrics, BioX-CPath provides interpretable insights through stain attention scores, entropy measures, and stain interaction scores, that permit measuring model alignment with known pathological mechanisms. 304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.zh_title: BioX-CPath：多染色IHC病理可解释诊断
304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.summary: 提出可解释图神经网络BioX-CPath，用于多染色免疫组化全切片图像分类。
key_points: 面向多染色IHC全切片图像分类
引入染色感知注意力池化模块
融合空间与语义特征提升可解释性
304a128e9f00cbf0b4af580fe049b7739fe1694c.zh_abstract: 开发具有生物学可解释性和可解释性的模型仍然是计算病理学中的一个关键挑战，特别是对于多染色免疫组织化学（IHC）分析。我们提出了 BioX-CPath，一种用于全切片图像（WSI）分类的可解释图神经网络架构，它利用了跨多个染色的空间和语义特征。其核心是，BioX-CPath 引入了一种新颖的染色感知注意力池化（SAAP）模块，该模块生成具有生物学意义的、染色感知的患者嵌入。我们的方法在类风湿性关节炎和干燥综合征多染色数据集上均达到了最先进的性能。除了性能指标之外，BioX-CPath 通过染色注意力分数、熵度量和染色交互分数提供了可解释的见解，这些允许衡量模型与已知病理机制的一致性。这一生物学 gr

f830576f5ffcdb610975d4033ab9cf1d6bba94a6.title: CheXwhatsApp: A Dataset for Exploring Challenges in the Diagnosis of Chest X-rays through Mobile Devices
f830576f5ffcdb610975d4033ab9cf1d6bba94a6.abstract: Mobile health (mHealth) has emerged as a transformative solution to enhance healthcare accessibility and affordability, particularly in resource-constrained regions and low-to-middle-income countries. mHealth leverages mobile platforms to improve healthcare accessibility, addressing radiologist shortages in low-resource settings by enabling remote diagnosis and consultation through mobile devices. Mobile phones allow healthcare workers to transmit radiographic images, such as chest X-rays (CXR), to specialists or AI-driven models for interpretation. However, AI-based diagnosis using CXR images shared via apps like WhatsApp suffers from reduced predictability and explainability due to compression artifacts, and there is a lack of datasets to systematically study these challenges. To address this, we introduce CheXwhatsApp, a dataset of 141,804 paired original and WhatsApp-compressed CXR i
f830576f5ffcdb610975d4033ab9cf1d6bba94a6.zh_title: CheXwhatsApp：移动设备胸片诊断挑战数据集
f830576f5ffcdb610975d4033ab9cf1d6bba94a6.summary: 发布CheXwhatsApp数据集，探究经手机传输的胸片在移动端远程诊断中面临的挑战。
key_points: 面向资源匮乏地区的移动健康场景
关注手机传输胸片的图像质量问题
揭示移动端胸片诊断的现实挑战
f830576f5ffcdb610975d4033ab9cf1d6bba94a6.zh_abstract: 移动健康（mobile health, mHealth）已成为一种变革性解决方案，用于增强医疗可及性和可负担性，尤其是在资源受限地区和低至中等收入国家。mHealth 利用移动平台改善医疗可及性，通过移动设备实现远程诊断和咨询，以应对低资源环境中的放射科医生短缺问题。移动电话使医疗工作者能够将放射影像（如胸部 X 光片（chest X-rays, CXR））传输给专科医生或 AI 驱动的模型进行解读。然而，使用通过 WhatsApp 等应用共享的 CXR 图像进行 AI 诊断时，由于压缩伪影，其可预测性和可解释性会降低，并且缺乏系统研究这些挑战的数据集。为解决这一问题，我们介绍了 CheXwhatsApp，一个包含 141,804 对原始和 WhatsApp 压缩 CXR i 的数据集。

c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.title: PathFinder: A Multi-Modal Multi-Agent System for Medical Diagnostic Decision-Making Applied to Histopathology
c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.abstract: Diagnosing diseases through histopathology whole slide images (WSIs) is fundamental in modern pathology but is challenged by the gigapixel scale and complexity of WSIs. Trained histopathologists overcome this challenge by navigating the WSI, looking for relevant patches, taking notes, and compiling them to produce a final holistic diagnostic. Traditional AI approaches, such as multiple instance learning and transformer-based models, fail short of such a holistic, iterative, multi-scale diagnostic procedure, limiting their adoption in the real-world. We introduce PathFinder, a multi-modal, multi-agent framework that emulates the decision-making process of expert pathologists. PathFinder integrates four AI agents—the Triage Agent, Navigation Agent, Description Agent, and Diagnosis Agent—that collaboratively navigate WSIs, gather evidence, and provide comprehensive diagnoses with natural la
c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.zh_title: PathFinder：病理诊断多模态多智能体系统
c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.summary: 提出面向组织病理全切片图像的多模态多智能体诊断系统PathFinder，模拟病理医生的迭代诊断流程。
key_points: 针对全切片图像吉像素级复杂度
多智能体迭代、多尺度诊断流程

c8648d71c371c65b9c61b60a0736cb31138fe06e.zh_abstract: 通过组织病理学全切片图像（WSIs）诊断疾病是现代病理学的基础，但受到WSIs千兆像素级规模和复杂性的挑战。训练有素的组织病理学家通过浏览WSI、寻找相关图像块、做笔记并汇总这些笔记以产生最终的整体诊断来克服这一挑战。传统AI方法，如多实例学习和基于Transformer的模型，未能达到这种整体性、迭代式、多尺度的诊断流程，限制了它们在真实世界中的采用。我们提出PathFinder，一个多模态、多智能体框架，模拟专家病理学家的决策过程。PathFinder整合四个AI智能体——分诊智能体（Triage Agent）、导航智能体（Navigation Agent）、描述智能体（Description Agent）和诊断智能体（Diagnosis Agent）——它们协同浏览WSIs、收集证据，并提供具有自然语言的全面诊断

6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.title: RadGPT: Constructing 3D Image-Text Tumor Datasets
6d3cac0ebcdf869fd83da0ca58391b9c60b10a9f.abstract: Cancers identified in CT scans are usually accompanied by detailed radiology reports, but publicly available $C T$ datasets often lack these essential reports. This absence limits their usefulness for developing accurate report generation AI. To address this gap, we present AbdomenAtlas 3.0, the first public, high-quality abdominal CT dataset with detailed, expert-reviewed radiology reports. All reports are paired with per-voxel masks and they describe liver, kidney and pancreatic tumors. AbdomenAtlas 3.0 has 9,262 triplets of CT, mask and report-3,955 with tumors. These CT scans come from 17 public datasets. Besides creating the reports for these datasets, we expanded their number of tumor masks by $4.2 \times$, identifying 3,011 new tumor cases. 10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.title: Derm1M: A Million-Scale Vision-Language Dataset Aligned with Clinical Ontology Knowledge for Dermatology
10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.abstract: The emergence of vision-language models has transformed medical AI, enabling unprecedented advances in diagnostic capability and clinical applications. However, progress in dermatology has lagged behind other medical domains due to the lack of standard image-text pairs. Existing dermatological datasets are limited in both scale and depth, offering only single-label annotations across a narrow range of diseases instead of rich textual descriptions, and lacking the crucial clinical context needed for real-world applications. To address these limitations, we present Derm1M, the first large-scale vision-language dataset for dermatology, comprising 1,029,761 image-text pairs. Built from diverse educational resources and structured around a standard ontology collaboratively developed by experts, Derm1M provides comprehensive coverage for over 390 skin conditions across four hierarchical levels
10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.zh_title: Derm1M：百万级皮肤科视觉-语言数据集

10d5d5598ed0d7f24388f0a7b607749f6ee30c28.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型的出现改变了医学 AI，在诊断能力和临床应用方面实现了前所未有的进步。然而，由于缺乏标准的图像-文本对，皮肤病学的进展落后于其他医学领域。现有的皮肤病学数据集在规模和深度上都有限，仅提供针对狭窄疾病范围的单标签注释，而非丰富的文本描述，并且缺乏实际应用所需的关键临床背景。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 Derm1M，这是首个用于皮肤病学的大规模视觉语言数据集，包含 1,029,761 个图像-文本对。Derm1M 基于多样化的教育资源构建，并围绕专家协作开发的标准本体进行组织，在四个层级上为超过 390 种皮肤状况提供了全面覆盖

25df1e0d17fdc4665b4105eeb06e6aecf8ff9df0.abstract: Providing effective treatment and making informed clinical decisions are essential goals of modern medicine and clinical care. We are interested in simulating disease dynamics for clinical decision-making, leveraging recent advances in large generative models. To this end, we introduce the Medical World Model (MeWM), the first world model in medicine that visually predicts future disease states based on clinical decisions. MeWM comprises (i) vision-language models to serve as policy models, and (ii) tumor generative models as dynamics models. The policy model generates action plans, such as clinical treatments, while the dynamics model simulates tumor progression or regression under given treatment conditions. 25df1e0d17fdc4665b4105eeb06e6aecf8ff9df0.zh_title: Medical World Model：医学世界模型预测疾病状态

cd40464a4a251b7842f93a7abb1ac28c3fa01b87.title: Scaling Tumor Segmentation: Best Lessons from Real and Synthetic Data
cd40464a4a251b7842f93a7abb1ac28c3fa01b87.abstract: AI for tumor segmentation is limited by the lack of large, voxel-wise annotated datasets, which are hard to create and require medical experts. In our proprietary JHH dataset of 3,000 annotated pancreatic tumor scans, we found that AI performance stopped improving after $\mathbf{1, 5 0 0}$ scans. With synthetic data, we reached the same performance using only $\mathbf{5 0 0}$ real scans. This finding suggests that synthetic data can steepen data scaling laws, enabling more efficient model training than real data alone. Motivated by these lessons, we created AbdomenAtlas 2.0—a dataset of 10,134 CT scans with a total of 13,223 tumor instances per-voxel manually annotated in six organs (pancreas, liver, kidney, colon, esophagus, and uterus) and 6,511 control scans. 3c84fccff6aada50707718aa5ebb1f8ee990c7f3.title: Boosting Vision Semantic Density with Anatomy Normality Modeling for Medical Vision-Language Pre-Training
3c84fccff6aada50707718aa5ebb1f8ee990c7f3.abstract: Vision-language pre-training (VLP) has great potential for developing multifunctional and general medical diagnostic capabilities. However, aligning medical images with a low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to reports with a high SNR presents a semantic density gap, leading to visual alignment bias. In this paper, we propose boosting vision semantic density to improve alignment effectiveness. On one hand, we enhance visual semantics through disease-level vision contrastive learning, which strengthens the model's ability to differentiate between normal and abnormal samples for each anatomical structure. 3c84fccff6aada50707718aa5ebb1f8ee990c7f3.zh_title: 引入解剖正常性建模的医学视觉语言预训练

230ce434e101ddcd58fa12cd021f799a50e0ec6f.title: MedSegFactory: Text-Guided Generation of Medical Image-Mask Pairs
230ce434e101ddcd58fa12cd021f799a50e0ec6f.abstract: This paper presents MedSegFactory, a versatile medical synthesis framework that generates high-quality paired medical images and segmentation masks across modalities and tasks. It aims to serve as an unlimited data repository, supplying image-mask pairs to enhance existing segmentation tools. The core of MedSegFactory is a dual-stream diffusion model, where one stream synthesizes medical images and the other generates corresponding segmentation masks. To ensure precise alignment between image-mask pairs, we introduce Joint Cross-Attention (JCA), enabling a collaborative denoising paradigm by dynamic cross-conditioning between streams. This bidirectional interaction allows both representations to guide each other's generation, enhancing consistency between generated pairs. 230ce434e101ddcd58fa12cd021f799a50e0ec6f.zh_abstract: 本文提出 MedSegFactory，一种多功能的医学合成框架，可跨模态和任务生成高质量的配对医学图像与分割掩码。它旨在充当无限的数据存储库，提供图像-掩码对以增强现有分割工具。MedSegFactory 的核心是一个双流扩散模型，其中一个流合成医学图像，另一个流生成对应的分割掩码。为确保图像-掩码对之间的精确对齐，我们引入联合交叉注意力（Joint Cross-Attention, JCA），通过流之间的动态交叉条件作用实现协同去噪范式。这种双向交互使两种表示能够相互指导对方的生成，从而增强生成对之间的一致性。MedSegFactory 通过用户定义的 promp 解锁按需生成配对的医学图像和分割掩码。

4a49bd492220d04109dde327353402f84d84d464.abstract: Pretraining a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) aggregator enables the derivation of Whole Slide Image (WSI)-level embeddings from patch-level representations without supervision. While recent multimodal MIL pretraining approaches leveraging auxiliary modalities have demonstrated performance gains over unimodal WSI pretraining, the acquisition of these additional modalities necessitates extensive clinical profiling. This requirement increases costs and limits scalability in existing WSI datasets lacking such paired modalities. To address this, we propose Gigapixel Vision-Concept Knowledge Contrastive pretraining (GECKO), which aligns WSIs with a Concept Prior derived from the available WSIs. GECKO then employs a dual-branc
4a49bd492220d04109dde327353402f84d84d464.zh_title: GECKO：病理十亿像素视觉—概念对比预训练

8de339a894f13f805658fbb4a2a7b6d5eaf2558a.title: Alleviating Textual Reliance in Medical Language-Guided Segmentation via Prototype-Driven Semantic Approximation
8de339a894f13f805658fbb4a2a7b6d5eaf2558a.abstract: Medical language-guided segmentation, integrating textual clinical reports as auxiliary guidance to enhance image segmentation, has demonstrated significant improvements over unimodal approaches. However, its inherent reliance on paired image-text input, which we refer to as “textual reliance”, presents two fundamental limitations: 1) many medical segmentation datasets lack paired reports, leaving a substantial portion of image-only data underutilized for training; and 2) inference is limited to retrospective analysis of cases with paired reports, limiting its applicability in most clinical scenarios where segmentation typically precedes reporting. To address these limitations, we propose ProLearn, the first Prototype-driven Learning framework for language-guided segmentation that fundamentally alleviates textual reliance. At its core, we introduce a novel Prototype-driven Semantic Appro

2b84882ba1245af6d15dd8d28e0acc89f7b8bac1.title: Constructing Ophthalmic MLLM for Positioning-Diagnosis Collaboration Through Clinical Cognitive Chain Reasoning
2b84882ba1245af6d15dd8d28e0acc89f7b8bac1.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) demonstrate significant potential in the field of medical diagnosis. However, they face critical challenges in specialized domains such as ophthalmology, particularly the fragmentation of annotation granularity and inconsistencies in clinical reasoning logic, which hinder precise cross-modal understanding. This paper introduces FundusExpert, an ophthalmologyspecific MLLM with integrated positioning-diagnosis reasoning capabilities, along with FundusGen, a dataset constructed through the intelligent Fundus-Engine system. 1f53309db704054ea76ffab93904af5d5bb4d690.title: Structure-Aware Semantic Discrepancy and Consistency for 3D Medical Image Self-Supervised Learning
1f53309db704054ea76ffab93904af5d5bb4d690.abstract: 3D medical image self-supervised learning (mSSL) holds great promise for medical analysis. Effectively supporting broader applications requires considering anatomical structure variations in location, scale, and morphology, which are crucial for capturing meaningful distinctions. However, previous mSSL methods partition images with fixed-size patches, often ignoring the structure variations. In this work, we introduce a novel perspective on 3D medical images with the goal of learning structure-aware representations. We assume that patches within the same structure share the same semantics (semantic consistency) while those from different structures exhibit distinct semantics (semantic discrepancy).
