d0dc2b9f7246a60e093c5127c8bb3e20658036ed.title: Semantic-tailored Variational-Contrastive Graph Learning for Cognitive Diagnosis
d0dc2b9f7246a60e093c5127c8bb3e20658036ed.abstract: Cognitive diagnosis (CD), the foundation of intelligent education, aims to assess students' cognitive levels in knowledge concepts. Graph-based CD enhances diagnostic performance by incorporating high-order relations among entities, such as students, exercises, and knowledge concepts. Recently, self-supervised learning has been applied to CD to address data sparsity. However, existing contrastive learning methods may distort the student-exercise graph and overlook important semantic heterogeneity between correct and incorrect response logs. To address these limitations, we propose the Semantic-tailored Variational-Contrastive Graph Cognitive Diagnosis (SVGCD) method. c0b96b93756fd5a88cb633ad3af10a94a4234c9d.title: Harnessing LLM for Noise-Robust Cognitive Diagnosis in Web-Based Intelligent Education Systems
c0b96b93756fd5a88cb633ad3af10a94a4234c9d.abstract: Cognitive diagnostics in the Web-based Intelligent Education System (WIES) aims to assess students' mastery of knowledge concepts from heterogeneous, noisy interactions. Recent work has tried to utilize Large Language Models (LLMs) for cognitive diagnosis, yet LLMs struggle with structured data and are prone to noise-induced misjudgments. Specially, WIES's open environment continuously attracts new students and produces vast amounts of response logs, exacerbating the data imbalance and noise issues inherent in traditional educational systems. To address these challenges, we propose DLLM, a Diffusion-based LLM framework for noise-robust cognitive diagnosis. DLLM first constructs independent subgraphs based on response correctness, then applies relation augmentation alignment module to mitigate data imbalance. ad3226acb7de0a4baaf9dd3e3bd39c63c9f1b0a9.title: MedAssist: LLM-Empowered Medical Assistant for Assisting the Scrutinization and Comprehension of Electronic Health Records
ad3226acb7de0a4baaf9dd3e3bd39c63c9f1b0a9.abstract: Efficiently comprehending diagnosis and treatment plans remains a significant challenge for both medical professionals and patients, particularly when dealing with rare or newly emerging diseases and specific combinations of comorbidities. We present MedAssist, a large language model (LLM)-empowered medical assistant designed to support the scrutinization and comprehension of electronic health records (EHRs). MedAssist leverages two key components: medical knowledge retrieval, which retrieves the latest and most comprehensive medical knowledge snippets from the web, and data retrieval, which extracts diagnosis and treatment plans for similar patients from existing EHR databases. By integrating these capabilities into user-friendly interfaces, MedAssist bridges critical gaps in medical knowledge accessibility and understanding, and advances patient care in realistic clinical scenarios.

ad3226acb7de0a4baaf9dd3e3bd39c63c9f1b0a9.zh_abstract: 高效理解诊断和治疗方案仍然是医疗专业人员和患者面临的重大挑战，尤其是在处理罕见或新发疾病以及特定合并症组合时。我们提出 MedAssist，一种由大语言模型（LLM）赋能的医学助手，旨在支持对电子健康记录（EHR）的细致审查与理解。MedAssist 利用两个关键组件：医学知识检索，它从网络检索最新且最全面的医学知识片段；以及数据检索，它从现有 EHR 数据库中提取相似患者的诊断和治疗方案。通过将这些能力集成到用户友好的界面中，MedAssist 弥合了医学知识可及性和理解方面的关键差距，并在真实临床场景中推进患者照护。

92fcffa585fe3c10930a0043ab4cd2e75c2f9b46.title: Genomic-Informed Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Spatiotemporal Avian Influenza Outbreak Forecasting
92fcffa585fe3c10930a0043ab4cd2e75c2f9b46.abstract: Accurate forecasting of Avian Influenza Virus (AIV) outbreaks within wild bird populations necessitates models that account for complex, multi-scale transmission patterns driven by diverse factors. While conventional spatiotemporal epidemic models are robust for human-centric diseases, they rely on spatial homophily and diffusive transmission between geographic regions. This simplification is incomplete for AIV as it neglects valuable genomic information critical for capturing dynamics like high-frequency reassortment and lineage turnover at the case level (e.g., genetic descent across regions), which are essential for understanding AIV spread. key_points: 面向野生鸟类禽流感暴发预测
引入基因组信息与异构图学习
指出传统时空模型的简化局限
92fcffa585fe3c10930a0043ab4cd2e75c2f9b46.zh_abstract: 准确预测野鸟种群中的禽流感病毒（AIV）暴发，需要能够考虑由多种因素驱动的复杂、多尺度传播模式的模型。虽然传统的时空流行病模型对于以人为中心的疾病是稳健的，但它们依赖地理区域之间的空间同质性和扩散式传播。这种简化对于 AIV 是不完整的，因为它忽略了对于在病例层面捕捉高频重配和谱系更替等动态至关重要的宝贵基因组信息（例如跨区域的遗传谱系传递），而这些信息对于理解 AIV 传播必不可少。为解决这些局限，我们系统地形式化 AIV 预测问题，并提出 BLUE（双层基因组感知异构图融合流水线）。该流水线整合遗传、空间和生态数据，以实现高度 a

8e6ed3571ed0b5020f2b5675a91ca9ffc7521ae9.title: The Double-Edged Sword of Knowledge Transfer: Diagnosing and Curing Fairness Pathologies in Cross-Domain Recommendation
8e6ed3571ed0b5020f2b5675a91ca9ffc7521ae9.abstract: Cross-domain recommendation (CDR) offers an effective strategy for improving recommendation quality in a target domain by leveraging auxiliary signals from source domains. Nonetheless, emerging evidence shows that CDR can inadvertently heighten group-level unfairness. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive theoretical and empirical analysis to uncover why these fairness issues arise. Specifically, we identify two key challenges: (i) Cross-Domain Disparity Transfer, wherein existing group-level disparities in the source domain are systematically propagated to the target domain; and (ii) Unfairness from Cross-Domain Information Gain, where the benefits derived from cross-domain knowledge are unevenly allocated among distinct groups. 53a56e183b97d086a3b33d3068a0c3b1ae8f4292.title: Mind the Ambiguity: Aleatoric Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs for Safe Medical Question Answering
53a56e183b97d086a3b33d3068a0c3b1ae8f4292.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models in Medical Question Answering is severely hampered by ambiguous user queries, a significant safety risk that demonstrably reduces answer accuracy in high-stakes healthcare settings. In this paper, we formalize this challenge by linking input ambiguity to aleatoric uncertainty (AU), which is the irreducible uncertainty arising from underspecified input. To facilitate research in this direction, we construct CV-MedBench, the first benchmark designed for studying input ambiguity in Medical QA. Using this benchmark, we analyze AU from a representation engineering perspective, revealing that AU is linearly encoded in LLM's internal activation patterns. Leveraging this insight, we introduce a novel AU-guided ''Clarify-Before-Answer'' framework, which incorporates AU-Probe - a lightweight module that detects input ambiguity directly from hidden states. 53a56e183b97d086a3b33d3068a0c3b1ae8f4292.zh_title: 面向安全医疗问答的偶然不确定性量化

2ca407cef8e60dbceb31d592981c015df61ca57d.title: From Social Media to Psychological Scale: An Adaptive Framework with Two-Hop Retrieval for Depression Screening
2ca407cef8e60dbceb31d592981c015df61ca57d.abstract: Depressive disorders represent a major global public health challenge. As an increasing number of individuals share their emotional experiences and concerns on social media, researchers have shown growing interest in leveraging such data for early depression screening. However, most existing methods rely on a fixed model and a singular reasoning paradigm, which constrains their adaptability to depression detection. The limited availability of mental health-related data and variability in training data distributions across different LLMs hinder their consistent and comprehensive understanding of diverse psychological symptoms. 2ca407cef8e60dbceb31d592981c015df61ca57d.zh_title: 从社交媒体到心理量表：抑郁筛查自适应框架

0dd6a4207a680deb872571cb03b0da4cacc2e2d8.title: Disentangled Graph LLM for Molecule Graph Editing under Distribution Shifts
0dd6a4207a680deb872571cb03b0da4cacc2e2d8.abstract: Molecule graph editing has become a powerful paradigm for optimizing chemical compounds in drug discovery. Existing methods overlook the invariant structure-property relationships, and rely on variable correlations that shift across different instructions, thereby failing to generalize to out-of-distribution (O.O.D.) scenarios. To overcome the weakness of existing work, in this paper we propose to capture and utilize the invariant factors in order to achieve generalizable molecule graph editing under distribution shifts. However, this problem remains challenging, given that the invariant and variant factors are deeply entangled within the editing models. 0dd6a4207a680deb872571cb03b0da4cacc2e2d8.zh_title: 分布偏移下的解耦图大模型分子图编辑

e95b2a7b7fb0c79059cfd2e409eeb79fe0a155b7.title: Addressing the Challenges of Mental Health Conversations with Large Language Models
e95b2a7b7fb0c79059cfd2e409eeb79fe0a155b7.abstract: Virtual Mental Health Assistants offer a promising solution to address the growing demand for accessible and scalable mental healthcare. However, existing dialogue generation models struggle with the complexities inherent in mental health conversations. In this paper, we explore the limitations of current Medical Dialogue Generation models by conducting experiments on the large language model ChatMGL. We propose modifications to ChatMGL, including fine-tuning the model on a mental health dataset without proximal policy optimization and incorporating dialogue act labels, to enhance its ability to handle the complex nature of mental health dialogues. Our results demonstrate that these modifications outperform baseline models in terms of ROUGE and BERT scores. e95b2a7b7fb0c79059cfd2e409eeb79fe0a155b7.zh_title: 大语言模型应对心理健康对话挑战
e95b2a7b7fb0c79059cfd2e409eeb79fe0a155b7.summary: WWW 2025论文分析医疗对话生成模型在心理健康对话中的局限，并在ChatMGL上提出改进与微调。
key_points: 虚拟心理健康助手需求增长

e95b2a7b7fb0c79059cfd2e409eeb79fe0a155b7.zh_abstract: 虚拟心理健康助手为满足对可及且可扩展的心理健康护理日益增长的需求提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有对话生成模型难以应对心理健康对话中固有的复杂性。在本文中，我们通过在大语言模型 ChatMGL 上进行实验，探讨当前医学对话生成模型的局限性。我们提出对 ChatMGL 的修改，包括在没有近端策略优化（proximal policy optimization）的情况下在心理健康数据集上微调模型，并纳入对话行为标签，以增强其处理心理健康对话复杂性的能力。我们的结果表明，这些修改在 ROUGE 和 BERT 分数方面优于基线模型。我们的工作表明，专门的微调和纳入领域特定知识可以提高虚拟助手的效能

b1fec80d81f837cc012fe50b8c818ba3564c89e6.title: Concept Relationship Embedding-Based Interactive Web Application for Explainable Medical Diagnosis
b1fec80d81f837cc012fe50b8c818ba3564c89e6.abstract: Deep learning has made remarkable progress in medical image analysis, yet its black-box nature still limits interpretability and clinician trust. Concept-based modeling offers a promising direction for explainable AI by integrating human-understandable concepts. However, existing approaches typically rely on global concept annotations and infer diagnosis based solely on the presence or absence of individual concepts. This oversimplified paradigm ignores the rich relationships among concepts and their causal influence on disease outcomes. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Concept Relationship Embedding Model (CREM) for interpretable medical diagnosis. b1fec80d81f837cc012fe50b8c818ba3564c89e6.zh_title: 概念关系嵌入的可解释医学诊断交互应用

ad58852b6d02a89c825c9ff415cb373d99d56fc7.title: Empowering LLMs for Structure-Based Drug Design via Exploration-Augmented Latent Inference
ad58852b6d02a89c825c9ff415cb373d99d56fc7.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess strong representation and reasoning capabilities, but their application to structure-based drug design (SBDD) is limited by insufficient understanding of protein structures and unpredictable molecular generation. To address these challenges, we propose Exploration-Augmented Latent Inference for LLMs (ELILLM), a framework that reinterprets the LLM generation process as an encoding, latent space exploration, and decoding workflow. ELILLM explicitly explores portions of the design problem beyond the model's current knowledge while using a decoding module to handle familiar regions, generating chemically valid and synthetically reasonable molecules. ad58852b6d02a89c825c9ff415cb373d99d56fc7.zh_title: 探索增强隐空间推理赋能LLM的基于结构药物设计

42946df742ab22a4c62ec6930ade687b6a887403.title: IntervEEG-LLM: Exploring EEG-Based Multimodal Data for Customized Mental Health Interventions
42946df742ab22a4c62ec6930ade687b6a887403.abstract: Incorporating multimodal physiological signals into mental health intervention may greatly enhance its effectiveness due to the rich semantic information they contain. EEG signals are particularly common and valuable for capturing brain activity, which can provide objective insights into users' mental states. However how to interpret and leverage these signals remains under-explored. This paper initiated the first attempt by proposing IntervEEG-LLM, an end-to-end framework leveraging EEG-based multimodal signals for mental health intervention. IntervEEG-LLM first used LLMs for heterogeneous multimodal physiological understanding of signals and predicted the intermediate modeling results of users. 42946df742ab22a4c62ec6930ade687b6a887403.zh_title: IntervEEG-LLM：基于脑电多模态数据的定制化心理健康干预
42946df742ab22a4c62ec6930ade687b6a887403.summary: 论文提出端到端框架IntervEEG-LLM，探索利用脑电等多模态生理信号支持定制化心理健康干预。

335cd141c6f07bf3ce43eb058ace99c0d0448cac.title: Leveraging Prompt Engineering with Lightweight Large Language Models to Label and Extract Clinical Information from Radiology Reports
335cd141c6f07bf3ce43eb058ace99c0d0448cac.abstract: Chest X-ray imaging plays a critical role in diagnosing chest diseases, making it a cornerstone in clinical and research domains. Automating disease diagnosis and extracting relevant clinical information from chest X-ray reports have become essential for developing AI-driven healthcare systems. While effective, deep learning models require extensive labelled datasets, making the labelling of diseases from radiology reports crucial. Traditionally, rule-based labelling approaches have been employed, but the emergence of large language models (LLMs) has introduced new possibilities through instruction-based prompt engineering. In this study, we explore various prompt engineering techniques, including in-context learning and prompt chaining, to label multilabel disease reports and extract key clinical findings from radiology reports. 335cd141c6f07bf3ce43eb058ace99c0d0448cac.zh_title: 用提示工程与轻量LLM标注放射报告临床信息

335cd141c6f07bf3ce43eb058ace99c0d0448cac.zh_abstract: 胸部 X 射线成像在诊断胸部疾病中发挥着关键作用，使其成为临床和研究领域的基石。自动化疾病诊断以及从胸部 X 射线报告中提取相关临床信息，对于开发 AI 驱动的医疗保健系统已变得至关重要。虽然有效，但深度学习模型需要大量标注数据集，这使得从放射学报告中标注疾病至关重要。传统上，人们采用基于规则的标注方法，但大语言模型（LLMs）的出现通过基于指令的提示工程带来了新的可能性。在本研究中，我们探索了多种提示工程技术，包括上下文学习（in-context learning）和提示链（prompt chaining），以标注多标签疾病报告并从放射学报告中提取关键临床发现。我们对两类专有 LLMs（e.

fe2c17d6d04de76037603acbe7bf41c4d60c63d4.title: Towards Efficient and Interpretable Medical Concept Representation via Ontology-driven Residual Vector Quantization
fe2c17d6d04de76037603acbe7bf41c4d60c63d4.abstract: Medical concepts, the core entities in Electronic Health Records (EHRs), provide essential inputs for clinical decision-making systems. However, most existing healthcare models still rely on massive concept-specific embedding tables, resulting in substantial memory overhead. Recent studies compress medical concepts into discrete code sequences for memory efficiency, but their flat semantic quantization fails to explicitly encode the hierarchical structure of medical ontologies, thereby limiting clinical interpretability. To this end, we propose MedRQ, an ontology-driven residual vector quantization framework that aligns discrete codes with multi-level clinical ontologies. By incorporating hierarchical supervision into the quantization process, MedRQ generates compact and ontology-consistent concept representations that generalize seamlessly across healthcare prediction tasks. fe2c17d6d04de76037603acbe7bf41c4d60c63d4.summary: 提出本体驱动残差向量量化方法，压缩电子健康记录中的医疗概念，降低内存并保留本体层级语义。
key_points: 用离散编码压缩医疗概念，减少内存开销

fe2c17d6d04de76037603acbe7bf41c4d60c63d4.zh_abstract: 医疗概念是电子健康记录（EHR）中的核心实体，为临床决策系统提供必要的输入。然而，大多数现有的医疗模型仍然依赖大量特定于概念的嵌入表，导致巨大的内存开销。最近的研究将医疗概念压缩为离散代码序列以提高内存效率，但其扁平语义量化未能显式编码医学本体的层次结构，从而限制了临床可解释性。为此，我们提出 MedRQ，一种本体驱动的残差向量量化框架，使离散代码与多级临床本体对齐。通过将层次监督纳入量化过程，MedRQ 生成紧凑且与本体内一致的概念表示，这些表示能够无缝泛化到各种医疗预测任务。实验

c49d88fffb1e50cbf76e96a579193fecabfe91d7.title: AI for Women's Health: Framework and Focus Areas
c49d88fffb1e50cbf76e96a579193fecabfe91d7.abstract: AI for women's health is an open challenge that needs to be addressed by cross-disciplinary efforts. There is an urgent need to establish a new type of collaboration that focuses on integrating and adopting AI methods in healthcare to bridge the gap between the aspiration to apply AI across all aspects of women's health and its practical adoption in everyday clinical practice. This is particularly important for women's health where we know there have been significant lags in finding innovative ways to manage prevalent and burdensome health issues that are experienced proportionately more or only by females across their life courses. This position paper will present our initial development including a comprehensive framework, a high-level methodology and main focus areas of advanced AI for Women's Health. The research aims to support women's health services worldwide by providing new tool

c49d88fffb1e50cbf76e96a579193fecabfe91d7.summary: 提出跨学科AI女性健康框架与重点方向，推动AI方法从愿景走向日常临床实践。
key_points: 需跨学科协作推进AI女性健康

c49d88fffb1e50cbf76e96a579193fecabfe91d7.zh_abstract: 用于女性健康的AI是一个开放挑战，需要由跨学科努力加以解决。迫切需要建立一种新型合作，重点是在医疗保健中整合和采用AI方法，以弥合将AI应用于女性健康各方面的愿望与其在日常临床实践中的实际采用之间的差距。这对女性健康尤为重要，因为我们知道，在寻找创新方法来管理常见且负担沉重的健康问题方面存在显著滞后，而这些问题在女性整个生命周期中由女性不成比例地更多经历或仅由女性经历。本立场文件将介绍我们的初步开发，包括一个综合框架、高层次方法学以及用于女性健康的先进AI的主要关注领域。该研究旨在通过提供新工具来支持全球女性健康服务

a9d14c244c60091f8d3620387d61fba9a22abc4a.title: coTherapist: A Behavior-Aligned Small Language Model Framework to Support Mental Healthcare Experts
a9d14c244c60091f8d3620387d61fba9a22abc4a.abstract: Access to mental healthcare is increasingly strained by workforce shortages and rising demand, motivating the development of intelligent systems that can support mental healthcare experts. We introduce coTherapist, a unified framework utilizing a small language model to emulate core therapeutic competencies through domain-specific fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, and agentic reasoning. Evaluation on clinical queries demonstrates that coTherapist generates more relevant and clinically grounded responses than contemporary baselines. Using our novel T-BARS rubric and psychometric profiling, we confirm coTherapist exhibits high empathy and therapist-consistent personality traits. Furthermore, human evaluation by domain experts validates that coTherapist delivers accurate, trustworthy, and safe responses. coTherapist was deployed and tested by clinical experts. a9d14c244c60091f8d3620387d61fba9a22abc4a.zh_title: coTherapist：支持心理健康专家的小语言模型框架

8ee9462ac76a2cddcb7e30a1fd698b6bd3d94e3b.title: MGK-RAG: Multi-Granularity Knowledge Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Radiology Report
8ee9462ac76a2cddcb7e30a1fd698b6bd3d94e3b.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is an effective approach to enhancing the factual accuracy of radiology reports. However, existing methods primarily model coarse-grained image–report correspondences, ignoring semantic relations among reports that capture hierarchical and fine-grained pathological knowledge. As a result, the learned representations fail to reflect detailed clinical semantics, causing factual inconsistencies in generated reports. Therefore, we propose a multi-granularity knowledge-integrated RAG framework for radiology reports. Specifically, we utilize multi-granularity semantic similarities, derived from the text modality, to adjust the original cross-modal contrastive learning loss. 514fcab27e84766c816d282b0897bd52d5bcc9ef.title: Explainable Vision-Language Model for Personalized Medicine
514fcab27e84766c816d282b0897bd52d5bcc9ef.abstract: Recent advancements in computer vision (CV) and natural language processing (NLP) have led to the emergence of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which excel in interpreting complex multimodal information by seamlessly integrating visual and textual data. This paper proposes a novel, interpretable framework that combines VLMs with specific mathematical transforms-namely, the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for efficient computation of frequency domains, and the Bilateral Laplace Transform for enhanced stability analysis in nonlinear systems-to enhance drug discovery and personalized medicine. The interpretable application of FFT identifies periodic patterns in temporal gene expression data from genes such as TP53 and EGFR, crucial for understanding circadian influences on drug metabolism. 3fcba2db9dfbf6f5d13f7831b4c901ddb4815385.title: Seek Inner: LLM-Enhanced Information Mining for Medical Visual Question Answering
3fcba2db9dfbf6f5d13f7831b4c901ddb4815385.abstract: Medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) focuses on analyzing medical images to accurately respond to clinicians' specific questions. Although integrating prior knowledge can enhance VQA reasoning, current methods often struggle to extract relevant information from the vast and complex medical knowledge base, thereby limiting the models' ability to learn domain-specific features. To overcome this limitation, our study presents a novel information mining approach that leverages large language models (LLMs) to efficiently retrieve pertinent data. Specifically, we design a latent knowledge generation module that employs LLMs to separately extract and filter information from questions and answers, enhancing the model's inference capabilities. 3fcba2db9dfbf6f5d13f7831b4c901ddb4815385.zh_title: Seek Inner：面向医学视觉问答的大模型信息挖掘

295f140c892cbc4a5b13759a092309268efc67c1.title: HAAF: Hierarchical Adaptation and Alignment of Foundation Models for Few-Shot Pathology Anomaly Detection
295f140c892cbc4a5b13759a092309268efc67c1.abstract: Precision pathology relies on detecting fine-grained morphological abnormalities within specific Regions of Interest (ROIs), as these local, texture-rich cues—rather than global slide contexts—drive expert diagnostic reasoning. While Vision-Language (V-L) models promise data efficiency by leveraging semantic priors, adapting them faces a critical Granularity Mismatch, where generic representations fail to resolve such subtle defects. Current adaptation methods often treat modalities as independent streams, failing to ground semantic prompts in ROI-specific visual contexts. To bridge this gap, we propose the Hierarchical Adaptation and Alignment Framework (HAAF ). 162a14f3fae0733bf89752e6383009fb4a17abab.title: Better Negatives, Better Predictions: Negative Sample Selection Strategies for Enhancing Biomedical KG Edge Classification
162a14f3fae0733bf89752e6383009fb4a17abab.abstract: The selection of negative samples plays a crucial role in a wide range of machine learning algorithms and is particularly critical in edge classification tasks, where this choice has a direct impact on predictive performance. In this paper, we propose a set of strategies for generating negative edges in large, heterogeneous biomedical knowledge graphs, tailored to different link prediction scenarios. In these graphs, the absence of an observed edge does not necessarily indicate the absence of a relationship; instead, it may simply reflect missing or undiscovered knowledge. Leveraging latent-space graph embeddings, we analyze the impact of different negative sample selection strategies that account for both node types and edge semantics. 14c7d43180074e0f38ec54e09fb02da92e43deae.abstract: The generation of 3D molecule structures plays a crucial role in drug discovery and materials design. However, sharing molecular data across organizations raises privacy concerns due to intellectual property and competitive advantages. Federated learning offers a promising solution by enabling collaborative model training without sharing raw data, but faces challenges in communication overhead when training popular diffusion models for 3D molecule generation. In this paper, we present FedEDM, a federated learning framework for training E(3) Equivariant Diffusion Models (EDM) for 3D molecule generation with significantly reduced communication overhead. ff5096a95fb282b03405f61275602bffe614bd98.abstract: Democratizing AI for smaller-scale entities is crucial, yet their critical infrastructure faces a triad of challenges: long-tail fault detection in heterogeneous data, multimodal gaps, and strict privacy compliance. Traditional Federated Learning (FL) struggles with ''gradient starvation'' on scarce samples and is vulnerable to inversion attacks. To address these, we propose Fed-S2, a privacy-preserving framework based on Adversarially Disentangled Federated Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Fed-S2 replaces parameter synchronization with a global knowledge graph constructed from lightweight embeddings sanitized via ''Semantic-Shielding.'' fca72c7eba1895496973335e3ed98de0209b1263.title: BEAST: Leveraging Contrastive Learning and Unsupervised Sentence Embeddings for Improved Drug Abuse Detection
fca72c7eba1895496973335e3ed98de0209b1263.abstract: Prescription drug abuse is a growing public health crisis worldwide. In the digital age, social media platforms offer a unique opportunity to monitor drug abuse trends in real-time. However, traditional machine learning models struggle with the informal language, sarcasm, and figurative speech used on social media. This paper proposes BEAST, a novel approach that leverages contrastive learning to improve the detection of drug abuse references hidden within figurative language. Additionally, the integration of SimCSE and Target-Based Generating Strategy further enhances the model's performance by generating superior representations from both labeled and unlabeled data. We test our model on three datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate the superiority of BEAST over the baseline in accurately identifying drug-related references hidden within figurative language on social media. f4f8b110fd24a540fd0fc2d00d646900c75f7a82.abstract: Medicine shortages pose a significant threat to healthcare systems worldwide, disrupting patient care and increasing costs. Social media platforms, with their real-time user-posted content, offer a valuable opportunity to detect early signs of such shortages. This paper introduces MedShort, a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to monitor, analyze, and detect Medicine Shortages from social media data while preserving user privacy. Key features include filtering relevant posts, extracting specific medicines and geographic insights, and providing actionable analytics for stakeholders. Experimental results show MedShort's effectiveness, with refined LLMs achieving high accuracy, precision, and recall across several medicines. e5d5d6539cb7d3e32d713bcade6436ad56c6c0e0.abstract: The diffusion model with multiple conditions has received widespread attention in the field of drug design due to its high-quality generation ability. However, the paradigm of directly generating new molecules from conditions used in existing work has not accurately fitted the joint distribution of multiple conditions during the generation process. To address this issue, we propose Graph Diffusion Evolution Model(GDEM) for multi conditional molecule generation. GDEM decomposes the process of molecular generation into a chain-like Markov evolution process, continuously adjusting the molecular structure and gradually approaching the true multi-conditional joint distribution. However, existing approaches have largely focused on inter-visit event predictions, overlooking the importance of intra-visit nowcasting, which provides prompt clinical insights during an ongoing patient visit. 952b794d18ff7a46a103c89bf3d5d7fb30c5787d.abstract: Recent advances in clinical prediction leverage large language models (LLMs) to extract semantic information from Electronic Health Records (EHRs). However, LLMs could produce biased or hallucinated responses camouflaged by their fluency and realistic appearance, which is unacceptable in diagnosis prediction. Uncertainty estimation (UE) has emerged as an effective approach to address this challenge by quantifying hallucination levels and prediction confidence in LLM outputs. Yet, directly determining diagnosis predictions based on UE remains insufficient, as diagnoses with high uncertainty may still correspond to correct outcomes. To this end, we propose ULoR, an uncertainty-aware leave-one-out refinement framework for reliable diagnosis prediction. 952b794d18ff7a46a103c89bf3d5d7fb30c5787d.zh_title: ULoR：面向诊断预测的不确定性感知留一法精炼框架

952b794d18ff7a46a103c89bf3d5d7fb30c5787d.zh_abstract: 临床预测的近期进展利用大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）从电子健康记录（Electronic Health Records, EHRs）中提取语义信息。然而，LLMs 可能产生有偏或幻觉性回答，这些回答被其流畅性和逼真外观所掩盖，这在诊断预测中是不可接受的。不确定性估计（Uncertainty Estimation, UE）已成为通过量化 LLM 输出中的幻觉水平和预测置信度来应对这一挑战的有效方法。然而，直接基于 UE 确定诊断预测仍然不够，因为高不确定性的诊断仍可能对应正确结果。为此，我们提出 ULoR，一种不确定性感知的留一法精炼框架，用于可靠的诊断预测。具体而言，我们首先通过整合模型诊断排序 d 的多个样本的统计信息来计算 UE 分数。

The proliferation of social media has created a vast repository of such metaphorical expressions, offering an unprecedented opportunity to understand mental health struggles. These metaphors can provide crucial insights for clinical assessment and therapeutic intervention. However, their potential remains largely untapped in automated depression detection, primarily due to the lack of large-scale, annotated datasets. 8f393e81f3c9081b45f2c2b354f35e4478b3ec16.zh_title: DRMD：基于隐喻概念映射的可解释抑郁检测

8b91d03174c3cc450e3f24be7f2723490a2c46e1.title: Fact-Checking Strategies in Web: Lateral Navigation in the Browser Boosts Health Misinformation Detection Even Under Confirmation Bias
8b91d03174c3cc450e3f24be7f2723490a2c46e1.abstract: Health misinformation poses serious public health risks, yet little is known about how ordinary users verify such content in real time. In this study, we investigate how behavioral fact-checking strategies, specifically, lateral reading (consulting multiple external sources) versus vertical reading (spending more time on fewer sources), affect accuracy in detecting health-related misinformation. We conducted a large-scale online experiment with 1,842 participants using a designed for the experiment purposes standalone web platform that logs respondents' behavioral signals (tab/window switches and time spent outside the experimental interface). This design enables indirect measurement of fact-checking in an ecologically valid setting. 88d8ec90e5c7962f8aeb57f224f747553e64a97e.title: Are Copywriters the Best Humans for the Job? The Case of Health-Related Ads
88d8ec90e5c7962f8aeb57f224f747553e64a97e.abstract: Health authorities who wish to design a health-promoting advertising campaign would like to create high quality, trustworthy ads that cause behavior change. Here we compare human copywriters' ads to those created by other methods with different levels of expertise and trustworthiness, including Large Language Models, non-specialists, and students of a marketing class (with some expertise). To do so, we ran an online search ads campaign for 10 health topics with 142 ads from five sources and measured ad performance through the Click-through rate (CTR). Our results show that the copywriter ads' CTR was no better than the CTR of ads created by a Large Language Model, by marketing students, or by nonspecialists. 7f26158f36dca008e8df806698888a559362effa.title: From Retrieval to Generation: Unifying External and Parametric Knowledge for Medical Question Answering
7f26158f36dca008e8df806698888a559362effa.abstract: Medical question answering (QA) demands reliable access to rich, domain-specific knowledge. A prevalent strategy enhances large language models (LLMs) with either external knowledge retrieved from medical corpora or parametric knowledge embedded with model parameters. Existing methods generally fall into two paradigms: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which grounds reasoning in retrieved evidence, and Generation-Augmented Generation (GAG), which relies exclusively on internally generated contexts. However, RAG often suffers from noisy or incomplete retrieval, whereas GAG is prone to hallucinated or inaccurate content due to unconstrained generation. Both limitations can misguide reasoning and compromise answer reliability. To overcome these challenges, we propose MedRGAG, a unified retrieval--generation augmented framework that seamlessly integrates external and parametric knowledge
7f26158f36dca008e8df806698888a559362effa.zh_title: 从检索到生成：统一外部与参数知识用于医学问答
7f26158f36dca008e8df806698888a559362effa.summary: 提出统一外部检索知识与参数化知识的医学问答方法，整合RAG与GAG两种范式。
key_points: 医学问答依赖丰富领域知识
现有方法分RAG与GAG两类范式
统一外部与模型内部参数知识
7f26158f36dca008e8df806698888a559362effa.zh_abstract: 医学问答（QA）要求可靠地获取丰富的领域特定知识。一种普遍采用的策略是用从医学语料库检索到的外部知识或嵌入模型参数的参数化知识来增强大语言模型（LLMs）。现有方法通常分为两种范式：检索增强生成（RAG），其将推理建立在检索到的证据之上；以及生成增强生成（GAG），其完全依赖内部生成的上下文。然而，RAG 常受噪声或不完整检索的影响，而 GAG 由于不受约束的生成，容易产生幻觉或不准确内容。这两种局限都可能误导推理并损害答案可靠性。为克服这些挑战，我们提出 MedRGAG，一个统一的检索—生成增强框架，可无缝整合外部知识与参数化知识

6be6f0119d9f416f89cd09114bccd32774f54dcf.title: GreenBites: A Real-Time Diet Assistant for Sustainable Health and Eco-Friendly Living
6be6f0119d9f416f89cd09114bccd32774f54dcf.abstract: Living a sustainable life requires being both environmentally aware and health-conscious. While sustainability is increasingly promoted in the food industry, gaps in information accessibility contribute significantly to the disparity between consumers' sustainable purchasing intentions and their actual behavior. Furthermore, environmental sustainability and health-conscious choices are often promoted separately, making it challenging for consumers to address both aspects at the same time. To bridge these gaps, we present GreenBites, a real-time diet assistant designed to integrate health and environmental impact assessments at the point of purchase, assisting consumers in making more informed and sustainable food choices. GreenBites leverages multimodal inputs, food recognition powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), and advanced algorithms to analyze food items and evaluate them across

5b22e05c6429cad930613e120ffc3f2d3baf2aec.title: Mental Health and Relations: Detection of Mental Health Disorders Related to Relationship Issues Through Reddit Posts
5b22e05c6429cad930613e120ffc3f2d3baf2aec.abstract: Relationship challenges, such as breakups and marital conflicts, often lead to mental health issues like depression and suicidal thoughts. To address this, we present a new binary classification dataset sourced from Reddit posts, specifically aimed at detecting mental health concerns triggered by relationship-related stress. The dataset categorizes text as either indicating mental health distress or not, offering valuable insights into the emotional effects of relationship problems. By applying advanced natural language processing techniques, this dataset supports early detection and intervention efforts. Furthermore, it can serve as a useful resource for government and non-government organizations (GOs and NGOs) to provide guidance and relationship counseling, offering timely support to individuals in need. The classifiers achieved an accuracy score of 78.43%.

5b22e05c6429cad930613e120ffc3f2d3baf2aec.zh_abstract: 关系挑战，例如分手和婚姻冲突，常导致抑郁和自杀念头等心理健康问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个新的二分类数据集，来源于 Reddit 帖子，专门旨在检测由关系相关压力引发的心理健康担忧。该数据集将文本分类为是否表明心理健康困扰，为关系问题的情绪影响提供了有价值的见解。通过应用先进的自然语言处理技术，该数据集支持早期检测和干预工作。此外，它还可作为政府和非政府组织（GOs 和 NGOs）提供指导和关系咨询的有用资源，为有需要的人提供及时支持。分类器达到了 78.43% 的准确率得分。

46774737995ebe060fc685daa54280039881ab02.title: Spatial-Temporal Analysis of Collective Emotional Resonance in China During Global Health Crisis
46774737995ebe060fc685daa54280039881ab02.abstract: The 21st century has already witnessed so many outbreaks with pandemic potential, including SARS (2002), H1N1 (2009), MERS (2012), Ebola (2014), Zika virus (2015), and the COVID-19 pandemic (2019). Using 60 million geotagged Sina Weibo tweets covering over 20 million active accounts, we investigate the collective emotional dynamics on social media in the most recent global pandemic, i.e., COVID-19. This research features two highlights: (1) It focuses on the Chinese population located in the initial epicenter of the pandemic. (2) It examines the initial year after the pandemic outbreak, a critical period where emotions were most intense due to the uncertainty and rapid developments related to the crisis. 123232277ce717f6ff3a8f07be5ba4b6515c527c.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on open-domain question answering, but their tendency to hallucinate unverifiable or unsafe medical content limits their applicability in clinical decision support and patient education. In contrast, high-quality medical knowledge graphs (KGs) encode curated relations between diseases, symptoms, drugs, examinations, and diet. We propose GC-DPG (Graph-Constrained Dual-Phase Generation), a two-phase framework that tightly couples an LLM with a disease-centric KG for Chinese medical QA. In the first phase, GC-DPG performs graph-based answer planning : given a user question and a disease KG, it constructs a structured, disease-specific Answer Plan that enumerates which KG facts are permissible for each detected intent (e.g., symptoms, checks, drugs). 123232277ce717f6ff3a8f07be5ba4b6515c527c.zh_title: GC-DPG：图约束双阶段生成的安全可验证中文医疗问答

17d3fbeffa6fc859098a65b39fb2b0c29c4b4577.title: Combining Evidence and Reasoning for Biomedical Fact-Checking
17d3fbeffa6fc859098a65b39fb2b0c29c4b4577.abstract: Misinformation in healthcare, from vaccine hesitancy to unproven treatments, poses risks to public health and trust in medical systems. While machine learning and natural language processing have advanced automated fact-checking, validating biomedical claims remains uniquely challenging due to complex terminology, the need for domain expertise, and the critical importance of grounding in scientific evidence. We introduce CER (Combining Evidence and Reasoning), a novel framework for biomedical fact-checking that integrates scientific evidence retrieval, reasoning via large language models, and supervised veracity prediction. 17d3fbeffa6fc859098a65b39fb2b0c29c4b4577.zh_title: 结合证据与推理的生物医学事实核查

17d3fbeffa6fc859098a65b39fb2b0c29c4b4577.zh_abstract: 医疗保健中的错误信息，从疫苗犹豫到未经证实的治疗方法，对公共卫生和医疗系统的信任构成风险。虽然机器学习和自然语言处理推进了自动化事实核查，但验证生物医学主张仍然面临独特挑战，因为术语复杂、需要领域专业知识，以及基于科学证据的至关重要性。我们介绍了 CER（Combining Evidence and Reasoning），一种用于生物医学事实核查的新框架，它整合了科学证据检索、通过大型语言模型的推理以及有监督的真实性预测。通过将大型语言模型的文本生成能力与用于高质量生物医学科学证据的先进检索技术相结合，CER 有效减轻了幻觉风险，确保生成的输出基于可验证的 verifiabl

0584885daee46d60a49f079082fff0c4d581d14d.title: MultiConAD: A Unified Multilingual Conversational Dataset for Early Alzheimer's Detection
0584885daee46d60a49f079082fff0c4d581d14d.abstract: Dementia is a progressive cognitive syndrome with Alzheimer's disease (AD) as the leading cause. Conversation-based AD detection offers a cost-effective alternative to clinical methods, as language dysfunction is an early biomarker of AD. However, most prior research has framed AD detection as a binary classification problem, limiting the ability to identify Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI)-a crucial stage for early intervention. Also, studies primarily rely on single-language datasets, mainly in English, restricting crosslanguage generalizability. To address this gap, we make three key contributions. First, we introduce a novel, multilingual dataset for AD detection by unifying 16 publicly available dementia-related conversational datasets. dfccd52c9cfa8d3c88ee2fee28076f9ff3c43c42.abstract: In recent years, there has been substantial progress in using pretrained Language Models (LMs) on a range of tasks aimed at improving the understanding of biomedical texts. Nonetheless, existing biomedical LLMs show limited comprehension of complex, domain-specific concept structures and the factual information encoded in biomedical Knowledge Graphs (KGs). In this work, we propose BALI (Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Language Model Ali gnment), a novel joint LM and KG pre-training method that augments an LM with external knowledge by the simultaneous learning of a dedicated KG encoder and aligning the representations of both the LM and the graph. b2d2f50718bc1313679239b0855025f0651e005c.title: Ask and Retrieve Knowledge: Towards Proactive Asking with Imperfect Information in Medical Multi-turn Dialogues
b2d2f50718bc1313679239b0855025f0651e005c.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) cannot effectively collaborate with humans who provide imperfect information at the initial stage of the dialogue, unless they learn to proactively ask questions. Our core idea is to enable LLMs to decide whether to take the action of ''ask'' or ''tell'' at each turn by self-reasoning, with the belief of the decisions enhanced by retrieving knowledge related to the user input. Thus, we propose the ask and retrieve knowledge framework (Ark), where LLMs think through what to retrieve, when to stop retrieving, and then take actions accordingly. Ark is used to produce the action paths for model training. To mitigate the collapse of models trained on synthetic data, we propose a progressive training strategy: self-reason learning by supervised fine-tuning on produced paths and knowledge alignment through direct preference optimization on doctor response. b2d2f50718bc1313679239b0855025f0651e005c.zh_title: Ark框架：医学多轮对话中主动提问与知识检索

89dbceefbb56dffe338b43fffd30cf80554b1bfb.title: Combating Biomedical Misinformation through Multi-modal Claim Detection and Evidence-based Verification
89dbceefbb56dffe338b43fffd30cf80554b1bfb.abstract: Biomedical misinformation - ranging from misleading social media posts to fake news articles and deepfake videos - is increasingly pervasive across digital platforms, posing significant risks to public health and clinical decision-making. We developed CER, a comprehensive fact-checking system designed specifically for biomedical content. CER integrates specialized components for claim detection, scientific evidence retrieval, and veracity assessment, leveraging both transformer models and large language models to process textual and multimedia content. Unlike existing fact-checking systems that focus solely on structured text, CER can analyze claims from diverse sources including videos and web content through automatic transcription and text extraction. 89dbceefbb56dffe338b43fffd30cf80554b1bfb.zh_title: 面向生物医学虚假信息的多模态核查系统

941c3135cf5bab93ef88bf9cbcb1bdba1cb6804f.title: PILs of Knowledge: A Synthetic Benchmark for Evaluating Question Answering Systems in Healthcare
941c3135cf5bab93ef88bf9cbcb1bdba1cb6804f.abstract: Patient Information Leaflets (PILs) provide essential information about medication usage, side effects, precautions, and interactions, making them a valuable resource for Question Answering (QA) systems in healthcare. However, no dedicated benchmark currently exists to evaluate QA systems specifically on PILs, limiting progress in this domain. To address this gap, we introduce a fact-supported synthetic benchmark composed of multiple-choice questions and answers generated from real PILs. We construct the benchmark using a fully automated pipeline that leverages multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate diverse, realistic, and contextually relevant question-answer pairs. The benchmark is publicly released as a standardized evaluation framework for assessing the ability of LLMs to process and reason over PIL content. a47d91270fc6532a251e7cf3d8b6a86358a793fc.abstract: Users formulate search queries that reflect an information need. Those queries are then submitted to a search service in the expectation that the retrieved results will allow the user to complete an external task, and align with their broader information context. In this study, we reimplement and reproduce the log-augmented dense retrieval approach introduced by Jin, Shin, and Lu in 2023. As part of our study we extend the experimentation by: (1) using all of the available training data rather than a subset; (2) exploring a second dense retrieval model; and (3) enhancing the approach by incorporating user reformulation behavior into the dense retrieval computation so as to improve ranking effectiveness. To evaluate these modifications, we again utilize the TripClick IR benchmark, which comprises approximately four million click log entries from a health domain web search engine. Although
a47d91270fc6532a251e7cf3d8b6a86358a793fc.zh_title: 稠密检索与用户交互改进的医学搜索

bda18b53f3c55ecb033ee44ca7aeaea5106c04c1.title: Towards Explainable and Safe Systems for Health Data
bda18b53f3c55ecb033ee44ca7aeaea5106c04c1.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into healthcare holds immense potential to transform medical services through personalized care, early diagnosis, and more informed decision-making. However, despite significant advances in digital health technologies, the adoption of AI-driven systems remains limited, particularly in sensitive domains such as mental health, due to concerns around transparency, safety, and user trust. These concerns are compounded by the complexity of clinical language, the high stakes of decision-making, and the need for accountability in automated systems. This research addresses these challenges by investigating how Large Language Models (LLMs) and related techniques can be adapted to create explainable, interpretable, and safe health information systems. Positioned at the intersection of health informatics, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Information
bda18b53f3c55ecb033ee44ca7aeaea5106c04c1.zh_title: 面向健康数据的可解释与安全系统
bda18b53f3c55ecb033ee44ca7aeaea5106c04c1.summary: SIGIR 2025探讨健康数据AI系统的可解释性与安全性，指出透明度与信任问题限制其在心理健康等敏感领域的采用。
key_points: 聚焦健康数据AI的可解释与安全
透明度与用户信任制约落地应用
涉及心理健康等敏感领域
bda18b53f3c55ecb033ee44ca7aeaea5106c04c1.zh_abstract: 人工智能融入医疗保健具有巨大潜力，可通过个性化护理、早期诊断和更明智的决策来转变医疗服务。然而，尽管数字健康技术取得了显著进展，AI驱动系统的采用仍然有限，尤其是在心理健康等敏感领域，原因在于对透明度、安全性和用户信任的担忧。临床语言的复杂性、决策的高风险性以及自动化系统中问责的需要，进一步加剧了这些担忧。本研究通过探究如何调整大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）及相关技术，以创建可解释、可理解且安全的健康信息系统，来应对这些挑战。该研究定位于健康信息学、自然语言处理（Natural Language Processing, NLP）和信息（Information）的交叉处。

7ba9315847ad3a75cd5b1efb321a74a9f409903b.title: Learning Evidence of Depression Symptoms via Prompt Induction
7ba9315847ad3a75cd5b1efb321a74a9f409903b.abstract: Depression places substantial pressure on mental health services, and many people describe their experiences outside clinical settings in high-volume user-generated text (e.g., online forums and social media). Automatically identifying clinical symptom evidence in such text can therefore complement limited clinical capacity and scale to large populations. We address this need through sentence-level classification of 21 depression symptoms from the BDI-II questionnaire, using BDI-Sen, a dataset annotated for symptom relevance. This task is fine-grained and highly imbalanced, and we find that common LLM approaches (zero-shot, in-context learning, and fine-tuning) struggle to apply consistent relevance criteria for most symptoms. 7ba9315847ad3a75cd5b1efb321a74a9f409903b.zh_title: 通过提示归纳学习抑郁症状证据
7ba9315847ad3a75cd5b1efb321a74a9f409903b.summary: 基于BDI-Sen数据集对BDI-II问卷21种抑郁症状作句级分类，从用户生成文本中识别症状证据。

7ba9315847ad3a75cd5b1efb321a74a9f409903b.zh_abstract: 抑郁症给心理健康服务带来了巨大压力，许多人在临床环境之外通过大量用户生成的文本（例如在线论坛和社交媒体）描述自己的经历。因此，自动识别此类文本中的临床症状证据，可以补充有限的临床能力并扩展至大规模人群。我们通过对BDI-II问卷中的21种抑郁症状进行句子级分类来满足这一需求，所用数据集为BDI-Sen，该数据集针对症状相关性进行了标注。这项任务粒度细且高度不平衡，我们发现常见的LLM方法（零样本、上下文学习和微调）难以为大多数症状应用一致的相关性标准。我们提出了症状归纳（Symptom Induction, SI），这是一种新方法，可将已标注示例压缩为简短、可解释的指南，以规定什么算作对于……的证据

20f3eb45d412cb9b1ac7ed9ccb185062106a7859.title: EviRAG: Evidence-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Vision-Language Models
20f3eb45d412cb9b1ac7ed9ccb185062106a7859.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely adopted for radiology report generation with medical vision-language models, leveraging external reports as linguistic references. However, existing RAG methods rely primarily on dense embedding similarity, which may retrieve reports that are semantically related yet clinically inconsistent with respect to presence or laterality constraints. Such inconsistencies are often propagated into generation, resulting in contradictory or unsupported findings. We propose an evidence-guided retrieval-augmented framework EviRAG that decomposes retrieval into structured and unstructured alignment levels. First, we induce structured clinical triplets from both query and database cases through targeted visual interrogation, projecting images into a shared evidence space. 20f3eb45d412cb9b1ac7ed9ccb185062106a7859.zh_title: EviRAG：面向医学视觉语言模型的证据引导检索增强生成
20f3eb45d412cb9b1ac7ed9ccb185062106a7859.summary: 针对密集嵌入检索易引入临床不一致报告的问题，提出证据引导的检索增强生成方法，用于放射报告生成。

20f3eb45d412cb9b1ac7ed9ccb185062106a7859.zh_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过医学视觉-语言模型被广泛用于放射学报告生成，利用外部报告作为语言参考。然而，现有的RAG方法主要依赖稠密嵌入相似度，这可能检索到语义相关但在有无或偏侧性约束方面临床不一致的报告。此类不一致常常传播到生成中，导致矛盾或缺乏支持的发现。我们提出一种证据引导的检索增强框架 EviRAG，将检索分解为结构化和非结构化对齐层级。首先，我们通过有针对性的视觉询问，从查询和数据库病例中归纳出结构化临床三元组，将图像投影到共享证据空间。三元组级对齐强制在有无和偏侧性变量上达成显式一致。

15fb30b43a45cd8dd8ee96e424d4316fc6e2c63e.title: BeLink: Biomedical Entity Linking Meets Generative Re-Ranking
15fb30b43a45cd8dd8ee96e424d4316fc6e2c63e.abstract: Despite recent progress, Biomedical Entity Linking (BEL) with large language models (LLMs) remains computationally inefficient and challenging to deploy in practical settings. In this work, we demonstrate that instruction-tuning of open-source generative models can offer an effective solution when applied at the re-ranking stage of the BEL pipeline. We propose a set-wise instruction-tuning formulation that enables fast and accurate candidate selection. Our method demonstrates strong performance on multiple BEL benchmarks, yielding significant improvements in linking accuracy (3%–24%) while reducing inference time compared to the state-of-the-art. We integrate our generative re-ranker into BeLink, a modular, end-to-end system designed for practical real-world BEL applications.
15fb30b43a45cd8dd8ee96e424d4316fc6e2c63e.zh_title: BeLink：生物医学实体链接的生成式重排序
15fb30b43a45cd8dd8ee96e424d4316fc6e2c63e.summary: 针对大模型做生物医学实体链接计算效率低的问题，提出集合式指令微调的生成式重排序方法以快速选择候选。
key_points: 大模型生物医学实体链接部署效率低

采用集合式指令微调实现候选选择
15fb30b43a45cd8dd8ee96e424d4316fc6e2c63e.zh_abstract: 尽管最近取得了进展，使用大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的生物医学实体链接（Biomedical Entity Linking, BEL）在计算上仍然效率低下，并且难以在实际环境中部署。在这项工作中，我们证明，当应用于BEL流程的重排序阶段时，对开源生成模型进行指令微调可以提供一种有效解决方案。我们提出了一种集合级指令微调表述，能够实现快速且准确的候选选择。我们的方法在多个BEL基准上表现出强劲性能，与最先进方法相比，在减少推理时间的同时，将链接准确率显著提高（3%–24%）。我们将生成式重排序器集成到BeLink中，这是一个为实际真实世界BEL应用设计的模块化端到端系统。

e0cbf8e3ad219ca070991c2dbcb5aee159307248.title: Depression Detection from Social Media: A Mutual Guidance Multi-modal Network with Complementary Graph Learning
e0cbf8e3ad219ca070991c2dbcb5aee159307248.abstract: Depression has become a critical global public health challenge, creating an urgent need for automated and scalable screening solutions. Social media platforms, which capture rich and spontaneous multi-modal behavioral data, offer a promising avenue for detecting early signs of mental distress. However, existing depression detection methods predominantly rely on static multi-modal fusion strategies and frequently fail to effectively tackle cross-modal semantic gaps. To address these limitations, we propose a Mutual Guidance Multi-modal Network with Complementary Graph Learning (MGMN) for depression detection by observing individuals' behavioral performance on social media. Specifically, a cross-modal mutual guidance mechanism is designed to dynamically construct a complementary graph by using mutual similarities within and across visual and acoustic modalities common in social media. e0cbf8e3ad219ca070991c2dbcb5aee159307248.summary: SIGIR 2026提出互引导多模态网络结合互补图学习，用于社交媒体抑郁检测并缓解跨模态语义鸿沟。
key_points: 基于多模态社交媒体数据检测抑郁
互引导网络缓解跨模态语义鸿沟

e0cbf8e3ad219ca070991c2dbcb5aee159307248.zh_abstract: 抑郁症已成为一项关键的全球公共卫生挑战，迫切需要自动化且可扩展的筛查解决方案。社交媒体平台捕获丰富且自发的多模态行为数据，为检测心理困扰的早期迹象提供了有前景的途径。然而，现有抑郁检测方法主要依赖静态多模态融合策略，常常无法有效应对跨模态语义鸿沟。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种带互补图学习的相互引导多模态网络（Mutual Guidance Multi-modal Network with Complementary Graph Learning, MGMN），通过观察个体在社交媒体上的行为表现进行抑郁检测。具体而言，设计了一种跨模态相互引导机制，利用社交媒体中常见的视觉和声学模态内部及之间的相互相似性，动态构建互补图。Mor

d93df8be2ca0fbc696a9261c836d211c62cd4eb4.title: OntoEL: Neuro-Symbolic Biomedical Entity Linking with Differentiable Fuzzy EL⊥ Reasoning
d93df8be2ca0fbc696a9261c836d211c62cd4eb4.abstract: Current neural biomedical entity linking (BioEL) models treat ontologies as flat dictionaries, ignoring the rich terminological knowledge (TBox) that defines concept boundaries. Consequently, they struggle with contextual ambiguity, often retrieving logically inconsistent candidates based solely on surface similarity. We present OntoEL, a neuro-symbolic framework that shifts BioEL from surface-level matching to logic-grounded reasoning. OntoEL integrates differentiable fuzzy EL⊥ reasoning into the retrieval pipeline as a consistency-aware re-ranker, employing a hybrid strategy: structural TBox reasoning is delegated to classical polynomial-time reasoners, while the sigmoidal Reichenbach implication performs soft type-consistency evaluation, effectively resolving the "implication bias" gradient pathology in previous neuro-symbolic methods. d93df8be2ca0fbc696a9261c836d211c62cd4eb4.zh_title: OntoEL：神经符号生物医学实体链接
d93df8be2ca0fbc696a9261c836d211c62cd4eb4.summary: 提出神经符号框架OntoEL，将可微模糊EL⊥推理引入生物医学实体链接，以逻辑推理替代表层匹配。

771d96e2e326261fbed4dd9d7948ee1da7a8b02d.title: CTCL: A Cross-Language Benchmark for Matching Patients to Clinical Trials
771d96e2e326261fbed4dd9d7948ee1da7a8b02d.abstract: The success of clinical trials depends on the recruitment of patients who match strict inclusion criteria. The development of effective patient to clinical trial matching systems depends on benchmarking datasets that support systematic evaluation. Apart from resources that are created in English by the TREC Clinical trials tracks (2021-23), very limited corpora exist for other languages and cross-language settings, despite the need of automatic support for clinical trial recruitment being global. To address this gap, we combine machine translation with medical expert annotation to construct CTCL (Clinical Trials Cross Lingual retrieval), a cross-lingual evaluation benchmark for patient-clinical trial retrieval in seven languages. 771d96e2e326261fbed4dd9d7948ee1da7a8b02d.zh_title: CTCL：跨语言临床试验患者匹配基准
771d96e2e326261fbed4dd9d7948ee1da7a8b02d.summary: 提出跨语言基准CTCL，用于评估患者与临床试验匹配系统，弥补英语以外及跨语言语料匮乏的问题。
key_points: 临床试验招募依赖符合入组标准的患者匹配
既有资源多由TREC以英语构建
其他语言与跨语言设置语料严重不足
771d96e2e326261fbed4dd9d7948ee1da7a8b02d.zh_abstract: 临床试验的成功取决于招募符合严格入选标准的患者。有效的患者与临床试验匹配系统的开发取决于支持系统性评估的基准数据集。除了 TREC 临床试验赛道（2021-23）以英语创建的资源之外，其他语言和跨语言设置可用的语料库非常有限，尽管临床试验招募的自动支持需求是全球性的。为填补这一空白，我们将机器翻译与医学专家标注相结合，构建了 CTCL（Clinical Trials Cross Lingual retrieval，临床试验跨语言检索），一个用于七种语言的患者—临床试验检索的跨语言评估基准。我们使用 14 个大型语言（嵌入）模型对跨语言检索任务进行基准测试。我们展示了我们的数据集如何可用于评估跨语言

632d42035fc32ea31a41e9bb1c9e1770f3ce58ef.title: MedNQS: Medical State-Aware Dual-Stage Next-Turn Question Suggestion for Online Medical Consultations
632d42035fc32ea31a41e9bb1c9e1770f3ce58ef.abstract: High-quality follow-up questions are essential for efficient online medical consultations, yet they are difficult for non-professional users to ask. Next-turn Question Suggestion (NQS) addresses this by recommending candidate questions to guide multi-turn interactions. In production, NQS faces two practical challenges: (1) click through signals are noisy and do not reliably reflect question quality, and (2) the standard two-stage pipeline optimizes retrieval and ranking separately, leading to suboptimal end-to-end performance. We present MedNQS, a medical state-aware dual-stage NQS system for online medical consultations. MedNQS uses medical dialogue state tracking to unify context across stages, retrieves candidates from both a curated FAQ set and LLM-generated questions with state-aware constraints, and reranks them with a lightweight transformer model trained on preference data. 632d42035fc32ea31a41e9bb1c9e1770f3ce58ef.zh_title: MedNQS：在线问诊的医学状态感知双阶段下一轮问题推荐
632d42035fc32ea31a41e9bb1c9e1770f3ce58ef.summary: 面向在线医疗问诊提出MedNQS，利用医学状态感知的双阶段方法推荐下一轮追问问题。
key_points: 追问问题对在线问诊效率至关重要
点击信号噪声大，难反映问题质量
两阶段流程检索与排序分离存在优化割裂
632d42035fc32ea31a41e9bb1c9e1770f3ce58ef.zh_abstract: 高质量的追问问题对于高效的在线医疗咨询至关重要，但非专业用户难以提出这些问题。下一轮问题建议（NQS）通过推荐候选问题来引导多轮交互，从而解决这一问题。在生产环境中，NQS 面临两个实际挑战：（1）点击信号存在噪声，不能可靠反映问题质量；（2）标准的两阶段流水线分别优化检索和排序，导致端到端性能次优。我们提出 MedNQS，一个面向在线医疗咨询的医学状态感知双阶段 NQS 系统。MedNQS 使用医学对话状态跟踪来统一各阶段的上下文，从精心整理的 FAQ 集和带状态感知约束的 LLM 生成问题中检索候选，并使用在偏好数据上训练的轻量级 transformer 模型对它们重排序。A clo

3cb8cc10e79d3f3454ab238780ed576d2d26731f.title: Improving Interpretability of Cognitive Diagnosis Models with LLM-based Semantic Augmentation
3cb8cc10e79d3f3454ab238780ed576d2d26731f.abstract: Cognitive diagnosis aims to infer students' mastery levels over knowledge components from their learning interactions, supporting personalized education applications. However, existing models encode responses as binary correctness labels, discarding information about which specific option a student selected. This input-level information loss limits their ability to distinguish qualitatively different error types. As a result, providing interpretable diagnostic outputs becomes challenging. To address these limitations, we propose SACD, a semantic-augmented cognitive diagnosis framework that integrates LLM-based semantic analysis with student behavioral modeling. First, an LLM-based exercise diagnostic generator analyzes exercise content and produces structured semantic annotations for each answer choice, capturing the specific misconceptions ea

2f751bdfd6176a1793064cca9aac7045727dede1.title: Targeted Multi-Modal Passage Search for Molecules and their Synthesis Pathways
2f751bdfd6176a1793064cca9aac7045727dede1.abstract: We present a chemical extraction and search pipeline intended to support information tasks related to drug discovery. Commonly used search tools for drug discovery such as Reaxys and SciFinder do not allow users to obtain retrieval results at the passage level. To address this, we present a passage retrieval tool for chemical patents that supports queries combining text and molecule diagrams expressed in SMILES. When SMILES is provided as a part of a query, the system refines text retrieval results through matching both textual names and drawn figures based on extracted SMILES representations. Molecule matches are obtained through substructure matching and structural similarity. This functionality was motivated by a chemist's need to find synthesis pathways for specific molecules containing a substructure of interest that binds and thus inhibits specific human genes. 2f751bdfd6176a1793064cca9aac7045727dede1.zh_title: 面向分子及合成路径的定向多模态段落检索
2f751bdfd6176a1793064cca9aac7045727dede1.summary: 构建化学专利段落级检索工具，支持文本与SMILES分子结构联合查询。
key_points: 面向药物发现信息任务
现有工具不支持段落级检索结果
支持文本与SMILES组合查询
2f751bdfd6176a1793064cca9aac7045727dede1.zh_abstract: 我们提出了一种化学提取与搜索流程，旨在支持与药物发现相关的信息任务。常用于药物发现的搜索工具（如 Reaxys 和 SciFinder）不允许用户在段落级别获取检索结果。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向化学专利的段落检索工具，支持结合文本和以 SMILES 表示的分子图的查询。当 SMILES 作为查询的一部分提供时，系统通过基于提取的 SMILES 表示匹配文本名称和绘制的图形来细化文本检索结果。分子匹配通过子结构匹配和结构相似性获得。这一功能源于化学家的需求：寻找含有感兴趣子结构、能够结合并因此抑制特定人类基因的特定分子的合成路径。针对这一演示

2d18f79edd13d9d0eb3c7a1ef9414bfc402ccad7.title: SciCheck: Reasoning Distillation for Biomedical Claim Verification
2d18f79edd13d9d0eb3c7a1ef9414bfc402ccad7.abstract: False claims about medical information can have damaging consequences. Although LLMs have been used to verify such claims, their success depends on access to accurate content and robust reasoning capabilities. Prior research assumes access to gold evidence during inference or relies on expensive, compute-intensive scaling strategies. However, these approaches fall short when applied to real-world verification tasks, where relevant evidence is hard to obtain and efficiency is crucial. To address this, we introduce SciCheck, a novel solution that integrates web evidence retrieval with a process of reasoning distillation. Our approach fine-tunes a small language model using reasoning traces generated by an LLM. 2d18f79edd13d9d0eb3c7a1ef9414bfc402ccad7.zh_title: SciCheck：面向生物医学论断验证的推理蒸馏
2d18f79edd13d9d0eb3c7a1ef9414bfc402ccad7.summary: 针对真实场景中证据难获取、算力开销大的问题，提出推理蒸馏方法验证生物医学虚假论断。
key_points: 医疗虚假信息验证具现实危害
已有方法依赖金标证据或大规模算力
以推理蒸馏提升验证效率与可行性

218553331635f8a7016a7cd5542b4461a1436884.title: BioCLEAR Benchmark for Biomedical Text Simplification
218553331635f8a7016a7cd5542b4461a1436884.abstract: Access to objective, reliable scientific information is crucial in a world of misinformation and disinformation, yet the general public often avoids scientific literature due to its perceived complexity. Modern generative information access models hold the promise of removing some of these barriers by developing appropriate approaches to scientific text simplification. We constructed BioCLEAR, a benchmark for Biomedical Comprehensible Lay Explanations of Academic Research used in the CLEF 2025 SimpleText track, comprising a large set of aligned abstracts and plain-language summaries from Cochrane systematic reviews. First, it provides a new resource for scientific document-level text simplification, including discourse-level aspects that are absent from traditional sentence-level data. 218553331635f8a7016a7cd5542b4461a1436884.zh_title: BioCLEAR：生物医学文本简化基准
218553331635f8a7016a7cd5542b4461a1436884.summary: 构建BioCLEAR基准，用于评估生物医学文献面向公众的通俗化文本简化。

用于CLEF 2025共享任务

218553331635f8a7016a7cd5542b4461a1436884.zh_abstract: 在虚假信息和错误信息充斥的世界中，获取客观、可靠的科学信息至关重要，但普通公众往往因其认为科学文献过于复杂而回避阅读。现代生成式信息获取模型有望通过开发适当的科学文本简化方法来消除其中一些障碍。我们构建了 BioCLEAR，这是一个用于生物医学学术研究可理解通俗解释（Biomedical Comprehensible Lay Explanations of Academic Research）的基准，用于 CLEF 2025 SimpleText 赛道，包含大量来自 Cochrane 系统综述的已对齐摘要和通俗语言摘要。首先，它为科学文档级文本简化提供了新资源，包括传统句子级数据中缺失的语篇层面方面。其次，我们纳入通过人工句子级简化创建的现有资源，以开展实验

16459b7321f88dcae2c509334564a048db33e363.title: Generating Effective Health-Related Queries for Promoting Reliable Search Results
16459b7321f88dcae2c509334564a048db33e363.abstract: Misinformation on the Internet poses significant risks to users seeking health information. This paper addresses the challenge of generating effective health-related queries to promote reliable search results. We propose a method leveraging Large Language Models to generate synthetic narratives that guide the creation of alternative queries. These queries are designed to retrieve more helpful and fewer harmful documents compared to those retrieved by the original user queries. We evaluate the effectiveness of these queries using classic and neural retrieval models across multiple datasets, demonstrating promising improvements in retrieving reputable content.
16459b7321f88dcae2c509334564a048db33e363.zh_title: 为促进可靠检索结果生成有效的健康相关查询
16459b7321f88dcae2c509334564a048db33e363.summary: 利用大语言模型生成合成叙述以构造替代查询，使用户检索到更多有益、更少有害的健康文档。
key_points: 针对网络健康信息误导风险
用LLM生成合成叙述派生替代查询
替代查询检索效果更优
16459b7321f88dcae2c509334564a048db33e363.zh_abstract: 互联网上的错误信息对寻求健康信息的用户构成重大风险。本文应对生成有效健康相关查询以促进可靠搜索结果的挑战。我们提出一种利用大型语言模型（Large Language Models）生成合成叙述的方法，以指导替代查询的创建。与原始用户查询检索到的文档相比，这些查询旨在检索更多有帮助且更少有害的文档。我们在多个数据集上使用经典检索模型和神经检索模型评估这些查询的有效性，证明在检索可信内容方面有前景良好的改进。

07ca999cb90cd370655c5e6e90037e1e888d1826.title: Meituan Merchant Business Diagnosis via Policy-Guided Dual-Process User Simulation
07ca999cb90cd370655c5e6e90037e1e888d1826.abstract: Simulating group-level user behavior enables scalable counterfactual evaluation of merchant strategies without costly online experiments. However, building a trustworthy simulator faces two structural challenges. First, information incompleteness causes reasoning-based simulators to over-rationalize when unobserved factors such as offline context and implicit habits are missing. Second, mechanism duality requires capturing both interpretable preferences and implicit statistical regularities, which no single paradigm achieves alone. We propose Policy-Guided Hybrid Simulation (PGHS), a dual-process framework that mines transferable decision policies from behavioral trajectories and uses them as a shared alignment layer. a3dd0934cea06b3594a678edece2b386c178b8e6.title: Mobile U-ViT: Revisiting large kernel and U-shaped ViT for efficient medical image segmentation
a3dd0934cea06b3594a678edece2b386c178b8e6.abstract: In clinical practice, medical image analysis often requires efficient execution on resource-constrained mobile devices. However, existing mobile models-primarily optimized for natural images-tend to perform poorly on medical tasks due to the significant information density gap between natural and medical domains. Combining computational efficiency with medical imaging-specific architectural advantages remains a challenge when developing lightweight, universal, and high-performing networks. To address this, we propose a mobile model called Mobile U-shaped Vision Transformer (Mobile U-ViT) tailored for medical image segmentation. Specifically, we employ the newly proposed ConvUtr as a hierarchical patch embedding, featuring a parameter-efficient large-kernel CNN with inverted bottleneck fusion. This design exhibits transformer-like representation learning capacity while being lighter and f
a3dd0934cea06b3594a678edece2b386c178b8e6.zh_title: Mobile U-ViT：高效医学图像分割轻量模型
a3dd0934cea06b3594a678edece2b386c178b8e6.summary: 提出Mobile U-ViT，结合大卷积核与U形ViT，面向移动端医学图像分割。
key_points: 临床需移动设备高效执行
自然图像移动模型在医学任务表现差
兼顾效率与医学影像结构优势

a313c87fbb4b3b0cb1186adfa2a85c1d1a06145e.title: Pathology-Aware Prototype Evolution via LLM-Driven Semantic Disambiguation for Multicenter Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
a313c87fbb4b3b0cb1186adfa2a85c1d1a06145e.abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading plays a critical role in early clinical intervention and vision preservation. Recent explorations predominantly focus on visual lesion feature extraction through data processing and domain decoupling strategies. However, they generally overlook domain-invariant pathological patterns and underutilize the rich contextual knowledge of foundation models, relying solely on visual information, which is insufficient for distinguishing subtle pathological variations. Therefore, we propose integrating fine-grained pathological descriptions to complement prototypes with additional context, thereby resolving ambiguities in borderline cases. Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Anchor Prototype Modulation (HAPM) framework to facilitate DR grading. a313c87fbb4b3b0cb1186adfa2a85c1d1a06145e.zh_title: 病理感知原型演化：LLM语义消歧用于多中心糖网诊断
a313c87fbb4b3b0cb1186adfa2a85c1d1a06145e.summary: 提出病理感知原型演化方法，借助大模型语义消歧提升多中心糖尿病视网膜病变分级诊断。
key_points: 糖网分级对早期临床干预与视力保护至关重要
现有方法忽视域不变病理模式，仅依赖视觉信息
结合大模型语义消歧进行病理感知原型演化

6e3e8707ead9b983bb863cadd39c58ceb15d0409.title: EyecareGPT: Boosting Comprehensive Ophthalmology Understanding with Tailored Dataset, Benchmark and Model
6e3e8707ead9b983bb863cadd39c58ceb15d0409.abstract: Medical Large Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) demonstrate significant potential in healthcare, but their reliance on general medical data and coarse-grained global visual understanding limits them in intelligent ophthalmic diagnosis. Currently, intelligent ophthalmic diagnosis faces three major challenges: (i) Data. The lack of deeply annotated, high-quality, multi-modal ophthalmic visual instruction data; (ii) Benchmark. The absence of a comprehensive and systematic benchmark for evaluating diagnostic performance; (iii) Model. The difficulty of adapting holistic visual architectures to fine-grained, region-specific ophthalmic lesion identification. 6e3e8707ead9b983bb863cadd39c58ceb15d0409.zh_title: EyecareGPT：眼科理解的数据集、基准与模型
6e3e8707ead9b983bb863cadd39c58ceb15d0409.summary: 针对眼科智能诊断在数据、基准与模型方面的不足，提出配套的多模态数据集、评测基准与模型。

提升细粒度眼科视觉理解
6e3e8707ead9b983bb863cadd39c58ceb15d0409.zh_abstract: 医学大型视觉-语言模型（Med-LVLMs）在医疗保健领域展现出巨大潜力，但它们对通用医学数据和粗粒度全局视觉理解的依赖限制了它们在智能眼科诊断中的应用。目前，智能眼科诊断面临三大挑战：(i) 数据。缺乏深度标注、高质量、多模态的眼科视觉指令数据；(ii) 基准。缺乏用于评估诊断性能的全面且系统的基准；(iii) 模型。难以将整体视觉架构适应于细粒度、区域特定的眼科病变识别。在本文中，我们提出了 Eyecare Kit，它通过定制的数据集、基准和模型系统地解决了上述三个关键挑战：首先，我们构建了一个多智能体数据引擎，使用真实世界眼科数据

af9ca50c5d248bd24642735e5dff671bd6b2525d.title: MM-Skin: Enhancing Dermatology Vision-Language Model with an Image-Text Dataset Derived from Textbooks
af9ca50c5d248bd24642735e5dff671bd6b2525d.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise as clinical assistants across various medical fields. However, specialized dermatology VLM capable of delivering professional and detailed diagnostic analysis remains underdeveloped, primarily due to less specialized text descriptions in current dermatology multimodal datasets. To address this issue, we propose MM-Skin, the first large-scale multimodal dermatology dataset that encompasses 3 imaging modalities, including clinical, dermoscopic, and pathological and nearly 10k high-quality image-text pairs collected from professional textbooks. In addition, we generate over 27k diverse, instruction-following vision question answering (VQA) samples (9× the size of current largest dermatology VQA dataset). af9ca50c5d248bd24642735e5dff671bd6b2525d.zh_title: MM-Skin：基于教材图文数据增强皮肤科视觉语言模型
af9ca50c5d248bd24642735e5dff671bd6b2525d.summary: 提出首个大规模皮肤科多模态数据集MM-Skin，涵盖三种成像模态，用于增强皮肤科视觉语言模型的诊断分析能力。

af9ca50c5d248bd24642735e5dff671bd6b2525d.zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已在多个医学领域展现出作为临床助手的潜力。然而，能够提供专业且详细诊断分析的专科皮肤病学 VLM 仍不发达，这主要是由于当前皮肤病学多模态数据集中的文本描述专业性不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 MM-Skin，这是首个大规模多模态皮肤病学数据集，涵盖 3 种成像模态，包括临床、皮肤镜和病理图像，以及从专业教科书中收集的近 10k 高质量图文对。此外，我们生成了超过 27k 多样化的、遵循指令的视觉问答（VQA）样本（是当前最大皮肤病学 VQA 数据集规模的 9 倍）。利用公共数据集和 MM-Skin，我们开发了 SkinVL，一种皮肤病学专用的 VLM，旨在实现精确且细致的皮肤疾病

3725dc2ec4b3388027eb7dac79d7939082dc8ba4.title: Tree-of-Reasoning: Towards Complex Medical Diagnosis via Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence Tree
3725dc2ec4b3388027eb7dac79d7939082dc8ba4.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential in the medical domain. However, existing models still fall short when faced with complex medical diagnosis task in the real world. This is mainly because they lack sufficient reasoning depth, which leads to information loss or logical jumps when processing a large amount of specialized medical data, leading to diagnostic errors. To address these challenges, we propose Tree-of-Reasoning (ToR), a novel multi-agent framework designed to handle complex scenarios. Specifically, ToR introduces a tree structure that can clearly record the reasoning path of LLMs and the corresponding clinical evidence. At the same time, we propose a cross-validation mechanism to ensure the consistency of multi-agent decision-making, thereby improving the clinical reasoning ability of multi-agents in complex medical scenarios. 3725dc2ec4b3388027eb7dac79d7939082dc8ba4.zh_title: Tree-of-Reasoning：多智能体证据树辅助复杂诊断
3725dc2ec4b3388027eb7dac79d7939082dc8ba4.summary: MM 2025 提出多智能体框架 Tree-of-Reasoning，以证据树提升复杂医学诊断的推理深度。

3725dc2ec4b3388027eb7dac79d7939082dc8ba4.zh_abstract: 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在医学领域已展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有模型在面对现实世界中的复杂医学诊断任务时仍然表现不足。这主要是因为它们缺乏足够的推理深度，导致在处理大量专业医学数据时出现信息丢失或逻辑跳跃，进而导致诊断错误。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Tree-of-Reasoning（ToR），一种旨在处理复杂场景的新型多智能体框架。具体而言，ToR 引入一种树结构，能够清晰记录 LLM 的推理路径及相应的临床证据。同时，我们提出一种交叉验证机制，以确保多智能体决策的一致性，从而提升多智能体在复杂医学场景中的临床推理能力。在 real-wo 上的实验结果

8fe1beac07159982e49d59c603df374020ec266a.title: MediSee: Reasoning-Based Pixel-Level Perception in Medical Images
8fe1beac07159982e49d59c603df374020ec266a.abstract: Despite progress in pixel-level medical image perception, existing methods remain task-specific or depend on precise prompts like bounding boxes or text. However, the need for medical knowledge limits accessibility for the general public, who are more likely to use logically reasoned oral queries than domain-specific inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel medical vision task: Medical Reasoning Segmentation and Detection (MedSD), which aims to comprehend implicit queries about medical images and generate the corresponding segmentation mask and bounding box for the target object. To accomplish this task, we first introduce a Multi-perspective, Logic-driven Medical Reasoning Segmentation and Detection (MLMR-SD) dataset, which encompasses a substantial collection of medical entity targets along with their corresponding reasoning. 8fe1beac07159982e49d59c603df374020ec266a.zh_title: MediSee：医学图像中的推理式像素级感知

a4d3d2bbe5af5379680f6f69dd83455971a01621.title: GynSurg: A Comprehensive Gynecology Laparoscopic Surgery Dataset
a4d3d2bbe5af5379680f6f69dd83455971a01621.abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have transformed computer-assisted intervention and surgical video analysis, driving improvements not only in surgical training, intraoperative decision support, and patient outcomes, but also in postoperative documentation and surgical discovery. Central to these developments is the availability of large, high-quality annotated datasets. In gynecologic laparoscopy, surgical scene understanding and action recognition are fundamental for building intelligent systems that assist surgeons during operations and provide deeper analysis after surgery. However, existing datasets are often limited by small scale, narrow task focus, or insufficiently detailed annotations, limiting their utility for comprehensive, end-to-end workflow analysis. a4d3d2bbe5af5379680f6f69dd83455971a01621.zh_title: GynSurg：妇科院腔镜手术综合数据集
a4d3d2bbe5af5379680f6f69dd83455971a01621.summary: MM 2025 发布 GynSurg 妇科院腔镜手术数据集，面向手术场景理解与动作识别，为智能手术系统研发提供大规模高质量标注数据。
key_points: 聚焦妇科院腔镜手术视频分析

a4d3d2bbe5af5379680f6f69dd83455971a01621.zh_abstract: 深度学习的最新进展已经改变了计算机辅助干预和手术视频分析，不仅推动了手术培训、术中决策支持和患者结局的改善，也推动了术后文档记录和手术发现。这些发展的核心是大型、高质量标注数据集的可用性。在妇科腹腔镜手术中，手术场景理解和动作识别对于构建智能系统至关重要，这些系统可在手术过程中辅助外科医生，并在术后提供更深入的分析。然而，现有数据集往往受限于规模小、任务重点狭窄或标注细节不足，限制了其用于全面、端到端工作流程分析的价值。为解决这些局限，我们引入 GynSurg，这是用于妇科腹腔镜的最大且最多样化的多任务数据集。

03d66b523a9b9a8c3e5964a2920fb6a1917c0fcd.title: Gaze into the Heart: A Multi-View Video Dataset for rPPG and Health Biomarkers Estimation
03d66b523a9b9a8c3e5964a2920fb6a1917c0fcd.abstract: Progress in remote PhotoPlethysmoGraphy (rPPG) is limited by the critical issues of existing publicly available datasets: small size, privacy concerns with facial videos, and lack of diversity in conditions. The paper introduces a novel, comprehensive, large-scale multi-view video dataset for rPPG and health biomarkers estimation. Our dataset comprises 3600 synchronized video recordings from 600 subjects, captured under varied conditions (resting and post-exercise) using multiple consumer-grade cameras at different angles. To enable multimodal analysis of physiological states, each recording is paired with a 100 Hz PPG signal and extended health metrics, such as electrocardiogram, arterial blood pressure, biomarkers, temperature, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, and stress level. 03d66b523a9b9a8c3e5964a2920fb6a1917c0fcd.zh_title: Gaze into the Heart：rPPG 与健康标志物多视角视频数据集
03d66b523a9b9a8c3e5964a2920fb6a1917c0fcd.summary: ACM MM 2025 发布大规模多视角视频数据集，含 600 名受试者 3600 段同步录制，用于远程光电容积描记与健康生物标志物估计。
key_points: 600 名受试者、3600 段同步视频

09c1519b02d2e115495125f2b4753a7e70a5cf34.title: The First MPDD Challenge: Multimodal Personality-aware Depression Detection
09c1519b02d2e115495125f2b4753a7e70a5cf34.abstract: Depression is a widespread mental health issue affecting diverse age groups, with notable prevalence among college students and the elderly. However, existing datasets and detection methods primarily focus on young adults, neglecting the broader age spectrum and individual differences that influence depression manifestation. Current approaches often establish a direct mapping between multimodal data and depression indicators, failing to capture the complexity and diversity of depression across individuals. This challenge includes two tracks based on age-specific subsets: Track 1 uses the MPDD-Elderly dataset for detecting depression in older adults, and Track 2 uses the MPDD-Young dataset for detecting depression in younger participants. 09c1519b02d2e115495125f2b4753a7e70a5cf34.zh_title: 首届MPDD挑战赛：多模态人格感知抑郁检测
09c1519b02d2e115495125f2b4753a7e70a5cf34.summary: MM 2025 举办首届多模态人格感知抑郁检测挑战赛，扩展年龄谱系与个体差异视角。
key_points: 抑郁影响各年龄段，大学生与老年人尤为突出
现有数据集与方法多聚焦年轻成年人
现有方法常直接映射多模态数据与抑郁指标
09c1519b02d2e115495125f2b4753a7e70a5cf34.zh_abstract: 抑郁症是一个影响不同年龄段的广泛心理健康问题，在大学生和老年人中尤为普遍。然而，现有的数据集和检测方法主要关注年轻人，忽视了更广泛的年龄范围以及影响抑郁症表现的个体差异。当前方法通常建立多模态数据与抑郁指标之间的直接映射，未能捕捉个体间抑郁症的复杂性和多样性。该挑战包括基于年龄特定子集的两条赛道：赛道1使用MPDD-Elderly数据集检测老年人的抑郁症，赛道2使用MPDD-Young数据集检测年轻参与者的抑郁症。多模态个性感知抑郁检测（MPDD）挑战旨在通过结合多模态数据与个体差异来弥补这一空白。

d61b43f5a407a1479252e94a400778f3da628cb2.title: MIRA: A Novel Framework for Fusing Modalities in Medical RAG
d61b43f5a407a1479252e94a400778f3da628cb2.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) have significantly advanced AI-assisted medical diagnosis, but often generate factually inconsistent responses that deviate from established medical knowledge. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances factual accuracy by integrating external sources, but it presents two key challenges. First, insufficient retrieval can miss critical information, whereas excessive retrieval can introduce irrelevant or misleading content, disrupting model output. Second, even when the model initially provides correct answers, over-reliance on retrieved data can lead to factual errors. To address these issues, we introduce Multimodal Intelligent Retrieval and Augmentation (MIRA) framework, designed to optimize factual accuracy in MLLM. d61b43f5a407a1479252e94a400778f3da628cb2.summary: MM 2025提出MIRA框架，用于在医学检索增强生成中融合多模态信息。
key_points: 针对MLLM事实不一致问题
关注检索不足与过度检索两难
提出多模态融合的RAG框架
d61b43f5a407a1479252e94a400778f3da628cb2.zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）显著推进了 AI 辅助医学诊断，但常常生成偏离既有医学知识的事实不一致响应。检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部来源来增强事实准确性，但它带来两个关键挑战。第一，检索不足可能遗漏关键信息，而检索过度可能引入无关或误导性内容，干扰模型输出。第二，即使模型最初提供正确答案，对检索数据的过度依赖也可能导致事实错误。为解决这些问题，我们引入多模态智能检索与增强（MIRA）框架，旨在优化 MLLM 中的事实准确性。MIRA 由两个关键组件组成：（1）一个校准的 Rethinking and Rearrangement 模块，可动态调整 number of

56b7de2f23d85920dc8639b2efea7539f2f010e9.title: Lightweight Medical Image Restoration via Integrating Reliable Lesion-Semantic Driven Prior
56b7de2f23d85920dc8639b2efea7539f2f010e9.abstract: Medical image restoration tasks aim to recover high-quality images from degraded observations, exhibiting emergent desires in many clinical scenarios, such as low-dose CT image denoising, MRI super-resolution, and MRI artifact removal. Despite the success achieved by existing deep learning-based restoration methods with sophisticated modules, they struggle with rendering computationally-efficient reconstruction results. Moreover, they usually ignore the reliability of the restoration results, which is much more urgent in medical systems. To alleviate these issues, we present LRformer, a Lightweight Transformer-based method via Reliability-guided learning in the frequency domain. 56b7de2f23d85920dc8639b2efea7539f2f010e9.zh_title: 融合可靠病灶语义先验的轻量医学图像复原
56b7de2f23d85920dc8639b2efea7539f2f010e9.summary: 引入可靠病灶语义驱动先验，实现计算高效的医学图像复原。

2602c2a05765006ac21ac3ac795a88cc607f3ae3.title: Learning to Be a Doctor: Searching for Effective Medical Agent Architectures
2602c2a05765006ac21ac3ac795a88cc607f3ae3.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, and their application in the medical domain holds particular promise due to the demand for high generalizability and reliance on interdisciplinary knowledge. However, existing medical agent systems often rely on static, manually crafted workflows that lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse diagnostic requirements and adapt to emerging clinical scenarios. Motivated by the success of automated machine learning (AutoML), this paper introduces a novel framework for the automated design of medical agent architectures. Specifically, we define a hierarchical and expressive agent search space that enables dynamic workflow adaptation through structured modifications at the node, structural, and framework levels. 2602c2a05765006ac21ac3ac795a88cc607f3ae3.zh_title: 学习当医生：搜索有效的医疗智能体架构
2602c2a05765006ac21ac3ac795a88cc607f3ae3.summary: 提出自动搜索医疗智能体架构的方法，以替代静态手工工作流，适应多样诊断需求。
key_points: 基于大语言模型的医疗智能体
针对静态工作流缺乏灵活性
