2602c2a05765006ac21ac3ac795a88cc607f3ae3.zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在广泛任务中已展现出强大能力，而由于对高泛化性的需求以及对跨学科知识的依赖，它们在医学领域的应用尤其具有前景。然而，现有的医学智能体系统往往依赖静态的、人工构建的工作流程，缺乏灵活性，难以适应多样化的诊断需求并适配新出现的临床场景。受自动化机器学习（AutoML）成功的启发，本文提出了一种用于医学智能体架构自动化设计的新框架。具体而言，我们定义了一个分层且表达力强的智能体搜索空间，通过在节点、结构和框架层面进行结构化修改，实现工作流程的动态适配。我们的框架将医学智能体概念化为基于图的架构

1e415575c3b2d5966ef4a5193d5ebffadf112390.title: Text-Promptable Propagation for Referring Medical Image Sequence Segmentation
1e415575c3b2d5966ef4a5193d5ebffadf112390.abstract: Referring Medical Image Sequence Segmentation (Ref-MISS) is a novel and challenging task that aims to segment anatomical structures in medical image sequences (e.g., endoscopy, ultrasound, CT, and MRI) based on natural language descriptions. Existing 2D and 3D segmentation models struggle to explicitly track objects of interest across medical image sequences, and lack support for interactive, text-driven guidance. To address these limitations, we propose Text-Promptable Propagation (TPP), which enables the recognition of referred objects through cross-modal referring interaction, and maintains continuous tracking across the sequence via Transformer-based triple propagation, using text embeddings as queries. To support this task, we curate a large-scale benchmark, Ref-MISS-Bench, which covers 4 imaging modalities and 20 different organs and lesions. Experimental results on this benchmark

1e415575c3b2d5966ef4a5193d5ebffadf112390.summary: 提出文本可提示传播（TPP），依据自然语言描述在医学图像序列中分割并跟踪目标解剖结构。

1e415575c3b2d5966ef4a5193d5ebffadf112390.zh_abstract: 指称医学图像序列分割（Referring Medical Image Sequence Segmentation, Ref-MISS）是一项新颖且具有挑战性的任务，旨在基于自然语言描述分割医学图像序列（例如内窥镜、超声、CT 和 MRI）中的解剖结构。现有 2D 和 3D 分割模型难以在医学图像序列中显式跟踪感兴趣对象，并且缺乏对交互式、文本驱动引导的支持。为解决这些局限，我们提出文本可提示传播（Text-Promptable Propagation, TPP），它通过跨模态指称交互实现对所指对象的识别，并利用文本嵌入作为查询，通过基于 Transformer 的三重传播在整个序列中保持连续跟踪。为支持该任务，我们构建了一个大规模基准 Ref-MISS-Bench，涵盖 4 种成像模态以及 20 种不同器官和病灶。该基准上的实验结果

Our approach begins by synthesizing a unified, fine-grained multi-task chest X-ray visual instruction dataset across different question types for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). 62bed341a0971b0f2af34c82bd95b64ce81ef322.summary: 提出CheXPO偏好优化策略，结合置信度相似度与反事实理由，缓解胸片VLM幻觉。
key_points: 缓解医学视觉语言模型幻觉
引入反事实理由构造偏好数据
降低专家标注成本
62bed341a0971b0f2af34c82bd95b64ce81ef322.zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）容易产生幻觉，这会严重损害医学应用中的可靠性。尽管偏好优化可以通过临床反馈减轻这些幻觉，但其实施面临诸如临床无关训练样本、数据分布不平衡以及高昂的专家标注成本等挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 CheXPO，一种胸部 X 射线偏好优化（Chest X-ray Preference Optimization）策略，它将置信度-相似度联合挖掘与反事实依据（counterfactual rationale）相结合。我们的方法首先合成一个统一的、细粒度的多任务胸部 X 射线视觉指令数据集，涵盖不同问题类型，用于监督微调（SFT）。然后，我们通过对 SFT 失败的 token 级置信度分析识别困难样本，并使用基于相似度的检索来扩展困难样本，以平衡偏好样本

e922445e897fe2faf2019b14f351553034a24e27.title: MARL-MambaContour: Unleashing Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Active Contour Optimization in Medical Image Segmentation
e922445e897fe2faf2019b14f351553034a24e27.abstract: We introduce MARL-MambaContour, the first contour-based medical image segmentation framework based on Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). Our approach reframes segmentation as a multi-agent cooperation task focused on generating topologically consistent object-level contours, addressing the limitations of traditional pixel-based methods which could lack topological constraints and holistic structural awareness of anatomical regions. Each contour point is modeled as an autonomous agent that iteratively adjusts its position to align precisely with the target boundary, enabling adaptation to blurred edges and intricate morphologies common in medical images. e922445e897fe2faf2019b14f351553034a24e27.zh_title: MARL-MambaContour：多智能体强化学习优化医学图像分割轮廓
e922445e897fe2faf2019b14f351553034a24e27.summary: 提出首个基于多智能体强化学习的轮廓式医学图像分割框架，生成拓扑一致的物体级轮廓。
key_points: 将分割重构为多智能体合作任务
每个轮廓点建模为自主智能体
关注拓扑一致性与结构感知
e922445e897fe2faf2019b14f351553034a24e27.zh_abstract: 我们提出 MARL-MambaContour，这是首个基于多智能体强化学习（Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）的基于轮廓的医学图像分割框架。我们的方法将分割重新表述为一项多智能体合作任务，重点在于生成拓扑一致的对象级轮廓，从而解决传统基于像素的方法可能缺乏拓扑约束以及对解剖区域整体结构感知的局限性。每个轮廓点被建模为一个自主智能体，该智能体迭代调整其位置以精确对齐目标边界，从而能够适应医学图像中常见的模糊边缘和复杂形态。这一迭代调整过程由轮廓特定的 Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）算法优化，并进一步通过熵正则化调整机制（Entropy Regularization Adjustment Mechanism, ERAM）增强，该机制动态平衡智能体的探索与

cbe0b19cba3897249e1dbd8727bc3f034b1d7aca.title: Single Domain Generalization for Multimodal Cross-Cancer Prognosis via Dirac Rebalancer and Distribution Entanglement
cbe0b19cba3897249e1dbd8727bc3f034b1d7aca.abstract: Deep learning has shown remarkable performance in integrating multimodal data for survival prediction. However, existing multimodal methods mainly focus on single cancer types and overlook the challenge of generalization across cancers. In this work, we are the first to reveal that multimodal prognosis models often generalize worse than unimodal ones in cross-cancer scenarios, despite the critical need for such robustness in clinical practice. To address this, we propose a new task: Cross-Cancer Single Domain Generalization for Multimodal Prognosis, which evaluates whether models trained on a single cancer type can generalize to unseen cancers. We identify two key challenges: degraded features from weaker modalities and ineffective multimodal integration. To tackle these, we introduce two plug-and-play modules: Sparse Dirac Information Rebalancer (SDIR) and Cancer-aware Distribution Enta
cbe0b19cba3897249e1dbd8727bc3f034b1d7aca.zh_title: 跨癌种多模态预后单域泛化方法
cbe0b19cba3897249e1dbd8727bc3f034b1d7aca.summary: 首次揭示多模态预后模型在跨癌种场景下常劣于单模态，并提出Dirac重平衡与分布纠缠方法。
key_points: 提出跨癌种预后新任务
多模态跨癌种泛化劣于单模态
Dirac重平衡与分布纠缠
cbe0b19cba3897249e1dbd8727bc3f034b1d7aca.zh_abstract: 深度学习在整合多模态数据以进行生存预测方面已展现出显著性能。然而，现有多模态方法主要关注单一癌症类型，忽视了跨癌症泛化的挑战。在这项工作中，我们首次揭示，在跨癌症场景中，多模态预后模型往往比单模态模型泛化更差，尽管临床实践中对此类鲁棒性有迫切需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出一个新任务：多模态预后的跨癌症单域泛化（Cross-Cancer Single Domain Generalization for Multimodal Prognosis），该任务评估在单一癌症类型上训练的模型能否泛化到未见过的癌症。我们识别出两个关键挑战：来自较弱模态的特征退化，以及多模态整合无效。为解决这些问题，我们引入两个即插即用模块：稀疏 Dirac 信息重平衡器（SDIR）和癌症感知分布 Enta

bfa082edb4492d4c90b6fb64ae404f287581c9ca.title: ACM Multimedia Grand Challenge on ENT Endoscopy Analysis
bfa082edb4492d4c90b6fb64ae404f287581c9ca.abstract: Automated analysis of endoscopic imagery is a critical yet underdeveloped component of ENT (ear, nose, and throat) care, hindered by variability in devices and operators, subtle and localized findings, and fine-grained distinctions such as laterality and vocal-fold state. In addition to classification, clinicians require reliable retrieval of similar cases, both visually and through concise textual descriptions. These capabilities are rarely supported by existing public benchmarks. To this end, we introduce ENTRep, the ACM Multimedia 2025 Grand Challenge on ENT endoscopy analysis, which integrates fine-grained anatomical classification with image-to-image and text-to-image retrieval under bilingual (Vietnamese and English) clinical supervision. bfa082edb4492d4c90b6fb64ae404f287581c9ca.zh_title: ACM MM 耳鼻喉内镜分析大挑战赛
bfa082edb4492d4c90b6fb64ae404f287581c9ca.summary: MM 2025 设立耳鼻喉内镜分析大挑战，聚焦设备与操作差异、细微病灶及侧别与声带状态等细粒度分类与相似病例检索。
key_points: 耳鼻喉内镜自动分析仍不成熟
需细粒度分类与病例检索能力
现有公开基准支持不足
bfa082edb4492d4c90b6fb64ae404f287581c9ca.zh_abstract: 内窥镜图像的自动分析是耳鼻喉（ENT）诊疗中关键但欠发达的组成部分，受到设备和操作者变异性、细微且局部的发现以及诸如偏侧性和声带状态等细粒度区分的阻碍。除了分类之外，临床医生还需要可靠地检索相似病例，既包括视觉上，也包括通过简洁的文本描述。现有公开基准很少支持这些能力。为此，我们提出了 ENTRep，即 ACM Multimedia 2025 耳鼻喉内窥镜分析大挑战赛，该挑战赛在双语（越南语和英语）临床监督下，将细粒度解剖分类与图像到图像和文本到图像检索相结合。具体而言，该数据集包含专家标注的图像，标注了解剖区域和正常或异常状态，并附有 dual

9af3431405dee05b3ae4aad019682fbb9334d597.title: Self-Supervised Anatomical Consistency Learning for Vision-Grounded Medical Report Generation
9af3431405dee05b3ae4aad019682fbb9334d597.abstract: Vision-grounded medical report generation aims to produce clinically accurate descriptions of medical images, anchored in explicit visual evidence to improve interpretability and facilitate integration into clinical workflows. However, existing methods often rely on separately trained detection modules that require extensive expert annotations, introducing high labeling costs and limiting generalizability due to pathology distribution bias across datasets. To address these challenges, we propose Self-Supervised Anatomical Consistency Learning (SS-ACL)-a novel and annotation-free framework that aligns generated reports with corresponding anatomical regions using simple textual prompts. SS-ACL constructs a hierarchical anatomical graph inspired by the invariant top-down inclusion structure of human anatomy, organizing entities by spatial location. It recursively reconstructs fine-grained a
9af3431405dee05b3ae4aad019682fbb9334d597.zh_title: 自监督解剖一致性学习与视觉落地的医学报告生成
9af3431405dee05b3ae4aad019682fbb9334d597.summary: 面向视觉落地的医学报告生成，提出自监督解剖一致性学习，避免依赖需大量专家标注的独立检测模块。
key_points: 目标是生成有视觉证据支撑的临床描述
现有方法依赖单独训练的检测模块
高标注成本与跨数据集病理分布偏差
9af3431405dee05b3ae4aad019682fbb9334d597.zh_abstract: 视觉锚定的医学报告生成旨在生成医学图像的临床准确描述，并以显式视觉证据为依据，以提高可解释性并促进融入临床工作流程。然而，现有方法通常依赖单独训练的检测模块，这些模块需要大量专家标注，带来高昂的标注成本，并因数据集间的病理分布偏差而限制泛化性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出自监督解剖一致性学习（Self-Supervised Anatomical Consistency Learning，SS-ACL）——一种新颖且无需标注的框架，它使用简单文本提示将生成报告与相应解剖区域对齐。SS-ACL 构建一个分层解剖图，其灵感来自人体解剖学中不变的自上而下包含结构，并按空间位置组织实体。它递归重建细粒度的 a

4d39b4b0d3eb85ed058f6658aaff6c8b951432f3.title: Unified Medical Image Segmentation with State Space Modeling Snake
4d39b4b0d3eb85ed058f6658aaff6c8b951432f3.abstract: Unified Medical Image Segmentation (UMIS) is critical for comprehensive anatomical assessment but faces challenges due to multi-scale structural heterogeneity. Conventional pixel-based approaches, lacking object-level anatomical insight and inter-organ relational modeling, struggle with morphological complexity and feature conflicts, limiting their efficacy in UMIS. We propose Mamba Snake, a novel deep snake framework enhanced by state space modeling for UMIS. Mamba Snake frames multi-contour evolution as a hierarchical state space atlas, effectively modeling macroscopic inter-organ topological relationships and microscopic contour refinements. We introduce a snake-specific vision state space module, the Mamba Evolution Block (MEB), which leverages effective spatiotemporal information aggregation for adaptive refinement of complex morphologies. 4d39b4b0d3eb85ed058f6658aaff6c8b951432f3.zh_title: 基于状态空间建模蛇形框架的统一医学图像分割
4d39b4b0d3eb85ed058f6658aaff6c8b951432f3.summary: 提出Mamba Snake，将状态空间建模融入深度蛇形框架，以多轮廓进化方式应对统一医学图像分割中的多尺度结构异质性。
key_points: 统一医学图像分割面临多尺度异质性
像素方法缺对象级与器官间关系建模
Mamba Snake以多轮廓进化建模
4d39b4b0d3eb85ed058f6658aaff6c8b951432f3.zh_abstract: 统一医学图像分割（UMIS）对于全面的解剖评估至关重要，但由于多尺度结构异质性而面临挑战。传统的基于像素的方法缺乏对象级解剖洞察和器官间关系建模，难以应对形态复杂性和特征冲突，限制了其在 UMIS 中的有效性。我们提出 Mamba Snake，一种用于 UMIS 的、由状态空间建模增强的新型深度蛇形框架。Mamba Snake 将多轮廓演化构建为分层状态空间图集，有效建模宏观器官间拓扑关系和微观轮廓细化。我们引入一个蛇形专用的视觉状态空间模块，即 Mamba Evolution Block（MEB），该模块利用有效的时空信息聚合来自适应细化复杂形态。能量图形状先验进一步确保 rob

1bf17f84ac69c52a6390c5f832548f7550fe05bf.title: Rethinking Diffusion Bridge Model with Dual Alignments for Medical Image Synthesis
1bf17f84ac69c52a6390c5f832548f7550fe05bf.abstract: Medical image synthesis is crucial in clinical workflows, enabling the generation of missing modalities from available imaging data. While recent diffusion-based models show promise in medical image synthesis, they face two key limitations: progressive distribution drift from coarse intermediate samples and structural granularity loss due to missing high-frequency constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Dual Diffusion Bridge (DualDB), a framework integrating implicit distribution alignment and explicit structural constraints within a unified diffusion bridge paradigm. First, implicit distribution alignment employs optimal transport-guided adversarial learning to minimize statistical discrepancies between intermediate and target distributions, mitigating global distribution drift. 1bf17f84ac69c52a6390c5f832548f7550fe05bf.zh_title: 双对齐扩散桥模型用于医学图像合成
1bf17f84ac69c52a6390c5f832548f7550fe05bf.summary: 针对扩散模型在医学图像合成中的分布漂移与高频结构损失，提出DualDB框架以由现有模态生成缺失模态。
key_points: 面向缺失模态的医学图像合成
指出中间样本分布漂移问题
指出高频约束缺失导致结构损失
1bf17f84ac69c52a6390c5f832548f7550fe05bf.zh_abstract: 医学图像合成在临床工作流程中至关重要，能够从可用影像数据生成缺失模态。虽然最近的基于扩散的模型在医学图像合成中显示出前景，但它们面临两个关键局限性：来自粗糙中间样本的渐进式分布漂移，以及由于缺少高频约束导致的结构粒度损失。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Dual Diffusion Bridge（DualDB），一个在统一扩散桥范式中整合隐式分布对齐和显式结构约束的框架。首先，隐式分布对齐采用最优传输引导的对抗学习，以最小化中间分布与目标分布之间的统计差异，缓解全局分布漂移。其次，显式结构对齐应用梯度驱动约束以保留 high-frequ

02e032378bd5c7d0faf1a8c6799bdee8cfa1d617.title: TopoImages: Incorporating Local Topology Encoding into Deep Learning Models for Medical Image Classification
02e032378bd5c7d0faf1a8c6799bdee8cfa1d617.abstract: Topological structures in image data, such as connected components and loops, play a crucial role in understanding image content (e.g., biomedical objects). Despite remarkable successes of numerous image processing methods that rely on appearance information, these methods often lack sensitivity to topological structures when used in general deep learning (DL) frameworks. In this paper, we introduce a new general approach, called TopoImages (for Topology Images), which computes a new representation of input images by encoding local topology of patches. In TopoImages, we leverage persistent homology (PH) to encode geometric and topological features inherent in image patches. Our main objective is to capture topological information in local patches of an input image into a vectorized form. 02e032378bd5c7d0faf1a8c6799bdee8cfa1d617.zh_title: TopoImages：面向医学图像分类的局部拓扑编码深度学习
02e032378bd5c7d0faf1a8c6799bdee8cfa1d617.summary: MM 2025 提出 TopoImages，将局部拓扑结构编码引入深度学习模型表示，提升医学图像分类对拓扑结构的敏感性。
key_points: 深度学习模型对拓扑结构不敏感
连通分量与环等拓扑结构具重要价值

f216f418a3b8c00d49ac0733fd5f3cf26d4424a8.title: DepFormer: A Unified Framework with Bimodal Collaborative Transformer for Depression Detection
f216f418a3b8c00d49ac0733fd5f3cf26d4424a8.abstract: Depression is an increasingly prevalent mental health issue worldwide, especially among the elderly, where effective early detection is crucial for timely intervention. While recent multimodal approaches demonstrate promise in leveraging visual and auditory cues for automatic depression recognition, existing methods often fail to extract fine-grained, depression-specific patterns from pre-extracted features and underutilize cross-modal interactions. To address these challenges, we propose DepFormer, a unified framework that incorporates a Bimodal Collaborative Transformer(BCT) for cross-modal representation learning and a personalized fusion module to enhance individual-specific modeling. The architecture comprises: (1) unimodal feature extraction, (2) bimodal collaborative representation learning via the BCT, (3) personalized feature fusion, and (4) final depression classification. f216f418a3b8c00d49ac0733fd5f3cf26d4424a8.zh_title: DepFormer：双模态协同Transformer抑郁检测统一框架
f216f418a3b8c00d49ac0733fd5f3cf26d4424a8.summary: 提出DepFormer统一框架，以双模态协同Transformer提升视觉与听觉线索的抑郁检测细粒度建模与跨模态交互。
key_points: 抑郁在老年人中日益普遍，早期检测重要
现有多模态方法难提取细粒度抑郁特征
跨模态交互利用不充分
f216f418a3b8c00d49ac0733fd5f3cf26d4424a8.zh_abstract: 抑郁症是全球日益普遍的心理健康问题，尤其是在老年人中，有效的早期检测对于及时干预至关重要。虽然最近的多模态方法在利用视觉和听觉线索进行自动抑郁症识别方面显示出前景，但现有方法往往无法从预提取的特征中提取细粒度的、抑郁症特有的模式，并且未能充分利用跨模态交互。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DepFormer，一个统一的框架，它结合了用于跨模态表示学习的双模态协作Transformer（BCT）和一个个性化融合模块，以增强个体特定的建模。该架构包括：（1）单模态特征提取，（2）通过BCT进行双模态协作表示学习，（3）个性化特征融合，以及（4）最终的抑郁症分类。Crit

46281a103d2b5a5be5976742249ae4f102f72590.title: Contrastive Regularization over LoRA for Multimodal Biomedical Image Incremental Learning
46281a103d2b5a5be5976742249ae4f102f72590.abstract: Multimodal Biomedical Image Incremental Learning (MBIIL) is essential for handling diverse tasks and modalities in the biomedical domain, as training separate models for each modality or task significantly increases inference costs. Existing incremental learning methods focus on task expansion within a single modality, whereas MBIIL seeks to train a unified model incrementally across modalities. The MBIIL faces two challenges: I) How to preserve previously learned knowledge during incremental updates? II) How to effectively leverage knowledge acquired from existing modalities to support new modalities? To address these challenges, we propose MSLoRA-CR, a method that fine-tunes Modality-Specific LoRA modules while incorporating Contrastive Regularization to enhance intra-modality knowledge sharing and promote inter-modality knowledge differentiation. 46281a103d2b5a5be5976742249ae4f102f72590.zh_title: LoRA对比正则化的多模态生物医学图像增量学习
46281a103d2b5a5be5976742249ae4f102f72590.summary: 面向多模态生物医学图像增量学习，提出基于LoRA的对比正则化方法，以缓解增量中的知识遗忘。
key_points: 各模态或任务单独建模会推高推理成本
目标是在多模态间增量训练统一模型
核心挑战是增量更新时保留既有知识
46281a103d2b5a5be5976742249ae4f102f72590.zh_abstract: 多模态生物医学图像增量学习（Multimodal Biomedical Image Incremental Learning, MBIIL）对于处理生物医学领域中的多样任务和模态至关重要，因为为每种模态或任务训练单独模型会显著增加推理成本。现有增量学习方法侧重于单一模态内的任务扩展，而 MBIIL 旨在跨模态增量训练一个统一模型。MBIIL 面临两个挑战：I）如何在增量更新期间保留先前学到的知识？II）如何有效利用从现有模态获得的知识来支持新模态？为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 MSLoRA-CR，一种微调模态特定 LoRA 模块并引入对比正则化（Contrastive Regularization）的方法，以增强模态内知识共享并促进模态间知识区分。我们的方法建立在一个大型视觉（visio）

e27931b44157478a13c15d501d3d5bb0830f38df.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Medical Vision-Language Models with Mixture of Modality Experts
e27931b44157478a13c15d501d3d5bb0830f38df.abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a promising solution to improve the robustness of deep learning models under domain shifts, particularly in real-world scenarios where source data or true labels are unavailable. In this paper, we propose a novel TTA framework tailored for medical vision-language models (VLMs) that leverages a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Building upon a frozen, pre-trained BiomedCLIP backbone, our method integrates parallel MoE adapters of different medical imaging modalities in each vision MLP block, enabling expert-specific adaptation without disrupting the core model representation. At inference time, only the MoE router is optimized through an entropy-regularized objective, which is further augmented by pseudo-label guidance and adaptive scaling strategies. e27931b44157478a13c15d501d3d5bb0830f38df.zh_title: 医学视觉语言模型的测试时自适应与模态专家混合
e27931b44157478a13c15d501d3d5bb0830f38df.summary: 提出面向医学 VLM 的测试时自适应框架，基于冻结 BiomedCLIP 并集成不同医学影像模态的并行 MoE 适配器。
key_points: 测试时自适应提升域偏移鲁棒性
基于冻结 BiomedCLIP 主干

e27931b44157478a13c15d501d3d5bb0830f38df.zh_abstract: 测试时自适应（Test-time adaptation, TTA）已成为一种有前景的解决方案，用于提升深度学习模型在域偏移下的鲁棒性，尤其是在源数据或真实标签不可用的真实世界场景中。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的 TTA 框架，专为医学视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）定制，利用混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）机制。基于冻结的预训练 BiomedCLIP 主干网络，我们的方法在每个视觉 MLP 块中集成了不同医学影像模态的并行 MoE 适配器，从而能够实现专家特定的自适应，而不会破坏核心模型表示。在推理时，仅通过熵正则化目标优化 MoE 路由器，并进一步由伪标签引导和自适应缩放策略增强。此外，我们提出了一种熵感知的 MoE 缩放策略，可动态调整 expert in

b454c3ad24127994232ec4217276dfb0130332d9.title: Simple but Effective: Sub-Volume Contrastive Learning for Class-Imbalanced Semi-Supervised 3D Medical Image Segmentation
b454c3ad24127994232ec4217276dfb0130332d9.abstract: Medical image segmentation is essential for precise anatomical delineation and clinical decision-making. However, fully supervised methods are limited by the substantial cost of acquiring pixel-level annotations, particularly for 3D volumetric data. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) alleviates this challenge by leveraging unlabeled data, yet it remains hindered by severe class imbalance, where dominant structures disproportionately occupy the voxel space, leading to feature degradation and unreliable pseudo-labels. To address this issue, we propose a simple but effective SSL framework, namely Sub-Volume Contrastive Learning (SuVCL), to enhance feature discriminability in imbalanced 3D medical image segmentation. b454c3ad24127994232ec4217276dfb0130332d9.zh_title: 简单有效：子体积对比学习用于类不平衡半监督3D医学图像分割
b454c3ad24127994232ec4217276dfb0130332d9.summary: 提出子体积对比学习方法，应对类不平衡半监督3D医学图像分割中的特征退化问题。
key_points: 子体积对比学习
半监督3D医学图像分割

b454c3ad24127994232ec4217276dfb0130332d9.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割对于精确的解剖描绘和临床决策至关重要。然而，全监督方法受到获取像素级标注的高昂成本的限制，特别是对于3D体数据。半监督学习（SSL）通过利用未标注数据缓解了这一挑战，但它仍然受到严重类别不平衡的阻碍，其中主导结构不成比例地占据体素空间，导致特征退化和不可靠的伪标签。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种简单但有效的SSL框架，即子体积对比学习（SuVCL），以增强不平衡3D医学图像分割中的特征判别性。我们的方法通过子体积采样结合了局部对比学习，该采样捕获小而具有语义信息量的区域，以保留细粒度结构细节

a4130da5a60511910a0856b6b22a0e3e6bd65d0d.title: Wearable Music2Emotion : Assessing Emotions Induced by AI-Generated Music through Portable EEG-fNIRS Fusion
a4130da5a60511910a0856b6b22a0e3e6bd65d0d.abstract: Emotions critically influence mental health, driving interest in music-based affective computing via neurophysiological signals with Brain-computer Interface techniques. While prior studies leverage music's accessibility for emotion induction, three key limitations persist: (1) Stimulus Constraints : Music stimuli are confined to small corpora due to copyright and curation costs, with selection biases from heuristic emotion-music mappings that ignore individual affective profiles. (2) Modality Specificity : Overreliance on unimodal neural data (e.g., EEG) ignores complementary insights from cross-modal signal fusion. (3) Portability Limitation : Cumbersome setups (e.g., 64+ channel gel-based EEG caps) hinder real-world applicability due to procedural complexity and portability barriers. a4130da5a60511910a0856b6b22a0e3e6bd65d0d.zh_title: 可穿戴 Music2Emotion：EEG-fNIRS 融合评估 AI 生成音乐诱发的情绪

57e83333163f0e035afba42b638cff6525a4bada.title: Deep-Plant-Disease Dataset Is All You Need for Plant Disease Identification
57e83333163f0e035afba42b638cff6525a4bada.abstract: Deep learning models have emerged as a promising alternative to conventional approaches for plant disease identification, a critical challenge in agricultural production. However, the existing plant disease datasets are insufficient to address the complexities of real-world agricultural scenarios, such as multi crop disease, unseen, few-shot, and domain shift adaptation. Additionally, the lack of standardized evaluation protocols and benchmark datasets hinders the fair evaluation of models against these challenges. To bridge this gap, we introduce Deep-Plant-Disease, the largest and most diverse dataset with novel text data designed to enhance model generalization in multi crop disease identification. 21250e9f6423abdb277aa8d5a11c1a2eb6588b9e.title: Semantic-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Medical Vision-Language Contrastive Pretraining
21250e9f6423abdb277aa8d5a11c1a2eb6588b9e.abstract: Existing medical vision-language contrastive pretraining methods aim to bring the paired image-report embeddings close together while pushing the unpaired ones apart. However, medical images often exhibit high inter-class visual similarity with only subtle differences, leading to the presence of hard negative samples that are semantically distinct from the anchor but incorrectly close to it in the embedding space, making it challenging to distinguish semantically dissimilar samples. Previous methods consider only the embedding similarity between samples to identify hard negatives, often wrongly treating false negatives as hard negatives. To address this issue, we design a simple yet effective approach called Semantic-Aware Hard Negative mining (SAHN), distinguishing hard negatives from false negatives and encouraging the model to pay greater attention to hard negatives. 21250e9f6423abdb277aa8d5a11c1a2eb6588b9e.summary: 针对医学图像类间差异细微产生的难负样本问题，提出语义感知难负样本挖掘以改进对比预训练。

21250e9f6423abdb277aa8d5a11c1a2eb6588b9e.zh_abstract: 现有的医学视觉-语言对比预训练方法旨在使成对的图像-报告嵌入彼此靠近，同时将未成对的嵌入推开。然而，医学图像通常表现出较高的类间视觉相似性，仅有细微差异，导致存在难负样本（hard negative samples），这些样本在语义上与锚点不同，但在嵌入空间中却错误地靠近锚点，使得区分语义上不相似的样本变得具有挑战性。先前的方法仅考虑样本之间的嵌入相似性来识别难负样本，常常错误地将假负样本（false negatives）当作难负样本。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了一种简单而有效的方法，称为语义感知难负样本挖掘（Semantic-Aware Hard Negative mining, SAHN），将难负样本与假负样本区分开，并鼓励模型更加关注难负样本。具体来说，har

15d68b788dc1173131736169bdf9df7326f3095a.title: Discovering Maximum Frequency Consensus: Lightweight Federated Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
15d68b788dc1173131736169bdf9df7326f3095a.abstract: Multimodal federated learning (MFL) focuses on integrating distributed multimodal data from different clients to improve feature representation while preserving user privacy and has gained popularity in medical image analysis. Existing research idealizes communication efficiency and generalization ability as independent optimization objectives, leading to the failure in the trade-off between model generalization and client resource constraints. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight Federated Learning with Mid-Frequency consensus-Driven (FedMFD) method, aiming to efficiently generalize multimodal medical image segmentation tasks while reducing communication costs. 15d68b788dc1173131736169bdf9df7326f3095a.zh_title: 面向医学图像分割的最大频率共识联邦学习

01ca79e6be75f6a9355b13e632603da61ba61420.title: Counting by Points: Density-Guided Weakly-Supervised Nuclei Segmentation in Histopathological Images
01ca79e6be75f6a9355b13e632603da61ba61420.abstract: Nuclei instance segmentation in histopathological images is pivotal for cancer diagnosis, yet heavily reliant on costly pixel-level annotations. While point-supervised methods reduce annotation burdens, existing approaches struggle to reconstruct accurate nuclear boundaries and fail to leverage spatial distribution cues, particularly in dense or irregularly structured tissues. This paper presents DeNSe, a novel density-guided weakly-supervised framework that integrates nuclei counting with instance segmentation to address these limitations. 01ca79e6be75f6a9355b13e632603da61ba61420.zh_abstract: 组织病理学图像中的细胞核实例分割对癌症诊断至关重要，但其高度依赖昂贵的像素级标注。虽然点监督方法减少了标注负担，但现有方法难以重建准确的细胞核边界，并且未能利用空间分布线索，尤其是在密集或结构不规则的组织中。本文提出了 DeNSe，一种新颖的密度引导弱监督框架，它将细胞核计数与实例分割相结合，以应对这些局限。与传统方法不同，DeNSe 引入了多任务学习架构，通过两项关键创新将密度回归与分割结合起来：(1) 一个基于最优传输理论的分布感知对齐模块，该模块协调密度图与分割掩码之间的特征表示，以增强实例区分

e5da2a27d395e667d943e1dfa0469ba3a744eec8.title: Efficient Multi-Slide Visual-Language Feature Fusion for Placental Disease Classification
e5da2a27d395e667d943e1dfa0469ba3a744eec8.abstract: Accurate prediction of placental diseases via whole slide images (WSIs) is critical for preventing severe maternal and fetal complications. However, WSI analysis presents significant computational challenges due to the massive data volume. Existing WSI classification methods encounter critical limitations: (1) inadequate patch selection strategies that either compromise performance or fail to sufficiently reduce computational demands, and (2) the loss of global histological context resulting from patch-level processing approaches. To address these challenges, we propose an Efficient multimodal framework for Patient-level placental disease Diagnosis, named EmmPD. Our approach introduces a two-stage patch selection module that combines parameter-free and learnable compression strategies, optimally balancing computational efficiency with critical feature preservation. e5da2a27d395e667d943e1dfa0469ba3a744eec8.zh_title: 高效多切片视觉-语言融合用于胎盘疾病分类
e5da2a27d395e667d943e1dfa0469ba3a744eec8.summary: 面向全切片图像提出高效多切片视觉-语言特征融合方法，用于胎盘疾病分类。
key_points: WSI数据量大带来计算挑战

e5da2a27d395e667d943e1dfa0469ba3a744eec8.zh_abstract: 通过全切片图像（WSIs）准确预测胎盘疾病对于预防严重的母体和胎儿并发症至关重要。然而，由于数据量庞大，WSI 分析带来了显著的计算挑战。现有的 WSI 分类方法面临关键局限性：（1）不充分的图像块选择策略，要么损害性能，要么未能充分降低计算需求；（2）由图像块级处理方法导致的全局组织学背景丢失。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于患者级胎盘疾病诊断的高效多模态框架，名为 EmmPD。我们的方法引入了一个两阶段图像块选择模块，该模块结合无参数和可学习的压缩策略，在计算效率与关键特征保留之间实现最佳平衡。此外，我们开发

d1014a937d96d694b5e4f81be1982d88058eba5f.title: Cross-Counter-Repeat Attention for Enhanced Understanding of Visual Semantics in Radiology Report Generation
d1014a937d96d694b5e4f81be1982d88058eba5f.abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG), intended to automatically generate a coherent free-text report describing the clinical observations of a radiograph, has been attracting increasing attention from researchers. In recent years, the Transformer-based encoder-decoder architecture has been adopted by most existing methods. However, they neglect the structural rationality issue when applying this single-modal architecture to the multi-modal RRG task, where information can only flow from visual features to textual features, but not in the opposite direction. This information asymmetry results in visual features having no knowledge of the textual features, sending out all visual information, including a large amount of heterogeneous noise. c7fc9447e82de552bb621e0bec75d38def85f49e.title: REMEMBER: Retrieval-based Explainable Multimodal Evidence-guided Modeling for Brain Evaluation and Reasoning in Zero- and Few-shot Neurodegenerative Diagnosis
c7fc9447e82de552bb621e0bec75d38def85f49e.abstract: Timely and accurate diagnosis of neurodegenerative disorders, such as Alzheimer's disease, is central to disease management. Existing deep learning models require large annotated datasets and often act as ''black boxes''. However, clinical datasets are frequently small or lack labels, limiting the effectiveness of these methods. Here, we introduce REMEMBER - Retrieval-based Explainable Multimodal Evidence-guided Modeling for Brain Evaluation and Reasoning - a machine learning framework that enables zero- and few-shot Alzheimer's diagnosis from brain MRI scans via reference-based reasoning. Specifically, REMEMBER first contrastively trains a vision-text model on expert-annotated reference data, using pseudo-text modalities to encode abnormality types, diagnosis labels, and composite clinical descriptions. c7fc9447e82de552bb621e0bec75d38def85f49e.zh_title: REMEMBER：可解释多模态检索框架用于神经退行诊断
c7fc9447e82de552bb621e0bec75d38def85f49e.summary: 提出基于检索的可解释多模态证据引导框架REMEMBER，用于零样本与少样本神经退行性疾病诊断。

a7c3e4ffb2fb2dc053aa1e808fc4198d1d169824.title: MUDI: A Multimodal Biomedical Dataset for Understanding Pharmacodynamic Drug-Drug Interactions
a7c3e4ffb2fb2dc053aa1e808fc4198d1d169824.abstract: Understanding the interaction between different drugs (drug-drug interaction or DDI) is critical for ensuring patient safety and optimizing therapeutic outcomes. Existing DDI datasets primarily focus on textual information, overlooking multimodal data that reflect complex drug mechanisms. In this paper, we (1) introduce MUDI, a large-scale Multimodal biomedical dataset for Understanding pharmacodynamic Drug-drug Interactions, and (2) benchmark learning methods to study it. In brief, MUDI provides a comprehensive multimodal representation of drugs by combining pharmacological text, chemical formulas, molecular structure graphs, and images across 310,532 annotated drug pairs labeled as Synergism, Antagonism, or New Effect. a7c3e4ffb2fb2dc053aa1e808fc4198d1d169824.zh_title: MUDI：药效学药物相互作用多模态数据集
a7c3e4ffb2fb2dc053aa1e808fc4198d1d169824.summary: 发布大规模多模态生物医学数据集MUDI用于理解药效学药物相互作用，并建立学习基准。
key_points: 现有DDI数据集以文本信息为主
MUDI提供多模态数据反映药物机制
对多种学习方法进行基准评测
a7c3e4ffb2fb2dc053aa1e808fc4198d1d169824.zh_abstract: 理解不同药物之间的相互作用（药物-药物相互作用或DDI）对于确保患者安全和优化治疗结果至关重要。现有的DDI数据集主要关注文本信息，忽视了反映复杂药物机制的多模态数据。在本文中，我们（1）介绍了MUDI，一个用于理解药效学药物-药物相互作用的大规模多模态生物医学数据集，并（2）对学习方法进行基准测试以研究它。简而言之，MUDI通过结合药理学文本、化学式、分子结构图和图像，对310,532个标注为协同作用、拮抗作用或新效应的药物对进行了全面的多模态表示。关键的是，为了有效评估基于机器学习的泛化能力，MUDI在测试集中包含了未见过的药物对。我们使用lat评估基准模型

85efa512318ca9da12b9fcaa473c5da589fde677.title: Reading Between the Channels: Knowledge-Augmented Medical Time Series Classification
85efa512318ca9da12b9fcaa473c5da589fde677.abstract: Medical time series, such as Electroencephalogram (EEG) and Electrocardiogram (ECG), are widely used for disease detection, with multiple electrodes or sensors recording simultaneously. Accurately modeling inter-channel relationships is crucial for improving detection performance. Current methods mainly rely on data-driven approaches to model channel relationships, facing two challenges: (1) insufficient integration of medical prior knowledge, hindering the accurate representation of physiological correlations between channels, and (2) high temporal pattern similarity across channels, leading to feature redundancy and degraded classification performance. To address these issues, we introduce KEMed, a knowledge-augmented model for medical time series classification. 85efa512318ca9da12b9fcaa473c5da589fde677.zh_title: 通道间知识增强的医学时间序列分类
85efa512318ca9da12b9fcaa473c5da589fde677.summary: 提出知识增强方法建模EEG/ECG等多通道关系，以提升疾病检测性能。
key_points: 医学时间序列含EEG与ECG
多电极同步记录用于疾病检测
现有方法缺乏医学先验知识整合
85efa512318ca9da12b9fcaa473c5da589fde677.zh_abstract: 医学时间序列，例如脑电图（EEG）和心电图（ECG），被广泛用于疾病检测，多个电极或传感器同时进行记录。准确建模通道间关系对于提高检测性能至关重要。当前方法主要依赖数据驱动方法来建模通道关系，面临两个挑战：（1）医学先验知识整合不足，阻碍了对通道间生理相关性的准确表示；（2）通道间时间模式高度相似，导致特征冗余和分类性能下降。为解决这些问题，我们提出了 KEMed，一种用于医学时间序列分类的知识增强模型。该模型通过为每个通道生成自然语言描述并 leve

70720e80305f68389aa8c2279effb5ac777b41f5.title: DyNAS-DDI: Dynamic Pairwise Architecture Search for Generalizable Drug-Drug Interaction LLM
70720e80305f68389aa8c2279effb5ac777b41f5.abstract: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is a pivotal task in biomedical research. Emerging multimodal approaches that integrate graph neural networks (GNNs) and large language models (LLMs) have gained traction, as GNNs capture molecular structures while LLMs provide a rich biomedical context. However, real-world DDI data often exhibit distribution shifts across structural and textual dimensions, stemming from variations in molecular scaffolds, drug sizes, and assay conditions. Existing methods assume an independent and identically distributed (I.I.D.) setting, failing to handle such shifts primarily due to there key limitations: (i) the entanglement of core interaction motifs with incidental structural features; (ii) inflexible message-passing GNN architectures ill-suited for diverse drug pairs; and (iii) underutilized biomedical knowledge in LLMs for capturing pairwise interaction seman
70720e80305f68389aa8c2279effb5ac777b41f5.zh_title: DyNAS-DDI：面向可泛化药物相互作用LLM的动态成对架构搜索
70720e80305f68389aa8c2279effb5ac777b41f5.summary: 该研究提出DyNAS-DDI，以动态成对架构搜索提升药物相互作用LLM泛化能力。
key_points: 药物相互作用预测是生物医学重要任务
现有方法融合图神经网络与大型语言模型
真实DDI数据存在结构与文本维度分布偏移
70720e80305f68389aa8c2279effb5ac777b41f5.zh_abstract: 药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测是生物医学研究中的一项关键任务。整合图神经网络（GNN）与大语言模型（LLM）的新兴多模态方法已受到关注，因为 GNN 捕获分子结构，而 LLM 提供丰富的生物医学上下文。然而，真实世界的 DDI 数据常在结构维度和文本维度上表现出分布偏移，这源于分子骨架、药物大小和测定条件的变化。现有方法假设独立同分布（I.I.D.）设定，未能处理此类偏移，主要由于以下关键局限：(i) 核心相互作用基序与偶然结构特征纠缠在一起；(ii) 不灵活的消息传递 GNN 架构不适合多样化的药物对；(iii) LLM 中用于捕获成对相互作用语义（seman）的生物医学知识未得到充分利用

6ca69a3c013587ef4ee3216e986f8df6db5ecc8c.title: Tyee: A Unified, Modular, and Fully-Integrated Configurable Toolkit for Intelligent Physiological Health Care
6ca69a3c013587ef4ee3216e986f8df6db5ecc8c.abstract: Deep learning has shown great promise in physiological signal analysis, yet its progress is hindered by heterogeneous data formats, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, fragmented model pipelines, and non-reproducible experimental setups. To address these limitations, we present Tyee, a unified, modular, and fully-integrated configurable toolkit designed for intelligent physiological healthcare. Tyee introduces three key innovations: (1) a unified data interface and configurable preprocessing pipeline for 12 kinds of signal modalities; (2) a modular and extensible architecture enabling flexible integration and rapid prototyping across tasks; and (3) end-to-end workflow configuration, promoting reproducible and scalable experimentation. 6ca69a3c013587ef4ee3216e986f8df6db5ecc8c.zh_title: Tyee：面向智能生理健康的统一模块化工具包
6ca69a3c013587ef4ee3216e986f8df6db5ecc8c.summary: 针对数据格式异构、预处理不一致与流程碎片化，作者提出统一、模块化、可配置的生理健康深度学习工具包Tyee。
key_points: 生理信号深度学习受异构数据与流程碎片化制约

6ca69a3c013587ef4ee3216e986f8df6db5ecc8c.zh_abstract: 深度学习在生理信号分析中展现出巨大前景，但其进展受到异构数据格式、不一致的预处理策略、碎片化的模型流程以及不可复现的实验设置的阻碍。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了 Tyee，一个统一、模块化且完全集成的可配置工具包，专为智能生理健康医疗而设计。Tyee 引入了三项关键创新：(1) 适用于 12 种信号模态的统一数据接口和可配置预处理流程；(2) 模块化且可扩展的架构，支持跨任务的灵活集成和快速原型设计；(3) 端到端工作流配置，促进可复现和可扩展的实验。Tyee 展现出一致的实际有效性和泛化能力，在所有评估任务中优于或匹配基线（在 state-of

302e14f296ae14ae2d791faf52ced77e9d68908f.title: MoTAS: MoE-Guided Feature Selection from TTS-Augmented Speech for Enhanced Multimodal Alzheimer's Early Screening
302e14f296ae14ae2d791faf52ced77e9d68908f.abstract: Early screening for Alzheimer's Disease (AD) through speech presents a promising non-invasive approach. However, challenges such as limited data and the lack of fine-grained, adaptive feature selection often hinder performance. To address these issues, we propose MoTAS, a robust framework designed to enhance AD screening efficiency. MoTAS leverages Text-to-Speech (TTS) augmentation to increase data volume and employs a Mixture of Experts (MoE) mechanism to improve multimodal feature selection, jointly enhancing model generalization. The process begins with automatic speech recognition (ASR) to obtain accurate transcriptions. TTS is then used to synthesize speech that enriches the dataset. After extracting acoustic and text embeddings, the MoE mechanism dynamically selects the most informative features, optimizing feature fusion for improved classification. 302e14f296ae14ae2d791faf52ced77e9d68908f.zh_title: MoTAS：TTS增强语音与MoE特征选择的阿尔茨海默筛查
302e14f296ae14ae2d791faf52ced77e9d68908f.summary: MM 2025 提出 MoTAS，利用文本转语音扩充数据并以专家混合机制进行多模态特征选择，提升阿尔茨海默病语音早期筛查。
key_points: 语音用于AD非侵入式早期筛查
TTS增强缓解数据有限问题
MoE实现自适应多模态特征选择
302e14f296ae14ae2d791faf52ced77e9d68908f.zh_abstract: 通过语音对阿尔茨海默病（AD）进行早期筛查是一种有前景的非侵入性方法。然而，数据有限以及缺乏细粒度、自适应的特征选择等挑战常常阻碍性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 MoTAS，一个旨在提高 AD 筛查效率的稳健框架。MoTAS 利用文本转语音（TTS）增强来增加数据量，并采用混合专家（MoE）机制来改进多模态特征选择，共同增强模型泛化能力。该过程从自动语音识别（ASR）开始，以获得准确的转录。然后使用 TTS 合成语音来丰富数据集。在提取声学和文本嵌入后，MoE 机制动态选择信息量最大的特征，优化特征融合以改进分类。在 ADReSSo 数据集上评估

e76720fc3cfe2538bfd01e22c61ee3e25bca5749.title: SpineBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Spinal Pathology Analysis
e76720fc3cfe2538bfd01e22c61ee3e25bca5749.abstract: With the increasing integration of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into the medical field, comprehensive evaluation of their performance in various medical domains becomes critical. However, existing benchmarks primarily assess general medical tasks, inadequately capturing performance in nuanced areas like the spine, which relies heavily on visual input. To address this, we introduce SpineBench, a comprehensive Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmark designed for fine-grained analysis and evaluation of MLLMs in the spinal domain. SpineBench comprises 64,878 QA pairs from 40,263 spine images, covering 11 spinal diseases through two critical clinical tasks: spinal disease diagnosis and spinal lesion localization, both in multiple-choice format. e76720fc3cfe2538bfd01e22c61ee3e25bca5749.zh_title: SpineBench：脊柱病理分析多模态大模型基准
e76720fc3cfe2538bfd01e22c61ee3e25bca5749.summary: 提出SpineBench视觉问答基准，用于细粒度评测多模态大模型在脊柱病理分析中的表现。
key_points: 聚焦依赖视觉输入的脊柱领域
以视觉问答形式构建基准
弥补现有基准细分领域不足
e76720fc3cfe2538bfd01e22c61ee3e25bca5749.zh_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）日益融入医学领域，全面评估其在各种医学领域中的性能变得至关重要。然而，现有基准主要评估一般医学任务，未能充分捕捉诸如脊柱这类高度依赖视觉输入的细微领域的性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SpineBench，一个全面的视觉问答（Visual Question Answering, VQA）基准，旨在对脊柱领域的 MLLMs 进行细粒度分析和评估。SpineBench 包含来自 40,263 幅脊柱图像的 64,878 个问答对，通过两项关键临床任务覆盖 11 种脊柱疾病：脊柱疾病诊断和脊柱病灶定位，二者均采用多项选择格式。SpineBench 通过整合并标准化来自开源脊柱疾病数据集的图像-标签对构建，并采样具有挑战性的

e36428e3651eedff76c1c06784654ef6885ba503.title: SP-Mamba: Spatial-Perception State Space Model for Unsupervised Medical Anomaly Detection
e36428e3651eedff76c1c06784654ef6885ba503.abstract: Radiography imaging protocols target on specific anatomical regions, resulting in highly consistent images with recurrent structural patterns across patients. Recent advances in medical anomaly detection have demonstrated the effectiveness of CNN- and transformer-based approaches. However, CNNs exhibit limitations in capturing long-range dependencies, while transformers suffer from quadratic computational complexity. In contrast, Mamba-based models, leveraging superior long-range modeling, structural feature extraction, and linear computational efficiency, have emerged as a promising alternative. To capitalize on the inherent structural regularity of medical images, this study introduces SP-Mamba, a spatial-perception Mamba framework for unsupervised medical anomaly detection. The window-sliding prototype learning and Circular-Hilbert scanning-based Mamba are introduced to better exploit
e36428e3651eedff76c1c06784654ef6885ba503.zh_title: SP-Mamba：无监督医学异常检测空间感知模型
e36428e3651eedff76c1c06784654ef6885ba503.summary: 基于Mamba的状态空间模型，利用空间感知实现无监督医学异常检测，兼顾长程建模与计算效率。
key_points: 面向放射影像无监督异常检测
结合Mamba长程建模优势
克服CNN与Transformer局限
e36428e3651eedff76c1c06784654ef6885ba503.zh_abstract: 放射成像协议针对特定的解剖区域，导致图像高度一致，患者之间具有重复的结构模式。医学异常检测的最新进展已证明了基于 CNN 和 transformer 的方法的有效性。然而，CNN 在捕获长程依赖关系方面存在局限，而 transformer 则受到二次计算复杂度的困扰。相比之下，基于 Mamba 的模型利用优越的长程建模、结构特征提取和线性计算效率，已成为一种有前景的替代方案。为了利用医学图像固有的结构规律性，本研究引入了 SP-Mamba，一个用于无监督医学异常检测的空间感知 Mamba 框架。引入了窗口滑动原型学习和基于 Circular-Hilbert 扫描的 Mamba，以更好地利用

d515f6385bf8b887b64ca738089d858e086866cf.title: CrosST: Cross Swin 4D Transformer for Multi-Modal Alzheimer's Detection
d515f6385bf8b887b64ca738089d858e086866cf.abstract: The task of spatiotemporal dynamic modeling of multi-modal high-dimensional neuroimaging data presents a significant challenge in the field of neuroscience. Recent works often integrate attention mechanisms for hierarchical modeling, but the gradual extraction of spatiotemporal features leads to feature isolation. Moreover, attention-based fusion mechanisms (such as cross attention) tend to focus on learning the self-similarity between different modalities, lacking sufficient exploration of the complementary information across modalities. To address these challenges, we propose the cross swin 4D transformer (CrosST), which can efficiently learn the spatiotemporal patterns of multi-modal high-dimensional neuroimaging data in an end-to-end manner. d515f6385bf8b887b64ca738089d858e086866cf.zh_title: CrosST：跨Swin 4D Transformer多模态阿尔茨海默检测
d515f6385bf8b887b64ca738089d858e086866cf.summary: 提出CrosST，用跨Swin 4D Transformer建模多模态神经影像时空动态以检测阿尔茨海默病。
key_points: 多模态高维神经影像时空建模是难点
现有方法存在时空特征孤立问题
交叉注意力融合偏重模态间自相似性
d515f6385bf8b887b64ca738089d858e086866cf.zh_abstract: 多模态高维神经影像数据的时空动态建模任务在神经科学领域提出了重大挑战。近期工作常整合注意力机制进行分层建模，但时空特征的逐步提取导致特征孤立。此外，基于注意力的融合机制（如交叉注意力）往往侧重于学习不同模态之间的自相似性，缺乏对跨模态互补信息的充分探索。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 cross swin 4D transformer（CrosST），其能够以端到端方式高效学习多模态高维神经影像数据的时空模式。CrosST 独特的扩散交叉注意力融合机制通过扩散策略连接来自不同模态的特征，在

c546c00387fb8039c04ea45b7effdf9d4c566296.title: RadLAS: A Foundation Model for Interpretable Radiography Image Analysis with Lesion-Aware Self-Supervised Pre-training
c546c00387fb8039c04ea45b7effdf9d4c566296.abstract: Medical Foundation Models (MFMs) are revolutionizing radiography image analysis with scalable and generalized diagnostic capabilities. However, their effectiveness in real-world clinical practice is limited due to insufficient interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose RadLAS, a novel MFM for interpretable Radiographic image analysis by introducing Lesion-Aware Self-supervised pre-training. Unlike conventional MFMs that rely on post-hoc explanations, RadLAS innovates by directly emulating human diagnostic reasoning to first grounding lesion evidence and then making decisions accordingly. c546c00387fb8039c04ea45b7effdf9d4c566296.zh_title: RadLAS：可解释放射影像分析基础模型
c546c00387fb8039c04ea45b7effdf9d4c566296.summary: MM 2025提出RadLAS，以病灶感知自监督预训练提升放射影像分析的临床可解释性。
key_points: 引入病灶感知自监督预训练
面向放射影像的基础模型

c546c00387fb8039c04ea45b7effdf9d4c566296.zh_abstract: 医学基础模型（MFMs）正以其可扩展和泛化的诊断能力彻底改变放射摄影图像分析。然而，由于可解释性不足，它们在真实临床实践中的有效性受到限制。为解决这一限制，我们提出 RadLAS，一种用于可解释放射摄影图像分析的新型 MFM，其引入病灶感知自监督预训练。与依赖事后解释的传统 MFM 不同，RadLAS 的创新之处在于直接模拟人类诊断推理，先定位病灶证据，再据此作出决策。具体而言，RadLAS 引入两个自监督任务：（I）病灶定位重建，其通过将病灶感知图像块恢复为其健康对应物来学习结构化解剖表征，从而经由输入-促进病灶证据的像素级定位。

ba74f58afd262ce427db730da9e88df41eac1033.title: OmniDoctor: Towards LLM-centric Lifelong Learning for New Emerging Medical VQA Tasks
ba74f58afd262ce427db730da9e88df41eac1033.abstract: Current medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated high accuracy and effectiveness on specific medical visual question answering (Medical VQA) tasks. However, they largely fail to tackle continuously emerging unseen Medical VQA scenarios (e.g., MRI, X-ray) in real-world settings, which significantly hinders their broader adoption in practical clinical environments. Motivated by these gaps, this paper introduces a new task, namely LLM-centric Lifelong Learning for New Medical VQA (L3NMV), which enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to continually learn medical image-text knowledge across various medical VQA tasks. ba74f58afd262ce427db730da9e88df41eac1033.zh_title: OmniDoctor：面向新兴医学 VQA 任务的终身学习
ba74f58afd262ce427db730da9e88df41eac1033.summary: 提出以 LLM 为中心的终身学习任务，使医学多模态大模型应对持续出现的新 VQA 场景。
key_points: 指出现有模型难以应对未见任务
提出 LLM 中心终身学习新任务
覆盖 MRI、X 光等新兴场景
ba74f58afd262ce427db730da9e88df41eac1033.zh_abstract: 当前的医学多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）已在特定的医学视觉问答（Medical VQA）任务上表现出高准确性和有效性。然而，它们在很大程度上无法应对真实世界环境中不断出现的未见医学 VQA 场景（例如 MRI、X 射线），这显著阻碍了其在实际临床环境中的更广泛采用。受这些差距的启发，本文引入一个新任务，即以 LLM 为中心的面向新医学 VQA 的终身学习（LLM-centric Lifelong Learning for New Medical VQA, L3NMV），其使大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）能够在各种医学 VQA 任务中持续学习医学图像-文本知识。此外，本文揭示了两个关键挑战：1）高效的医学知识保留（Each-task），旨在用有限数据高效保留每个医学 VQA 任务的关键知识。2）高效的医学干扰缓解（C

a81c295f143d98e547218c44db822a99306ba9a2.title: Enhancing Multi-task Learning Capability of Medical Generalist Foundation Model via Image-centric Multi-annotation Data
a81c295f143d98e547218c44db822a99306ba9a2.abstract: The emergence of medical generalist foundation models has revolutionized conventional task-specific model development paradigms, aiming to better handle multiple tasks through joint training on large-scale medical datasets. However, recent advances prioritize simple data scaling or architectural component enhancement, while neglecting to re-examine multi-task learning from a data-centric perspective. Critically, simply aggregating existing data resources leads to decentralized image-task alignment, which fails to cultivate comprehensive image understanding or align with clinical needs for multi-dimensional image interpretation. a36e165b64e2b374584efdc225859d4bec4ef7a8.title: Interpreting Radiologist's Intention from Eye Movements in Chest X-ray Diagnosis
a36e165b64e2b374584efdc225859d4bec4ef7a8.abstract: Radiologists rely on eye movements to navigate and interpret medical images. A trained radiologist possesses knowledge about the potential diseases that may be present in the images and, when searching, follows a mental checklist to locate them using their gaze. This is a key observation, yet existing models fail to capture the underlying intent behind each fixation. In this paper, we introduce a deep learning-based approach, RadGazeIntent, designed to model this behavior: having an intention to find something and actively searching for it. Our transformer-based architecture processes both the temporal and spatial dimensions of gaze data, transforming fine-grained fixation features into coarse, meaningful representations of diagnostic intent to interpret radiologists' goals. a36e165b64e2b374584efdc225859d4bec4ef7a8.zh_title: 从胸片诊断中的眼动解读放射科医生的意图

9815015a2e664f75e7c7be8c60ae9d5e011f503c.abstract: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical decision-making, treatment planning, and disease tracking. Nonetheless, it confronts two significant challenges: the presence of ''soft boundaries'' between the foreground and background exacerbated by poor illumination and low contrast, and the misleading co-occurrence of salient and non-salient objects during the training phase, which complicates the model's accuracy in distinguishing relevant features. To overcome these challenges, we introduce RoDeCon-Net, a novel framework engineered to enhance medical image segmentation. 9815015a2e664f75e7c7be8c60ae9d5e011f503c.zh_title: Rodecon-net：鲁棒解耦与对比增强融合的医学图像分割

8e6614d78b9c3cad1635a387d3acccb9ff5e15be.title: BrainSegDMIF: A Dynamic Fusion-enhanced SAM for Brain Lesion Segmentation
8e6614d78b9c3cad1635a387d3acccb9ff5e15be.abstract: The segmentation of substantial brain lesions is a significant and challenging task in the field of medical image segmentation. Substantial brain lesions in brain imaging exhibit high heterogeneity, with indistinct boundaries between lesion regions and normal brain tissue. Small lesions in single slices are difficult to identify, making the accurate and reproducible segmentation of abnormal regions, as well as their feature description, highly complex. Existing methods have the following limitations: 1) They rely solely on single-modal information for learning, neglecting the multi-modal information commonly used in diagnosis. 8e6614d78b9c3cad1635a387d3acccb9ff5e15be.zh_title: BrainSegDMIF：动态融合增强SAM的脑病灶分割

8724fec834a167457e414ed84f703b5c3598a361.title: LooBox: Loose-box-supervised 3D Tumor Segmentation with Self-correcting Bidirectional Learning
8724fec834a167457e414ed84f703b5c3598a361.abstract: Deep learning-based tumor segmentation methods typically require precise pixel-level annotations, which are costly in clinical practice. While bounding box supervision offers a more efficient alternative, existing approaches assume unrealistically tight box annotations, leading to performance degradation when applied to the loose boxes commonly produced by medical annotators. To address this challenge, we propose LooBox, a novel 3D segmentation framework that utilizes loose box annotations through a self-correction and bidirectional rectification paradigm. For the self-correction part, we propose a noise cleaner that comprehensively utilizes deterministic outer box information by integrating three complementary perspectives for predictive self-rectification: entropy mapping, gradient monitoring, and foreground-background affinity measurement. 8724fec834a167457e414ed84f703b5c3598a361.zh_title: LooBox：松边界框监督的3D肿瘤分割

78d3cae49ccf413ed11d4f63b4c2a823447c63a0.title: MeDKCoOp: Dual Knowledge-guided Graph Prompt Learning for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
78d3cae49ccf413ed11d4f63b4c2a823447c63a0.abstract: The rapid evolution of vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, has demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities in downstream tasks. Prompt learning paradigms like Context Optimization (CoOp) refine learnable prompts for efficient adaptation. However, their application in the biomedical domain remains limited due to the insufficient utilization of specialized biomedical knowledge and cross-modality structural relationships. 78d3cae49ccf413ed11d4f63b4c2a823447c63a0.zh_title: MeDKCoOp：面向生物医学视觉语言模型的双知识图提示学习

6c279109143354d495e78f14c8e5fe6c6f9df69f.title: Joint Holistic and Lesion Controllable Mammogram Synthesis via Gated Conditional Diffusion Model
6c279109143354d495e78f14c8e5fe6c6f9df69f.abstract: Mammography is the most commonly used imaging modality for breast cancer screening, driving an increasing demand for deep-learning techniques to support large-scale analysis. However, the development of accurate and robust methods is often limited by insufficient data availability and a lack of diversity in lesion characteristics. While generative models offer a promising solution for data synthesis, current approaches often fail to adequately emphasize lesion-specific features and their relationships with surrounding tissues. In this paper, we propose Gated Conditional Diffusion Model (GCDM), a novel framework designed to jointly synthesize holistic mammogram images and localized lesions. 5ee13fbbb83f053d7328cdeac3cd518b5008ccc1.title: Enhancing Endoscopic Image Retrieval via Self-Supervised Learning and Large VLM-Based Re-ranking
5ee13fbbb83f053d7328cdeac3cd518b5008ccc1.abstract: Medical image retrieval is essential for clinical diagnosis and medical education, yet remains highly challenging in endoscopic imaging due to limited annotated data, the lack of domain-specific pretrained models, and subtle visual similarities across anatomical regions. In this work, we utilize self-supervised contrastive learning to pretrain a strong image encoder tailored for endoscopic data, which serves as the backbone for downstream retrieval tasks. 5768ae8364765bb36ef021d0ca7683e44e27e741.title: EIR-SDG: Explore Invariant Representation for Single-source Domain Generalization in Medical Image Segmentation
5768ae8364765bb36ef021d0ca7683e44e27e741.abstract: Single-source domain generalization (SDG) in medical image segmentation is a challenging yet practical task that efficiently enhances generalization ability while avoiding high annotation costs and privacy concerns. In this paper, we propose EIR-SDG, a novel SDG approach that explores domain-invariant representation for medical image segmentation. The core of EIR-SDG lies in mitigating the effect of style in the encoder while facilitating robust segmentation in the decoder. Concretely, we design a training-free texture and style diversity module that transforms images into diverse random appearances without requiring optimization or gradient updates, which simulates unseen target distributions while mitigating overfitting to regular patterns in synthetic data. 5768ae8364765bb36ef021d0ca7683e44e27e741.zh_title: EIR-SDG：医学图像分割单源域泛化
5768ae8364765bb36ef021d0ca7683e44e27e741.summary: 提出EIR-SDG方法，通过探索域不变表示提升医学图像分割的单源域泛化能力。

5768ae8364765bb36ef021d0ca7683e44e27e741.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割中的单源域泛化（single-source domain generalization, SDG）是一项具有挑战性但实用的任务，它能在避免高标注成本和隐私问题的同时有效增强泛化能力。在本文中，我们提出 EIR-SDG，一种新颖的 SDG 方法，探索用于医学图像分割的域不变表示。EIR-SDG 的核心在于减轻编码器中风格的影响，同时在解码器中促进稳健分割。具体而言，我们设计了一个无需训练的纹理和风格多样性模块，该模块将图像转换为多样的随机外观，无需优化或梯度更新，从而模拟未见目标分布，同时减轻对合成数据中规律模式的过拟合。在此基础上，我们设计了一个特征自适应白化模块，它解耦并白化风格敏感的特征相关性

30aa869ace86e3cb060aeb64b65ee44421021b6d.title: PRIME: Prototype-Driven Class Incremental Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
30aa869ace86e3cb060aeb64b65ee44421021b6d.abstract: Class incremental medical segmentation (CIMS) aims to sequentially learn new classes while preserving knowledge of previously learned categories in the absence of old-class labels. Current methods suffer from performance degradation under class imbalance and require additional segmentation heads to accommodate new categories. Inspired by recent prototype learning that leverages prototypes to achieve robust recognition of new categories under limited-data regimes, we introduce a Prototype-dRIven class increMEntal (PRIME) method. PRIME replaces the incremental segmentation heads with prototypes to mitigate class imbalance, allowing new class learning with the simple addition of new prototypes. 30aa869ace86e3cb060aeb64b65ee44421021b6d.zh_title: PRIME：原型驱动的医学图像分割类增量学习
30aa869ace86e3cb060aeb64b65ee44421021b6d.summary: 论文提出原型驱动的类增量学习方法PRIME，用于在无旧类标签条件下顺序学习新类别并缓解类别不平衡导致的性能下降。

1a52b27b93b0e79b37ed06cceae72711a9e8669c.title: MORE: Multi-Organ Medical Image REconstruction Dataset
1a52b27b93b0e79b37ed06cceae72711a9e8669c.abstract: CT reconstruction provides radiologists with images for diagnosis and treatment, yet current deep learning methods are typically limited to specific anatomies and datasets, hindering generalization ability to unseen anatomies and lesions. To address this, we introduce the Multi-Organ medical image REconstruction (MORE) dataset, comprising CT scans across 9 diverse anatomies with 15 lesion types. This dataset serves two key purposes: (1) enabling robust training of deep learning models on extensive, heterogeneous data, and (2) facilitating rigorous evaluation of model generalization for CT reconstruction. We further establish a strong baseline solution that outperforms prior approaches under these challenging conditions. Our results demonstrate that: (1) a comprehensive dataset helps improve the generalization capability of models, and (2) optimization-based methods offer enhanced robustn
1a52b27b93b0e79b37ed06cceae72711a9e8669c.zh_title: MORE：多器官医学图像重建数据集
1a52b27b93b0e79b37ed06cceae72711a9e8669c.summary: 构建覆盖9种解剖结构与15种病变类型的CT重建数据集，用于提升跨解剖泛化能力。
key_points: 涵盖9种解剖部位CT扫描
包含15种病变类型
针对跨解剖与病变泛化受限
1a52b27b93b0e79b37ed06cceae72711a9e8669c.zh_abstract: CT 重建为放射科医生提供用于诊断和治疗的图像，然而当前的深度学习方法通常局限于特定解剖结构和数据集，阻碍了对未见解剖结构和病变的泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们引入了多器官医学图像重建（Multi-Organ medical image REconstruction, MORE）数据集，包含跨 9 种不同解剖结构的 CT 扫描以及 15 种病变类型。该数据集有两个关键用途：（1）使深度学习模型能够在广泛、异构的数据上进行稳健训练，（2）促进对 CT 重建模型泛化能力的严格评估。我们进一步建立了一个强基线解决方案，在这些具有挑战性的条件下优于先前方法。我们的结果表明：（1）全面的数据集有助于提高模型的泛化能力，（2）基于优化的方法提供增强的鲁棒性

0a8d605010bc5a0531caa058894ab8963a991d2d.title: Real-Time EEG Emotion Recognition from Dynamic Mixed Spatiotemporal Graph Learning
0a8d605010bc5a0531caa058894ab8963a991d2d.abstract: Real-time emotion recognition provides promising applications for mental healthcare monitoring and human-computer interaction design. Electroencephalography (EEG) emotion recognition has become a hot topic in the field of affective computing and intelligent brain-computer interface (BCI), and it is a feasible solution for achieving real-time emotion recognition. However, due to the uncertainty and individual specificity of emotional cognition, there are still some challenges in achieving efficient online emotion decoding applications. To address this, in this work, we propose an online emotion decoding method named DMSGL (Real-Time EEG Emotion Recognition from Dynamic Mixed Spatiotemporal Graph Learning). 0a8d605010bc5a0531caa058894ab8963a991d2d.zh_title: 动态混合时空图学习的实时脑电情绪识别
0a8d605010bc5a0531caa058894ab8963a991d2d.summary: 提出动态混合时空图学习方法用于实时脑电情绪识别，可服务于心理健康监测与人机交互。
key_points: 面向实时脑电情绪识别
可应用于心理健康监测与脑机接口
情绪认知存在不确定性与个体差异
0a8d605010bc5a0531caa058894ab8963a991d2d.zh_abstract: 实时情绪识别为心理健康监测和人机交互设计提供了有前景的应用。脑电图（EEG）情绪识别已成为情感计算和智能脑机接口（BCI）领域的热点话题，并且是实现实时情绪识别的一种可行解决方案。然而，由于情绪认知的不确定性和个体特异性，在实现高效在线情绪解码应用方面仍存在一些挑战。为解决此问题，在本工作中，我们提出了一种名为DMSGL（Real-Time EEG Emotion Recognition from Dynamic Mixed Spatiotemporal Graph Learning，基于动态混合时空图学习的实时EEG情绪识别）的在线情绪解码方法。具体而言，在DMSGL中，我们提出利用受认知启发和数据驱动的学习策略，从EEG中探索潜在的与情绪相关的图特征，并且时间分析……

091836b235c124059a35f8bc0b82b6eca6df2c8c.title: Gradient-Aware Revitalization of Non-Effective Samples in Medical Image Segmentation
091836b235c124059a35f8bc0b82b6eca6df2c8c.abstract: Deep learning-based medical image segmentation, with its precise lesion localization capabilities, serves as a core component in multimedia medical applications and intelligent diagnostic assistance systems. Recent innovations in network architectures significantly improve segmentation performance. However, the Non-Effective Samples (NES) on model optimization receive little attention. These samples are characterized by minimal gradient variations in loss during training and exhibit a slight contribution to model optimization. They encompass well-segmented samples with near-zero loss values and challenging samples with consistently high loss values. Especially, when NES accumulate, the model will fall into an optimization trap, causing the optimization to stagnate. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight plug-and-play Gradient-Aware Sample Selection and Reactivation Strategy (GA-
091836b235c124059a35f8bc0b82b6eca6df2c8c.zh_title: 医学图像分割中非有效样本的梯度感知重激活
091836b235c124059a35f8bc0b82b6eca6df2c8c.summary: 关注训练中梯度变化微小的非有效样本，提出梯度感知方法提升医学图像分割性能。
key_points: 非有效样本在模型优化中被忽视
其损失梯度变化极小
提出梯度感知重激活方法
091836b235c124059a35f8bc0b82b6eca6df2c8c.zh_abstract: 基于深度学习的医学图像分割，凭借其精确的病灶定位能力，是多媒体医学应用和智能诊断辅助系统中的核心组成部分。近期网络架构的创新显著提升了分割性能。然而，模型优化中的非有效样本（Non-Effective Samples, NES）却很少受到关注。这些样本的特征是在训练期间损失函数中的梯度变化极小，并且对模型优化的贡献很小。它们包括损失值接近零的分割良好的样本以及损失值持续较高的困难样本。特别是，当 NES 累积时，模型将陷入优化陷阱，导致优化停滞。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种轻量级即插即用的梯度感知样本选择与重激活策略（Gradient-Aware Sample Selection and Reactivation Strategy, GA-

fafb18d1125f4f18e1eaf409af0c3462275d36e0.title: EMIFS: Efficient Multi-scale Information Fusion Self-supervision for Medical Image Segmentation
fafb18d1125f4f18e1eaf409af0c3462275d36e0.abstract: Medical image segmentation plays an important role in clinical decision making and auxiliary diagnosis. Today, however, it still faces three major challenges. 1. In the task of medical image segmentation, due to the different types of lesions and the large difference in the size of the lesion area, the segmentation accuracy is seriously reduced. 2. In order to pursue the segmentation performance, the model is difficult to be applied to the actual medical environment due to the excessive parameters. 3. Relying too much on manually labeled images to assist training. In order to meet these challenges, we propose a lightweight segmentation network, which is dedicated to extracting local and global information and fusing multi-level and multi-source features to maximize the segmentation accuracy for different shape lesions, especially for the case of fuzzy boundary and small segmentation targ
fafb18d1125f4f18e1eaf409af0c3462275d36e0.zh_title: EMIFS：多尺度信息融合自监督医学图像分割
fafb18d1125f4f18e1eaf409af0c3462275d36e0.summary: 提出高效多尺度信息融合自监督框架EMIFS，应对医学图像分割中病灶差异大与参数过多的问题。
key_points: 病灶类型与面积差异大影响分割精度
追求性能致参数量大难落地临床
提出多尺度信息融合自监督框架
fafb18d1125f4f18e1eaf409af0c3462275d36e0.zh_abstract: 医学图像分割在临床决策和辅助诊断中发挥着重要作用。然而，如今它仍面临三大挑战。1. 在医学图像分割任务中，由于病变类型不同以及病变区域大小差异很大，分割准确率严重降低。2. 为了追求分割性能，模型因参数过多而难以应用于实际医疗环境。3. 过于依赖人工标注图像来辅助训练。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种轻量级分割网络，致力于提取局部和全局信息并融合多层级、多源特征，以最大化对不同形状病变的分割准确率，尤其是对于边界模糊和分割目标较小的情况

faad31255e804934de0ddf494116b54bd432ee53.title: To Advance People's Well-Being: Human health sensing, analysis, and applications
faad31255e804934de0ddf494116b54bd432ee53.abstract: This talk presents research on estimating health status from facial video analysis, focusing on non-invasive approaches to support well-being. The talk introduces robust estimation methods from facial videos for health- and well-being related indicators and real-time systems capable of simultaneously estimating vital signs-including heart rate, respiration, blood oxygen level, blood pressure, and pulse variability. It also explains the feasibility of estimating states such as drowsiness and stress from facial videos. These techniques utilize widely available devices such as smartphones and PCs, enabling continuous and low-burden monitoring in daily life. By demonstrating the feasibility of vision-based health estimation across various contexts, this work highlights its potential for workplace well-being, preventive healthcare, and telemedicine applications. faad31255e804934de0ddf494116b54bd432ee53.zh_title: 促进人类福祉：人体健康感知、分析与应用
faad31255e804934de0ddf494116b54bd432ee53.summary: 该报告介绍基于面部视频的非侵入式健康状态估计方法及实时系统，可同时估计心率、呼吸、血氧、血压等指标。
key_points: 面部视频健康感知
实时估计多项生命体征
非侵入式福祉支持
faad31255e804934de0ddf494116b54bd432ee53.zh_abstract: 本报告介绍了基于面部视频分析估计健康状况的研究，重点关注支持福祉的非侵入性方法。报告介绍了从面部视频中稳健估计健康与福祉相关指标的方法，以及能够同时估计生命体征（包括心率、呼吸、血氧水平、血压和脉搏变异性）的实时系统。它还解释了从面部视频估计困倦和压力等状态的可行性。这些技术利用智能手机和 PC 等广泛可用的设备，能够在日常生活中实现连续且低负担的监测。通过展示基于视觉的健康估计在各种场景中的可行性，这项工作凸显了其在工作场所福祉、预防保健和远程医疗应用中的潜力。最终，本研究旨在

df92c5bd3511a194e6b2651484f6a911890ffc58.title: TabiMed: Tabularizing Medical Images for Few-Shot In-Context Diagnosis
df92c5bd3511a194e6b2651484f6a911890ffc58.abstract: Achieving accurate predictions with limited samples is a key challenge in biomedical image artificial intelligence. Previous methods rely on pre-trained image foundation models with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or zero-shot inference to enhance small-data performance. However, SFT is time-consuming and prone to overfitting, whereas zero-shot inference fails to fully exploit available data. Inspired by recent tabular foundation models, which show superior performance on small-sample tasks with in-context learning (ICL), we propose TabiMed, a novel framework that transforms visual representations into structured tabular data, leveraging pre-trained tabular models for fast and accurate analysis on small data. TabiMed consists of three key components: dynamic modality-aware representation engine, tabularization adapter and in-context inference module. Experiments on 10 datasets from differen
df92c5bd3511a194e6b2651484f6a911890ffc58.zh_title: TabiMed：医学图像表格化实现小样本上下文诊断
df92c5bd3511a194e6b2651484f6a911890ffc58.summary: 提出TabiMed，将医学图像表格化以借助表格基础模型能力，在小样本下做上下文诊断，规避微调与零样本推理的不足。
key_points: 受表格基础模型在小样本任务上表现启发
指出监督微调耗时且易过拟合
零样本推理无法充分利用可用数据
df92c5bd3511a194e6b2651484f6a911890ffc58.zh_abstract: 在生物医学图像人工智能中，用有限样本实现准确预测是一项关键挑战。先前方法依赖预训练图像基础模型，通过监督微调（SFT）或零样本推理来提升小数据性能。然而，SFT 耗时且容易过拟合，而零样本推理未能充分利用可用数据。受近期表格基础模型启发，这些模型通过上下文学习（ICL）在小样本任务上表现出优越性能，我们提出 TabiMed，一个新颖框架，将视觉表示转换为结构化表格数据，利用预训练表格模型对小数据进行快速准确分析。TabiMed 由三个关键组件组成：动态模态感知表示引擎、表格化适配器和上下文推理模块。在来自 differen 的 10 个数据集上的实验

d99345128696dbe92a2abdb2ae9748fb294b13f1.title: The Overlooked Matters: Revisiting Background, Prototype, and Activation in Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
d99345128696dbe92a2abdb2ae9748fb294b13f1.abstract: In few-shot medical image segmentation, most existing methods focus heavily on learning explicit correlations between support and query sets, often overlooking the core demands of the segmentation task itself. In this work, we identify three overlooked yet critical issues that limit current performance: the diversity of background distributions, the degradation of support prototypes, and the over-activation of irrelevant regions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework with three lightweight and adaptive modules. First, a background self-distillation module acts as a self-attention-driven agent to cluster and aggregate diverse background features, generating multiple sub-prototypes that enhance foreground-background separation. Second, we introduce a prototype self-anchoring mechanism that leverages a dual-branch correlation mapping and reverse supervision to stabilize
d99345128696dbe92a2abdb2ae9748fb294b13f1.zh_title: 重审小样本医学图像分割的背景、原型与激活
d99345128696dbe92a2abdb2ae9748fb294b13f1.summary: 指出小样本医学图像分割中被忽视的背景多样性、支撑原型退化与无关区域过度激活三问题，并提出相应框架。
key_points: 现有方法偏重支撑集与查询集相关性
识别背景分布多样性与原型退化问题
指出无关区域过度激活限制性能
d99345128696dbe92a2abdb2ae9748fb294b13f1.zh_abstract: 在少样本医学图像分割中，大多数现有方法主要侧重于学习支持集和查询集之间的显式相关性，往往忽视了分割任务本身的核心需求。在这项工作中，我们识别出三个被忽视但关键的问题，它们限制了当前性能：背景分布的多样性、支持原型退化以及无关区域的过度激活。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个包含三个轻量级自适应模块的新框架。首先，背景自蒸馏模块作为一个自注意力驱动的代理，对多样的背景特征进行聚类和聚合，生成多个子原型，以增强前景-背景分离。其次，我们引入了一种原型自锚定机制，利用双分支相关映射和反向监督来稳定

bd64a408c5233fb4ef9e100c3acbaf829c9a6453.title: MedAI Hub: A Multimodal Medical Data Platform with Evolutionary Image Enhancement and Graph-Driven Literature Retrieval
bd64a408c5233fb4ef9e100c3acbaf829c9a6453.abstract: We present MedAI Hub, an integrated multimodal medical platform designed to bridge clinical practice and research by transforming patient-doctor interactions into structured scientific data. This platform supports comprehensive management of multimodal medical records-including clinical notes, medical images, and patient-reported outcomes-while implementing privacy-preserving data sharing mechanisms. Building upon this infrastructure, we introduce two novel AI-driven modules:(1) ITERATE (Image-Text Enhancement, Retrieval, and Alignment): An evolutionary algorithm inspired by Visual Genome that optimizes medical image-text alignment through iterative cross-modal refinement. Leveraging LLM-guided ''DNA evolution'' and multimodal feedback, ITERATE enhances ultrasound image quality for diagnostic tasks, achieving 3.5-7% accuracy gains on ScienceQA and ARC-Easy benchmarks.(2) MedQuery: A grap
bd64a408c5233fb4ef9e100c3acbaf829c9a6453.zh_title: MedAI Hub：多模态医疗数据平台
bd64a408c5233fb4ef9e100c3acbaf829c9a6453.summary: 提出整合多模态病历（临床笔记、医学图像、患者报告结局）的医疗平台，含隐私保护共享机制及两个AI模块，如ITERATE图像增强。
key_points: 管理临床笔记、图像与患者报告结局
实现隐私保护的数据共享机制
含ITERATE等两个AI驱动模块
bd64a408c5233fb4ef9e100c3acbaf829c9a6453.zh_abstract: 我们提出 MedAI Hub，一个集成的多模态医疗平台，旨在通过将医患互动转化为结构化科学数据来连接临床实践与研究。该平台支持多模态医疗记录的综合管理（包括临床笔记、医学图像和患者报告结果），同时实施隐私保护的数据共享机制。在此基础设施之上，我们引入两个新颖的 AI 驱动模块：（1）ITERATE（图像-文本增强、检索和对齐）：一种受 Visual Genome 启发的进化算法，通过迭代跨模态细化来优化医学图像-文本对齐。利用 LLM 引导的“DNA 进化”和多模态反馈，ITERATE 提升了用于诊断任务的超声图像质量，在 ScienceQA 和 ARC-Easy 基准上实现了 3.5-7% 的准确率提升。（2）MedQuery：一个图

ba276f07255fa948b6c00fb57dfa5fecd97897a8.title: HEALTH+: Empowering Individuals via Unifying Health Data
ba276f07255fa948b6c00fb57dfa5fecd97897a8.abstract: Managing personal health data is a challenge in today's fragmented and institution-centric healthcare ecosystem. Individuals often lack meaningful control over their medical records, which are scattered across incompatible systems and formats. This vision paper presents Health +, a user-centric, multimodal health data management system that empowers individuals (including those with limited technical expertise) to upload, query, and share their data across modalities (e.g., text, images, reports). Rather than aiming for institutional overhaul, Health + emphasizes individual agency by providing intuitive interfaces and intelligent recommendations for accessing and sharing data. At the system level, it tackles the complexity of storing, integrating, and securing heterogeneous health records, ensuring both efficiency and privacy. By unifying multimodal data and prioritizing patients, Health
ba276f07255fa948b6c00fb57dfa5fecd97897a8.zh_title: HEALTH+：以统一健康数据赋能个人
ba276f07255fa948b6c00fb57dfa5fecd97897a8.summary: MM 2025 愿景论文提出以用户为中心的多模态健康数据管理系统 HEALTH+，支持个人上传、查询与共享跨模态健康数据。
key_points: 针对碎片化、机构中心的医疗生态
支持文本、图像、报告等多模态数据
面向技术能力有限的用户

b26ed95c2059f738f7ba448e5eaac04cf5fd171b.title: HyMoENet: Mixture-of-Experts Enhanced CNN-Transformer Hybrid Framework for Classifying Anatomical Sites in Endoscopic ENT Images
b26ed95c2059f738f7ba448e5eaac04cf5fd171b.abstract: Classifying anatomical regions in endoscopic ENT (ear, nose, and throat) images is challenging due to strong inter-class similarities, bilateral symmetry, and the scarcity of annotated datasets. To overcome these issues, we present HyMoENet. This novel hybrid deep learning architecture combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for localized feature extraction with Vision Transformers to represent global context. Furthermore, it leverages a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) technique to improve multi-perspective specialization. Our architecture makes use of parallel CNN-Transformer encoders, which are incorporated into a dynamic MoE layer that adaptively routes representations to the most appropriate experts. b26ed95c2059f738f7ba448e5eaac04cf5fd171b.zh_title: HyMoENet：专家混合增强的CNN-Transformer内镜耳鼻喉图像部位分类
b26ed95c2059f738f7ba448e5eaac04cf5fd171b.summary: 提出CNN与视觉Transformer混合并引入稀疏专家混合的架构，用于内镜耳鼻喉图像解剖部位分类。
key_points: CNN提取局部特征、ViT建模全局上下文

acdbcccb38596c9d38a4d2b3eb6833e130cf7e23.title: Hierarchical Disentanglement of Cognitive States for Enhanced Cognitive Diagnosis
acdbcccb38596c9d38a4d2b3eb6833e130cf7e23.abstract: With the rapid evolution of multimedia technologies and its widespread integration into education, adaptive multimedia learning has gained significant prominence. Cognitive diagnosis (CD) is pivotal in this domain, as it models students' cognitive states using practice data captured by multimedia learning applications. However, existing methods often simplify these states to mere proficiency on knowledge concepts. Constructivism in education emphasizes learning as a continuous cognitive development process, during which students' cognitive states become increasingly complex, involving not only their construction of concepts but also their construction of relations between concepts that have long been overlooked. ab0adcc684a7642485ef7e0e6d42d6d23f71ec6f.title: EEG-Driven Image Reconstruction with Saliency-Guided Diffusion Models
ab0adcc684a7642485ef7e0e6d42d6d23f71ec6f.abstract: Existing EEG-driven image reconstruction methods often overlook spatial attention mechanisms, limiting fidelity and semantic coherence. To address this, we propose a dual-conditioning framework that combines EEG embeddings with spatial saliency maps to enhance image generation. Our approach leverages the Adaptive Thinking Mapper (ATM) for EEG feature extraction and fine-tunes Stable Diffusion 2.1 via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to align neural signals with visual semantics, while a ControlNet branch conditions generation on saliency maps for spatial control. Evaluated on THINGS-EEG, our method achieves a significant improvement in the quality of low- and high-level image features over existing approaches. Simultaneously, strongly aligning with human visual attention. The results demonstrate that attentional priors resolve EEG ambiguities, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions with applic
ab0adcc684a7642485ef7e0e6d42d6d23f71ec6f.zh_title: 基于显著性引导扩散模型的脑电图像重建
ab0adcc684a7642485ef7e0e6d42d6d23f71ec6f.summary: MM 2025 提出双条件框架，将脑电嵌入与空间显著性图结合，经 LoRA 微调 Stable Diffusion 2.1 提升重建保真度。
key_points: 双条件结合脑电嵌入与空间显著性图
ATM 提取脑电特征并 LoRA 微调扩散模型
引入 ControlNet 增强空间控制
ab0adcc684a7642485ef7e0e6d42d6d23f71ec6f.zh_abstract: 现有的脑电（EEG）驱动图像重建方法常常忽视空间注意力机制，限制了保真度和语义一致性。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种双重条件框架，将 EEG 嵌入与空间显著性图相结合以增强图像生成。我们的方法利用自适应思维映射器（Adaptive Thinking Mapper, ATM）进行 EEG 特征提取，并通过低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）微调 Stable Diffusion 2.1，使神经信号与视觉语义对齐，同时由 ControlNet 分支以显著性图为条件进行生成以实现空间控制。在 THINGS-EEG 上评估时，我们的方法在低层和高层图像特征质量上较现有方法取得显著提升。同时，与人类视觉注意力高度对齐。结果表明，注意力先验可解决 EEG 歧义，使高保真重建成为可能，并具有应用

a38e61e91e1700bbe4cde6fa549c00a1436beedf.title: PySimPace v2.0: An Easy-to-Use Simulation Tool with Machine Learning Pipelines for Realistic MRI Motion Artifact Generation
a38e61e91e1700bbe4cde6fa549c00a1436beedf.abstract: Motion artifacts in structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) pose a significant challenge for both clinical use and machine learning (ML)-based image analysis. Existing ML approaches for artifact correction require paired clean and corrupted datasets, which are difficult to acquire. We present py-simpace, an open-source, pip-installable MRI motion artifact simulation toolkit with native ML integration. py-simpace supports structural MRI and functional MRI (fMRI) simulation, offering configurable k-space and image-space motion, ghosting, Gibbs ringing, and physiological noise. It provides an end-to-end pipeline with a ready-to-use PyTorch Dataset interface for ML training. We describe the design of py-simpace v2.0, compare it with existing tools, and demonstrate its utility for robust artifact correction model development.
a38e61e91e1700bbe4cde6fa549c00a1436beedf.zh_title: PySimPace v2.0：MRI运动伪影仿真工具
a38e61e91e1700bbe4cde6fa549c00a1436beedf.summary: 开源可安装的MRI运动伪影仿真工具，内置机器学习流程，支持结构与功能MRI模拟。
key_points: 支持结构MRI与功能MRI仿真
解决配对干净与伪影数据难获取问题
原生集成机器学习流程且开源
a38e61e91e1700bbe4cde6fa549c00a1436beedf.zh_abstract: 结构性和功能性磁共振成像（MRI）中的运动伪影对临床使用和基于机器学习（ML）的图像分析都构成了重大挑战。现有的用于伪影校正的ML方法需要配对的干净和损坏数据集，而这些数据集难以获取。我们提出了py-simpace，一个开源、可通过pip安装的MRI运动伪影模拟工具包，具有原生ML集成。py-simpace支持结构性MRI和功能性MRI（fMRI）模拟，提供可配置的k空间和图像空间运动、鬼影、Gibbs振铃和生理噪声。它提供了一个端到端流程，并带有用于ML训练的即用型PyTorch Dataset接口。我们描述了py-simpace v2.0的设计，将其与现有工具进行比较，并展示了其在稳健伪影校正模型开发中的实用性。

899ea5be8b10221f9cf8ee2aa919d930baacbf3f.title: Efficient Trajectory Space-Time Super-Resolution for Fast Live-cell Imaging
899ea5be8b10221f9cf8ee2aa919d930baacbf3f.abstract: Live-cell imaging is a powerful tool for studying dynamic subcellular processes by capturing the spatiotemporal organization of the biological microenvironment. However, limitations due to phototoxicity and photobleaching prevent microscopes from achieving high frame rates and high-quality images. Although current deep learning methods can enhance both frame rates and image resolution without compromising cell health, they often overlook the continuity of subcellular trajectories, which leads to discontinuous temporal modeling. It also incurs prohibitive computational costs due to exhaustive correlation computation that hinder real-time applications. To address these issues with high efficiency, we propose Trajectory Space-Time Super-Resolution (T-STSR), a method designed to boost frame rates and resolution in fast subcellular imaging while significantly reducing computational overhead.
899ea5be8b10221f9cf8ee2aa919d930baacbf3f.zh_title: 面向快速活细胞成像的轨迹时空超分辨率
899ea5be8b10221f9cf8ee2aa919d930baacbf3f.summary: MM 2025 提出轨迹时空超分辨率方法，提升活细胞成像帧率与分辨率并保持亚细胞轨迹连续性。
key_points: 针对光毒性与光漂白造成的成像限制
指出既有方法忽略亚细胞轨迹连续性
在不损害细胞健康下提升帧率与质量
899ea5be8b10221f9cf8ee2aa919d930baacbf3f.zh_abstract: 活细胞成像是通过捕捉生物微环境的时空组织来研究动态亚细胞过程的有力工具。然而，光毒性和光漂白带来的限制使显微镜无法同时实现高帧率和高品质图像。尽管当前的深度学习方法能够在不损害细胞健康的情况下提升帧率和图像分辨率，但它们常常忽视亚细胞轨迹的连续性，导致时间建模不连续。此类方法还因穷举式相关性计算而带来高昂的计算成本，阻碍实时应用。为高效解决这些问题，我们提出轨迹时空超分辨率（Trajectory Space-Time Super-Resolution, T-STSR），这是一种旨在提升快速亚细胞成像中的帧率和分辨率、同时显著降低计算开销的方法。

5f1fbd52018eadb713cfbef176afc47501d27c4d.title: Pathology-Aware Reconstruction with Discriminative Knowledge Boosting Alignment for Che-Xray Vision-Language Pre-training
5f1fbd52018eadb713cfbef176afc47501d27c4d.abstract: Current medical vision-language pre-training models primarily follow two paradigms: report-supervised cross-modal alignment pre-training and reconstruction-based self-supervised pre-training. The former enhances the discriminative power of representations, while the latter facilitates fine-grained representation learning. However, naively combining these two paradigms inherits their inherent limitations: reconstruction-based methods treat all image patches equally during reconstruction, failing to effectively capture critical pathological details-since disease-related regions typically occupy only a small fraction of the image. Meanwhile, alignment-based methods suffer from suboptimal representations due to the presence of false negatives. 5f1fbd52018eadb713cfbef176afc47501d27c4d.zh_title: 胸部X光视觉语言预训练：病理感知重建与对齐
5f1fbd52018eadb713cfbef176afc47501d27c4d.summary: 提出病理感知重建与判别性知识增强对齐，用于胸部X光视觉语言预训练。
key_points: 结合报告监督与重建式自监督两种范式
指出现有结合方式继承各自局限
提出病理感知重建与知识增强对齐
5f1fbd52018eadb713cfbef176afc47501d27c4d.zh_abstract: 当前的医学视觉-语言预训练模型主要遵循两种范式：报告监督的跨模态对齐预训练和基于重构的自监督预训练。前者增强了表示的判别能力，而后者促进了细粒度表示学习。然而，简单地将这两种范式结合起来会继承它们固有的局限性：基于重构的方法在重构过程中平等对待所有图像块，无法有效捕捉关键的病理细节——因为疾病相关区域通常只占图像的一小部分。同时，基于对齐的方法由于存在假阴性而遭受次优表示。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的预训练框架，它集成了两个关键组件：病理感知重构（PAR）和Di

596f6dcf0a6cecd4470b7733035c6410a1cb2964.title: Medical Vision-Language Pre-training with Multimodal Variational Masked Autoencoder for Robust Medical VQA
596f6dcf0a6cecd4470b7733035c6410a1cb2964.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Medical VQA) plays an important role in medical informatics. However, the robustness of existing medical VQA models is severely challenged by adversarial attacks. Current methods (e.g. adversarial training and noise-based reasoning) heavily rely on additional data or complex procedures and often ignore model-level robustness. To address these issues, we propose Multimodal Variational Masked Autoencoder (MVMAE), a novel pre-training framework designed to enhance the robustness of the medical VQA task. MVMAE leverages masked modeling and variational inference to extract robust multimodal features. The framework introduces a low-cost multimodal bottleneck fusion module and employs reparameterization to sample robust latent representations, ensuring effective feature fusion and reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public medical VQA datasets demonstrate
596f6dcf0a6cecd4470b7733035c6410a1cb2964.zh_title: 多模态变分掩码自编码器医学视觉语言预训练
596f6dcf0a6cecd4470b7733035c6410a1cb2964.summary: 提出多模态变分掩码自编码器MVMAE预训练框架，提升医学VQA模型对抗攻击鲁棒性。
key_points: 医学VQA鲁棒性受对抗攻击挑战
现有方法依赖额外数据或复杂流程
提出多模态变分掩码自编码器MVMAE
596f6dcf0a6cecd4470b7733035c6410a1cb2964.zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答（Medical VQA）在医学信息学中发挥着重要作用。然而，现有医学VQA模型的鲁棒性受到对抗性攻击的严重挑战。当前方法（例如对抗训练和基于噪声的推理）严重依赖额外数据或复杂程序，并且常常忽略模型级别的鲁棒性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了多模态变分掩码自编码器（MVMAE），一种新颖的预训练框架，旨在增强医学VQA任务的鲁棒性。MVMAE利用掩码建模和变分推理来提取鲁棒的多模态特征。该框架引入了一个低成本的多模态瓶颈融合模块，并采用重参数化来采样鲁棒的潜在表示，确保有效的特征融合和重构。在公共医学VQA数据集上的大量实验证明

55b2acffad596ac6c2fa5a73518d2fc9e52047f8.title: MCHM25: Multimedia Computing for Health and Medicine
55b2acffad596ac6c2fa5a73518d2fc9e52047f8.abstract: Recent years have witnessed an unprecedented growth of multimodal data in healthcare, ranging from distributed sensors and medical imaging devices (MRI, CT, X-rays) to digital health platforms that integrate audio, video, 3D geometry, and clinical text. The increasing availability of such data presents significant opportunities for computer-aided diagnosis and intelligent healthcare solutions, yet also poses substantial challenges in multimodal integration, large-scale analysis, and real-world deployment. The 2nd International Workshop on Multimedia Computing for Health and Medicine (MCHM'25), held in conjunction with ACM Multimedia 2025, focuses on advanced multimedia computing techniques, including mobile and hardware solutions, for tackling real-world problems in healthcare. The workshop brings together researchers and practitioners in multimedia computing, artificial intelligence, an
55b2acffad596ac6c2fa5a73518d2fc9e52047f8.zh_title: MCHM25：健康与医学多媒体计算
55b2acffad596ac6c2fa5a73518d2fc9e52047f8.summary: 讨论医疗多模态数据增长带来的计算机辅助诊断机遇，以及多模态整合与规模化分析的挑战。
