7517787efd3a01aa11b9a7103bd7c5285c5213ed.zh_abstract: 影像组学（Radiomics）和深度学习都为定量医学影像提供了强大的工具，但大多数现有融合方法仅利用全局影像组学特征，而忽略了空间分辨的影像组学参数图的互补价值。我们提出了一个统一的框架，该框架首先选择具有判别力的影像组学特征，然后将其在全局和体素水平注入经影像组学增强的 nnUNet，用于胰腺导管腺癌（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC）检测。在 PANORAMA 数据集上，我们的方法在交叉验证中达到了 AUC = 0.96 和 AP = 0.84。在外部内部队列中，它达到了 AUC = 0.95 和 AP = 0.78，优于基线 nnUNet；它还在 PANORAMA Grand Challenge 中排名第二。这表明，当在全局和体素水平注入时，手工设计的影像组学特征可为 PDAC 的深度学习模型提供互补信号。

747fefd480f0ac7125740c6f340139025127a480.title: Text-Guided Cross Pseudo Supervision for Semi-Supervised Multi-Organ Segmentation in Abdominal CT Scans
747fefd480f0ac7125740c6f340139025127a480.abstract: Semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation in abdominal CT scans holds substantial potential to enhance disease diagnosis while reducing the time and effort needed for organ annotations. However, accurate segmentation of small and complex organs is still a challenge due to limited annotations. In multi-organ segmentation, the anatomical structure can provide rich semantic information such as relative position of organs. Therefore, we propose a text-guided cross pseudo supervision (TG-CPS) method, which integrates text embeddings from vision-language models (VLMs) into CPS framework. Specifically, we introduce a text branch to capture anatomical relationships using text label prompts, guiding the segmentation model to learn structured feature embeddings. 729d3b564fd3c6999a3033c14bf9e4d3e9e16b9a.title: Ranking Xai Methods for Head and Neck Cancer Outcome Prediction
729d3b564fd3c6999a3033c14bf9e4d3e9e16b9a.abstract: For head and neck cancer (HNC) patients, prognostic outcome prediction can support personalized treatment strategy selection. Improving prediction performance of HNC outcomes has been extensively explored by using advanced artificial intelligence (AI) techniques on PET/CT data. However, the interpretability of AI remains a critical obstacle for its clinical adoption. Unlike previous HNC studies that empirically selected explainable AI (XAI) techniques, we are the first to comprehensively evaluate and rank $\mathbf{1 3}$ XAI methods across $\mathbf{2 4}$ metrics, covering faithfulness, robustness, complexity and plausibility. 729d3b564fd3c6999a3033c14bf9e4d3e9e16b9a.zh_title: 头颈癌预后预测中13种XAI方法排序

713aac7dd7bbae17a08fcb27ebf516efdf4ad443.title: Understanding the Spreading Mechanism of Tau Propagation in Alzheimers Disease Through a Multi-Layer Transport
713aac7dd7bbae17a08fcb27ebf516efdf4ad443.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is characterized by the progressive spread of tau protein aggregates throughout the brain. Significant advances have been made in modeling this process using a potential energy transport framework, where the overarching goal is to elucidate the “prion-like” pathways of tau propagation from longitudinal tau-PET scans. However, current methods are limited to single-layer models, where tau spreading is constrained to either white matter fiber pathways (“air-based”) or the cortical folding patterns of the brain (“road-based”). This simplification overlooks the possibility that both air-based and road-based transport mechanisms might collaboratively drive the whole-brain tau propagation. 70219dbf69f2bb49e68cfa372d37acc3a2502c3f.abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) for medical image analysis constitute an active area of research. In this work, we systematically investigated the performance of four pre-trained VLMs, consisting of one non-medical (CLIP) and three recent medical VLMs (BiomedCLIP, MedCLIP, and PubMedCLIP) for tumor classification in six breast ultrasound datasets. Accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value were used as the evaluation measures. Traditional hand-crafted and model-based tissue microstructure reconstruction methods often require extensive diffusion gradient sampling, which can be time-consuming and limits the clinical applicability of tissue microstructure information. Recent advances in deep learning have shown promise in microstructure estimation; however, accurately estimating tissue microstructure from clinically feasible dMRI scans remains challenging without appropriate constraints. 66616bfe8f3cc8e190babb7ae3442a459f867b57.title: Reliable Brain Tumor Segmentation Based on Spiking Neural Networks with Efficient Training
66616bfe8f3cc8e190babb7ae3442a459f867b57.abstract: We propose a reliable and energy-efficient framework for 3D brain tumor segmentation using spiking neural networks (SNNs). A multi-view ensemble of sagittal, coronal, and axial SNN models provides voxel-wise uncertainty estimation and enhances segmentation robustness. To address the high computational cost in training SNN models for semantic image segmentation, we employ Forward Propagation Through Time (FPTT), which maintains temporal learning efficiency with significantly reduced computational cost. Experiments on the Multimodal Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenges (BraTS 2017 and BraTS 2023) demonstrate competitive accuracy, well-calibrated uncertainty, and an 87 % reduction in FLOPs, underscoring the potential of SNNs for reliable, low-power medical IoT and Point-of-Care systems.

66616bfe8f3cc8e190babb7ae3442a459f867b57.zh_abstract: 我们提出一个可靠且节能的框架，使用脉冲神经网络（SNN）进行3D脑肿瘤分割。由矢状位、冠状位和轴位SNN模型组成的多视角集成提供体素级不确定性估计并增强分割鲁棒性。为解决训练用于语义图像分割的SNN模型时的高计算成本，我们采用随时间前向传播（FPTT），其在显著降低计算成本的同时保持时间学习效率。在多模态脑肿瘤分割挑战赛（BraTS 2017和BraTS 2023）上的实验证明具有竞争力的准确度、良好校准的不确定性以及FLOPs降低87%，突显SNN在可靠、低功耗医疗物联网和即时检测（Point-of-Care）系统中的潜力。

63cb1fce8f93f57c39fb8eabb621c3310526fd9d.abstract: Automated segmentation plays a pivotal role in medical image analysis and computer-assisted interventions. Active learning (AL) is a promising approach to reduce the amount of labeled data required to train a model by iteratively selecting only the most beneficial instances to be labeled from the pool of unlabeled data. 5db5385b75350415b93a215f1490859b446567a1.title: Multi-Scale Boundary Enhanced Pseudo Label Refinement for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

5db5385b75350415b93a215f1490859b446567a1.zh_title: 多尺度边界增强的伪标签细化半监督分割
5db5385b75350415b93a215f1490859b446567a1.summary: 提出MBPLR方法，用多尺度协作与边界增强模块提升半监督医学图像分割的伪标签精度，在2D与3D数据集上取得最佳表现。

5b70a7bd34fabc0b981c339a2d801e75015b8847.title: SemiETPicker: Fast and Label-Efficient Particle Picking for CryoET Tomography Using Semi-Supervised Learning
5b70a7bd34fabc0b981c339a2d801e75015b8847.abstract: Cryogenic Electron Tomography (CryoET) combined with sub-volume averaging (SVA) is the only imaging modality capable of resolving protein structures inside cells at molecular resolution. Particle picking, the task of localizing and classifying target proteins in 3D CryoET volumes, remains the main bottleneck. Due to the reliance on time-consuming manual labels, the vast reserve of unlabeled tomograms remains underutilized. In this work, we present a fast, label-efficient semi-supervised framework that exploits this untapped data. Our framework consists of two components: (i) an end-toend heatmap-supervised detection model inspired by keypoint detection, and (ii) a teacher-student co-training mechanism that enhances performance under sparse labeling conditions. Furthermore, we introduce multi-view pseudo-labeling and a CryoET-specific DropBlock augmentation strategy to further boost perfo
5b70a7bd34fabc0b981c339a2d801e75015b8847.zh_title: 半监督冷冻电镜断层颗粒拾取方法
5b70a7bd34fabc0b981c339a2d801e75015b8847.summary: 提出SemiETPicker半监督框架，结合热图监督检测与教师-学生协同训练，在稀疏标注条件下提升冷冻电镜断层图像的颗粒拾取效率。

5b5a1c36e6a417fb084735828ced7a4cd466745d.title: Low Performing Pixel Correction in Computed Tomography with Unrolled Network and Synthetic Data Training
5b5a1c36e6a417fb084735828ced7a4cd466745d.abstract: Low performance pixels (LPP) in Computed Tomography (CT) detectors would lead to ring and streak artifacts in the reconstructed images, making them clinically unusable. In recent years, several solutions have been proposed to correct LPP artifacts, either in the image domain or in the sinogram domain using supervised deep learning methods. However, these methods require dedicated datasets for training, which are expensive to collect. Moreover, existing approaches focus solely either on image-space or sinogram-space correction, ignoring the intrinsic correlations from the forward operation of the CT geometry. In this work, we propose an unrolled dual-domain method based on synthetic data to correct LPP artifacts. Specifically, the intrinsic correlations of LPP between the sinogram and image domains are leveraged through synthetic data generated from natural images, enabling the trained mo
5b5a1c36e6a417fb084735828ced7a4cd466745d.zh_title: 展开网络与合成数据训练的CT低性能像素校正
5b5a1c36e6a417fb084735828ced7a4cd466745d.summary: 提出基于合成数据的展开式双域方法，利用正弦图与图像域相关性校正CT探测器低性能像素伪影。
key_points: 展开式双域方法校正低性能像素伪影

5a13dc18c22a6beddccfe8d6604fb0145c0e6962.title: ASDC-NET: Anterior Segment Disease Classification Network Based on Slit-Lamp Images
5a13dc18c22a6beddccfe8d6604fb0145c0e6962.abstract: Anterior segment diseases are common in clinical ophthalmology, but most studies focus on individual conditions, with relatively few addressing the broader classification of these diseases. In this paper, we propose an anterior segment disease classification network (ASDC-NET) to classify 5 types of diseases based on slit-lamp images. The proposed method designs a wavelet feature enhancement (WFE) module to extract frequency domain information, a multi-scale feature fusion (MSFF) module to combine features at different scales, and an adaptive channel aggregation (ACA) module to adapt to lesion variability. Evaluation results on the dataset including 1,250 slit-lamp images demonstrate the excellent classification performance of the proposed method, outperforming other state-of-the-art methods.
5a13dc18c22a6beddccfe8d6604fb0145c0e6962.zh_title: 基于裂隙灯图像的前节疾病分类网络
5a13dc18c22a6beddccfe8d6604fb0145c0e6962.summary: 提出ASDC-NET，用波let特征增强、多尺度融合与自适应通道聚合模块对5类前节疾病裂隙灯图像分类，在1250张图像上优于对比方法。

5617edf3e2505b3c1c3357f2aee3211ad87b62f5.title: Enhancing Sam Prompt Generation with DINOv3 Representations for Referring Medical Image Segmentation
5617edf3e2505b3c1c3357f2aee3211ad87b62f5.abstract: Referring Medical Image Segmentation aims to segment target regions in medical images according to referring expressions. Current SAM-based approaches typically generate prompts via vision-language models by regressing positive and negative point coordinates or directly producing prompt embeddings. However, these methods often suffer from limited point diversity and insufficient semantic guidance during embedding generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel SAM-based framework that leverages the strong representational capability of DINOv3 to guide prompt generation. Representative features of the target region, together with a similarity loss, are used to supervise the generation of prompt embeddings, providing semantically consistent and discriminative guidance for SAM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DINOv3-guided module improves the Dice score of a baselin
5617edf3e2505b3c1c3357f2aee3211ad87b62f5.zh_title: DINOv3引导SAM提示生成用于指代医学图像分割
5617edf3e2505b3c1c3357f2aee3211ad87b62f5.summary: 提出用DINOv3表征引导SAM提示生成的框架，通过相似度损失监督提示嵌入，提升基线Dice分数。
key_points: 针对SAM提示点多样性不足与语义弱
用DINOv3目标区域特征监督提示嵌入

5513597565cee58d4fb74dae9b7f2970dde9a0d7.title: Enhancing Lung Segmentation Algorithms to Ensure Inclusion of Juxtapleural Nodules
5513597565cee58d4fb74dae9b7f2970dde9a0d7.abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is pivotal in detecting and monitoring pulmonary nodules in lung cancer screening. With the advancement of artificial intelligence in medical imaging, accurate lung segmentation has become crucial for reliable feature extraction. While traditional methods lack generalizability, deep learning models also encounter difficulties including juxtapleural nodules. To overcome the challenge, we finetuned a 3D U-Net by randomly masking out 70% of the images, which forces the model to infer the missing regions and learn the boundaries of the lungs. Our model achieved a Dice of 0.982 in lung segmentation. Notably, our approach achieved higher sensitivity compared to three state-of-the-art deep learning models in the inclusion of juxtapleural and large masses by 0.11, 0.20, and 0.52, respectively. Additionally, it consistently outperformed these models on external datasets.
5513597565cee58d4fb74dae9b7f2970dde9a0d7.zh_title: 改进肺分割算法以纳入胸膜旁结节
5513597565cee58d4fb74dae9b7f2970dde9a0d7.summary: 随机遮盖70%图像微调3D U-Net，迫使模型推断缺失区域，肺分割Dice达0.982，胸膜旁结节与大肿块敏感度优于三个先进模型并在外部数据集验证。
key_points: 随机遮盖70%图像的3D U-Net微调策略

5513597565cee58d4fb74dae9b7f2970dde9a0d7.zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（Computed tomography, CT）在肺癌筛查中检测和监测肺结节方面至关重要。随着人工智能在医学影像中的进步，准确的肺部分割对于可靠的特征提取已变得至关重要。传统方法缺乏泛化性，而深度学习模型也遇到困难，包括胸膜旁结节。为克服这一挑战，我们通过随机遮盖 70% 的图像来微调 3D U-Net，这迫使模型推断缺失区域并学习肺部边界。我们的模型在肺部分割中达到 0.982 的 Dice 值。值得注意的是，在纳入胸膜旁结节和大肿块时，我们的方法相比三个最先进的深度学习模型分别实现了高 0.11、0.20 和 0.52 的敏感性。此外，它在外部数据集上始终优于这些模型。

51f38652398c0a98dda22776fdca8c247ecf9800.title: Benchmark of H&E-to-Mif Virtual Staining in Digital Pathology
51f38652398c0a98dda22776fdca8c247ecf9800.abstract: Multiplex Immunofluorescence (mIF) provides detailed information on the abundance and spatial localization of clinically relevant proteins in tissue, yet its acquisition is costly and not widely accessible. Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining, the pathological gold standard, is inexpensive and ubiquitous but lacks molecular specificity. Recent deep learning models can predict mIF signals from H&E, enabling in silico virtual staining, but standardized, publicly reproducible benchmarks are lacking, making it difficult to compare published methods. We propose a multi-level benchmark for $\mathrm{H} \& \mathrm{E} \rightarrow$ mIF prediction using public datasets. Representative models are trained on a shared dataset and evaluated across colorectal cancer cohorts. Performance is assessed at the pixel level for mIF reconstruction, at the cell level for cell-type classification, and with respe
51f38652398c0a98dda22776fdca8c247ecf9800.zh_title: H&E到mIF虚拟染色的数字病理基准
51f38652398c0a98dda22776fdca8c247ecf9800.summary: 基于公开数据集提出H&E预测mIF的多层级基准，在结直肠癌队列上从像素、细胞等层面评估代表性模型。

51f38652398c0a98dda22776fdca8c247ecf9800.zh_abstract: 多重免疫荧光（Multiplex Immunofluorescence, mIF）提供了组织中临床相关蛋白丰度和空间定位的详细信息，但其采集成本高昂且未广泛可及。苏木精-伊红（Hematoxylin and eosin, H&E）染色作为病理学金标准，价格低廉且普遍，但缺乏分子特异性。近期深度学习模型能够从 H&E 预测 mIF 信号，从而实现计算机虚拟染色（in silico virtual staining），但缺乏标准化、可公开复现的基准，使得比较已发表方法变得困难。我们提出了一个使用公共数据集进行 H&E → mIF 预测的多层次基准。代表性模型在共享数据集上训练，并在结直肠癌队列中评估。性能评估包括：针对 mIF 重建的像素级评估、针对细胞类型分类的细胞级评估，以及针对……

4c7c3a00d46266a8c32d157bd40e8b4407e01714.title: MEDQUA: A NISQ-Aware Quantum Adapter for Medical Vision–Language Models
4c7c3a00d46266a8c32d157bd40e8b4407e01714.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are promising for medical image classification but still face generalization limits from visual encoders and cross-site distribution shift. Fully quantum VLMs could offer richer representations, yet NISQ hardware makes end-to-end quantum training impractical. We introduce MEDQUA, a NISQ-aware quantum adapter that attaches to a pretrained VLM decoder. An entropydriven router sparsely selects tokens for a shallow variational quantum bottleneck, while a lightweight LoRA-based classical path processes all tokens to ensure stability and low cost. On MIMIC-CXR and ChestMNIST, MEDQUA consistently improves accuracy and AUROC over classical VLM baselines (including SFT) with modest overhead, showing that adaptively integrated quantum modules already yield practical gains. As coherence, error rates, and compilation advance, the same adapter can scale to deeper circuit
4c7c3a00d46266a8c32d157bd40e8b4407e01714.zh_title: MEDQUA：医学视觉语言模型的NISQ量子适配器
4c7c3a00d46266a8c32d157bd40e8b4407e01714.summary: 提出NISQ感知的量子适配器MEDQUA，挂载于预训练视觉语言模型解码器，在MIMIC-CXR与ChestMNIST上提升准确率与AUROC。

4c7c3a00d46266a8c32d157bd40e8b4407e01714.zh_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在医学图像分类中前景广阔，但仍面临来自视觉编码器和跨站点分布偏移的泛化限制。完全量子VLM可提供更丰富的表示，但NISQ硬件使端到端量子训练不切实际。我们提出MEDQUA，一种NISQ感知的量子适配器，连接到预训练的VLM解码器。熵驱动的路由器稀疏选择token进入浅层变分量子瓶颈，而基于LoRA的轻量级经典路径处理所有token以确保稳定性和低成本。在MIMIC-CXR和ChestMNIST上，MEDQUA以适度开销持续优于经典VLM基线（包括SFT）的准确度和AUROC，表明自适应集成量子模块已产生实际增益。随着相干性、错误率和编译的进步，同一适配器可扩展到更深电路

4bdd852de7e26ea2285080ff53c6718a8300b3be.title: MEA-YOLO: Medical Enhanced Attention YOLO for Simultaneous Polyp and Lumen Detection in Robotic Colonoscopy
4bdd852de7e26ea2285080ff53c6718a8300b3be.abstract: Robotic colonoscopy requires accurate simultaneous detection of polyps and lumens for autonomous navigation. However, existing object detectors lack medical domain-specific designs. We present MEA-YOLO (Medical Enhanced Attention YOLO), a unified framework for simultaneous polyp and lumen detection that integrates domain-specific attention mechanisms tailored for colonoscopy imaging. Our novel C2f-MEA module combines efficient multi-scale attention with specialized edge and lumen enhancement branches, addressing the unique visual characteristics of colonoscopic images. Evaluated on the Extended-LDPolyp dataset (37,947 images with dual annotations, video-level split), MEA-YOLO achieves 74.52% mAP@0.5, outperforming YOLOv8n by 2.58% and Faster R-CNN by 41.65%. Task-specific evaluation shows 72.52% AP for polyp detection and 76.52% AP for lumen detection, with consistent improvements in bot
4bdd852de7e26ea2285080ff53c6718a8300b3be.summary: 提出面向机器人结肠镜的MEA-YOLO框架，在扩展数据集上同时检测息肉与管腔，优于YOLOv8n等基线。

4bdd852de7e26ea2285080ff53c6718a8300b3be.zh_abstract: 机器人结肠镜检查需要准确同时检测息肉和肠腔以实现自主导航。然而，现有目标检测器缺乏医学领域特定设计。我们提出 MEA-YOLO（Medical Enhanced Attention YOLO，医学增强注意力 YOLO），一个用于同时检测息肉和肠腔的统一框架，其整合了为结肠镜成像量身定制的领域特定注意力机制。我们新颖的 C2f-MEA 模块将高效多尺度注意力与专门的边缘和肠腔增强分支相结合，应对结肠镜图像的独特视觉特征。在 Extended-LDPolyp 数据集（37,947 张具有双重标注的图像，视频级划分）上评估，MEA-YOLO 达到 74.52% mAP@0.5，比 YOLOv8n 高 2.58%，比 Faster R-CNN 高 41.65%。任务特定评估显示息肉检测的 AP 为 72.52%，肠腔检测的 AP 为 76.52%，并在 bot 中具有一致的改进

48c3e5691700d1f573c590482e46c96cb4d29537.title: SelfMedHPM: Self Pre-Training with Hard Patches Mining Masked Autoencoders for Medical Image Segmentation
48c3e5691700d1f573c590482e46c96cb4d29537.abstract: In recent years, deep learning methods such as convolutional neural network (CNN) and transformers have made significant progress in CT multi-organ segmentation. However, CT multi-organ segmentation methods based on masked image modeling (MIM) are very limited. There are already methods using MAE for CT multi-organ segmentation task, we believe that the existing methods do not identify the most difficult areas to reconstruct. To this end, we propose a MIM self-training framework with hard patches mining masked autoencoders for CT multi-organ segmentation tasks (self-MedHPM). The method performs ViT self-pretraining on the training set of the target data and introduces an auxiliary loss predictor, which first predicts the patch loss and determines the location of the next mask. SelfMedHPM implementation is better than various competitive methods in abdominal CT multi-organ segmentation an
48c3e5691700d1f573c590482e46c96cb4d29537.zh_title: 难块挖掘掩码自编码器的医学分割自预训练

48329b168076f46cb2a016c94d0232041def2b2b.title: Topological Image Analysis of Coronary Calcifications for Improved Cardiovascular Risk Prediction from Screening Non-Contrast CT
48329b168076f46cb2a016c94d0232041def2b2b.abstract: Accurately identifying high-risk cardiovascular patients is crucial to prevent myocardial infarctions and revascularizations. However, traditional risk assessments, such as the Agatston score, quantify coronary artery calcifications (CAC) at ≥130 Hounsfield units (HU), overlooking the contribution of lower-density calcifications. We introduce TopologyCAC, a model that leverages topological image analysis and persistent homology to capture the structure, spatial distribution, and persistence of CACs across lowered HU thresholds in CT calcium score (CTCS) images. In a cohort of 2,132 patients, TopologyCAC outperformed the Agatston score, achieving a testing Net Reclassification Improvement (NRI) of 0.11 on the testing set. Additionally, for patients under 60 years, TopologyCAC achieved a testing C-index of 0.81 in this preliminary analysis, significantly improving early-stage disease risk
48329b168076f46cb2a016c94d0232041def2b2b.zh_title: 拓扑影像分析提升冠脉钙化的心血管风险预测

47deb6b355207dca7edeaaecede802029c9bc7e8.title: Boundary-Aware Adversarial Filtering for Reliable Diagnosis Under Extreme Class Imbalance
47deb6b355207dca7edeaaecede802029c9bc7e8.abstract: We study classification under extreme class imbalance where recall and calibration are both critical: for example, in medical diagnosis scenarios. We propose AF-SMOTE, a mathematically motivated augmentation framework that first synthesizes minority points and then filters them by an adversarial discriminator and a boundary utility model. We prove that, under mild assumptions on the decision boundary smoothness and class-conditional densities, our filtering step monotonically improves a surrogate of $\mathrm{F}_{\beta}$ (for $\beta \geq 1$) while not inflating Brier score. On MIMIC-IV proxy label prediction and canonical fraud detection benchmarks, AF-SMOTE attains higher recall and average precision than strong oversampling baselines (SMOTE, ADASYN, Borderline-SMOTE, SVM-SMOTE), and yields the best calibration. We further validate these gains across multiple additional datasets beyond M

44ec6d4e2611336d494c68d1525e287724c65a78.title: Scale-Cascaded Diffusion Models for Super-Resolution in Medical Imaging
44ec6d4e2611336d494c68d1525e287724c65a78.abstract: Diffusion models have been increasingly used as strong generative priors for solving inverse problems such as superresolution in medical imaging. However, these approaches typically utilize a diffusion prior trained at a single scale, ignoring the hierarchical scale structure of image data. In this work, we propose to decompose images into Laplacian pyramid scales and train separate diffusion priors for each frequency band. We then develop an algorithm to perform super-resolution that utilizes these priors to progressively refine reconstructions across different scales. Evaluated on brain, knee, and prostate MRI data, our approach both improves perceptual quality over baselines and reduces inference time through smaller coarse-scale networks. Our framework unifies multiscale reconstruction and diffusion priors for medical image super-resolution.

440f51214cddb805bb3bc9db91efd73a742b1872.title: Skull Fracture Visualization Using Disk Harmonic Maps
440f51214cddb805bb3bc9db91efd73a742b1872.abstract: Skull fractures, especially those of the base and facial regions, are challenging to identify due to the intricate anatomy and their subtle morphological characteristics. They necessitate meticulous attention and allocation of sufficient time to ensure accurate diagnosis and optimal patient care. This paper introduces a novel approach that converts a head CT to a mesh representation, in order to utilize disk harmonic mapping and eventually create a flatten map of the skull for improved visualization. In such a view, fractures appear continuous with enhanced contrast. The effectiveness of this technique was evaluated using the CQ500 dataset. This alternative visualization of a flattened skull can provide radiologists and emergency department personnel a valuable addition to conventional radiological views, increasing the effectiveness and speed of skull fracture detection.

43d37505acd72386c2ff6e3a2d6b1977a94561bb.abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) imaging requires accurate attenuation correction (AC) to account for photon loss due to tissue density variations. In PET/MR systems, computed tomography (CT), which offers a straightforward estimation of AC is not available. This study presents a deep learning approach to generate synthetic CT (sCT) images directly from Time-of-Flight (TOF) non-attenuation corrected (NAC) PET images, enhancing AC for PET/MR. We first evaluated models pre-trained on large-scale natural image datasets for a CT-to-CT reconstruction task, finding that the pre-trained model outperformed those trained solely on medical datasets. 4387a7422afb6eb661492649eab074b363a850d8.title: RVPD: An Automated System for Calculating the Tortuosity and Bifurcation Angles of Retinal Vessels to Predict Diseases
4387a7422afb6eb661492649eab074b363a850d8.abstract: Hypertension and diabetes are known to potentially cause morphological changes in the retinal capillary system, yet quantifying these changes presents significant challenges. This research addresses this issue by designing and developing an automated system capable of analyzing retinal images to detect and measure these changes. Our system automatically segments vessels and the optic disc, calculates tortuosity and bifurcation angles, and performs disease prediction based on these measurements along with clinical features. For tortuosity calculation, we adopted a novel curve fitting method, which provides more stable convergence compared to traditional discrete numerical methods. The system integrates clinical data and conducts prediction experiments on hypertensive and diabetic patients with varying sample sizes. 4120c3f0095892b4c388ad83ab2ae562823a9feb.title: [18F]Florbetapir Pet Uptake Differences in White Matter Across the Alzheimer's Disease Continuum: From Cognitively Normal to MCI and Dementia
4120c3f0095892b4c388ad83ab2ae562823a9feb.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is widely recognized for hallmark gray matter (GM) changes, including extracellular amyloid plaques and neurofibrillary tangles. However, recent neuroimaging research suggests that white matter (WM) aberrations may also play a significant role in AD risk and development. This study investigates AD dementia by examining regional covariance patterns of WM changes, expanding beyond the conventional focus on GM. Using [18F]Florbetapir ([18F]FBP) Positron Emission Tomography (PET) data from 716 participants in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), we analyzed inter-subject covarying patterns to reveal latent WM sources associated with AD dementia. 410d3d00a0a8bddde273a08dfba4f2a935c49056.title: Forecasting Future Anatomies: Longitudinal Brain MRI-TO-MRI Prediction
410d3d00a0a8bddde273a08dfba4f2a935c49056.abstract: Predicting future brain state from a baseline magnetic resonance image (MRI) is a central challenge in neuroimaging, and has important implications for studying neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD). Most existing approaches predict future cognitive scores or clinical outcomes, such as conversion from mild cognitive impairment to dementia. Instead, here we investigate longitudinal MRI image-to-image prediction that forecasts a participant's entire brain MRI several years into the future, intrinsically modeling complex, spatially distributed neurodegenerative patterns. We implement and evaluate five deep learning architectures (UNet, U${ }^{2}$-Net, UNETR, Time-Embedding UNet, and ODEUNet) on two longitudinal cohorts (ADNI and AIBL). 40bc10098421b459a4affc5f91e0cde2789bdfed.abstract: Disease progression modeling provides a robust framework to identify long-term disease trajectories from short-term biomarker data. It is a valuable tool to gain a deeper understanding of diseases with a long disease trajectory, such as Alzheimer's disease. A key limitation of most disease progression models is that they are specific to a single data type (e.g., continuous data), thereby limiting their applicability to heterogeneous, real-world datasets. To address this limitation, we propose the Mixed Events model, a novel disease progression model that handles both discrete and continuous data types. This model is implemented within the Subtype and Stage Inference (SuStaIn) framework, resulting in Mixed-SuStaIn, enabling subtype and progression modeling. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have led to the development of vision-language models (VLMs) that demonstrate enhanced multimodal capabilities, including stronger language comprehension and reasoning skills compared to CLIP. 3f03bf58c6843f7cac97f91abb284d1b8f27586b.title: Leveraging Multi-Rater Annotations to Calibrate Object Detectors in Microscopy Imaging
3f03bf58c6843f7cac97f91abb284d1b8f27586b.abstract: Deep learning-based object detectors have achieved impressive performance in microscopy imaging, yet their confidence estimates often lack calibration, limiting their reliability for biomedical applications. In this work, we introduce a new approach to improve model calibration by leveraging multi-rater annotations. This improves upon label sampling strategies, where models are trained on mixed annotations, and offers a more principled way to capture inter-rater variability. 3dd9e3b178175e03559c628f4fd0fff78c8b468f.abstract: Foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) show strong generalization, yet adapting them to medical images remains difficult due to domain shift, scarce labels, and the inability of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to exploit unlabeled data. Fine-tuning foundation models on specific low-resource medical tasks has become a standard practice. Previous few-shot domain adaptation (FSDA) methods seek to bridge the distribution gap between source and target domains by utilizing auxiliary data. The selection and scheduling of auxiliaries are often based on heuristics, which can easily cause negative transfer. 314d8a40c6e17dc07a677ef169bafffae093d30f.title: Variance-Penalized MC-Dropout as a Learned Smoothing Prior for Brain Tumour Segmentation
314d8a40c6e17dc07a677ef169bafffae093d30f.abstract: Brain tumor segmentation is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning, yet many deep learning approaches, particularly convolutional neural networks, such as UNet and its variations produce noisy boundaries in regions of tumor infiltration. 2ce844102aff71a962e19797f07c7c30ea5299c5.title: Instance-Aware Deep Learning for Liver Metastasis Segmentation
2ce844102aff71a962e19797f07c7c30ea5299c5.abstract: Accurate segmentation of colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) from CT scans is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning in oncology. However, accurate lesion delineation remains a significant challenge due notably to instance imbalance. In this work, we propose an instance-aware segmentation model to enhance CRLM extraction, exploiting an instance-level loss function. Through careful evaluation, we analyze performance across diverse lesion morphologies and sizes, an aspect often overlooked for model validation. By leveraging a SwinUNETR-based architecture and three distinct datasets, we demonstrate improved instance detection ability, thereby contributing to better clinical decision-making in managing CRLM. A publicly-available implementation is provided: https://github.com/marwanabb/CRLM-instance/.

259b3e7b8bb7f688e0bd53da9923070b28d9709c.title: Crestomics: Analyzing Carotid Plaques in the Crest-2 Trial with a New Additive Classification Model
259b3e7b8bb7f688e0bd53da9923070b28d9709c.abstract: Accurate characterization of carotid plaques is critical for stroke prevention in patients with carotid stenosis. We analyze 500 plaques from CREST-2, a multi-center clinical trial, to identify radiomics-based markers from B-mode ultrasound images linked with high-risk. We propose a new kernel-based additive model, combining coherence loss with group-sparse regularization for nonlinear classification. Group-wise additive effects of each feature group are visualized using partial dependence plots. Results indicate our method accurately and interpretably assesses plaques, revealing a strong association between plaque texture and clinical risk.

24d06224b1f47e7627cb6c856bac591dad67a9a5.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have become the architecture of choice for many computer vision tasks, yet their performance in computer-aided diagnostics remains limited. Focusing on breast cancer detection from mammograms (BCDM), we identify two main causes for this shortfall. First, medical images are high-resolution with small abnormalities, leading to an excessive number of tokens and making it difficult for the softmax-based attention to localize and attend to relevant regions. 248e148d088398c645332f86b16147dcadeec0af.title: An Efficient Framework for Long-Tailed and Multi-Label Classification on Chest X-Rays
248e148d088398c645332f86b16147dcadeec0af.abstract: To tackle the challenges of long-tailed disease distributions and label-occurrence within chest X-ray classification. 1f70cad356e6fd7c7fefaacac850bc3ec7c255d2.abstract: Segmentation of cartilages to examine the Knee osteoarthritis is a challenging problem in medical image analysis, due to distribution gaps in source and target domains. Existing models trained on one MRI domain struggle to generalize to MRI scans produced from different scanners, highlighting the need to develop novel approaches to adapt to cross-modalities. In this paper, we propose a novel Eigen Low-rank subspace-assisted Mean Teacher Knowledge Distillation framework (MTKD-LRS) using a semi-supervised learning approach. This framework leverages the low-rank approximations within the deep feature subspaces to capture meaningfullatent patterns and construct the domain-invariant feature representations. 1f30242d9c9493de7a3d79a42b24518660b126c5.title: Study of Shape Fusion Algorithms for 3D Time-Lapse Microscopy
1f30242d9c9493de7a3d79a42b24518660b126c5.abstract: In biomedical image processing, reference data used to benchmark segmentation algorithms are typically obtained by fusing expert annotations. We compare popular fusion algorithms (majority voting, STAPLE, and Robust Bayesian Fusion) and study (1) how their results depend on the variability of input annotations and (2) how well they preserve shapes w.r.t, biologically relevant measures (BRM) such as volume and average roundness. We also study (3) the correlation between BRM and measures common in image processing (namely, Jaccard index and Hausdorff distance). For our experiments, we created 3D time-lapse segmentation annotations of migrating cells with complex dynamic shapes (Fluo-C3DL-MDA231 dataset from the Cell Tracking Challenge). 1ee1240aff0f70cfa57b398b3aea6f465d410423.title: PCA-Enhanced Probabilistic U-Net for Effective Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation
1ee1240aff0f70cfa57b398b3aea6f465d410423.abstract: Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation (AMIS) is significant to address the challenges of inherent uncertainties from image ambiguities, noise, and subjective annotations. Existing conditional variational autoencoder (cVAE)-based methods effectively capture uncertainty but face limitations including redundancy in high-dimensional latent spaces and limited expressiveness of single posterior networks. To overcome these issues, we introduce a novel PCA-Enhanced Probabilistic U-Net (PEP U-Net). Our method effectively incorporates Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for dimensionality reduction in the posterior network to mitigate redundancy and improve computational efficiency. Additionally, we further employ an inverse PCA operation to reconstruct critical information, enhancing the latent space's representational capacity. 1a0ac6b7919b79fe62a8c7533cbee9eaa9c85b23.title: Synergy Vs. Noise: Performance-Guided Multimodal Fusion for Biochemical Recurrence-Free Survival in Prostate Cancer
1a0ac6b7919b79fe62a8c7533cbee9eaa9c85b23.abstract: Multimodal deep learning (MDL) has emerged as a transformative approach in computational pathology. By integrating complementary information from multiple data sources, MDL models have demonstrated superior predictive performance across diverse clinical tasks compared to unimodal models. However, the assumption that combining modalities inherently improves performance remains largely unexamined. We hypothesise that multimodal gains depend critically on the predictive quality of individual modalities, and that integrating weak modalities may introduce noise rather than complementary information. We test this hypothesis on a prostate cancer dataset with histopathology, radiology, and clinical data to predict time-to-biochemical recurrence. 1a0ac6b7919b79fe62a8c7533cbee9eaa9c85b23.zh_title: 多模态融合预测前列腺癌生化复发

199adff147db524a92c4621fd2ef349928755249.title: SFECNet: Fusion of Structural, Functional and Effective Connectivity Network for Epilepsy Classification
199adff147db524a92c4621fd2ef349928755249.abstract: For brain network analysis, multimodal fusion learning leverages multiple medical imaging modalities to gather more comprehensive information. This method could usually results more accurate diagnoses in brain diseases like epilepsy. Many multimodal approaches typically construct only structural connectivity (SC) networks and functional connectivity (FC) networks. However SC and FC are undirected connectivity, leading to lack of directed interaction between brain regions. Effective connectivity (EC) networks implying causal relationships, could further offer complementary information. So we propose a Fusion of Structural, Functional and Effective Connectivity Network for Epilepsy Classification (SFECNet). 1877f9bb018d990e7666b11dca7ffdc48cd9f41d.title: Efficient CMR Report Classification Through Synthetic Data Distillation and Metadata Fusion
1877f9bb018d990e7666b11dca7ffdc48cd9f41d.abstract: This study presents a ClinicalBERT model specialized for cardiovascular MR (CMR) report classification through synthetic data-driven knowledge distillation and metadata integration. To enable efficient and accurate classification of CMR reports, we generated 20,000 synthetic reports using a large language model, transferring nuanced medical knowledge to Clinical-BERT while minimizing computational costs. Metadata integration further enhanced classification specificity for target diseases, with mixed results observed for negation filtering. Our optimized model achieved a 50% performance improvement over the baseline, demonstrating synthetic data's potential for training specialized NLP models in clinical applications. 15aeea09d6cf4567a3b60eafc62b026a3619e598.title: Cephalometric Landmark Detection Using Graph- and Image-Aware Network with Landmark Contrastive Regularization
15aeea09d6cf4567a3b60eafc62b026a3619e598.abstract: The detection or digitization of cephalometric landmarks is a critical step in the clinical pipeline of craniomaxillofacial (CMF) surgical planning. Prior methods for cephalometric landmark detection are limited to using either CBCT images or 3D bony meshes to infer the landmark positions and thus result in suboptimal outcomes. In this study, we propose to use both CBCT images and 3D bony models (derived from CBCT images) to detect landmarks, which allows for comprehensive consideration of both imaging and geometric information for more accurate and robust landmark detection. To overcome the challenge of effectively utilizing the two heterogeneous modalities, we designed a novel CNN-GCN hybrid network, Graph-/Image-aware Network (GrImNet), which enables end-to-end training and inference using grid image and non-grid mesh data for cephalometric landmark detection. 11bc70d51aaef6cf547a25b453b4c2706cc70181.title: Medical Text and Image Reasoning for Radiation Oncology via Large Language Model
11bc70d51aaef6cf547a25b453b4c2706cc70181.abstract: Evaluating text based logical reasoning and medical image reasoning abilities in large language models (LLMs) within the domain of radiation oncology is often challenging. Testing LLMs without fine-tuning in this context often fails to achieve high accuracy, particularly when dealing with domain-specific questions, limiting their utility in medical decision-making. In this paper, five prominent LLMs - ChatGPT-4o, Claude-3.5 Sonnet, Llama 3.2, Gemini 1.5 Flash, and o1-preview are evaluated to assess their text based logical reasoning and medical image reasoning performances on two publicly available datasets. We propose a new challenging benchmark dataset featuring a mixture of single-choice questions as well as multiple choice questions in radiation oncology for the reasoning task. 11bc70d51aaef6cf547a25b453b4c2706cc70181.zh_title: 大语言模型在放射肿瘤学文本与图像推理评测

0fff94841176c9e727e5b3b2791455bcc7b3bcf0.title: Multi-Phase Attention for Early Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma Segmentation from Contrast Enhanced Liver MRI
0fff94841176c9e727e5b3b2791455bcc7b3bcf0.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally, primarily due to late-stage detection. Accurate segmentation of HCC from multiphase MRI scans plays a critical role in early detection and treatment planning, but manual segmentation is labor-intensive owing to the heterogenous and diffuse nature of these tumors. In this study, we propose a novel deep learning framework that leverages multi-phase MRI data to perform early stage HCC segmentation. Our method introduces a Multi-Phase Attention (MPA) module to effectively capture and integrate information from arterial, venous, and delayed post-contrast phases. We compare our approach against five state-of-the-art medical image segmentation models, demonstrating its ability to outperform these baselines on small early stage tumors. 0d6f4defa1bc7040dbda42e453267ce46ceee126.title: A Unified Framework for Semi-Supervised Image Segmentation and Registration
0d6f4defa1bc7040dbda42e453267ce46ceee126.abstract: Semi-supervised learning, which leverages both annotated and unannotated data, is an efficient approach for medical image segmentation, where obtaining annotations for the whole dataset is time-consuming and costly. Traditional semi-supervised methods primarily focus on extracting features and learning data distributions from unannotated data to enhance model training. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach incorporating an image registration model to generate pseudo-labels for the unannotated data, producing more geometrically correct pseudo-labels to improve the model training. Our method was evaluated on a 2D brain data set, showing excellent performance even using only 1% of the annotated data. 0d6f4defa1bc7040dbda42e453267ce46ceee126.zh_title: 半监督分割与配准统一框架

0cbd7ccdcf05d115fec6f38e6f27aeece5030295.title: LWV-UNet: Lightweight Vision Transformer UNet for Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Image Segmentation
0cbd7ccdcf05d115fec6f38e6f27aeece5030295.abstract: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is a common malignancy of the head and neck. Deep learning-based image segmentation of NPC can facilitate clinical diagnosis. However, these models are often characterized by a large number of parameters and high computational complexity. To address this issue, we propose a Lightweight Vision Transformer UNet (LWV-UNet) model. This model combines the strengths of convolutional neural networks and Transformers, and achieves lightweight characteristics by using Inverted Residual (IR) blocks and MobileViTv2 blocks to replace the encoder. The MobileViTv2 block enables global feature modeling, allowing it to capture complex image structures. Additionally, we use IR blocks in the skip connections to learn information from different feature maps. Finally, the decoder, composed of IR blocks, generates the predicted segmentation map. 0c76b02d2924e38977816d867b02a43b3cd0a3aa.title: Biomechanically Accurate Gait Analysis: A 3D Human Reconstruction Framework for Markerless Estimation of Gait Parameters
0c76b02d2924e38977816d867b02a43b3cd0a3aa.abstract: This paper presents a biomechanically interpretable framework for gait analysis using 3D human reconstruction from video data. Unlike conventional keypoint based approaches, the proposed method extracts biomechanically meaningful markers analogous to motion capture systems and integrates them within OpenSim for joint kinematic estimation. To evaluate performance, both spatiotemporal and kinematic gait parameters were analysed against reference marker-based data. Results indicate strong agreement with marker-based measurements, with considerable improvements when compared with pose-estimation methods alone. The proposed framework offers a scalable, markerless, and interpretable approach for accurate gait assessment, supporting broader clinical and real world deployment of vision based biomechanics.

0c5b3b88d43c6f6cc1838bba389ae0566a6c5213.abstract: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) technique that enables non-invasive mapping of structural brain connectivity. Fiber orientation distribution (FOD) is a crucial intermediate model used to represent complex white matter fiber configurations within a voxel and serves as a key step for subsequent brain tractography and connectome analysis. However, obtaining reliable FOD estimates is particularly challenging due to the constraints of acquisition protocols, which often feature low spatial and angular resolutions in non-research-focused clinical settings. Current deep learning approaches could address these limitations, but they typically enhance FOD quality only for either low angular or low spatial resolution inputs. 096ee5e56f6c9f9d5bdca0915062ab51b4ec4098.title: Controllable Latent Diffusion-Based 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation: With Synthetic Label Generation and Detailed Variance Map
096ee5e56f6c9f9d5bdca0915062ab51b4ec4098.abstract: Approaches based on the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) have shown promise for directly generating segmentation maps from medical images. However, denoising in the original image space limits the application of DDPM to 2D images. We present a latent diffusion model-based segmentation method (LDM-seg) to directly generate multi-label segmentation maps from 3D medical images, such as multisequence magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). A distinctive aspect of our approach is utilizing ControlN et to apply MRI as a conditioning factor to control the generation process. Trained and validated on the BraTS 2023 Adult Glioma dataset, we show LDM-seg outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including nnU-Net and MedNeXt. 0858bce913c235282454019fc6d239a73e65e2b1.title: Signal Reconstructions for ECG-Transmembrane Voltage Potentials Using Transformers
0858bce913c235282454019fc6d239a73e65e2b1.abstract: Transmembrane voltage potential (TMP) data play a vital role in detecting heart conditions such as coronary heart diseases, arrythmias, and heart failures. However, defects and limitations in electrocardiogram devices can adversely affect data collection, often resulting in data that are noisy and time-step limited. Such corrupted data can impair a clinician's ability to correctly diagnose and further understand a patient's heart condition. In this paper, we propose two machine learning architectures for recovering the true TMP signal from corrupted ECG data. In particular, we consider (1) a long short - term memory model, which takes in the entire ECG measurement data and produces the TMP signal in a 1-to-1 fashion; and (2) a transformer-based model, which takes in the ECG signal and produces the TMP signal in a generative fashion. Numerical experiments demonstrate that these approaches
0858bce913c235282454019fc6d239a73e65e2b1.zh_title: Transformer重建心电跨膜电压信号

07ab18e89ea704ac6becaf15f7bda67aa5c134a2.title: Salience-Enhanced Network for Metal Artifact Reduction in CT Imaging
07ab18e89ea704ac6becaf15f7bda67aa5c134a2.abstract: Computed Tomography (CT) technology is widely used in clinical diagnosis; however, metal implants often introduce severe artifacts in CT images. To address this issue, metal artifact reduction (MAR) techniques have emerged. In the image domain, existing MAR methods have made some progress, but few have focused on utilizing artifact information to guide models effectively. To bridge this gap, we propose a salience-enhanced metal artifact reduction network. The framework is comprised of two stages: In the first stage, a Siamese network extracts common artifact features from different datasets while distinguishing non-artifact features, and Grad-CAM is utilized to generate heatmaps that highlight salient artifact features. In the second stage, a baseline network based on a transformer module, guided by these salience maps, concentrates on artifact regions for precise artifact correction. We

06d35a790bc27077561ecff62cb17f1e866bdefd.abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the scarcity of annotated data in medical image segmentation by leveraging unlabeled samples to enhance model training. Currently, some methods employ a co-training strategy to achieve semi-supervised segmentation. However, many studies overlook the feature interaction between the two subnets. Moreover, effectively reducing the effects of inconsistent predictions from the two subnets remains challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel Discrepancy-induced Cross-subnet Interaction network for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. Specifically, we present a Cross-subnet Interaction Module (CIM) to strengthen the interaction between the two feature maps, which helps reduce model cognitive bias. 06419dc96dfa1d7d2e261220606b153756f70f03.title: Seeing Beyond the Image: ECG and Anatomical Knowledge-Guided Myocardial Scar Segmentation from Late Gadolinium-Enhanced Images
06419dc96dfa1d7d2e261220606b153756f70f03.abstract: Accurate segmentation of myocardial scar from late gadolinium enhanced (LGE) cardiac MRI is essential for evaluating tissue viability, yet remains challenging due to variable contrast and imaging artifacts. Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals provide complementary physiological information, as conduction abnormalities can help localize or suggest scarred myocardial regions. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal framework that integrates ECG-derived electrophysiological information with anatomical priors from the AHA-17 atlas for physiologically consistent LGE-based scar segmentation. As ECGs and LGE-MRIs are not acquired simultaneously, we introduce a Temporal Aware Feature Fusion (TAFF) mechanism that dynamically weights and fuses features based on their acquisition time difference. Our method was evaluated on a clinical dataset and achieved substantial gains over the state-of-the-art

06419dc96dfa1d7d2e261220606b153756f70f03.zh_abstract: 从晚期钆增强（LGE）心脏 MRI 中准确分割心肌瘢痕对于评估组织存活性至关重要，但由于对比度变化和成像伪影，仍具有挑战性。心电图（ECG）信号提供互补的生理信息，因为传导异常有助于定位或提示瘢痕化心肌区域。在本工作中，我们提出一种新颖的多模态框架，将 ECG 衍生的电生理信息与来自 AHA-17 图谱的解剖先验相结合，用于生理一致的基于 LGE 的瘢痕分割。由于 ECG 和 LGE-MRI 并非同时采集，我们引入时间感知特征融合（TAFF）机制，根据采集时间差动态加权并融合特征。我们的方法在临床数据集上进行了评估，并相较于最先进水平取得了显著提升

05fb2e0229dc9f3ab36c0009804777c2ccc65716.abstract: Multi-modal models require aligned, shared embedding spaces. However, common CLIP-based approaches need large amounts of samples and do not natively support 3D or tabular data, both of which are crucial in the medical domain. To address these issues, we revisit CLIP-style alignment by training a domain-specific 3D foundation model as an image encoder and demonstrate that modality alignment is feasible with only 62 MRI scans. Our approach is enabled by a simple embedding accumulation strategy required for training in 3D, which scales the amount of negative pairs across batches in order to stabilize training. We perform a thorough evaluation of various design choices, including the choice of backbone and loss functions, and evaluate the proposed methodology on zero-shot classification and image-retrieval tasks. 0539f50ec5379973a7c01e2919fed915e946335f.title: An Automated Whole Torso Aortic and Iliac Artery Atherosclerotic Burden Assessment on Body CT
0539f50ec5379973a7c01e2919fed915e946335f.abstract: Atherosclerosis, characterized by plaque buildup in arterial walls, is often studied in coronary arteries. However, it is less studied in the aorta and iliac arteries, despite their links with diseases like ischemic heart disease, stroke, and periph-eral vascular conditions. This work develops an automated method to segment and label plaques in the aorta, left, and right iliac arteries. Using an nnU-Net-based segmentation framework, plaques, arteries, and organs that potentially in-duce false plaque detections are first segmented. Plaques are then labeled according to the arteries in which they are located. Agatston scores are calculated on labeled plaques to assess atherosclerosis burden. The proposed method was validated using 50 internal contrast-enhanced and 60 external non-contrast CT scans. 04a19e5c9e9d9bf3aa774f9cf0b791fccfc40772.title: Age Knowledge Guided CNN-Transformer Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
04a19e5c9e9d9bf3aa774f9cf0b791fccfc40772.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neuro-degenerative disorder characterized by subtle structural changes across certain brain regions. These changes can result in a gap between one's chronological age and brain age, which can be served as a biomarker for AD diagnosis. However, it is challenging to leverage this knowledge effectively. To address this problem, we introduced a dual-branch age knowledge guided CNN-Transformer network. The proposed framework comprises three parts: 1) Brain age prediction branch generates predicted brain age and age-related multi-scale feature maps; 2) AD prediction branch fuses the feature maps and extracts AD-related features; 3) Brain Age Guided Attention Module integrates features of the two branches and gives the final AD classification. Furthermore, we propose a novel Channel-Coordinate Attention (CCA) to enhance feature capabilities in 3D neuroimaging data.

ff7070e02e0a2e83fa432dc4a35e463a628bdb2c.abstract: Deep learning has achieved remarkable success in medical imaging; however, its reliance on large annotated datasets limits its applicability in data-scarce clinical settings. An ultrasound-based technology to monitor treatments over the therapeutic temperature range is desirable clinically. fd08019c34bc4b87de2e7ab2ba5461c56307ffb2.abstract: Anatomical landmark localization is a fundamental task for downstream medical imaging tasks including registration and quantitative analysis. Traditional approaches rely on hierarchical machine learning locators or whole-image neural network processing, which are prone to local minima or require extensive computation. However, in the medical domain, most major foundation diffusion models are held privately due to the data replication issue inherent in diffusion models. The data replication issue refers to a sampling problem observed in diffusion models, where the model tends to generate samples closely resembling the training data. This phenomenon becomes pronounced when a diffusion model is trained on a small dataset containing only a few hundred images. To address these issues, we developed a multi-expert classification framework that utilizes a mixture of expert models, each leveraging the MobileNetV2 architecture with distinct loss functions tailored for class imbalance. facc8e0310f15b5858ef185acce9cd780e79cd5f.abstract: Accurate survival prediction from histopathology wholeslide images (WSIs) remains challenging due to gigapixel resolutions, spatial heterogeneity, and complex survival distributions. fab45b5409139c832aef09c3221dfd5bd761486d.title: Ranking-Guided Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation for Severity Classification
fab45b5409139c832aef09c3221dfd5bd761486d.abstract: Semi-supervised domain adaptation leverages a few labeled and many unlabeled target samples, making it promising for addressing domain shifts in medical image analysis. However, existing methods struggle with severity classification due to unclear class boundaries. Severity classification involves naturally ordered class labels, complicating adaptation. We propose a novel method that aligns source and target domains using rank scores learned via ranking with class order. Specifically, Cross-Domain Ranking ranks sample pairs across domains, while Continuous Distribution Alignment aligns rank score distributions. Experiments on ulcerative colitis and diabetic retinopathy classification validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating successful alignment of class-specific rank score distributions.

f95dd62d2633038c8402b7c78c007e50ee01e7a4.abstract: High b-value diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) enhances the visibility of prostate cancer lesions, but its acquisition often suffers from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and significantly increases the patient scan times. f8fa3dee471a16b207c2231640db8e72f64f016a.abstract: This work presents the development of an anatomically realistic ultrasound elastography (USE) database, developed by modifying pre-existing B-mode images from open-source databases. Cooper's ligaments, a curvilinear network of ligaments running through the breast volume, are known to alter the stiffness distribution of the tissue due to their mechanical properties, affecting the tissue displacement field resulting from mechanical stimulation. In this paper, a method is presented for integrating these ligaments in B-mode images, in order to generate anatomically accurate radiofrequency (RF) data. This RF data serves as the foundation for training a convolutional neural network (CNN) designed to automatically detect breast cancer using USE, advancing the potential of this technology in breast cancer diagnosis.

BiM processes each time point with parallel bilinear and linear pathways to produce time-step representation, which is then aggregated over time for classification. f79ea882ac038ab2aee02e7e8c08ccafded76662.title: How to Optimize Concordance in Medical Imaging for Deep Survival Analysis? Concordance Pairwise Logistic Loss
f79ea882ac038ab2aee02e7e8c08ccafded76662.abstract: Deep survival analysis in medical imaging traditionally relies on Cox proportional hazards with negative partial log-likelihood (NLL), which optimizes likelihood rather than directly targeting concordance, the fundamental ranking metric for risk prediction. This disconnect is amplified in medical imaging, where high-resolution images force memory-constrained small batches, destabilizing NLL's risk-set-based gradients. Here, we introduce Concordance Pairwise Logistic Loss (CPL), a novel objective that directly optimizes pairwise ranking concordance by penalizing incorrect risk orderings between comparable sample pairs. CPL integrates inverse probability of censoring weights (IPCW) through dynamic (batchcomputed) and static (precomputed) strategies to handle informative censoring. f669c1fd40d5c90085b4dd993732fa6ae6ae9834.title: Feature Aggregation for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis Using FDG-PET Images: The Potential of Graph-Based Methods
f669c1fd40d5c90085b4dd993732fa6ae6ae9834.abstract: Feature ranking for Alzheimer's disease (AD) classification often suffers from instability and inconsistent performance due to variations across neuroimaging datasets and analytic approaches. This study evaluates individual feature-ranking methods, simple aggregation techniques, and graph-based consensus approaches for AD classification. Significant discrepancies across individual ranking methods reveal their distinct sensitivities to data characteristics, underscoring the need for robust integration strategies. Aggregation-based approaches effectively leverage complementary insights to enhance stability and predictive accuracy. Among them, graph-based consensus methods-particularly our proposed multi-cutoff graph representations with Sinkhorn aggregation-demonstrate a principled capacity to capture complex feature dependencies and yield interpretable, high-fidelity consensus rankings. f629d521917660505ff57d53170265e457d73a40.abstract: Human anatomy, with its inherent structural consistency across various organs, provides a unique foundation for medical imaging, presenting two key properties: inter-organ discrimination, where each organ displays unique patterns compared to others (e.g., chest vs. hand vs. leg), and intra-organ discrimination, where subtle variations within the same organ across different patients are apparent (e.g., left vs. right hand). We envision developing a medical imaging model that leverages these foundational properties to enhance anatomical “understanding” and establish a “robust” framework for medical imaging. f629d521917660505ff57d53170265e457d73a40.zh_title: MOSS：跨多器官自监督预训练

f59ff15f0c8c1a54c53a57562074b76503319a1f.abstract: Accurate prediction of malignancy in renal tumors is crucial for informing clinical decisions and optimizing treatment strategies. However, existing imaging modalities lack the necessary accuracy to reliably predict malignancy before surgical intervention. While deep learning has shown promise in malignancy prediction using 3D CT images, traditional approaches often rely on manual segmentation to isolate the tumor region and reduce noise, which enhances predictive performance. Manual segmentation, however, is labor-intensive, costly, and dependent on expert knowledge. f505a9dae0e9ac739d7bf668246f436d31f7d29f.title: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Reasoning in Operating Room Long Video Understanding
f505a9dae0e9ac739d7bf668246f436d31f7d29f.abstract: Operating rooms (OR) are complex, high-risk environments that demand long-horizon video understanding for intelligent surgical assistance and quality assurance. Existing domainspecific OR models and datasets mainly address short-clip or frame-level analysis, lacking the ability to reason across extended temporal contexts. In contrast, general long-video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong temporal reasoning but fail to capture the structured interactions and clinical semantics unique to surgical workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce OR-LongVQA, a benchmark for long-video understanding in operating rooms, covering diverse factors and causality-centered questions. We further propose a reasoning retrieval framework based on temporal scene graph and evidence-grounded reasoning modules that retrieve relevant subgraphs and perform interpretable step-by-step inference.

f48ae33f03c3916830f15864e1dba13b69c41ffd.abstract: Functional brain networks derived from resting-state fMRI are powerful biomarkers for neurological disorders. f3f96d0831265bb637aee65202f602e8b239c52e.abstract: In cases of prevalent diseases and disorders, such as Prenatal Alcohol Exposure (PAE), multi-site data collection allows for increased study samples. However, multi-site studies introduce additional variability through heterogeneous collection materials, such as scanner and acquisition protocols, which confound with biologically relevant signals. Neuroscientists often utilize statistical methods on imagederived metrics, such as volume of regions of interest, after all image processing to minimize site-related variance. HACA3, a deep learning harmonization method, offers an opportunity to harmonize image signals prior to metric quantification; however, HACA3 has not yet been validated in a pediatric cohort. f32aaa2b8b9f87001ee9d2bc61f2eee75059558c.abstract: 4D Flow MRI enables comprehensive hemodynamic assessment but remains constrained by prolonged acquisition times (10-15 min) and limited spatial resolution, hindering clinical deployment. Conventional super-resolution (SR) methods aim to enhance the original spatial resolution without accounting for acquisition time. This study investigates arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) frameworks applied to reduced-time acquisitions to recover clinical-grade resolution. Two generalisable ASSR architectures - LIIF and LTE - originally designed for 2D natural imagery, are reformulated for 3D volumetric data and trained exclusively on in-vivo measurements. f15c5cd0d2878b0b2cf6dfbfa490dfb3f3361cdc.title: Reference-Free 2D-to-3D Multiple Slice Transport Average Registration (MSTAR) for Late Gadolinium Enhancement Cardiac MRI
f15c5cd0d2878b0b2cf6dfbfa490dfb3f3361cdc.abstract: We present MSTAR, a reference-free statistical method for reformatting 2D image slices into a coherent 3D volumetric dataset using sliding window technique and transport averaging based registration. This approach handles motion and anatomical changes, enabling enhanced visualization quality and coherence in free-breathing cardiac MRI. In a study of 74 patients with intracardiac devices, MSTAR generated high-quality 3D volumes without a pre-existing target, achieving 81.3% sensitivity and 92.2% specificity compared to standard 2D protocol. The 3D method enabled LGE findings confirmation in multiple views, eliminating indeterminate segments present in 2D protocol. This technique bridges the gap between 2D and 3D LGE imaging, improving diagnostic confidence in complex cases and benefiting patients unable to hold their breath for segmented scans.

These comparisons were converted into scalar quality labels using the TrueSkill ranking framework, with conservative estimates $(\mu-3 \sigma)$ normalized to a $0-5$ scale. An EfficientNet-B0 regression model trained on these labels achieved a Pearson correlation of $R=0.895$ and $R^{2}=0.798$ on a validation set. f0e71fef6454aacfc6c862d1afec9c265a00fb55.title: Deep Learning-Based Cosmetic Evaluation of Breast Cancer Conservative Treatment
f0e71fef6454aacfc6c862d1afec9c265a00fb55.abstract: Cosmetic evaluation of breasts is important for cancer care teams to counsel patients, manage their expectations, and make treatment choices for breast-conserving cancer treatments. However, availability of experts to grade breast cosmesis is a challenge, especially in low and medium income countries (LMICs). We present a technique and a tool for cosmetic evaluation of breast-conserving therapies, including surgery and radiation, which has been evaluated in an LMIC setting. We show that it is more accurate on South Asian and African women than the available alternative that was based on older computer vision techniques and was trained and tested on a Caucasian population. Our technique adapts to domain shifts, such as changes in demographic physiological characteristics and co-morbidity based on deep learning. Due to the small size and dense distribution of the leakage areas, along with the limited availability of labeled clinical data, this segmentation task is significant challenge. To address these challenges, we integrate a self-supervised pre-training strategy based on Masked Autoencoders (MAE) with the foundation model MedSAM2. We further investigate several loss functions and identify a task-specific combined loss that yields the best performance. ef1e144a0499209fbbd717ea9504a823aa93d51c.title: CSEval: A Framework for Evaluating Clinical Semantics in Text-to-Image Generation
ef1e144a0499209fbbd717ea9504a823aa93d51c.abstract: Text-to-image generation has been increasingly applied in medical domains for various purposes such as data augmentation and education. Evaluating the quality and clinical reliability of these generated images is essential. However, existing methods mainly assess image realism or diversity, while failing to capture whether the generated images reflect the intended clinical semantics, such as anatomical location and pathology. In this study, we propose the Clinical Semantics Evaluator (CSEval), a framework that leverages language models to assess clinical semantic alignment between the generated images and their conditioning prompts. Our experiments show that CSEval identifies semantic inconsistencies overlooked by other metrics and correlates with expert judgment. ee1f992f2358debb02256f5d9f9748af9681c384.title: Diaphragm-Net: 3D Full Automatic Segmentation of the Diaphragm Based on Deep Learning Methods for 3D-CT Images
ee1f992f2358debb02256f5d9f9748af9681c384.abstract: Predicting breathing movement is complex and is regarded as one of the most challenging areas in medical research. The diaphragm is the main muscle of respiration, thin and flat structure, making its automatic segmentation difficult. Manual segmentation is a tedious, time-consuming task, and expert segmentations are prone to intra- and inter-operator variability. The full automatic segmentation of the diaphragm remains difficult and challenging due to its thickness, irregular shape and the similar density with the surrounding organs. In this work, we have developed a new automated deep learning (DL) segmentation framework of the diaphragm. More precisely, we have proposed a new multi-axis annotation refinement workflow using deep transfer learning (Multi-Axis-DTL). ee06044f7a494a1c6d14d4840d19b44f39514b9a.title: Automatic Correction of Generative AI Chest X-Ray Radiology Reports
ee06044f7a494a1c6d14d4840d19b44f39514b9a.abstract: The factual correctness of generative AI-derived radiology reports needs to be improved before they can be used in clinical workflows. In this paper, we propose an automatic report correction method that uses both image and textual information in automated radiology reports to identity errors in identity and location in findings through fact-checking models. Prompts for a pre-trained large language model are then generated from the error analysis to produce corrected sentences by selectively modifying target findings described in the automated report sentences. We show that this method of report correction, on the average, improves the report quality between 17-30% across various SOTA report generators over multi-institutional chest X-ray datasets.

ed71f20d257efdfbf3680e14c92dbbccb920a83f.title: Attentive Latent Replay for Continual Learning in Pathology
ed71f20d257efdfbf3680e14c92dbbccb920a83f.abstract: Deep learning has shown promise in advancing pathology image analysis, yet reliable deployment remains challenging in settings where datasets arrive over extended time, necessitating adaptation to new data classes. Privacy concerns, legal issues, and storage constraints often complicate data retention. Moreover, existing models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained on new tasks. There is a pressing need for algorithms resilient to forgetting and capable of generalizing to new data without substantially storing past examples. To address such challenges, we propose a novel replay methodology using generative models, enhanced by a knowledge regularization approach leveraging attention embeddings from prior tasks. ecf81bc1bbe969b07377e370e41c02aa29a423cb.title: Introducing Transformer-Based Cascaded Classifiers for Breast Cancer Histopathology Classification
ecf81bc1bbe969b07377e370e41c02aa29a423cb.abstract: Computer-aided diagnosis of breast histological images supports the identification of tumors, which is of high prognostic value for breast cancer patients. This task remains challenging due to stain variability, limited annotated data, and class imbalance. e8e7711c2b2b118bbeaa53744f0eda6176525aa4.abstract: Image inpainting aims to restore missing (or masked) regions of an image in a visually and semantically plausible manner, offering a versatile foundation for various medical imaging applications. e8d2113088f5aec2a0cea1b3d6de39ff0e7b6ea3.abstract: Diagnosing diseases from multiple organs is common in clinical practice but remains challenging. e8ca72b43cc7d139711109ba577666a827541421.title: Deep Learning-Driven Automated Aortic Valve Calcification Assessment in CT Calcium Score Screening Images
e8ca72b43cc7d139711109ba577666a827541421.abstract: Aortic valve stenosis (AVS) is the most common valvular disease and the third most common cardiovascular disease, with a growing impact in the aging population. AVS culminates in heart failure if left undiagnosed or untreated. e81aa07dc2366dfa8334b176a6d24ccf757ca46c.abstract: Accurate assessment of cardiac function, such as ejection fraction using clinical images, requires high-fidelity medical image segmentation. A particular example is left-ventricular (LV) segmentation using 2-D echocardiography. While deep learning models excel in automating the segmentation with sufficient ground truth data, their performance is significantly challenged in real-world clinical settings by speckle noise, artifacts, and domain shift across scanners and sites. To address this, we propose a physics-informed framework that embeds prior anatomical knowledge to guide neural network predictions. e752191c9d2dee24f8441ad8f2a53f23290ad7d1.title: Explainable Variational Networks with Unrolled Gradient Descent for Magnetic Particle Imaging Reconstruction
e752191c9d2dee24f8441ad8f2a53f23290ad7d1.abstract: Magnetic particle imaging (MPI) is an emerging noninvasive molecular imaging technique. To address this challenge, we propose an interpretable variational network that unfolds the gradient descent solver into a learnable iterative architecture: Within an energy minimization framework, this network balances data fidelity (ensuring consistency with measured MPI signals) and field of expertise (FoE) regularization (constraining the solution space). e5a06393fe24d3ed05717371e36ce07a7e926194.title: On the Role of Adversarial Perturbations in Unsupervised Deep Learning for Enhancing Image Quality of Degraded Medical-Images
e5a06393fe24d3ed05717371e36ce07a7e926194.abstract: Unsupervised learning enables deep-neural-network (DNN) training without high-quality data. Typical DNN methods for unsupervised image quality enhancement either (i) focus only on spatially uncorrelated noise, (ii) demand a training set comprising multiple noisy acquisitions per scene, or (iii) apply only to specific data; these aspects limit their applicability to medical images in clinical applications. Moreover, most such existing methods lack robustness to out-of-distribution (OOD) images observed during deployment. We propose a novel unsupervised DNN learning formulation to enhance a variety of medical images. e58378db9388a45619e2490204ba4130cfa1963e.title: Dual-Domain Hierarchical Adversarial Learning for Semi-Supervised Multi-View Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation and Disease Classification
e58378db9388a45619e2490204ba4130cfa1963e.abstract: Accurate prenatal screening for congenital heart disease (CHD) relies on fetal echocardiography, yet clinical interpretation is heavily operator-dependent and hampered by the scarcity of high-quality annotated multi-view data. To address these challenges, we propose a Dual-Domain Hierarchical Adversarial Learning (DD-HAL) framework for the 2026 ISBI Fetal HearT UltraSound Challenge. DD-HAL incorporates three core designs: a multi-view-shared and view-specific multi-branch encoder-decoder architecture, a hierarchical adversarial domain adaptation module, and a Mean-Teacher semi-supervised framework with consistency regularization, which simultaneously addresses multi-view heterogeneity, label scarcity, and domain shift. Our codes will be publicly available at https://github.com/SnapeLocke/DDHAL.

e43c5999eb7e0aa7861472e46c6b7a3e2b91d06a.title: DIFF-MAMBA: Efficient State-Space Modeling for End-To-End Ultrasound Video Diagnosis

SDs are typically monitored through invasive, high-frequency electrocorticography (ECoG); however, detection remains challenging due to signal artifacts that obscure critical SD-related electrophysiological changes, such as power attenuation and DC drifting. Recent studies suggest spectrogram analysis could improve SD detection; however, brain injury patients often show power reduction across all bands except delta, causing class imbalance. e3fe492a540f457c690aa44789aff0e36e263a0e.title: Measuring and Aligning Abstraction in Vision-Language Models with Medical Taxonomies
e3fe492a540f457c690aa44789aff0e36e263a0e.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong zero-shot performance for chest X-ray classification, but standard flat metrics fail to distinguish between clinically minor and severe errors. This work investigates how to quantify and mitigate abstraction errors by leveraging medical taxonomies. We benchmark several state-of-the-art VLMs using hierarchical metrics and introduce Catastrophic Abstraction Errors to capture cross-branch mistakes. Our results reveal substantial misalignment of VLMs with clinical taxonomies despite high flat performance. To address this, we propose risk-constrained thresholding and taxonomy-aware fine-tuning with radial embeddings, which reduce severe abstraction errors to below 2% while maintaining competitive performance. e2ef8105092768d30091f2a9c962bfcdeffd51ea.title: Selective Visual Program Reasoning in Whole-Slide Large Vision-Language Models
e2ef8105092768d30091f2a9c962bfcdeffd51ea.abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) show potential in pathology image diagnosis but struggle with fine-grained feature extraction from gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs). To address this, we propose a two-stage framework that uses external visual programs to enhance visual input for pathology question answering. First, an LLM-guided visual program selection module trains the VLM to choose relevant programs and generate interpretable rationales. Second, the selected programs are executed on WSIs to extract detailed visual features, which are then fused into the VLM for accurate slide-level QA. We also introduce SlideVLM, a vision-language model backbone with a visual token selection mechanism designed for efficient WSI processing in both stages. e2497cb1f25cf3bf326b555e1fae088f1d557cc9.title: 3D DoseGLA: Gated Linear Attention with Wavelet-Domain Constraint for Efficient 3D Radiotherapy Dose Prediction
e2497cb1f25cf3bf326b555e1fae088f1d557cc9.abstract: Dose calculation, as the core of radiotherapy, remains a timeconsuming and experience-dependent process. While deep learning methods have been proposed to improve efficiency, they often face challenges in global modeling and computational complexity, especially with 3D data, limiting their clinical applicability. Moreover, their predicted dose maps are often over-smoothed due to pixel-wise loss functions such as L1 loss that ignore inter-pixel relationship. e220b01187f043c4f94d143427953de10949adb9.abstract: Cognition emerges from the adaptive coordination of neural systems responding to internal demands and external stimuli. e1f8be76c616951b8982665116627294b717a064.title: Deep Multimodal Integration of Whole Slide Images and Pathology Reports for Precise Estrogen Receptor Classification in Breast Cancer

e1998a87bc092e7b68e46040aaff7a313e9aa5b0.title: A Comparison of Object Detection and Phrase Grounding Models in Chest X-Ray Abnormality Localization Using Eye-Tracking Data
e1998a87bc092e7b68e46040aaff7a313e9aa5b0.abstract: Chest diseases rank among the most prevalent and dangerous global health issues. Object detection and phrase grounding deep learning models interpret complex radiology data to as-sist healthcare professionals in diagnosis. Object detection locates abnormalities for classes, while phrase grounding lo-cates abnormalities for textual descriptions. This paper inves-tigates how text enhances abnormality localization in chest X-rays by comparing the performance and explainability of these two tasks. To establish an explainability benchmark, we proposed an automatic pipeline to generate image regions for report sentences using radiologists' eye-tracking data1. The better performance - mIoU = 36% vs. 20% - and ex-plainability - Containment ratio 48% vs. 26% - of the phrase grounding model infers the effectiveness of text in enhancing chest X-ray abnormality localization.

Then, a meta-learning scheme enforces intra-class compactness and inter-class separability via a triplet loss in the inner loop, while the outer loop minimizes correlation alignment loss for site invariance.
