dc99ea7b65f0f2c92fc67917119db27dad30c6e1.title: Unsupervised Confidence Calibration for Active Learning
dc99ea7b65f0f2c92fc67917119db27dad30c6e1.abstract: In active learning, training data to be annotated is generally selected based on the confidence scores output by a classifier. However, the selection of the initial training data pool typically relies on random sampling since the classifier has not yet been trained. To address this issue, it is necessary to obtain a classifier that can appropriately assess confidence without supervised learning at the initial pool selection stage. In this study, we propose an unsupervised confidence calibration method based on domain adaptation. The proposed framework integrates a variational autoencoder into an unsupervised domain adaptation method and trains them simultaneously, thereby allowing the estimation of the joint distribution of input data and class labels. The proposed framework enables the classifier to compute reliable confidence scores for the target domain in a completely unsupervised ma

dc3d440b428b2a55e72976287a1a8468cfa6576f.title: RDMP: A Reference Detection and Mask Propagation Pipeline for Numerous 3D Glomeruli Segmentation in Large Volumes
dc3d440b428b2a55e72976287a1a8468cfa6576f.abstract: Quantitative analysis of numerous repetitive structures in large volumes is one of the most challenging tasks in biomedical imaging, primarily due to its intensive manual requirements. Kidney glomeruli exemplify this challenge due to their dispersion across the cortical region, high density and microscopic size. To address this, we present a Reference Detection and Mask Propagation (RDMP) pipeline that combines object detection with 2D and 3D mask propagation, gradually achieving efficient segmentation of the entire volume by using a 2D reference example. Our method demonstrates robust performance, achieving a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.9096 on microCT data, and when generalized to Synchrotron Radiation X-ray (SRX) data, reaching a DSC of 0.8431 with only minimal bounding box fine-tuning. Overall, this pipeline shows strong potential for efficient, large-scale kidney analysis
dc3d440b428b2a55e72976287a1a8468cfa6576f.zh_title: 大体积三维肾小球分割的参考检测与掩膜传播流程

dc3d440b428b2a55e72976287a1a8468cfa6576f.zh_abstract: 对大体积中众多重复结构进行定量分析是生物医学成像中最具挑战性的任务之一，主要由于其繁重的人工需求。肾小球由于分散在皮质区域、密度高且尺寸微小，是这一挑战的典型代表。为解决此问题，我们提出一种参考检测与掩膜传播（RDMP）流程，将目标检测与 2D 和 3D 掩膜传播相结合，通过使用一个 2D 参考示例，逐步实现整个体积的高效分割。我们的方法表现出稳健性能，在 microCT 数据上达到 0.9096 的 Dice 相似系数（DSC），并且当泛化到同步辐射 X 射线（SRX）数据时，仅需极少的边界框微调即可达到 0.8431 的 DSC。总体而言，该流程在高效、大规模肾脏分析方面显示出强大潜力

dba7cf324f444623879a579c22628b359e044d6e.title: Towards Encoding 3D Abdominal MRI Acquisitions as Neural Fields
dba7cf324f444623879a579c22628b359e044d6e.abstract: Medical imaging data is typically 3D, causing scan sizes and databases to grow cubically with resolution, unlike the quadratic growth in standard computer vision tasks. Compressing scan dimensionality is essential for deep learning, as raw data often exceeds GPU memory limits. Autoencoders are commonly used for data-specific non-linear compression, balancing compactness and fidelity. However, they are limited to the resolution of the training data. Inspired by Neural Fields, we propose an autoencoder with a fully-connected network as its decoder, and train it on the UK Biobank abdominal MRI dataset. Beyond more fidelity in the reconstruction, our encoding is a continuous function of 3D coordinates rather than 3D rasters like the original data, which enables our architecture to be utilized in a variety of applications such as super-resolution, in-painting and extrapolation. We show that t
dba7cf324f444623879a579c22628b359e044d6e.zh_title: 将三维腹部MRI采集编码为神经场

dba7cf324f444623879a579c22628b359e044d6e.zh_abstract: 医学影像数据通常是3D的，导致扫描大小和数据库随分辨率呈立方增长，而标准计算机视觉任务中则是平方增长。压缩扫描维度对于深度学习至关重要，因为原始数据常常超过GPU内存限制。自编码器通常用于数据特定的非线性压缩，在紧凑性和保真度之间取得平衡。然而，它们受限于训练数据的分辨率。受神经场（Neural Fields）启发，我们提出一种以全连接网络作为解码器的自编码器，并在UK Biobank腹部MRI数据集上训练它。除了重建具有更高保真度外，我们的编码是3D坐标的连续函数，而不是像原始数据那样的3D栅格，这使我们的架构可用于多种应用，如超分辨率、图像修复和外推。我们展示了 t

dba11f87181a8cb6ecc6f5423b75d1b0a6069fd0.title: Dihedral-Invariant LBP Co-Occurrence for Cellular Texture Analysis
dba11f87181a8cb6ecc6f5423b75d1b0a6069fd0.abstract: Co-occurring Local Binary Patterns (LBPs) capture spatial relationships between adjacent intensity transitions and are effective for texture-based biomedical image analysis. Existing rotation-invariant formulations, such as RIC-LBP, still treat mirror-reflected configurations as distinct, introducing redundant orientation variability. We analyze how the cyclic group $C_{2}$ and dihedral group $D_{2}$ partition the 256 adjacent 4-bit LBP pairs, identifying the cases where reflection merges rotation-generated bins. We propose a compact reflectionand rotation-invariant descriptor (RRIC-LBP) based on $D_{2}$ orbits, reducing the histogram dimensionality from 136 to 88. Evaluations on fluorescence microscopy of mitochondrial networks show statistically equivalent classification performance, demonstrating that the reduced representation maintains discriminative power.

db3f8b06b668e98abe5d2550b65bd25e2128f80c.title: Introduction of a Learned Prior to Passive Cavitation Imaging
db3f8b06b668e98abe5d2550b65bd25e2128f80c.abstract: High-intensity focused ultrasound can induce cavitation, enabling therapeutic applications, such as sonoporation, targeted drug delivery, or histotripsy, which require accurate monitoring. Passive acoustic mapping, known as passive delay-and-sum (DAS), is a common cavitation monitoring technique but suffers from limited axial resolution. Recently, a regularized inverse approach, cross-spectral matrix fitting (CMF), incorporating prior knowledge into the reconstruction process, such as the group sparse characteristics of cavitation power maps (CMF-spTV), was proposed. While this approach improves axial resolution, it may fail to reconstruct cavitation clouds under specific conditions, e.g., elongated in the lateral direction. Herein, we propose a plug-andplay framework using a deep denoiser learned within a deep equilibrium framework. The proposed method improves the F1-score by 2 percent

dad2a313ff5987fb13f55643fab00091af453bb9.title: Benchmarking Deep Learning for Future Liver Remnant Segmentation in Colorectal Liver Metastasis
dad2a313ff5987fb13f55643fab00091af453bb9.abstract: Accurate segmentation of the future liver remnant (FLR) is critical for surgical planning in colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) to prevent fatal post-hepatectomy liver failure. However, this segmentation task is technically challenging due to complex resection boundaries, convoluted hepatic vasculature and diffuse metastatic lesions. A primary bottleneck in developing automated AI tools has been the lack of high-fidelity, validated data. We address this gap by manually refining all 197 volumes from the public CRLM-CT-Seg dataset, creating the first open-source, validated benchmark for this task. We then establish the first segmentation baselines, comparing cascaded (Liver → CRLM → FLR) and end-to-end (E2E) strategies using nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, and STU-Net. We find a cascaded nnU-Net achieves the best final FLR segmentation Dice (0.767), while the pretrained STU-Net provides superior CRLM
dad2a313ff5987fb13f55643fab00091af453bb9.zh_title: 结直肠肝转移未来残肝分割的深度学习基准

dad2a313ff5987fb13f55643fab00091af453bb9.zh_abstract: 未来肝残体（FLR）的准确分割对于结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）的手术规划至关重要，以防止致命的肝切除术后肝衰竭。然而，由于复杂的切除边界、迂曲的肝血管系统和弥漫性转移病灶，该分割任务在技术上具有挑战性。开发自动化 AI 工具的一个主要瓶颈是缺乏高保真、经过验证的数据。我们通过手动精修公共 CRLM-CT-Seg 数据集中的全部 197 个体积数据来填补这一空白，创建了该任务首个开源、经过验证的基准。随后，我们建立了首批分割基线，使用 nnU-Net、SwinUNETR 和 STU-Net 比较级联（Liver → CRLM → FLR）和端到端（E2E）策略。我们发现，级联 nnU-Net 在最终 FLR 分割中取得最佳 Dice（0.767），而预训练的 STU-Net 提供更优的 CRLM

dacf7082386d2ff49f08cb2d2cc650dbc372300f.title: AICM: An Anatomical-Prior Integrated Conditional Consistency Model for Self-Supervised MRI Through-Plane Super-Resolution
dacf7082386d2ff49f08cb2d2cc650dbc372300f.abstract: High-resolution volumetric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is desirable for accurate diagnosis, yet clinical scans are typically acquired as stacks of 2D slices for reduced scan time, resulting in a loss of fine anatomical detail along the through-plane direction. To address this limitation, we propose AICM, an anatomical-prior integrated conditional consistency model for self-supervised through-plane super-resolution MRI. AICM enables single-step generation of high-resolution (i.e., thin) slices, conditioned on low-resolution (i.e., thick) slice inputs. By integrating anatomical priors from a medical foundation model (MedSAM) along with a physics-inspired self-supervised framework, AICM achieves high-fidelity slice super-resolution without paired supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AICM achieves image quality comparable to or superior to that of state-of-the-art generat
dacf7082386d2ff49f08cb2d2cc650dbc372300f.zh_title: AICM：解剖先验条件一致性模型用于MRI超分

dacf7082386d2ff49f08cb2d2cc650dbc372300f.zh_abstract: 高分辨率容积磁共振成像（MRI）对于准确诊断是理想的，但临床扫描通常以二维切片堆栈的形式采集以减少扫描时间，从而导致穿过平面方向上的精细解剖细节丢失。为解决这一局限，我们提出 AICM，一种解剖先验集成的条件一致性模型，用于自监督的穿过平面 MRI 超分辨率。AICM 能够在以低分辨率（即厚）切片为输入条件下，单步生成高分辨率（即薄）切片。通过整合来自医学基础模型（MedSAM）的解剖先验以及受物理启发的自监督框架，AICM 无需配对监督即可实现高保真切片超分辨率。大量实验表明，AICM 达到的图像质量与最先进的生成

da502bbf9d2bab1806791ace2ff3206147e89bf9.title: US-XAI: A Rag-Grounded Vision Language Model for Explainable Urinary Sediment Classification
da502bbf9d2bab1806791ace2ff3206147e89bf9.abstract: Urinary sediment analysis is essential for diagnosing renal and urinary tract disorders, but manual classification of components remains labor-intensive and prone to subjective variability due to visual similarities. Although deep learning (DL) has improved automated classification, most models offer only final predictions without interpretable justification, limiting clinical trust and hindering adoption. We present US-XAI, a multi-task VLM that performs classification and generates textual explanations for urinary sediment particles. US-XAI combines a Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder with a classification head for classification and a Large Language Model (LLM) decoder for rationale generation. da261228cbc12296f02f58ea565f63918c950497.title: Effective Feature Learning for 3D Medical Registration via Domain-Specialized DINO Pretraining
da261228cbc12296f02f58ea565f63918c950497.abstract: Medical image registration is a critical component of clinical imaging workflows, enabling accurate longitudinal assessment, multi-modal data fusion, and image-guided interventions. Intensity-based approaches often struggle with interscanner variability and complex anatomical deformations, whereas feature-based methods offer improved robustness by leveraging semantically informed representations. In this work, we investigate DINO-style self-supervised pretraining directly on 3D medical imaging data, aiming to learn dense volumetric features well suited for deformable registration. We assess the resulting representations on challenging interpatient abdominal registration task across both MRI and CT modalities. da261228cbc12296f02f58ea565f63918c950497.zh_abstract: 医学图像配准是临床影像工作流程的关键组成部分，可实现准确的纵向评估、多模态数据融合和图像引导干预。基于强度的方法常难以应对扫描仪间差异和复杂解剖变形，而基于特征的方法通过利用语义信息表征提供更好的鲁棒性。在本工作中，我们研究直接在 3D 医学影像数据上进行 DINO 风格自监督预训练，旨在学习非常适合可变形配准的稠密体素特征。我们在具有挑战性的跨患者腹部配准任务上评估所得表征，涵盖 MRI 和 CT 两种模态。我们的领域专用预训练优于在大规模自然图像集合上训练的 DINOv2 模型，同时在推理时需要显著更少的计算资源...

da127606ab1a416b05086cabd540368f5ed7d546.title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Out-of-Distribution Detection
da127606ab1a416b05086cabd540368f5ed7d546.abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for building reliable AI systems, as models that produce outputs for invalid inputs cannot be trusted. Although deep learning (DL) is often assumed to outperform traditional machine learning (ML), medical imaging data are typically acquired under standardized protocols, leading to relatively constrained image variability in OOD detection tasks. This motivates a direct comparison between ML and DL approaches in this setting. The two approaches are evaluated on open datasets comprising over 60,000 fundus and non-fundus images across multiple resolutions. Both approaches achieved an AUROC of 1.000 and accuracies between 0.999 and 1.000 on internal and external validation sets, showing comparable detection performance. The ML approach, however, exhibited substantially lower end-to-end latency while maintaining equivalent accuracy, indicating g
da127606ab1a416b05086cabd540368f5ed7d546.zh_title: 机器学习与深度学习在分布外检测上的对比

da11c7dfd3f4cc3fd68e25011f2fad95a4de1e8b.title: NC-REG: Neural Cortical Maps for Rigid Registration
da11c7dfd3f4cc3fd68e25011f2fad95a4de1e8b.abstract: We introduce neural cortical maps, a continuous and compact neural representation for cortical feature maps, as an alternative to traditional discrete structures such as grids and meshes. It can learn from meshes of arbitrary size and provide learnt features at any resolution. Neural cortical maps enable efficient optimization on the sphere and achieve runtimes up to 30 times faster than classic barycentric interpolation (for the same number of iterations). d9e35553c65e3c03204b8af54ece14e4c55abf8d.title: Human Brain Excitation-Inhibition Balance Through Fmri Dynamics: Estimators and in-Vivo Validation
d9e35553c65e3c03204b8af54ece14e4c55abf8d.abstract: Long-range temporal interactions of brain functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) signals offer a noninvasive window into human excitation-inhibition balance (EIB). We evaluated four Hurst exponent (H) estimation methods: continuous wavelet transform (CWT), discrete wavelet transform (DWT), detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA), and fractionally integrated noise (FIN) modeling. Validation first employed simulated fractional Gaussian noise and fractional Brownian motion signals of varying timeseries lengths, then phantom data to assess robustness to scanner noise. Restingstate fMRI and spectroscopy (MRS) data from 36 healthy participants enabled in-vivo validation by correlating H with biologicallyrelevant MRS-derived EIB in the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex. d9df60fa3074c1e9c99d968347b070d6a9d81567.title: Towards Multi-Label Open Set Diagnosis for Medical Images
d9df60fa3074c1e9c99d968347b070d6a9d81567.abstract: In real clinical scenarios, diagnosis algorithms may face the complex concurrent presence of multiple common, rare, or even unknown disease conditions. In particular, rare disease categories may be underrepresented or even absent from the class-imbalanced training set, leaving safe and trustworthy diagnostic decision-making extremely challenging. In this work, we first formalize the medical image diagnosis as a multi-label open set recognition under class-imbalanced training data and propose a novel Multi-label Open set Diagnosis (MOSD) solution to address this problem. Our MOSD first employs a Balanced Multi-label Data Augmentation (BMDA) module to augment multi-label image data to alleviate the class imbalance in model training more effectively. Then it also boasts a Multi-label Evidential Deep Learning (MEDL) module with tailored learning objectives to better estimate the uncertainty
d9df60fa3074c1e9c99d968347b070d6a9d81567.zh_title: 面向医学图像的多标签开放集诊断

d9df60fa3074c1e9c99d968347b070d6a9d81567.zh_abstract: 在真实临床场景中，诊断算法可能面临多种常见、罕见甚至未知疾病状况复杂并存的情况。特别是，罕见疾病类别在类别不平衡的训练集中可能代表性不足甚至完全缺失，这使得安全且可信的诊断决策极具挑战性。在本工作中，我们首先将医学图像诊断形式化为类别不平衡训练数据下的多标签开放集识别（multi-label open set recognition），并提出一种新颖的多标签开放集诊断（Multi-label Open set Diagnosis, MOSD）解决方案来应对该问题。我们的 MOSD 首先采用平衡多标签数据增强（Balanced Multi-label Data Augmentation, BMDA）模块来增强多标签图像数据，以更有效地缓解模型训练中的类别不平衡。随后，它还拥有一个多标签证据深度学习（Multi-label Evidential Deep Learning, MEDL）模块，该模块具有定制的学习目标，以更好地估计不确定性

d8551d7070f00d44c4ac62552d8205dcab196fc4.title: PhysHVS-LDCT: Dose-Controllable Physics-Based Low-Dose CT Synthesis for Benchmarking and Data Augmentation
d8551d7070f00d44c4ac62552d8205dcab196fc4.abstract: Reducing radiation exposure in Computed Tomography (CT) remains a clinical priority, particularly for radiosensitive groups such as pediatric and pregnant patients. Although Low-Dose CT (LDCT) reduces radiation-related risk, lowering the tube current increases noise and artifacts that can compromise diagnostic quality. Progress in LDCT reconstruction is further limited by the scarcity of paired full-dose and low-dose data, as ethical constraints prohibit multi-dose acquisitions. Moreover, most public CT datasets contain only clinical-dose scans, restricting their use for low-dose imaging research. To address this limitation, we introduce a benchmarking-oriented generative framework for synthesizing realistic LDCT images from existing clinical-dose data. We further present PhysHVS-LDCT, a dose-controllable synthesis pipeline designed as an effective dataset augmentation tool. By utilizing
d8551d7070f00d44c4ac62552d8205dcab196fc4.zh_title: PhysHVS-LDCT：剂量可控的物理低剂量CT合成

d7fbdffd0133d18d0c45b8788cd312a159002001.title: Parallel Route Coherent Mixup Deep Learning for Single Source to Multi-Domain Generalized Prostate Cancer Segmentation for Mr Guided Adaptive Radiotherapy
d7fbdffd0133d18d0c45b8788cd312a159002001.abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) guided adaptive radiotherapy for prostate cancer (PCa) allows daily treatment adaptation to the geometry of tumor and organs to deliver precise treatments while sparing organs from radiation. However, manual delineation of tumors and organs limits the adoption of this technology. Deep learning (DL) methods, though promising for in-distribution (ID) data that resembles training, deteriorate in performance when applied to out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. Hence, we developed a novel parallel-route coherent feature mixup (PaRC-mix) training approach for single source to multi-domain generalization. PaRC-mix performs feature augmentations at multiple network layers through matching linear combinations of features extracted across training batches. d7fbdffd0133d18d0c45b8788cd312a159002001.zh_title: PaRC-mix：前列腺癌分割单源多域泛化

d7a6c9abe2225ed8956f9fae652247b6295e9a30.title: Learning From Limited Multi-Phase CT: Dual-Branch Prototype-Guided Framework for Early Recurrence Prediction in HCC
d7a6c9abe2225ed8956f9fae652247b6295e9a30.abstract: Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) is recommended in clinical guidelines for managing hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet complete multi-phase acquisition is often unavailable. Here, we present DuoProto, a novel dualbranch, prototype-guided framework that leverages limited multi-phase CT during training to enhance single-phase ER prediction in HCC. DuoProto aligns class-level representations across single- and multi-phase inputs via prototype learning, incorporates clinically informed ranking, and infers with single-phase only. Under conditions of class imbalance and missing phase, DuoProto consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving absolute gains of $3-9 \%$ across all metrics. The proposed framework provides a clinically aligned solution, enabling more informed decision-making. Code is available at https://github.com/idssplab/DuoProto.

d545505b93951ac197994631fdeb20b343f03801.title: Variational Reference-Free Multicontrast Super Resolution for MRI
d545505b93951ac197994631fdeb20b343f03801.abstract: Many medical protocols benefit from the wide variety of soft tissue contrasts that can be obtained from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) with high spatial resolution. However, acquiring high-resolution 3D MRI volumes for different contrasts can require significant acquisition time. In this respect, multicontrast reconstruction strategies offer a potential solution. To circumvent acquisition time, the presence of information redundancy in the measurements can be exploited. Multicontrast super-resolution (MSR) uses anatomical information from a specific contrast, typically obtained from an isotropic reference, to reconstruct another contrast that has been undersampled. d4e64b5b31b5b74bbaefc04767723f7e577cfdc2.abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized medical image segmentation, significantly enhancing accuracy and automation in identifying anatomical structures and pathologies crucial for diagnosis and treatment planning. While powerful vision foundation models pretrained on extensive natural image collections have transformed computer vision, adapting these models to medical image segmentation presents unique challenges due to limited data availability, diverse imaging protocols, ethical concerns, and task complexity. To this end, we introduce DASAM, a novel medical image segmentation framework that addresses these challenges through innovative lightweight domain adaptation mechanisms. Our model captures multiple perspectives from chest x-ray reports through time-aware text guidance, potentially acquiring anatomical detail and pathology. This contributes to the synthesis of accurate chest x-ray images from the reports. d45d8daadacdab87b64d03cf5732f87264aa6860.title: Integrations: Informed Subset Selection Based Generation for Medical Imaging in Resource Constrained Setting
d45d8daadacdab87b64d03cf5732f87264aa6860.abstract: Deep learning models are revolutionizing the field of radiology and diagnostic medicine. However, these models require a large amount of labelled data causing an impediment to their utilization in low resource setting. In this paper (INTEGRATIONS, INformed subseT sElection based GeneRATion for medical Imaging in resource cONstrained Setting), we demonstrate that informed subset selection followed by human labelling and then Wasserstein GANs (wGANs) driven data augmentation performed comparably to large labelled data-based prediction. This demonstrates that despite having less amount of labelled data, one can reach the required quantum of large labelled data by data augmentation using wGANs, albeit if a small subset (10%) of images selected for human labelling is performed using informed subset selection.

d446b5f7ed0d737689276313cc50550a3ce70f90.title: View-Conditioned Semi-Supervised Learning for Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Analysis
d446b5f7ed0d737689276313cc50550a3ce70f90.abstract: Congenital heart disease (CHD) screening from fetal cardiac ultrasound is challenged by view-specific label validity, longtailed small structures, and scarce expert annotations. We study a semi-supervised framework with dataset-provided view information, a LoRA-adapted SwinUNETR, viewconditioned masking, weak-to-strong consistency, invalidmass suppression on unmasked segmentation logits, and anatomy-constrained stage-wise checkpoint selection. On our internal split of 311 labeled images, 2409 unlabeled images, and 80 validation images, the final fixed-threshold model achieved Dice 76.98, NSD 57.85, and view-masked MacroF1@0.5 0.513. Relative to the direct joint-training baseline, diagnosis improved substantially while high-quality anatomy was preserved. These findings support anatomy-protected semi-supervised optimization and provide a reference for official evaluation.

d370b65db7b706f1928d8efd5bba81bbe8322bc2.abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) is a functional imaging modality that enables the visualization of biochemical and physiological processes across various tissues. d370b65db7b706f1928d8efd5bba81bbe8322bc2.zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层成像（Positron Emission Tomography, PET）是一种功能成像模态，能够可视化各种组织中的生物化学和生理过程。最近，基于深度学习（deep learning, DL）的方法在直接将正弦图（sinograms）映射到 PET 图像方面取得了显著进展。然而，基于回归的 DL 模型通常会产生过度平滑、缺乏细节的重建（即低失真、低感知质量），而基于 GAN 和基于似然的后验采样模型往往会在预测中引入不期望的伪影（即高失真、高感知质量），限制了它们的临床适用性。为了实现稳健的感知-失真权衡，我们提出后验均值去噪扩散模型（Posterior-Mean Denoising Diffusion Model, PMDM-PET），这是一种基于近期建立的数学理论的新方法，旨在探索感知-失真（perception-distor）的闭式表达式

d33f0d30ded3321746ab85eafb27c16f4b8c4e72.title: A Temporally Aware Transformer Model for Predicting Personalized Head Growth and Surgical Outcomes in Craniosynostosis
d33f0d30ded3321746ab85eafb27c16f4b8c4e72.abstract: Craniosynostosis is the premature fusion of the cranial sutures, often requiring corrective surgery. However, treatment selection remains subjective due to the lack of longitudinal image datasets, hindering the creation of tools that can predict pathologic development and treatment outcomes. In this work, we introduce a temporally aware transformer to predict personalized cranial development before and after treatment using a unique longitudinal 3D craniofacial photogrammetry dataset. We combine a geometric autoencoder to create low-dimensional encodings of each photogram and a dual-branch transformer guided by developmental context embeddings for independent modeling of natural growth and anatomical changes introduced by surgery. Trained on 1,493 pre- and postsurgical 3D photograms, our method outperformed state-of-the-art models with a point-to-point prediction error of 2.09 $\pm 1.51
d33f0d30ded3321746ab85eafb27c16f4b8c4e72.zh_title: 时间感知Transformer预测颅缝早闭头颅生长与手术结局
d33f0d30ded3321746ab85eafb27c16f4b8c4e72.summary: 基于1493例纵向3D颅面摄影数据训练时间感知Transformer，预测个体化颅骨发育与手术效果，点位误差2.09±1.51。
key_points: 构建纵向3D颅面摄影数据集，含术前术后共1493例
几何自编码器与双分支Transformer分别建模自然生长与手术改变

d33f0d30ded3321746ab85eafb27c16f4b8c4e72.zh_abstract: 颅缝早闭（craniosynostosis）是颅缝的过早融合，通常需要矫正手术。然而，由于缺乏纵向图像数据集，治疗选择仍具有主观性，这阻碍了能够预测病理发展和治疗结果的工具的创建。在本工作中，我们引入一种时间感知 Transformer（temporally aware transformer），利用一个独特的纵向 3D 颅面摄影测量数据集来预测治疗前后个体化的颅骨发育。我们将几何自编码器与由发育上下文嵌入引导的双分支 Transformer 相结合，以创建每张摄影测量图的低维编码，并分别独立建模自然生长和手术引入的解剖变化。在 1,493 张术前和术后 3D 摄影测量图上训练后，我们的方法以 2.09 ± 1.51 的点对点预测误差优于最先进模型。

d18000cb3b9dadb02db1adc8ccdd367b00242f68.title: Abdominal Cone-Beam CT Visual Quality Enhancement Using 2.5D Conditional Diffusion Model
d18000cb3b9dadb02db1adc8ccdd367b00242f68.abstract: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is crucial for accurate patient positioning in image-guided radiotherapy. However, CBCT is often compromised by scatter, beam hardening, and limited projection angles, which result in increased noise and degraded image quality. These limitations hinder its application in quantitative clinical tasks such as dose calculation, organ delineation, and radiomics analysis. In this study, we propose a learning-based method for enhancing the visual quality of CBCT images using a 2.5 D conditional diffusion model. By leveraging adjacent slices of the CBCT as a condition, the model can learn structural consistency and provide restored images that suppress noise and artifacts through the reverse diffusion process. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior image quality compared to existing 2D diffusion approaches, validating its
d18000cb3b9dadb02db1adc8ccdd367b00242f68.zh_title: 2.5D条件扩散模型提升腹部锥形束CT图像质量
d18000cb3b9dadb02db1adc8ccdd367b00242f68.summary: 用2.5D条件扩散模型结合相邻切片信息抑制腹部CBCT噪声与伪影，图像质量优于现有2D扩散方法。

d1511128ebca36e42a3f74904bf89b455e806feb.title: MRI-Based Multi-Scale Multi-Modal Neonatal Brain Age Estimation Framework with Weight-Aware Feature
d1511128ebca36e42a3f74904bf89b455e806feb.abstract: Accurate assessment of postmenstrual age (PMA) is critical for evaluating neonatal brain development and predicting neurodevelopmental outcomes. This paper presents a novel multi-scale multi-modal MRI framework for neonatal brain age estimation that integrates body weight as a core feature alongside imaging data. Our approach leverages T2-weighted structural MRI (T2w) and fractional anisotropy (FA) of diffusion MRI (dMRI) employing a three-branch network to extract multi-scale anatomical and microstructural features from both modalities. A transformer module then performs weight-aware feature fusion, effectively combining imaging characteristics with clinical weight information for precise PMA prediction. Evaluated on the dHCP neonatal cohort, our method achieves a mean absolute error of 0.48 weeks in term-born infants. Furthermore, our analysis reveals significant brain maturation delay
d1511128ebca36e42a3f74904bf89b455e806feb.zh_title: 基于MRI多尺度多模态的新生儿脑龄估计框架
d1511128ebca36e42a3f74904bf89b455e806feb.summary: 提出融合T2w、dMRI与体重的多尺度多模态框架，在dHCP队列足月儿中PMA预测MAE为0.48周。
key_points: 三支网络提取多尺度影像特征
Transformer进行体重感知融合
dHCP队列MAE 0.48周

d1511128ebca36e42a3f74904bf89b455e806feb.zh_abstract: 准确评估经后年龄（postmenstrual age, PMA）对于评估新生儿大脑发育和预测神经发育结局至关重要。本文提出一种新的多尺度多模态 MRI 框架用于新生儿脑龄估计，该框架将体重作为核心特征与影像数据相结合。我们的方法利用 T2 加权结构 MRI（T2w）和扩散 MRI（dMRI）的各向异性分数（fractional anisotropy, FA），采用三分支网络从两种模态中提取多尺度解剖和微结构特征。随后，Transformer 模块执行体重感知特征融合，有效结合影像特征与临床体重信息以进行精确的 PMA 预测。在 dHCP 新生儿队列上评估时，我们的方法在足月儿中取得 0.48 周的平均绝对误差。此外，我们的分析揭示了显著的大脑成熟延迟。

d11782ac4eca72751d8f8bbbc335b3b52d81bcc4.title: Enhanced Graph Representation for Reliable Retinal Vessel Analysis: CLSA Population-Based Study
d11782ac4eca72751d8f8bbbc335b3b52d81bcc4.abstract: Several fully automatic pipelines have recently been published to calculate vascular biomarkers on fundus images, relying on deep learning models for the segmentation of the arterioles and venules (A/V). But the artefacts produced by those probabilistic models can be problematic for vascular graph parsing algorithms. We propose a graph-based heuristic-driven method to estimates the most plausible (according to clinical knowledge) vascular graph given an imperfect A/V segmentation map. Experiments show significant improvements in the classification of arterioles and venules on the MAPLES-DR dataset and enhance the reliability of vessel tortuosity measured on the CLSA dataset.
d11782ac4eca72751d8f8bbbc335b3b52d81bcc4.zh_title: 图表示提升视网膜血管分析的可靠性
d11782ac4eca72751d8f8bbbc335b3b52d81bcc4.summary: 提出启发式图方法，在A/V分割不完美时重建临床合理的视网膜血管图，提升动静脉分类与血管迂曲度测量的可靠性。
key_points: 基于图的启发式方法处理不完美动静脉分割图
在MAPLES-DR上动静脉分类显著改善
在CLSA人群中提升血管迂曲度测量可靠性

d11782ac4eca72751d8f8bbbc335b3b52d81bcc4.zh_abstract: 最近已有若干全自动流程被发表，用于在眼底图像上计算血管生物标志物，这些流程依赖深度学习模型对小动脉与小静脉（arterioles and venules, A/V）进行分割。但这些概率模型产生的伪影（artefacts）可能对血管图解析算法造成问题。我们提出一种基于图的启发式驱动方法，在不完美的 A/V 分割图条件下估计最合理（依据临床知识）的血管图。实验表明，该方法在 MAPLES-DR 数据集上显著改善了小动脉与小静脉的分类，并提高了在 CLSA 数据集上测得的血管迂曲度的可靠性。

d0ca207069b1f89e55e37284ec65f435f257287a.title: Zero-Shot Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Diagnosis via Medklip Fine-Tuning and Prototype-Based Prompting
d0ca207069b1f89e55e37284ec65f435f257287a.abstract: Zero-shot recognition of unseen findings in long-tailed(LT) multi-label chest X-ray classification remains a fundamental challenge. To address this, we propose a method that combines model fine-tuning with a class-prototype prompting mechanism. Semantic-Aware Vision-Language Pretraining leverages a medical vision-language model to align chest X-ray images with structured disease label representations, enabling generalization to unseen categories. Domain-Adaptive Fine-Tuning adapts the model to the target CXR dataset, enhancing discriminative feature learning while preserving cross-modal semantic knowledge to better handle long-tailed distributions. Finally, Prototype-Based Zero-Shot Inference constructs robust class prototypes from high-confidence samples, providing stable semantic anchors that guide zero-shot prediction for unseen diseases. Extensive experiments validate the effectivene
d0ca207069b1f89e55e37284ec65f435f257287a.zh_title: MedKlip微调与原型提示的零样本胸片诊断
d0ca207069b1f89e55e37284ec65f435f257287a.summary: 结合MedKlip微调与类原型提示，实现长尾多标签胸片中的零样本疾病诊断。
key_points: 语义感知视觉语言预训练对齐
域自适应微调保留跨模态知识
原型零样本推断处理未见疾病

d0ca207069b1f89e55e37284ec65f435f257287a.zh_abstract: 在长尾（long-tailed, LT）多标签胸部 X 线分类中，对未见征象（unseen findings）的零样本识别仍是一项根本性挑战。为解决此问题，我们提出一种将模型微调与类原型提示机制相结合的方法。语义感知视觉-语言预训练（Semantic-Aware Vision-Language Pretraining）利用医学视觉-语言模型将胸部 X 线图像与结构化疾病标签表示对齐，从而能够泛化到未见类别。领域自适应微调（Domain-Adaptive Fine-Tuning）使模型适应目标 CXR 数据集，在增强判别性特征学习的同时保留跨模态语义知识，以更好地处理长尾分布。最后，基于原型的零样本推理（Prototype-Based Zero-Shot Inference）从高置信度样本构建稳健的类原型，提供稳定的语义锚点以指导对未见疾病的零样本预测。大量实验验证了其有效性。

d0b0e80ae84ca194b0abd242ea9ae61ec00810aa.title: Latent Space Modelling of a Biomedical Multimodal Dataset
d0b0e80ae84ca194b0abd242ea9ae61ec00810aa.abstract: Clinical decision-making is rarely based on a single data source or modality. However, contemporary machine learning applications are mostly tailored to one specific modality. In this work, multimodal data integration, including histologic images and surgery-related texts, is tested for creating patient-level vector representations with information density comparable to that of pathologic analysis for Head and Neck (HNC) patients. Here, we rely on the multimodal HNCfocusing HANCOCK dataset. First, we transform individual modalities into vector representations using proven expert models tailored to their data types. Next, these are aligned into a joint latent space. Finally, the modality-specific vectors are recombined into a single patient-level embedding. With this approach, a mean AUC score of 0.67 for cancer-specific survival and 0.66 for 3 -year recurrence was achieved using only tex
d0b0e80ae84ca194b0abd242ea9ae61ec00810aa.zh_title: 生物医学多模态数据集的潜空间建模
d0b0e80ae84ca194b0abd242ea9ae61ec00810aa.summary: 在HANCOCK头颈癌数据集上，把组织学图像与手术文本对齐到联合潜空间并重组成患者级嵌入，报告癌症特异生存AUC 0.67、3年复发AUC 0.66。

d048868f2e6426b31d4e957df12d832d03380943.title: Comprehensive Attention Networks for Cell Segmentation Using Numerical Integration
d048868f2e6426b31d4e957df12d832d03380943.abstract: The emergence of neural networks has greatly improved segmentation accuracy in the domain of biomedical imaging, but the majority of existing solutions all employ the same general methodology. Attempting to generate entire masks at once naturally makes it difficult for a network to perform consistently well in every boundary region, especially when the objects to be segmented are complex. We describe a novel approach which combines attention-based neural networks with numerical integration methods to segment detected objects in a piecewise manner by tracing boundary pixels. This algorithm allows datasets with only a small number of annotated instances to be used for training and for behaviour analysis at the inference stage. We demonstrate our results on two datasets of the Cell Tracking Challenge, including simulated and real recordings of cells. The source code is available at https://
d048868f2e6426b31d4e957df12d832d03380943.zh_title: 数值积分注意力网络用于细胞分割

d048868f2e6426b31d4e957df12d832d03380943.zh_abstract: 神经网络的出现极大地提高了生物医学成像领域的分割精度，但大多数现有解决方案都采用相同的通用方法。试图一次性生成整个掩膜自然会使网络难以在每个边界区域都始终保持良好表现，尤其是当待分割对象复杂时。我们描述一种新方法，它将基于注意力的神经网络与数值积分方法相结合，通过追踪边界像素以分段方式分割检测到的对象。该算法允许仅含少量标注实例的数据集用于训练，并可在推理阶段进行行为分析。我们在 Cell Tracking Challenge 的两个数据集上展示了结果，包括细胞的模拟记录和真实记录。源代码可在 https:// 获取。

d03cea605d90bcd4ea231942f1e54e5261cbc870.title: Multi-Label Neonatal EEG Segmentation Enriched with Semi-Synthetic Data
d03cea605d90bcd4ea231942f1e54e5261cbc870.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in routine clinical practice. In particular, it is of the utmost importance for monitoring newborns suffering from acute neonatal encephalopathy. In such a pathological context, continuous acquisitions during the first days of life must be analyzed, which represents an insurmountable workload for clinicians. Machine learning approaches are a way of helping human experts in their work. More specifically, deep learning models have the ability to segment specific physiological and pathological patterns. The main obstacle to the development of these models is their correct training from a sufficient number of annotations. Indeed, building annotated EEG datasets involves a time cost that is generally unacceptable. In this paper, a deep learning model dedicated to the segmentation of multiple patterns in newborn EEG is proposed. We study the impact o
d03cea605d90bcd4ea231942f1e54e5261cbc870.zh_title: 半合成数据增强新生儿EEG多标签分割
d03cea605d90bcd4ea231942f1e54e5261cbc870.summary: 针对新生儿脑病连续EEG标注成本高的问题，提出多模式分割深度模型并研究半合成数据对训练的影响。

cfd621b54d2e053af04f639fd3a0d99a900d9e32.title: TMI-CLNet: Triple-Modal Interaction Network for Chronic Liver Disease Prognosis from Imaging, Clinical, and Radiomic Data Fusion
cfd621b54d2e053af04f639fd3a0d99a900d9e32.abstract: Chronic liver disease represents a significant health challenge worldwide and accurate prognostic evaluations are essential for personalized treatment plans. Recent evidence suggests that integrating multimodal data, such as computed tomography imaging, radiomic features, and clinical information, can provide more comprehensive prognostic information. However, modalities have an inherent heterogeneity, and incorporating additional modalities may exacerbate the challenges of heterogeneous data fusion. Moreover, existing multimodal fusion methods often struggle to adapt to richer medical modalities, making it difficult to capture inter-modal relationships. To overcome these limitations, We present the Triple-Modal Interaction Chronic Liver Network (TMI-CLNet). Specifically, we develop an Intra-Modality Aggregation module and a Triple-Modal Cross-Attention Fusion module, which are designed
cfd621b54d2e053af04f639fd3a0d99a900d9e32.zh_title: 三模态交互网络预测慢性肝病预后

cfd3d73de3fe4d96e401fda70929e2bc8f48bca6.title: A Multimodal Slice Discovery Framework for Systematic Failure Detection and Explanation in Medical Image Classification
cfd3d73de3fe4d96e401fda70929e2bc8f48bca6.abstract: Despite advances in machine learning-based medical image classifiers, the safety and reliability of these systems remain major concerns in practical settings. Existing auditing approaches mainly rely on unimodal features or metadata-based subgroup analyses, which are limited in interpretability and often fail to capture hidden systematic failures. To address these limitations, we introduce the first automated auditing framework that extends slice discovery methods to multimodal representations specifically for medical applications. Comprehensive experiments were conducted under common failure scenarios using the MIMIC-CXR-JPG dataset, demonstrating the framework's strong capability in both failure discovery and explanation generation. Our results also show that multimodal information generally allows more comprehensive and effective auditing of classifiers, while unimodal variants beyond
cfd3d73de3fe4d96e401fda70929e2bc8f48bca6.zh_title: 多模态切片发现框架用于影像分类失败检测
cfd3d73de3fe4d96e401fda70929e2bc8f48bca6.summary: 提出面向医学图像分类的多模态自动审计框架，在 MIMIC-CXR-JPG 上检测并解释系统性失败。
key_points: 将切片发现方法扩展到多模态表示

cfd3d73de3fe4d96e401fda70929e2bc8f48bca6.zh_abstract: 尽管基于机器学习的医学图像分类器取得了进展，这些系统的安全性和可靠性在实际环境中仍是主要关切。现有审计方法主要依赖单模态特征或基于元数据的亚组分析，其在可解释性方面有限，且往往无法捕捉隐藏的系统性失效。为解决这些局限，我们引入首个自动化审计框架，将切片发现（slice discovery）方法扩展到多模态表示，专门用于医学应用。使用 MIMIC-CXR-JPG 数据集在常见失效场景下进行了全面实验，证明该框架在失效发现和解释生成方面均具有强大能力。我们的结果还表明，多模态信息通常能够对分类器进行更全面、更有效的审计，而单模态变体则超出

cfbc8562d640e1b60f735ec555c22da3fa188bb4.title: Using Off-Target-Disease Data to Improve Target-Disease Lesion Segmentation
cfbc8562d640e1b60f735ec555c22da3fa188bb4.abstract: Does increasing the training data in deep learning always improve the accuracy of lesion segmentation on brain MRIs? To answer this question, we conduct experiments of small-diffuse lesion segmentation on 8 public brain MRI datasets with 3 different diseases, including Multiple Sclerosis (MS), White Matter Hyperintensities (WMH), and Chronic Stroke (CS). These diseases all have small lesions (lesions occupying < 2% of the whole brain MRI on average) that are often diffuse (injuring multiple brain regions), posing considerable challenges for lesion segmentation using deep learning. Our experimental results show that adding more data from other off-target diseases often led to a surprising decrease in accuracy on the target disease using a Naïve training strategy. ce220ec16b3fcda1a4d8eac3e85b1a509d580ee6.title: LOCBAM: Advancing 3D Patch-Based Image Segmentation by Integrating Location Context
ce220ec16b3fcda1a4d8eac3e85b1a509d580ee6.abstract: Patch-based methods are widely used in 3D medical image segmentation to address memory constraints in processing highresolution volumetric data. However, these approaches often neglect the patch's location within the global volume, which can limit segmentation performance when anatomical context is important. In this paper, we investigate the role of location context in patch-based 3D segmentation and propose a novel attention mechanism, LocBAM, that explicitly processes spatial information. Experiments on BTCV, AMOS22, and KiTS23 demonstrate that incorporating location context stabilizes training and improves segmentation performance, particularly under low patch-to-volume coverage where global context is missing. Furthermore, LocBAM consistently outperforms classical coordinate encoding via CoordConv. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/compai-lab/2026-ISBI-hooft.

cd668d951c38c080772932bba6af563128bc78cd.title: Robust Pediatric Brain Tumor Segmentation: Evaluating Modality Importance and Resilience in Missing-Modality Scenarios
cd668d951c38c080772932bba6af563128bc78cd.abstract: Pediatric brain tumor segmentation from multi-parametric MRI (mpMRI) is essential for treatment planning and disease monitoring. However, most deep learning approaches assume the availability of complete imaging protocols, which is often unrealistic in pediatric clinical practice due to motion artifacts or shortened scan time. In this work, we present a systematic analysis of MRI modality importance for pediatric brain tumor segmentation using the BraTS-PEDs 2023 dataset. A 3D SegResNet model is trained and evaluated under different modality combinations, where separate models are constructed for each available subset of MRI sequences. Results show that T2-FLAIR provides strong cues for whole tumor delineation, while T1c is critical for enhancing tumor detection. The exclusion of T1c leads to the largest performance degradation, whereas the model shows limited sensitivity to missing T1.

cd14be839aa8476f11fe58548f4fcd0bf9ad184e.title: LognormalNet: Parametric Survival Model with Uncertainty Quantification via Evidential Likelihood-Based Inference
cd14be839aa8476f11fe58548f4fcd0bf9ad184e.abstract: Due to censored observations and multi-modal data heterogeneity, reliable survival prediction is a significant challenge for patients after cancer treatment. In this study, we propose LognormalNet, a parametric neural network that performs survival estimation and uncertainty quantification using evidential likelihood-based inference. The model captures the nonlinear relationship between patient covariates and survival time under a lognormal distribution. To characterize prediction uncertainty, we employ a random fuzzy set, derived by linearizing the network output and using a Gaussian approximation of the likelihood function. This framework can capture both aleatory uncertainty and epistemic uncertainty. Evaluated on the HECTOR2025 dataset, LognormalNet outperforms other survival models while effectively quantifying prediction uncertainty.

c81b3d00abb7718fbc83ba7847fcb2da212b82bc.abstract: Cardiovascular diseases remain the leading cause of global mortality, underscoring the critical need for accurate and timely diagnosis. Echocardiography has been established as the primary non-invasive diagnostic tool, but its reliance on operator expertise leads to significant variability and limits access to timely care. To address these challenges, we introduce ResMSCAM-FFT Net, a deep learning model for precise semantic segmentations and measurements of cardiac chambers in 2D echocardiogram videos. Rooted in the U-Net structure, ResMSCAM-FFT Net incorporates Pyramid Vision Transformer v2 (PVT v2) encoder for efficient multi-scale feature extraction, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) Block to enforce global topological consistency and mitigate ultrasound artifacts, and Residual Multi-Scale Convolutional Attention Module (ResMSCAM) for content-aware local boundary refinement. c7bfd505ca36a070ee31b1244fe1b5d4a3a5c461.title: Multi-Stage Bidirectional Cross-Attention Model for Predicting Prognosis in Multiple Peritoneum Lesions with Clinical Information
c7bfd505ca36a070ee31b1244fe1b5d4a3a5c461.abstract: Peritoneal metastasis occurs when cancer cells spread from the primary tumor to the peritoneum, leading to morphological alterations that significantly impact patient survival. The specific changes across multiple peritoneal sites can effectively indicate a patient's risk level and prognosis. However, the considerable variation in peritoneal shape, size, and location poses significant challenges for feature extraction and prognostic analysis. Traditional multi-instance learning approaches typically fuse instance features extracted by the backbone network at the final stage, but their lack of intermediate interaction limits the ability to capture both common and distinct features. To address this limitation, we propose a Multi-Stage BiDirectional Cross-Attention framework (MSBDCA). c7bfd505ca36a070ee31b1244fe1b5d4a3a5c461.zh_title: 多阶段双向交叉注意力模型结合临床信息预测腹膜病变预后

c73ba45577b7077a9f454b23da3deeac1063c4df.abstract: Accurate grading of Conjunctival Melanocytic Intraepithelial Lesions (CMIL) is essential for treatment and melanoma prediction but remains difficult due to subtle morphological cues and interrelated diagnostic criteria. We introduce INTERACT-CMIL, a multi-head deep learning framework that jointly predicts five histopathological axes; WHO4, WHO5, horizontal spread, vertical spread, and cytologic atypia, through Shared Feature Learning with Combinatorial Partial Supervision and an Inter-Dependence Loss enforcing crosstask consistency. Trained and evaluated on a newly curated, multicenter dataset of 486 expert-annotated conjunctival biopsy patches from three university hospitals, INTERACT-CMIL achieves consistent improvements over CNN and foundation-model (FM) baselines, with relative macro $\mathrm{F}_{1}$ gains up to $55.1 \%(\text{WHO} 4)$ and 25.0% (vertical spread). c73ba45577b7077a9f454b23da3deeac1063c4df.zh_title: 结膜黑素细胞病变分级的多任务共享学习

c716bb4b17ecfff14d556967e65da0eb04c41424.title: Cervical Cancer Lesion Grading Based on Clinical Diagnostic Criteria and Multi-View Approach Using Intraoperative Colposcopic Images
c716bb4b17ecfff14d556967e65da0eb04c41424.abstract: Current research on cervical cancer grading often ignores the integration of clinical diagnostic practice, and effectively fusing multiple views of the lesion site is crucial for accurate analysis. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a multi-view classification network using acetic acid-stained colposcopy to screen intraoperative images. This model introduces a novel multi-linkage attention mechanism based on sliding Windows to enhance feature fusion across multiple views. Experimental results show that compared with Swin-Transformer, Vision Transformer and MobileNetV2(all without pre-training weights), the accuracy of the proposed model is improved by 2.60%, 9.68% and 14.43%, respectively. These results highlight the superior performance of the model in grading cervical cancer lesions and its potential as a valuable tool for clinical diagnosis.

c69fe4ad8123832eff95a89d01681cf2425bab90.title: DINOv2-Enhanced Dual-View Unimatch for Joint Carotid Plaque Segmentation and Classification
c69fe4ad8123832eff95a89d01681cf2425bab90.abstract: Carotid ultrasound analysis is significantly hindered by speckle noise, operator dependency, and the complexity of integrating multi-view information. Existing methods, often constrained by single-view perspectives and fully supervised paradigms, struggle to generalize across diverse clinical settings. To address these challenges, we propose DINOv2-Enhanced Dual-View UniMatch, a novel framework for joint carotid plaque segmentation and classification. Central to our approach is the utilization of the powerful DINOv2 foundation model as a shared backbone to extract robust, view-invariant features from complementary longitudinal and transverse scans, processed via independent DPT decoders. c69fe4ad8123832eff95a89d01681cf2425bab90.zh_title: DINOv2双视角框架联合颈动脉斑块分割分类

c690c2a6e1f940c3c1aa34f44732fd089c8e6e81.title: Leveraging Whole Slide Difficulty in Multiple Instance Learning to Improve Prostate Cancer Grading
c690c2a6e1f940c3c1aa34f44732fd089c8e6e81.abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) has been widely applied in histopathology to classify Whole Slide Images (WSIs) with slide-level diagnoses. While the ground truth is established by expert pathologists, the slides can be difficult to diagnose for non-experts and lead to disagreements between the annotators. In this paper, we introduce the notion of Whole Slide Difficulty (WSD), based on the disagreement between an expert and a non-expert pathologist. We propose two different methods to leverage WSD, a multi-task approach and a weighted classification loss approach, and we apply them to Gleason grading of prostate cancer slides. Results show that integrating WSD during training consistently improves the classification performance across different feature encoders and MIL methods, particularly for higher Gleason grades (i.e., worse diagnosis).

c690c2a6e1f940c3c1aa34f44732fd089c8e6e81.zh_abstract: 多实例学习（Multiple Instance Learning, MIL）已广泛应用于组织病理学中，用于对具有切片级诊断的全切片图像（Whole Slide Images, WSIs）进行分类。尽管真实标签由专家病理学家确定，但非专家可能难以诊断这些切片，并导致标注者之间出现分歧。本文中，我们基于专家与非专家病理学家之间的分歧，引入全切片难度（Whole Slide Difficulty, WSD）的概念。我们提出两种利用 WSD 的不同方法，即多任务方法和加权分类损失方法，并将其应用于前列腺癌切片的 Gleason 分级。结果表明，在训练过程中整合 WSD 可持续提升不同特征编码器和 MIL 方法的分类性能，尤其是对较高的 Gleason 分级（即更差的诊断）。

c67dee7cf68f33812a11f3f590a5fd1bb5b99c7b.title: Follow Your Heart: Landmark-Guided Transducer Pose Scoring for Point-of-Care Echocardiography
c67dee7cf68f33812a11f3f590a5fd1bb5b99c7b.abstract: Point-of-care transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) makes it possible to assess a patient's cardiac function in almost any setting. A critical step in the TTE exam is acquisition of the apical 4-chamber (A4CH) view, which is used to evaluate clinically impactful measurements such as left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF). However, optimizing transducer pose for high-quality image acquisition and subsequent measurement is a challenging task, particularly for novice users. In this work, we present a multi-task network that provides feedback cues for A4CH view acquisition and automatically estimates LVEF in high-quality A4CH images. The network cascades a transducer pose scoring module and an uncertainty-aware LV landmark detector with automated LVEF estimation. A strength is that network training and inference do not require cumbersome or costly setups for transducer position tracking. W

c5f49070827e70b30fb015366cc45c48dcb47405.title: Fedharmo: Harmonizing Global Aggregation and Local Alignment in Cross-Domain Federated Medical Image Segmentation
c5f49070827e70b30fb015366cc45c48dcb47405.abstract: Federated learning has emerged as the mainstream technique for breaking data silos in the healthcare domain by enabling collaborative training of machine learning models among different clients while ensuring data privacy. However, due to the discrepancy in the data distribution of each client, the aggregated model may ultimately be shifted towards certain clients. Consequently, we propose FedHarmo, a federated learning segmentation framework that employs an adaptive aggregation weight updating strategy to prevent model aggregation shifted towards certain clients. Additionally, we utilize the distribution measurement metric to minimize the distance between the global model and local models. Comprehensive experiments on ten medical image datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Our code are available at https://github.com/GGbond-study/FedHarmo.

c5f49070827e70b30fb015366cc45c48dcb47405.zh_abstract: 联邦学习（federated learning）已成为医疗领域打破数据孤岛的主流技术，它能够使不同客户端之间协同训练机器学习模型，同时确保数据隐私。然而，由于各客户端数据分布的差异，聚合模型最终可能偏向某些客户端。因此，我们提出 FedHarmo，一种联邦学习分割框架，它采用自适应聚合权重更新策略来防止模型聚合偏向某些客户端。此外，我们利用分布度量指标来最小化全局模型与本地模型之间的距离。在十个医学图像数据集上的全面实验证明了我们提出方法的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/GGbond-study/FedHarmo 获取。

c5e3414141bfc375d1659269bf4fe80d38e67186.title: SonoYOLO + MedSAM2: A Pipeline for Automatic Detection and Segmentation of Regions of Interest in Cardiac Ultrasound Videos
c5e3414141bfc375d1659269bf4fe80d38e67186.abstract: Precise evaluation of cardiac function is essential for early diagnosis, risk assessment, and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Cardiac ultrasound videos are widely used for this purpose, but cardiologists need to manually delineate the regions of interest in the videos, which is a time-consuming and error-prone process. While many automatic video segmentation methods exist, modern deep learning-based methods require dense annotations for training, which is labor-intensive. Recent zero-shot segmentation models specialized for medical data such as MedSAM2 do not require such dense annotations, but they still need manual prompts (e.g., bounding boxes), which hinders automatic deployment. Considering that breast density itself is an independent risk factor, an artificial intelligence (AI) framework that captures both local lesions and global anatomical context is required. c5dab4d958dc18890824de681dc123db4cb83bc3.zh_title: 乳腺癌诊断ViT的层级分析：超越注意力机制

c57d5c4b22763b8e5bbad4ddab28d1ca3f8874a6.abstract: Achilles tendinopathy is a common condition resulting in pain and inflammation in the Achilles tendon due to injury or overuse. Ultrasound is typically the medical imaging modality of choice during diagnosis due to its relatively broader accessibility, lower cost, and non-invasiveness when compared to other technologies but can produce noisy, poorer quality images depending on many factors in data collection. Past studies have applied fully supervised machine learning methods for detection of Achilles tendinopathy, requiring strenuous data cleaning and labeling, which is time consuming for physicians. To more closely align with a typical clinical workflow, this work applies a weakly supervised multiple instance learning approach with attention-based pooling to detect and emphasize ultrasound images in a set that are more indicative of a patient's tendon health. This approach achieved 97.
c57d5c4b22763b8e5bbad4ddab28d1ca3f8874a6.zh_title: 注意力多实例学习检测跟腱病变

c538ee76b36048a9a9a6b46e034147c6327a2ead.title: LF-MAMBA: A State Space Model-Based Framework for Accurate Bilateral Hippocampi Segmentation in Low-Field Pediatric MRI
c538ee76b36048a9a9a6b46e034147c6327a2ead.abstract: Precise segmentation of bilateral hippocampi in pediatric brain MRI is essential for studying early brain development and diagnosing neurodevelopmental disorders. Current deep learning methods face challenges with low-field MRI due to lower image quality, signal-to-noise ratios, and tissue contrast. We introduce LF-Mamba, a UNet-based model specifically designed for low-field pediatric MRI segmentation, integrating structured state-space modeling for long-range dependency capture and frequency domain attention for effective feature fusion. We extensively evaluated LF-Mamba against state-of-the-art models on the LISA dataset, with results demonstrating that LF-Mamba outperforms existing models, achieving a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 45.23% and a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 60.24%. c36c22a1ba2bed5b6b429f54aa06b44419fdd78d.abstract: The heterogeneity and complexity of breast lesions, along with the vast amount of imaging data provided by each sequence Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), make breast cancer diagnosis highly challenging. Many studies use deep learning methods for multi-sequence MRI joint analysis to improve diagnostic performance. However, existing approaches often ignore the requirements for distinct feature learning processes for different sequence MRIs. Additionally, they have not fully leveraged or discriminated relevant information during modeling, limiting the effectiveness of the model. c2b23e9ca69ae9677b19d25ae467e767534ec8df.abstract: Myocardial transmembrane potential (TMP) offers greater clinical value than body surface potential (BSP) or heart-surface reconstructions. In this work, we propose a TMP reconstruction method based on a convergent learned descent-type algorithm (LDA) and its induced deep neural network. Specifically, we propose a variational model where the data fidelity term links BSP measurements to the TMP via a heart-torso geometric matrix. c0f26181d15a130709e588d71bea6abe29f6349b.title: A Proximal Approach for Stain Separation and Normalization of Whole-Slide Histopathological Images
c0f26181d15a130709e588d71bea6abe29f6349b.abstract: Stain variability in histopathological images presents a major obstacle to developing accurate and reliable computer-aided diagnosis systems. In this paper, we introduce a novel stain normalization framework based on a stain separation proximal algorithm. Specifically, we first propose a new stain separation method that extracts individual stain components from a given stained image. Subsequently, we perform stain normalization by aligning the separated source stains with those of a target reference image. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively reduces inter-image color variations while preserving the essential structural details of the tissue.

c0c1f91b271af537fbfafdd5f0ed6c0c1674359f.abstract: Virtual staining has emerged as a promising approach to reduce laboratory workload and enhance digital hematopathology workflows. The model introduces a class-conditioned pairing strategy and a classification consistency loss guided by an external DenseNet-based sideroblast classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. c0bf1accd6f9d110430b7ef1970e9a13149fe7b5.title: Ucad: Uncertainty-Guided Contour-Aware Displacement for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

To address these issues, we propose UCAD, an Uncertainty-Guided Contour-Aware Displacement framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation that preserves contour-aware semantics while enhancing consistency learning. Our UCAD leverages superpixels to generate anatomically coherent regions aligned with anatomy boundaries, and an uncertainty-guided selection mechanism to selectively displace challenging regions for better consistency learning. c00412ea8643893fcf350368e915c6234fd13b15.title: Generalize or Specialize? The Effect of Coil Combining in Deep Learning Based MR Image Reconstruction
c00412ea8643893fcf350368e915c6234fd13b15.abstract: With the advent of deep-learning based MR image reconstruction, new questions are raised regarding best design choices. In particular, when using recent reconstruction models that have been developed for processing multi-channel MR data. A fundamental question is whether to first combine channels to improve model generalizability (i.e., a “coil-combined” approach) or to keep channel processing separate to fully utilize multi-channel information (i.e., an “all-coil” approach). In this work, we compare three popular architectures using coil-combined and all-coil styles on brain MR images. All-coil styles improved in-distribution performance, such as when reconstructing only presumed healthy individu-als. Coil-combined designs better generalized to unseen data from patients with pathology.

However, the rarity of MS limits the availability of labeled data for model training, and the poor interpretability of many ML models hinders clinical adoption. We propose ProtoMSNet, a prototypical network for MS detection from easily acquired echocardiographic views. bd584fd0f78bf36e0a1e2e0dd8a4de71575c1514.abstract: Ventricular tachycardia (VT) refractory to conventional therapies can be treated with stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR), yet its biological mechanisms remain unclear. Twenty-one anatomical landmarks enabled consistent registration of CT, radiation dose maps and histopathology descriptors. It leverages a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline to extract contextual information from evidence-based resources including PubMed database and current clinical guidelines. bcff0e10f965bf0a1b9d88b8101182de3372ddcc.title: Time-Aware Neural Operator for Liver Radiofrequency Ablation Planning
bcff0e10f965bf0a1b9d88b8101182de3372ddcc.abstract: Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) benefits from fast, accurate predictors of thermal dose, yet high-fidelity FEM solvers remain too slow for routine treatment planning. We present a time-aware, hybrid 3D Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) surrogate for liver RFA that performs one-shot prediction at arbitrary times. The model combines an FNO trunk with explicit time conditioning and a factorised spatial modulator that generates per-parameter scale/shift fields from temporal and biophysical (electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity and perfusion) inputs, enabling structured, physics-guided modulation of the operator. bc462f6337c6fece9572344394a5812985a9ef5a.abstract: Surgical phase recognition is critical for context-aware interventions, but deep learning models require large, costly annotated datasets. ba19ce1efe26aefe07b24f10d852904bf34918b0.title: A Multi-Modal Transformer for Ultrasound-Guided Diffuse Optical Tomography
ba19ce1efe26aefe07b24f10d852904bf34918b0.abstract: Diffuse Optical Tomography (DOT) is a non-invasive imaging modality that estimates tissue optical properties using near-infrared (NIR) light. Conventional DOT reconstruction methods suffer from poor spatial resolution and instability due to the ill-posed inverse problem. In this work, we propose MDOT-former, a multi-modal transformer that integrates B-mode ultrasound (US) imaging with DOT to enhance reconstruction accuracy. The proposed model employs a multimodal cross-attention transformer to extract morphological features from US images and improve the localization and quantification of optical properties. To facilitate model training, we introduce an in-silico simulation framework that synthesizes paired DOT and US data. We evaluate MDOT-former using both in-silico and ex-vivo experiments, demonstrating a significant improvement over state-of-the-art (SOTA) learning-based algorithms.

b899b1d5686c5ed4d7c247d22b82ae81647aa4f0.abstract: Reconstructing the cortical surface from brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans is crucial for cortical surface analysis. However, existing cortical surface reconstruction (CSR) methods are mostly tailored for high-resolution MRI with specific parameters, whereas clinical scans often suffer from thicker slices and inconsistent resolutions. To address this, we propose a two-stage deep learning approach for accurate and robust cortical surface reconstruction from MRI with arbitrary slice thickness. In the first stage, we employ an implicit neural representation (INR) super-resolution method with cycle-consistency loss to unify MRI with varying slice thicknesses to a consistent thickness while preserving underlying statistical properties. b7892e03fa21c9e1551c162a8a7736e6850c1393.title: Dynamic Group Joint ICA (Dyna-gjICA) Uncovers Neural Mechanisms Underlying Depression with and without Anxiety
b7892e03fa21c9e1551c162a8a7736e6850c1393.abstract: Multimodal fusion of electroencephalography (EEG) and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) remains challenging because EEG and fMRI differ in structure, and most existing methods compress their dynamics into static summaries. Previously, we developed a group joint independent component analysis (gjICA) framework to jointly decompose EEG and fMRI, but it did not capture spatially evolving fMRI networks. Here, we extend gjICA to dynamic gjICA (Dyna-gjICA) to incorporate spatial dynamic features of fMRI, enabling joint analysis of time-resolved fMRI networks and EEG spectral dynamics. Applied to simultaneous EEG-fMRI data from 65 anxious-depression (AD) and 65 non-anxious-depression (NAD) patients, the model identified one significant subcortical, two dorsalattention, and one language component discriminating AD from NAD. b76e738afb0165edb4ec12359d009581f44c2d6c.title: Prompt-Free Lightweight Sam Adaptation for Histopathology Nuclei Segmentation with Strong Cross-Dataset Generalization
b76e738afb0165edb4ec12359d009581f44c2d6c.abstract: Histopathology nuclei segmentation is crucial for quantitative tissue analysis and cancer diagnosis. Although existing segmentation methods have achieved strong performance, they are often computationally heavy and show limited generalization across datasets, which constrains their practical deployment. Recent SAM-based approaches have shown great potential in general and medical imaging, but typically rely on prompt guidance or complex decoders, making them less suitable for histopathology images with dense nuclei and heterogeneous appearances. We propose a prompt-free and lightweight SAM adaptation that leverages multi-level encoder features and residual decoding for accurate and efficient nuclei segmentation. b723549f9edaa31313dcc3d6e55d37372975b6fe.title: Scribble-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation With Dynamic Teacher Switching and Hierarchical Consistency
b723549f9edaa31313dcc3d6e55d37372975b6fe.abstract: Scribble-supervised methods have emerged to mitigate the prohibitive annotation burden in medical image segmentation. However, the inherent sparsity of these annotations introduces significant ambiguity, which results in noisy pseudo-label propagation and hinders the learning of robust anatomical boundaries. To address this challenge, we propose SDTNet, a novel dual-teacher, single-student framework designed to maximize supervision quality from these weak signals. Our method features a Dynamic Teacher Switching (DTS) module to adaptively select the most reliable teacher. This selected teacher then guides the student via two synergistic mechanisms: high-confidence pseudo-labels, refined by a Pick Reliable Pixels (PRP) mechanism, and multi-level feature alignment, enforced by a Hierarchical Consistency (HiCo) module. b6dbf8ee9ecf84d0cb549594e2e5f9a4982dec6f.title: Iterative Confidence-Based Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Lung Cancer Segmentation Under Annotation Scarcity
b6dbf8ee9ecf84d0cb549594e2e5f9a4982dec6f.abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising solution to the annotation scarcity challenge in medical image segmentation. In this work, we propose a novel iterative confidencebased SSL framework for 3D lung tumor segmentation that combines model ensembling with quality-aware pseudo-label selection. Using a few labeled CT scans only, our method estimates a confidence score from inter-model agreement showing strong correlation with segmentation quality and outperforming Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty estimation. Further, by iteratively selecting the most confident pseudo-labels from unlabeled samples, our approach surpasses both supervised baselines and naive pseudo-labeling. b60ace7ea599bfa30ec3a64287a0ec4c4c35d4c1.abstract: Deep neural networks are increasingly applied in healthcare to detect and diagnose medical conditions, including breast cancer through mammogram analysis. However, these models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks and distribution shifts, undermining diagnostic reliability and trust. This study explores baseline methods to address these vulnerabilities and proposes a modified robust training approach to enhance model robustness and reliability in mammogram analysis.

b4e3f5e657cc54e681bc27e0d7fbda90408bb8bb.abstract: Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA) synthesis from non-contrast Computed Tomography (CT) scans offers a contrast-free alternative for vascular assessment, particularly benefiting patients at risk from iodinated contrast agents. However, existing generative models such as GANs or diffusion networks often fail to maintain vascular continuity and anatomical realism. In this study, we propose SAFM-CTA, a Segmentation-Augmented Foundation Model for high-fidelity CT-to-CTA translation. SAFM-CTA integrates a pretrained 3D Vision Transformer encoder that captures global anatomical priors with a multitask decoder jointly trained for CTA synthesis and vascular segmentation. Through segmentation-guided optimization and vessel-weighted content loss, the model enforces explicit anatomical consistency during generation. b40941ac9cb2e407428209b3009d69385c815672.abstract: Medical image segmentation is crucial for precise diagnosis and quantitative analysis, yet its widespread adoption faces two main challenges: 1) the high cost and expertise required for pixel-level annotation, and 2) the computational complexity of model training. Recently, vision foundation models (VFMs), particularly the Segment Anything Model (SAM), have demonstrated strong prompt-based generalization for accurate boundary detection. However, automatically generating precise prompts for SAM remains a key bottleneck. To address these issues, we propose a training-free, one-shot framework that generates prompts by transferring a label from a support image to a query image based on DINOv3 feature similarity. b35563dab221a10a9b61c51b28c275811d97b89f.abstract: Image denoising is a persistent challenge, often relying on paired datasets or known noise distributions. While deep neural networks are effective, they are impractical for medical applications like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) due to their dependency on paired datasets and struggle with unknown noise distributions. Recent advances in self-supervised techniques and diffusion models allow denoising from a single noisy image, but current methods struggle with over-smoothing and hallucination, limiting clinical applicability. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-stage Ensemble Deep Learning framework that capitalizes on the power of diffusion models and operates independently of signal or noise priors. b2f1d0e4926fbc581a20bdf56c268755168c08ea.title: Towards Causality-Aware Modeling for Multimodal Brain-Muscle Interactions
b2f1d0e4926fbc581a20bdf56c268755168c08ea.abstract: Robust characterization of dynamic causal interactions in multivariate biomedical signals is essential for advancing computational and algorithmic methods in biomedical imaging. We introduce a DBN-informed CCM framework that integrates geometric manifold reconstruction with probabilistic temporal modeling. b22e3836e951b10c8b7671d6537b15e7a94a6e0b.abstract: Automatic polyp segmentation plays a crucial role in the early diagnosis and treatment of colorectal cancer (CRC). However, this technology often faces challenges such as complex polyp morphology, unclear boundaries, and limited generalization capability of the algorithms. b226b5d2eafb64321936135f0ded71c58b6de561.title: Polyp Detection in Colonoscopy Videos via Boosted Multi-Scale Feature Fusion
b226b5d2eafb64321936135f0ded71c58b6de561.abstract: Computer-aided detection (CAD) systems are vital for advancing colorectal cancer screening and prevention through effective polyp detection approaches. Recent breakthroughs in deep learning technology have greatly enhanced medical image analysis and CAD systems for polyp detection. This paper proposes to use a boosted multi-scale feature fusion method for polyp detection in colonoscopy videos. The method is evaluated on a publicly available colonoscopy video dataset, in terms of metrics mAP, precision, recall and F1-score. In comparison with other state-of-the-art polyp detection methods, our method achieves better performance in both accuracy and efficiency, positioning it as a robust choice for real-time polyp detection in colonoscopy videos.

ac3c3504381bba4523af0101ade334f61b8f57bc.title: Ultrasharp: Beltrami Transformers for Ultrasound Super-Resolution
ac3c3504381bba4523af0101ade334f61b8f57bc.abstract: Ultrasound (US) super-resolution (SR) is challenged by anisotropic point spread functions (PSFs), multiplicative speckle noise, and the clinical need for edge fidelity at tissue interfaces. We propose UltraSharp, a geometry- and physics-aware transformer that injects Beltrami image geometry into attention while enforcing formation-consistent reconstruction. The proposed framework employs edge-aware Beltrami positional encodings to capture geodesic structure, anisotropic geodesic attention to limit cross-boundary feature mixing, and physics- and speckle-aware losses to preserve realistic texture statistics. Across cardiac, breast, and fetal US, UltraSharp improves edge quality and texture while maintaining fidelity. We report standard SR metrics and USspecific measures, including contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), edge spread, speckle SNR, and downstream segmentation accuracy.

ac21ce97ce9141c8c70ef2c6d3ee1a69fbcd9f17.title: When Vision-Language Models Look but Don't See: Anatomical Bias in Endoscopic Spatial Reasoning
ac21ce97ce9141c8c70ef2c6d3ee1a69fbcd9f17.abstract: Reliable spatial understanding is essential for complete mucosal inspection during upper gastrointestinal endoscopy, particularly under the Systematic Screening Protocol for the Stomach (SSS). Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show promise for assisting navigation but often rely on textual priors rather than visual information, a limitation known as anatomical bias. To evaluate spatial reasoning, we introduce EndoSSS-RP, a benchmark based on the GastroHUN dataset (380 patients, 2,796 images, 3,678 binary questions). Each question, targeting left/right or above/below relationships between gastric surfaces (e.g., anterior vs. posterior wall), is tested on original, flipped, and rotated images to assess model robustness in determining relative position across different orientations. Prompts are structured across three levels: L1 (anatomical terms only), L2 (anatomical terms with visual markers)
ac21ce97ce9141c8c70ef2c6d3ee1a69fbcd9f17.zh_title: 视觉语言模型在内镜空间推理中的解剖偏倚

abe2f2488e7d3c248ebb556bb692b8886c8b7a27.title: Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Multi-Harmonic Feature Fusion and Enhanced U-Net for Low-Concentration Magnetic Particle Imaging
abe2f2488e7d3c248ebb556bb692b8886c8b7a27.abstract: To address weak signals and severe background artifacts in low-concentration magnetic particle imaging, this paper proposes a noise-resilient reconstruction algorithm based on multi-harmonic feature fusion and an enhanced U-Net(MH-U-Net). Our algorithm introduces enhancements in both the signal and image domains to improve the reconstruction quality. In the signal domain, the algorithm performs a weighted fusion of the imaginary parts of the 3rd and 5th harmonics, utilizes filtered back projection to preserve highfrequency edges, and employs a grid search to determine the optimal weights. In the image domain, an optimized U-Net architecture driven by a joint loss function is employed for precise denoising. Experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm achieves high structural similarity on the training set, demonstrating a substantial performance improvement compared to the baselin

aa989266490437145978c11e10154c882572df4b.title: A Calibrated Memorization Index (MI) for Detecting Training Data Leakage in Generative MRI Models
aa989266490437145978c11e10154c882572df4b.abstract: Image generative models are known to duplicate images from the training data as part of their outputs, which can lead to privacy concerns when used for medical image generation. We propose a calibrated per-sample metric for detecting memorization and duplication of training data. Our metric uses image features extracted using an MRI foundation model, aggregates multi-layer whitened nearest-neighbor similarities, and maps them to a bounded Overfit/Novelty Index (ONI) and Memorization Index (MI) scores. Across three MRI datasets with controlled duplication percentages and typical image augmentations, our metric robustly detects duplication and provides more consistent metric values across datasets. At the sample level, our metric achieves near-perfect detection of duplicates.

aa989266490437145978c11e10154c882572df4b.zh_abstract: 已知图像生成模型会将其输出的一部分复制训练数据中的图像，这在用于医学图像生成时可能引发隐私担忧。我们提出一种经过校准的逐样本指标，用于检测训练数据的记忆和复制。我们的指标使用由MRI基础模型提取的图像特征，聚合多层白化最近邻相似度，并将其映射为有界的过拟合/新颖性指数（Overfit/Novelty Index, ONI）和记忆指数（Memorization Index, MI）分数。在三个具有受控复制百分比和典型图像增强的MRI数据集上，我们的指标能稳健地检测复制，并在不同数据集间提供更一致的指标值。在样本层面，我们的指标对重复样本的检测接近完美。

a9f3a53e275fa4dcc614593bfea8e682fdf1319e.abstract: Multimodal neuroimaging has shown promise for improving the diagnosis of brain disorders. However, its clinical applicability is often limited by incomplete data due to high acquisition costs, equipment constraints, or patient compliance. Existing strategies, such as data imputation and knowledge distillation, suffer from noise propagation and poor adaptability to diverse missing modality scenarios. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel MultiBranch and Multi-Task Learning (MBMT) framework that leverages hard parameter sharing (HPS) to enhance knowledge transfer and incorporates feature disentanglement (FD) to effectively separate specific and common representations, reducing redundancy and noise while enabling complementary multimodal integration. a9f3a53e275fa4dcc614593bfea8e682fdf1319e.zh_title: 多分支多任务框架用于模态缺失的自闭症诊断

a9773476f751039fc838aa6170f50c75a9fea05a.title: Identifying Brain Strokes by Image Analysis Using Transfer Learning

The classification of brain strokes is crucial for accurate and timely medical treatment. Our research employs transfer learning, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), ResNet, RadiNet, and MobileNet algorithms, to classify brain strokes from Computed Tomography (CT) scans, focusing on improving both the speed and accuracy of stroke diagnosis using transfer learning techniques. To deal with the unbalanced nature of the dataset, we implemented various features of data augmentation techniques and achieved class balance in the dataset. a9514e6a955bd98f9e45643d979b715a57eb160d.title: Robust Classification of Urinary Sediment with Limited Data Through Semi-Supervised Ensemble Models
a9514e6a955bd98f9e45643d979b715a57eb160d.abstract: This paper proposes ensemble-based approaches to improve classification performance with limited labeled data in urine sediment images. These methods achieve significant advancements over conventional approaches. In experiments, for the case with 102 labeled data points, the proposed techniques achieved F1 scores of 0.884 and 0.901, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both precision and recall. Classification accuracy for rare classes, such as Cryst and Cast, also improved considerably. These results emphasize the effectiveness of ensembling in reducing overfitting and variance in data-scarce settings, particularly enhancing stability and accuracy for rare particle classification. This approach holds potential for fields like medical imaging, where data is often limited, yet high classification performance is essential.

a8c82bdf84fe2f69975bd991f43ad0b395bff720.title: EDA: Enhanced Domain-Adversarial Training for Anatomical Landmark Detection
a8c82bdf84fe2f69975bd991f43ad0b395bff720.abstract: Manually annotating anatomical landmarks in medical images requires experienced clinicians and is a labor-intensive process. However, recent AI-assisted methods for landmark detection often rely on the training and test data originating from the same domain. This work introduces a novel unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) framework aimed at anatomical landmark detection from a medical image, designed to bridge the gap between a source domain with labels and an unlabeled target domain. Specifically, we have developed a new Domain-Adversarial Network that incorporates skip connections to transfer and fuse high-resolution feature maps. Additionally, we proposed Dynamic Gaussian Learning, which allows the model to escape from local error regions. We carry out experiments on landmark detection for both head and chest, and the results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art perf
a8c82bdf84fe2f69975bd991f43ad0b395bff720.zh_title: EDA：面向解剖标志点检测的增强域对抗训练
