a8c82bdf84fe2f69975bd991f43ad0b395bff720.zh_abstract: 在医学图像中手动标注解剖标志需要经验丰富的临床医生，且是一个劳动密集型过程。然而，近期 AI 辅助的标志点检测方法往往依赖于来自同一领域的训练和测试数据。本工作提出一种新的无监督域适应（unsupervised domain adaptation, UDA）框架，旨在从医学图像中检测解剖标志，设计用于弥合有标签源域与无标签目标域之间的差距。具体而言，我们开发了一种新的域对抗网络（Domain-Adversarial Network），其引入跳跃连接以迁移和融合高分辨率特征图。此外，我们提出了动态高斯学习（Dynamic Gaussian Learning），使模型能够逃离局部错误区域。我们在头部和胸部的标志点检测上开展实验，结果表明我们的方法达到了最先进的性能

a8c09bcd9ec2bb3238400576b51bec3c0a9d6cb9.title: RWKVFUSE: Parallel Encoders Network for Medical Image Segmentation
a8c09bcd9ec2bb3238400576b51bec3c0a9d6cb9.abstract: Medical image segmentation is essential for accurate lesion identification and disease diagnosis. Conventional CNN-based methods are limited by their restricted receptive fields, whereas Transformer models effectively capture global dependencies but incur quadratic computational costs. Recently, sequence modeling approaches with linear attention mechanisms, such as the RWKV, have demonstrated the ability to model long-range dependencies with linear complexity. To address this, we propose a dual-encoder architecture, RWKVFuse, which integrates VRWKV and CNNs to extract fine-grained spatial features and long-range dependencies. Extensive experiments across four imaging modalities show that the proposed RWKVFuse model outperforms state-of-the-art methods in metrics such as DSC and HD95. Our code is available at: https://github.com/alqurri/rwkv

a8b29eab28b0bf1409602d1714ce5939aba0e926.title: Functional Network Connectivity in White Matter: A Group Informed ICA-Based Network Approach
a8b29eab28b0bf1409602d1714ce5939aba0e926.abstract: White matter (WM) has traditionally been undervalued in functional brain connectivity studies due to its weaker blood-oxygenation-level-dependent (BOLD) signals compared to gray matter (GM). Conventional atlas-based approaches often overlook the individualized aspects of functional networks, limiting their applicability for WM. In this study, we introduce the first WM intrinsic connectivity network (ICN) templates derived from a large dataset of over 100,000 scans, demonstrating the feasibility of estimating individualized WM networks using multivariate-spatially constrained ICA (scICA). By combining WM and GM ICNs, our work provides an expanded framework for evaluating functional network connectivity (FNC) across both tissue types, offering new insights into the integrative role of WM in functional connectivity. a8a3586062ac3446d87214e5886960b5c0605ab9.title: Hyper-DSCNet: Integrating Radiographic Details and Syndromic Context with Hypergraph Learning for Chest X-Ray Detection
a8a3586062ac3446d87214e5886960b5c0605ab9.abstract: Chest X-ray imaging plays a crucial role in thoracic disease screening, yet faces challenges in detecting complex lesions ranging from micro-nodules to interconnected syndromes like heart failure. Current deep learning models exhibit limitations in local detail perception and multi-lesion semantic relationship modeling. Based on this, we propose Hyper-DSCNet, a Hypergraph learning method that integrates three core modules: a Radiographic Detail Enhancement(RDE) module for small lesions, a Syndromic Context Modeling (SCM) module for capturing high-order associations, and a Multi-finding Adaptive Fusion (MFA) module for dynamic feature integration. Evaluation on the ChestX-Det dataset shows 3.0% AP50 and 6.8% AP-s improvements over baselines, demonstrating strong performance and clinical potential.

However, existing multimodal fusion approaches are shallow or over-homogenize the inherently heterogeneous characteristics of FC and SC, while expert-defined anatomical priors are underutilized with static integration. To address these limitations, we propose Brain Transformer with Adaptive Mutual-Distill and Selective Prior Fusion (BrainTAP). We introduce Adaptive Mutual Distill (AMD), which enables layer-wise information exchange between modalities through learnable distill-intact ratios, preserving modalityspecific signals while capturing cross-modal synergies. a7868670dbbd5822e22eb5a44ce0b1489a21b068.title: Joint-Specialist Learning with Endoscopic Descriptor Guidance for Ulcerative Colitis Grading
a7868670dbbd5822e22eb5a44ce0b1489a21b068.abstract: Accurate endoscopic grading of ulcerative colitis (UC) is essential for disease monitoring and treatment planning. Most existing approaches focus on predicting either the Mayo endoscopic score (MES) or ulcerative colitis endoscopic index of severity (UCEIS) independently, without modeling their clinical relationship. In the work, we propose a multi-task joint-specialist learning framework with endoscopic descriptor guidance (JSL-EDG) for comprehensive UC grading. Our method employs a shared encoder to jointly learn representations for both MES and UCEIS, while two dedicated specialist models further enhance specific scoring for each task. We present an endoscopic descriptor loss that supervises metadata to strengthen clinically meaningful learning for UCEIS. a67a49c3f863e38db389eb06dd99b133f2b3ef80.title: Automated Prediction of Paravalvular Regurgitation Before Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
a67a49c3f863e38db389eb06dd99b133f2b3ef80.abstract: Severe aortic stenosis is a common and life-threatening condition in elderly patients, often treated with Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI). Despite procedural advances, paravalvular aortic regurgitation (PVR) remains one of the most frequent post-TAVI complications, with a proven impact on long-term prognosis. In this work, we investigate the potential of deep learning to predict the occurrence of PVR from preoperative cardiac CT. To this end, a dataset of preoperative TAVI patients was collected, and 3D convolutional neural networks were trained on isotropic CT volumes. The results achieved suggest that volumetric deep learning can capture subtle anatomical features from pre-TAVI imaging, opening new perspectives for personalized risk assessment and procedural optimization.

a655ed6eef5cc3fa38d01487234320ebde69dc06.abstract: Deep learning models perform best when trained on large datasets, but in medical imaging, obtaining such data is challenging due to privacy concerns, scarcity of rare conditions, high costs, and time-intensive annotations. a6028bf72099d38c8c2446808fd762cb2ac583a1.abstract: Sarcopenia is an age-related condition characterized by progressive loss of skeletal muscle mass, quality and function, leading to increased morbidity and mortality. Early detection remains challenging due to lack of scalable assessment tools. POCUS offers a portable, non-ionizing modality for bedside muscle evaluation, but currently analysis is operator dependent and time-consuming. This study proposes, an automated framework for sarcopenia risk stratification from standardized POCUS acquisitions. A Vision transformer-based segmentation model (UltraSAM) was fine-tuned to delineate three lower-limb muscles in Bmode ultrasound images acquired from 70 elderly inpatients. a5c3b032f908a295fb35d6ea1060f6df4ca3ca38.abstract: Existing deep learning models for skin lesion diagnosis often operate as black boxes, lacking an explicit understanding of the pathological structures topology, which contradicts the diagnostic logic of dermatologists. To address this, we introduce DermPrism, a novel multi-stage framework. At its core is the Patho-Spatial Graph (PSG) Block, which decomposes the visual representation into a structured pathological graph. This is achieved by a Pathological Characteristic Point (PCP) Miner that identifies diagnostically salient points, a Hierarchical Graph Connector that builds a multi-scale topological map, and a Geometric Learner that reasons over this graph. By explicitly modeling the where and how of pathological features, DermPrism bridges the critical gap between pixel-level recognition and high-level clinical reasoning. a4cdeb7349ae59a080b988b5f2e8effa3db87b40.title: LIDSS: A Latent Information-Driven Dynamic Framework for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

However, existing methods often suffer from limited segmentation accuracy due to difficulties in effectively leveraging labeled data, which stems from low tissue contrast, ambiguous anatomical boundaries, and a lack of reliable supervision in unlabeled regions. a4b35dd1a2ce4e2276fd52086c26d27d9a866bd8.abstract: Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE), a delayed consequence of traumatic brain injury (TBI), typically arises more than a week post-injury. While pathological changes in white matter (WM) post-TBI have been highlighted using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), alterations in superficial white matter (SWM)-key in cortico-cortical connectivity-are less understood in PTE. We analyzed DTI metrics (AD, MD, RD, and FA) across 68 SWM regions in 27 TBI patients with PTE and 41 without, as part of the EpiBioS4Rx study. Employing Elastic Net Regression (ENR), we achieved an average area under the curve (AUC) of 0.86 in classifying PTE from TBI patients and identified critical SWM regions linked to PTE, including the right temporal pole, parahippocampal gyrus, and superior temporal gyrus. a3c61e7b41023e4285bced899490072964e6fabe.title: Hypernetwork-Based Adaptive Aggregation for Multimodal Multiple-Instance Learning in Predicting Coronary Calcium Debulking
a3c61e7b41023e4285bced899490072964e6fabe.abstract: In this paper, we present the first attempt to estimate the necessity of debulking coronary artery calcifications from computed tomography (CT) images. We formulate this task as a Multiple-instance Learning (MIL) problem. The difficulty of this task lies in that physicians adjust their focus and decision criteria for device usage according to tabular data representing each patient's condition. To address this issue, we propose a hypernetwork-based adaptive aggregation transformer (HyperAdAgFormer), which adaptively modifies the feature aggregation strategy for each patient based on tabular data through a hypernetwork. The experiments using the clinical dataset demonstrated the effectiveness of HyperAdAgFormer.

a32dda14d12d50c6cf35dfa4f99a9006f23e1359.title: Mitral Valve Deep Learning Localization in CT Scans for MIMVR Surgery
a32dda14d12d50c6cf35dfa4f99a9006f23e1359.abstract: Minimal invasive mitral valve repair (MIVMR), a recently developed method guided by video endoscopy, still remains complex and technically challenging. The clinical outcomes are strongly dependent on the appropriate choice of the thoracic incision, since it enables, or not, a good visualization and manipulation of the valve. This makes the accurate localization of mitral valve very important. a320a4e8373e3e2a5826afba02de2bad742c1248.title: A Foundation Model for Cell Segmentation from Immunohistochemistry: A Pilot Study
a320a4e8373e3e2a5826afba02de2bad742c1248.abstract: Cell segmentation plays an important role in the basic research and disease diagnosis of immunohistochemistry (IHC). Although frontiers of large foundation models have been well investigated in H&E stained computational pathology, few works have focused on the diverse and complex analytics of IHC cells, meaning there is currently no foundation model specifically pre-trained on IHC datasets. Furthermore, existing foundation models fail to adequately consider the diversity of contextual priors in IHC images, such as imaging, preparation, and staining methods. Additionally, in downstream segmentation tasks, the popular transformer architecture lacks designs for capturing the subtle structural features of cells. a320a4e8373e3e2a5826afba02de2bad742c1248.zh_title: 首个免疫组化细胞分割基础模型试点研究

a20d43267518100d4d5da93034c50c21cb8bc0bb.abstract: We present a deep-learning framework that estimates the two-dimensional left ventricular stream function directly from conventional color Doppler, bypassing velocity vector reconstruction. Ground-truth stream functions were computed from $i$ VFM-reconstructed polar velocity components and used to train an U-Net that takes five polar-grid channels as input (de-aliased Doppler velocity, Doppler power, binary left-ventricular cavity mask, and radial and angular coordinates) and outputs the stream function $\psi(r, \theta)$. Vortical regions were identified by the largest closed iso-contours of $\psi$. On a patient test set (317 frames from 3 patients), the model achieved a global $R^{2}=0.94$ and a normalized RMSE of $7.0 \% \pm 4.1 \%$, with strong spatial agreement of vortex regions (Dice of $0.90 \pm 0.02)$. The method was robust to reductions in Doppler sector angular width, where the $
a20d43267518100d4d5da93034c50c21cb8bc0bb.zh_title: Deep Vortography：彩色多普勒心腔内涡流分析

a1f6710b370e6d27a13ac0431924b7445833b132.title: Multi-Map Fusion for Weakly Supervised Disease Localization from Globally Assigned Diagnostic Labels in Brain MRI
a1f6710b370e6d27a13ac0431924b7445833b132.abstract: Deep learning for brain MRI analysis is often limited by the need for dense voxelwise annotations, which are costly and unreliable for subtle abnormalities. We propose GALAFormer, a weakly supervised Transformer-based framework that localizes disease-relevant regions using only subjectlevel diagnostic labels propagated to 2D slices. The method aggregates complementary internal localization signals-tokenlevel activation, attention rollout, and gradient-based rele-vance-through a confidence-guided fusion module, enabling anatomically coherent and interpretable localization without spatial supervision. Experiments on three $\mathrm{T}_{1}$-weighted MRI datasets spanning tumors, multiple sclerosis, and Alzheimer's disease demonstrate robust generalization and consistently improved localization over existing weakly supervised approaches.

a1f6710b370e6d27a13ac0431924b7445833b132.zh_abstract: 脑 MRI 分析的深度学习常受限于对密集体素级标注的需求，而这些标注成本高昂且对细微异常并不可靠。我们提出 GALAFormer，一种弱监督的基于 Transformer 的框架，仅使用传播到 2D 切片的受试者级诊断标签来定位疾病相关区域。该方法通过置信度引导融合模块聚合互补的内部定位信号——token 级激活、注意力 rollout 和基于梯度的相关性——从而在没有空间监督的情况下实现解剖连贯且可解释的定位。在涵盖肿瘤、多发性硬化和阿尔茨海默病的三个 T1 加权 MRI 数据集上的实验证明了稳健的泛化能力，并且相较现有弱监督方法持续改善了定位。

a1cb8a23f2e3cd6f636cc194c221330a1e4d59d1.title: Breaking the Disconnection Dilemma in Class-Imbalanced Cerebrovascular Segmentation
a1cb8a23f2e3cd6f636cc194c221330a1e4d59d1.abstract: Cerebrovascular segmentation plays a vital role in medical image processing, as it aids in diagnosing and treating cere-brovascular diseases. However, current methods often fail to meet the practical accuracy standards required in clinical settings. This paper presents a novel cerebrovascular segmentation method based on 3D UNet. First, we construct a connectivity matrix to obtain cerebrovascular connectivity information, which is then combined with the centreline distance weighted loss to effectively reduce errors caused by disconnection and class imbalance. To validate the effectiveness of this method, we conducted a series of experiments on a public dataset, and the results demonstrated significant performance improvements across multiple metrics in the cerebrovascular segmentation task.

a1b6bc9712d9b8a19f9b776bb0e426b11bebacf6.title: From Binary to Continuous: Learning to Continuously Quantify Histopathological Patterns from Binary Labeled Images
a1b6bc9712d9b8a19f9b776bb0e426b11bebacf6.abstract: Quantifying histopathological patterns on continuous scales is clinically valuable but often impractical due to annotation costs; most public datasets provide only binary or categorical labels. We present a probabilistic regression framework that learns continuous scores from binary supervision. Image patches are encoded into a latent space where a small set of learned prototypes captures intra-class variability. A Kernel Density Matrix (KDM) layer maps latent features to a full predictive distribution, enabling uncertainty estimations and prototype based interpretability. We study the approach on BreastPathQ, using its continuous cellularity scores only for evaluation while training with binarized labels. a171ab4e43f47debc034745b5b56b0cd89e6971e.title: Predicting Axillary Lymph Node Metastasis in Breast Cancer by Integrating Dual-ROI Features from Multi-Parametric MRI
a171ab4e43f47debc034745b5b56b0cd89e6971e.abstract: Prediction of axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer is a critical factor in determining the prognosis of breast cancer patients and the necessity of axillary intervention. However, current research methods are limited to single-parameter MRI sequences, only use images from the primary tumor area or the axillary lymph node region, and the methods for achieving feature fusion pay relatively little attention to modal interactivity. To address these, we propose a multi-modal fusion model that uses a Cross-Sequence Module to capture relationships between different sequences, while the interaction between the primary tumor and axillary lymph node regions of interest (ROIs) is achieved through a module we refer to as the Dual-ROI Dependency Module, in order to predict axillary lymph node metastasis. a171ab4e43f47debc034745b5b56b0cd89e6971e.zh_abstract: 乳腺癌腋窝淋巴结转移的预测是决定乳腺癌患者预后以及是否需要腋窝干预的关键因素。然而，当前研究方法局限于单参数 MRI 序列，仅使用原发肿瘤区域或腋窝淋巴结区域的图像，且实现特征融合的方法对模态交互性的关注相对较少。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种多模态融合模型，该模型使用跨序列模块（Cross-Sequence Module）捕获不同序列之间的关系，同时原发肿瘤与腋窝淋巴结感兴趣区（ROIs）之间的交互通过我们称为双 ROI 依赖模块（Dual-ROI Dependency Module）的模块实现，以预测腋窝淋巴结转移。实验结果表明，该方法取得了很强的预测性能

a0ec1fdabfa613cffb54c84c91110944e4dc1edd.title: PROZONESAM2: Prostate Zonal Segmentation Using Sam2 and Gland-To-Zones Consistency Constraints
a0ec1fdabfa613cffb54c84c91110944e4dc1edd.abstract: Accurate prostate zonal segmentation on MRI is crucial for prostate cancer (PCa) detection and treatment. Traditional CNN-based methods, though effective in single-center training, often lack global context awareness and generalize poorly to external datasets, especially in the peripheral zone (PZ) with fuzzy boundaries. Recently, foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have shown strong segmentation ability, but domain gaps and limited medical annotations hinder their direct use in medical imaging. To address these challenges, we propose ProZoneSAM2, a region-constrained fine-tuning segmentation method built upon SAM2. a0ec1fdabfa613cffb54c84c91110944e4dc1edd.zh_abstract: MRI 上准确的前列腺分区分割对前列腺癌（PCa）的检测和治疗至关重要。传统的基于 CNN 的方法虽然在单中心训练中有效，但往往缺乏全局上下文感知，并且对外部数据集的泛化能力较差，尤其是在边界模糊的外周带（PZ）中。近来，像 Segment Anything Model（SAM）这样的基础模型已展现出强大的分割能力，但领域差距和有限的医学标注阻碍了它们在医学影像中的直接使用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ProZoneSAM2，一种构建于 SAM2 之上的区域约束微调分割方法。ProZoneSAM2 仅微调记忆编码器和掩码解码器（5.58 M 参数），并引入区域约束损失机制（RCLM），通过约束 PZ 与中央腺体（CG）的空间互补性 wi 来强制它们之间的解剖一致性

a07bfde2716517f03c1fa32b4c8ce12d664fe2e5.abstract: Diffeomorphic image registration is a fundamental tool in medical image processing that facilitates medical image analysis tasks as it preserves the image topology during the registration. In this work, we focused on the traditional large deformation diffeomorphic metric mapping (LDDMM) and proposed a time-varying velocity prediction model by utilizing fully convolutional networks (FCNs) for fast dif-feomorphic image registration. In contrast to prevailing unsupervised learning-based registration methodologies, the proposed approach incorporated the Laplacian operator of LDDMM into the framework of FCNs for parameter learning. The evaluation of the proposed method involved the utilization of two distinct T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (T1w MRI) datasets. a0643c6f39c01a180c1490bfdbbab894e6f6f972.title: SLIM-UAM - Semi-Supervised Learning In Medical Imaging: Uncertainty-Attention Model
a0643c6f39c01a180c1490bfdbbab894e6f6f972.abstract: Deep CNN/ViT supervised models for medical imaging typically require substantial amounts of high-quality labeled data, which can be challenging in resource-poor settings. This paper proposes a novel attention-integrated uncertainty-aware semi-supervised framework for medical image segmentation. By implementing the mean-teacher model, a knowledge distillation technique, our framework leverages unlabeled data by encouraging consistent predictions under various perturbations. Enhanced with an attention mechanism, our model (SLIM-UAM) significantly improves segmentation performance tested on two datasets (Left Atrium Segmentation Dataset and Medical Segmentation Decathlon - Spleen Dataset). It not only outperforms SOTA semi-supervised methods but provides performance similar to SOTA supervised model trained using 4x more labeled data. a01980e536631bf315a4c241c1bbb881d09e0529.abstract: CT urography (CTU) is a widely utilized imaging technique for comprehensively examining the entire urinary system to diagnose causes of blood in the urine, known as hematuria. However, the assessment can be time-consuming as the urinary tract spans the entirety of the abdomen and pelvis and components of the urinary tract are often difficult to visualize. In particular, the ureters are very small and identifying a stone or tumor within the ureters often proves difficult for radiologists. To aid in the detection of pathology, we propose a method for segmenting the ureters. Our novel method uses consecutive slices in CTU examinations. This approach leverages both the Swin Transformer and the Diffusion Model. 9fdb22d9938330b064874e568bee92af32d99835.title: Multi-Modal Integration for Predicting Biochemical Recurrence in Prostate Cancer
9fdb22d9938330b064874e568bee92af32d99835.abstract: Predicting biochemical recurrence (BCR) is crucial for Prostate Cancer (PCa) treatment plan. We present a novel multi-modal approach using deep learning framework that integrates Whole Slide Images (WSI) with associated clinical text to improve BCR prediction. Our model leverages contrastive learning approach where both visual and textual data are used to effectively capture the interplay between histopathology features and textual information by jointly modeling these data sources. Evaluation results indicate that our model building approach is able to effectively integrates spatial insights from WSIs and clinical texts, leading in enhanced BCR prediction performance compared to other existing methodologies and individual modalities. This approach has the potential to advance precision medicine in PCa care.

9fb88c216510672a7edb8b9d506a097d0a64799c.abstract: The nnU-Net has become the de facto standard in medical image segmentation. While the generalizability of nnUNet has widely been studied across various domains, we question the optimality of the automated nnU-Net configuration specifically for cerebral microbleed (CMB) segmentation. We identified that the standard nnU-Net setup, particularly the recommended input patch size, is primarily optimized for the heterogeneous nature of multi-organ segmentation, resulting in suboptimal performance for CMB segmentation. To address this limitation, we propose a patch selection algorithm based on a local minima search that fully leverages the imaging characteristics of CMB lesions. Experiments on two independent cohorts demonstrate that our approach improves the overall performance without altering the segmentation backbone, highlighting the important role of preprocessing. 9f2acc0de0384b64cd5bd85c42ebb3e5c28a23db.title: Locating Standard Planes in Endometrium Ultrasound Videos via Clinical Prior Knowledge of Key Anatomical Structures
9f2acc0de0384b64cd5bd85c42ebb3e5c28a23db.abstract: Accurate localization of standard planes is crucial for sonog-raphers diagnosing and evaluating endometrial function from ultrasound videos. Traditionally, this process is performed manually, resulting in significant inter- and intra-observer variability. To address these challenges and enhance diagnos-tic consistency, we propose an automated model that localizes endometrial standard planes by detecting key anatomical structures. Specifically, our model segments the endometrium and identifies uterine cavity lines, facilitating standard plane localization based on clinical prior knowledge. Experimen-tal results demonstrate that our model outperforms existing methods, achieving an AUC of 0.922 and an accuracy of 0.869. The model's predictions provide consistent and in-terpretable results, supporting sonographers in their assessments.

9d6f7907d81e1e40c083f6ba2282f712dcd43d06.abstract: Counterfactual image generation enables controlled data augmentation, bias mitigation, and disease modeling. However, existing methods guided by external classifiers or regressors are limited to subject-level factors (e.g., age) and fail to produce localized structural changes, often resulting in global artifacts. Pixel-level guidance using segmentation masks has been explored but requires user-defined counterfactual masks, which is tedious and impractical. Segmentor-guided Counterfactual Fine-Tuning (Seg-CFT) addressed this by using segmentation-derived measurements to supervise structurespecific variables, yet it remains restricted to global interventions. We propose Positional Seg-CFT, which subdivides each structure into regional segments and derives independent measurements per region, enabling spatially localized and anatomically coherent counterfactuals. 9c6e387054e9e9bc5fa89af729f470d49bb427af.title: Comparative Evaluation of Five Hippocampal Segmentation Algorithms in Limbic Encephalitis: Addressing Inflammation and Atrophy Challenges
9c6e387054e9e9bc5fa89af729f470d49bb427af.abstract: Limbic encephalitis (LE) mainly affects the hippocampus, where inflammation and atrophy can complicate MRI volumetry methods. While manual segmentation is the gold standard, it is laborious and subjective, motivating automated alternatives. We evaluated five hippocampal segmentation methods-FreeSurfer, FastSurfer, SPM, JointLabelFusion, and nnU-Net-on 187 MRIs from 65 CASPR2LE patients and 191 MRIs from 64 matched controls. Expert manual segmentations served as reference, with performance assessed across accuracy and robustness metrics. FreeSurfer proved the most reliable, accurately capturing disease-related trajectories, whereas other tools were limited by crashes, training data, or anatomical variability.

99893ca28173162fb91e5ccdc328c4b7b253bf88.title: TAR-Diff: Diffusion-Based Ultrasound Video Generation for Medical Diagnosis with Temporal Attention Residuals
99893ca28173162fb91e5ccdc328c4b7b253bf88.abstract: Deep learning methods have demonstrated remarkable potential in analyzing breast ultrasound images, offering advantages in clinical efficiency. However, while dynamic lesion changes are key for diagnosis, large-scale annotated video datasets are scarce, limiting the performance and generalization of vision-based models. We propose a diffusion-based framework that synthesizes realistic breast ultrasound videos while capturing temporal changes relevant to diagnosis. Through the integration of multi-scale conditioning and temporal attention residual layers, the model effectively learns to focus on relevant spatiotemporal features, improving the generation of coherent and clinically useful ultrasound video sequences. 99893ca28173162fb91e5ccdc328c4b7b253bf88.zh_title: 基于扩散模型的超声视频生成

99893ca28173162fb91e5ccdc328c4b7b253bf88.zh_abstract: 深度学习方法在分析乳腺超声图像方面已展现出显著潜力，在临床效率方面具有优势。然而，尽管动态病灶变化对诊断至关重要，大规模带标注的视频数据集仍然稀缺，限制了基于视觉的模型的性能和泛化能力。我们提出一种基于扩散的框架，在合成逼真的乳腺超声视频的同时捕获与诊断相关的时间变化。通过集成多尺度条件和时间注意力残差层，该模型能够有效学习关注相关的时空特征，改进连贯且具有临床价值的超声视频序列的生成。在 BUSI 和 BUSV 数据集上给出了大量结果，通过定性和定量分析以及跨下游任务 i 来评估生成的视频

9959feb7adb9bf171b275181eccdeac10a14a062.title: Contrastive Meta-Domain Adaptation for Robust Skin Lesion Classification Across Clinical and Acquisition Conditions
9959feb7adb9bf171b275181eccdeac10a14a062.abstract: Deep learning models for dermatological image analysis remain sensitive to acquisition variability and domain-specific visual characteristics, leading to performance degradation when deployed in clinical settings. We investigate how visual artifacts and domain shifts affect deep learning-based skin lesion classification. We propose an adaptation strategy, grounded in the idea of visual meta-domains, that transfers visual representations from larger dermoscopic datasets into clinical image domains, thereby improving generalization robustness. Experiments across multiple dermatology datasets show consistent gains in classification performance and reduced gaps between dermoscopic and clinical images. These results emphasize the importance of domain-aware training for deployable systems.

992050f89265d323303f6f4d6d3d4c81c82a4db5.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Generation in Cancer Ai
992050f89265d323303f6f4d6d3d4c81c82a4db5.abstract: Transcriptomic data offer valuable insights for cancer diagnosis and prognosis, but high cost limits their routine use. Recent studies have shown that transcriptomic profiles can be efficiently synthesized from digital histopathology images. However, they are of little practical use unless the reliability of such black-box predictions is rigorously evaluated. In this work, we propose a novel conformal prediction based methodology to quantify and calibrate generative uncertainty. Experimental results on publicly available multimodal datasets, The Cancer Genomic Atlas (TCGA), Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC) and STImage, spanning independent cancer cohorts of glioma-glioblastoma, renal, and breast show that our conformal-based methodology not only efficiently estimates uncertainty bounds to guarantee a desired ground truth coverage but also calibrates the model to be fa
992050f89265d323303f6f4d6d3d4c81c82a4db5.zh_title: 癌症AI多模态生成的保形不确定性量化

98c3f981202d33e61127125299803f0043fc8b37.title: Classification of Surgeons' Gender from Videos of the Surgical Field
98c3f981202d33e61127125299803f0043fc8b37.abstract: We present a novel approach to classify the gender of the operating surgeon in videos from the microscope (that show only the surgical field) using the SurgGender model and a step-based analysis technique. This method addresses both technical and ethical challenges of implicit gender biases, which impact training and career progression. By focusing on gender classification, our work aims to support equitable, context-aware surgical systems. The SurgGender leverages 3D shifted window-based self-attention to capture key spatialtemporal patterns. Our step-based approach enhances classification by isolating relevant video segments and reducing non-informative noise. Rigorous testing demonstrates that this method improves accuracy and processing efficiency, establishing a foundation for bias-aware surgical video analysis.

976312ecd3afc05997b73b5cee0ad30528124927.abstract: Ultrasound-based computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) has indicated effectiveness for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH). Recently, foundation models have shown promising potential to further improve the performance of a CAD model. However, their deployment in clinical applications remains challenging due to the high computational cost and overfitting risk of full fine-tuning. To address this issue, a new memory-efficient adaptation framework, named External Spatial Adapter Tuning (ESAT), is proposed for the CAD of DDH. The ESAT develops spatial adapters based on lowrank depthwise separable convolution at each layer of foundation model, so as to extract and refine hierarchical spatial features. 976312ecd3afc05997b73b5cee0ad30528124927.zh_title: 外部空间适配器微调用于超声DDH诊断

9758876d6cd3ad621eaa06f9808a1311c3ceb9ed.title: PAT-DIFF: Pathology-Aware Residual Diffusion Framework for MRI-to-PET Translation in Alzheimer's Disease
9758876d6cd3ad621eaa06f9808a1311c3ceb9ed.abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) provide complementary information for Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis, but acquiring both is often impractical owing to the high cost and radiation exposure associated with PET. To bridge these complementary domains, we propose PaT-Diff, a pathology-aware residual diffusion framework that translates MRI into PET representations in a clinically interpretable and biomarker-consistent manner. The model learns AD-related residual representations that bridge the anatomical MRI and pathological PET domains while integrating demographic attributes via CLIP-based clinical conditioning. To further emphasize amyloid-relevant regions associated with AD pathology, a pathology-weighted reconstruction loss combines pixel-level and pathology-region-weighted objectives. 9758876d6cd3ad621eaa06f9808a1311c3ceb9ed.zh_title: 病理感知残差扩散实现 MRI 到 PET 的跨模态生成

9702acbcfa67ab1b9b28309207b4dc99b3219cbc.title: Benchmarking Lesion-Level Response Assessment of Metastatic Bone Disease on WB-MRI Using Manual, Interactive and Automated Segmentation Methods
9702acbcfa67ab1b9b28309207b4dc99b3219cbc.abstract: Reliable application of response criteria on whole-body MRI (WB-MRI) requires lesion measurements with variability sufficiently small to remain within clinically meaningful decision thresholds. Although manual approaches are established in clinical research, comparative evidence against novel deep learning pipelines remains limited. In a cohort of 40 advanced prostate cancer patients, we benchmarked three pipelines for per-lesion response assessment in skeletal metastases: manual Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) diameters, semi-automated segmentation (nnInteractive), and fully automated segmentation with an end-to-end deep learning model. 96e1d41fe704e354290e9e344f42a387faca6f6f.title: Diffusion-Driven 3D CECT-to-NCECT Conversion for Head and Neck Imaging
96e1d41fe704e354290e9e344f42a387faca6f6f.abstract: Many medical applications, such as proton therapy and radiotherapy planning, require both Contrast Enhanced CT (CECT) for tumor and organ delineation and Non-Contrast Enhanced CT (NCECT) for accurate radiation dose calculation. The need for both scans can introduce dosimetric uncertainties due to tissue motion, particularly in thoracic and abdominal tumors. This study presents a diffusion model-based deep learning framework to generate NCECT directly from CECT, offering a solution that reduces the need for the NCECT scan and minimizes motion-related uncertainties. We trained and evaluated the diffusion model using 6400 2D CT slices from abdominal CECT and NCECT image pairs from 25 patients. The model's performance was evaluated using structural similarity index measure (SSIM), Mean Square Error (MSE), and qualitative visual assessments, focusing on the accuracy of NCECT image generation.

96dbb93ae97936e0b5cd6df21bf21c2ab19c169e.title: Multi-View Consistent Wound Segmentation with Neural Fields
96dbb93ae97936e0b5cd6df21bf21c2ab19c169e.abstract: Wound care is often challenged by the economic and logistical burdens that consistently afflict patients and hospitals worldwide. In recent decades, healthcare professionals have sought support from computer vision and machine learning algorithms. In particular, wound segmentation has gained interest due to its ability to provide professionals with fast, automatic tissue assessment from standard RGB images. Some approaches have extended segmentation to 3D, enabling more complete and precise healing progress tracking. However, inferring multi-view consistent 3D structures from 2D images remains a challenge. In this paper, we evaluate WoundNeRF, a NeRF SDF-based method for estimating robust wound segmentations from automatically generated annotations. We demonstrate the potential of this paradigm in recovering accurate segmentations by comparing it against state-of-the-art Vision Transform
96dbb93ae97936e0b5cd6df21bf21c2ab19c169e.zh_title: 神经场实现多视角一致的伤口分割

96c41fe474d8ab36dcda2688e75114632f09888a.title: Modeling Structure-Function Discordance in Glaucoma Visual Field Analysis
96c41fe474d8ab36dcda2688e75114632f09888a.abstract: The Humphrey Visual Field (HVF) test is essential for assessing functional vision loss in glaucoma, but artifacts and patient variability can reduce test reliability. This work models and aims to predict two types of structure-function discordance between HVF sensitivity and retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thickness from optical coherence tomography (OCT): (i) functional loss with normal structure (FLD) and (ii) structural loss with normal function (SLD). Groundtruth labels were derived by combining HVF pattern deviations with OCT RNFL classifications, while predictions relied solely on HVF data. We evaluated three methods: (i) neighbor-based rules, (ii) zone-majority classification, and (iii) a lightweight convolutional neural architecture with dual outputs each specialized for FLD or SLD. 96255f33d38d621771c1d84162a328046bf77f1f.title: AutoATQ: Automating Along-Tract Quantification Without Tractography
96255f33d38d621771c1d84162a328046bf77f1f.abstract: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) is a unique noninvasive technique for characterizing brain white-matter microstructure, and tractometry is a key analytical method for identifying localized abnormalities. However, traditional tractometry relies on tractography, which has significant limitations, including indirect inference of anatomy, false-positive streamlines, and difficulties with crossing fibers. Additionally, it requires a lengthy acquisition of $q$-space data. To this end, we propose a novel deep learning framework for direct microstructural characterization using white matter bundle masks, thereby eliminating the need for tractography. Our approach uses the U-Mamba network to accurately segment 72 predefined white matter bundles from parameterized spherical mean images, thereby enhancing tissue specificity. 96255f33d38d621771c1d84162a328046bf77f1f.zh_title: AutoATQ：无需纤维追踪的沿束定量自动化

96255f33d38d621771c1d84162a328046bf77f1f.zh_abstract: 扩散 MRI（diffusion MRI, dMRI）是一种独特的无创技术，用于表征脑白质微观结构，而纤维束测量学（tractometry）是识别局部异常的关键分析方法。然而，传统纤维束测量学依赖于纤维束成像（tractography），后者具有显著局限性，包括对解剖结构的间接推断、假阳性流线以及交叉纤维处理困难。此外，它需要耗时的 $q$-空间数据采集。为此，我们提出一种新颖的深度学习框架，利用白质纤维束掩膜直接进行微结构表征，从而无需纤维束成像。我们的方法使用 U-Mamba 网络从参数化球均值图像中准确分割 72 个预定义白质纤维束，从而增强组织特异性。我们还引入一个专用的点云网络来估计每个的中心线

961bc08029a6521951855417065e2322e385f570.title: A Multi-Scale Linear-Time Encoder for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
961bc08029a6521951855417065e2322e385f570.abstract: We introduce Multi-scale Adaptive Recurrent Biomedical Linear-time Encoder (MARBLE), the first purely Mamba-based multi-state multiple instance learning (MIL) framework for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis. MARBLE processes multiple magnification levels in parallel and integrates coarse-to-fine reasoning within a linear-time state-space model, efficiently capturing cross-scale dependencies with minimal parameter overhead. WSI analysis remains challenging due to gigapixel resolutions and hierarchical magnifications, while existing MIL methods typically operate at a single scale and transformer-based approaches suffer from quadratic attention costs. By coupling parallel multi-scale processing with linear-time sequence modeling, MARBLE provides a scalable and modular alternative to attention-based architectures. Experiments on five public datasets show improvements of up to $\mathbf{6. 9 \%

961bc08029a6521951855417065e2322e385f570.zh_abstract: 我们介绍多尺度自适应循环生物医学线性时间编码器（Multi-scale Adaptive Recurrent Biomedical Linear-time Encoder, MARBLE），这是首个纯基于 Mamba 的、用于全切片图像（whole-slide image, WSI）分析的多状态多实例学习（multiple instance learning, MIL）框架。MARBLE 并行处理多个放大倍数，并在线性时间状态空间模型中整合从粗到细的推理，以最小参数开销高效捕捉跨尺度依赖关系。由于千兆像素分辨率和分层放大结构，WSI 分析仍具挑战性，而现有 MIL 方法通常仅在单一尺度上运行，基于 transformer 的方法则受二次注意力成本困扰。通过将并行多尺度处理与线性时间序列建模相结合，MARBLE 为基于注意力的架构提供了一种可扩展且模块化的替代方案。在五个公开数据集上的实验显示，提升最高可达 $\mathbf{6. 9 \%

9602ec3d3f2d671180e47751191ebeece936c2f8.title: ACE-Net: 3D VFM-CNN Fusion with Adaptive Covariance Eigen-Gate for Coronary Artery Segmentation
9602ec3d3f2d671180e47751191ebeece936c2f8.abstract: Accurate segmentation of coronary arteries from CT angiography is crucial for quantitative stenosis evaluation and surgical planning. This task requires models to capture both global anatomical context and fine-grained local details. While 3D Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) and CNNs are naturally suited for these complementary roles, effectively fusing their heterogeneous feature streams remains a major challenge. To address this, we propose ACE-Net, a unified framework built upon a parallel dual-encoder architecture that couples a 3D foundation model-driven encoder (finetuned from SAM-Med3D) for global structural encoding with a 3D U-Net-based shape encoder for fine-grained local representation. 959a2879cc33cd2e3a732187d96913e1364c4307.title: BrainOrg-QC: Automated Morphological Quality Control of Cerebral Organoids
959a2879cc33cd2e3a732187d96913e1364c4307.abstract: Cerebral organoids are three-dimensional (3D) self-organized cellular structures that recapitulate key aspects of human brain development. They have become promising models in neuroscience research, particularly for modeling neurological diseases and evaluating neurotoxicity. However, they exhibit substantial heterogeneity, notably in morphology and size, which hampers their reproducibility and scalability. Critically, current organoid characterization methods lack standardization, limiting their broader applicability. Here, we present an automated quality control (QC) framework for 60-day cortical organoids that integrates non-invasive imagebased assessment of morphology and growth. 94990a14c40e0b96103091b4a04b6c49a438444a.title: How to Evaluate Generated skVCT from MVCT? Optimal Parameters and Clinical Validation
94990a14c40e0b96103091b4a04b6c49a438444a.abstract: This study investigates the correlation of computer vision metrics with the clinical utility of domain-transferred synthetic medical images. Here, we use a Cycle-Consistency Generative Adversarial Network using softly paired data to create synthetic kilovoltage computed tomography (CT) from megavoltage computed tomography images, leveraging a unique database of 1109 head-and-neck CTs, an order of magnitude larger than previous works. The quality of synthetic images was quantified using standard metrics such as Structural Similarity, which we used to identify the best models in the clinical context of adaptative radiation therapy. Using the framework defined here, we identify the optimal parameter values of widely used metrics and validate our findings through a clinical evaluation using a panel of nine radiation oncologists who evaluated 4320 images.

93cb40094fa91b78663f1313ade2202d4b2bb078.abstract: Automated analysis of fetal cardiac ultrasound requires simultaneous segmentation of anatomical structures and classification of congenital heart disease (CHD), yet expert annotation is scarce in clinical practice. We present a semisupervised dual-task framework that jointly optimizes pixel-level segmentation of 14 cardiac structures (plus background) and multi-label CHD classification across 7 pathological categories from four standard cardiac imaging planes. The framework builds on a shared DINOv2 ViT-B/14 backbone with partial fine-tuning, where the lower six transformer blocks are frozen to preserve generic visual representations while the upper six are fully updated for cardiac domain adaptation. 9385709dfff82ca116145d1993e57da1658a1ef4.abstract: This work presents POSEIDON, a portable ocular surface evaluation system built on a hardware-software co-design paradigm for real-time, quantitative assessment of ocular surface diseases. The system integrates dual-modality imaging into an end-to-end pipeline, with a lightweight network for meibomian gland delineation on edge devices with limited power and memory. By unifying imaging, computation, and clinical interpretation in a compact system, POSEIDON establishes a scalable route toward intelligent ocular surface disease analysis and democratized eye-health monitoring.

93446c004e04c16f245dbb9209b927596ce49240.abstract: Echocardiogram video segmentation is crucial for enabling rapid, objective, and reproducible quantification of cardiac structures, which is the key for the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Although recent SAM-based methods have achieved promising results, they often struggle to effectively capture spatio-temporal features in echocardiogram videos, resulting in limited performance for multi-structure segmentation. To this end, we propose the Spatio-Temporal Segment Anything Model (ST-SAM)—a novel framework comprising a Spatial Topology Module (STM) and a Temporal Graph Enhanced Module (TGEM) that jointly enhance spatial topological relationships and temporal consistency in echocardiogram videos. 9252790c9e712c619e32e7bf22caeaef6cab6736.abstract: Multi-Contrast Super-Resolution (MCSR) for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is often hindered by the need for large, perfectly paired, and fixed-scale training datasets, limiting clinical applicability. To overcome these challenges, we propose a modular MCSR framework that eliminates these requirements. Our method decouples the task into two stages: (1) an unpaired cross-modal synthesis (U-CMS) module translates a high-resolution (HR) reference image into the target contrast, and (2) an unsupervised super-resolution (USR) module, based on implicit neural representations (INRs), reconstructs the final image at an arbitrary scale. This design fuses population-level knowledge from unpaired synthesis with subject-specific details from the low-resolution (LR) input. 924593ed0b42a092e2fcf8d3f74150d3fb506d75.abstract: Live-cell imaging plays an increasingly important role in developmental biology and drug discovery. By formalizing the fluorescence field as an implicit neural representation, high-quality stack can be posteriorly sampled from continuous manifold. 91732a0b312b62fca6a7b64e6508edb5b69d5b55.abstract: Deep learning-based object detectors have demonstrated strong performance in localizing brain tumors on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Saliency-based explainable AI (XAI) methods visualize where a model focuses its attention. Despite this, their alignment with expert visual attention and robustness to benign image variations remains insufficiently studied in neuroimaging. 9040fa17bea6c694e11f1eb0cd9ff0e7e7cc8d82.title: Clinically Grounded Radiology Report Generation via Explanation-Guided Policy Optimization
9040fa17bea6c694e11f1eb0cd9ff0e7e7cc8d82.abstract: Radiology report generation requires models that are both linguistically fluent and clinically grounded. While recent Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have shown promise, they often suffer from hallucinations and factual misalignment with medical images. Existing preference optimization methods improve fluency but overlook clinical relevance, leading to shallow lexical learning. To address this, we propose a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework guided by the GREEN (Generative Radiology Evaluation and Error Notation) score a chest X ray report specific, fine-grained reward metric. By employing tokenlevel GREEN score-based rewards, our approach captures clinical semantics and entity fidelity, resulting in reports that are both factually consistent and clinically trustworthy.

9040fa17bea6c694e11f1eb0cd9ff0e7e7cc8d82.zh_abstract: 放射学报告生成需要模型在语言上流畅且具有临床依据。尽管近期医学视觉-语言模型（Medical Vision-Language Models, Med-VLMs）显示出前景，但它们常出现幻觉以及与医学图像的事实不一致。现有偏好优化方法提高了流畅性，但忽视了临床相关性，导致浅层词汇学习。为解决这一问题，我们提出一个由 GREEN（Generative Radiology Evaluation and Error Notation）评分引导的组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）框架，该评分是胸部 X 射线报告专用的细粒度奖励指标。通过采用基于 token 级 GREEN 评分的奖励，我们的方法捕捉临床语义和实体保真度，从而生成既事实一致又临床可信的报告。

900088998a40b933f7097c746633b21d1edded5f.abstract: Despite their prominent performance on tasks such as ROI classification and segmentation, many pathology foundation models remain constrained by a specific input size e.g. $224 \times 224$, creating substantial inefficiencies when applied to whole-slide images (WSIs), which span thousands of resolutions. A naïve strategy is to either enlarge inputs or downsample the WSIs. However, enlarging inputs results in prohibitive GPU memory consumption, while downsampling alters the microns-per-pixel resolution and obscures critical morphological details. To overcome these limitations, we propose an space- and time- efficient inference strategy that sparsifies attention using spatially aware neighboring blocks and filters out non-informative tokens through global attention scores. 8fe06c0ce3bc987a03b98460a8e455e61ef9df41.title: Open-Set Semi-Supervised Learning for Long-Tailed Medical Datasets
8fe06c0ce3bc987a03b98460a8e455e61ef9df41.abstract: Many practical medical imaging scenarios include categories that are under-represented but still crucial. The relevance of image recognition models to real-world applications lies in their ability to generalize to these rare classes as well as unseen classes. Real-world generalization requires taking into account the various complexities that can be encountered in the real-world. First, training data is highly imbalanced, which may lead to model exhibiting bias toward the more frequently represented classes. Moreover, real-world data may contain unseen classes that need to be identified, and model performance is affected by the data scarcity. While medical image recognition has been extensively addressed in the literature, current methods do not take into account all the intricacies in the real-world scenarios. 8fe06c0ce3bc987a03b98460a8e455e61ef9df41.zh_title: 面向长尾医疗数据的开放集半监督学习

8fd2e893c03a9a233401bb806803c9a3e82d81ef.title: Sequential Spatial-Temporal Network for Interpretable Automatic Ultrasonic Assessment of Fetal Head During Labor
8fd2e893c03a9a233401bb806803c9a3e82d81ef.abstract: The intrapartum ultrasound guideline established by ISUOG highlights the Angle of Progression (AoP) and Head Symphysis Distance (HSD) as pivotal metrics for assessing fetal head descent and predicting delivery outcomes. Accurate measurement of the AoP and HSD requires a structured process. This begins with identifying standardized ultrasound planes, followed by the detection of specific anatomical landmarks within the regions of the pubic symphysis and fetal head that correlate with the delivery parameters AoP and HSD. Finally, these measurements are derived based on the identified anatomical landmarks. Addressing the clinical demands and standard operation process outlined in the ISUOG guideline, we introduce the Sequential Spatial-Temporal Network (SSTN), the first interpretable model specifically designed for the video of intrapartum ultrasound analysis. 8f8953700f938cbbbf7cd283ce7d41e31183d20e.title: Deep Learning for Cardiac TMP Imaging: A Physics-Informed Data Augmentation Approach
8f8953700f938cbbbf7cd283ce7d41e31183d20e.abstract: The noninvasive imaging of myocardial transmembrane potential (TMP) from body surface potentials (BSP) holds clinical promise but is a challenging ill-posed inverse problem. Although deep learning (DL) has shown potential, its application is constrained by two issues: the lack of extensive, high-fidelity training datasets and the tendency of unconstrained models to yield physiologically unrealistic outcomes. This paper introduces a novel end-to-end DL framework designed to overcome these obstacles. Our approach is built upon a simulation-driven data generation technique. We employ the Aliev-Panfilov (AP) model, a computationally efficient model for cardiac excitation dynamics, guided by a structured sampling of initial pacing conditions, to synthesize a diverse training corpus. 8f6546fdb088cdc2a23ede59ae08405e90aa1921.title: Improving Fairness in Vision Language Models for Medical Applications via Max Deviation Penalty
8f6546fdb088cdc2a23ede59ae08405e90aa1921.abstract: Fairness in medical artificial intelligence (AI) tools is essential, as biased model behaviour can lead to unequal diagnostic outcomes and raise serious ethical concerns, ultimately reducing clinical trust. Although Vision Language Models (VLMs) show strong performance in medical imaging, they still exhibit demographic biases, particularly across gender, race, and other sensitive attributes. Addressing these disparities is difficult due to the utility-fairness trade off, where improving equity often reduces diagnostic accuracy. To overcome these challenges, we propose the Max Deviation Penalty, a lightweight regularization objective that integrates seamlessly into parameter efficient finetuning schemes. 8f6546fdb088cdc2a23ede59ae08405e90aa1921.zh_title: 最大偏差惩罚：提升医学视觉语言模型公平性

8f54bcef1536d51a3c113b6f24d73739b8b9d390.title: SACL: Semantics-Aware Contrastive Learning for One-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
8f54bcef1536d51a3c113b6f24d73739b8b9d390.abstract: One-shot medical image segmentation remains a challenging task due to the diversified anatomical structures and the presence of ambiguous surrounding tissues. While large pre-trained models have shown success in few-shot segmentation, they typically require extensive datasets for fine-tuning. Approaches such as synthetic pseudo-labeling and semi-supervised learning offer simpler, cost-effective solutions by learning from noisy annotations with consistency regularization. However, a significant challenge is the domain shift between homogenous synthetic data and more complex clinical data, which limits the generalizability of these models. In this paper, we propose a novel semantics-aware contrastive learning (SACL) method for one-shot medical image segmentation. 8f54bcef1536d51a3c113b6f24d73739b8b9d390.zh_title: 语义感知对比学习用于单样本医学图像分割

8f1967ca68757b83cf11c0409594da5009a4a2d4.title: NEUSEG: INTERPRETABLE UNSUPERVISED GM/WM SEGMENTATION IN BRAIN HISTOPATHOLOGY USING NUCLEI MORPHOMETRICS
8f1967ca68757b83cf11c0409594da5009a4a2d4.abstract: We present NEUSEG, a fully automated, interpretable, and unsupervised pipeline for gray/white matter (GM/WM) segmentation in brain histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs). GM/WM segmentation in WSIs is challenging due to their gigapixel-scale resolution and substantial variability in staining, regional morphology, and underlying pathology. To address this, NEUSEG combines nuclei morphometrics with a two-component Gaussian Mixture Model and refines boundaries using a Conditional Random Field and morphological post-processing. In comparison with a supervised CNN baseline, NEUSEG achieved comparable accuracy on in-distribution slides and superior robustness under out-of-distribution conditions. 8f0190092844a6f4b209cf67f8cb7adf8fa19873.title: Bias Mitigation for Brain Age Prediction via Age Delta Correlation Loss
8f0190092844a6f4b209cf67f8cb7adf8fa19873.abstract: Deep regression models for brain age prediction derived from T1-weighted MRI are known to suffer from the regression-to-the-mean bias, leading to overestimation in younger individuals and underestimation in older ones. Although post-hoc linear calibration is commonly used to correct the bias, this two-step approach produces a problematic biomarker for Alzheimer's disease classification, as it results in a suboptimal model. To address this, we introduce $\mathcal{L}_{\text{ADC}}$, a loss term designed to penalize the Pearson correlation between the brain-age delta and chronological age, which we integrate end-to-end with the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE). The proposed training pipeline enables balanced control of the accuracy-bias trade-off during model training without depending on post-hoc adjustments alone. 8f0190092844a6f4b209cf67f8cb7adf8fa19873.zh_title: 年龄偏差相关性损失缓解脑龄预测偏倚

8e74b578b8b39aa754a863b59bc19309eae02c9c.title: GP-CPS: Gradient Penalty Cross Pseudo Supervision for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
8e74b578b8b39aa754a863b59bc19309eae02c9c.abstract: Medical imaging has always been constrained due to the challenges in the acquisition process, poor signal-to-noise ratios, high costs, and the complexity of medical image features. This work introduces a semi supervised framework called Gradient Penalty Cross Pseudo Supervision (GP-CPS), which is based on the Cross Pseudo Supervision (CPS) model and innovatively introduces the concept of gradient penalty, sig-nificantly enhancing the model's performance. To our knowledge, this is the first time the concept of gradient penalty has been applied in the field of image segmentation. Furthermore, this work introduces a concept of fused cross pseudo super-vision to enhance the diversity of training and strengthen the robustness of the model. 8e3eb016ff404a2d74364e8339ed4aeeacdd54e2.title: High-Fidelity 3D CT Super-Resolution on Real-Paired Datasets with Adaptive Interpolation and Feature Consistency
8e3eb016ff404a2d74364e8339ed4aeeacdd54e2.abstract: High-resolution thin-slice Computed Tomography (CT) imaging is critical for accurate diagnosis, yet clinical scans are often acquired with thick slices to reduce radiation dose and scanning time. This leads to anisotropic volumes that obscure fine anatomical details and hinder 3D analysis. While deep learning-based super-resolution (SR) methods have made progress in reconstructing high-resolution volumes from thick-slice inputs, they remain limited by challenges in slice generation, feature enhancement, and structural refinement. In this work, we present a unified framework that systematically addresses these three aspects. 8e2fe057e2c84ef68b439516bdec787d522fb1e9.abstract: Post-reconstruction filtering is essential for suppressing the elevated imaging noise in cardiac-gated SPECT acquisitions, where the smoothing level often needs to be adjusted to better accommodate inter-subject variability in acquired data statistics. In this study we investigate the feasibility of achieving an adjustable smoothing level by employing a pre-trained deep learning (DL) denoising network for processing cardiac-gated images, the purpose being to avoid the need to re-train the DL network when the desired smoothing level varies for a given patient. We evaluated the performance of this approach on a set of 30 clinical gated acquisitions using a DL network pre-trained from the ungated data of 862 studies. 8e0a9808e34713b51ae1cdf46980a7d495c94829.title: Fully Unsupervised Deep Spectral Clustering for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
8e0a9808e34713b51ae1cdf46980a7d495c94829.abstract: Blood vessel segmentation plays a crucial role in the diagnosis and treatment of eye diseases. Fully supervised and semi-supervised deep learning-based methods require large, labeled datasets for their training. We propose a novel, fully unsupervised deep learning segmentation framework that implements the spectral clustering algorithm to address this issue. A deep neural network is used to learn the continuous Laplace-Beltrami partial differential operator of the images and solve its eigen decomposition in an end-to-end manner with a tai-lored loss function. The learned eigen decomposition spans the image space and is specifically tuned to the input image. Pixels are mapped to this space, and a k-means clustering algorithm produces the final segmentation results. We validated our method on the publicly available DRIVE and STARE reti-nal vessel datasets, demonstrating qualitative and qua
8e0a9808e34713b51ae1cdf46980a7d495c94829.zh_title: 全无监督深度谱聚类视网膜血管分割
8e0a9808e34713b51ae1cdf46980a7d495c94829.summary: 提出全无监督深度谱聚类分割框架，学习图像拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子特征分解后聚类出血管。
key_points: 无需标注数据，端到端学习算子特征分解
将像素映射至谱空间后用k-means聚类

8e0a9808e34713b51ae1cdf46980a7d495c94829.zh_abstract: 血管分割在眼部疾病的诊断和治疗中起着至关重要的作用。全监督和半监督的基于深度学习的方法需要大型标注数据集进行训练。我们提出了一种新的、全无监督的深度学习分割框架，该框架实现谱聚类算法以解决这一问题。使用深度神经网络学习图像的连续 Laplace-Beltrami 偏微分算子，并使用定制损失函数以端到端方式求解其特征分解。学习到的特征分解跨越图像空间，并专门针对输入图像进行调整。像素被映射到该空间，k-means 聚类算法产生最终分割结果。我们在公开可用的 DRIVE 和 STARE 视网膜血管数据集上验证了我们的方法，展示了定性和定量……

8d884ba8710d7d033e07f281f5b7ec770476201d.title: Optimal Transport with Foundation Models for Multi-Stain CBIR in Digital Pathology
8d884ba8710d7d033e07f281f5b7ec770476201d.abstract: Combining multiple staining in histopathology is vital to relate complementary information within a tissue. We present a novel framework that enables local correspondence in the form of patch retrieval (CBIR) in multi-stain whole-slide images without the need for explicit registration. By leveraging foundation models as meaningful patch encoders, we are able to retrieve an H&E patch in a dataset of patches extracted from IHC slides. Using Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport for weak supervision, we learn a lightweight correction module that aligns embeddings and improves retrieval accuracy by up to 30% (depending on patch size and model), at negligible cost, despite staining and structural variations. Our method paves the way for efficient multi-stain integration in digital pathology workflows.
8d884ba8710d7d033e07f281f5b7ec770476201d.zh_title: 数字病理多染色CBIR的联合基础模型最优传输
8d884ba8710d7d033e07f281f5b7ec770476201d.summary: 提出无需配准的多染色全切片图像块检索框架，用基础模型编码并以融合Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输弱监督，检索精度最高提升30%。
key_points: 多染色WSI图像块检索无需显式配准
基础模型作图像块编码器

8d884ba8710d7d033e07f281f5b7ec770476201d.reason: 新方法但仅检索任务内部评估，无外部验证，属5档
8d884ba8710d7d033e07f281f5b7ec770476201d.zh_abstract: 在组织病理学中结合多种染色对于关联组织内互补信息至关重要。我们提出一种新框架，可在多染色全切片图像中以块检索（patch retrieval, CBIR）形式实现局部对应，而无需显式配准。通过利用基础模型作为有意义的块编码器，我们能够在从 IHC 切片提取的块数据集中检索 H&E 块。使用融合 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输进行弱监督，我们学习一种轻量级校正模块，该模块对齐嵌入并将检索准确率提高最多 30%（取决于块大小和模型），尽管存在染色和结构变异，代价可忽略不计。我们的方法为数字病理工作流中高效的多染色整合铺平道路。

8d51108489922742d73d8329b2ffaf4119d50a5c.title: Towards ROI-Free Modality Translation for MRI with Test-Time Augmentation
8d51108489922742d73d8329b2ffaf4119d50a5c.abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) equips medical professions with comprehensive information to examine various regions of interest (ROI). Nevertheless, the acquisition of a sufficient amount of MRI modalities can be arduous due to limitations such as financial constraints or disabilities of the patient. Recently, researchers have suggested image-to-image translation between MRI modalities utilizing generative models. However, these models still suffer from the disparity between the data quantities of different ROI. In this research, we propose MRI Translation Test-Time Augmentation (MRI-TA), an original method that utilizes the modality representation of a ROI with sufficient data to augment the model for another ROI with lacking data during test time. We perform experiments using T1 and T2 modalities from BraTS2024, GTU and Mendeley Lumber datasets and show promising results in performan
8d51108489922742d73d8329b2ffaf4119d50a5c.zh_title: 面向MRI的免ROI模态翻译与测试时增强
8d51108489922742d73d8329b2ffaf4119d50a5c.summary: 提出MRI-TA，在测试时利用数据充足ROI的模态表征增强数据缺乏ROI的模态翻译。
key_points: 解决不同ROI间MRI数据量不均
测试时增强跨ROI模态翻译
在BraTS2024等T1/T2数据实验
8d51108489922742d73d8329b2ffaf4119d50a5c.reason: 方法创新但限于回顾性图像翻译评估，属5档
8d51108489922742d73d8329b2ffaf4119d50a5c.zh_abstract: 磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）为医学专业人员提供了全面信息，以检查各种感兴趣区域（region of interest, ROI）。然而，由于经济限制或患者残疾等局限，获取足够数量的 MRI 模态可能十分困难。最近，研究人员提出利用生成模型在 MRI 模态之间进行图像到图像翻译。然而，这些模型仍受不同 ROI 之间数据量差异的困扰。在本研究中，我们提出 MRI 翻译测试时增强（MRI Translation Test-Time Augmentation, MRI-TA），这是一种原创方法，在测试时利用数据充足的 ROI 的模态表征，为另一个数据缺乏的 ROI 增强模型。我们使用来自 BraTS2024、GTU 和 Mendeley Lumber 数据集的 T1 和 T2 模态进行实验，并在性能上显示出有前景的结果

8d2af6457dc535053f5f672bd2da5fa6e6f44308.title: Intensity Normalization Using Elastic Warping for FDG-PET Images
8d2af6457dc535053f5f672bd2da5fa6e6f44308.abstract: Intensity normalization is a critical preprocessing step in brain FDG-PET image analysis, enabling quantitative comparison across subjects. Traditional linear methods rely on scaling factors from specific regions or overall brain uptake, which are sensitive to the choice of reference region and spatial disturbances. We propose a novel normalization method based on elastic warping using the Fisher-Rao metric. In contrast to linear scaling methods, our approach allows flexible stretching and squeezing of the intensity range without requiring prior disease knowledge. Compared to conventional methods, our proposed method demonstrates a modest performance improvement in detecting hypo-metabolic voxels, as validated by TTC staining in a rat stroke model, while exhibiting substantially greater robustness against both rigid and scaling spatial disturbances.
8d2af6457dc535053f5f672bd2da5fa6e6f44308.zh_title: 基于弹性形变的FDG-PET强度归一化
8d2af6457dc535053f5f672bd2da5fa6e6f44308.summary: 提出基于Fisher-Rao度量的弹性形变强度归一化方法，在大鼠卒中模型中以TTC染色验证低代谢体素检测。

8ceead97eae6255b39fafb85c30b7d22e5d720e4.title: Transformer-Based Foundation Model for Universal Ultrasound Image Analysis
8ceead97eae6255b39fafb85c30b7d22e5d720e4.abstract: We propose a transformer-based foundation model for unified multi-task, multi-organ, multi-disease ultrasound image analysis, targeting 27 subtasks across segmentation, classification, detection, and landmark regression. The model follows hard parameter sharing: the encoder of a Swin Transformer pretrained on ImageNet is shared by all tasks, while each task uses its own prediction head. For segmentation and detection tasks, we use feature pyramid network decoders with separate segmentation and detection branches; for classification and regression tasks, we use encoder-level features with specific heads. Compared to other existing methods in offline experiments, the proposed method has the best performance. At the Foundation Model Challenge for Ultrasound Image Analysis (FMC UIA) challenge, our method achieved 8th place among 24th participating teams. The code is public at https://github.

8ceead97eae6255b39fafb85c30b7d22e5d720e4.zh_abstract: 我们提出一种基于 Transformer 的基础模型，用于统一的多任务、多器官、多疾病超声图像分析，面向分割、分类、检测和关键点回归中的 27 个子任务。该模型采用硬参数共享：在 ImageNet 上预训练的 Swin Transformer 编码器由所有任务共享，而每个任务使用各自的预测头。对于分割和检测任务，我们使用具有独立分割分支和检测分支的特征金字塔网络（feature pyramid network）解码器；对于分类和回归任务，我们使用编码器级特征并配以特定头。在离线实验中，与其他现有方法相比，所提方法具有最佳性能。在超声图像分析基础模型挑战赛（Foundation Model Challenge for Ultrasound Image Analysis, FMC UIA）中，我们的方法在 24 支参赛队伍中获得了第 8 名。代码公开于 https://github.

8c5667c6b1efbcee756d2b3deb8c6fa6445f849d.title: Track, Measure, Evaluate: A Clinically Aligned Pipeline for Automatic Radiotherapy Response Assessment in Brain Tumors
8c5667c6b1efbcee756d2b3deb8c6fa6445f849d.abstract: Precise monitoring of tumor size dynamics on serial MRI is essential for radiotherapy response assessment. This task is challenging and resource intensive in the clinic, particularly in patients with multiple brain tumors. We present a modelagnostic lesion tracking, measurement, and response assessment framework that operates directly on binary masks from any segmentation models. The system assigns identity to each lesion at the baseline scan, maintains correspondence across follow-up scans using a compact tracking region of interest, and computes standardized measurements at each visit after radiotherapy. The framework is tunable to align with different response assessment criteria (e.g., RANO-BM, RANO-LGG, RANO-HGG) by adjusting the measurement and aggregation rules. In this study we use lesion-level RANO-BM criteria for the longest diameter-based as well as volumetric response assessm
8c5667c6b1efbcee756d2b3deb8c6fa6445f849d.zh_title: 脑肿瘤放疗反应评估的临床对齐流水线
8c5667c6b1efbcee756d2b3deb8c6fa6445f849d.summary: 提出与模型无关的病灶追踪、测量与反应评估框架，直接基于分割掩膜并按RANO-BM等标准输出放疗后评估。

8c5667c6b1efbcee756d2b3deb8c6fa6445f849d.zh_abstract: 在系列 MRI 上精确监测肿瘤大小动态对于放疗反应评估至关重要。该任务在临床上具有挑战性且资源密集，尤其是在多发性脑肿瘤患者中。我们提出一个模型无关的病灶追踪、测量和反应评估框架，可直接作用于来自任何分割模型的二值掩膜。该系统在基线扫描时为每个病灶分配身份标识，使用紧凑的追踪感兴趣区域在随访扫描之间保持对应关系，并在放疗后每次访视时计算标准化测量值。该框架可通过调整测量和聚合规则来匹配不同的反应评估标准（例如 RANO-BM、RANO-LGG、RANO-HGG）。在本研究中，我们使用病灶级别的 RANO-BM 标准进行基于最长径以及基于体积的反应评估

8c15a8ad68ddb7821b130515eef752b2cda6a852.title: A Dual-Track Framework for Enhancing Age-Related Macular Degeneration Diagnosis Through Embedding and Vision Classification
8c15a8ad68ddb7821b130515eef752b2cda6a852.abstract: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of vision loss in older adults, making timely and accurate diagnosis crucial for effective treatment. This study suggests a new framework for AMD diagnosis that integrates embedding extraction and direct vision classification to improve diagnostic performance. We employ a dual-track methodology, utilizing advanced pretrained models for embedding extraction (utilizing Virchow2) alongside a vision-based approach (utilizing Nomic) to classify fundus images into distinct AMD categories: (1) normal, (2) intermediate, (3) geographic atrophy, and (4) wet AMD. Our experiments achieved the best results, with an accuracy of 98.03%, an F1 score of 98.05%, and a precision of 98.08%. 8c15a8ad68ddb7821b130515eef752b2cda6a852.zh_title: 双轨框架提升年龄相关性黄斑变性诊断

8b56452df42c5c380e649f38c06c1f397f175267.title: Freqformer: Frequency-Aware Single Image Super Resolution Network for Biomedical HSI
8b56452df42c5c380e649f38c06c1f397f175267.abstract: Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) provides rich spectral information that supports a wide range of biomedical applications, yet its spatial resolution remains inherently limited by sensor design and acquisition time. Single Image Super Resolution (SISR) offers a computational solution to enhance HSI spatial detail without compromising spectral integrity. Despite recent progress in HSI-SISR, existing models underutilize frequency-domain cues and often fail when applied to biomedical datasets. This paper presents FreqFormer-HSR, a frequency-enhanced reconstruction framework that augments spatial-spectral feature extraction through lightweight frequency modulation and multi-scale residual refinement. We evaluate the proposed method on two biomedical HSI datasets using a consistent experimental pipeline and compare against representative baselines. Quantitative and visual analyses demonstrate that
8b56452df42c5c380e649f38c06c1f397f175267.zh_title: Freqformer：生物医学高光谱图像超分辨

8b3c208efa269291729e0c00073f9a618608d96d.title: Diagnosis with Nanoscale Protein Distributions: Single-Molecule Fluorescence Localization Microscopy and Attention-Based Learning
8b3c208efa269291729e0c00073f9a618608d96d.abstract: Single-molecule (fluorescence) localization microscopy (SMLM) finds the position of markers for target proteins at approx. 10 nm precision. Diagnosis of some diseases currently relies on inspection of nanoscale morphology by electron microscopy (EM), an expensive and slow test with limited sample coverage. Nanoscale biological processes also underlie health and disease in general, and so there is a need for more efficient diagnostic methods. We demonstrate that SMLM of routine biopsy samples can be used to assist diagnosis via data classification models. We predict diagnosis of 20 patients with chronic renal diseases (focal segmental glomerulosclerosis or minimal change disease) with a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.97 in cross-validation, and balanced accuracy of 90%. We tested state-of-the-art pretrained feature extraction from image tiles at 0.045 mic
8b3c208efa269291729e0c00073f9a618608d96d.zh_title: 单分子定位显微成像结合注意力学习辅助诊断

8b070bad595108c0638c33283658521f4c19b8f2.title: Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive Loss for Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
8b070bad595108c0638c33283658521f4c19b8f2.abstract: Robust segmentation of biomedical images remains challenging primarily due to ill-defined object boundaries. Although several loss functions have recently been proposed to enhance object boundary recognition, concerns remain about the susceptibility to unstable annotations resulting from boundary ambiguities. Here, we introduce the Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss, which leverages prototypical contrastive learning to improve boundary recognition and enable stable training even under noisy annotation conditions. The PPC loss utilizes prototype features obtained from local regions near object boundaries, focusing specifically on ambiguous areas that have been challenging for existing approaches. 8b070bad595108c0638c33283658521f4c19b8f2.zh_title: 面向医学图像分割的边缘原型对比损失

88fac3ffa31741ba693e78b943131ed9ec3512fd.title: Shape-Guided Self-Supervised Learning for Intracranial Aneurysm Segmentation
88fac3ffa31741ba693e78b943131ed9ec3512fd.abstract: Intracranial aneurysm (IA) is a localized dilation of a cerebral artery that can rupture and cause life-threatening subarachnoid hemorrhage. Accurate segmentation of aneurysms is essential for quantitative morphological assessment and clinical decision-making. IA segmentation remains challenging due to class imbalance, scarce annotations, and high shape variability. Traditional shape-based methods lack shape adaptability, while deep learning approaches often ignore explicit shape priors and are limited by small datasets. To address these issues, we propose a clinically inspired, shape-guided self-supervised learning framework that uses a synthetic deformation engine to generate pseudoaneurysmal geometries, enabling robust learning of aneurysm shape representations without dense labels. Experiments show consistent performance gains (up to +3.0% in aneurysm IoU) across multiple point-based
88fac3ffa31741ba693e78b943131ed9ec3512fd.zh_title: 形状引导自监督学习用于颅内动脉瘤分割

88ce5656e27bb07e745f33f5b380a2ad70d52922.title: Upstream Probabilistic Meta-Imputation for Multimodal Pediatric Pancreatitis Classification
88ce5656e27bb07e745f33f5b380a2ad70d52922.abstract: Pediatric pancreatitis is a progressive and debilitating inflammatory condition, including acute pancreatitis and chronic pancreatitis, that presents significant clinical diagnostic challenges. Machine learning-based methods also face diagnostic challenges due to limited sample availability and multimodal imaging complexity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Upstream Probabilistic Meta-Imputation (UPMI), a light-weight augmentation strategy that operates upstream of a stacking classifier in a low-dimensional meta-feature space rather than in image space. Modality-specific logistic regressions (T1W and T2W MRI radiomics) produce probability outputs that are transformed into a 7-dimensional meta-feature vector. 88ce5656e27bb07e745f33f5b380a2ad70d52922.zh_title: 上游概率元插补用于儿童胰腺炎多模态分类

8828d0351043eb567d846dcf03d9c1dcce1e20d8.title: Automatic Segmentation of Calcified Plaque in Carotid Arteries
8828d0351043eb567d846dcf03d9c1dcce1e20d8.abstract: Stroke remains a leading cause of death globally, with calcified plaque in the carotid artery being a significant risk factor. Evaluating the impact of calcified carotid plaque, particularly in patients with embolic stroke of undetermined source (ESUS), is critical yet challenging. Manual segmentation, essential for assessing stroke risk, is time-consuming, and conventional methods like 2D and 3D UNet often struggle with the small size of calcified plaques. Therefore, this paper in-troduces a two-step segmentation process. First, segments the carotid artery to narrow the search space and focus on the region of interest around the artery. Then, it segments the calcified plaque within that targeted region. 84b984fa6861e2fbcb388d6a2049a50297071da2.abstract: Stroke is a serious global public health problem, and several studies on tools to assist its diagnosis have been conducted, many of them involving image processing techniques and deep learning. However, the use of graph convolutional networks (GCN) for stroke classification and segmentation has yet to be explored. This work uses GCN to implement a hemorrhagic stroke segmentation system in Computed Tomography (CT) scans. The results show that the proposed methodology performs well in segmentation, reaching 95.98% in the Dice coefficient and 92.54% in the Jaccard coefficient.

We propose a knowledge-aware unsupervised domain adaptation network guided by knowledge perception that considers both common features and domain-specific features. We employ maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) loss to mitigate distribution discrepancies between various domains. In addition, major clinical risk factors (MCRF) are embedded in domain-specific feature extractors to better extract domain-invariant features. 81895398d078711687cab23a6cac25c97ab437be.abstract: Transformer-based models, renowned for their ability to learn long-range information, have recently shown outstanding ca-pabilities in the fields of computer vision and medical image analysis. However, a common limitation in these models is their tendency towards excessive down-sampling, which often results in the loss of high-frequency information. To over-come this limitation, this paper proposes a new method, called Wave-VNet, for efficient and accurate segmentation for medi-cal images. This method employs tokenized image patches in a Transformer-based, V-shaped Encoder-Decoder structure, enriched with skip connections to enhance local-global se-mantic feature learning. 815a5b92d0fae3681bb6bfaba15cc892899c696e.abstract: Accurate assessment of Alzheimer's disease (AD) using neuroimaging is important for understanding disease progression and supporting clinical research. Structural MRI (sMRI) is widely used for this purpose, but most deep learning approaches primarily rely on intensity-based features, which may not fully capture subtle morphological variations. Jacobian determinant maps (JSM) provide complementary information by describing localized brain deformations; however, conventional multimodal fusion strategies such as early or late fusion may not fully capture the interactions between these modalities. To address this, we explore a cross-attention fusion approach that explicitly models the relationship between sMRI intensity and JSM-derived deformation features for AD classification. 80961cad32f106171447377bcb539e8ba915324a.abstract: Report-supervised (RSuper) learning seeks to alleviate the need for dense tumor voxel labels with constraints derived from radiology reports (e.g., volumes, counts, sizes, locations). In MRI studies of brain tumors, however, we often involve multi-parametric scans and substructures. Here, finegrained modality/parameter-wise reports are usually provided along with global findings and are correlated with different substructures. Moreover, the reports often describe only the largest lesion and provide qualitative or uncertain cues (“mild,” “possible”). Classical RSuper losses (e.g., sum volume consistency) can over-constrain or hallucinate unreported findings under such incompleteness, and are unable to utilize these hierarchical findings or exploit the priors of varied lesion types in a merged dataset. 7ffe2c018877f58225468a6b49b625f88d58da01.title: A Comparison of Deep Learning Models for Automatic Left-Ventricular Segmentation in 3D Echocardiography
7ffe2c018877f58225468a6b49b625f88d58da01.abstract: Echocardiography is a non-invasive, non-ionizing, and cost-effective medical imaging modality that uses ultrasound waves to evaluate cardiac function. Left ventricle (LV) analysis is crucial for diagnosing cardiac diseases. Segmentation of the LV from echocardiography images is a challenging, time-consuming process requiring manual contouring from experts and is prone to inter-observer variability. Five different deep-learning models are evaluated for automatic LV segmentation from 3D echocardiography. The models were compared using overlap and distance metrics: Dice score, Jaccard index, and Hausdorff distance. Volumetric analysis was used to examine the accuracy of the predictions from the deep learning models against the expert-annotated ground truth volumes.
