7fabc41f8553bde9c07cc77e34ec62ebe1a3e396.title: Multimodal Optical Imaging Platform for Quantitative Burn Assessment
7fabc41f8553bde9c07cc77e34ec62ebe1a3e396.abstract: Accurate assessment of burn severity at injury onset remains a major clinical challenge due to the lack of objective methods for detecting subsurface tissue damage. This limitation is critical in battlefield and mass-casualty settings, where rapid and reliable evaluation of burn depth is essential for triage and surgical decision-making. We present a multimodal optical imaging framework that establishes the foundation for a compact, low-size, weight, and power (low-SWaP) field-deployable device for quantitative burn assessment. The system integrates broadband hyperspectral imaging (VSWIR, $400-2100 ~\text{nm}$) with laser speckle contrast imaging to jointly evaluate biochemical composition and microvascular perfusion. 7f99d2a95ebb18e05dba9e9db0f03ffe58e4ee63.abstract: Advances in brain imaging have become critical for the early detection of neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's Disease. Recent studies have demonstrated the potential of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to model complex interactions among brain regions, thereby improving diagnostic accuracy. However, most existing GNN approaches rely on static, node-based functional connectivity representations, which fail to capture more realistic functional connections at the edge level and their dynamics. Motivated by recent neuroscientific findings suggesting that cognitive processes emerge from moment-to-moment, edge-centric interactions in fMRI BOLD signals, we propose a novel GNN framework driven by time-varying edge co-fluctuation representations. 7f0c4fdadad3557e972fd2b9aa1ceaa1966f5500.abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major global health burden, where early detection through cytological screening is critical for improving outcomes. However, Pap smear analysis is often manual, time-consuming, and prone to inter-observer variability. Although deep learning offers promise for automating cytology analysis, challenges such as limited data, class imbalance, staining variability, and overlapping cells hinder reliable model development. We propose a cascaded detection framework using multi-dataset pretraining followed by domain-specific finetuning. 7e08ece919ad527cf849be7d97242cc7feac8b2b.title: Attention-Based Multiple Instance Learning for Predominant Growth Pattern Prediction in Lung Adenocarcinoma WSI Using Foundation Models
7e08ece919ad527cf849be7d97242cc7feac8b2b.abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) grading depends on accurately identifying growth patterns, which are indicators of prognosis and can influence treatment decisions. Common deep learning approaches to determine the predominant pattern rely on patch-level classification or segmentation, requiring extensive annotations. This study proposes an attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) framework to predict the predominant LUAD growth pattern at the whole slide level to reduce annotation burden. Our approach integrates pretrained pathology foundation models as patch encoders, used either frozen or fine-tuned on annotated patches, to extract discriminative features that are aggregated through attention mechanisms. 7dac429b64b40201892458e2a3a7b57a7f0f0512.title: Hierarchical Frequency Regularization for Out-Of-Distribution Detection in Generative Models for Medical Images
7dac429b64b40201892458e2a3a7b57a7f0f0512.abstract: Robust deployment of deep learning models in applications such as medical imaging is of critical importance. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential in this regard, as it can identify samples that can mislead models into overconfident yet erroneous results. Existing generative approaches, such as Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), often rely on low-level image statistics, limiting their ability to distinguish OOD samples. We propose a hierarchical frequency regularization framework that improves robustness by enforcing consistency across high and low frequency feature representations. 7dac429b64b40201892458e2a3a7b57a7f0f0512.zh_abstract: 深度学习模型在医学影像等应用中的稳健部署至关重要。分布外（out-of-distribution, OOD）检测在这方面至关重要，因为它可以识别可能误导模型产生过度自信却错误结果的样本。现有的生成式方法，如变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoders, VAEs），通常依赖低层图像统计量，限制了其区分 OOD 样本的能力。我们提出一种分层频率正则化框架，通过强制高频与低频特征表示之间的一致性来提高稳健性。在组织学、CT 和 MRI 数据上的实验表明，结合两个频率成分可实现最稳定的性能：组织学数据上 AUC 为 0.989，腹部 CT 和脑 MRI 分别取得 0.732 和 0.740 的具有竞争力的结果。所提出的方法增强了在分布……下的泛化能力。

7bfbcf9e0e7da4b0da614516df9e2871eeb22e04.abstract: Deep learning has achieved notable success in diagnosing neurological disorders from electroencephalographic (EEG) signals; however, interpretability and reliability remain critical challenges. This work introduces SpectroXAI, a unified framework that transforms multichannel EEG recordings into spectrograms and classifies them using a 19-channel ResNet-18 architecture. Dual-mode explainability is achieved through Grad-CAM++ and SHAP for spatial and channel-level attribution. Furthermore, to quantify explanation reliability, Intersection over Union (IoU) and Spearman's rank correlation have been used to measure crossmethod consistency. The proposed SpectroXAI is evaluated on the OpenNeuro dataset (ds004504) and achieves 90% accuracy, an F1-score of 0.909, and consistent attribution agreement ($\text{IoU}=0.48 \pm 0.09; \rho=0.23 \pm 0.05$). 7bda49a9b00fe09521ddf772c2a0617060d3ff9a.title: A Deep Learning Framework for Glomeruli Segmentation with Boundary Attention
7bda49a9b00fe09521ddf772c2a0617060d3ff9a.abstract: Accurate detection and segmentation of glomeruli in kidney tissue are essential for diagnostic applications. Traditional deep learning methods primarily rely on semantic segmentation, which often fails to precisely delineate adjacent glomeruli. To address this challenge, we propose a novel glomerulus detection and segmentation model that emphasises boundary separation. Leveraging pathology foundation models, the proposed U-Net–based architecture incorporates a specialised attention decoder designed to highlight critical regions and improve instance-level segmentation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both Dice score and Intersection over Union (IoU), indicating superior performance in glomerular delineation.

7bd1d6cd23d1525cad6f8328bf9673a836c2253d.title: Distribution-Based Brain Connectivity Graph Representations for Classification
7bd1d6cd23d1525cad6f8328bf9673a836c2253d.abstract: Graph-based modeling of the human brain connectome from resting-state fMRI data has become a widely adopted approach in neuroimaging. Instead of scalar edge weights, here, we use a vector of quantiles of distribution-valued edges from a voxel clustering-based statistical estimator. 7bc414e5f269acd4984c3a8be335ed0339165263.title: Separation of Epileptic Foci and Background Sources Using Heterogeneous Source Model with Poisson Wavelet Expansion
7bc414e5f269acd4984c3a8be335ed0339165263.abstract: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) inverse problem is a method that estimates neural currents from the magnetic field measured outside the head, which is essentially used in the diagnosis of epilepsy. Although a single equivalent current dipole (ECD) fitting is usually used in clinical practice, the localization result is incorrect if multiple foci and/or background activities exist other than epileptic discharges. In this paper, we propose a heterogeneous source model that combines two models to distinguish multiple foci from the background activities: one model expresses the localized and multiple foci using Poisson wavelets mapped from a sphere to a cortical surface, and the other model consists of the elemental dipoles on a mesh grid for the background activities. 7b67707dee0e35dea9c6d1e7be079fc7a704121f.title: TopoGate: Quality-Aware Topology-Stabilized Gated Fusion for Longitudinal Low-Dose CT New-Lesion Prediction
7b67707dee0e35dea9c6d1e7be079fc7a704121f.abstract: Longitudinal low-dose CT follow-ups vary in noise, reconstruction kernels, and registration quality. These differences destabilize subtraction images and can trigger false “newlesion” alarms. We present TopoGate, a lightweight model that combines the follow-up appearance view with the subtraction view and controls their influence through a learned, quality-aware gate. The gate is driven by three case-specific signals: CT appearance quality, registration consistency, and stability of anatomical topology measured with topological metrics. On the NLST-New-Lesion-LongCT cohort comprising 152 pairs from 122 patients, TopoGate improves discrimination and calibration over single-view baselines, achieving an area under the ROC curve of 0.65 with a standard deviation of 0.05 and a Brier score of 0.14. 794563007ae479c431e33859b0e4ca0ec801f5ed.title: Hospital-Specific Bias in Patch-Based Pathology Models
794563007ae479c431e33859b0e4ca0ec801f5ed.abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) achieve strong performance on diverse histopathology tasks, but their sensitivity to hospital-specific domain shifts remains underexplored. We systematically evaluate state-of-the-art PFMs on TCGA patch-level datasets and introduce a lightweight adversarial adaptor to remove hospital-related domain information from latent representations. Experiments show that, while disease classification accuracy is largely maintained, the adaptor effectively reduces hospital-specific bias, as confirmed by t-SNE visualizations. Our study establishes a benchmark for assessing cross-hospital robustness in PFMs and provides a practical strategy for enhancing generalization under heterogeneous clinical settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/MengRes/pfm_domain_bias.

7930c718f9c420964321bc68e88e389787e5e40a.title: Predictive Modeling of Mood Using Functional Network Connectivity: Differential Impacts in Exercise + Smart and Control Groups
7930c718f9c420964321bc68e88e389787e5e40a.abstract: Accurate mood prediction is essential for understanding brain health dynamics and developing interventions, particularly among young adult populations such as undergraduate students. This study explores the use of static functional network connectivity (sFNC) measures from resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) data to predict a composite mood index reflecting anxiety, depression, and stress. An autoencoder was employed to capture nonlinear relationships among mood variables, followed by Gaussian process regression (GPR) to predict the composite index at baseline and post-intervention, as well as changes over time. The model demonstrated strong predictive performance, with $R^{2}$ values of 0.60 (baseline), 0.81 (post-intervention), and 0.64 (change). 792f78916ee5ecbb8827c6bf303f50fe6cbc1668.title: SFENet: Shallow Feature Excitation for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
792f78916ee5ecbb8827c6bf303f50fe6cbc1668.abstract: Retinal vessel segmentation is crucial for ophthalmic diagnosis, yet deploying deep learning models on mobile devices remains challenging due to high computational complexity. We propose a lightweight framework, SFENet, that achieves accurate segmentation with minimal resource requirements. Unlike traditional U-Net-based models that rely on deep, computationally intensive encoders, SFENet employs a streamlined single-branch architecture and emphasizes shallow features. Its core innovations include three modules: a hierarchical receptive field module (HRFM) for efficient multi-scale feature extraction, a feature refinement module (FRM) for enhancing vessel detail through dual-branch fusion, and a spatial context mining module (SCMM) for modeling long-range dependencies to ensure vessel continuity. 78a78a4fdcab469190562623b5fa55c40d26abb1.abstract: The molecular diagnosis of $O^{6}$-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) is a critical biomarker for evaluating the prognosis and therapeutic response in glioma patients. However, current machine learning and deep learning methods for predicting MGMT status from multi-modal data suffer from limited classification accuracy and insufficient interpretability of inter-modal relationships. To overcome these limitations, a novel Graph-in-Graph Network (GiG-Net) is proposed to jointly enhance predictive performance and cross-modal explainability. The proposed framework constructs a Position-wise Multi-modal Fusion Graph (PMFG) to model correlations among MRI sequences and radiomic features, followed by a Spatial Relation Graph (SRG) that integrates fused multi-modal representations to capture spatial dependencies. 77761f8dfc517e0bd66f1af88831af9338b6a68e.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Framework for Coronary Artery Lesions in CTCA
77761f8dfc517e0bd66f1af88831af9338b6a68e.abstract: Coronary artery disease is a leading cause of mortality world-wide, emphasizing the need for accurate and efficient detection methods. Current deep learning approaches for coronary lesion detection in computed tomography coronary angiog-raphy (CTCA) rely on large labeled datasets for supervised learning, limiting scalability. This study proposes an unsu-pervised framework for coronary lesion detection in CTCA. Using vessel linearization, we generated small linear volume patches from CTCA and trained a deep autoencoder model, MemAE, exclusively on normal patches to detect anomalies based on reconstruction error without lesion location labels. Results on a public dataset demonstrate high accuracy, achieving 97.5% on per-patient average reconstruction error and 85% using the number of patches with high reconstruction error, offering a scalable and accessible solution.

Early retinal fluid accumulation is a key biomarker, and Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) provides noninvasive, high-resolution retinal imaging essential for diagnosis. Accurate segmentation of retinal structures is crucial, yet recent conventional deep learning approaches often do not provide satisfactory performance because fluid regions occupy a small portion of the image, leading to inefficient computation and reduced accuracy. 7724a17b51c440c5f1fcbb504310ece9a2624b10.title: Human-Aligned Learning of Interpretable Biomarkers for Lung Ultrasound Diagnosis
7724a17b51c440c5f1fcbb504310ece9a2624b10.abstract: Lung ultrasound (LUS) offers rapid, radiation-free bedside imaging, yet automated interpretation remains constrained by the opacity of end-to-end deep learning models. We propose a framework that explicitly aligns learned representations with human clinical reasoning by supervising models to predict interpretable visual biomarkers - clinician-recognized patterns such as A-lines, B-lines, and pleural irregularities - prior to diagnostic inference. This biomarker-aligned representation serves as a compact, semantically meaningful intermediate space for downstream tasks including lungseverity scoring, S/F ratio estimation, and disease classification. 75b2c9b30f1542b048e873d3bc1b6c16157e0ed1.title: Morphogenetic Field Loss for Unified Medical Image Segmentation

73300273ade55b85f1b87932910e1780a78108d3.title: Graphtrack: Automated Longitudinal Lesion Tracking in Ct Via Local-Global Reasoning With Contrastive and Graph Learning
73300273ade55b85f1b87932910e1780a78108d3.abstract: Accurate lesion tracking in longitudinal CT scans is essential for streamlining treatment response and disease progression evaluation in oncology, but current clinical workflows remain largely manual and variable. We propose GraphTrack, a two-stage deep learning framework that unifies local and global reasoning for automated lesion correspondence. First, a self-supervised 3D Masked Autoencoder (3DMAE) pretrains transferable lesion representations, fine-tuned within a 3D Siamese Neural Network (3DSNN) via contrastive learning for pairwise similarity estimation. Then, these features are integrated into an Edge Graph Attention Network (EdgeGAT) with similarity-based curriculum learning to model spatial, temporal, and morphological dependencies. 70565a9e6ee8f9d5547f2015e771bc78d319b0e3.abstract: Ischemic stroke is a major cause of global disability, making outcome prediction crucial for effective management. In this study, we propose an approach using a tabular transformer to fuse diffusion weighted MRI and clinical variables for stroke outcome prediction. The 3-month modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score serves as the ground truth for forecasting patient outcomes. 6fccafc17346de78de49b6d46408bc58db169f6d.title: Task-Aware Functional Hypergraph Learning for Brain State Classification via Information Bottleneck
6fccafc17346de78de49b6d46408bc58db169f6d.abstract: Functional connectivity networks (FCNs) are widely used in fMRI-based brain analysis. While most existing studies represent FCNs using graphs, traditional graph structures primarily focus on pairwise connections, overlooking higher-order relationships. Additionally, many methods construct graphs or hypergraphs independently of downstream tasks, which can result in suboptimal representations that fail to capture task-relevant structures. To address these limitations, we propose a novel approach that integrates task-specific information directly into the hypergraph construction process. 6f28278013dfc50722d9704fb904351345c2c5c5.title: Cardiac Output Prediction From Echocardiograms: Self-Supervised Learning with Limited Data
6f28278013dfc50722d9704fb904351345c2c5c5.abstract: Cardiac Output (CO) is a key parameter in the diagnosis and management of cardiovascular diseases. However, its accurate measurement requires right-heart catheterization, an invasive and time-consuming procedure, motivating the development of reliable non-invasive alternatives using echocardiography. In this work, we propose a self-supervised learning (SSL) pretraining strategy based on SimCLR to improve CO prediction from apical four-chamber echocardiographic videos. The pretraining is performed using the same limited dataset available for the downstream task, demonstrating the potential of SSL even under data scarcity. Our results show that SSL mitigates overfitting and improves representation learning, achieving an average Pearson correlation of 0.41 on the test set and outperforming PanEcho, a model trained on over one million echocardiographic exams.

6de5a3da732ae2961e3f58a60e66cb62f455e995.title: Deepsrs: Enhancing Stimulated Raman Scattering Imaging Through Multi-Stage Deep Learning for Super-Resolution and Denoising
6de5a3da732ae2961e3f58a60e66cb62f455e995.abstract: DeepSRS is a multi-stage deep learning framework designed to enhance Stimulated Raman Scattering (SRS) microscopy images by addressing both denoising and super-resolution challenges. The pipeline combines an autoencoder-based spectral denoiser with fine-tuned generative models—namely GAN and diffusion architectures—to achieve rapid, high-fidelity reconstruction. DeepSRS attains up to fourfold lateral superresolution, markedly improving signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), structural similarity, and perceptual quality metrics. This integrated approach expands the analytical capabilities of nonlinear optical imaging and opens new avenues for biochemical visualization, histological interpretation, and quantitative microscopy in both research and clinical settings.

6d438f34abc33d5e0e6d0011c979e5c2b3a78894.abstract: Multi-organ segmentation holds paramount significance in many clinical tasks. It remains challenging to train a single model that can robustly learn from several partially labelled datasets due to label conflict and data imbalance problems. We propose MO-CTranS: a single model that can overcome such problems. MO-CTranS contains a CNN-based encoder and a Transformer-based decoder, which are connected in a multi-resolution manner. 6cd8390b1856426f4dd97424defaac57d6eac72a.title: DA-GMGENet: A Domain Adaptation Framework for 3D CT-Based ECE Identification in Head and Neck Cancer

6c19c6a224c715d2b5a6c37c31b7c4c1f04b8092.title: Functional-Positional Context Embedding in Graph Neural Networks for Improved Parkinson's Disease Diagnosis
6c19c6a224c715d2b5a6c37c31b7c4c1f04b8092.abstract: Graph neural networks for fMRI data often emphasize region-to-region similarities but neglect important factors like hemispheric asymmetry and functional grouping. We introduce a novel framework integrating Functional and Positional Context Embedding with Hemispheric Asymmetry Features to enhance early-stage Parkinson's Disease classification. Our approach refines graph representations of functional connectivity, yielding improved detection of subtle pathological patterns. These findings underscore the value of neuroscience-informed design in brain connectivity analysis.

6b97ca7c7586879f2c91b260e135cbd99d7dcf93.title: CODE: A SELF-SUPERVISED CONSISTENCY MODEL FRAMEWORK FOR MRI DENOISING
6b97ca7c7586879f2c91b260e135cbd99d7dcf93.abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is great for visualizing soft tissues and quantitative assessment of tissue properties, but its acquisitions are often limited by signal noise originating from the patient's thermal and physiological processes, motion, and hardware limitations/imperfections. We propose CoDe, a self-supervised consistency model (CM) framework that achieves efficient one-step MRI denoising. Our approach consists of two components: a noise estimation model that predicts the noise level of the input image and a CM performing one-step denoising to recover clean images. Additionally, we introduce a Random Matrix Theory (RMT)-based regularization that leverages physical noise statistics to enhance structural fidelity. Experiments on public brain and in-house prostate diffusion MRI datasets demonstrate that CoDe achieves superior image quality compared with existing methods while
6b97ca7c7586879f2c91b260e135cbd99d7dcf93.zh_title: CoDe：自监督一致性模型框架用于MRI去噪

6b97ca7c7586879f2c91b260e135cbd99d7dcf93.zh_abstract: 磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）非常适合软组织可视化和组织特性的定量评估，但其采集常受到信号噪声的限制，这些噪声来源于患者的热过程和生理过程、运动以及硬件限制/不完美。我们提出 CoDe，一种自监督一致性模型（consistency model, CM）框架，可实现高效的一步 MRI 去噪。我们的方法由两个部分组成：一个预测输入图像噪声水平的噪声估计模型，以及一个执行一步去噪以恢复干净图像的 CM。此外，我们引入基于随机矩阵理论（Random Matrix Theory, RMT）的正则化，利用物理噪声统计量来增强结构保真度。在公开脑部和内部前列腺扩散 MRI 数据集上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，CoDe 实现了更优的图像质量，同时

6a55184b822c10fc4d5d100b408658c666a91c86.title: From Volumes to Slices: Computationally Efficient Contrastive Learning for Sequential Abdominal CT Analysis
6a55184b822c10fc4d5d100b408658c666a91c86.abstract: The requirement for expert annotations limits the effectiveness of deep learning for medical image analysis. Although 3D self-supervised methods like volume contrast learning (VoCo) are powerful and partially address the labeling scarcity issue, their high computational cost and memory consumption are barriers. We propose 2D-VoCo, an efficient adaptation of the VoCo framework for slice-level self-supervised pre-training that learns spatial-semantic features from unlabeled 2D CT slices via contrastive learning. The pre-trained CNN backbone is then integrated into a CNN-LSTM architecture to classify multi-organ injuries. In the RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma dataset, 2D-VoCo pretraining significantly improves mAP, precision, recall, and RSNA score over training from scratch. Our framework provides a practical method to reduce the dependency on labeled data and enhance model performance in clin
6a55184b822c10fc4d5d100b408658c666a91c86.summary: 提出切片级自监督预训练方法2D-VoCo，降低3D对比学习的算力开销，并在RSNA腹部创伤数据上提升多器官损伤分类指标。

预训练CNN结合CNN-LSTM分类多器官损伤

6a55184b822c10fc4d5d100b408658c666a91c86.zh_abstract: 对专家标注的需求限制了深度学习在医学图像分析中的有效性。尽管诸如体对比学习（volume contrast learning，VoCo）的 3D 自监督方法很强大，并部分解决了标注稀缺问题，但其高计算成本和内存消耗仍是障碍。我们提出 2D-VoCo，这是 VoCo 框架的一种高效适配，用于切片级自监督预训练，通过对比学习从无标注的 2D CT 切片中学习空间语义特征。随后，将预训练的 CNN 主干集成到 CNN-LSTM 架构中对多器官损伤进行分类。在 RSNA 2023 腹部创伤数据集中，与从头训练相比，2D-VoCo 预训练显著提高了 mAP、精确率、召回率和 RSNA 评分。我们的框架提供了一种实用方法，可降低对标注数据的依赖并增强模型在临床

6a44b28a474786a92598f3c820b40e8d529a7dad.title: Uncertainty Analysis in Intravascular Oct Segmentation
6a44b28a474786a92598f3c820b40e8d529a7dad.abstract: Integrating uncertainty quantification (UQ) into optical coherence tomography (OCT) segmentation could enhance model reliability and clinical interpretability. Using an ensemble-based model, we estimated pixelwise entropy as a measure of uncertainty and compared it to segmentation accuracy and inter-observer variability. Higher entropy was associated with lower accuracy: uncertain predictions had lower Dice scores and larger measurement errors, particularly in complex structures. Regions of annotator disagreement coincided with elevated model uncertainty. Entropy-based UQ thus provides an interpretable confidence measure, supporting selective human review and more trustworthy AI-assisted OCT analysis.

67ce077ea44a3c96ea7ea4674fd6534caf0e68e6.title: Foundation Model-Guided Iteratively Prompting and Pseudo-Labeling for Partially Labeled Medical Image Segmentation
67ce077ea44a3c96ea7ea4674fd6534caf0e68e6.abstract: Automated medical image segmentation has achieved remarkable progress with fully labeled data. However, sitespecific clinical priorities and the high cost of manual annotation often yield scans with only a subset of organs labeled, leading to the partially labeled problem that degrades performance. To address this issue, we propose IPnP, an Iteratively Prompting and Pseudo-labeling framework, for partially labeled medical image segmentation. IPnP iteratively generates and refines pseudo-labels for unlabeled organs through collaboration between a trainable segmentation network (specialist) and a frozen foundation model (generalist), progressively recovering full-organ supervision. On the public dataset AMOS with the simulated partial-label setting, IPnP consistently improves segmentation performance over prior methods and approaches the performance of the fully labeled reference. 67ce077ea44a3c96ea7ea4674fd6534caf0e68e6.zh_abstract: 在完全标注数据下，自动化医学图像分割已取得显著进展。然而，特定站点的临床优先级以及人工标注的高成本，常导致扫描图像中仅有一部分器官被标注，从而引发部分标注问题并降低性能。为解决该问题，我们提出 IPnP，一种用于部分标注医学图像分割的迭代提示与伪标注（Iteratively Prompting and Pseudo-labeling）框架。IPnP 通过可训练分割网络（specialist）与冻结基础模型（generalist）之间的协作，迭代生成并优化未标注器官的伪标签，逐步恢复全器官监督。在采用模拟部分标注设置的公开数据集 AMOS 上，IPnP 持续优于先前方法的分割性能，并接近完全标注参考的性能。我们进一步

67c05128aae919bca677638d34ae95d6eb2b4727.title: All-Subtype Cataract Classification and Grading in AS-OCT via a Unified Multi-Task Framework
67c05128aae919bca677638d34ae95d6eb2b4727.abstract: Automated cataract grading based on Anterior Segment Optical Coherence Tomography (AS-OCT) plays a key role in objective diagnosis. However, current approaches are restricted to single-subtype analysis, limiting their clinical applicability. We propose a unified multitask framework that concurrently performs lens subregion segmentation and severity grading for cortical, nuclear, and posterior subcapsular cataracts. The framework integrates three modules: an Implicit Boundary Rendering (IBR) module for sub-pixel boundary refinement, a Laplacian Feature Masking (LFM) module for subregion-specific feature separation, and a Multi-Granularity Experts Fusion (MGEF) module for adaptive feature integration. Experiments on 2,088 AS-OCT images demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving IoU by up to 4 % and grading accuracy by 3-10 % compared with existing models.

67c05128aae919bca677638d34ae95d6eb2b4727.zh_abstract: 基于眼前节光学相干断层扫描（Anterior Segment Optical Coherence Tomography, AS-OCT）的自动化白内障分级在客观诊断中发挥关键作用。然而，当前方法局限于单一亚型分析，限制了其临床适用性。我们提出一个统一的多任务框架，可同时执行晶状体亚区域分割以及皮质性、核性和后囊下白内障的严重程度分级。该框架集成三个模块：用于亚像素边界细化的隐式边界渲染（Implicit Boundary Rendering, IBR）模块、用于亚区域特定特征分离的拉普拉斯特征掩蔽（Laplacian Feature Masking, LFM）模块，以及用于自适应特征集成的多粒度专家融合（Multi-Granularity Experts Fusion, MGEF）模块。在 2,088 张 AS-OCT 图像上的实验表明，我们的方法达到最先进性能，与现有模型相比，IoU 最高提升 4%，分级准确率提升 3-10%。

67baa1d588f5fbdf310a5c57f860e58454b3d92e.title: A BI-OBJECTIVE BUDGETED SET-COVER FORMULATION FOR OPTIMISINGINVERSE-GEOMETRY X-RAY CT ARCHITECTURES
67baa1d588f5fbdf310a5c57f860e58454b3d92e.abstract: Current X ray computed tomography uses cone beam and fan beam architectures guided by clinical requirements. We investigate inverse geometry CT (IGCT), which flips the standard acquisition paradigm by replacing a single source and a large detector with multiple sources and a small detector. For practical realisation and in order to limit acquisition time, we focus on configurations with a small detector and a limited number of sources, which leads to truncation artefacts and insufficient angular coverage for some voxels. To mitigate these artefacts, we focus on optimising the spatial placement of a fixed budget of sources for imaging an organ of interest. We cast the problem as a linear integer program based on budgeted set cover, with a bi-objective, hierarchical structure. Finally, we present an approximation framework based on a stochastic algorithm to efficiently solve this problem.

6785576e31db748e1a41e0a057f51e5997dbfd00.abstract: Acquiring high-quality synthetic computed tomography (sCT) images from cone-beam CT is crucial for accurate dose calculation in the field of adaptive radiotherapy. However, existing sCT generation methods based on diffusion models often struggle to preserve anatomical structures, especially when the anatomical structure of the input CBCT and ground-truth CT differs in shape. To address this, we propose a Hierarchical Anatomical-Guided Diffusion (HAGD) framework that captures both global semantic information and local textural details for anatomical-aware sCT generation. We first introduce a dual-branch encoder to simultaneously extract features from coarse structural masks and fine segmentation maps. 6754ef110e60a81dacf8b99a24209e5ab89ef938.title: SEGMENTATION CONFIDENCE FOR ARBITRARY CNNS
6754ef110e60a81dacf8b99a24209e5ab89ef938.abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.

670d0e59f89d4868f161b5d7b3fef9bc000dc197.abstract: We present a multi-task framework for simultaneous fetal cardiac structure segmentation (14 classes, 4 views) and congenital heart disease (CHD) classification (7 pathologies) from prenatal ultrasound, developed for the FETUS 2026 Challenge at ISBI. Classification is performed through a multi-scale attention pooling and a morphological feature head. 658d9e7e96e700520f8e4f05e42ac979af214a07.title: A Multi-Modal Variational Hypergraph Autoencoder for Structural-Functional Brain Connectivity Analysis
658d9e7e96e700520f8e4f05e42ac979af214a07.abstract: Brain connectivity analysis offers critical insights on understanding and classifying neurological disorders. However, conventional graph neural networks (GNNs) used in existing studies are limited to pairwise connections, and fail to capture higher-order interactions among brain regions. To address this gap, we propose a Multi-Modal Variational Hypergraph Autoencoder (MVHGAE) that integrates both structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) within a unified hypergraph representation. The variational formulation enables probabilistic latent encoding of brain connectivity patterns, facilitating more robust and generalizable representations across subjects. Unlike generic Hypergraph Neural Networks (HGNNs), the proposed architecture incorporates dynamic node-edge weighting and deterministic feature fusion for enhanced stability. 64f8430952dfcb6adbab229193d1654424b201c3.abstract: Opportunistic coronary artery calcification (CAC) scoring using chest computed tomography (CT) scans is a valuable tool for predicting cardiovascular event risk. Despite over 15 million chest CT scans performed annually, routine CAC scoring remains limited due to the manual labor involved. Although deep learning algorithms have shown promise in segmenting CAC lesions for risk evaluation, widespread adoption is still lacking because of the costs associated with these technologies and the difficulties in integrating them into existing clinical workflows. In this study, we propose a pipeline for CAC segmentation and risk classification. We first train a segmentation model on gated CT scans and subsequently fine-tune it using a smaller dataset of non-gated scans. 64a047c9ee53af6916563b605461259b933ec66a.title: RDTE-UNet: A Boundary and Detail Aware UNet for Precise Medical Image Segmentation
64a047c9ee53af6916563b605461259b933ec66a.abstract: Medical image segmentation is essential for computer-assisted diagnosis and treatment planning, yet substantial anatomical variability and boundary ambiguity hinder reliable delineation of fine structures. We propose RDTE-UNet, a segmentation network that unifies local modeling with global context to strengthen boundary delineation and detail preservation. RDTE-UNet employs a hybrid ResBlock detail-aware Transformer backbone and three modules: ASBE for adaptive boundary enhancement, HVDA for fine-grained feature modeling, and EulerFF for fusion weighting guided by Euler's formula. Together, these components improve structural consistency and boundary accuracy across morphology, orientation, and scale. 6432470c674335d3135abc78cdd6cc498f148230.title: CROSS-MODAL FINE-TUNING OF 3D CONVOLUTIONAL FOUNDATION MODELS FOR ADHD CLASSIFICATION WITH LOW-RANK ADAPTATION
6432470c674335d3135abc78cdd6cc498f148230.abstract: Early diagnosis of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children plays a crucial role in improving outcomes in education and mental health. Diagnosing ADHD using neuroimaging data, however, remains challenging due to heterogeneous presentations and overlapping symptoms with other conditions. To address this, we propose a novel parameter-efficient transfer learning approach that adapts a large-scale 3D convolutional foundation model, pre-trained on CT images, to an MRI-based ADHD classification task. Our method introduces Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in 3D by factorizing 3D convolutional kernels into 2D low-rank updates, dramatically reducing trainable parameters while achieving superior performance. 63ec8583eedf4153e3bd2ad91eba681b23f78e91.title: Useful Nonrobust Features are Ubiquitous in Biomedical Images
63ec8583eedf4153e3bd2ad91eba681b23f78e91.abstract: We study whether deep networks for medical imaging learn useful nonrobust features - predictive input patterns that are not human interpretable and highly susceptible to small adversarial perturbations - and how these features impact test performance. We show that models trained only on nonrobust features achieve well-above-chance accuracy across five MedMNIST classification tasks, confirming their predictive value in-distribution. Conversely, adversarially trained models that primarily rely on robust features sacrifice indistribution accuracy but yield markedly better performance under controlled distribution shifts (MedMNIST-C). Overall, nonrobust features boost standard accuracy yet degrade out-of-distribution performance, revealing a practical robustnessaccuracy trade-off in medical imaging classification tasks that should be tailored to the requirements of the deployment setting.

63df01408d59840e92a53bfb57251d683729638a.title: Survival Modeling from Whole Slide Images Via Patch-Level Graph Clustering and Mixture Density Experts
63df01408d59840e92a53bfb57251d683729638a.abstract: We present a modular framework for predicting cancerspecific survival from whole-slide pathology images (WSIs). The approach integrates four main components: (i) Quantile-Based Patch Filtering, which employs quantile-based thresholding to identify prognostically informative tissue regions; (ii) Graph Regularized Patch Clustering using $k$-NN graph to model phenotype-level heterogeneity through spatial-morphological coherence; (iii) Hierarchical Feature Aggregation for learning intra- and inter-cluster dependencies; and (iv) an Expert Guided Mixture Density Modeling module to estimate complex survival distributions using Gaussian distributions. The proposed model achieves a concordance index of $0.653 \pm 0.037$ on TCGA-LUAD, $0.719 \pm 0.011$ on TCGA-KIRC, and $0.733 \pm 0.037$ on TCGA-BRCA, surpassing current state-of-the-art methods.

This work introduces a cross-modal image learning framework that can automatically determine HER2 status directly from routine Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained whole-slide images, reducing the need for IHC images. Our model learns from paired H&E-IHC samples to capture subtle tissue structures and patterns in H&E images that reflect HER2 expression. 63663431daac59ea1208ddb11965a2a651138c3a.title: Mobile Augmented Reality for Hip Osteotomy Planning: Integration with 3D Slicer and Pilot Evaluation

60deb1e0a1c3842a4fc4fdb27193d24b51246532.title: Semi-Supervised Learning for Congenital Heart Disease Prediction in Fetal Echocardiography
60deb1e0a1c3842a4fc4fdb27193d24b51246532.abstract: Fetal echocardiography is widely used for prenatal congenital heart disease (CHD) screening, but automated analysis is difficult due to strong speckle noise, large view variation, and severe class imbalance. This challenge evaluates semisupervised anatomical segmentation and multi-label CHD classification, and the final ranking is a weighted combination of classification score, segmentation score, and processing time. We then perform multi-label CHD classification with a patch-andglobal framework using a self-supervised Vision Transformer backbone. 608ecdd8a5036ff4358ac72931f9642ca0847657.abstract: Ultrasound imaging involves diverse anatomical targets and variable acquisition settings, which complicates the creation of broadly applicable analytical tools. Conventional deep learning approaches are often narrowly tailored to individual tasks, which restricts their potential to serve as versatile foundation models in clinical contexts. 60170f6f1c4cc3deb29ae85b76ced8f64ab46ada.title: Joint Multiscale Image Learning for Segmentation in Macroscopic and Microscopic Pathology Images
60170f6f1c4cc3deb29ae85b76ced8f64ab46ada.abstract: Image segmentation at both macroscopic and microscopic level is important in digital pathology. In these images, visually similar regions within the same image often share semantic characteristics, offering an opportunity for intra-image reference learning. Our approach builds upon a whole image segmentation model and introduces a complementary part level module that enables mutual referencing among image regions. 5fc8754dfbd56d5e8f9ef65b309223026f944747.title: Adaptive Gradient Domain Normalization for One-Sided Unsupervised Medical Image Synthesis

We adapt the normalization of the gradient field of the generated image to match the target gradient magnitude distribution, encouraging the generator towards anatomically-sound outputs with appropriate preservation or suppression of local gradient alignment. 5f88c542a21be3d157b143c6b418a75436dab6ee.title: Multi-Scale Attention Framework with Transformer Architecture for Explainable Chest X-Ray Report Generation
5f88c542a21be3d157b143c6b418a75436dab6ee.abstract: Automated chest X-ray (CXR) report generation addresses the critical shortage of radiologists while improving diagnostic efficiency. We propose an enhanced deep learning framework integrating multi-scale attention mechanisms with transformer-based architectures for clinically accurate and explainable radiology report generation. Our model employs EfficientNetB3 with spatial and channel attention modules, coupled with a multi-layer transformer decoder optimized for medical text generation. Comprehensive experiments on the MIMIC-CXR dataset demonstrate superior performance (BLEU-1: 0.418, BLEU-4: 0.195, ROUGE-L: 0.321) while providing interpretable attention visualizations highlighting diagnostically relevant regions. The integrated explainability framework makes our approach suitable for clinical deployment and decision support systems.

5ea7227a6ec1f2874b2fee8c8e5c7b410a493b44.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enhanced the interpretability of disease diagnosis, leading to more accurate outcomes and improved patient understanding. This approach combines visual details with expert medical language, enabling MLLMs to detect patterns and disease indicators effectively. 5c1b3ddf951519df50de0103a71d28863cc43d62.title: Abdominal Segmentation and Blood Vessel Detection in CTA Scans for Diep Reconstruction Procedures
5c1b3ddf951519df50de0103a71d28863cc43d62.abstract: Deep Inferior Epigastric Perforator (DIEP) flap reconstruction requires precise identification of perforator vessels traversing the abdominal muscle to supply the fat and skin tissues. Computed tomography angiography (CTA) reveals contrast-enhanced blood vessels critical for the DIEP surgical harvesting selection. CTA annotation is time-consuming and expertise-dependent, requiring clinicians to trace small perforator vessels through hundreds of image slices. We present an end-to-end automated pipeline that receives raw CTA scans and performs ROI extraction, deep learning multi-class segmentation and detection of perforation points. The pipeline achieves effective segmentation with reliable detection of critical anatomical landmarks. It can reduce pre-operative preparation time while maintaining clinical accuracy for improved surgical planning and navigation.

59f400dbccf48e6d22ca3229e52c9153c1691511.abstract: The application of deep learning models to neuroimaging data has proven to be a powerful approach for understanding and predicting the progression of Alzheimer's disease (AD). A critical factor in improving prediction accuracy lies in in-corporating longitudinal information into these models. Previous approaches integrated longitudinal neuroimaging data from time steps in the future, and evaluated their re-sults on a single heterogeneous group of MCI subjects, con-taining MCI converters (MCI-C) at different stages of disease progression. In this study, we investigate the impact of incorporating past longitudinal neuroimaging information into deep learning models to predict the conversion from mild cognitive im-pairment (MCI) to Alzheimer's disease, and we evaluate our results for different MCI groups with converters at different stages of the disease. 593a646b87f4815d461c3f67f06122c13fa3c842.abstract: Acquiring accurate real-world monocular depth data in surgery is often infeasible. Widely used synthetic datasets can provide accurate ground truth labels, however, these do not reflect variabilities in real-world surgery. To address this limitation, we aim to leverage high-fidelity synthetic depth data and transfer this understanding to diverse surgical dataset. To achieve this, we introduce a novel efficient teacher-student architecture, namely “PatchSurg”. Our PatchSurg exploits the structural details in synthetic datasets and transfers it to realworld cases by mitigating the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, using a detail and scale disentangling technique. 57a5cce9b55a9aa1581b86d620b5c4feeffa75e6.abstract: Generating synthetic CT images from CBCT or MRI has a potential for efficient radiation dose planning and adaptive radiotherapy. However, existing CNN-based models lack global semantic understanding, while Transformers often overfit small medical datasets due to high model capacity and weak inductive bias. To address these limitations, we propose a DINOv3-Guided Cross Fusion (DGCF) framework that integrates a frozen self-supervised DINOv3 Transformer with a trainable CNN encoder-decoder. It hierarchically fuses global representation of Transformer and local features of CNN via a learnable cross fusion module, achieving balanced local appearance and contextual representation. 5744defd7d63267bf03be4669a140ace1a100466.title: Rethinking Slide-Level Adaptation of Pathology Foundation Models
5744defd7d63267bf03be4669a140ace1a100466.abstract: The emergence of pathology foundation models (PFMs) has transformed histopathological image analysis, replacing conventional image encoders pretrained on natural images and becoming the mainstream feature extractor for patches in whole slide images (WSIs). To perform slide-level analysis, multiple instance learning (MIL) remains the dominant paradigm. However, such approaches rely on task-specific slide-level representations, which often lack generality and carry a risk of feature overfitting. Another simple way is to directly aggregate patch features into a slide representation via training-free pooling methods. We propose DPANet, a Dual-Path Prior-guided Attention Network for Few-Shot IVUS Segmentation. 5370da6239224f6abd19c2170e25ee652b9f7a72.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP and BLIP have demonstrated strong generalization in visual reasoning tasks. 52e0101d6ef5d9e1e017134f8294aa28efdbbec0.title: Frugal-Combat: An Ultra-Low-Sample Diffusion MRI Harmonization Method
52e0101d6ef5d9e1e017134f8294aa28efdbbec0.abstract: MRI is highly sensitive to site-specific acquisition conditions (e.g., scanner models, protocols). To avoid unwanted biases, multicentric studies require a harmonization step to mitigate these scanner-specific effects. One widely used method is ComBat, which has proven effective when a sufficiently large number of subjects per site, preferably healthy controls (HC), are available to ensure reliable statistical estimation. 517c3e2fc5e5c863b1c202a109b0f9ea4ca5269c.title: Conformal Coronary Calcification Volume Estimation with Conditional Coverage via Histogram Clustering
517c3e2fc5e5c863b1c202a109b0f9ea4ca5269c.abstract: Incidental detection and quantification of coronary calcium in CT scans could lead to the early introduction of lifesaving clinical interventions. However, over-reporting could negatively affect patient wellbeing and unnecessarily burden the medical system. Therefore, careful considerations should be taken when automatically reporting coronary calcium scores. A cluster-based conditional conformal prediction framework is proposed to provide score intervals with calibrated coverage from trained segmentation networks without retraining. The proposed method was tuned and used to calibrate predictive intervals for 3D UNet models (deterministic, MCDropout and deep ensemble) reaching similar coverage with better triage metrics compared to conventional conformal prediction. The state-of-the-art point cloud registration methods uniformly or randomly select superpoints to employ a coarse-to-fine registration strategy. Due to the uneven density of shape features in different parts for the knee joint, this selection cannot fully utilize the topological information of bone point cloud. Moreover, the relatively low overlap between the preoperative complete point cloud and the intraoperative partial point cloud makes the accurate registration hard. A point cloud registration method based on chart and learnable superpoint match is proposed in this paper. Radiomic features extracted from plaque, lumen, and union regions were used for vulnerable plaque classification with TabPFN and semi-supervised training. Current prediction models for CLM typically rely on whole slide images (WSIs) and clinical data, rather than fully integrating heterogeneous data sources such as pathology reports, which limits their ability to predict patient outcomes accurately. We introduce a novel multimodal framework for the survival and recurrence prediction of CLM that leverages latent diffusion models (LDMs) and large language models (LLMs), combining visual and textual information. Our approach integrates dual-resolution WSIs with detailed pathology reports to predict critical clinical endpoints, namely Time-to-Recurrence (TTR) and overall survival (OS). 4ea334e5659699161d46485296439c8c3234521b.title: Unified PET Image Enhancement for Diverse Degradation Levels with Mixture-Of-Experts and Dynamic Prompts
4ea334e5659699161d46485296439c8c3234521b.abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) images often suffer from suboptimal quality due to physical constraints and clinical trade-offs, such as radiation dose and scanning time. Thus, PET image enhancement using deep learning is of great importance. However, most existing methods are designed to handle a single degradation level and lack the flexibility to adapt to varying degrees of image degradation. Recently, the all-in-one image restoration paradigm has emerged, aiming to handle multiple types of degradation within a single model. Inspired by this direction, this paper proposes a unified model for enhancing PET images under various degradation conditions, including varying doses and scanning times. 4e03745d0d643187b0e34fe1f34c1726b9db8085.title: Multi-Task Ensemble Learning for Endoscopic Ulcerative Colitis Severity Grading
4e03745d0d643187b0e34fe1f34c1726b9db8085.abstract: Accurate endoscopic grading of Ulcerative Colitis (UC) is critical for clinical decision-making but remains subjective. We present our solution for the IEEE ISBI 2026 EndoUC Challenge, addressing Mayo Endoscopic Score (MES) classification (4 classes) and UCEIS score classification (9 classes). Our approach combines a ConvNeXt-Base backbone with multitask auxiliary supervision using UCEIS sub-component annotations, a Class-Distance Weighted Cross-Entropy (CDW-CE) loss respecting ordinal structure, and 5-fold ensemble with 7-variant test-time augmentation. On the hidden test set, our method achieved 46.0% F1/67.2% AUC on Task 1 and 35.8% $\text{F1}/65.1 \%$ AUC on Task 2, attaining the highest F1 and AUC on Task 2 among all teams. We analyze the distribution shift observed across all participants and discuss implications for robust UC grading.

4cb76757dd7e2a7e3d2c9381020cd6f6b6d9f856.title: Federated Few-Shot Segmentation for Rare Brain Tumours via Weighted Aggregation and Prototype-Guided Adaptation
4cb76757dd7e2a7e3d2c9381020cd6f6b6d9f856.abstract: Brain tumour segmentation is a fundamental task for neurooncological diagnosis and treatment planning. However, the scarcity of annotated data for rarer tumour types such as metastases limits the applicability of deep learning models. Federated learning (FL) enables multi-institutional collaboration without sharing patient data, yet existing approaches struggle with data imbalance, domain heterogeneity, and fewshot generalisation to new centers. We propose a federated framework designed for rare brain tumour segmentation that introduces three key modules: (1) client-specific weighted aggregation to improve fairness and stability under heterogeneous data quality, (2) a cross-attention decoder interaction to enable positive knowledge transfer between tumour types, and (3) a prototype-based decoder initialisation (ProtoInit++) for efficient few-shot adaptation to new centers. 4c61d3b6a6ed308ba4461e27691307a325f59a4e.abstract: This work proposes Bonnet, an ultra-fast sparse-volume pipeline for whole-body bone segmentation from CT scans. 4beb38174b6eed1b6a492747008e34e7a8c171b2.title: Artifact Correction and Quality Assessment via Perceptual Contrastive Learning on Diffusion MRI
4beb38174b6eed1b6a492747008e34e7a8c171b2.abstract: Diffusion MRI is crucial for examining the microstructure of brain tissues, which are often affected by artifacts such as ghosting and motion distortions that hinder analysis. 4b730406bfe0a00816b43a97de736994ca958766.title: Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans
4b730406bfe0a00816b43a97de736994ca958766.abstract: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topologypreserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.

4b730406bfe0a00816b43a97de736994ca958766.zh_abstract: 从 CT 图像中准确分割结肠对于结直肠疾病分析至关重要，然而基于深度学习的方法常因解剖结构复杂而产生不连通的预测。本研究引入一个三阶段、保持拓扑结构的分割流程来解决该问题。第一阶段执行基于深度学习的初始分割，随后进行中心线桥接以重新连接不相交区域，并通过重建阶段细化连续性。在 TotalSegmentator 和 RAOS 数据集上使用重叠、距离和基于拓扑的指标进行评估，结果表明在保持分割准确性的同时改善了结构一致性。所提出的方法增强了拓扑完整性，使结肠分割在临床和研究应用中更加可靠。

4aafa5feec58f05e00ba4b9b81be01c7e2a69833.abstract: X-ray dark-field radiography provides complementary diagnostic information to conventional attenuation imaging by visualizing microstructural tissue changes through small-angle scattering. However, the limited availability of such data poses challenges for developing robust deep learning models. In this work, we present the first framework for generating dark-field images directly from standard attenuation chest X-rays using an Uncertainty-Guided Progressive Generative Adversarial Network. The model incorporates both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty to improve interpretability and reliability. Experiments demonstrate high structural fidelity of the generated images, with consistent improvement of quantitative metrics across stages. 4a65292bd0bb081e419e5b09c95937afb3b11f0f.abstract: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging is widely used to analyze abnormal brain activity in Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) by modeling the brain as a graph. Recent graph-based approaches employ graph structure learning (GSL), which adaptively infers connectivity among brain regions from data, aiming to identify subtle disease-related alterations. However, existing GSL methods rarely account for an essential characteristic of brain organization, the smallworld network, which reflects local specialization and efficient global integration. Motivated by this limitation, we propose the Small-world Pattern Aware Reconstructed networK (SPARK), a dual-geometry GSL framework designed to incorporate this property into learned structures. Recent medical foundation models have demonstrated strong performance in full-modality brain tumor segmentation by jointly utilizing multiple MRI sequences. However, in clinical practice, missing modalities caused by patient motion, contrast agent intolerance, or acquisition constraints often lead to degraded segmentation accuracy. 49a71bee1e5f2265e7d13ea977c456efd50a603f.title: Quantitative and Qualitative Assessment of Generative AI for Cross-Modal CT-to-MRI Translation in Spine Imaging
49a71bee1e5f2265e7d13ea977c456efd50a603f.abstract: The application of Generative AI for cross-modal image-to-image translation holds significant potential in emergency care, particularly for spinal pathologies such as Cauda Equina Syndrome, where timely MRI access is often critical yet not always accessible. In such cases, synthetic MRI translated from the more readily available CT imaging could provide an interim solution to support clinical assessment. This study compares five generative methods for CT-to-MRI translation through both quantitative analysis using standard computer vision metrics and expert qualitative evaluation via a blinded randomised survey. 4991d00f33168b740a77b1681936e188eb5d196f.title: DINO-MambaSeg: A Foundation-Guided Network for Patchy Atrophy Segmentation
4991d00f33168b740a77b1681936e188eb5d196f.abstract: Pathological myopia (PM) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss, where patchy chorioretinal atrophy (PA) serves as a crucial biomarker of disease progression. Accurate segmentation of PA lesions remains challenging due to low contrast, irregular morphology, and limited annotations. To address these issues, we propose DINO-MambaSeg, a novel segmentation framework driven by foundation models. Our method integrates a frozen DINOv3 encoder with a hybrid Mamba-ASPP module for joint global-local feature refinement. Furthermore, we incorporate an optic disc exclusion prior into the loss function to suppress false positives and enhance anatomical plausibility. We also construct PA-Fundus, a new pixel-level annotated dataset dedicated to PA lesions. 49166ebaebf449f4d81111b0c8186039d798e728.title: TA-MIR: Text Aggregation for Multimodal Feature Representation in Medical Image Registration
49166ebaebf449f4d81111b0c8186039d798e728.abstract: The aggregation of multimodal features in medical image registration remains underexplored, limiting the performance of current models in capturing complex anatomical relationships. Traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) often overlook the rich semantic information available from text, while existing approaches lack effective methods to combine spatial and contextual cues. 4909e6a0db571f50ae51b51de2a5731af09050c0.title: End-to-End Mandibular Reconstruction with Integrated Repositioning and Completion Networks
4909e6a0db571f50ae51b51de2a5731af09050c0.abstract: Patients with mandibular defects require mandibular reconstruction surgery to restore both physiological function and facial morphology. Accurate preoperative planning relies on a complete mandible in its correct anatomical position. However, existing methods primarily focus on morphological completion, without considering anatomical repositioning, which can result in significant issues if the defective mandible is left in a compensatory malposition. This paper presents a novel end-to-end framework that jointly performs mandible repositioning and morphological completion. In the repositioning stage, we predict rigid transformations to restore the displaced mandible to its anatomically correct location. Our pre-trained model can be easily adapted for specific downstream tasks via fine-tuning, serving as a robust backbone for further analysis. 48b2864c059e2002a0b06c061d0755e5faf206dc.abstract: Segmentation of colorectal cancer (CRC) tumors in 3D medical imaging is both complex and clinically critical, providing vital support for effective radiation therapy planning and survival outcome assessment. Recently, 3D volumetric segmentation architectures incorporating long-range sequence modeling mechanisms, such as Transformers and Mamba, have gained attention for their capacity to achieve high accuracy in 3D medical image segmentation. 474dd9a0ae179921bc139dd9dd7ea8a6e2946bf7.title: An Automated Pipeline for Processing and Analysis of Clinical Fetal Diffusion Mri
474dd9a0ae179921bc139dd9dd7ea8a6e2946bf7.abstract: In this work, we present an automated pipeline for processing diffusion MRI (dMRI) data acquired in fetuses in clinical routine. In-vivo fetal dMRI provides critical insight into brain development but is challenging due to motion, low SNR ratio, and artifacts. These challenges are prominent in the clinical routine, with additional constraints on the duration of the scanning session. Existing state-of-the-art pipelines are designed for high-quality research acquisition protocols that are not feasible in routine clinical practice. We introduce a comprehensive framework that integrates robust opensource tools to handle clinical fetal dMRI, performing motion correction, anatomical standardization, and diffusion tensor estimation. The pipeline is complemented by an extended set of anatomical parcellations for the dHCP fetal atlas, enabling detailed regional analysis. Applied to a large clinic

470db98ac46a441b68b6c847085897987b5b959d.title: Numerical Framework for Deep Learning Photoacoustics Image Reconstruction
470db98ac46a441b68b6c847085897987b5b959d.abstract: Photoacoustic imaging (PAI) combines pulsed optical excitation with ultrasound detection to produce high-contrast molecular and structural images of biological tissues. Conventional PAI systems rely on high-energy pulsed lasers that, despite their excellent performance, remain bulky, costly, and constrained by strict safety requirements, limiting their clinical translation. This work explores the use of pulsed semiconductor diodes as a compact, low-cost, and portable alternative. Although these sources exhibit lower peak power and reduced fluence, advanced computational approaches can compensate for these limitations. We present a numerical framework that integrates realistic optical and acoustic simulations with deep learning reconstruction to enhance image quality under low-fluence conditions. The framework accounts for light propagation, transducer response, and acoustic field effects

46eb60c0251c6a83b15fca09a3013b2393db4830.abstract: In recent years, deep learning has achieved remarkable success in medical diagnosis. However, its performance is often limited by small medical datasets, leading to overfitting and poor generalization. Accurate diagnosis also depends on non-image semantic attributes (e.g., age, sex, lifestyle factors), which provide critical complementary context. To address these challenges, we present PnP-SAF, a plug-andplay Semantic-Attribute Fusion framework that enhances data-efficient medical image diagnosis. PnP-SAF can be seamlessly integrated into both CNN- and Transformer-based architectures, enabling effective fusion of semantic attributes with image features in a flexible manner. Two variants of a ResNet-based model, with and without self-attention, were trained and evaluated on simulated 2D ultrasound streams from the clinical data of 97 patients, each patient being associated with a reference volume acquired in a standardized manner. 459d06f8f4a977c3db0cec43f380ae51d5d763fc.abstract: Segmentation plays a crucial role in medical image analysis. Although deep learning models have achieved remarkable results in automatic image segmentation, their training typically demands large amounts of annotated data, which are costly and time-consuming to obtain. Recently, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated strong zero-shot performance in image segmentation. Nevertheless, its effectiveness can be limited in specialized tasks like medical image segmentation that demand deep domain-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose a semi-supervised learning (SSL) model for medical image segmentation that integrates SAM with a domain-specific network to enable effective learning of both scarce labelled and unlabelled data. 441105f2439d91fc6ed25f8299ed496c0e1e5796.title: OpenEEG: Uncertainty-Aware Open Set Learning for EEG-Based Brain Disorders Diagnosis
441105f2439d91fc6ed25f8299ed496c0e1e5796.abstract: Deep learning models for EEG-based brain disorder diagnosis have shown promise, but their clinical utility is hampered by the restrictive closed-set assumption and an inability to quantify predictive uncertainty. This limitation leads to overconfident misclassifications of both unseen disorders and challenging known cases, posing significant safety risks. To address these issues, we propose OpenEEG, an uncertainty-aware open-set learning framework designed to simultaneously reject unknown disease categories and quantify the epistemic uncertainty of its predictions. OpenEEG integrates a Transformer backbone with a UA-Classifier based on evidential deep learning, which learns a Dirichlet distribution over class predictions to derive uncertainty scores. 4300f9b4bff502f762b860099e61fc0312ffa0ff.title: Exploring Xeno-Learning for Brain Image Synthesis: An Image-to-Image Translation Approach to Cross-Species Knowledge Transfer
4300f9b4bff502f762b860099e61fc0312ffa0ff.abstract: Despite an abundance of high-quality mouse neuroimaging data, anatomical divergence from humans limits how findings from this data can be translated into clinical insights or applications. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept for a deep learning-driven image-to-image translation framework that translates parcellations of 23 common regions between mouse and human brain MRI datasets. Our model utilizes species-specific pre-trained autoencoders with principal component analysis dimensionality reduction coupled with a multi-layer perceptron that learns mappings from mouse to human latent encodings. 41f3961416dc1cf04d2a928fdf7db23c6dde051b.abstract: Efficient and accurate whole-brain lesion segmentation re-mains a challenge in medical image analysis. In this work, we revisit MeshNet, a parameter-efficient segmentation model, and introduce a novel multi-scale dilation pattern with an encoder-decoder structure. Its innovations include three aspects: designing an Anatomical Structure Query-based Segmentation Decoder to embed medical prior into global feature learning; proposing a View-Aware Connected Component Loss to dynamically constrain the connected domain morphology of anatomical structures and suppress false positives and structural fragmentation; putting forward a Dual-Threshold Guided Semi-Supervised Classification Learning strategy to maximize the value of unlabeled data and alleviate class imbalance and pseudo-label noise. 40ba616ee50f4e00b511724638282f9972d67bca.title: Time-Embedding U-Net for Temporally Consistent Left Ventricular Segmentation in 3D Echocardiography
40ba616ee50f4e00b511724638282f9972d67bca.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) echocardiography is an inherently noisy modality, but allows for capture of temporally complex cardiac motions. Existing segmentation methods often treat cardiac frames independently, resulting in inconsistent delineations across the cardiac cycle, reduced segmentation accuracy, and, in turn, impacting the estimation of key clinical metrics. To address this, our work introduces temporal positional embeddings based on the cardiac cycle to improve 3D echocardiography segmentation. By encoding cardiac phase information into sinusoidal functions, we inject temporal embeddings into the bottleneck and decoder of a U-Net. Our approach (TU-Net) outperforms state-of-the-art models, including nnU-Net and Transformer baselines, UNETR and SwinUNETR. 3ffcd40d3ad09e2f9323197eed17aafa4e7cde38.title: Line Artifact Removal Over Medical X-Ray Images via Joint Dictionaries Sparse Decomposition with Structured Incoherence
3ffcd40d3ad09e2f9323197eed17aafa4e7cde38.abstract: Line artifact is one of several artifacts that can affect the image quality of X-ray digital radiography. It appears as a sequence of a bright line followed by a darker one with variable intensity over the image. Extracting this artifact is challenging since it can remove some of the medical content and worsen the image quality. In this paper, we present a new line artifact suppression method based on a joint sparse dictionary model where the clinical content dictionary is learned with an incoherence penalty with respect to the artifact model. Tests on a large X-ray dataset show better estimation performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods.

3fd1a236255d01b6d7b3a5c2139d8c4040527e3a.abstract: Congenital heart disease (CHD) is a major cause of infant morbidity and mortality, and fetal ultrasound is the standard modality for prenatal screening. The FETUS Challenge (ISBI 2026) focuses on the joint tasks of fetal cardiac structure segmentation and CHD-related multi-label classification across standard cardiac views under a semi-supervised learning (SSL) setting. We present a view-guided framework with separate models for segmentation and classification, both augmented with an auxiliary standard-view prediction head. To further exploit anatomical information, we introduce a view-specific geometric classifier that derives explicit geometric features from segmentation masks to capture cardiac structural relationships. 3f79a0a98075efbfacc8d7c794fb5be7506f5e15.title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation with Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
3f79a0a98075efbfacc8d7c794fb5be7506f5e15.abstract: Generating healthy counterfactuals from pathological images holds significant promise in anomaly detection or for application of analysis tools designed for healthy scans. These counterfactuals should represent what a patient's scan would plausibly look like in the absence of pathology, preserving individual anatomical characteristics while modifying only the pathological regions. Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) can generate healthy counterfactuals by training on solely healthy data, with the assumption that a partial denoising process will be unable to model disease regions - and will instead reconstruct a closely matched healthy counterpart. More recent methods have incorporated synthetic pathological images to better guide the diffusion process, but it remains challenging to effectively balances the removal of anomalies with the retention of subject-specific features.

3d1859b8fca08633110818d1e21a8f1090a6686f.title: Protostage-NET: A Clinically Guided Foundation Model With Prototypical Learning for Automated Amd Grading From Oct Images
3d1859b8fca08633110818d1e21a8f1090a6686f.abstract: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a major cause of vision loss, where accurate staging is essential for treatment. 3ae6ca19cb977a1fec1497ba47c1addf9e8887b9.title: Meso-Regions: 4D Segmentation of Early Contrast Enhancement Biomarkers for Pleural Mesothelioma Diagnosis

3951cd7ceff364b28bf57a8446165543d9889bc1.abstract: Medical images contain higher spatial correlation between data points compared to natural images. Our approach produces regional interpretable outcomes that effectively capture essential disease features while focusing on rare but critical abnormal regions. 384034ba311ca0f60f1c188e303ec2ff2a235b3b.title: ATRI-Net: A Multimodal and Multifocal Fusion Network for Embryo Euploidy Prediction
384034ba311ca0f60f1c188e303ec2ff2a235b3b.abstract: Selecting euploid embryos during in vitro fertilization (IVF) is crucial for successful implantation, yet conventional preimplantation genetic testing (PGT) is invasive and costly. To overcome these challenges, we have developed ATRI-Net, a high-performance multimodal model designed to predict whether embryos are euploid based on time-lapse videos of embryonic development captured at multiple focal planes, alongside patients' clinical data. ATRI-Net utilizes the Dynamic Multi-Focal Local Space Relation Aggregator (DYMFLSRA) module to fuse multifocal information at each developmental stage of the embryo, employs the UniFormerV2 video understanding model to extract spatiotemporal information, and integrates video features with clinical data using an efficient mutan modality fusion module for prediction. The effectiveness of ATRI-Net has been validated on a novel IVF dataset from the First

376550131337f4fb1b755709b6d1b51e9b9ca088.title: CephRes-MHNet: A Multi-Head Residual Network for Accurate and Robust Cephalometric Landmark Detection
376550131337f4fb1b755709b6d1b51e9b9ca088.abstract: Accurate localization of cephalometric landmarks from 2D lateral skull X-rays is vital for orthodontic diagnosis and treatment. Manual annotation is time-consuming and error-prone, whereas automated approaches often struggle with low contrast and anatomical complexity. This paper introduces CephRes-MHNet, a multi-head residual convolutional network for robust and efficient cephalometric landmark detection. The architecture integrates residual encoding, dual-attention mechanisms, and multi-head decoders to enhance contextual reasoning and anatomical precision. Trained on the Aariz Cephalometric dataset of 1,000 radiographs, CephResMHNet achieved a mean radial error (MRE) of 1.23 mm and a success detection rate (SDR) @ 2.0 mm of 85.5 %, outperforming all evaluated models. 37040d91d62ad1fe00c68e1344e1d090e5d83e0a.title: From Intensity to Anatomy: Optimizing nnU-Net for MR-to-CT Translation on SynthRAD2025
37040d91d62ad1fe00c68e1344e1d090e5d83e0a.abstract: Magnetic resonance (MR) to computed tomography (CT) translation enables a non-ionizing alternative for radiotherapy planning and longitudinal disease monitoring. The SynthRAD2025 dataset provides a large-scale benchmark to evaluate cross-modality synthesis methods across anatomical regions. Building upon the nnU-Net framework, this work revisits its design for image synthesis and proposes key optimizations to establish a strong new baseline. We integrate architectural refinements, a two-stage fine-tuning strategy, and an optimized Anatomical Feature-Prioritized (AFP) loss that leverages pre-trained segmentation features to enhance anatomical fidelity. Best practices for AFP supervision are detailed, including segmentation model configuration and layer selection. Evaluation on SynthRAD2025 combines intensity and segmentation-based metrics, showing that our optimized model ranks first on s

35dc211c0f61f92bdd2c531e44ef7c45465812d8.title: Segmentation of Cardiovascular Structures from Screening Non-contrast CT Calcium Score Images Using the Tuned CardioNC-Segmentator on Virtual CTA Images
35dc211c0f61f92bdd2c531e44ef7c45465812d8.abstract: In this work, we outline the development of a deep learning-based segmentation network aimed at automatically segmenting heart chambers using virtual CT angiography (VCT A) data. Inspired by the structure and methodology of TotalSegmentator, our approach leverages nnU-Net architecture, optimized for the precise delineation of anatomical structures in volumetric medical images. The model is trained on a dataset (N=51) of non-contrast CT calcium score (CTCS) scans, annotated with ground truth segmentations of the heart's atria and ventricles. The integration of virtual CT angiography as a pre-processing step enhances the visibility of cardiac structures, such as large blood pools and adipose and muscle tissues, aiding the model's ability to discern complex boundary regions. Our results demonstrate the network's ability to achieve high agreement in segmenting the left and right atria and ve

35d959c8e3426cf59356f9f4348b15afc6e054bb.title: Machine Learning-Based Polysomnography Data Analysis for ADHD Diagnosis: A Focus on Sleep Stage-Based Biomarkers
35d959c8e3426cf59356f9f4348b15afc6e054bb.abstract: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) significantly impacts children and adults worldwide, posing challenges in neurodevelopmental diagnostics. This study aimed to improve ADHD diagnostic accuracy by identifying sleep stage-based biomarkers for ADHD through the analysis of polysomnography (PSG) recordings, including EEG, EOG, EMG, and ECG signals across five sleep stages. Our analysis included 20,294 epochs for ADHD and 19,968 epochs for non-ADHD from 48 patients. We applied graph metrics, particularly the average shortest path length, to quantify the efficiency of information transfer within brain networks and other physiological systems. We employed nested cross-validation to ensure robust model training and evaluation, with an outer 5-fold cross-validation and an inner GridSearchCV for hyperparameter tuning and model selection. 35ce51a1c99bd1693b238798166b4c0d43218219.title: A Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Prostate Cancer Risk Prediction Integrating Biparametric MRI, Radiology Reports, and Clinical Biomarkers
35ce51a1c99bd1693b238798166b4c0d43218219.abstract: Accurate prostate cancer risk stratification requires integration of heterogeneous clinical data sources that exhibit variable quality and complementary diagnostic information. We propose EFNet-SAF (Expert Fusion Network with Staged Adaptive Fusion), a multimodal framework that integrates Biparametric MRI (DWI, T2-weighted), radiology reports, and clinical biomarkers (e.g.,PSA, Age) through an instance-specific adaptive approach. The architecture employs modality-specific expert networks trained independently with pretrained encoders, followed by adaptive fusion that learns patient-specific modality importance. Hierarchical imaging processing exploits spatial correspondence between DWI and T2 sequences, while clinical biomarkers are incorporated through a learned weighting mechanism. Evaluated on 73 prostate cancer cases using 5 -fold cross-validation, EFNet-SAF achieved an AUROC of $0.9

35a42436ed79848cc29fe662e577525779fb5764.title: Structural Self-Supervision for Label-Free Aortic Dissection Triage on Non-Contrast CT
35a42436ed79848cc29fe662e577525779fb5764.abstract: Effective triage of aortic abnormalities on non-contrast CT (NCCT) is critical for emergency care. Yet automated detection remains difficult due to low vessel–background contrast, resulting in unstable pseudo-segmentations and unreliable supervision. We address this by transforming pseudo-mask instability into a source of structural self-supervision. Instead of suppressing such variability, our framework leverages it to learn normative aortic anatomy and detect deviations indicative of pathology. It integrates three key modules: (1) Prompt-invariant Structural Embedding (PISE) enforces feature consistency across multiple SAM-based prompts; (2) Region-aware Disentanglement (RAD) isolates vessel-wall representations from surrounding tissues; (3) Consistency Evidence Map (CEM) provides transparent, radiologistaligned visualization of abnormal regions. 352f357a5d633a18405637710f1c8e48138195da.title: Otoscopy AI: Deeply Supervised Attention for Otoscopic Image Segmentation
352f357a5d633a18405637710f1c8e48138195da.abstract: Automatic segmentation of otoscopic images is a prevalent challenge and a focus of active research. Recent works in the field adopt convolutional neural networks (CNNs) because of their performance compared to traditional methods. In this paper, we introduce a novel deeply supervised attention (DSA) approach that integrates a deep supervision mechanism with a convolutional block attention module (CBAM) to enhance the model using high-level features from small and uncertain objects. The proposed approach improves the segmentation of 11 otoscopic features, including the tympanic membrane, the cerumen, and abnormalities. Our method is the first architecture to provide segmentation for such abnormalities, reaching 0.80 mAP on average, demonstrating $10-20 \%$ superior performance over existing state-of-the-art methods.
